e.en: The astronauts attended a long {debriefing} after returning home.
e.zh: 宇航员返回后参加了长时间的情况汇报会。

e.en: We're {debriefing} the interns about their first week.
e.zh: 我们正在和实习生们聊他们第一周的感受。

e.en: Workers cleared the {debris} after the storm passed.
e.zh: 风暴过后,工人们清理了残骸。

e.en: Tiny pieces of space {debris} threaten orbiting satellites.
e.zh: 微小的太空碎片威胁着在轨卫星。

e.en: In casual writing some people add an s, calling them {debrises}.
e.zh: 在随意写作中,有人会加 s 写成 debrises。

e.en: Standard English avoids {debrises}; the word debris is uncountable.
e.zh: 标准英语避免使用 debrises,因为 debris 是不可数名词。

e.en: She finally paid off her student loan {debt}.
e.zh: 她终于还清了助学贷款。

e.en: The company is drowning in credit card {debt}.
e.zh: 这家公司被信用卡债务压得喘不过气。

e.en: The court ordered the {debtor} to repay within sixty days.
e.zh: 法院命令债务人在六十天内还款。

e.en: A reliable {debtor} usually qualifies for lower interest rates.
e.zh: 信誉良好的债务人通常能获得更低的利率。

e.en: He worked two jobs to pay off his {debts}.
e.zh: 他打两份工以偿还债务。

e.en: The startup's {debts} grew faster than its revenue.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的负债增长得比收入还快。

e.en: It took hours to {debug} the login flow.
e.zh: 花了好几个小时才调试好登录流程。

e.en: Use console logs to {debug} the React component.
e.zh: 用控制台日志来调试这个 React 组件。

e.en: Set a breakpoint and step through with the {debugger}.
e.zh: 设个断点,然后用调试器逐步执行。

e.en: Chrome's built-in {debugger} is a lifesaver for frontend devs.
e.zh: Chrome 自带的调试器是前端开发者的救星。

debunk.t: v. 揭穿；戳破（谣言、迷思）

e.en: Scientists rushed to {debunk} the viral health rumor.
e.zh: 科学家们迅速出面驳斥这则疯传的健康谣言。

e.en: This article aims to {debunk} common myths about coffee.
e.zh: 这篇文章旨在揭穿关于咖啡的常见误解。

debunker.t: n. 揭穿谎言者；辟谣人

e.en: He built a reputation as a tireless {debunker} of pseudoscience.
e.zh: 他以不知疲倦地揭穿伪科学而闻名。

e.en: The famous {debunker} streams live fact-checks every weekend.
e.zh: 这位著名的揭穿者每周末都会直播事实核查。

debunking.t:
n. 揭穿；辟谣
v. debunk 的现在分词

e.en: Her channel focuses on {debunking} popular conspiracy theories.
e.zh: 她的频道专门揭穿流行的阴谋论。

e.en: The professor spent the lecture {debunking} historical myths.
e.zh: 教授整堂课都在驳斥那些历史迷思。

debussy.t: n. 德彪西（法国作曲家）

e.en: She played a dreamy piece by {Debussy} at the recital.
e.zh: 她在独奏会上演奏了一首德彪西的梦幻曲目。

e.en: {Debussy} is celebrated as a pioneer of musical impressionism.
e.zh: 德彪西被誉为音乐印象派的先驱。

debut.t:
n. 首次亮相；出道
v. 首次登场

e.en: The band will {debut} their new album next week.
e.zh: 乐队将在下周首次发布他们的新专辑。

e.en: Her acting {debut} surprised even the toughest critics.
e.zh: 她的演艺处女作连最严苛的影评人都为之惊艳。

e.en: The young {debutant} scored a goal in his first match.
e.zh: 这位年轻的初登场球员在首秀中就攻入一球。

e.en: Critics praised the novel as the work of a promising {debutant}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部小说出自一位前途无量的新人之手。

debutante.t: n. 初次参加社交的少女；新人

e.en: The {debutante} wore a white gown to the formal ball.
e.zh: 这位初入社交圈的姑娘穿着白色长裙出席正式舞会。

e.en: She was introduced as a {debutante} at the spring gala.
e.zh: 她在春季晚会上作为社交新人被介绍出场。

debuts.t: n./v. debut 的第三人称单数或复数

e.en: The new iPhone {debuts} in stores this Friday.
e.zh: 新款 iPhone 将于本周五在门店首发。

e.en: Most rookie {debuts} are nerve-wracking but exciting.
e.zh: 大多数新人首秀都令人紧张又兴奋。

debutted.t: v. debut 的过去式（首次亮相）

e.en: The startup {debutted} its app at last year's conference.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在去年的大会上首次推出了它的应用。

e.en: Her single {debutted} at number one on the charts.
e.zh: 她的单曲首发就登上了排行榜冠军。

debutting.t: v. debut 的现在分词（首次亮相）

e.en: The director is {debutting} her short film at Sundance.
e.zh: 这位导演将在圣丹斯电影节首映她的短片。

e.en: Several rookies are {debutting} in tonight's basketball game.
e.zh: 几位新人将在今晚的篮球比赛中首次登场。

dec.t: n. December 的缩写；十二月

e.en: The meeting is scheduled for {Dec} 15 at noon.
e.zh: 会议定于 12 月 15 日中午举行。

e.en: My calendar shows three deadlines in early {Dec}.
e.zh: 我日历上显示十二月初有三个截止日期。

e.en: Scientists track {decadal} changes in global temperature.
e.zh: 科学家跟踪全球气温的十年尺度变化。

e.en: The report presents a {decadal} review of energy use.
e.zh: 这份报告对能源使用进行了十年回顾。

e.en: Smartphones have transformed daily life over the past {decade}.
e.zh: 智能手机在过去十年彻底改变了日常生活。

e.en: She spent a {decade} working as a foreign correspondent.
e.zh: 她做了十年的驻外记者。

e.en: The empire's {decadence} eventually led to its collapse.
e.zh: 帝国的颓废最终导致了它的崩溃。

e.en: Critics view fast fashion as modern consumer {decadence}.
e.zh: 评论家把快时尚视为现代消费的颓靡象征。

e.en: We shared a {decadent} chocolate cake after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后我们分享了一块极致诱人的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: The hotel's {decadent} spa offers gold-leaf facials.
e.zh: 这家酒店奢靡的水疗中心提供金箔面部护理。

e.en: The brownie was {decadently} rich and topped with caramel.
e.zh: 这块布朗尼浓郁奢华,上面还淋了焦糖。

e.en: They lived {decadently} during their year in Paris.
e.zh: 他们在巴黎的那一年过着极尽奢华的生活。

e.en: The two friends have known each other for {decades}.
e.zh: 这两位朋友已经认识好几十年了。

e.en: Climate patterns shift slowly over many {decades}.
e.zh: 气候模式在数十年间缓慢变化。

decaf.t: n. 低咖啡因咖啡（decaffeinated 的简称）

e.en: I'll have a {decaf} latte, please.
e.zh: 我要一杯无咖啡因的拿铁,谢谢。

e.en: Switching to {decaf} helped me sleep much better.
e.zh: 改喝无咖啡因咖啡后我睡得好多了。

e.en: She ordered a {decaffeinated} coffee after dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐后点了一杯无咖啡因咖啡。

e.en: Most cafés now offer {decaffeinated} versions of every drink.
e.zh: 现在大多数咖啡馆每款饮品都提供无咖啡因版本。

e.en: She stuck a rainbow {decal} on her laptop lid.
e.zh: 她在笔记本电脑盖上贴了一张彩虹贴花。

e.en: The race car was covered in sponsor {decal}s.
e.zh: 那辆赛车上贴满了赞助商的贴纸。

e.en: The pastor preached on the {decalogue} every Sunday.
e.zh: 牧师每个周日都讲解十诫。

e.en: Moses received the {decalogue} on Mount Sinai.
e.zh: 摩西在西奈山上领受了十诫。

e.en: Boccaccio's {Decameron} contains one hundred lively tales.
e.zh: 薄伽丘的《十日谈》收录了一百个生动的故事。

e.en: She read the {Decameron} during her Italian literature course.
e.zh: 她在意大利文学课上读了《十日谈》。

decamp.t: v. 拔营撤离；悄悄溜走

e.en: The thieves {decamp}ed before the police arrived.
e.zh: 窃贼在警察赶到前就溜走了。

e.en: We {decamp}ed from the noisy hotel at dawn.
e.zh: 我们天一亮就从那家吵闹的酒店撤了出来。

decant.t: v. 滗出；（将酒）倒入醒酒器

e.en: Please {decant} the wine into the crystal carafe.
e.zh: 请把酒倒入水晶醒酒瓶里。

e.en: She likes to {decant} pantry staples into glass jars.
e.zh: 她喜欢把储物柜里的食材倒进玻璃罐里。

e.en: He poured the whisky from a heavy crystal {decanter}.
e.zh: 他从厚重的水晶醒酒瓶里倒出威士忌。

e.en: The antique {decanter} sat on the dining sideboard.
e.zh: 那只古董醒酒瓶摆在餐厅的边柜上。

e.en: The storm nearly {decapitate}d the tulips in the garden.
e.zh: 暴风雨几乎把花园里的郁金香都拦腰打断了。

e.en: Revolutionaries threatened to {decapitate} the deposed king.
e.zh: 革命者扬言要将被废黜的国王斩首。

decapitated.t:
adj. 被斩首的
v. decapitate 的过去式

e.en: Archaeologists found a {decapitated} statue at the temple ruins.
e.zh: 考古学家在神庙遗址发现了一尊被砍头的雕像。

e.en: The lawnmower left a row of {decapitated} dandelions behind.
e.zh: 割草机身后留下了一排被削掉头的蒲公英。

e.en: The film's graphic {decapitation} scene drew heavy criticism.
e.zh: 影片中血腥的斩首场景招致了强烈批评。

e.en: In medieval Europe, {decapitation} was reserved for nobles.
e.zh: 在中世纪欧洲,斩首是专为贵族保留的处决方式。

e.en: The young {decathlete} broke his country's national record.
e.zh: 那位年轻的十项全能选手打破了本国的全国纪录。

e.en: Every {decathlete} must train in ten different events.
e.zh: 每位十项全能运动员都必须训练十个不同的项目。

decathlon.t: n. 十项全能（田径比赛）

e.en: He won gold in the {decathlon} at the Olympics.
e.zh: 他在奥运会十项全能比赛中夺得金牌。

e.en: The {decathlon} tests speed, strength, and endurance over two days.
e.zh: 十项全能在两天内考验速度、力量和耐力。

decay.t: v./n. 腐烂；衰败；（信号、辐射）衰减

e.en: Brushing twice a day helps prevent tooth {decay}.
e.zh: 每天刷牙两次有助于预防蛀牙。

e.en: The abandoned mansion began to {decay} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 那座废弃的豪宅多年无人打理后开始破败。

e.en: The dentist pulled out two badly {decayed} molars.
e.zh: 牙医拔掉了两颗严重蛀坏的臼齿。

e.en: {Decayed} leaves had piled up along the forest path.
e.zh: 森林小径上堆满了腐烂的落叶。

decaying.t: adj. 正在腐烂的；衰败中的

e.en: A {decaying} log on the trail was covered in moss.
e.zh: 小径上一根腐朽的木头长满了青苔。

e.en: The documentary explored the city's {decaying} industrial neighborhoods.
e.zh: 那部纪录片探讨了这座城市衰败的工业区。

decays.t:
v. decay 的第三人称单数
n. 腐烂（复数）

e.en: Carbon-14 {decays} at a known and steady rate.
e.zh: 碳-14以已知且稳定的速度衰变。

e.en: Wood {decays} quickly when exposed to moisture and warmth.
e.zh: 木材在潮湿温暖的环境下会迅速腐烂。

decca.t: n. 迪卡（英国唱片公司）

e.en: The Beatles famously failed their {Decca} audition in 1962.
e.zh: 披头士1962年在Decca唱片公司的试音以失败告终。

e.en: She signed her first record deal with {Decca} Records.
e.zh: 她和Decca唱片公司签下了第一份唱片合约。

e.en: I can barely {decipher} my doctor's handwriting on this note.
e.zh: 我几乎看不懂医生在这张便条上的字迹。

e.en: Researchers worked years to {decipher} the ancient script.
e.zh: 研究人员花了多年才破译这种古文字。

decipherable.t: adj. 可破译的；可辨认的

e.en: The faded inscription was barely {decipherable} after centuries.
e.zh: 经过几个世纪，这段褪色的铭文几乎难以辨认。

e.en: His messy notes are only {decipherable} to himself.
e.zh: 他潦草的笔记只有他自己能看懂。

deciphering.t: v. 破译（decipher 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the morning {deciphering} her grandmother's old letters.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在辨读祖母的旧信。

e.en: {Deciphering} legal jargon takes patience and practice.
e.zh: 读懂法律术语需要耐心和练习。

e.en: Buying that house was the best {decision} we ever made.
e.zh: 买下那栋房子是我们做过最正确的决定。

e.en: The court's {decision} surprised legal experts nationwide.
e.zh: 法院的判决让全国的法律专家感到意外。

e.en: Good {decision-making} requires both data and intuition.
e.zh: 良好的决策既需要数据也需要直觉。

e.en: The app uses AI to support medical {decision-making}.
e.zh: 这款应用利用人工智能辅助医疗决策。

e.en: Different cultures approach {decision-makings} in distinct ways.
e.zh: 不同文化在决策方式上各有差异。

e.en: The course compares {decision-makings} across business sectors.
e.zh: 课程比较了不同商业领域的决策方式。

decisional.t: adj. 决策的；与决定有关的

e.en: The judge cited {decisional} authority from earlier cases.
e.zh: 法官援引了早期案件的判例权威。

e.en: Patients deserve full {decisional} control over their care.
e.zh: 病人应当拥有对自身治疗的完全决策权。

e.en: Parents make countless small {decisions} every single day.
e.zh: 父母每天都要做无数个小决定。

e.en: Big {decisions} should never be rushed late at night.
e.zh: 重大决定绝不应该在深夜匆忙做出。

e.en: A {decisive} leader inspires confidence during a crisis.
e.zh: 果断的领导者能在危机中激发信心。

e.en: Her late goal was the {decisive} moment of the match.
e.zh: 她最后的进球是这场比赛的决定性时刻。

e.en: The team won {decisively} by a score of five to one.
e.zh: 球队以五比一的比分大胜对手。

e.en: She acted {decisively} when the fire alarm sounded.
e.zh: 火警响起时，她毫不犹豫地采取了行动。

e.en: His {decisiveness} under pressure earned the team's respect.
e.zh: 他在压力下的果断赢得了团队的尊重。

e.en: The role demands creativity, focus, and {decisiveness}.
e.zh: 这个职位需要创造力、专注和果断的判断力。

deck.t:
n. 甲板；一副（牌）
v. 装饰

e.en: We had coffee on the back {deck} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我们在后院的露台上喝了咖啡。

e.en: Shuffle the {deck} thoroughly before dealing the cards.
e.zh: 在发牌前把这副牌彻底洗一下。

e.en: She dozed off in a striped {deckchair} by the pool.
e.zh: 她在泳池边一张条纹躺椅上打起了瞌睡。

e.en: Folding {deckchairs} are stored in the garden shed.
e.zh: 折叠躺椅存放在花园的小屋里。

decker.t: n. 有…层甲板的船（常构词，如double-decker）

e.en: London's red double-{decker} buses are famous worldwide.
e.zh: 伦敦的红色双层巴士闻名世界。

e.en: They ordered a triple-{decker} sandwich for lunch.
e.zh: 他们午餐点了一份三层三明治。

e.en: He worked as a {deckhand} on a fishing boat last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他在一艘渔船上当甲板水手。

e.en: The {deckhand} secured the ropes before departure.
e.zh: 船启航前，甲板水手把缆绳系紧了。

decking.t: n. 露台木地板；铺面材料

e.en: We installed new wooden {decking} in the backyard last week.
e.zh: 上周我们在后院铺了新的木地板。

e.en: Composite {decking} lasts longer than traditional timber.
e.zh: 复合材料地板比传统木材更耐用。

e.en: The {deckle} edge gave the invitation a handmade feel.
e.zh: 毛边纸的设计让请柬显得很有手工感。

e.en: Artists prize paper with a natural {deckle} edge.
e.zh: 艺术家们偏爱带有天然毛边的纸张。

e.en: The cruise ship has fifteen {decks} and four pools.
e.zh: 这艘邮轮有十五层甲板和四个泳池。

e.en: The DJ set up two {decks} for the evening party.
e.zh: DJ为晚上的派对架好了两台打碟机。

e.en: The actor began to {declaim} Shakespeare from the balcony.
e.zh: 那位演员开始在阳台上慷慨朗诵莎士比亚的台词。

e.en: Politicians often {declaim} against their opponents on TV.
e.zh: 政客们常在电视上慷慨抨击对手。

e.en: His passionate {declamation} moved the entire audience.
e.zh: 他充满激情的演讲打动了全场观众。

e.en: The speech turned into a long {declamation} about freedom.
e.zh: 演讲变成了一段关于自由的长篇慷慨陈词。

e.en: His {declamatory} style works better on stage than in podcasts.
e.zh: 他那种慷慨激昂的风格更适合舞台而非播客。

e.en: The essay's {declamatory} tone felt outdated to modern readers.
e.zh: 文章慷慨激昂的语气在现代读者看来有些过时。

e.en: He made a public {declaration} of love at the concert.
e.zh: 他在演唱会上公开表白了爱意。

e.en: Customs requires a {declaration} for any cash over ten thousand.
e.zh: 海关要求对超过一万的现金进行申报。

e.en: The summit produced several joint {declarations} on climate.
e.zh: 峰会在气候问题上发表了多份联合声明。

e.en: Travelers must submit customs {declarations} upon arrival.
e.zh: 旅客抵达时必须提交海关申报单。

e.en: React uses a {declarative} approach to building user interfaces.
e.zh: React采用声明式方法来构建用户界面。

e.en: A {declarative} sentence simply states a fact or opinion.
e.zh: 陈述句只是用来表达事实或观点。

e.en: The company sought a {declaratory} judgment to clarify its rights.
e.zh: 公司申请了一项确认判决以明确其权利。

e.en: The statute is purely {declaratory} of existing common law.
e.zh: 该法规只是对现有普通法的宣示性规定。

e.en: You must {declare} all goods worth over the limit at customs.
e.zh: 超过限额的物品必须在海关如实申报。

e.en: The president will {declare} a state of emergency tonight.
e.zh: 总统今晚将宣布进入紧急状态。

declared.t:
adj. 公开表明的
v. 宣布（过去式）

e.en: She {declared} herself a candidate in next year's election.
e.zh: 她宣布自己将参加明年的竞选。

e.en: The artist {declared} the painting officially finished.
e.zh: 那位艺术家宣告这幅画正式完成。

declares.t: v. 宣布（第三人称单数）

e.en: The contract {declares} both parties equally responsible.
e.zh: 合同声明双方负有同等责任。

e.en: He proudly {declares} his independence from family wealth.
e.zh: 他自豪地宣告自己脱离了家族财富。

e.en: She stood up, {declaring} that the meeting was over.
e.zh: 她站起来宣布会议结束。

e.en: {Declaring} bankruptcy was a painful but necessary choice.
e.zh: 申请破产是个痛苦但必要的选择。

e.en: The {declassification} of old files revealed surprising secrets.
e.zh: 对旧档案的解密揭示了惊人的秘密。

e.en: Historians welcomed the {declassification} of wartime documents.
e.zh: 历史学家对战时文件的解密表示欢迎。

declassified.t:
adj. 已解密的
v. 解密（过去式）

e.en: Recently {declassified} documents shed new light on the case.
e.zh: 最近解密的文件让案件有了新线索。

e.en: The agency {declassified} hundreds of files last month.
e.zh: 该机构上个月解密了数百份文件。

e.en: Officials may {declassify} the report after thirty years.
e.zh: 官员们可能在三十年后解密这份报告。

e.en: Lawmakers urged the agency to {declassify} the findings.
e.zh: 议员们敦促该机构公开这些调查结果。

e.en: German nouns follow a complex {declension} system.
e.zh: 德语名词遵循一套复杂的变格规则。

e.en: Latin students must memorize every {declension} carefully.
e.zh: 学拉丁语的学生必须仔细背熟每一种变格。

e.en: Sailors adjust their compass for magnetic {declination}.
e.zh: 水手们会根据磁偏角调整指南针。

e.en: His polite {declination} of the offer surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他礼貌地拒绝邀请，让所有人都很意外。

e.en: The map shows magnetic {declinations} for each region.
e.zh: 地图显示了每个地区的磁偏角。

e.en: Sailors must account for compass {declinations} during long voyages.
e.zh: 水手在远航时必须考虑罗盘的偏角。

decline.t:
v./n. 下降；衰退
v. 谢绝

e.en: I had to {decline} the job offer politely.
e.zh: 我不得不礼貌地拒绝那份工作邀请。

e.en: Birth rates continue to {decline} in many countries.
e.zh: 许多国家的出生率持续下降。

e.en: She {declined} the invitation to the party.
e.zh: 她婉拒了那场聚会的邀请。

e.en: Sales {declined} sharply during the third quarter.
e.zh: 第三季度销售额急剧下降。

declines.t: v. 下降；谢绝（第三人称单数）

e.en: The chart shows steady {declines} in stock prices.
e.zh: 图表显示股价持续下跌。

e.en: He always {declines} dessert after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后总是拒绝甜点。

e.en: The company is struggling with {declining} revenue.
e.zh: 公司正在为收入下滑而苦苦挣扎。

e.en: She kept {declining} his calls all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都拒接他的电话。

e.en: We hiked down a gentle {declivity} into the valley.
e.zh: 我们沿着缓缓的下坡走入山谷。

e.en: The house sits on a steep {declivity} overlooking the sea.
e.zh: 那座房子坐落在俯瞰大海的陡坡上。

deco.t: n. 装饰艺术风格（art deco）

e.en: The hotel lobby features stunning art {deco} design.
e.zh: 酒店大堂采用了惊艳的装饰艺术风格设计。

e.en: She collects vintage {deco} jewelry from the 1920s.
e.zh: 她收藏二十年代的复古装饰艺术风珠宝。

e.en: The herbalist prepared a bitter {decoction} from tree bark.
e.zh: 草药师用树皮熬制了一剂苦涩的汤药。

e.en: She drinks a ginger {decoction} every morning for health.
e.zh: 她每天早上喝一碗姜汤来养生。

e.en: Engineers worked overnight to {decode} the encrypted message.
e.zh: 工程师们通宵破解那条加密信息。

e.en: It takes practice to {decode} body language accurately.
e.zh: 准确解读肢体语言需要长期练习。

decoded.t:
adj. 已解码的
v. 解码（过去式）

e.en: Researchers finally {decoded} the ancient hieroglyphs.
e.zh: 研究人员终于破译了古代象形文字。

e.en: The app {decoded} the QR code in seconds.
e.zh: 这个应用几秒钟就解析了二维码。

e.en: You need a special {decoder} to watch these channels.
e.zh: 观看这些频道需要专用的解码器。

e.en: The video {decoder} struggles with high-resolution files.
e.zh: 该视频解码器处理高分辨率文件时有些吃力。

e.en: Children learn reading by {decoding} letters into sounds.
e.zh: 孩子通过把字母转化为发音来学习阅读。

e.en: The software is {decoding} the satellite signal now.
e.zh: 软件正在解码卫星信号。

e.en: Her evening gown featured an elegant {decolletage}.
e.zh: 她的晚礼服设计了优雅的低胸领口。

e.en: The dress code forbids dramatic {decolletage} at the gala.
e.zh: 晚会的着装要求禁止过于暴露的低胸装。

decolonization.t: n. 去殖民化；非殖民化

e.en: The course explores African {decolonization} after World War II.
e.zh: 这门课程探讨二战后非洲的去殖民化进程。

e.en: Museums are rethinking their collections through {decolonization}.
e.zh: 博物馆正通过去殖民化视角重新审视其馆藏。

e.en: Activists urge universities to {decolonize} their reading lists.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促高校对阅读书目进行去殖民化改革。

e.en: It takes more than policy to {decolonize} a culture.
e.zh: 要让一种文化去殖民化,光有政策是不够的。

decolonized.t: v. decolonize 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: Most African nations were {decolonized} by the 1970s.
e.zh: 大多数非洲国家在七十年代前已实现非殖民化。

e.en: The curriculum was {decolonized} to include diverse voices.
e.zh: 课程经过去殖民化改革,纳入了多元的声音。

decolonizing.t:
v. decolonize 的现在分词
n. 去殖民化过程

e.en: She wrote a book on {decolonizing} modern education.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于现代教育去殖民化的书。

e.en: The museum is slowly {decolonizing} its exhibition space.
e.zh: 博物馆正在逐步对展览空间进行去殖民化。

decommission.t: v. 使（设备、设施）停用退役

e.en: The navy plans to {decommission} the aging aircraft carrier.
e.zh: 海军计划让那艘老化的航空母舰退役。

e.en: It costs billions to {decommission} a nuclear power plant.
e.zh: 让一座核电站退役要花费数十亿美元。

decommissioned.t:
v. decommission 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 已退役的

e.en: The old submarine was {decommissioned} last year.
e.zh: 那艘旧潜艇去年已经退役。

e.en: They turned the {decommissioned} factory into a museum.
e.zh: 他们把那座停产的工厂改造成了博物馆。

decommissioning.t:
n. 退役、停用过程
v. decommission 的现在分词

e.en: The {decommissioning} of the reactor will take decades.
e.zh: 该反应堆的退役工作将耗时数十年。

e.en: Engineers are {decommissioning} the outdated server cluster.
e.zh: 工程师正在停用那套过时的服务器集群。

e.en: Plastic bottles take centuries to {decompose} naturally.
e.zh: 塑料瓶要数百年才能自然分解。

e.en: We can {decompose} the problem into smaller subtasks.
e.zh: 我们可以把问题分解成更小的子任务。

decomposed.t:
v. decompose 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 腐烂的

e.en: The fallen leaves had completely {decomposed} into rich soil.
e.zh: 落叶已完全分解成肥沃的腐殖土。

e.en: He {decomposed} the equation into three simpler parts.
e.zh: 他把方程分解成三个更简单的部分。

decomposing.t:
v. decompose 的现在分词
adj. 正在腐烂的

e.en: A {decomposing} log can host hundreds of insect species.
e.zh: 一根腐烂的木头能容纳数百种昆虫。

e.en: The algorithm works by {decomposing} signals into frequencies.
e.zh: 该算法的原理是把信号分解成不同频率。

e.en: Forensic scientists study the rate of {decomposition} carefully.
e.zh: 法医科学家会仔细研究尸体的腐败速度。

e.en: Matrix {decomposition} is a key technique in linear algebra.
e.zh: 矩阵分解是线性代数中的关键技术。

e.en: The textbook compares several matrix {decompositions} in detail.
e.zh: 教材详细比较了几种矩阵分解方法。

e.en: Different chemical {decompositions} produce different byproducts.
e.zh: 不同的化学分解过程会产生不同的副产物。

decompress.t: v. 解压（文件）；减压放松

e.en: I take a long walk to {decompress} after work.
e.zh: 下班后我会去散步放松一下。

e.en: Click the file to {decompress} the zipped folder.
e.zh: 点击文件即可解压缩这个压缩包。

e.en: Divers must follow {decompression} schedules to avoid sickness.
e.zh: 潜水员必须遵守减压程序以免得减压病。

e.en: Weekends are my time for mental {decompression}.
e.zh: 周末是我放松身心的时间。

decongestant.t: n. 鼻塞缓解药、减充血剂

e.en: I took a {decongestant} to clear my stuffy nose.
e.zh: 我吃了一片解充血药来缓解鼻塞。

e.en: This nasal {decongestant} works within fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 这种鼻用减充血剂十五分钟内就会起效。

e.en: Critics often {deconstruct} popular films scene by scene.
e.zh: 评论人常常逐场逐景地解构热门影片。

e.en: Let's {deconstruct} the argument and check each premise.
e.zh: 我们来拆解这个论点,逐条检查它的前提。

deconstructed.t:
v. deconstruct 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 解构式的

e.en: The chef served a {deconstructed} cheesecake on slate.
e.zh: 厨师在石板上端出了一份解构版芝士蛋糕。

e.en: She {deconstructed} the novel's themes in her essay.
e.zh: 她在论文里解构了这部小说的主题。

e.en: His lecture on the {deconstruction} of gender norms went viral.
e.zh: 他关于性别规范解构的讲座爆红网络。

e.en: The dish is a playful {deconstruction} of classic lasagna.
e.zh: 这道菜是对经典千层面别出心裁的解构。

deconstructionism.t: n. 解构主义（文学理论）

e.en: Her thesis examines Derrida's influence on {deconstructionism}.
e.zh: 她的论文考察了德里达对解构主义的影响。

e.en: Many critics dismiss {deconstructionism} as overly abstract.
e.zh: 许多评论家认为解构主义过于抽象,不予认同。

deconstructionist.t:
n. 解构主义者
adj. 解构主义的

e.en: The professor offered a {deconstructionist} reading of the poem.
e.zh: 那位教授对这首诗进行了解构主义式的解读。

e.en: She is a leading {deconstructionist} in literary theory circles.
e.zh: 她是文学理论界顶尖的解构主义学者。

deconstructive.t: adj. 解构性的、解构主义的

e.en: His {deconstructive} approach challenges every traditional assumption.
e.zh: 他这种解构性的研究方法挑战了一切传统假设。

e.en: The architect favors a {deconstructive} style with broken angles.
e.zh: 这位建筑师偏爱带有破碎角度的解构主义风格。

decontaminate.t: v. 去除污染、消毒净化

e.en: Workers in hazmat suits arrived to {decontaminate} the lab.
e.zh: 穿着防化服的工作人员前来对实验室进行消毒去污。

e.en: It will take years to {decontaminate} the polluted soil.
e.zh: 清除受污染土壤的工作需要数年时间。

e.en: The hospital follows strict {decontamination} procedures every shift.
e.zh: 医院每个班次都严格执行消毒去污程序。

e.en: Soldiers underwent {decontamination} after the chemical drill.
e.zh: 士兵们在化学演习后接受了去污处理。

decontextualized.t:
adj. 脱离语境的
v. 使脱离上下文

e.en: Quotes look misleading when {decontextualized} from the article.
e.zh: 引言一旦脱离原文语境就会显得具有误导性。

e.en: The artist's work feels strange when {decontextualized} from history.
e.zh: 这位艺术家的作品脱离历史背景后显得很怪异。

decontrol.t:
v. 取消管制
n. 管制解除

e.en: The government voted to {decontrol} fuel prices next year.
e.zh: 政府已表决决定明年放开燃油价格管制。

e.en: Many economists advocate the {decontrol} of farm subsidies.
e.zh: 许多经济学家主张取消对农业补贴的管制。

decor.t: n. 装饰风格、室内陈设

e.en: The cafe's vintage {decor} attracts photographers every weekend.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的复古装饰每周末都吸引摄影师光顾。

e.en: They updated the office {decor} with plants and warm lighting.
e.zh: 他们用绿植和暖光重新装饰了办公室。

e.en: We always {decorate} the tree on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 我们每年都在平安夜布置圣诞树。

e.en: She wants to {decorate} her apartment in minimalist style.
e.zh: 她想把公寓装饰成极简风格。

decorated.t:
v. decorate 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 装饰过的

e.en: He {decorated} the cake with fresh strawberries and cream.
e.zh: 他用新鲜草莓和奶油装饰了蛋糕。

e.en: She is a highly {decorated} war veteran.
e.zh: 她是一位获得众多勋章的战争老兵。

decorates.t: v. decorate 的第三人称单数

e.en: My mom {decorates} the house elaborately every holiday.
e.zh: 我妈每个节日都把家里装饰得非常精致。

e.en: A vintage poster {decorates} the wall above his desk.
e.zh: 一张复古海报装饰着他书桌上方的墙面。

decorating.t:
v. decorate 的现在分词
n. 装饰布置

e.en: We spent the weekend {decorating} the nursery for the baby.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在为宝宝布置婴儿房。

e.en: She loves {decorating} cookies during the holiday season.
e.zh: 她喜欢在节日期间装饰饼干。

e.en: The only {decoration} on the wall was a small mirror.
e.zh: 墙上唯一的装饰是一面小镜子。

e.en: Cake {decoration} requires patience and a steady hand.
e.zh: 装饰蛋糕需要耐心和稳定的手。

e.en: We packed away the Christmas {decorations} in January.
e.zh: 我们一月份就把圣诞装饰品收起来了。

e.en: The party {decorations} were all in pink and gold.
e.zh: 派对的装饰全都是粉色和金色的。

decorative.t: adj. 装饰用的、起装饰作用的

e.en: She added some {decorative} pillows to the gray sofa.
e.zh: 她在灰色沙发上添了几个装饰抱枕。

e.en: The vase is purely {decorative} and not for flowers.
e.zh: 这个花瓶纯属装饰用,并不用来插花。

e.en: The chef arranged the herbs {decoratively} around the plate.
e.zh: 厨师把香草装饰性地摆放在盘子四周。

e.en: Lights were strung {decoratively} along the garden path.
e.zh: 灯串装饰性地挂在花园小径两旁。

decorator.t: n. 装潢师；（编程）装饰器

e.en: We hired an interior {decorator} to redo the living room.
e.zh: 我们请了一位室内装饰师来重新设计客厅。

e.en: The {decorator} suggested warmer tones for the bedroom.
e.zh: 装饰师建议卧室使用更温暖的色调。

e.en: Guests maintained a {decorous} silence during the ceremony.
e.zh: 宾客在典礼上保持着得体的沉默。

e.en: Her behavior at the dinner was perfectly {decorous}.
e.zh: 她在晚宴上的举止非常得体。

e.en: The children sat {decorously} through the long speech.
e.zh: 孩子们规规矩矩地坐着听完了长篇演讲。

e.en: She bowed {decorously} before leaving the stage.
e.zh: 她得体地鞠了一躬才离开舞台。

e.en: Guests maintained {decorum} throughout the formal dinner party.
e.zh: 宾客在正式晚宴上始终保持着得体的礼仪。

e.en: The judge demanded {decorum} in the crowded courtroom.
e.zh: 法官要求拥挤的法庭内保持庄重秩序。

decoupage.t: n. 剪纸装饰工艺、贴花艺术

e.en: She covered the tray with floral {decoupage} cutouts.
e.zh: 她用花卉剪贴拼贴装饰了那个托盘。

e.en: The craft store offers a {decoupage} workshop on weekends.
e.zh: 那家手工店周末开设剪贴艺术课程。

decouple.t: v. 解耦、分离（系统间关联）

e.en: Engineers want to {decouple} the frontend from the database.
e.zh: 工程师希望把前端与数据库解耦。

e.en: Policymakers hope to {decouple} growth from carbon emissions.
e.zh: 决策者希望让经济增长与碳排放脱钩。

decoupling.t:
n. 解耦、脱钩
v. decouple 的现在分词

e.en: The {decoupling} of services made deployment much easier.
e.zh: 服务解耦让部署变得轻松多了。

e.en: Economists debate the {decoupling} of wages from productivity.
e.zh: 经济学家正讨论工资与生产率脱钩的现象。

decoy.t:
n. 诱饵、圈套
v. 引诱

e.en: Hunters set up a wooden duck {decoy} on the lake.
e.zh: 猎人在湖面上摆了一只木制诱饵鸭。

e.en: The email link was a phishing {decoy} for stealing passwords.
e.zh: 那个邮件链接是窃取密码的钓鱼诱饵。

decrease.t:
v. 减少、下降
n. 减少量

e.en: Sales {decrease} sharply after the holiday season ends.
e.zh: 假期结束后销售额会大幅下降。

e.en: There was a notable {decrease} in app crashes this month.
e.zh: 本月应用崩溃次数明显减少。

decreased.t:
v. decrease 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 减少了的

e.en: Traffic accidents {decreased} after the new speed limit.
e.zh: 新限速实施后交通事故有所减少。

e.en: My screen time {decreased} once I deleted social media apps.
e.zh: 我删掉社交应用后屏幕使用时间下降了。

decreases.t:
v. decrease 的第三人称单数
n. decrease 的复数

e.en: Battery life {decreases} when you stream high-resolution video.
e.zh: 播放高清视频时电池续航会缩短。

e.en: The chart shows three consecutive monthly {decreases} in revenue.
e.zh: 图表显示营收连续三个月下滑。

decreasing.t: adj. 递减的、不断减少的

e.en: Engagement is {decreasing} on the older version of the app.
e.zh: 旧版应用的用户参与度正在下降。

e.en: Sort the results by {decreasing} order of price.
e.zh: 请按价格从高到低排序结果。

decree.t:
n. 法令、判决
v. 颁布法令

e.en: The mayor issued a {decree} banning fireworks downtown.
e.zh: 市长颁布法令禁止市中心燃放烟花。

e.en: By royal {decree}, the new holiday became official.
e.zh: 根据王室法令,这个新节日正式确立。

decrement.t:
n. 减量；（编程）自减
v. 递减

e.en: The loop will {decrement} the counter until it reaches zero.
e.zh: 循环会递减计数器直到归零。

e.en: Each failed attempt causes a small {decrement} in your score.
e.zh: 每次失败尝试都会让分数小幅下降。

e.en: The {decrepit} old shed finally collapsed in the storm.
e.zh: 那个破旧的小棚子终于在风暴中倒塌了。

e.en: He drives a {decrepit} car held together with duct tape.
e.zh: 他开着一辆全靠胶带勉强维持的破车。

e.en: The mansion had fallen into total {decrepitude} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 那座宅邸因多年无人照管已彻底破败。

e.en: He feared the {decrepitude} of old age more than death itself.
e.zh: 他比起死亡更害怕年老体衰。

decrescendo.t:
n. 渐弱（音乐）
adv. 渐弱地

e.en: The orchestra ended the piece with a soft {decrescendo}.
e.zh: 乐队以轻柔的渐弱结束了这首曲子。

e.en: Mark a {decrescendo} on the last four bars of music.
e.zh: 请在最后四小节音乐上标注渐弱记号。

e.en: Many states are debating the {decriminalization} of marijuana possession.
e.zh: 许多州正在讨论将持有大麻非刑罪化。

e.en: Activists pushed for the {decriminalization} of minor drug offenses.
e.zh: 活动人士推动将轻微毒品犯罪非刑罪化。

e.en: The council voted to {decriminalize} jaywalking in the city.
e.zh: 市议会投票决定将乱穿马路非刑罪化。

e.en: Some doctors urge lawmakers to {decriminalize} small drug amounts.
e.zh: 一些医生敦促立法者将少量毒品非刑罪化。

decry.t: v. 公开谴责；强烈批评

e.en: Critics {decry} the new policy as deeply unfair.
e.zh: 评论人士谴责这项新政策极不公平。

e.en: Teachers continue to {decry} the lack of school funding.
e.zh: 教师们持续抨击学校经费严重不足。

e.en: You need the private key to {decrypt} this message.
e.zh: 你需要私钥才能解密这条消息。

e.en: The app can {decrypt} files automatically once you log in.
e.zh: 登录后该应用就能自动解密文件。

e.en: Strong {decryption} requires the matching key and algorithm.
e.zh: 强解密需要匹配的密钥和算法。

e.en: The hacker spent weeks attempting {decryption} of the database.
e.zh: 黑客花了数周尝试解密那个数据库。

e.en: We drove through {Dedham} on our way to Boston.
e.zh: 我们去波士顿的路上经过了戴德姆镇。

e.en: The historic courthouse in {Dedham} dates back to colonial times.
e.zh: 戴德姆那座历史悠久的法院可追溯到殖民时期。

e.en: I want to {dedicate} this song to my grandmother.
e.zh: 我想把这首歌献给我的祖母。

e.en: She plans to {dedicate} her summer to learning Mandarin.
e.zh: 她打算把整个夏天用来学习中文。

e.en: He is a {dedicated} teacher who stays late every day.
e.zh: 他是位敬业的老师,每天都加班到很晚。

e.en: The app has a {dedicated} server for video processing.
e.zh: 该应用有一台专门用于视频处理的服务器。

dedicatee.t: n. 作品被题献的对象

e.en: His wife was the {dedicatee} of his first novel.
e.zh: 他的妻子是他第一部小说的题献对象。

e.en: The composer named her mentor as the {dedicatee}.
e.zh: 作曲家将这首作品题献给了她的导师。

dedicates.t: v. dedicate 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {dedicates} an hour each morning to meditation.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会留出一小时冥想。

e.en: The author {dedicates} the book to her late father.
e.zh: 作者把这本书献给了她已故的父亲。

e.en: He's {dedicating} the next year to writing his memoir.
e.zh: 他将用接下来的一年专心写自传。

e.en: The mayor is {dedicating} the new park this Saturday.
e.zh: 市长将于本周六为新公园举行揭幕仪式。

dedication.t:
n. 奉献精神
n. 题词；献辞

e.en: Her {dedication} to the project impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 她对这个项目的投入让全队都很佩服。

e.en: The book opens with a heartfelt {dedication} to her parents.
e.zh: 这本书以一段对父母的真挚献词开篇。

e.en: The album includes several {dedications} to fallen friends.
e.zh: 这张专辑里有数段献给逝去朋友的题词。

e.en: She read the touching {dedications} at the front of each book.
e.zh: 她阅读了每本书前面动人的献词。

e.en: The {dedicatory} note appears on the very first page.
e.zh: 那段题献文字出现在第一页上。

e.en: He wrote a brief {dedicatory} speech for the ceremony.
e.zh: 他为典礼写了一段简短的献词。

e.en: From the clues, you can {deduce} who stole the wallet.
e.zh: 根据这些线索,你可以推断出是谁偷了钱包。

e.en: Scientists {deduce} the planet's age from radioactive decay.
e.zh: 科学家通过放射性衰变推断行星的年龄。

e.en: Sherlock {deduced} the suspect's profession from his shoes.
e.zh: 福尔摩斯从鞋子推断出嫌疑人的职业。

e.en: She {deduced} from his tone that something was wrong.
e.zh: 她从他的语气中察觉到出了问题。

deduces.t: v. deduce 的第三人称单数

e.en: The detective {deduces} the truth from tiny inconsistencies.
e.zh: 侦探从细小的矛盾中推断出真相。

e.en: The model {deduces} user preferences from browsing history.
e.zh: 该模型根据浏览记录推断用户偏好。

e.en: The killer's identity is easily {deducible} from chapter three.
e.zh: 凶手身份从第三章起就很容易推断出来。

e.en: His motives were {deducible} from a single email.
e.zh: 仅凭一封邮件就能推测出他的动机。

e.en: She spent hours {deducing} the password from old hints.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时从旧提示中推算出密码。

e.en: He's good at {deducing} feelings from body language.
e.zh: 他很擅长从肢体语言推断对方的情绪。

e.en: The company will {deduct} taxes from your monthly paycheck.
e.zh: 公司会从你的月薪中扣除税款。

e.en: You can {deduct} business meals on your tax return.
e.zh: 你可以在报税时抵扣商务餐费用。

deductibility.t: n. 可扣除性；可抵扣性

e.en: Check the {deductibility} of donations before claiming them.
e.zh: 申报前请确认捐款是否可以税前抵扣。

e.en: New rules limit the {deductibility} of home office expenses.
e.zh: 新规则限制了家庭办公支出的可抵扣额度。

deductible.t:
adj. 可抵扣的
n. 免赔额

e.en: My insurance has a high {deductible} for emergency visits.
e.zh: 我的保险急诊自付额很高。

e.en: Charitable donations are usually tax {deductible}.
e.zh: 慈善捐款通常可以抵扣税款。

deduction.t:
n. 扣除（金额）
n. 推理；演绎

e.en: Your tax {deduction} for student loan interest is limited.
e.zh: 你学生贷款利息的税务抵扣是有限额的。

e.en: By careful {deduction}, she figured out the puzzle.
e.zh: 通过缜密的推理,她解开了这道谜题。

e.en: Itemized {deductions} can lower your taxable income.
e.zh: 逐项扣除可以降低你的应税收入。

e.en: Her {deductions} from the evidence proved correct in court.
e.zh: 她从证据中得出的推论在法庭上得到了证实。

e.en: Detectives rely on strong {deductive} reasoning to solve cases.
e.zh: 侦探依靠强大的演绎推理能力来破案。

e.en: Math proofs follow strict {deductive} logic.
e.zh: 数学证明遵循严格的演绎逻辑。

deed.t:
n. 行为；事迹
n. 契约；证书

e.en: Helping that stranger was a truly kind {deed}.
e.zh: 帮助那位陌生人真是一件善举。

e.en: She signed the {deed} to the house yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 她昨天下午签署了房屋的契约。

e.en: His good {deeds} earned him respect throughout the village.
e.zh: 他的善行让他在整个村子里备受尊敬。

e.en: The lawyer keeps property {deeds} locked in a safe.
e.zh: 律师把房产契据锁在保险柜里。

e.en: The wedding {deejay} kept the dance floor packed all night.
e.zh: 婚礼DJ整晚都让舞池座无虚席。

e.en: She works as a radio {deejay} on weekend mornings.
e.zh: 她周末早晨在电台担任DJ。

e.en: The judge will {deem} the evidence admissible or not.
e.zh: 法官将判定该证据是否可被采纳。

e.en: Please share whatever you {deem} important for the meeting.
e.zh: 请分享任何你认为对会议重要的内容。

e.en: The bridge was {deemed} unsafe and closed for repairs.
e.zh: 该桥被判定为不安全并已关闭维修。

e.en: His proposal was {deemed} too expensive by the board.
e.zh: 他的提案被董事会认为过于昂贵。

e.en: The court ruled, {deeming} the contract invalid.
e.zh: 法院作出裁决,认定该合同无效。

e.en: Reviewers rejected the paper, {deeming} it poorly researched.
e.zh: 评审拒绝了这篇论文,认为研究不够深入。

deems.t: v. deem 的第三人称单数

e.en: The algorithm {deems} certain posts inappropriate for minors.
e.zh: 该算法判定某些帖子不适合未成年人观看。

e.en: She {deems} honesty more important than tact.
e.zh: 她认为诚实比圆滑更重要。

deep.t:
adj. 深的；深刻的
adv. 深深地

e.en: The lake is surprisingly {deep} near the eastern shore.
e.zh: 这个湖在东岸附近出乎意料地深。

e.en: We had a {deep} conversation about life and ambition.
e.zh: 我们就人生和理想进行了一场深入的交谈。

e.en: Reading widely will {deepen} your understanding of history.
e.zh: 广泛阅读会加深你对历史的理解。

e.en: The rain may {deepen} the puddles in the yard.
e.zh: 雨水可能会让院子里的水洼变得更深。

e.en: Their friendship {deepened} after surviving the storm together.
e.zh: 一起挺过那场风暴后,他们的友谊加深了。

e.en: His voice {deepened} noticeably during high school.
e.zh: 他的嗓音在高中阶段明显变低沉了。

e.en: There's a {deepening} crisis in the housing market right now.
e.zh: 目前住房市场正面临日益加深的危机。

e.en: The {deepening} shadows signaled that night was approaching.
e.zh: 渐浓的暗影预示着夜幕即将降临。

e.en: The lake gets {deeper} near the center.
e.zh: 湖中央的水更深。

e.en: We need a {deeper} understanding of the problem.
e.zh: 我们需要对这个问题有更深入的理解。

e.en: The Mariana Trench is the {deepest} part of the ocean.
e.zh: 马里亚纳海沟是海洋最深的地方。

e.en: She shared her {deepest} fears with her therapist.
e.zh: 她向治疗师袒露了内心最深的恐惧。

e.en: He was {deeply} moved by the speech.
e.zh: 他被那段演讲深深打动。

e.en: Breathe {deeply} and try to relax.
e.zh: 深呼吸，试着放松。

e.en: The {deepness} of the well surprised the hikers.
e.zh: 井的深度让徒步者感到意外。

e.en: There was a strange {deepness} to her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音有种奇特的低沉感。

e.en: A {deer} crossed the road just before sunset.
e.zh: 日落前，一只鹿穿过了马路。

e.en: Hunters spotted several {deer} in the meadow.
e.zh: 猎人在草地上发现了几只鹿。

e.en: He wore soft {deerskin} gloves in winter.
e.zh: 冬天他戴着柔软的鹿皮手套。

e.en: The jacket was made of genuine {deerskin}.
e.zh: 这件夹克是用真鹿皮做的。

def.t:
n. 定义（definition 缩写）
adj. 很棒的（俚）

e.en: In Python, you use {def} to declare a function.
e.zh: 在 Python 中用 def 来定义函数。

e.en: That new track is straight up {def}.
e.zh: 那首新歌真的太棒了。

e.en: Vandals tried to {deface} the monument with spray paint.
e.zh: 破坏者试图用喷漆毁损这座纪念碑。

e.en: It is illegal to {deface} public property.
e.zh: 损毁公共财产是违法的。

e.en: The museum reported the {defacement} of a famous painting.
e.zh: 博物馆报告了一幅名画遭到损毁。

e.en: Police are investigating the {defacement} of the war memorial.
e.zh: 警方正在调查战争纪念碑被损毁一事。

e.en: The accountant was accused of trying to {defalcate} company funds.
e.zh: 那名会计被指控企图挪用公司资金。

e.en: Officials who {defalcate} public money face severe penalties.
e.zh: 挪用公款的官员将面临严厉处罚。

e.en: The actor sued the tabloid for {defamation}.
e.zh: 那位演员以诽谤罪起诉了那家小报。

e.en: Spreading false rumors online can amount to {defamation}.
e.zh: 在网上散布谣言可能构成诽谤。

e.en: The judge ruled the article was {defamatory}.
e.zh: 法官裁定这篇文章具有诽谤性。

e.en: He deleted the {defamatory} post after a warning.
e.zh: 收到警告后他删除了那条诽谤性帖子。

e.en: The blogger was warned not to {defame} public figures.
e.zh: 那位博主被警告不得诽谤公众人物。

e.en: She felt the rumors were meant to {defame} her.
e.zh: 她觉得那些谣言是为了诋毁她。

e.en: Poets often use {defamiliarization} to make ordinary objects feel new.
e.zh: 诗人常用陌生化手法让平凡事物焕然一新。

e.en: The film's strange angles create a sense of {defamiliarization}.
e.zh: 影片奇特的镜头角度营造出陌生化的感受。

defang.t: v. 拔除毒牙；去除威胁

e.en: The new law aims to {defang} powerful tech monopolies.
e.zh: 新法律旨在削弱强大的科技垄断企业。

e.en: Critics say the amendment will {defang} the agency.
e.zh: 批评人士称该修正案会让该机构形同虚设。

default.t:
n./adj. 默认（设置）
v. 违约

e.en: You can change the {default} language in settings.
e.zh: 你可以在设置里更改默认语言。

e.en: The borrower may {default} on the loan next month.
e.zh: 借款人下个月可能会贷款违约。

e.en: The company {defaulted} on its bond payments last year.
e.zh: 该公司去年未能按时偿付债券。

e.en: The app {defaulted} to dark mode after the update.
e.zh: 更新后应用默认切换到了深色模式。

e.en: The bank publishes a list of loan {defaulter} cases monthly.
e.zh: 银行每月公布一份贷款违约者名单。

e.en: A serial {defaulter} can be banned from future credit.
e.zh: 屡次违约者可能会被禁止再次贷款。

defaults.t:
n. 默认设置
v. 违约

e.en: You can reset all the {defaults} from this menu.
e.zh: 你可以在这个菜单里重置所有默认设置。

e.en: If a borrower {defaults}, the bank seizes the collateral.
e.zh: 如果借款人违约，银行将没收抵押物。

defeat.t:
v. 击败；战胜
n. 失败

e.en: The team suffered a crushing {defeat} in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中惨遭失利。

e.en: She refused to let one setback {defeat} her dreams.
e.zh: 她不愿让一次挫折击垮自己的梦想。

e.en: Our team {defeated} the champions in overtime.
e.zh: 我们队在加时赛中击败了卫冕冠军。

e.en: He looked tired and {defeated} after the long day.
e.zh: 漫长的一天后他显得疲惫又沮丧。

e.en: {Defeating} the boss requires careful timing and teamwork.
e.zh: 击败这个 boss 需要精准的时机和团队配合。

e.en: Working overtime to save time is {defeating} the purpose.
e.zh: 加班来省时间反而违背了初衷。

e.en: The coach refused to tolerate any {defeatism} in the locker room.
e.zh: 教练绝不容忍更衣室里出现任何失败主义情绪。

e.en: His {defeatism} spread through the team before the match.
e.zh: 赛前他的失败主义情绪在队里蔓延开来。

e.en: Stop being so {defeatist} and try again.
e.zh: 别这么消极悲观，再试一次。

e.en: That {defeatist} attitude won't help us win.
e.zh: 那种失败主义的态度无助于我们获胜。

defeats.t:
v. 击败
n. 失败（复数）

e.en: The team has suffered three straight {defeats} this season.
e.zh: 这支球队本赛季已连吞三败。

e.en: A good firewall {defeats} most basic attacks.
e.zh: 一道好的防火墙能挡住大多数基础攻击。

e.en: Please don't let your dog {defecate} on the lawn.
e.zh: 请不要让你的狗在草坪上排便。

e.en: Babies typically {defecate} several times a day.
e.zh: 婴儿通常一天排便好几次。

e.en: The doctor asked about her frequency of {defecation}.
e.zh: 医生询问了她排便的频率。

e.en: Painful {defecation} can be a symptom of several conditions.
e.zh: 排便疼痛可能是多种疾病的症状。

defect.t:
n. 缺陷；瑕疵
v. 叛逃

e.en: The phone has a manufacturing {defect} and needs replacement.
e.zh: 这部手机有制造缺陷，需要更换。

e.en: Several scientists chose to {defect} during the Cold War.
e.zh: 冷战期间有几位科学家选择叛逃。

e.en: His sudden {defection} to a rival party shocked supporters.
e.zh: 他突然倒戈加入对手政党，令支持者震惊。

e.en: The athlete's {defection} made international headlines.
e.zh: 那位运动员的叛逃登上了国际新闻头条。

e.en: The store offered a refund for the {defective} product.
e.zh: 商店为有缺陷的产品提供了退款。

e.en: A {defective} brake caused the accident.
e.zh: 刹车故障导致了这起事故。

e.en: The {defector} was granted asylum in a neutral country.
e.zh: 这名叛逃者在一个中立国获得了庇护。

e.en: The former {defector} wrote a memoir about his escape.
e.zh: 这位前叛逃者写了一本关于逃亡的回忆录。

defects.t:
n. 缺陷（复数）
v. 叛逃

e.en: Quality control caught several {defects} in the batch.
e.zh: 质检在这批产品中发现了几处缺陷。

e.en: It is rare that a top diplomat {defects} publicly.
e.zh: 高级外交官公开叛逃的情况很罕见。

defence.t: n. 防御；辩护（英式拼写）

e.en: The lawyer prepared a strong {defence} for her client.
e.zh: 律师为她的当事人准备了有力的辩护。

e.en: Our team's {defence} kept them scoreless all night.
e.zh: 我们队的防守让对手整晚都没能得分。

defenceless.t: adj. 无防备的；无力自卫的

e.en: The kitten looked tiny and {defenceless} in the rain.
e.zh: 那只小猫在雨中显得弱小无助。

e.en: He felt {defenceless} against the harsh accusations.
e.zh: 面对严厉的指控他感到无力招架。

e.en: The city's {defences} held against repeated attacks.
e.zh: 该城的防御工事抵住了一次次进攻。

e.en: Vaccines strengthen the body's natural {defences}.
e.zh: 疫苗能增强人体的天然防御能力。

e.en: He hired a top lawyer to {defend} his reputation.
e.zh: 他聘请了一位顶级律师为他的名誉辩护。

e.en: The champion will {defend} her title next weekend.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军将于下周末进行卫冕赛。

defendable.t: adj. 可防御的；可辩护的

e.en: Their position is barely {defendable} given the new evidence.
e.zh: 鉴于新证据，他们的立场几乎站不住脚。

e.en: The hilltop fortress proved easily {defendable}.
e.zh: 事实证明这座山顶要塞很容易防守。

e.en: The {defendant} pleaded not guilty to all charges.
e.zh: 被告对所有指控均不认罪。

e.en: The jury found the {defendant} liable for damages.
e.zh: 陪审团认定被告应承担损害赔偿责任。

e.en: She {defended} her thesis brilliantly in front of the panel.
e.zh: 她在答辩委员会面前出色地为论文辩护。

e.en: The soldiers {defended} the bridge for three days.
e.zh: 士兵们坚守这座桥长达三天。

e.en: He was a fierce {defender} of free speech online.
e.zh: 他是网络言论自由的坚定捍卫者。

e.en: The {defender} blocked the shot in the final seconds.
e.zh: 防守球员在最后几秒挡下了射门。

e.en: The {defenders} of the fortress fought bravely until dawn.
e.zh: 要塞的守军英勇战斗直到天明。

e.en: Animal rights {defenders} protested outside the lab.
e.zh: 动物权益捍卫者在实验室外抗议。

e.en: The {defending} champion looked nervous before the match.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军在赛前显得很紧张。

e.en: She spent hours {defending} her decision on social media.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时在社交媒体上为自己的决定辩护。

e.en: A good antivirus {defends} your laptop against malware.
e.zh: 好的杀毒软件能保护你的笔记本电脑免受恶意软件侵害。

e.en: The senator always {defends} his voting record publicly.
e.zh: 那位参议员总是公开为自己的投票记录辩护。

e.en: The team's {defense} was the strongest in the league.
e.zh: 这支球队的防守是联赛中最强的。

e.en: She offered no {defense} when confronted with the evidence.
e.zh: 面对证据时她没有任何辩解。

e.en: The puppy was {defenseless} against the larger dog.
e.zh: 小狗在那只大狗面前毫无防御能力。

e.en: Civilians were left {defenseless} after the troops withdrew.
e.zh: 军队撤离后，平民们陷入毫无防卫的境地。

e.en: The young {defenseman} blocked three shots in the period.
e.zh: 这位年轻的后卫在这一节挡下了三次射门。

e.en: He was traded to become the team's top {defenseman}.
e.zh: 他被交易过来成为球队的头号后卫。

e.en: Stress can weaken your body's natural {defenses}.
e.zh: 压力会削弱身体的天然防御力。

e.en: The country upgraded its coastal {defenses} last year.
e.zh: 该国去年升级了海岸防御设施。

defensible.t: adj. 站得住脚的；可防御的

e.en: His decision was both ethical and legally {defensible}.
e.zh: 他的决定既符合伦理，又在法律上站得住脚。

e.en: The argument is no longer {defensible} given the new data.
e.zh: 鉴于新数据，这个论点已经站不住脚了。

e.en: He gets {defensive} whenever someone mentions his past.
e.zh: 每当有人提起他的过去，他就变得很有戒心。

e.en: The team played a strong {defensive} game tonight.
e.zh: 今晚球队打出了一场漂亮的防守战。

e.en: She replied {defensively} when asked about the missing money.
e.zh: 被问及失踪的钱款时她带着戒备地回答。

e.en: The team played {defensively} to protect their narrow lead.
e.zh: 球队采取防守战术以保住微弱的领先优势。

e.en: Her {defensiveness} during the meeting made honest feedback impossible.
e.zh: 她在会议中的防御心态让坦诚的反馈无法进行。

e.en: He apologized for his {defensiveness} when questioned about the mistake.
e.zh: 被问及那个错误时,他为自己的戒备态度道歉。

e.en: We decided to {defer} the decision until next quarter.
e.zh: 我们决定把这个决定推迟到下个季度。

e.en: Junior staff often {defer} to the senior engineer's judgment.
e.zh: 初级员工常常听从那位资深工程师的判断。

e.en: Out of {deference} to her experience, the team accepted her proposal.
e.zh: 出于对她经验的尊重,团队接受了她的提案。

e.en: He spoke with quiet {deference} to the elderly professor.
e.zh: 他用平静而恭敬的语气对那位年长教授说话。

e.en: The new intern was overly {deferential} to every senior employee.
e.zh: 新来的实习生对每位资深员工都过分恭敬。

e.en: She gave a {deferential} nod before taking her seat.
e.zh: 她恭敬地点了点头,然后坐下。

e.en: The waiter spoke {deferentially} to the famous guest.
e.zh: 服务员恭敬地与那位名人客人交谈。

e.en: He bowed {deferentially} as the elders entered the room.
e.zh: 长辈们走进房间时,他恭敬地鞠躬。

e.en: She applied for a student loan {deferment} during graduate school.
e.zh: 读研期间她申请了学生贷款的延期偿还。

e.en: The court granted a {deferment} of the trial date.
e.zh: 法院批准了庭审日期的延期。

e.en: The board approved a {deferral} of the merger to next year.
e.zh: 董事会批准将合并推迟到明年。

e.en: Tax {deferral} can help small businesses manage cash flow.
e.zh: 延迟纳税可以帮助小企业管理现金流。

deferred.t:
adj. 延期的
v. 推迟（过去式）

e.en: The launch was {deferred} until the bugs were fixed.
e.zh: 发布被推迟,直到修复完所有漏洞。

e.en: She {deferred} her admission to travel for a year.
e.zh: 她推迟了入学,出去旅行了一年。

e.en: In {defiance} of the curfew, protesters stayed in the square.
e.zh: 抗议者无视宵禁,继续留在广场上。

e.en: Her eyes flashed with {defiance} when the boss raised his voice.
e.zh: 老板提高声音时,她的眼中闪过一丝反抗。

e.en: The {defiant} teenager refused to apologize to his parents.
e.zh: 那个倔强的少年拒绝向父母道歉。

e.en: She gave a {defiant} answer to the reporter's pointed question.
e.zh: 面对记者尖锐的提问,她给出了挑衅的回答。

e.en: He folded his arms {defiantly} and refused to leave.
e.zh: 他倔强地抱起双臂,拒绝离开。

e.en: She stared {defiantly} at the judge during sentencing.
e.zh: 宣判时她不屈地盯着法官。

e.en: Quick {defibrillation} can save a patient in cardiac arrest.
e.zh: 对心脏骤停的病人及时电击除颤可以救命。

e.en: The paramedics performed {defibrillation} within two minutes of arrival.
e.zh: 急救人员到达后两分钟内就进行了除颤。

e.en: Every gym should have a {defibrillator} mounted on the wall.
e.zh: 每家健身房墙上都应该安装一台除颤器。

e.en: The portable {defibrillator} restarted his heart at the airport.
e.zh: 那台便携式除颤器在机场重新启动了他的心跳。

e.en: Doctors corrected the spinal {deformity} with surgery.
e.zh: 医生通过手术矫正了脊柱畸形。

e.en: The puppy was born with a minor {deformity} in its paw.
e.zh: 小狗出生时爪子有轻微畸形。

e.en: Scammers tried to {defraud} elderly people of their savings.
e.zh: 骗子企图骗取老年人的积蓄。

e.en: He was charged with conspiracy to {defraud} investors.
e.zh: 他被控合谋诈骗投资者。

defrauded.t: v. 诈骗（defraud 的过去式）

e.en: The company {defrauded} customers out of millions of dollars.
e.zh: 该公司诈骗了客户数百万美元。

e.en: Many homeowners were {defrauded} by the fake contractor.
e.zh: 许多业主被那个假承包商骗了。

e.en: The grant helps {defray} the cost of medical research.
e.zh: 这笔拨款有助于支付医学研究的费用。

e.en: A small fee will {defray} travel expenses for volunteers.
e.zh: 少量费用即可为志愿者支付差旅开支。

defrock.t: v. 革除（神职人员的）职位

e.en: The bishop chose to {defrock} the priest after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻发生后,主教决定剥夺那位神父的圣职。

e.en: Few churches are willing to {defrock} their senior clergy.
e.zh: 很少有教会愿意罢黜其高级神职人员。

defrocked.t: v. 革除教职（defrock 的过去式）

e.en: The {defrocked} minister later wrote a memoir about his fall.
e.zh: 那位被革职的牧师后来写了一本回忆录讲述自己的堕落。

e.en: He was {defrocked} for serious misconduct last year.
e.zh: 他去年因严重失德被剥夺了圣职。

e.en: Remember to {defrost} the chicken before dinner tonight.
e.zh: 记得在今晚做饭前把鸡肉解冻。

e.en: Press this button to {defrost} the windshield quickly.
e.zh: 按这个按钮可以快速给挡风玻璃除霜。

defrosted.t: v. 解冻（defrost 的过去式）

e.en: The salmon has fully {defrosted} and is ready to cook.
e.zh: 三文鱼已经完全解冻,可以下锅了。

e.en: She {defrosted} the freezer for the first time in years.
e.zh: 她多年来第一次给冰箱除霜。

e.en: Turn on the rear {defroster} to clear the foggy window.
e.zh: 打开后窗除雾器把雾蒙蒙的玻璃弄清楚。

e.en: The {defroster} broke during the coldest week of winter.
e.zh: 除霜器在冬天最冷的那周坏了。

e.en: With a {deft} flick of the wrist, she flipped the pancake.
e.zh: 她手腕一个利落的翻转,把煎饼翻了过来。

e.en: The novel features a {deft} portrayal of family tension.
e.zh: 这部小说对家庭矛盾的刻画十分巧妙。

e.en: The chef {deftly} sliced the onion into thin rings.
e.zh: 厨师利落地把洋葱切成薄薄的圈。

e.en: She {deftly} avoided the reporter's awkward question.
e.zh: 她巧妙地回避了记者那个尴尬的问题。

e.en: The pianist played with remarkable {deftness} and feeling.
e.zh: 钢琴家弹奏得既灵巧又富有情感。

e.en: His {deftness} with chopsticks impressed the whole table.
e.zh: 他用筷子的娴熟让全桌人都印象深刻。

defunct.t: adj. 不再存在的；已停用的

e.en: They found old photos from the now {defunct} magazine.
e.zh: 他们找到了那本如今已停刊杂志的旧照片。

e.en: The {defunct} factory has been turned into apartments.
e.zh: 那座废弃的工厂已被改建成公寓。

defuse.t: v. 化解（紧张局势）；拆除引信

e.en: A joke can sometimes {defuse} a tense meeting quickly.
e.zh: 一个玩笑有时能迅速化解紧张的会议气氛。

e.en: Experts worked carefully to {defuse} the unexploded bomb.
e.zh: 专家们小心翼翼地拆除那枚未爆炸弹。

e.en: Teenagers sometimes {defy} their parents just to feel free.
e.zh: 青少年有时反抗父母只是为了感受自由。

e.en: These results {defy} every prediction the analysts made.
e.zh: 这些结果违背了分析师做出的每一个预测。

defying.t: v. 违抗（defy 的现在分词）

e.en: She kept skating, {defying} the doctor's strict orders.
e.zh: 她不顾医生的严令继续滑冰。

e.en: The startup is {defying} expectations with rapid growth.
e.zh: 这家初创公司以飞速增长打破了人们的预期。

e.en: Set the oven to 180 {deg} Celsius before baking the cake.
e.zh: 烤蛋糕前先把烤箱预热到180度。

e.en: The screen tilts about 15 {deg} for better viewing.
e.zh: 屏幕大约倾斜15度以便观看。

degas.t:
v. 去除气体
n. 德加（画家）

e.en: You should {degas} the resin before pouring it into molds.
e.zh: 将树脂倒入模具前应先脱气处理。

e.en: Engineers {degas} the chamber to maintain a clean vacuum.
e.zh: 工程师对腔体进行除气以保持洁净的真空环境。

e.en: The novel critiques the moral {degeneracy} of the elite.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了精英阶层的道德堕落。

e.en: Quantum {degeneracy} explains why electrons share energy levels.
e.zh: 量子简并性解释了为何电子会共享能级。

degenerate.t:
v. 退化；恶化
adj. 堕落的

e.en: Negotiations quickly {degenerate} into shouting and finger-pointing.
e.zh: 谈判很快堕落为相互大喊大叫和指责。

e.en: His handwriting has become almost {degenerate} over the years.
e.zh: 这些年来他的字迹已变得几乎难以辨认。

e.en: Macular {degeneration} is a leading cause of vision loss.
e.zh: 黄斑变性是导致视力丧失的主要原因之一。

e.en: The film depicts the slow {degeneration} of an empire.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个帝国的缓慢衰落。

e.en: Alzheimer's is a {degenerative} disease that affects memory.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默症是一种影响记忆的退行性疾病。

e.en: Old athletes often suffer from {degenerative} joint problems.
e.zh: 老运动员常常患有退行性关节问题。

e.en: The packaging is fully {degradable} within six months.
e.zh: 这种包装在六个月内可以完全降解。

e.en: Look for {degradable} bags instead of regular plastic ones.
e.zh: 选择可降解袋,而不是普通塑料袋。

e.en: Soil {degradation} threatens food security in many regions.
e.zh: 土壤退化威胁着许多地区的粮食安全。

e.en: Workers protested against the {degradation} of their conditions.
e.zh: 工人们抗议工作条件的恶化。

e.en: The film catalogs the daily {degradations} faced by refugees.
e.zh: 这部影片记录了难民每天遭受的种种屈辱。

e.en: Multiple environmental {degradations} have hurt the local fisheries.
e.zh: 多重的环境退化已损害了当地渔业。

e.en: Compressing photos repeatedly will {degrade} their quality.
e.zh: 反复压缩照片会降低画质。

e.en: Don't let anyone {degrade} you with cruel words.
e.zh: 别让任何人用恶语贬低你。

e.en: The video looked badly {degraded} after multiple uploads.
e.zh: 经过多次上传后,视频画质明显变差。

e.en: Pollution has severely {degraded} the river's ecosystem.
e.zh: 污染严重破坏了这条河的生态系统。

e.en: Sunlight slowly {degrades} the color of outdoor furniture.
e.zh: 阳光会慢慢使户外家具的颜色褪色。

e.en: Constant criticism {degrades} a child's sense of self-worth.
e.zh: 不断的批评会损害孩子的自我价值感。

degrading.t:
adj. 有辱人格的
v. 降级中

e.en: The workers complained about the {degrading} treatment they received.
e.zh: 工人们抱怨他们所受到的侮辱性对待。

e.en: Battery performance is {degrading} faster than expected.
e.zh: 电池性能下降的速度比预期要快。

e.en: Spray some {degreaser} on the stove before wiping it clean.
e.zh: 在擦炉灶前先喷点去油剂。

e.en: Mechanics use heavy-duty {degreaser} to clean engine parts.
e.zh: 机械师用强力去油剂清洁引擎部件。

e.en: She earned a {degree} in computer science last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天获得了计算机科学学位。

e.en: The temperature dropped one {degree} every hour overnight.
e.zh: 夜里气温每小时下降一度。

degrees.t: n. 度数；程度（degree 的复数）

e.en: It's already 35 {degrees} outside and barely noon yet.
e.zh: 外面已经35度了,这才刚到中午。

e.en: Many staff members hold advanced {degrees} from top universities.
e.zh: 许多员工拥有顶尖大学的高等学位。

e.en: The restaurant offers a ten-course {degustation} menu on weekends.
e.zh: 这家餐厅周末提供十道菜的品鉴套餐。

e.en: We booked a wine {degustation} at the vineyard tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们预订了明天在酒庄的品酒会。

e.en: Wound {dehiscence} is a serious complication after surgery.
e.zh: 伤口裂开是手术后的一种严重并发症。

e.en: Botanists observed seed {dehiscence} as the pods dried out.
e.zh: 植物学家观察到豆荚干燥后种子的裂开过程。

dehumanise.t: v. 使失去人性（英式拼写）

e.en: Wartime propaganda often tries to {dehumanise} the enemy.
e.zh: 战时宣传常常试图把敌人非人化。

e.en: Algorithms can subtly {dehumanise} how we treat customers.
e.zh: 算法可能在不知不觉中使我们对待客户的方式失去人性。

dehumanised.t: v. 使失去人性（dehumanise 过去式）

e.en: Prisoners felt completely {dehumanised} by the harsh routine.
e.zh: 囚犯们在严酷的日常中感觉完全被剥夺了人性。

e.en: The factory system {dehumanised} workers throughout the 1800s.
e.zh: 工厂制度在整个19世纪让工人失去了人性。

e.en: Constant surveillance gradually {dehumanises} everyone in the office.
e.zh: 持续的监控逐渐让办公室里的每个人都失去人性。

e.en: Hate speech {dehumanises} entire communities and fuels violence.
e.zh: 仇恨言论使整个群体非人化,并助长暴力。

dehumanising.t: v. 使失去人性（现在分词）

e.en: Refugees endured {dehumanising} conditions at the overcrowded camp.
e.zh: 难民们在拥挤不堪的营地里忍受着非人的处境。

e.en: Critics call the new policy {dehumanising} and unjust.
e.zh: 批评人士称新政策非人道且不公正。

e.en: Propaganda often relies on the {dehumanization} of minority groups.
e.zh: 宣传往往依靠对少数群体的非人化。

e.en: Critics warn about the {dehumanization} caused by automated hiring systems.
e.zh: 批评者警告自动招聘系统会让人失去人性。

dehumanize.t: v. 使失去人性；非人化

e.en: War rhetoric tends to {dehumanize} the enemy in subtle ways.
e.zh: 战争言论往往会以微妙的方式将敌人非人化。

e.en: Such labels {dehumanize} workers and ignore their real struggles.
e.zh: 这种标签将工人非人化,忽视了他们真实的困境。

e.en: Refugees often feel {dehumanized} by the long asylum process.
e.zh: 难民常常因漫长的庇护程序而感到被剥夺了尊严。

e.en: The novel describes a {dehumanized} society ruled by algorithms.
e.zh: 这部小说描述了一个被算法统治、失去人性的社会。

e.en: Constant surveillance {dehumanizes} employees in modern warehouses.
e.zh: 持续监控让现代仓库里的员工失去人性。

e.en: Hate speech {dehumanizes} entire communities with a single word.
e.zh: 仇恨言论用一个词就能把整个群体非人化。

e.en: The prison conditions were described as {dehumanizing} and cruel.
e.zh: 监狱条件被形容为残忍且毫无人性。

e.en: She quit after years of {dehumanizing} treatment from management.
e.zh: 在管理层多年非人对待后,她辞职了。

e.en: We bought a {dehumidifier} to keep the basement dry.
e.zh: 我们买了一台除湿机让地下室保持干燥。

e.en: The {dehumidifier} hums quietly all night during rainy season.
e.zh: 雨季时除湿机整夜安静地嗡嗡运转。

e.en: Long flights can quickly {dehydrate} your skin and body.
e.zh: 长途飞行会很快让你的皮肤和身体脱水。

e.en: You can {dehydrate} mangoes at home using a low oven.
e.zh: 你可以用低温烤箱在家把芒果烘干。

e.en: After the hike, she felt dizzy and badly {dehydrated}.
e.zh: 徒步之后,她感到头晕,严重脱水。

e.en: Astronauts often eat {dehydrated} meals during long missions.
e.zh: 宇航员在长期任务中经常吃脱水食品。

e.en: The doctor warned that {dehydration} can cause serious headaches.
e.zh: 医生警告说脱水会引起严重头痛。

e.en: Drink water regularly to avoid {dehydration} during summer workouts.
e.zh: 夏天锻炼时要常喝水,以防脱水。

e.en: My new food {dehydrator} makes amazing apple chips.
e.zh: 我新买的食物烘干机能做出超棒的苹果脆片。

e.en: Hikers love jerky made in a home {dehydrator}.
e.zh: 徒步爱好者很喜欢用家用烘干机做的肉干。

e.en: The supplement contains {dehydroepiandrosterone}, often called DHEA.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有脱氢表雄酮,通常叫做 DHEA。

e.en: Doctors sometimes measure {dehydroepiandrosterone} to assess adrenal function.
e.zh: 医生有时会测脱氢表雄酮以评估肾上腺功能。

e.en: The audit revealed several {deficiencies} in the company's security practices.
e.zh: 审计发现公司安全措施存在多项不足。

e.en: Vitamin {deficiencies} can cause fatigue and weakened immunity.
e.zh: 维生素缺乏会导致疲劳和免疫力下降。

e.en: An iron {deficiency} left her feeling tired all day.
e.zh: 缺铁让她整天都感到疲倦。

e.en: The report highlighted a serious {deficiency} in worker training.
e.zh: 报告指出员工培训存在严重不足。

e.en: Many people in winter are {deficient} in vitamin D.
e.zh: 很多人在冬天都缺乏维生素D。

e.en: The early prototype was {deficient} in basic safety features.
e.zh: 早期原型在基本安全功能上有所欠缺。

e.en: The building was {deficiently} maintained for over a decade.
e.zh: 这栋楼十多年来维护得很不到位。

e.en: He argued the contract was {deficiently} drafted from the start.
e.zh: 他认为这份合同从一开始就拟得不够完善。

deficit.t:
n. 赤字；亏损
n. 不足额

e.en: The team faced a ten-point {deficit} at halftime.
e.zh: 该队在中场时落后十分。

e.en: The country's budget {deficit} grew sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年该国的预算赤字大幅增加。

e.en: Sleep {deficits} can hurt memory and decision-making.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会损害记忆力和决策能力。

e.en: The government plans to reduce trade {deficits} over five years.
e.zh: 政府计划在五年内减少贸易逆差。

defied.t: v. 违抗；反抗（defy 过去式）

e.en: She {defied} her parents and pursued an art career.
e.zh: 她不顾父母反对,选择了艺术事业。

e.en: The startup {defied} expectations by becoming profitable in year one.
e.zh: 那家初创公司打破预期,第一年就实现了盈利。

defies.t: v. 违抗；蔑视（第三人称单数）

e.en: The cat's flexibility {defies} the laws of physics.
e.zh: 猫的柔韧性简直违反了物理定律。

e.en: His success {defies} every traditional measure of talent.
e.zh: 他的成功打破了所有传统的天赋标准。

defile.t:
v. 玷污；亵渎
n. 隘路

e.en: Vandals tried to {defile} the ancient monument with graffiti.
e.zh: 破坏者企图用涂鸦玷污那座古老的纪念碑。

e.en: He refused to {defile} the memory of his late mentor.
e.zh: 他拒绝玷污已故导师的名誉。

e.en: The {defilement} of the temple shocked the entire community.
e.zh: 寺庙遭到亵渎令整个社区震惊。

e.en: Locals protested against the {defilement} of the sacred river.
e.zh: 当地居民抗议圣河遭到污染亵渎。

definable.t: adj. 可定义的；可界定的

e.en: Happiness is not easily {definable} in scientific terms.
e.zh: 幸福很难用科学语言明确定义。

e.en: Every project should have clearly {definable} success metrics.
e.zh: 每个项目都应该有可以明确定义的成功指标。

e.en: Please {define} your terms before we continue the debate.
e.zh: 在继续辩论之前,请先界定一下你的用词。

e.en: Your choices today {define} who you become tomorrow.
e.zh: 你今天的选择决定了你明天成为怎样的人。

e.en: The roles on the team are clearly {defined}.
e.zh: 团队中各人的角色都有明确的界定。

e.en: Regular workouts gave him a more {defined} jawline.
e.zh: 经常锻炼让他的下颌线条更加分明。

definer.t: n. 定义者；下定义的人

e.en: The dictionary's chief {definer} reviews every new entry carefully.
e.zh: 词典的首席释义编辑会仔细审查每一个新词条。

e.en: She became the {definer} of modern minimalist design.
e.zh: 她成了现代极简设计的定义者。

defines.t: v. 定义；规定（第三人称单数）

e.en: The constitution {defines} the rights of every citizen.
e.zh: 宪法界定了每个公民的权利。

e.en: Curiosity {defines} the best engineers I have worked with.
e.zh: 好奇心是我合作过的最优秀工程师们的共同特质。

defining.t:
v. 定义中
adj. 决定性的

e.en: Winning that championship was the {defining} moment of her career.
e.zh: 赢得那个冠军是她职业生涯中决定性的时刻。

e.en: The team spent hours {defining} the project's scope.
e.zh: 团队花了好几个小时来界定项目的范围。

e.en: We need a {definite} answer by Friday at the latest.
e.zh: 我们最迟周五前需要一个明确的答复。

e.en: There has been a {definite} improvement in her grades.
e.zh: 她的成绩有了明显的进步。

e.en: I'll {definitely} be at your birthday party tomorrow.
e.zh: 我明天一定会去你的生日派对。

e.en: This restaurant is {definitely} worth the long wait.
e.zh: 这家餐厅绝对值得排长队等位。

e.en: She answered with a {definiteness} that left no room for doubt.
e.zh: 她回答得斩钉截铁,不容置疑。

e.en: The plan lacked the {definiteness} investors were looking for.
e.zh: 这份计划缺乏投资者所期待的明确性。

definition.t:
n. 定义；释义
n. (画面) 清晰度

e.en: Look up the {definition} of the word in the dictionary.
e.zh: 在词典里查一下这个词的定义。

e.en: The new monitor displays text with stunning {definition}.
e.zh: 这台新显示器显示文字的清晰度令人惊艳。

e.en: The dispute is largely {definitional} rather than substantive.
e.zh: 这场争论主要是定义上的分歧,而非实质问题。

e.en: He raised a {definitional} question about what counts as art.
e.zh: 他提出了一个关于何为艺术的定义性问题。

e.en: The textbook lists key {definitions} at the end of each chapter.
e.zh: 教科书在每章末尾列出关键术语的定义。

e.en: Different cultures have different {definitions} of success.
e.zh: 不同文化对成功有着不同的定义。

e.en: This biography is the {definitive} account of his life.
e.zh: 这本传记是关于他一生的权威记述。

e.en: We still don't have a {definitive} answer about the cause.
e.zh: 我们仍然没有关于起因的确切答案。

e.en: The DNA test {definitively} proved his innocence.
e.zh: DNA检测确凿地证明了他的清白。

e.en: She {definitively} ruled out running for office again.
e.zh: 她明确表态不会再竞选公职。

deflate.t:
v. 放气；使瘪
v. 通货紧缩

e.en: Don't forget to {deflate} the air mattress before packing.
e.zh: 打包前别忘了把气垫床放气。

e.en: His harsh comment seemed to {deflate} her excitement instantly.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话似乎瞬间浇灭了她的兴奋。

e.en: She felt {deflated} after the rejection email arrived.
e.zh: 收到那封拒信后她感到很沮丧。

e.en: The {deflated} balloon lay sadly on the floor.
e.zh: 那只瘪了的气球可怜地躺在地板上。

e.en: Losing in the final round was a {deflating} experience.
e.zh: 在决赛中失利是一次令人泄气的经历。

e.en: He spent ten minutes {deflating} the inflatable boat.
e.zh: 他花了十分钟给充气艇放气。

deflation.t:
n. 通货紧缩
n. 放气；消气

e.en: Prolonged {deflation} can be as harmful as runaway inflation.
e.zh: 长期通货紧缩可能和恶性通胀一样有害。

e.en: The {deflation} of the tire was caused by a small nail.
e.zh: 轮胎漏气是被一颗小钉子扎到的。

e.en: Economists worried about a {deflationary} spiral in the economy.
e.zh: 经济学家担心经济会陷入通缩螺旋。

e.en: The central bank acted to counter {deflationary} pressures.
e.zh: 央行采取措施应对通缩压力。

deflator.t: n. 紧缩因子；平减指数

e.en: The GDP {deflator} measures price changes across the whole economy.
e.zh: GDP平减指数衡量整个经济体的价格变化。

e.en: Analysts use the price {deflator} to compare values across years.
e.zh: 分析师用价格平减指数来比较不同年份的数值。

e.en: The shield was designed to {deflect} incoming arrows.
e.zh: 那面盾牌的设计是用来挡开射来的箭。

e.en: He tried to {deflect} the question with a joke.
e.zh: 他试图用一个笑话来回避那个问题。

e.en: The goalkeeper {deflected} the ball with his fingertips.
e.zh: 守门员用指尖把球挡了出去。

e.en: She skillfully {deflected} every personal question from the reporter.
e.zh: 她巧妙地回避了记者所有的私人问题。

e.en: His answer was a clear {deflection} from the real issue.
e.zh: 他的回答明显是在回避真正的问题。

e.en: The bridge showed slight {deflection} under the heavy load.
e.zh: 在重压下,桥梁出现了轻微的弯曲变形。

e.en: The car has a wind {deflector} on the sunroof.
e.zh: 这辆车的天窗上装有挡风板。

e.en: Engineers added a heat {deflector} above the engine.
e.zh: 工程师在发动机上方加装了一个隔热挡板。

e.en: Children should not {deflower} the garden by picking every blossom.
e.zh: 孩子们不该把花园里的花全摘光。

e.en: The frost will {deflower} the cherry trees overnight.
e.zh: 一夜的霜冻会让樱花全部凋落。

e.en: Tap the screen to {defocus} the background in portrait mode.
e.zh: 在人像模式下点击屏幕可以虚化背景。

e.en: Photographers sometimes {defocus} the lens for a dreamy effect.
e.zh: 摄影师有时会故意让镜头失焦来营造梦幻效果。

e.en: The {defocused} city lights formed beautiful bokeh in the photo.
e.zh: 虚化的城市灯光在照片里形成漂亮的散景。

e.en: His eyes looked tired and slightly {defocused} after the long meeting.
e.zh: 长会过后,他的眼神显得疲惫,有些涣散。

e.en: The army sprayed a powerful {defoliant} over the dense jungle.
e.zh: 军队在茂密的丛林上空喷洒了强力落叶剂。

e.en: Farmers avoid using {defoliant} near organic crops.
e.zh: 农民们避免在有机作物附近使用脱叶剂。

e.en: Caterpillars can {defoliate} an entire oak tree in days.
e.zh: 毛毛虫几天内就能把整棵橡树的叶子吃光。

e.en: Strong winds {defoliate} the trees before winter arrives.
e.zh: 寒冬来临前,大风就把树叶吹光了。

e.en: Severe {defoliation} weakened the forest after the pest outbreak.
e.zh: 虫害爆发后,严重的落叶使森林变得脆弱。

e.en: Scientists studied {defoliation} caused by chemical warfare.
e.zh: 科学家研究了化学战造成的落叶现象。

e.en: The gypsy moth is a notorious {defoliator} of hardwood trees.
e.zh: 舞毒蛾是阔叶树臭名昭著的食叶害虫。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {defoliator} population through the summer.
e.zh: 研究人员整个夏季都在追踪食叶昆虫的数量。

e.en: Logging companies {deforest} vast areas of the Amazon each year.
e.zh: 伐木公司每年都会砍伐亚马逊的大片森林。

e.en: It is illegal to {deforest} protected national parkland.
e.zh: 在受保护的国家公园砍伐森林是违法的。

e.en: {Deforestation} contributes significantly to global climate change.
e.zh: 森林砍伐对全球气候变化有重大影响。

e.en: Satellite images reveal alarming rates of {deforestation}.
e.zh: 卫星图像显示出令人担忧的森林砍伐速度。

e.en: Repeated {deforestations} have left the hillsides bare and eroded.
e.zh: 反复砍伐使山坡变得光秃且水土流失。

e.en: Historians documented several {deforestations} during the colonial era.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了殖民时期的几次大规模森林砍伐。

e.en: The {deforested} hillside slid down during the heavy rains.
e.zh: 被砍伐殆尽的山坡在暴雨中滑塌了。

e.en: Settlers {deforested} much of the valley in the 1800s.
e.zh: 19世纪定居者砍伐了山谷里的大部分森林。

e.en: Heat can {deform} plastic containers if they're left in the car.
e.zh: 塑料容器留在车里可能会被高温烤变形。

e.en: The metal beams began to {deform} under the heavy load.
e.zh: 金属梁在重压下开始变形。

e.en: Engineers tested a {deformable} material for car bumpers.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种可变形材料用于汽车保险杠。

e.en: The robot's {deformable} grippers can hold fragile fruit.
e.zh: 机器人的可变形夹爪能抓取易碎的水果。

e.en: The crash caused significant {deformation} of the front bumper.
e.zh: 这次碰撞导致前保险杠严重变形。

e.en: Geologists study rock {deformation} to understand tectonic forces.
e.zh: 地质学家通过研究岩石变形来了解构造力。

e.en: The frame was badly {deformed} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后车架严重变形。

e.en: He found a {deformed} apple at the bottom of the basket.
e.zh: 他在篮子底部发现了一个畸形的苹果。

e.en: Lactate {dehydrogenase} levels rise after intense muscle damage.
e.zh: 剧烈肌肉损伤后,乳酸脱氢酶水平会升高。

e.en: The enzyme alcohol {dehydrogenase} breaks down ethanol in the liver.
e.zh: 乙醇脱氢酶在肝脏中分解乙醇。

dei.t: n. 多元、平等与包容（Diversity, Equity, Inclusion 缩写）

e.en: The company expanded its {DEI} programs after the new hire.
e.zh: 公司在新人入职后扩大了多元、平等与包容项目。

e.en: Several states are pushing back against corporate {DEI} initiatives.
e.zh: 多个州正在抵制企业的多元平等包容举措。

deictic.t:
adj. 指示的（语言学）
n. 指示词

e.en: Words like "here" and "now" are classic {deictic} expressions.
e.zh: "这里"和"现在"是典型的指示语表达。

e.en: Children master {deictic} pronouns surprisingly early in development.
e.zh: 儿童在发育早期就出人意料地掌握了指示代词。

e.en: Roman emperors expected {deification} after their deaths.
e.zh: 罗马皇帝期望死后被神化。

e.en: The fans' {deification} of the singer made him uncomfortable.
e.zh: 粉丝对这位歌手的神化让他感到不自在。

deified.t: v. 神化（deify 的过去式）

e.en: Ancient Egyptians {deified} certain pharaohs as living gods.
e.zh: 古埃及人将某些法老神化为活神。

e.en: Silicon Valley has nearly {deified} a handful of founders.
e.zh: 硅谷几乎把几位创始人神化了。

e.en: The media tends to {deify} successful tech entrepreneurs.
e.zh: 媒体倾向于将成功的科技创业者神化。

e.en: Some cultures {deify} ancestors and pray to them daily.
e.zh: 有些文化会把祖先神化并每天向他们祈祷。

e.en: The manager wouldn't even {deign} to answer my email.
e.zh: 经理甚至不屑于回复我的邮件。

e.en: She finally {deigned} to join us for lunch.
e.zh: 她终于屈尊和我们一起吃午饭。

e.en: {Deindustrialization} hollowed out many American manufacturing towns.
e.zh: 去工业化掏空了许多美国制造业城镇。

e.en: Economists debate whether {deindustrialization} actually improves long-term productivity.
e.zh: 经济学家争论去工业化是否真的能提升长期生产力。

e.en: Several founding fathers were drawn to {deism} rather than orthodox religion.
e.zh: 几位开国元勋更倾向于自然神论,而非正统宗教。

e.en: {Deism} holds that God created the universe and stepped back.
e.zh: 自然神论认为上帝创造宇宙后便不再干预。

e.en: Thomas Jefferson is often described as a {deist}.
e.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊常被描述为自然神论者。

e.en: As a {deist}, he believed in a distant, non-interfering creator.
e.zh: 作为自然神论者,他相信一位遥远、不干预的造物主。

e.en: His writings reveal a clearly {deistic} view of the universe.
e.zh: 他的著作展现出明显的自然神论宇宙观。

e.en: The philosopher offered a {deistic} alternative to traditional theism.
e.zh: 这位哲学家提出了一种自然神论以替代传统有神论。

e.en: The temple is dedicated to a local mountain {deity}.
e.zh: 这座寺庙供奉一位当地的山神。

e.en: Every morning, villagers leave fruit before the {deity}'s statue.
e.zh: 每天早上,村民会在神像前供上水果。

e.en: Linguistics students often struggle with the concept of {deixis}.
e.zh: 语言学学生常常对指示语这一概念感到困惑。

e.en: Pointing gestures are a basic form of spatial {deixis}.
e.zh: 指点手势是空间指示语的基本形式。

e.en: He looked utterly {dejected} after losing the final match.
e.zh: 输掉决赛后,他显得无比沮丧。

e.en: The {dejected} candidate quietly left the stage.
e.zh: 那位失意的候选人悄悄离开了舞台。

dejectedly.t: adv. 沮丧地；垂头丧气地

e.en: She walked {dejectedly} home after the rejection email.
e.zh: 收到拒信后,她沮丧地走回了家。

e.en: He stared {dejectedly} at the empty bank account.
e.zh: 他沮丧地盯着空空如也的银行账户。

e.en: A wave of {dejection} hit her when the offer fell through.
e.zh: 录用机会落空时,一阵失落涌上她心头。

e.en: His face showed obvious {dejection} after reading the verdict.
e.zh: 读完判决后,他脸上明显写满了沮丧。

e.en: We had a long {dejeuner} at a sunny Paris cafe.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎一家阳光明媚的咖啡馆吃了顿悠长的午餐。

e.en: The hotel offers a complimentary {dejeuner} for early guests.
e.zh: 酒店为早到的客人提供免费午餐。

deke.t:
v. 做假动作晃过（冰球）
n. 假动作

e.en: The forward used a quick {deke} to beat the goalie.
e.zh: 前锋用一个快速假动作骗过了守门员。

e.en: She tried to {deke} past the defender and scored.
e.zh: 她尝试用假动作晃过防守球员后破门得分。

del.t: n. 删除键（Delete 缩写）；梯度算子 ∇

e.en: Press {del} to remove the highlighted file.
e.zh: 按 Del 键删除选中的文件。

e.en: The keyboard shortcut uses Ctrl plus {del} to clear the row.
e.zh: 快捷键是 Ctrl 加 Del 来清除整行。

e.en: The inspector found {delamination} in the aircraft's composite wing.
e.zh: 检查员在飞机的复合材料机翼中发现了分层。

e.en: Moisture often causes {delamination} in cheap plywood furniture.
e.zh: 潮湿常常导致廉价胶合板家具出现分层。

delaware.t: n. 特拉华州（美国州名）

e.en: Many U.S. companies incorporate in {Delaware} for tax reasons.
e.zh: 许多美国公司出于税务原因在特拉华州注册。

e.en: We drove through {Delaware} on our way to New York.
e.zh: 我们去纽约的路上穿过了特拉华州。

delay.t:
n. 延迟；耽搁
v. 推迟

e.en: The flight had a two-hour {delay} due to fog.
e.zh: 由于大雾,航班延误了两个小时。

e.en: Please don't {delay} your reply any longer.
e.zh: 请不要再拖延回复了。

e.en: The package was {delayed} by bad weather.
e.zh: 包裹因为天气恶劣而延误了。

e.en: She {delayed} the meeting until next Monday.
e.zh: 她把会议推迟到了下周一。

delaying.t:
adj. 拖延的
v. 推迟（delay 进行式）

e.en: Stop {delaying} the decision and just commit to one option.
e.zh: 别再拖延决定了,就选一个吧。

e.en: Heavy traffic is {delaying} commuters all over the city.
e.zh: 严重的交通拥堵让全市的通勤者都被耽搁了。

delays.t:
n. 延误（复数）
v. 推迟（第三人称单数）

e.en: Frequent train {delays} are frustrating daily commuters.
e.zh: 频繁的列车晚点让每日通勤者很恼火。

e.en: The new system {delays} notifications by a few seconds.
e.zh: 新系统会让通知延迟几秒钟。

delectable.t: adj. 美味的；令人愉悦的

e.en: The bakery sells the most {delectable} chocolate croissants.
e.zh: 这家面包店卖最美味的巧克力可颂。

e.en: She prepared a {delectable} dinner for her in-laws.
e.zh: 她为公婆准备了一顿美味的晚餐。

delectably.t: adv. 美味地；令人愉悦地

e.en: The steak was {delectably} tender and perfectly seasoned.
e.zh: 牛排嫩得令人陶醉,调味恰到好处。

e.en: Her cookies smelled {delectably} of butter and vanilla.
e.zh: 她的饼干散发出诱人的黄油和香草味。

e.en: The chef prepared oysters for our {delectation}.
e.zh: 主厨为我们的享用准备了生蚝。

e.en: He read the gossip column with obvious {delectation}.
e.zh: 他津津有味地读着八卦专栏。

delegate.t:
n. 代表
v. 委派；授权

e.en: Good managers {delegate} tasks instead of doing everything alone.
e.zh: 好的管理者会分派任务,而不是事事亲力亲为。

e.en: Each country sent one {delegate} to the climate summit.
e.zh: 每个国家都派了一名代表参加气候峰会。

delegated.t:
adj. 被委派的
v. 委派（过去式）

e.en: She {delegated} the budget review to her assistant.
e.zh: 她把预算审核交给了助理。

e.en: Authority can be {delegated}, but responsibility cannot.
e.zh: 权力可以下放,但责任无法转移。

delegates.t:
n. 代表（复数）
v. 委派（第三人称单数）

e.en: Hundreds of {delegates} gathered for the annual conference.
e.zh: 数百名代表聚集参加年度会议。

e.en: A skilled leader {delegates} effectively to free up time.
e.zh: 出色的领导者能有效授权,以腾出时间。

e.en: A Chinese {delegation} visited the new research lab.
e.zh: 一个中国代表团参观了新的研究实验室。

e.en: Effective {delegation} is a hallmark of strong leadership.
e.zh: 有效的授权是强力领导力的标志。

e.en: Several {delegations} walked out during the controversial speech.
e.zh: 在那场有争议的演讲中,几个代表团退场了。

e.en: Trade {delegations} from Asia arrived in Geneva yesterday.
e.zh: 来自亚洲的贸易代表团昨天抵达了日内瓦。

e.en: My boss is a great {delegator} who trusts her team.
e.zh: 我老板很会授权,非常信任团队。

e.en: Every effective {delegator} also follows up on results.
e.zh: 每位高效的授权者都会跟进结果。

delegitimation.t: n. 去合法化；剥夺合法性

e.en: Constant attacks led to the gradual {delegitimation} of the courts.
e.zh: 持续的攻击导致法院逐渐丧失公信力。

e.en: Scholars study the {delegitimation} of democratic institutions worldwide.
e.zh: 学者研究全球民主机构合法性被削弱的现象。

delegitimization.t: n. 去合法化；剥夺合法性

e.en: Fake news contributes to the {delegitimization} of mainstream journalism.
e.zh: 假新闻助长了主流新闻业合法性的丧失。

e.en: The campaign aimed at the {delegitimization} of the election results.
e.zh: 这场运动旨在否定选举结果的合法性。

delete.t:
v. 删除
n. 删除键

e.en: Are you sure you want to {delete} this file permanently?
e.zh: 你确定要永久删除这个文件吗?

e.en: Please {delete} my account and all related data.
e.zh: 请删除我的账户以及所有相关数据。

deleted.t:
adj. 已删除的
v. 删除（过去式）

e.en: I accidentally {deleted} the entire project folder.
e.zh: 我不小心把整个项目文件夹删了。

e.en: Her old tweets have all been {deleted}.
e.zh: 她以前的推文都已经被删除了。

e.en: Lack of sleep has {deleterious} effects on memory.
e.zh: 睡眠不足对记忆力有不良影响。

e.en: The new policy could be {deleterious} to small businesses.
e.zh: 这项新政策可能对小企业有害。

deletes.t: v. 删除（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app automatically {deletes} old messages after thirty days.
e.zh: 该应用会在三十天后自动删除旧消息。

e.en: She {deletes} every spam email without opening it.
e.zh: 她不打开就直接删除每一封垃圾邮件。

deleting.t: v. 正在删除（delete 进行式）

e.en: I'm {deleting} duplicate photos from my phone.
e.zh: 我正在删除手机里的重复照片。

e.en: Be careful when {deleting} files from the shared drive.
e.zh: 从共享盘删除文件时要小心。

e.en: The {deletion} of your account is permanent.
e.zh: 账户的删除是永久性的。

e.en: Please confirm the {deletion} before closing this window.
e.zh: 关闭此窗口前请确认删除。

delft.t: n. 代尔夫特（荷兰城市）；青花陶器

e.en: We toured a pottery studio in {Delft} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了代尔夫特的一家陶艺工作室。

e.en: Her grandmother collected blue {Delft} plates from the Netherlands.
e.zh: 她外婆收藏来自荷兰的蓝色代尔夫特瓷盘。

e.en: The museum displayed centuries-old {delftware} in glass cases.
e.zh: 博物馆在玻璃柜中展出几百年前的代尔夫特蓝陶。

e.en: She inherited a set of antique {delftware} from her aunt.
e.zh: 她从姑妈那里继承了一套古董代尔夫特蓝陶。

e.en: Our flight to {Delhi} was delayed by six hours.
e.zh: 我们飞往德里的航班晚点了六小时。

e.en: Street food in {Delhi} is famous around the world.
e.zh: 德里的街头小吃闻名世界。

deli.t: n. 熟食店（delicatessen 的缩写）

e.en: I grabbed a sandwich from the {deli} on the corner.
e.zh: 我在街角的熟食店买了个三明治。

e.en: This {deli} makes the best pastrami in town.
e.zh: 这家熟食店做的烟熏牛肉是全城最好的。

deliberate.t:
adj. 故意的；深思熟虑的
v. 仔细考虑

e.en: Ignoring her message was a {deliberate} choice.
e.zh: 无视她的消息是一个有意的选择。

e.en: The jury will {deliberate} for several hours today.
e.zh: 陪审团今天将商议好几个小时。

e.en: The committee {deliberated} for weeks before announcing the winner.
e.zh: 委员会经过数周商讨才宣布获奖者。

e.en: She {deliberated} over which job offer to accept.
e.zh: 她在几个工作邀请之间斟酌该接受哪一个。

e.en: He {deliberately} ignored my calls all weekend.
e.zh: 他整个周末都故意不接我的电话。

e.en: The chef seasons each dish {deliberately} and with care.
e.zh: 厨师有意识且细心地为每道菜调味。

e.en: She spoke with a calm {deliberateness} that impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她说话从容审慎,令所有人印象深刻。

e.en: The {deliberateness} of his actions suggested careful planning.
e.zh: 他行动的从容审慎显示出周密的计划。

deliberates.t: v. 仔细考虑（第三人称单数）

e.en: The board {deliberates} on budget changes every quarter.
e.zh: 董事会每季度商议一次预算调整。

e.en: She {deliberates} carefully before making any major decision.
e.zh: 做任何重大决定前她都会仔细斟酌。

e.en: The judges are still {deliberating} on the final score.
e.zh: 评委们仍在商议最终得分。

e.en: I've been {deliberating} between two apartments all week.
e.zh: 这一周我一直在两套公寓之间反复考虑。

e.en: After much {deliberation}, she accepted the new role.
e.zh: 经过反复考虑,她接受了这个新职位。

e.en: The jury reached a verdict after hours of {deliberation}.
e.zh: 陪审团经过数小时商议后作出了裁决。

e.en: Congress is meant to be a slow, {deliberative} body.
e.zh: 国会本应是一个慢节奏、审慎议事的机构。

e.en: They followed a {deliberative} process before launching the product.
e.zh: 在发布产品前他们走了一套审慎的决策流程。

e.en: The night market sells local {delicacies} at low prices.
e.zh: 夜市以低价出售当地美食。

e.en: Truffles and caviar are considered expensive {delicacies}.
e.zh: 松露和鱼子酱被视为昂贵的珍馐。

e.en: Sea urchin is a {delicacy} in many coastal regions.
e.zh: 海胆在许多沿海地区是一道珍馐。

e.en: He handled the topic with surprising {delicacy}.
e.zh: 他处理这个话题时出乎意料地细致得体。

delicate.t: adj. 精致的；脆弱的；微妙的

e.en: Wash these {delicate} silk shirts by hand only.
e.zh: 这些娇贵的丝绸衬衫只能手洗。

e.en: Negotiations reached a {delicate} stage last week.
e.zh: 谈判上周进入了一个微妙的阶段。

e.en: She {delicately} placed the cake on the display stand.
e.zh: 她小心翼翼地把蛋糕放到展示架上。

e.en: The manager handled the complaint {delicately} and professionally.
e.zh: 经理委婉而专业地处理了这次投诉。

e.en: The corner {delicatessen} makes incredible homemade pastrami sandwiches.
e.zh: 街角的熟食店做的自制烟熏牛肉三明治超棒。

e.en: We picked up cheese and olives at the German {delicatessen}.
e.zh: 我们在那家德国熟食店买了奶酪和橄榄。

e.en: New York is famous for its old-school Jewish {delicatessens}.
e.zh: 纽约以其老派的犹太熟食店闻名。

e.en: Several {delicatessens} in town stock imported Italian meats.
e.zh: 城里有几家熟食店供应进口的意大利肉制品。

e.en: This ramen is absolutely {delicious} on a cold day.
e.zh: 这碗拉面在寒冷的天里实在太好吃了。

e.en: She baked a {delicious} chocolate cake for the party.
e.zh: 她为聚会烤了一个美味的巧克力蛋糕。

deliciously.t: adv. 美味地；令人愉悦地

e.en: The novel is {deliciously} dark and full of twists.
e.zh: 这部小说阴暗得过瘾,情节充满反转。

e.en: His new café smells {deliciously} of fresh croissants.
e.zh: 他新开的咖啡馆飘着新鲜可颂的诱人香气。

e.en: You can't beat the {deliciousness} of a fresh mango in summer.
e.zh: 夏天里没有什么比得上一颗新鲜芒果的美味。

e.en: Her dumplings have a {deliciousness} that keeps customers coming back.
e.zh: 她的饺子那种美味让顾客一来再来。

delight.t:
n. 喜悦；乐事
v. 使高兴

e.en: The kids squealed with {delight} when they saw the puppy.
e.zh: 孩子们看到小狗时高兴得尖叫起来。

e.en: This new café is a real {delight} to visit.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆去一次就让人心情愉悦。

e.en: I'm {delighted} that you could join us tonight.
e.zh: 你今晚能来我真是太高兴了。

e.en: She was {delighted} by the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 那个惊喜生日派对让她非常开心。

e.en: The toddler {delightedly} splashed in every puddle on the path.
e.zh: 小娃娃在路上的每个水坑里开心地踩水。

e.en: He {delightedly} unwrapped the gift from his sister.
e.zh: 他兴高采烈地拆开了姐姐送的礼物。

delightful.t: adj. 令人愉快的；讨人喜欢的

e.en: We had a {delightful} evening at the riverside restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在江边餐厅度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

e.en: Her new puppy is the most {delightful} little creature.
e.zh: 她的新小狗是最讨人喜欢的小家伙。

e.en: The tea garden was {delightfully} quiet on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 周日早晨那家茶园安静得让人惬意。

e.en: Her novel is {delightfully} weird and hard to put down.
e.zh: 她的小说怪得有趣,让人爱不释手。

e.en: The chef keeps {delighting} guests with seasonal tasting menus.
e.zh: 主厨不断用时令套餐让客人惊喜。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {delighting} her grandchildren with stories.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在用故事逗孙辈开心。

delights.t:
n. 乐事（复数）
v. 使高兴

e.en: The bakery offers many sweet {delights} for the holidays.
e.zh: 这家面包店为节日准备了许多甜点佳品。

e.en: Nothing {delights} him more than a long mountain hike.
e.zh: 没什么比一次长途山地徒步更让他开心。

delimit.t: v. 划定界限；限定范围

e.en: Use commas to {delimit} the values in this CSV file.
e.zh: 用逗号来分隔这个 CSV 文件中的各个值。

e.en: The treaty will {delimit} the new border between the states.
e.zh: 该条约将划定两州之间的新边界。

e.en: The {delimitation} of voting districts caused political controversy.
e.zh: 选区的划定引发了政治争议。

e.en: Clear {delimitation} of responsibilities helps the team work smoothly.
e.zh: 明确划分职责有助于团队顺畅协作。

delimited.t:
adj. 分隔的（如逗号分隔）
v. 划定（过去式）

e.en: Save the data as a tab-{delimited} text file.
e.zh: 把数据保存为以制表符分隔的文本文件。

e.en: A low fence {delimited} the boundary of the garden.
e.zh: 一道矮围栏划定了花园的边界。

e.en: The contract should clearly {delineate} each partner's responsibilities.
e.zh: 合同应清楚地划分每位合伙人的职责。

e.en: The map will {delineate} the protected forest area.
e.zh: 这张地图将标明受保护森林区的范围。

e.en: The report {delineated} every step of the migration plan.
e.zh: 该报告详细描绘了迁移计划的每一步。

e.en: Property lines were clearly {delineated} on the survey map.
e.zh: 地界在测绘图上被清晰地标了出来。

e.en: The author's {delineation} of the main character feels very real.
e.zh: 作者对主角的刻画显得非常真实。

e.en: Clear {delineation} of duties prevents confusion among team members.
e.zh: 清楚地划分职责可避免团队成员之间的混乱。

delinquency.t: n. 违法行为；（青少年）犯罪

e.en: The program aims to reduce juvenile {delinquency} in poor neighborhoods.
e.zh: 该项目旨在减少贫困社区的青少年犯罪行为。

e.en: His loan {delinquency} hurt his credit score badly.
e.zh: 他贷款逾期严重影响了他的信用评分。

delinquent.t:
n. 违法者；拖欠者
adj. 违法的

e.en: Your account is sixty days {delinquent} on the rent.
e.zh: 你的账户房租已逾期六十天未付。

e.en: The school works closely with {delinquent} teenagers and their families.
e.zh: 学校与有不良行为的青少年及其家人密切合作。

delirious.t: adj. 神志不清的；狂喜的

e.en: The fans were {delirious} after their team won the final.
e.zh: 球队赢下决赛后,球迷们欣喜若狂。

e.en: He became {delirious} from the high fever overnight.
e.zh: 他因高烧一夜之间开始神志不清。

deliriously.t: adv. 神志不清地；狂喜地

e.en: They were {deliriously} happy on their wedding day.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼那天高兴得发狂。

e.en: She talked {deliriously} during the worst hours of the fever.
e.zh: 高烧最严重的时候,她说起话来神志不清。

e.en: The patient slipped into {delirium} during the night.
e.zh: 病人在夜里陷入了神志不清的状态。

e.en: There was a sense of {delirium} in the championship crowd.
e.zh: 夺冠现场的人群中弥漫着一种狂喜。

e.en: The company faces {delisting} from the stock exchange next month.
e.zh: 该公司下个月将面临从证券交易所摘牌。

e.en: News of the {delisting} caused the share price to plunge.
e.zh: 摘牌的消息导致股价暴跌。

e.en: We can {deliver} your order by tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 我们可以在明天下午之前送达您的订单。

e.en: She has to {deliver} a keynote speech at the conference.
e.zh: 她要在会议上发表主旨演讲。

deliverable.t:
n. 交付物；成果
adj. 可交付的

e.en: The first project {deliverable} is due next Friday.
e.zh: 项目的第一项交付物下周五截止。

e.en: Each {deliverable} must be approved before we move on.
e.zh: 每项交付物在继续推进前都必须获得批准。

e.en: They prayed for {deliverance} from the long drought.
e.zh: 他们祈祷能从长期的干旱中得到解脱。

e.en: The ceasefire felt like {deliverance} after months of fighting.
e.zh: 经过数月的战斗,停火协议像是一种解脱。

e.en: My package was {delivered} to the wrong address again.
e.zh: 我的包裹又被送到了错误的地址。

e.en: She {delivered} a powerful speech that moved the audience.
e.zh: 她发表了一篇打动观众的有力演讲。

e.en: The food {deliverer} called when he reached the lobby.
e.zh: 送餐员到达大堂时打了电话。

e.en: She is the main {deliverer} of bad news in our office.
e.zh: 在我们办公室里,坏消息主要是她去通知。

e.en: Online grocery {deliveries} have changed how families shop.
e.zh: 在线生鲜配送改变了家庭购物的方式。
