e.en: The driver makes about thirty {deliveries} every weekday.
e.zh: 这位司机每个工作日大约送三十单。

e.en: He's {delivering} pizzas part-time while studying engineering.
e.zh: 他一边读工程学一边兼职送披萨。

e.en: The CEO is {delivering} the keynote at this year's summit.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在今年的峰会上发表主旨演讲。

delivers.t: v. 交付；递送（第三人称单数）

e.en: The courier {delivers} packages before noon every weekday.
e.zh: 快递员每个工作日中午前送达包裹。

e.en: This phone {delivers} stunning photos even in low light.
e.zh: 这款手机即使在弱光下也能拍出惊艳照片。

demerger.t: n. 公司分拆、业务剥离

e.en: The {demerger} created two independent companies listed separately on the exchange.
e.zh: 此次分拆产生了两家独立上市的公司。

e.en: Investors generally welcomed the {demerger} as a strategic move.
e.zh: 投资者普遍欢迎此次分拆,认为这是一项战略举措。

demerit.t:
n. 缺点；过失
n. (学校) 记过

e.en: Each {demerit} brings the student closer to a parent meeting.
e.zh: 每记一次过都让该学生更接近被叫家长。

e.en: The plan's main {demerit} is its surprisingly high upfront cost.
e.zh: 该方案的主要缺点是前期成本出乎意料地高。

e.en: The duke rode through his vast {demesne} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 公爵每个周日早晨都骑马巡视他广阔的领地。

e.en: Software architecture is firmly within her professional {demesne}.
e.zh: 软件架构完全在她的专业领域之内。

demeter.t: n. 得墨忒耳（希腊农业女神）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Demeter} is the goddess of the harvest.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中，得墨忒耳是丰收女神。

e.en: The museum's new exhibit features a marble statue of {Demeter}.
e.zh: 博物馆的新展览展出了一尊得墨忒耳的大理石像。

e.en: She ordered a {demi} baguette with her morning coffee.
e.zh: 她点了一个半截法棍配早晨的咖啡。

e.en: The recipe calls for a {demi} cup of cream.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要半杯奶油。

e.en: Hercules was a {demigod} born to a mortal mother and Zeus.
e.zh: 赫拉克勒斯是凡人母亲与宙斯所生的半神。

e.en: Fans treat the retired quarterback like a local {demigod}.
e.zh: 球迷把那位退役四分卫当作本地的半神来崇拜。

demilitarised.t: adj. 非军事化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The border zone has been fully {demilitarised} since the treaty.
e.zh: 自条约签订以来，边境地区已完全非军事化。

e.en: Both sides {demilitarised} the disputed islands last year.
e.zh: 双方去年将争议岛屿非军事化。

e.en: The peace deal called for the {demilitarization} of the buffer zone.
e.zh: 和平协议要求对缓冲区进行非军事化。

e.en: Complete {demilitarization} of the region remains a distant goal.
e.zh: 该地区的彻底非军事化仍是遥远目标。

demilitarize.t: v. 使非军事化；解除武装

e.en: The two countries agreed to {demilitarize} the contested border.
e.zh: 两国同意将争议边境非军事化。

e.en: Activists are urging the government to {demilitarize} the police force.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促政府让警察部队去军事化。

e.en: The {demilitarized} zone separates the two Koreas.
e.zh: 非军事区将朝韩两国隔开。

e.en: After the war, the island was officially {demilitarized}.
e.zh: 战后，该岛被正式宣布为非军事化区。

demimonde.t: n. 风尘女子阶层；半上流社会

e.en: The novel paints a vivid picture of Paris's nineteenth-century {demimonde}.
e.zh: 小说生动描绘了十九世纪巴黎的风月圈。

e.en: He moved easily through the city's artistic {demimonde}.
e.zh: 他在这座城市的艺术边缘圈子里游刃有余。

e.en: Tooth {demineralization} is the first stage of cavity formation.
e.zh: 牙齿脱矿是蛀牙形成的第一阶段。

e.en: The plant uses reverse osmosis for water {demineralization}.
e.zh: 该工厂使用反渗透技术对水进行脱盐处理。

demise.t:
n. 消亡；死亡
v. 终结

e.en: Streaming services hastened the {demise} of the DVD rental store.
e.zh: 流媒体服务加速了DVD租赁店的消亡。

e.en: Few people predicted the rapid {demise} of the once-popular app.
e.zh: 很少有人预料到这款曾风靡一时的应用会迅速衰亡。

e.en: The estate was {demised} to his eldest daughter in the will.
e.zh: 该地产在遗嘱中被让予他的长女。

e.en: The cottage was {demised} to the tenant for ninety-nine years.
e.zh: 这栋小屋以九十九年的租期租给了承租人。

demises.t: n./v. 消亡；终结（复数/三单）

e.en: History records the {demises} of many great empires.
e.zh: 史书记载了许多伟大帝国的灭亡。

e.en: The newspaper's obituary section lists the week's notable {demises}.
e.zh: 报纸的讣告版列出了本周值得关注的去世人物。

e.en: She served espresso in tiny {demitasse} cups after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后她用小巧的半杯咖啡杯端上了浓缩咖啡。

e.en: He sipped his {demitasse} slowly on the café terrace.
e.zh: 他在咖啡馆露台上慢慢啜饮着小杯浓咖啡。

demiurge.t: n. 造物主；巨匠造物神

e.en: In Gnostic thought, the {demiurge} fashioned the material world.
e.zh: 在诺斯替思想中，造物主塑造了物质世界。

e.en: The CEO acted like a {demiurge}, shaping the company in his image.
e.zh: 那位CEO像造物主一样按自己的形象塑造公司。

demo.t:
n. 演示；样品
v. 示范

e.en: The startup gave a live {demo} of its new app yesterday.
e.zh: 这家初创公司昨天现场演示了它的新应用。

e.en: You can download a free {demo} before buying the full game.
e.zh: 购买完整版前你可以免费下载试玩版。

e.en: His grandfather got his {demob} suit at the end of the war.
e.zh: 他祖父在战争结束时领到了退伍套装。

e.en: After {demob}, many soldiers struggled to find civilian work.
e.zh: 复员后，许多士兵难以找到平民工作。

demobilisation.t: n. 复员；遣散（英式拼写）

e.en: The {demobilisation} of troops began the day the ceasefire was signed.
e.zh: 部队的复员工作在停火协议签署当天就开始了。

e.en: Postwar {demobilisation} flooded the labour market with returning veterans.
e.zh: 战后复员让劳动力市场涌入大批归来的老兵。

demobilise.t: v. 复员；遣散（英式拼写）

e.en: The army began to {demobilise} reservists after the conflict ended.
e.zh: 冲突结束后，军队开始遣散预备役人员。

e.en: Negotiators want both sides to {demobilise} their militias.
e.zh: 谈判人员希望双方解散各自的民兵组织。

e.en: Rapid {demobilization} caused unemployment to spike in 1946.
e.zh: 1946年快速的复员导致失业率飙升。

e.en: The UN supervised the {demobilization} of former combatants.
e.zh: 联合国监督了前战斗人员的复员工作。

e.en: The government plans to {demobilize} half its troops by next year.
e.zh: 政府计划明年前让一半部队复员。

e.en: Critics say the speech was designed to {demobilize} young voters.
e.zh: 批评人士认为这场演讲意在让年轻选民失去投票热情。

democracies.t: n. 民主制；民主国家（复数）

e.en: Many young {democracies} struggle with corruption in their early years.
e.zh: 许多新兴民主国家在初期都饱受腐败困扰。

e.en: Established {democracies} are not immune to political polarization.
e.zh: 成熟的民主国家也无法幸免于政治两极化。

e.en: A healthy {democracy} depends on a free and informed press.
e.zh: 健康的民主依赖于自由且消息灵通的新闻媒体。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the future of digital {democracy}.
e.zh: 她以数字民主的未来为题写了论文。

democrat.t: n. 民主主义者；(美) 民主党人

e.en: Her grandfather was a lifelong {democrat} who never missed an election.
e.zh: 她祖父一生都是民主党人，从未错过任何一次选举。

e.en: He considers himself a true {democrat} who respects every voter.
e.zh: 他自认为是尊重每位选民的真正民主主义者。

democratic.t: adj. 民主的；民主制度的

e.en: The country held its first {democratic} election in over thirty years.
e.zh: 该国举行了三十多年来的首次民主选举。

e.en: Our team makes decisions in a {democratic} way through group voting.
e.zh: 我们团队以民主方式通过集体投票来做决定。

democratically.t: adv. 民主地；以民主方式

e.en: The president was {democratically} elected with a clear majority.
e.zh: 这位总统以明显多数票民主地当选。

e.en: The committee chair is chosen {democratically} every two years.
e.zh: 委员会主席每两年通过民主方式选出。

e.en: Smartphones drove the {democratisation} of high-quality photography.
e.zh: 智能手机推动了高质量摄影的大众化。

e.en: The country's {democratisation} took decades of grassroots effort.
e.zh: 该国的民主化耗费了数十年的基层努力。

democratise.t: v. 使民主化（英式拼写）

e.en: The startup aims to {democratise} access to financial advice.
e.zh: 这家初创公司旨在让金融咨询服务大众化。

e.en: Open-source tools help {democratise} software development globally.
e.zh: 开源工具帮助全球软件开发走向大众化。

e.en: AI tools are driving the {democratization} of content creation.
e.zh: 人工智能工具正在推动内容创作的大众化。

e.en: The {democratization} of higher education remains an unfinished project.
e.zh: 高等教育的大众化仍是一项未竟的事业。

e.en: The platform aims to {democratize} investing for ordinary people.
e.zh: 该平台旨在让普通人也能参与投资。

e.en: Cheap cameras helped {democratize} filmmaking in the 2000s.
e.zh: 廉价摄像机在2000年代帮助电影制作走向大众化。

e.en: YouTube {democratized} video publishing for anyone with a camera.
e.zh: YouTube让任何有摄像机的人都能发布视频。

e.en: Streaming has {democratized} access to films from around the world.
e.zh: 流媒体让来自世界各地的电影变得触手可及。

democratizer.t: n. 推动民主化的人或事物

e.en: The internet is often called the great {democratizer} of information.
e.zh: 互联网常被称为信息领域的大众化者。

e.en: Cheap solar panels became a powerful {democratizer} of clean energy.
e.zh: 廉价太阳能板成为清洁能源普及的有力推动者。

e.en: The app is {democratizing} access to legal advice for renters.
e.zh: 这款应用正在让租客也能轻松获取法律咨询。

e.en: Generative AI is rapidly {democratizing} creative work.
e.zh: 生成式人工智能正迅速让创意工作走向大众化。

demoes.t: n./v. 演示；样品（demo 的复数/三单）

e.en: The conference featured live {demoes} of three new robots.
e.zh: 会议上有三款新机器人的现场演示。

e.en: The band's early {demoes} circulated on cassette tapes.
e.zh: 那支乐队早期的小样曾以磁带形式流传。

e.en: The {demographer} predicted a sharp drop in birth rates by 2030.
e.zh: 这位人口学家预测到2030年出生率将急剧下降。

e.en: She trained as a {demographer} before joining the census bureau.
e.zh: 她在加入人口普查局之前接受过人口学家培训。

demographic.t:
adj. 人口的
n. 特定人群

e.en: Their app targets the under-25 {demographic} on social media.
e.zh: 他们的应用面向社交媒体上25岁以下的人群。

e.en: The town is undergoing a major {demographic} shift.
e.zh: 这座小镇正在经历重大的人口结构变化。

e.en: The neighbourhood has changed {demographically} over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里这个社区在人口结构上发生了变化。

e.en: The two cities are {demographically} very similar.
e.zh: 这两座城市在人口构成上非常相似。

demographics.t: n. 人口统计数据；用户画像

e.en: The marketing team studied the {demographics} of their app users.
e.zh: 营销团队研究了应用用户的人群构成。

e.en: Shifting {demographics} are reshaping the country's housing market.
e.zh: 不断变化的人口结构正在重塑该国的住房市场。

e.en: The two regions have completely different {demographies} and cultures.
e.zh: 这两个地区有着完全不同的人口构成和文化。

e.en: Comparing the {demographies} of neighboring countries reveals striking patterns.
e.zh: 比较邻国的人口结构可以发现明显的规律。

e.en: She teaches a graduate course on the {demography} of aging.
e.zh: 她讲授一门关于老龄化人口学的研究生课程。

e.en: Japan's changing {demography} is putting pressure on its pension system.
e.zh: 日本不断变化的人口结构正给其养老金体系带来压力。

demoiselle.t:
n. 少女
n. 蓑羽鹤

e.en: A graceful {demoiselle} crane landed on the edge of the lake.
e.zh: 一只优雅的蓑羽鹤落在湖边。

e.en: The young {demoiselle} curtsied politely as the guests arrived.
e.zh: 那位年轻的小姐在客人到来时礼貌地行了屈膝礼。

e.en: Picasso's painting Les {Demoiselles} d'Avignon shocked the art world.
e.zh: 毕加索的画作《亚维农少女》震惊了艺术界。

e.en: Several {demoiselles} chatted quietly in the garden pavilion.
e.zh: 几位年轻女子在花园凉亭里轻声交谈。

e.en: The city plans to {demolish} the old factory next month.
e.zh: 市政府计划下个月拆除那座旧工厂。

e.en: The lawyer was ready to {demolish} the witness's testimony.
e.zh: 那位律师准备彻底驳倒证人的证词。

e.en: They {demolished} the abandoned warehouse to make way for housing.
e.zh: 他们拆除了废弃的仓库，为住宅腾出空间。

e.en: The home team {demolished} their rivals five-nil last night.
e.zh: 主队昨晚以五比零大胜对手。

e.en: The new study {demolishes} the long-held theory about caffeine.
e.zh: 这项新研究推翻了关于咖啡因的长期理论。

e.en: The crew {demolishes} an average of two buildings per week.
e.zh: 这支施工队平均每周拆除两栋建筑。

e.en: Workers are {demolishing} the bridge to build a wider one.
e.zh: 工人们正在拆除这座桥，以便建造更宽的新桥。

e.en: Her closing argument was {demolishing} every point the defense made.
e.zh: 她的结案陈词彻底驳倒了辩方提出的每一个观点。

delivery.t:
n. 递送，配送；交付
n. 分娩

e.en: Free {delivery} is available for orders over fifty dollars.
e.zh: 订单满五十美元即可免费配送。

e.en: Her calm {delivery} made the speech truly memorable.
e.zh: 她沉稳的演讲风格让这次发言令人难忘。

e.en: The {deliveryman} knocked twice and left the box at the door.
e.zh: 送货员敲了两下门,把箱子放在门口。

e.en: A friendly {deliveryman} brings our groceries every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 每周六早上都有一位友好的送货员送来食品杂货。

deliverymen.t: n. 送货员（deliveryman 的复数）

e.en: Several {deliverymen} were waiting outside the busy restaurant.
e.zh: 几位送餐员在繁忙的餐厅外等候。

e.en: The company hired more {deliverymen} during the holiday rush.
e.zh: 公司在假日高峰期雇用了更多送货员。

dell.t:
n. 戴尔（电脑品牌）
n. 小山谷

e.en: I bought a refurbished {Dell} laptop for online classes.
e.zh: 我买了一台翻新的戴尔笔记本电脑用来上网课。

e.en: A small cottage stood quietly in the green {dell}.
e.zh: 一座小屋静静地坐落在翠绿的山谷中。

delle.t: (罕用) 意大利语介词；人名片段

e.en: The museum's name comes from Galleria {delle} Carrozze in Rome.
e.zh: 这家博物馆的名字来自罗马的马车廊。

e.en: She studied art at Accademia {delle} Belle Arti in Florence.
e.zh: 她在佛罗伦萨美术学院学习艺术。

e.en: We spent the weekend at a beach house in {Del Mar}.
e.zh: 我们周末在德尔马的海滨别墅度过。

e.en: The {Del Mar} racetrack hosts famous horse racing every summer.
e.zh: 德尔马赛马场每年夏天都举办著名的赛马比赛。

deloitte.t: n. 德勤（会计师事务所）

e.en: She accepted a consulting offer from {Deloitte} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月接受了德勤的咨询职位。

e.en: {Deloitte} released its annual technology trends report yesterday.
e.zh: 德勤昨天发布了年度科技趋势报告。

e.en: The shelter had to {delouse} the rescued dogs immediately.
e.zh: 收容所必须立即为获救的狗清除虱子。

e.en: Soldiers used special powder to {delouse} their uniforms in the field.
e.zh: 士兵在战地用特殊药粉为军服除虱。

delphi.t:
n. 德尔菲（古希腊圣地）
n. Delphi 编程语言

e.en: Tourists climb steep paths to visit ancient {Delphi} in Greece.
e.zh: 游客攀登陡峭山路去参观希腊古城德尔斐。

e.en: He still maintains old software written in {Delphi}.
e.zh: 他仍在维护用 Delphi 编写的旧软件。

delphic.t: adj. 晦涩难解的；德尔菲神谕的

e.en: The CEO gave a {Delphic} answer that confused every reporter.
e.zh: 首席执行官的回答含糊难解,令每位记者都摸不着头脑。

e.en: Her {Delphic} smile hinted at secrets she would never share.
e.zh: 她那神秘的微笑暗示着永不会透露的秘密。

e.en: Tall blue {delphinium} flowers lined the garden path beautifully.
e.zh: 高大的蓝色飞燕草花美丽地排列在花园小径旁。

e.en: She planted {delphinium} seeds along the back fence last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在后篱笆边种下了飞燕草种子。

delta.t:
n. 三角洲
n. 希腊字母 Δ；增量

e.en: The Mississippi {delta} is home to diverse wildlife and wetlands.
e.zh: 密西西比河三角洲拥有丰富的野生动物和湿地生态。

e.en: The app sends a {delta} update instead of the full file.
e.zh: 该应用只发送增量更新,而不是整个文件。

deltoid.t:
n. 三角肌
adj. 三角形的

e.en: Lifting weights helps strengthen the {deltoid} muscles in your shoulders.
e.zh: 举重有助于增强肩部的三角肌。

e.en: He pulled a {deltoid} muscle while moving heavy boxes upstairs.
e.zh: 他在搬重箱子上楼时拉伤了三角肌。

e.en: Don't {delude} yourself into thinking the problem will disappear.
e.zh: 别自欺欺人,以为问题会自行消失。

e.en: Smooth advertising can {delude} consumers about a product's real value.
e.zh: 花哨的广告可能让消费者对产品真实价值产生错觉。

e.en: He was {deluded} into believing the investment was completely safe.
e.zh: 他被骗以为这项投资是完全安全的。

e.en: Anyone {deluded} enough to trust that website lost their money.
e.zh: 任何天真到去相信那个网站的人都会赔钱。

deluge.t:
n. 洪水；大量涌来
v. 淹没，泛滥

e.en: A sudden {deluge} flooded the basement within ten minutes.
e.zh: 突如其来的暴雨在十分钟内淹没了地下室。

e.en: The post received a {deluge} of angry comments overnight.
e.zh: 这条帖子一夜之间收到了大量愤怒的评论。

e.en: It's a {delusion} to think hard work alone guarantees success.
e.zh: 以为光靠努力就能成功是种错觉。

e.en: The patient suffered from a {delusion} that the neighbors were spying.
e.zh: 病人产生了邻居在监视他的妄想。

delusional.t: adj. 妄想的，不切实际的

e.en: Anyone who expects perfect weather all summer is simply {delusional}.
e.zh: 任何指望整个夏天天气都完美的人都太天真了。

e.en: He sounded {delusional} when describing his secret meetings with celebrities.
e.zh: 他描述自己与名人秘密会面的样子听起来像在妄想。

e.en: The map's {delusive} simplicity hid the dangerous mountain terrain.
e.zh: 地图欺骗性的简洁掩盖了危险的山地地形。

e.en: His promises proved entirely {delusive} once the contract was signed.
e.zh: 合同一签,他的承诺就完全成了空话。

e.en: We booked a {deluxe} suite with an ocean view for our anniversary.
e.zh: 我们为周年纪念订了带海景的豪华套房。

e.en: The {deluxe} edition includes bonus tracks and a hardcover booklet.
e.zh: 豪华版包含额外曲目和精装小册子。

e.en: The documentary will {delve} into the origins of social media addiction.
e.zh: 这部纪录片将深入探讨社交媒体成瘾的根源。

e.en: Researchers {delve} into old archives to uncover forgotten stories.
e.zh: 研究人员深入翻查旧档案,挖掘被遗忘的故事。

dem.t: n. 民主党人（Democrat 缩写）

e.en: The {Dem} candidate narrowly won the swing district last night.
e.zh: 民主党候选人昨晚以微弱优势赢得了摇摆选区。

e.en: She's a registered {Dem} but votes independently in local races.
e.zh: 她登记为民主党人,但在地方选举中独立投票。

e.en: Strong heat can {demagnetize} the small magnets inside the speaker.
e.zh: 强热可能使扬声器内的小磁铁失去磁性。

e.en: Technicians use a special tool to {demagnetize} hard drives before disposal.
e.zh: 技术人员在处理硬盘前会用专用工具消磁。

demagogic.t: adj. 蛊惑人心的，煽动性的

e.en: His {demagogic} speech blamed immigrants for every economic problem.
e.zh: 他煽动性的演讲把所有经济问题都归咎于移民。

e.en: Voters grew tired of the candidate's {demagogic} promises and empty slogans.
e.zh: 选民对该候选人煽动性的承诺和空洞口号感到厌倦。

e.en: The {demagogue} stirred up the crowd with fear and false statistics.
e.zh: 那个煽动家用恐惧和虚假数据煽动群众。

e.en: History remembers him as a {demagogue} who exploited public anger.
e.zh: 历史将他记作一个利用公众愤怒的煽动政客。

demagoguery.t: n. 蛊惑民心的言论或手段

e.en: Critics accused the senator of pure {demagoguery} during the debate.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位参议员在辩论中纯粹是在煽动民意。

e.en: Modern social media amplifies {demagoguery} faster than ever before.
e.zh: 现代社交媒体比以往更快地放大了煽动言论。

demagogy.t: n. 蛊惑民众的政治手段

e.en: His campaign relied on cheap {demagogy} rather than real policy.
e.zh: 他的竞选靠廉价的煽动而非真实的政策。

e.en: Educated voters quickly recognized the {demagogy} behind those slogans.
e.zh: 有见识的选民很快看穿了那些口号背后的煽动手段。

demand.t:
n. 需求，要求
v. 要求，需要

e.en: Customers {demand} faster shipping and clearer return policies.
e.zh: 顾客要求更快的发货速度和更清晰的退货政策。

e.en: There's growing {demand} for electric vehicles in major cities.
e.zh: 大城市对电动汽车的需求正在不断增长。

demanded.t: v. 要求（demand 的过去式）

e.en: The protesters {demanded} an immediate response from city officials.
e.zh: 抗议者要求市政官员立即作出回应。

e.en: She {demanded} a refund after the product broke within a week.
e.zh: 产品一周内就坏了,她要求退款。

e.en: The boss is a tough {demander} who expects perfect results daily.
e.zh: 老板是个严格的要求者,每天都期望完美的结果。

e.en: As a {demander} of quality, she rejected three drafts of the design.
e.zh: 作为对质量严苛的要求者,她否决了三版设计稿。

e.en: Raising twins is more {demanding} than most parents anticipate.
e.zh: 养育双胞胎比大多数父母预想的要更费心力。

e.en: She left the {demanding} job to spend more time with family.
e.zh: 她辞去了那份高强度的工作,以便多陪陪家人。

demands.t:
n. 需求（复数）
v. 要求（第三人称单数）

e.en: The union {demands} better pay and safer working conditions.
e.zh: 工会要求更高的工资和更安全的工作条件。

e.en: Modern parenting {demands} patience, energy, and constant flexibility.
e.zh: 现代育儿需要耐心、精力和持续的灵活应变。

e.en: Surveyors will {demarcate} the property line before construction begins.
e.zh: 勘测员将在施工开始前划定地界。

e.en: Painted lines clearly {demarcate} the bike lane from car traffic.
e.zh: 涂漆的线条清楚地将自行车道与汽车道分开。

e.en: The river forms a natural {demarcation} between the two provinces.
e.zh: 这条河成为两省之间的天然分界线。

e.en: There's no clear {demarcation} between work and personal time anymore.
e.zh: 工作与私人时间之间已经没有明确的界限了。

demarche.t: n. 外交照会，正式交涉

e.en: The ambassador filed a formal {demarche} protesting the trade restrictions.
e.zh: 大使提交了一份正式的外交抗议,反对贸易限制。

e.en: Several allies coordinated a joint {demarche} to the foreign ministry.
e.zh: 几个盟国联合向外交部提出了共同的外交照会。

dematerialization.t: n. 非物质化；证券无纸化

e.en: The {dematerialization} of music collections changed how artists earn income.
e.zh: 音乐收藏的非实体化改变了艺术家的收入方式。

e.en: Stock {dematerialization} replaced paper certificates with digital records.
e.zh: 股票无纸化用电子记录取代了纸质证书。

dematerialize.t: v. 消失无形；（证券）无纸化

e.en: Physical books seem to {dematerialize} as readers switch to e-readers.
e.zh: 随着读者改用电子阅读器,纸质书似乎正在消失。

e.en: The character can {dematerialize} and pass through walls in the game.
e.zh: 游戏中这个角色能化为虚体并穿墙而过。

deme.t: n. 同类群（生物学）；古希腊村社

e.en: Ancient Athens divided its citizens by {deme} for political purposes.
e.zh: 古雅典出于政治目的按区社划分公民。

e.en: Biologists track each {deme} to study local genetic variation.
e.zh: 生物学家跟踪每个地方种群以研究局部遗传变异。

e.en: Don't let rude comments online {demean} your sense of self-worth.
e.zh: 别让网上的粗鲁评论贬低你的自我价值感。

e.en: He refused to {demean} himself by begging for the promotion.
e.zh: 他拒绝降低身份去乞求晋升。

demeaning.t: adj. 有失体面的，侮辱性的

e.en: She quit after enduring months of {demeaning} comments from her manager.
e.zh: 在忍受了几个月经理的贬损话语后,她辞职了。

e.en: Cleaning toilets isn't {demeaning} — every honest job has value.
e.zh: 打扫厕所并不丢人——每份正当工作都有价值。

e.en: Her calm {demeanor} reassured everyone during the emergency landing.
e.zh: 她镇定的举止在紧急降落时让所有人都安下心来。

e.en: The dog's friendly {demeanor} made it perfect for therapy work.
e.zh: 这只狗友善的性情使它非常适合做治疗犬。

demeanour.t: n. 举止，风度（英式拼写）

e.en: His professional {demeanour} impressed the interview panel immediately.
e.zh: 他专业的举止立刻让面试小组印象深刻。

e.en: The judge's stern {demeanour} kept the courtroom completely silent.
e.zh: 法官严肃的神态让法庭里鸦雀无声。

demented.t: adj. 精神错乱的，疯狂的

e.en: The villain laughed in a {demented} way that scared the children.
e.zh: 反派发出疯狂的笑声,把孩子们吓坏了。

e.en: Working triple shifts left him feeling completely {demented} by Friday.
e.zh: 连上三班让他到周五时觉得自己彻底疯了。

e.en: Early signs of {dementia} include forgetting recent conversations and names.
e.zh: 痴呆的早期迹象包括忘记最近的对话和名字。

e.en: Caring for a parent with {dementia} can be emotionally exhausting.
e.zh: 照顾患痴呆症的父母可能让人情感上极度疲惫。

e.en: Sprinkle some {demerara} sugar on top before baking the muffins.
e.zh: 在烤松饼前撒上一些粗黄糖。

e.en: This coffee tastes wonderful with a spoon of {demerara} sugar.
e.zh: 这杯咖啡加一勺德梅拉拉糖,味道好极了。

e.en: Shareholders voted to {demerge} the media division from the parent company.
e.zh: 股东投票决定将媒体部门从母公司分拆出去。

e.en: Plans to {demerge} the two business units were announced yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天宣布了将两个业务部门分拆的计划。

e.en: The {demolition} of the old stadium begins on Monday.
e.zh: 旧体育场的拆除工作将于周一开始。

e.en: Residents complained about the noise from the {demolition} site.
e.zh: 居民们抱怨拆迁工地传来的噪音。

demolitions.t: n. 拆除作业；爆破（复数）

e.en: Several controversial {demolitions} sparked protests across the city.
e.zh: 几起有争议的拆除事件在全市引发了抗议。

e.en: The firm specialises in large-scale industrial {demolitions}.
e.zh: 这家公司专门从事大型工业拆除工程。

e.en: The video game's final boss is a fire-breathing {demon}.
e.zh: 这款电子游戏的最终BOSS是一个喷火的恶魔。

e.en: She's a {demon} on the tennis court when she's focused.
e.zh: 她专注起来在网球场上简直是个高手。

e.en: The horror film features a creepy {demonic} possession scene.
e.zh: 这部恐怖片里有一段令人毛骨悚然的恶魔附身场景。

e.en: He worked with {demonic} energy to finish before the deadline.
e.zh: 他以惊人的精力赶在截止日期前完成工作。

e.en: The article criticised the media's {demonization} of immigrants.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了媒体对移民的妖魔化。

e.en: Constant {demonization} of opponents is corroding political debate.
e.zh: 对对手的不断妖魔化正在侵蚀政治辩论。

e.en: The media tends to {demonize} politicians from the opposing party.
e.zh: 媒体往往会把对立党派的政客妖魔化。

e.en: It's unfair to {demonize} an entire group for one person's mistake.
e.zh: 因一个人的错误而妖魔化整个群体是不公平的。

e.en: Sugar has been {demonized} in many recent diet trends.
e.zh: 在近年的许多饮食潮流中,糖被妖魔化了。

e.en: The film {demonized} hackers as criminals without nuance.
e.zh: 那部电影把黑客一概描绘成罪犯,毫无细节可言。

e.en: Stop {demonizing} immigrants for problems they didn't cause.
e.zh: 别再把移民妖魔化,把不属于他们的问题怪到他们头上。

e.en: The article was criticized for {demonizing} video games.
e.zh: 这篇文章因将电子游戏妖魔化而受到批评。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on medieval {demonology} and witch trials.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于中世纪恶魔学和女巫审判的论文。

e.en: The book explores Japanese {demonology} through ancient folklore.
e.zh: 这本书通过古代民间传说探讨日本恶魔学。

e.en: The video game features {demons} as the final bosses.
e.zh: 这款电子游戏把恶魔设定为最终boss。

e.en: She's still fighting her inner {demons} after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后她仍在与内心的恶魔搏斗。

demonstrability.t: n. 可证明性；可演示性

e.en: The {demonstrability} of the theory makes it widely accepted.
e.zh: 这一理论的可证明性使其被广泛接受。

e.en: Scientists value {demonstrability} above elegant speculation.
e.zh: 科学家重视可验证性,胜过优雅的推测。

e.en: There's {demonstrable} progress in the team's coding skills.
e.zh: 团队的编程能力有了显著可见的进步。

e.en: The drug showed {demonstrable} benefits in clinical trials.
e.zh: 该药物在临床试验中显示出明显可证的疗效。

e.en: This new approach is {demonstrably} faster than the old one.
e.zh: 这种新方法明显比旧方法更快。

e.en: The claim is {demonstrably} false based on the data.
e.zh: 根据这些数据,该说法显然是错误的。

demonstrate.t:
v. 演示；证明
v. 示威游行

e.en: Let me {demonstrate} how to use this feature.
e.zh: 我来演示一下这个功能怎么用。

e.en: Thousands gathered to {demonstrate} against the new law.
e.zh: 数千人聚集起来抗议这项新法律。

e.en: She {demonstrated} the new app at the conference.
e.zh: 她在大会上演示了这款新应用。

e.en: Studies have {demonstrated} a clear link between sleep and health.
e.zh: 研究已证明睡眠与健康之间存在明显关联。

demonstrates.t: v. 演示；证明（第三人称）

e.en: This chart {demonstrates} the rapid growth of our user base.
e.zh: 这张图表展示了我们用户群的快速增长。

e.en: His behavior {demonstrates} a real lack of judgment.
e.zh: 他的行为表明他严重缺乏判断力。

e.en: The instructor is {demonstrating} the proper yoga pose.
e.zh: 教练正在示范正确的瑜伽姿势。

e.en: Protesters were {demonstrating} outside the embassy peacefully.
e.zh: 抗议者在大使馆外和平示威。

demonstration.t:
n. 演示；示范
n. 示威游行

e.en: The salesman gave a quick {demonstration} of the blender.
e.zh: 销售员快速演示了一下这台搅拌机。

e.en: A massive {demonstration} blocked traffic downtown yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天一场大规模示威活动堵塞了市中心的交通。

e.en: The store offers free product {demonstrations} every weekend.
e.zh: 这家店每个周末都提供免费的产品演示。

e.en: Street {demonstrations} continued for the third week in a row.
e.zh: 街头示威活动已连续进行了第三周。

demonstrative.t:
adj. 感情外露的
adj. 指示的（语法）

e.en: He's not very {demonstrative}, but he clearly cares deeply.
e.zh: 他不太外露感情,但显然很在乎。

e.en: Italian families are often warm and {demonstrative}.
e.zh: 意大利家庭通常温暖且乐于表达感情。

e.en: She {demonstratively} hugged her son in front of everyone.
e.zh: 她当着所有人的面热情地拥抱了她儿子。

e.en: He {demonstratively} ignored her message at dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时他故意当众无视她的信息。

e.en: Police arrested one {demonstrator} during the rally.
e.zh: 警方在集会期间逮捕了一名示威者。

e.en: The {demonstrator} showed shoppers how the vacuum worked.
e.zh: 演示员向顾客展示了这台吸尘器的使用方法。

demoralisation.t: n. 士气低落（英式拼写）

e.en: Constant layoffs led to widespread {demoralisation} among staff.
e.zh: 持续的裁员导致员工普遍士气低落。

e.en: The team's {demoralisation} was obvious after another loss.
e.zh: 又输一场后,队伍士气崩溃显而易见。

demoralise.t: v. 打击士气（英式拼写）

e.en: Harsh criticism can {demoralise} even the best employees.
e.zh: 严厉的批评连最优秀的员工都能打击士气。

e.en: Don't let one setback {demoralise} the whole team.
e.zh: 别让一次挫折让整个团队士气低落。

demoralised.t: v. 打击士气（英式过去式）

e.en: The players looked completely {demoralised} after the defeat.
e.zh: 输球后球员们看起来彻底士气低落。

e.en: She felt {demoralised} after weeks of job rejections.
e.zh: 被拒了几周工作后她感到非常沮丧。

demoralising.t: v. 打击士气（英式进行式）

e.en: Losing five matches in a row is incredibly {demoralising}.
e.zh: 连输五场比赛真的让人士气崩溃。

e.en: The boss's constant nitpicking is {demoralising} the whole team.
e.zh: 老板没完没了地挑刺,整个团队都士气低落。

e.en: The endless meetings caused massive {demoralization} in the office.
e.zh: 没完没了的会议让办公室士气大幅低落。

e.en: Years of underfunding led to {demoralization} in the department.
e.zh: 多年的资金不足让该部门士气消沉。

e.en: Public failure can {demoralize} a startup founder quickly.
e.zh: 公开的失败会让创业者很快丧失斗志。

e.en: Don't {demoralize} your kids by comparing them to others.
e.zh: 别拿你的孩子和别人比较,会打击他们的自信心。

e.en: The {demoralized} workers staged a quiet walkout.
e.zh: 士气低落的工人静悄悄地集体离岗。

e.en: He felt {demoralized} after his startup failed.
e.zh: 创业失败后他感到一蹶不振。

e.en: Getting rejected ten times in a row was {demoralizing}.
e.zh: 连续被拒十次实在让人灰心。

e.en: It's {demoralizing} to work hard and get no recognition.
e.zh: 努力工作却得不到认可,真的很打击人。

e.en: The manager threatened to {demote} him for missing deadlines.
e.zh: 经理威胁说,因为他没按时完成任务,要把他降职。

e.en: They had to {demote} the team to a lower league.
e.zh: 他们不得不把这支队伍降到更低的联赛。

e.en: She was {demoted} from manager to associate last month.
e.zh: 她上个月从经理被降职为普通员工。

e.en: The club was {demoted} after finishing last in the standings.
e.zh: 该俱乐部因排名垫底而被降级。

e.en: The novel uses {demotic} language to feel authentic.
e.zh: 这部小说使用通俗的语言以显得真实。

e.en: Scholars studied the {demotic} script of ancient Egypt.
e.zh: 学者们研究古埃及的世俗体文字。

e.en: He took the {demotion} as a chance to start over.
e.zh: 他把这次降职当作重新开始的机会。

e.en: The team's {demotion} shocked their loyal fans.
e.zh: 球队降级让忠实球迷大为震惊。

demotivate.t: v. 使失去动力；打击积极性

e.en: Unrealistic deadlines can {demotivate} even passionate developers.
e.zh: 不切实际的截止时间会让最有热情的开发者也失去动力。

e.en: Don't {demotivate} students by grading them too harshly.
e.zh: 不要因为给分太严而打击学生的积极性。

e.en: The shelves are {demountable}, so moving them is easy.
e.zh: 这些架子可以拆卸,搬动起来很方便。

e.en: They installed a {demountable} wall to divide the office.
e.zh: 他们装了一面可拆卸隔断墙来划分办公区。

demur.t:
v. 反对；表示异议
n. 异议

e.en: She accepted the offer without {demur}.
e.zh: 她毫无异议地接受了这个提议。

e.en: A few board members began to {demur} at the proposal.
e.zh: 几位董事开始对这项提案表示异议。

e.en: She wore a {demure} dress to the family dinner.
e.zh: 她穿了一件端庄的连衣裙参加家庭晚餐。

e.en: Her {demure} smile hid a sharp sense of humor.
e.zh: 她那矜持的微笑下藏着犀利的幽默感。

e.en: She {demurely} declined the second glass of wine.
e.zh: 她矜持地谢绝了第二杯酒。

e.en: The bride smiled {demurely} as cameras flashed around her.
e.zh: 新娘在闪光灯前矜持地微笑着。

e.en: MS is characterized by {demyelination} of nerve fibers.
e.zh: 多发性硬化症的特征是神经纤维的脱髓鞘。

e.en: The MRI revealed clear signs of {demyelination} in the brain.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示大脑中有明显的脱髓鞘迹象。

e.en: The blog focuses on the {demystification} of machine learning.
e.zh: 这个博客专注于揭开机器学习的神秘面纱。

e.en: Her book is a {demystification} of personal finance for beginners.
e.zh: 她的书帮初学者揭开个人理财的神秘面纱。

e.en: The series offers helpful {demystifications} of complex tax rules.
e.zh: 该系列对复杂的税收规定做了很有帮助的解读。

e.en: His lectures are essentially {demystifications} of modern physics.
e.zh: 他的讲座本质上是对现代物理的通俗解读。

e.en: The tutorial finally {demystified} regular expressions for me.
e.zh: 这个教程终于让我搞懂了正则表达式。

e.en: Her explanation {demystified} the entire tax filing process.
e.zh: 她的讲解让整个报税流程一目了然。

e.en: This guide {demystifies} the home buying process step by step.
e.zh: 这本指南一步步揭开买房流程的神秘面纱。

e.en: The video {demystifies} how blockchain actually works.
e.zh: 这个视频清楚解释了区块链到底是如何运作的。

demystify.t: v. 揭开神秘面纱；使易懂

e.en: This course aims to {demystify} artificial intelligence for beginners.
e.zh: 这门课程旨在为初学者揭开人工智能的神秘面纱。

e.en: Let me {demystify} the legal jargon in your contract.
e.zh: 我来帮你弄清楚合同里的法律术语。

e.en: She's writing a book {demystifying} cryptocurrency for everyday investors.
e.zh: 她正在写一本书,为普通投资者揭开加密货币的神秘面纱。

e.en: The podcast is great at {demystifying} complex science topics.
e.zh: 这个播客很擅长把复杂的科学话题讲得通俗易懂。

e.en: Historians try to {demythologize} the founding fathers' lives.
e.zh: 历史学家试图还原开国元勋们的真实生活。

e.en: The documentary aims to {demythologize} Silicon Valley culture.
e.zh: 这部纪录片旨在揭穿硅谷文化的神话。

den.t:
n. 兽穴；巢穴
n. 私人小房间

e.en: The fox returned to its {den} just before dawn.
e.zh: 狐狸在天亮前回到了自己的洞穴。

e.en: He turned the basement into a cozy {den} for movie nights.
e.zh: 他把地下室改成了一个温馨的小窝,用来看电影。

e.en: His sharp {denouncement} of the policy made headlines worldwide.
e.zh: 他对该政策的尖锐谴责登上了全球头条。

e.en: The committee issued a formal {denouncement} of the unethical research.
e.zh: 委员会就该不道德的研究发表了正式谴责声明。

denounces.t: v. 谴责；公开指责（第三人称单数）

e.en: The senator regularly {denounces} corporate influence on elections.
e.zh: 这位参议员经常谴责企业对选举的影响。

e.en: In her column, she {denounces} hate speech in any form.
e.zh: 她在专栏中谴责任何形式的仇恨言论。

e.en: The crowd cheered as the speaker began {denouncing} the policy.
e.zh: 演讲者开始谴责该政策时，人群欢呼起来。

e.en: She wrote an editorial {denouncing} the company's labor practices.
e.zh: 她写了一篇社论谴责该公司的用工做法。

dens.t: n. 兽穴；窝（den 的复数）

e.en: Wolves return to the same {dens} year after year.
e.zh: 狼群年复一年回到同一个洞穴。

e.en: The basement was full of cozy reading {dens}.
e.zh: 地下室里满是舒适的阅读小天地。

dense.t:
adj. 密集的；稠密的
adj. 愚钝的

e.en: The fog was so {dense} we couldn't see the road.
e.zh: 雾太浓，我们看不清路。

e.en: This textbook is {dense} but worth reading carefully.
e.zh: 这本教材内容密集，但值得仔细研读。

e.en: Tokyo is one of the most {densely} populated cities on earth.
e.zh: 东京是地球上人口最密集的城市之一。

e.en: The forest grew {densely} along the riverbanks.
e.zh: 森林在河岸两旁茂密生长。

e.en: Different metals have very different {densities} and weights.
e.zh: 不同的金属有着差别很大的密度和重量。

e.en: Population {densities} vary widely between rural and urban areas.
e.zh: 农村和城市之间的人口密度差异很大。

e.en: Lead has a much higher {density} than aluminum.
e.zh: 铅的密度比铝高得多。

e.en: The {density} of housing makes traffic worse every year.
e.zh: 住房密度使交通状况一年比一年糟。

dent.t:
n. 凹痕
v. 使凹陷

e.en: The shopping cart left a small {dent} in my car door.
e.zh: 购物车在我的车门上留下了一个小凹痕。

e.en: Her donation barely made a {dent} in the funding gap.
e.zh: 她的捐款对资金缺口几乎没有任何影响。

e.en: My new job offers excellent {dental} insurance.
e.zh: 我的新工作提供很好的牙科保险。

e.en: Regular {dental} checkups can prevent serious problems later.
e.zh: 定期牙科检查可以预防日后出现严重问题。

dented.t:
adj. 有凹痕的
v. 使凹陷（过去式）

e.en: He drove a {dented} old pickup truck around the farm.
e.zh: 他开着一辆凹陷的旧皮卡在农场里转。

e.en: The scandal {dented} the company's reputation overnight.
e.zh: 丑闻一夜之间损害了公司的声誉。

e.en: Below the enamel, the tooth's {dentine} is softer and yellowish.
e.zh: 牙釉质下面的牙本质较软，呈淡黄色。

e.en: Cavities can spread quickly once they reach the {dentine}.
e.zh: 龋齿一旦蔓延到牙本质就会迅速扩散。

e.en: I have an appointment with my {dentist} tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天早上和牙医有个预约。

e.en: The {dentist} said I need to floss more often.
e.zh: 牙医说我需要更经常地用牙线。

e.en: She studied {dentistry} for five years before opening her clinic.
e.zh: 她学了五年牙医专业才开了自己的诊所。

e.en: Modern {dentistry} uses lasers to make procedures less painful.
e.zh: 现代牙科使用激光让治疗过程不那么疼痛。

e.en: Most {dentists} recommend brushing twice a day.
e.zh: 大多数牙医建议每天刷牙两次。

e.en: The clinic employs five {dentists} and several hygienists.
e.zh: 这家诊所聘有五名牙医和几名洁牙师。

e.en: A child's {dentition} usually includes twenty baby teeth.
e.zh: 儿童的牙列通常包括二十颗乳牙。

e.en: Fossil {dentition} helps scientists identify ancient mammal species.
e.zh: 化石牙列有助于科学家识别古代哺乳动物的种类。

e.en: We drove up to {Denton} for the weekend music festival.
e.zh: 我们驱车前往登顿参加周末的音乐节。

e.en: Mr. {Denton} has been teaching at the school for decades.
e.zh: 登顿先生已经在这所学校任教数十年。

e.en: Grandpa soaked his {denture} in a glass overnight.
e.zh: 爷爷把假牙泡在杯子里过夜。

e.en: A well-fitted {denture} can restore both chewing and confidence.
e.zh: 一副贴合的假牙既能恢复咀嚼功能，也能恢复自信。

denuclearization.t: n. 无核化；去核武器化

e.en: The two nations resumed talks on {denuclearization} of the peninsula.
e.zh: 两国重启了关于半岛无核化的谈判。

e.en: Full {denuclearization} would require years of careful verification.
e.zh: 全面无核化需要多年的细致核查。

e.en: Logging operations {denude} the hillside of its protective trees.
e.zh: 伐木作业让山坡失去了保护性的树木。

e.en: Storms can {denude} the beach of sand within hours.
e.zh: 风暴几小时内就能把沙滩上的沙子刮光。

denuded.t:
adj. 裸露的
v. 剥光（过去式）

e.en: The {denuded} forest looked grey and lifeless after the fire.
e.zh: 大火过后，光秃秃的森林显得灰暗而毫无生气。

e.en: Years of overgrazing left the slopes completely {denuded}.
e.zh: 多年的过度放牧使山坡完全裸露。

e.en: Activists gathered to {denunciate} the new surveillance law publicly.
e.zh: 活动人士聚集起来公开谴责这项新的监控法律。

e.en: He used the speech to {denunciate} corruption in the party.
e.zh: 他借演讲公开抨击党内的腐败行为。

e.en: Her {denunciation} of the policy went viral on social media.
e.zh: 她对该政策的谴责在社交媒体上迅速传开。

e.en: The article was a sharp {denunciation} of corporate greed.
e.zh: 那篇文章是对企业贪婪行为的尖锐抨击。

e.en: Public {denunciations} flooded the comments section overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间评论区涌入了大量公开谴责。

e.en: His speech contained fierce {denunciations} of the regime.
e.zh: 他的演讲中包含了对该政权的强烈谴责。

e.en: We're flying to {Denver} next weekend for a hiking trip.
e.zh: 我们下周末要飞往丹佛去徒步旅行。

e.en: The startup just opened a new office in {Denver}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司刚在丹佛开设了新办公室。

e.en: The company continues to {deny} any wrongdoing in the case.
e.zh: 该公司继续否认在此案中有任何不当行为。

e.en: Don't {deny} yourself a small treat after a long week.
e.zh: 忙了一周，别舍不得给自己一点小奖励。

e.en: There's no {denying} that remote work has changed everything.
e.zh: 不可否认，远程办公已经改变了一切。

e.en: He kept {denying} the rumors despite all the evidence.
e.zh: 尽管证据确凿，他仍不断否认这些传言。

e.en: I forgot to put on {deodorant} before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前我忘了涂止汗剂。

e.en: This natural {deodorant} actually works all day long.
e.zh: 这款天然止汗剂真的能管用一整天。

e.en: She sprayed an air {deodorizer} after frying the fish.
e.zh: 煎完鱼后她喷了空气除臭剂。

e.en: The car came with a free pine-scented {deodorizer}.
e.zh: 这辆车附赠一个松木味的除臭剂。

deontological.t: adj. 义务论的；道义论的

e.en: From a {deontological} view, lying is wrong regardless of consequences.
e.zh: 从义务论的角度看，撒谎无论后果如何都是错的。

e.en: The professor compared utilitarian and {deontological} ethics in class.
e.zh: 教授在课上比较了功利主义和义务论伦理学。

e.en: DNA stands for {deoxyribonucleic} acid, the carrier of genetic code.
e.zh: DNA 是脱氧核糖核酸的缩写，是遗传密码的载体。

e.en: Scientists extracted {deoxyribonucleic} acid from the ancient bone fragment.
e.zh: 科学家从那块古老的骨骼碎片中提取了脱氧核糖核酸。

e.en: The last train will {depart} from platform three at midnight.
e.zh: 末班列车将于午夜从三号站台发车。

e.en: Our plans rarely {depart} from the original schedule.
e.zh: 我们的计划很少偏离原定时间表。

departed.t:
adj. 已故的
v. 离开（过去式）

e.en: She {departed} for Tokyo before sunrise this morning.
e.zh: 她今天日出前就动身前往东京了。

e.en: The family gathered to honor their {departed} grandfather.
e.zh: 全家聚在一起缅怀已故的祖父。

departing.t:
v. 离开（现在分词）
adj. 即将离去的

e.en: Passengers {departing} from gate twelve should board immediately.
e.zh: 从十二号登机口出发的旅客请立即登机。

e.en: The CEO gave a heartfelt speech to the {departing} interns.
e.zh: 首席执行官向即将离开的实习生发表了真挚的演讲。

e.en: The marketing {department} is hiring two new designers this quarter.
e.zh: 市场部本季度要招聘两名新设计师。

e.en: You'll find batteries in the electronics {department} on aisle four.
e.zh: 在四号通道的电子产品部就能找到电池。

e.en: We have a {departmental} meeting every Monday at nine.
e.zh: 我们每周一上午九点有部门例会。

e.en: The new policy requires {departmental} approval before any purchase.
e.zh: 新规定要求任何采购都需经部门批准。

e.en: Budgets are now allocated {departmentally} rather than by individual project.
e.zh: 预算现在按部门分配，而不再按单个项目划分。

e.en: The data is organized {departmentally} for easier review.
e.zh: 数据按部门进行整理，方便审阅。

e.en: Several {departments} will collaborate on the new product launch.
e.zh: 多个部门将共同参与新产品的发布。

e.en: Most large {departments} use Slack to coordinate daily tasks.
e.zh: 大多数大型部门用 Slack 来协调日常工作。

departs.t: v. 离开；出发（第三人称单数）

e.en: The shuttle {departs} every fifteen minutes from the main lobby.
e.zh: 班车每十五分钟从大厅出发一趟。

e.en: This year's design {departs} sharply from previous models.
e.zh: 今年的设计与以往的型号有很大不同。

e.en: Check the screen for your gate and {departure} time.
e.zh: 请查看屏幕上的登机口和起飞时间。

e.en: Her resignation marks a major {departure} for the company.
e.zh: 她的辞职对公司来说是一次重大变动。

e.en: All international {departures} are listed on the upper screen.
e.zh: 所有国际出发航班都显示在上方屏幕上。

e.en: Recent {departures} have left the team understaffed.
e.zh: 最近的人员离职让团队人手不足。

e.en: You can always {depend} on her to meet a deadline.
e.zh: 你总可以指望她按时完成任务。

e.en: Travel plans {depend} heavily on the weather forecast.
e.zh: 出行计划在很大程度上取决于天气预报。

e.en: This brand is known for the {dependability} of its appliances.
e.zh: 这个品牌以家电的可靠性而闻名。

e.en: Employers value {dependability} more than raw talent sometimes.
e.zh: 有时雇主看重可靠性胜过单纯的才华。

e.en: My old laptop is slow but still very {dependable}.
e.zh: 我的旧笔记本电脑速度慢，但仍然非常可靠。

e.en: She's the most {dependable} colleague on our entire team.
e.zh: 她是我们整个团队中最可靠的同事。

e.en: The bus {dependably} arrives within two minutes of schedule.
e.zh: 这趟公交车一向能在预定时间两分钟内准时到站。

e.en: He {dependably} delivers his reports before the Friday deadline.
e.zh: 他总能在周五截止日期前可靠地交出报告。

e.en: You can claim tax credits for each {dependant} child at home.
e.zh: 家中每个被抚养的孩子都可以申请税收抵免。

e.en: Her elderly mother is listed as a {dependant} on the form.
e.zh: 她年迈的母亲在表格上被列为被抚养人。

depended.t: v. 依赖；取决于（过去式）

e.en: For years the village {depended} on a single water well.
e.zh: 多年来，这个村子一直依赖一口水井。

e.en: She {depended} on her sister during the difficult divorce.
e.zh: 在那段艰难的离婚期间，她一直依靠她的姐姐。

e.en: Our {dependence} on smartphones grows stronger every year.
e.zh: 我们对智能手机的依赖一年比一年强。

e.en: The country wants to reduce its {dependence} on imported oil.
e.zh: 该国希望减少对进口石油的依赖。

e.en: The {denationalization} of the airline angered many workers.
e.zh: 航空公司的私有化改革激怒了许多工人。

e.en: Critics warn that {denationalization} could raise consumer prices.
e.zh: 批评者警告说,私有化可能会推高消费者价格。

denationalize.t: v. 使非国有化；私有化

e.en: The government plans to {denationalize} several state-owned banks.
e.zh: 政府计划将几家国有银行私有化。

e.en: Activists protested the move to {denationalize} the railway system.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议将铁路系统私有化的举措。

denature.t: v. 使变性（蛋白质）；使失去本性

e.en: High temperatures {denature} the proteins in egg whites.
e.zh: 高温会使蛋清中的蛋白质变性。

e.en: Acids can {denature} enzymes and stop them from working.
e.zh: 酸会使酶变性,从而失去活性。

denatured.t: adj. 已变性的（蛋白质、酒精）

e.en: The lab uses {denatured} alcohol for cleaning equipment.
e.zh: 实验室用变性酒精清洁仪器。

e.en: Heat {denatured} the proteins, changing the texture completely.
e.zh: 加热使蛋白质变性,质地完全改变。

denbigh.t: n. 登比（英国地名/人名）

e.en: We visited {Denbigh} Castle during our trip to Wales.
e.zh: 我们在威尔士旅行时参观了登比城堡。

e.en: {Denbigh} is a small market town with rich history.
e.zh: 登比是一座历史悠久的小集镇。

e.en: She inherited a beautiful {Denby} pottery set from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一套漂亮的登比陶器。

e.en: {Denby} stoneware is known for its durability and design.
e.zh: 登比炻器以耐用和设计精美著称。

e.en: Each {dendrite} receives signals from neighboring neurons.
e.zh: 每条树突都从相邻的神经元接收信号。

e.en: Scientists studied how a single {dendrite} transmits electrical impulses.
e.zh: 科学家们研究了单条树突如何传递电脉冲。

e.en: The neuron grew {dendritic} branches that connected to nearby cells.
e.zh: 该神经元长出树突状分支，与邻近细胞相连。

e.en: Frost formed a {dendritic} pattern across the cold window.
e.zh: 霜在冰冷的窗户上形成了树枝状的图案。

e.en: They walked through a wooded {dene} on the way home.
e.zh: 他们回家途中穿过一片林木茂密的小山谷。

e.en: A small stream ran along the bottom of the {dene}.
e.zh: 一条小溪沿着山谷底部流淌。

e.en: Travelers should use repellent to avoid catching {dengue} fever.
e.zh: 旅行者应使用驱蚊剂以防感染登革热。

e.en: Cases of {dengue} surged after the heavy summer rains.
e.zh: 夏季暴雨过后，登革热病例激增。

e.en: We met our friend at a café in {Denham} village.
e.zh: 我们在丹纳姆村的一家咖啡馆见了朋友。

e.en: The actor {Denham} delivered a memorable performance last night.
e.zh: 演员丹纳姆昨晚奉献了令人难忘的表演。

deniable.t: adj. 可否认的；可推诿的

e.en: The agency wanted the operation to remain plausibly {deniable}.
e.zh: 该机构希望这次行动保持可被合理否认的状态。

e.en: His involvement was barely {deniable} after the emails leaked.
e.zh: 邮件泄露后，他的参与几乎无法否认。

e.en: Her response was a flat {denial} of all the accusations.
e.zh: 她的回应是对所有指控的断然否认。

e.en: He was in {denial} about how serious the problem had become.
e.zh: 他不愿承认问题已经变得多么严重。

e.en: Despite repeated {denials}, the company eventually admitted the data leak.
e.zh: 尽管多次否认，该公司最终承认了数据泄露。

e.en: Her {denials} only made the reporters more suspicious.
e.zh: 她的否认反而让记者更加怀疑。

denied.t: v. 否认；拒绝（deny 的过去式）

e.en: The bank {denied} my loan application without explanation.
e.zh: 银行没有给出解释就拒绝了我的贷款申请。

e.en: He {denied} ever sending the controversial message.
e.zh: 他否认曾发送过那条有争议的信息。

denier.t:
n. 否认者
n. 旦尼尔（纤维细度单位）

e.en: The climate {denier} ignored decades of scientific evidence.
e.zh: 那位气候否认者无视了数十年的科学证据。

e.en: She bought stockings with a low {denier} for summer.
e.zh: 她买了夏天穿的低旦数丝袜。

denies.t: v. 否认；拒绝（deny 的三单）

e.en: The suspect still {denies} any involvement in the burglary.
e.zh: 嫌疑人仍然否认与这起入室盗窃案有任何关联。

e.en: The policy {denies} access to users without a verified account.
e.zh: 该政策拒绝向未通过验证的用户开放访问权限。

e.en: It's unprofessional to {denigrate} colleagues behind their backs.
e.zh: 在背后诋毁同事是非常不专业的行为。

e.en: Critics often {denigrate} popular films without watching them fully.
e.zh: 评论者常常没看完影片就贬低热门电影。

e.en: The article's {denigration} of the artist sparked widespread backlash.
e.zh: 这篇文章对该艺术家的诋毁引发了广泛反弹。

e.en: Public {denigration} of opponents has become disturbingly common online.
e.zh: 网上公开诋毁对手的现象已变得令人不安地普遍。

denim.t: n. 牛仔布；粗斜纹棉布

e.en: She wore a vintage {denim} jacket to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿着一件复古牛仔夹克去看演唱会。

e.en: This brand sources organic {denim} from sustainable farms.
e.zh: 这个品牌从可持续农场采购有机牛仔布。

denims.t: n. 牛仔裤；牛仔布衣物

e.en: He pulled on his favorite {denims} before heading out.
e.zh: 他套上最喜欢的牛仔裤就出门了。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {denims} in every imaginable wash.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种水洗工艺的手工牛仔裤。

e.en: Soil bacteria drive {denitrification} by converting nitrates into nitrogen gas.
e.zh: 土壤细菌通过将硝酸盐转化为氮气来推动反硝化作用。

e.en: Wetlands play a key role in {denitrification} of agricultural runoff.
e.zh: 湿地在农业径流的反硝化过程中起着关键作用。

e.en: The fox is a familiar {denizen} of British suburbs.
e.zh: 狐狸是英国郊区常见的住客。

e.en: He's a longtime {denizen} of late-night online forums.
e.zh: 他是深夜网络论坛的老常客。

e.en: We spent a wonderful summer cycling around {Denmark}.
e.zh: 我们度过了一个美好的夏天，骑车环游丹麦。

e.en: {Denmark} consistently ranks among the world's happiest countries.
e.zh: 丹麦一直位列全球最幸福国家之中。

e.en: Most oil contracts {denominate} prices in U.S. dollars.
e.zh: 大多数石油合约以美元计价。

e.en: The bonds {denominate} their face value in euros.
e.zh: 这些债券以欧元标示面值。

e.en: She handed the cashier a large {denomination} bill.
e.zh: 她递给收银员一张大面额的钞票。

e.en: His grandfather belonged to a small Protestant {denomination}.
e.zh: 他的祖父属于一个小型的新教教派。

e.en: The school is {denominational} and hires teachers from one faith.
e.zh: 这所学校属于某教派，只聘用同一信仰的教师。

e.en: Their charity work crosses {denominational} lines and welcomes everyone.
e.zh: 他们的慈善工作跨越教派界限，欢迎所有人。

e.en: To add fractions, you first need a common {denominator}.
e.zh: 分数相加之前，首先要找到公分母。

e.en: Trust is the lowest common {denominator} in any healthy team.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康团队最基本的公约数。

e.en: The word's {denotation} differs sharply from its emotional connotation.
e.zh: 这个词的字面含义与其情感内涵大相径庭。

e.en: Dictionaries focus on {denotation} rather than cultural associations.
e.zh: 词典注重词的本义，而非文化联想。

e.en: Legal documents rely on precise {denotations} to avoid ambiguity.
e.zh: 法律文件依靠精确的字面定义来避免歧义。

e.en: Some words carry multiple {denotations} depending on the field.
e.zh: 有些词在不同领域有多种字面含义。

denotative.t: adj. 指示的；表示字面义的

e.en: The dictionary lists the {denotative} meaning of every entry.
e.zh: 词典列出每个词条的字面意义。

e.en: Scientific writing favors {denotative} language over emotional phrasing.
e.zh: 科学写作偏好直陈意义的语言，而非情感性表达。

e.en: Red lines on the map {denote} restricted military zones.
e.zh: 地图上的红线表示军事禁区。

e.en: In chemistry, the symbol H can {denote} hydrogen.
e.zh: 在化学中，符号H可以表示氢。

denoted.t: v. 表示（denote 的过去式）

e.en: The variable is {denoted} by the Greek letter sigma.
e.zh: 该变量用希腊字母σ表示。

e.en: Her silence {denoted} disapproval more clearly than words could.
e.zh: 她的沉默比任何言语都更清楚地表明了她的不赞同。

e.en: A green checkmark {denotes} that the task has been completed.
e.zh: 绿色对勾表示任务已经完成。

e.en: In this dataset, NaN {denotes} a missing measurement.
e.zh: 在这个数据集中，NaN表示缺失的测量值。

denoting.t: v. 表示（denote 的现在分词）

e.en: He drew an arrow {denoting} the direction of airflow.
e.zh: 他画了一个箭头表示气流的方向。

e.en: Use bold text {denoting} which fields are required.
e.zh: 用粗体文字标示哪些字段是必填的。

e.en: The novel's {denouement} tied every loose plot thread together.
e.zh: 小说的结局把所有未解的情节线索都收拢在一起。

e.en: After hours of tension, the {denouement} felt surprisingly quiet.
e.zh: 经过数小时的紧张后，结局显得出奇平静。

e.en: World leaders quickly moved to {denounce} the violent attack.
e.zh: 各国领导人迅速谴责了这起暴力袭击事件。

e.en: She used her speech to {denounce} corruption in the government.
e.zh: 她借演讲谴责政府中的腐败行为。

denounced.t: v. 谴责（denounce 的过去式）

e.en: Activists {denounced} the new law as an attack on privacy.
e.zh: 活动人士谴责新法律是对隐私的侵犯。

e.en: The coach publicly {denounced} the racist abuse aimed at his players.
e.zh: 教练公开谴责了针对他球员的种族主义谩骂。

dependences.t: n. 依赖；依赖关系（dependencies 的旧拼写）

e.en: The project has too many external {dependences} to ship safely.
e.zh: 该项目外部依赖过多，无法安全发布。

e.en: Mapping all the {dependences} took the team an entire week.
e.zh: 理清所有依赖关系花了团队整整一周时间。

dependency.t: n. 依赖；依赖项（软件包、模块）

e.en: The build failed because of a missing {dependency} in the package.
e.zh: 由于包中缺少一个依赖项，构建失败了。

e.en: He's working on overcoming his {dependency} on caffeine.
e.zh: 他正在努力克服对咖啡因的依赖。

dependent.t:
adj. 依赖的；取决于…的
n. 受抚养者

e.en: Your final grade is {dependent} on the group project score.
e.zh: 你的最终成绩取决于小组项目的得分。

e.en: Many small towns are {dependent} on tourism for survival.
e.zh: 许多小镇靠旅游业维持生计。

dependents.t: n. 受抚养者；依赖物（复数）

e.en: Please list all {dependents} on the insurance enrollment form.
e.zh: 请在保险登记表上列出所有家属。

e.en: Workers with {dependents} get priority for the family housing.
e.zh: 有家属的员工在申请家庭住房时享有优先权。

depending.t: v. 取决于；视…而定（depend 的现在分词）

e.en: Delivery takes three to five days, {depending} on your location.
e.zh: 送达需要三到五天，视所在地点而定。

e.en: The price varies {depending} on which features you select.
e.zh: 价格因你选择的功能不同而有所变化。

depends.t: v. 取决于；依赖（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whether we hike tomorrow {depends} entirely on the weather.
e.zh: 我们明天是否去徒步完全取决于天气。

e.en: The whole team {depends} on her for technical support.
e.zh: 整个团队的技术支持都靠她。

depersonalization.t: n. 人格解体；去个性化

e.en: Long shifts can lead to feelings of {depersonalization} among nurses.
e.zh: 长时间轮班会让护士产生人格解体的感觉。

e.en: The therapist explained that {depersonalization} often follows severe stress.
e.zh: 治疗师解释说，人格解体常出现在严重压力之后。

depersonalize.t: v. 去个性化；使失去人格

e.en: Big tech tends to {depersonalize} customer service through chatbots.
e.zh: 大型科技公司倾向于通过聊天机器人让客户服务变得没有人情味。

e.en: Try not to {depersonalize} students by referring only to ID numbers.
e.zh: 不要只用学号称呼学生，那样会让人感觉冷漠。

depersonalized.t: adj. 去个性化的；失去人格的

e.en: The hospital's {depersonalized} routines made patients feel like numbers.
e.zh: 医院程式化的流程让病人感觉自己只是个号码。

e.en: Online learning can feel cold and {depersonalized} without video.
e.zh: 没有视频的网课会让人感觉冷漠、缺乏人情味。

e.en: The mural will {depict} the city's history across four panels.
e.zh: 这幅壁画将通过四块画板展现这座城市的历史。

e.en: Modern films often {depict} AI as a threat to humanity.
e.zh: 现代电影常将人工智能描绘成对人类的威胁。

depicted.t:
v. 描绘（过去式）
adj. 所描绘的

e.en: The novel {depicted} life in rural China during the 1980s.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了上世纪八十年代中国农村的生活。

e.en: In the painting, the saint is {depicted} holding a lamp.
e.zh: 画中那位圣人手持一盏灯。

depicting.t: v. 描绘；描述（现在分词）

e.en: The exhibit features photos {depicting} daily life in wartime.
e.zh: 展览展出了一些描绘战时日常生活的照片。

e.en: He drew a sketch {depicting} the suspect's face from memory.
e.zh: 他凭记忆画了一张描绘嫌疑人面部的素描。

e.en: Critics praised the film's honest {depiction} of teenage anxiety.
e.zh: 影评人称赞这部电影对青少年焦虑的真实刻画。

e.en: Her {depiction} of the city felt warm and nostalgic.
e.zh: 她对这座城市的描绘充满温暖和怀旧之情。

e.en: Early {depictions} of the goddess vary across different regions.
e.zh: 早期对这位女神的描绘在不同地区各有差异。

e.en: The game received praise for its diverse character {depictions}.
e.zh: 这款游戏因角色刻画多元化而受到赞誉。

depicts.t: v. 描绘；描述（第三人称单数）

e.en: The poster {depicts} a lone astronaut on a red planet.
e.zh: 这张海报描绘了一名孤独的宇航员在红色星球上。

e.en: Her latest novel {depicts} immigrant life in modern London.
e.zh: 她最新的小说描绘了现代伦敦移民的生活。

e.en: Streaming videos all day can quickly {deplete} your data plan.
e.zh: 整天看视频会很快用光你的流量套餐。

e.en: Overfishing continues to {deplete} stocks in the North Atlantic.
e.zh: 过度捕捞持续耗尽北大西洋的渔业资源。

e.en: After the marathon, his energy was completely {depleted}.
e.zh: 跑完马拉松后，他的体力已经完全耗尽。

e.en: The region's groundwater has been seriously {depleted} by drought.
e.zh: 该地区的地下水因干旱而被严重消耗。

e.en: Scientists are warning about the rapid {depletion} of fish stocks.
e.zh: 科学家正在警告渔业资源的快速枯竭。

e.en: Resource {depletion} is one of the biggest issues facing the planet.
e.zh: 资源枯竭是地球面临的最严重问题之一。

deplorable.t: adj. 糟糕的；应受谴责的

e.en: The living conditions in the shelter were absolutely {deplorable}.
e.zh: 收容所里的居住条件实在糟糕透顶。

e.en: Many called the company's response a {deplorable} lack of empathy.
e.zh: 许多人认为公司的回应令人遗憾，毫无同理心。

deplorably.t: adv. 糟糕地；令人遗憾地

e.en: The historic building has been {deplorably} neglected for decades.
e.zh: 这座历史建筑几十年来都被极其糟糕地荒置着。

e.en: He behaved {deplorably} toward the wait staff at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时对服务员的态度极其恶劣。

deplore.t: v. 谴责；强烈反对；对…感到痛惜

e.en: World leaders {deplore} the violence shown in the recent footage.
e.zh: 各国领导人对最近视频中所展现的暴力深感痛惜。

e.en: I {deplore} how social media has shortened our attention spans.
e.zh: 我对社交媒体让我们的注意力变得越来越短深感遗憾。

deploy.t: v. 部署（代码、服务）；调配

e.en: We {deploy} the new version every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们每周五下午部署新版本。

e.en: The army will {deploy} troops to the border region.
e.zh: 军队将向边境地区部署兵力。

deployable.t: adj. 可部署的；可调配的

e.en: The container image is {deployable} to any cloud provider.
e.zh: 该容器镜像可部署到任何云服务商。

e.en: Only half the unit is currently {deployable} for combat.
e.zh: 目前该部队只有一半可投入作战。

deployed.t:
v. 部署（过去式）
adj. 已部署的

e.en: The team {deployed} the patch within an hour.
e.zh: 团队在一小时内部署了补丁。

e.en: Peacekeepers were {deployed} along the disputed border.
e.zh: 维和人员被部署在争议边境一带。

deploying.t: v. 部署；调配（现在分词）

e.en: We are {deploying} the new feature to production now.
e.zh: 我们正在把新功能部署到生产环境。

e.en: The company is {deploying} engineers to fix the outage.
e.zh: 公司正在派遣工程师修复故障。

deployment.t: n. 部署（上线发布）；调度

e.en: The {deployment} failed because of a missing config file.
e.zh: 由于配置文件缺失,这次部署失败了。

e.en: Her {deployment} to Japan lasted nearly two years.
e.zh: 她在日本的驻派持续了将近两年。

e.en: We automated all our {deployments} with GitHub Actions.
e.zh: 我们用 GitHub Actions 实现了所有部署的自动化。

e.en: Overseas {deployments} have strained the family.
e.zh: 海外驻派让这个家庭承受了不少压力。

deploys.t:
v. 部署（第三人称单数）
n. 部署（复数）

e.en: The pipeline {deploys} new code automatically after tests pass.
e.zh: 测试通过后,流水线会自动部署新代码。

e.en: Our team {deploys} updates several times a day.
e.zh: 我们团队一天内会多次发布更新。

e.en: The {depoliticization} of the courts remains a controversial goal.
e.zh: 法院的去政治化仍是一个有争议的目标。

e.en: Many called for the {depoliticization} of public broadcasting.
e.zh: 许多人呼吁公共广播去政治化。

e.en: Reformers want to {depoliticize} the central bank's leadership.
e.zh: 改革者希望让央行领导层去政治化。

e.en: It is hard to {depoliticize} an issue this divisive.
e.zh: 要让如此分裂的议题去政治化非常困难。

e.en: The committee was {depoliticized} after years of partisan fighting.
e.zh: 经历多年的党派斗争后,该委员会被去政治化了。

e.en: She prefers a {depoliticized} approach to climate science.
e.zh: 她倾向于以非政治化的方式研究气候科学。

depopulate.t: v. 使人口减少；使荒无人烟

e.en: Long droughts can {depopulate} entire farming villages.
e.zh: 长期干旱可能让整片农村人口流失殆尽。

e.en: The war threatened to {depopulate} the countryside.
e.zh: 战争可能使乡村人口锐减。

depopulated.t: adj. 人口锐减的；荒无人烟的

e.en: The mining town was largely {depopulated} by the 1990s.
e.zh: 到了九十年代,这座矿业小镇几乎已无人居住。

e.en: Disease {depopulated} many islands during the colonial era.
e.zh: 殖民时期疾病使许多岛屿人口骤减。

e.en: Rural {depopulation} is a serious problem in northern Japan.
e.zh: 农村人口流失是日本北部的一个严重问题。

e.en: The report blames {depopulation} on the lack of jobs.
e.zh: 报告将人口减少归咎于工作机会匮乏。

e.en: The government threatened to {deport} undocumented workers.
e.zh: 政府威胁要驱逐无证劳工。

e.en: Authorities can {deport} anyone who overstays their visa.
e.zh: 当局可驱逐任何逾期居留者出境。

e.en: Minor traffic offenses are not usually {deportable} crimes.
e.zh: 轻微交通违规通常不属于可被驱逐出境的罪行。

e.en: The lawyer argued her client was not {deportable}.
e.zh: 律师辩称她的当事人不应被驱逐出境。

e.en: He is fighting {deportation} in immigration court.
e.zh: 他正在移民法庭抗辩驱逐令。

e.en: Mass {deportation} sparked protests across the country.
e.zh: 大规模驱逐行动在全国引发了抗议。

deported.t:
v. 驱逐出境（过去式）
adj. 被驱逐的

e.en: He was {deported} after his work visa expired.
e.zh: 工作签证过期后,他被驱逐出境。

e.en: Thousands were {deported} during last year's crackdown.
e.zh: 去年的整治行动中有数千人被驱逐出境。

e.en: Each {deportee} was given a small bag of belongings.
e.zh: 每名被驱逐者只领到一小袋随身物品。

e.en: The plane carried over a hundred {deportee} passengers.
e.zh: 飞机载着一百多名被驱逐出境的乘客。

e.en: Her calm {deportment} impressed the interview panel.
e.zh: 她沉稳的举止给面试官留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The school still teaches old-fashioned {deportment} and manners.
e.zh: 这所学校仍教授传统的仪态与礼仪。

depose.t:
v. 罢免；废黜
v. 宣誓作证

e.en: Rebels tried to {depose} the king last spring.
e.zh: 叛军去年春天试图废黜国王。

e.en: Lawyers will {depose} the witness next Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 律师将于下周二上午对证人进行庭外取证。

deposed.t: adj. 被罢免的；被废黜的

e.en: The {deposed} dictator fled to a neighboring country.
e.zh: 被废黜的独裁者逃往了邻国。

e.en: Both executives were {deposed} for over six hours.
e.zh: 两位高管都接受了长达六个多小时的庭外取证。

deposit.t:
n. 存款；押金；定金
v. 存入；沉积

e.en: Please {deposit} the check before five o'clock.
e.zh: 请在五点前把支票存入账户。

e.en: The landlord asked for a one-month security {deposit}.
e.zh: 房东要求支付相当于一个月租金的押金。

depositary.t: n. 受托保管人；保管机构

e.en: The bank acts as {depositary} for the trust's assets.
e.zh: 该银行担任信托资产的保管机构。

e.en: Each fund must appoint an independent {depositary} institution.
e.zh: 每只基金必须指定一家独立的托管机构。

e.en: She {deposited} her paycheck using the mobile app.
e.zh: 她用手机应用存入了工资支票。

e.en: Floods {deposited} thick mud across the entire valley.
e.zh: 洪水在整个山谷沉积下厚厚的淤泥。

depositing.t: v. 存入；沉积（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {depositing} cash at the bank.
e.zh: 他上午一直在银行存现金。

e.en: The river keeps {depositing} sand near the bridge.
e.zh: 河水不断在桥边淤积泥沙。

deposition.t:
n. 证词；罢免
n. 沉积（作用）

e.en: The lawyer scheduled a {deposition} for next Monday.
e.zh: 律师将庭外取证安排在下周一。

e.en: Wind {deposition} formed the dunes over many centuries.
e.zh: 风力沉积历经数百年形成了这些沙丘。

e.en: Every {depositor} is insured up to a hundred thousand dollars.
e.zh: 每位储户最多可获十万美元的存款保险。

e.en: The bank apologized to each affected {depositor} personally.
e.zh: 该行向每位受影响的储户逐一致歉。

depository.t: n. 存放处；保管库；托管机构

e.en: Old library books are kept in a climate-controlled {depository}.
e.zh: 旧馆藏书籍存放在一个恒温恒湿的库房里。

e.en: Drop returned items in the {depository} near the entrance.
e.zh: 请把归还物品投入入口附近的存放箱。

deposits.t:
n. 存款；矿藏（复数）
v. 存入（第三人称单数）

e.en: The bank pays low interest on small {deposits}.
e.zh: 该行对小额存款支付的利息很低。

e.en: Geologists discovered rich copper {deposits} in the mountains.
e.zh: 地质学家在山中发现了丰富的铜矿矿藏。

e.en: The bus arrives at the {depot} every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 公交车每二十分钟抵达一次车站。

e.en: Supplies are stored at a central {depot} downtown.
e.zh: 补给品存放在市中心的中央仓库。

e.en: Critics worry violent games may {deprave} young viewers.
e.zh: 批评者担心暴力游戏会腐蚀年轻观众的心灵。

e.en: He argued that easy money can {deprave} anyone.
e.zh: 他认为轻易得来的钱财能让任何人堕落。

depraved.t: adj. 堕落的、道德败坏的

e.en: The novel describes a {depraved} and cruel villain.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一个堕落而残忍的反派。

e.en: Reporters called the crime {depraved} and senseless.
e.zh: 记者称这起罪行邪恶且毫无理由。

depravities.t: n. 堕落行为（depravity 的复数）

e.en: The diary recorded the {depravities} of the war years.
e.zh: 日记记录了战争年代的种种堕落行径。

e.en: He confessed the {depravities} he had witnessed in prison.
e.zh: 他坦白了在监狱里目睹的种种恶行。

e.en: The film exposes the {depravity} hidden behind closed doors.
e.zh: 这部电影揭露了门后所掩藏的堕落。

e.en: Such {depravity} shocked even seasoned investigators.
e.zh: 如此堕落令经验丰富的调查员也感到震惊。

deprecate.t: v. 弃用（旧功能）；不赞成

e.en: We plan to {deprecate} this API in the next release.
e.zh: 我们计划在下个版本中弃用这个 API。

e.en: Senior engineers often {deprecate} their own contributions.
e.zh: 资深工程师常常会贬低自己的贡献。

e.en: This function is {deprecated} and will be removed soon.
e.zh: 该函数已弃用,即将被移除。

e.en: The library marked several methods as {deprecated} last year.
e.zh: 该库去年将多个方法标记为已弃用。

e.en: The new release {deprecates} the old authentication module.
e.zh: 新版本弃用了旧的认证模块。

e.en: She always {deprecates} her own writing in public.
e.zh: 她在公开场合总是贬低自己的写作。

deprecating.t:
v. 正在弃用
adj. 贬低的

e.en: Google is {deprecating} third-party cookies in Chrome browsers.
e.zh: 谷歌正在 Chrome 浏览器中逐步弃用第三方 Cookie。

e.en: His self-{deprecating} jokes made the whole room laugh.
e.zh: 他自我调侃的笑话逗得满屋子人发笑。

deprecatingly.t: adv. 贬低地、不以为然地

e.en: He smiled {deprecatingly} when praised for his work.
e.zh: 被称赞工作时,他谦逊地微微一笑。

e.en: She spoke {deprecatingly} about her own painting skills.
e.zh: 她谦虚地谈论自己的绘画水平。

e.en: New cars {depreciate} quickly in the first few years.
e.zh: 新车在最初几年里贬值很快。

e.en: Don't {depreciate} the work your team has done.
e.zh: 不要贬低团队所做的工作。

e.en: The currency has {depreciated} sharply against the dollar.
e.zh: 该货币兑美元大幅贬值。

e.en: His old laptop has {depreciated} to almost nothing.
e.zh: 他那台旧笔记本电脑已经几乎一文不值了。

e.en: Rapid {depreciation} makes leasing more attractive than buying.
e.zh: 快速贬值让租赁比购买更具吸引力。

e.en: Accountants record {depreciation} on equipment every year.
e.zh: 会计师每年都会记录设备的折旧。

e.en: Years of {depredation} left the forest nearly bare.
e.zh: 多年的掠夺破坏让这片森林几近光秃。

e.en: Locusts caused widespread {depredation} of the wheat fields.
e.zh: 蝗虫对麦田造成了大面积的破坏。

e.en: Rainy weekends really {depress} my mood.
e.zh: 下雨的周末真的会让我心情低落。

e.en: Higher interest rates may {depress} consumer spending this quarter.
e.zh: 加息可能会抑制本季度的消费者支出。

depressant.t:
n. 镇静剂
adj. 抑制的

e.en: Alcohol is a {depressant} that slows the nervous system.
e.zh: 酒精是一种抑制中枢神经系统的物质。

e.en: The doctor warned that this drug is a {depressant}.
e.zh: 医生警告说这种药物是一种镇静抑制剂。

e.en: She has been feeling {depressed} since losing her job.
e.zh: 自从失业以来,她一直感到很消沉。

e.en: The {depressed} housing market worried local builders.
e.zh: 低迷的住房市场让当地建筑商感到担忧。

e.en: The news from the front lines is utterly {depressing}.
e.zh: 前线传来的消息令人极为沮丧。

e.en: Gray winter skies can be quite {depressing} after months.
e.zh: 连续几个月的灰色冬日天空让人相当压抑。

e.en: Sales remained {depressingly} flat throughout the holiday season.
e.zh: 整个假期销售额都低迷得令人沮丧。

e.en: The hotel room was {depressingly} small and dark.
e.zh: 酒店房间小得阴暗得让人心情低落。

e.en: She has been getting therapy for her {depression}.
e.zh: 她一直在接受抑郁症的心理治疗。

e.en: The Great {Depression} reshaped American economic policy forever.
e.zh: 大萧条彻底重塑了美国的经济政策。

e.en: Rainwater collected in the small {depressions} along the path.
e.zh: 雨水积聚在小径旁的浅坑里。

e.en: Several economic {depressions} marked the early twentieth century.
e.zh: 二十世纪初出现了多次经济萧条。

depressive.t:
adj. 抑郁的
n. 抑郁症患者

e.en: He was diagnosed with a {depressive} disorder last year.
e.zh: 他去年被诊断出患有抑郁障碍。

e.en: The film has a strangely {depressive} mood throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影自始至终弥漫着一种压抑的氛围。

e.en: The doctor used a tongue {depressor} to check my throat.
e.zh: 医生用压舌板检查了我的喉咙。

e.en: This muscle acts as a {depressor} of the lower jaw.
e.zh: 这块肌肉起着下颌下压肌的作用。

e.en: Crews must {depressurize} the cabin before opening the hatch.
e.zh: 机组必须先给客舱减压才能打开舱门。

e.en: Wait for the cooker to {depressurize} before lifting the lid.
e.zh: 先等高压锅泄压完毕再揭盖。

e.en: Sleep {deprivation} can seriously affect your concentration.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会严重影响你的注意力。

e.en: The report highlights child {deprivation} in rural areas.
e.zh: 报告强调了农村地区儿童贫困的问题。

e.en: Wartime {deprivations} shaped her entire generation.
e.zh: 战时的种种匮乏塑造了她整整一代人。

e.en: He spoke calmly about the {deprivations} of prison life.
e.zh: 他平静地谈起了监狱生活的种种艰苦。

e.en: Don't {deprive} yourself of small daily pleasures.
e.zh: 别剥夺自己日常的小确幸。

e.en: The new law could {deprive} workers of overtime pay.
e.zh: 新法律可能会剥夺工人的加班费。

e.en: She grew up in a {deprived} neighborhood on the city's edge.
e.zh: 她在城郊一个贫困社区长大。

e.en: The puppy looked sad and {deprived} of attention.
e.zh: 那只小狗看上去很难过,无人关爱。

e.en: Scrolling at night {deprives} you of quality sleep.
e.zh: 夜里刷手机会让你失去高质量的睡眠。

e.en: The new policy {deprives} students of free lunch.
e.zh: 新政策剥夺了学生的免费午餐。

e.en: Skipping breakfast is {depriving} your brain of fuel.
e.zh: 不吃早餐等于让大脑得不到能量。

e.en: The court ruled against {depriving} him of his license.
e.zh: 法院裁定不得吊销他的执照。

deprogrammer.t: n. 帮人摆脱邪教的人

e.en: The family hired a {deprogrammer} to help their son leave the cult.
e.zh: 这家人请了一位反洗脑专家帮儿子脱离邪教。

e.en: A skilled {deprogrammer} works slowly to rebuild trust.
e.zh: 出色的反洗脑师会慢慢重建信任。

e.en: Email the IT {dept} if your laptop won't boot.
e.zh: 如果笔记本无法启动,请发邮件给IT部门。

e.en: She just transferred to the marketing {dept}.
e.zh: 她刚调到市场部。

deptford.t: n. 德特福德（伦敦地名）

e.en: We took the train down to {Deptford} for brunch.
e.zh: 我们坐火车到德特福德吃早午餐。

e.en: {Deptford} has changed a lot since the dockyard closed.
e.zh: 自从船坞关闭后,德特福德变化很大。

e.en: The pool's {depth} drops sharply near the diving board.
e.zh: 泳池在跳板附近水深骤然加大。

e.en: Her essay shows real {depth} of thought.
e.zh: 她的文章显示出真正的思想深度。

depthless.t: adj. 肤浅的；深不可测的

e.en: His smile was charming but somehow {depthless}.
e.zh: 他的笑容迷人,却莫名地缺乏深度。

e.en: The lake looked {depthless} under the black night sky.
e.zh: 在漆黑的夜空下,湖水显得深不见底。

e.en: Strange creatures live in the {depths} of the ocean.
e.zh: 海洋深处生活着奇异的生物。

e.en: She sank into the {depths} of despair after the loss.
e.zh: 失去之后她陷入了深深的绝望。

e.en: A {deputation} of parents met the principal yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天一个家长代表团会见了校长。

e.en: The villagers sent a {deputation} to the mayor's office.
e.zh: 村民们派了一个代表团去市长办公室。

e.en: The manager will {depute} someone to handle the complaints.
e.zh: 经理会派人去处理这些投诉。

e.en: You can {depute} routine tasks to your assistant.
e.zh: 你可以把日常事务委托给助理处理。

e.en: Two {deputies} arrived to secure the crash site.
e.zh: 两名警员赶到现场保护车祸位置。

e.en: The mayor and her {deputies} held a press conference.
e.zh: 市长和她的副手们召开了新闻发布会。

deputise.t: v. 代理、代表（英式拼法）

e.en: I'll {deputise} for the chair while she's on leave.
e.zh: 主席休假期间我会代理她的职务。

e.en: Can you {deputise} someone to take the meeting notes?
e.zh: 你能指派个人来做会议记录吗?

e.en: The sheriff had to {deputize} volunteers during the search.
e.zh: 搜寻期间警长不得不临时任命志愿者为副警员。

e.en: He asked her to {deputize} for him at the conference.
e.zh: 他请她代他出席会议。

deputy.t:
n. 副手、代理人
adj. 副的

e.en: The {deputy} mayor announced the new transit plan.
e.zh: 副市长公布了新的交通规划。

e.en: A {deputy} pulled us over for speeding on the highway.
e.zh: 一名警官在高速公路上以超速为由把我们拦下了。

e.en: In German class we learned that {der} means "the" for masculine nouns.
e.zh: 德语课上我们学到 der 是阳性名词的定冠词。

e.en: The article {der} changes form depending on grammatical case.
e.zh: 冠词 der 会根据语法格的变化而改变形式。

e.en: War can {deracinate} entire communities within weeks.
e.zh: 战争能在几周内让整个社区背井离乡。

e.en: The policy aimed to {deracinate} traditional rural culture.
e.zh: 该政策意在铲除传统的乡村文化。

e.en: One careless comment can {derail} the whole negotiation.
e.zh: 一句不慎的话可能让整场谈判脱轨。

e.en: Heavy snow caused the freight train to {derail}.
e.zh: 大雪导致那列货运列车出轨。

e.en: The project was {derailed} by sudden budget cuts.
e.zh: 项目因突如其来的预算削减而停滞。

e.en: A loose rail {derailed} two carriages near the station.
e.zh: 一根松动的铁轨让车站附近两节车厢出轨。

e.en: My bike's rear {derailleur} keeps skipping gears uphill.
e.zh: 我自行车的后变速器上坡时总是跳挡。

e.en: A clean {derailleur} makes shifting much smoother.
e.zh: 干净的变速器能让换挡顺畅得多。

e.en: Investigators are still studying the cause of the {derailment}.
e.zh: 调查人员仍在分析这次脱轨事故的原因。

e.en: The scandal led to a complete {derailment} of his career.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻让他的事业彻底脱轨。

e.en: Months of isolation can truly {derange} a person.
e.zh: 数月的隔离真的会让一个人精神错乱。

e.en: Don't let one bad review {derange} your whole schedule.
e.zh: 别让一条差评打乱你的整个安排。

e.en: The villain in the movie laughs like a {deranged} clown.
e.zh: 电影里的反派笑得像个疯癫的小丑。

e.en: She sent a series of {deranged} messages at 3 a.m.
e.zh: 她凌晨三点发来一连串语无伦次的消息。

e.en: Witnesses described his behavior as a sign of {derangement}.
e.zh: 目击者称他的行为显示出精神错乱的迹象。

e.en: The novel explores the slow {derangement} of its narrator.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了叙述者一步步精神失常的过程。

derby.t:
n. 德比赛（同城对决）
n. 圆顶礼帽

e.en: The local {derby} between the two teams sold out instantly.
e.zh: 两支球队的同城德比比赛瞬间售罄。

e.en: He wore a brown {derby} hat to the wedding.
e.zh: 他戴了一顶棕色圆顶礼帽去参加婚礼。

e.en: We hiked across the hills of {Derbyshire} all weekend.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在德比郡的山间徒步。

e.en: {Derbyshire} is famous for its caves and stone villages.
e.zh: 德比郡以其洞穴和石头村庄闻名。

deregulate.t: v. 解除管制，放松监管

e.en: Critics warn against plans to {deregulate} the energy market.
e.zh: 评论人士警告不要放松对能源市场的管制。

e.en: The government voted to {deregulate} regional bus services.
e.zh: 政府投票决定放开对地区巴士服务的管制。

deregulated.t:
adj. 已放松管制的
v. deregulate 的过去式

e.en: Airlines were largely {deregulated} in the late 1970s.
e.zh: 航空业在1970年代末基本放开了管制。

e.en: A {deregulated} market often leads to lower entry barriers.
e.zh: 放松管制的市场通常会降低准入门槛。

deregulation.t: n. 解除管制，去监管化

e.en: Banking {deregulation} in the 1990s reshaped Wall Street.
e.zh: 九十年代的银行放松管制重塑了华尔街。

e.en: Some economists blame the crash on financial {deregulation}.
e.zh: 一些经济学家把这次崩盘归咎于金融业的放松管制。

deregulatory.t: adj. 放松管制的，去监管的

e.en: The new administration favors a {deregulatory} agenda.
e.zh: 新政府青睐放松管制的议程。

e.en: His {deregulatory} push faced strong union opposition.
e.zh: 他推动放松管制的举措遭到工会强烈反对。

derelict.t:
adj. 废弃的，荒废的
n. 流浪汉

e.en: They turned a {derelict} warehouse into a trendy café.
e.zh: 他们把一座废弃仓库改造成了时髦咖啡馆。

e.en: The judge said the guard was {derelict} in his duties.
e.zh: 法官表示这名保安玩忽职守。

e.en: He was fired for gross {dereliction} of duty.
e.zh: 他因严重玩忽职守被解雇。

e.en: The whole block has fallen into {dereliction}.
e.zh: 整条街区已经破败荒废。

derelicts.t: n. 废弃物；流浪者（复数）

e.en: Several {derelicts} along the riverfront await demolition.
e.zh: 河滨地带几座废弃建筑正等待拆除。

e.en: The old harbor was full of rusting {derelicts}.
e.zh: 老港口里到处是生锈的废弃船只。

e.en: Critics continue to {deride} the movie's predictable plot.
e.zh: 评论家依然嘲讽这部电影老套的剧情。

e.en: Don't {deride} ideas before you've even tried them.
e.zh: 还没尝试就别急着嘲笑别人的想法。

e.en: The proposal was widely {derided} on social media.
e.zh: 这一提议在社交媒体上遭到广泛嘲讽。

e.en: Once {derided} as a fad, the technology is now mainstream.
e.zh: 这项技术曾被讥为一时风潮,如今已成主流。

e.en: Her suggestion was met with open {derision} from the panel.
e.zh: 她的建议遭到评审团公开的嘲笑。

e.en: He laughed in {derision} when he saw the offer.
e.zh: 看到那份报价时,他嘲讽地笑了起来。

e.en: She brushed off the {derisions} of online trolls easily.
e.zh: 她轻松甩开了网络喷子的种种嘲讽。

e.en: The artist endured years of public {derisions} before success.
e.zh: 这位艺术家成名前忍受了多年的公开嘲讽。

e.en: He gave a {derisive} snort and walked out of the room.
e.zh: 他嘲讽地哼了一声,走出了房间。

e.en: The crowd's {derisive} laughter rattled the young speaker.
e.zh: 观众的嘲笑声让年轻演讲者乱了阵脚。

e.en: He smiled {derisively} when he heard the excuse.
e.zh: 听到那个借口,他露出了嘲讽的微笑。

e.en: She {derisively} called the project a vanity exercise.
e.zh: 她讥讽地把这个项目称作虚荣表演。

derisory.t: adj. 少得可笑的；嘲讽的

e.en: The company offered a {derisory} pay rise of one percent.
e.zh: 公司提出加薪百分之一,实在少得可笑。

e.en: Fans called the new ticket prices simply {derisory}.
e.zh: 球迷们称新票价简直少得可笑。

e.en: The word's {derivation} can be traced back to Old French.
e.zh: 这个词的词源可以追溯到古法语。

e.en: The textbook walks through the full {derivation} of the formula.
e.zh: 教科书完整推导了这个公式。

derivative.t:
n. 衍生品；导数
adj. 派生的，缺乏原创的

e.en: Reviewers called the film unoriginal and {derivative}.
e.zh: 评论家说这部电影毫无新意,只是模仿之作。

e.en: Banks lost billions on complex {derivative} contracts.
e.zh: 银行在复杂的衍生品合约上亏损了数十亿。

e.en: Many English words {derive} from Latin and Greek roots.
e.zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

e.en: She seems to {derive} real joy from teaching kids to read.
e.zh: 她似乎从教孩子阅读中获得真正的快乐。

derived.t:
adj. 派生的
v. 源自（过去式）

e.en: The drug is {derived} from a rare tropical plant.
e.zh: 这种药物提取自一种稀有的热带植物。

e.en: He {derived} great satisfaction from finishing the marathon.
e.zh: 完成马拉松让他获得了巨大的满足感。

e.en: The company {derives} most of its revenue from cloud services.
e.zh: 该公司大部分收入来自云服务。

e.en: She {derives} great satisfaction from teaching young children.
e.zh: 她从教孩子中获得极大的满足感。

deriving.t: v. 派生，获取（现在分词）

e.en: Many users are {deriving} real value from the new AI features.
e.zh: 许多用户正从新的AI功能中获得实在的价值。

e.en: He spent hours {deriving} the formula step by step.
e.zh: 他花了数小时一步步推导这个公式。

e.en: The clinic offers {dermabrasion} to reduce acne scars.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供磨皮术以减轻痘疤。

e.en: Recovery from {dermabrasion} usually takes about two weeks.
e.zh: 磨皮术后恢复通常需要约两周时间。

e.en: The cream targets the {dermal} layer to boost collagen.
e.zh: 这款面霜作用于真皮层以促进胶原蛋白生成。

e.en: She got {dermal} fillers to smooth out fine lines.
e.zh: 她注射了皮肤填充剂来抚平细纹。

e.en: Contact {dermatitis} can be triggered by harsh detergents.
e.zh: 接触性皮炎可能由刺激性洗涤剂引发。

e.en: His {dermatitis} flares up whenever the weather turns dry.
e.zh: 天气一变干燥,他的皮炎就会发作。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {dermatologic} surgery center last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月新开了一家皮肤外科中心。

e.en: Always read the label for {dermatologic} side effects.
e.zh: 务必阅读标签上的皮肤科副作用说明。

dermatological.t: adj. 皮肤病学的，皮肤科的

e.en: This sunscreen has been {dermatological}ly tested on sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这款防晒霜已在敏感肌上经过皮肤科测试。

e.en: She runs a {dermatological} clinic in downtown Shanghai.
e.zh: 她在上海市中心经营一家皮肤科诊所。

e.en: My {dermatologist} recommended a gentler face wash.
e.zh: 我的皮肤科医生推荐了一款更温和的洗面奶。

e.en: You should see a {dermatologist} if the rash persists.
e.zh: 如果疹子持续不退,你应该去看皮肤科医生。

e.en: She's specializing in {dermatology} after finishing medical school.
e.zh: 她医学院毕业后正专攻皮肤科。

e.en: The {dermatology} department is on the third floor.
e.zh: 皮肤科诊室在三楼。

e.en: Collagen in the {dermis} keeps skin firm and elastic.
e.zh: 真皮中的胶原蛋白让皮肤紧致有弹性。

e.en: The needle delivers vitamins directly into the {dermis}.
e.zh: 这种针头将维生素直接送入真皮层。

e.en: Please don't {derogate} her work in front of the team.
e.zh: 请不要在团队面前贬低她的工作。

e.en: Critics tried to {derogate} the film as shallow entertainment.
e.zh: 评论家试图把这部电影贬为肤浅的娱乐片。

e.en: The contract allows no {derogation} from the safety standards.
e.zh: 合同不允许对安全标准作任何减损。

e.en: His comments were taken as a {derogation} of her authority.
e.zh: 他的言论被视为对她权威的贬损。

e.en: The post was removed for using {derogatory} language.
e.zh: 该帖子因使用贬损性语言而被删除。

e.en: Avoid {derogatory} remarks about coworkers in chat channels.
e.zh: 避免在聊天群里对同事发表贬低性言论。

e.en: An oil {derrick} towered over the empty Texas plain.
e.zh: 一座钻井塔耸立在空旷的德州平原上。

e.en: Workers used a {derrick} to lift the steel beams.
e.zh: 工人们用起重架吊起钢梁。

derrida.t: n. 德里达（法国哲学家）

e.en: Her thesis draws heavily on {Derrida}'s theory of deconstruction.
e.zh: 她的论文大量借鉴了德里达的解构主义理论。

e.en: {Derrida} reshaped how philosophers think about language and meaning.
e.zh: 德里达改变了哲学家对语言与意义的思考方式。

e.en: The yoga pants are designed to flatter your {derriere}.
e.zh: 这款瑜伽裤的设计能修饰臀部线条。

e.en: He slipped on the ice and landed on his {derriere}.
e.zh: 他在冰上滑倒,屁股着地。

e.en: She kept a small {derringer} hidden in her purse.
e.zh: 她在手提包里藏着一把小型袖珍手枪。

e.en: The museum displays an antique {derringer} from the 1860s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把1860年代的古董袖珍手枪。

derry.t: n. 德里（北爱尔兰城市）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the old walls of {Derry}.
e.zh: 我们周末游览了德里的古城墙。

e.en: {Derry} has become a popular tourist destination in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 德里已成为北爱尔兰的热门旅游城市。

e.en: The whirling {dervish} spun gracefully under the spotlight.
e.zh: 旋转的苏菲教托钵僧在聚光灯下优雅地旋转。

e.en: She cleaned the kitchen like a {dervish} before guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前,她像陀螺一样飞快地打扫厨房。

e.en: We hiked along the {Derwent} River all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们沿着德文特河徒步了一整个下午。

e.en: {Derwent} pencils are popular with professional illustrators.
e.zh: 德文特彩铅深受专业插画师的喜爱。

derwentwater.t: n. 德文特湖（英国湖泊）

e.en: {Derwentwater} is one of the most photographed lakes in England.
e.zh: 德文特湖是英格兰最常被拍摄的湖泊之一。

e.en: We rented a rowboat on {Derwentwater} at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时在德文特湖租了一条划艇。

e.en: The old system still uses {DES} encryption for legacy files.
e.zh: 这个旧系统仍用DES加密处理遗留文件。

e.en: {DES} has long been replaced by AES in modern security.
e.zh: 在现代安全领域,DES早已被AES取代。

e.en: The city now drinks {desalinated} seawater every summer.
e.zh: 这座城市每年夏天都饮用淡化后的海水。

e.en: Farmers use {desalinated} water to irrigate desert crops.
e.zh: 农民用淡化海水灌溉沙漠中的农作物。

e.en: Saudi Arabia leads the world in {desalination} capacity.
e.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的海水淡化产能位居世界第一。

e.en: New {desalination} plants use less energy than older designs.
e.zh: 新型海水淡化厂比旧设计耗能更少。

e.en: {Desalinization} could ease water shortages in coastal regions.
e.zh: 海水淡化可以缓解沿海地区的缺水问题。

e.en: The startup is developing cheaper {desalinization} membranes.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在研发更便宜的海水淡化膜。

e.en: Engineers are testing solar panels that can {desalinize} seawater.
e.zh: 工程师正在测试可以淡化海水的太阳能板。

e.en: It costs a lot of energy to {desalinize} ocean water.
e.zh: 淡化海水需要消耗大量能源。

desaturation.t: n. 去饱和；降低饱和度

e.en: Apply slight {desaturation} to give the photo a vintage feel.
e.zh: 轻微降低饱和度可以让照片更有复古感。

e.en: Oxygen {desaturation} during sleep can signal sleep apnea.
e.zh: 睡眠中血氧饱和度下降可能预示睡眠呼吸暂停。

descant.t:
n. 高音部；descant
v. 详述

e.en: The choir added a soaring {descant} to the final verse.
e.zh: 合唱团在最后一段加入了高亢的高声部。

e.en: He loves to {descant} on the merits of vinyl records.
e.zh: 他喜欢长篇大论地夸黑胶唱片的好处。

descartes.t: n. 笛卡尔（法国哲学家、数学家）

e.en: {Descartes} famously wrote, 'I think, therefore I am.'
e.zh: 笛卡尔有句名言:“我思故我在。”

e.en: Modern philosophy is often said to begin with {Descartes}.
e.zh: 人们常说现代哲学始于笛卡尔。

descend.t:
v. 下降；下来
v. 起源于

e.en: The plane will {descend} into Tokyo in about ten minutes.
e.zh: 飞机将在大约十分钟后下降抵达东京。

e.en: Hikers should {descend} the mountain before dark.
e.zh: 徒步者应在天黑前下山。

descendant.t:
n. 后代；子孙
adj. 下降的

e.en: She is a direct {descendant} of a Qing dynasty official.
e.zh: 她是一位清朝官员的直系后裔。

e.en: Python is a distant {descendant} of the ABC programming language.
e.zh: Python是ABC编程语言的一个远亲后代。

descended.t:
v. descend 的过去式；下降
v. 源自

e.en: Silence {descended} on the room when she walked in.
e.zh: 她走进来时,房间里顿时一片寂静。

e.en: He {descended} the stairs slowly, holding the railing.
e.zh: 他扶着扶手缓缓走下楼梯。

e.en: Every {descendent} of the founder receives a small dividend.
e.zh: 创始人的每一位后裔都能领到一小笔分红。

e.en: This breed is a {descendent} of ancient hunting dogs.
e.zh: 这个品种是古代猎犬的后代。

descender.t: n. (字母的) 下伸笔画；下降者

e.en: The letter 'g' has a curved {descender} below the baseline.
e.zh: 字母g的下伸部在基线下方呈曲线状。

e.en: Designers shortened the {descender} to fit tighter line spacing.
e.zh: 设计师缩短了下伸部以适应更紧的行距。

e.en: Sort the results in {descending} order of price.
e.zh: 按价格降序排列结果。

e.en: The {descending} elevator stopped suddenly between floors.
e.zh: 下行的电梯在楼层之间突然停住了。

descends.t: v. descend 的第三人称单数；下降

e.en: A heavy fog {descends} on the bay every evening.
e.zh: 每天傍晚,浓雾都会笼罩海湾。

e.en: The road {descends} sharply just past the bridge.
e.zh: 过了桥后,道路急剧下坡。

descent.t:
n. 下降；下坡
n. 血统；出身

e.en: The plane began its {descent} into San Francisco.
e.zh: 飞机开始下降前往旧金山。

e.en: She is of Korean {descent} but grew up in Brazil.
e.zh: 她是韩国后裔,但在巴西长大。

e.en: Mountain bikers love the steep {descents} on this trail.
e.zh: 山地车手很喜欢这条小道陡峭的下坡路段。

e.en: Several rapid {descents} caused her ears to pop.
e.zh: 几次快速下降让她的耳朵直发胀。

describable.t: adj. 可描述的；能形容的

e.en: The flavor is barely {describable} — you have to taste it.
e.zh: 这种味道几乎无法形容,你得亲自尝一尝。

e.en: Her joy at the news was hardly {describable}.
e.zh: 她听到消息时的喜悦难以言表。

e.en: Can you {describe} the man you saw at the door?
e.zh: 你能描述一下你在门口看到的那个男人吗?

e.en: In one sentence, {describe} what your startup does.
e.zh: 用一句话描述你的初创公司在做什么。

described.t: v. describe 的过去式；描述

e.en: The witness {described} the suspect as tall and bearded.
e.zh: 证人描述嫌疑人身材高大,留着胡子。

e.en: The new feature works exactly as {described} in the docs.
e.zh: 新功能的运作方式与文档中描述的完全一致。

e.en: She's a vivid {describer} of city life in her novels.
e.zh: 她在小说中是一位描绘城市生活的高手。

e.en: The audio {describer} narrates scenes for visually impaired viewers.
e.zh: 口述影像员为视障观众解说画面。

describes.t: v. describe 的第三人称单数；描述

e.en: The README {describes} how to install the package locally.
e.zh: 自述文件说明了如何在本地安装这个软件包。

e.en: He {describes} himself as a curious lifelong learner.
e.zh: 他自称是一个充满好奇心的终身学习者。

describing.t: v. describe 的现在分词；描述

e.en: She spent ten minutes {describing} the bug to support.
e.zh: 她花了十分钟向客服描述这个错误。

e.en: There's no {describing} how beautiful the sunset was.
e.zh: 那场日落的美丽简直无法形容。

e.en: The product {description} is missing key technical specs.
e.zh: 产品描述里缺少关键的技术参数。

e.en: Her {description} of the accident matched the video footage.
e.zh: 她对事故的描述与视频画面相符。

e.en: Good job {descriptions} attract more qualified candidates.
e.zh: 好的职位描述能吸引到更合适的候选人。

e.en: The app generates product {descriptions} using AI.
e.zh: 这款应用用AI自动生成产品描述。

e.en: Use a more {descriptive} variable name than 'data'.
e.zh: 用一个比“data”更具描述性的变量名。

e.en: Her writing is rich and {descriptive}, full of sensory detail.
e.zh: 她的文字丰富而富有描绘性,充满感官细节。

descriptively.t: adv. 描述性地；用描写方式

e.en: The travel blog writes {descriptively} about hidden mountain villages.
e.zh: 这个旅行博客以细腻的笔触描写隐秘的山村。

e.en: Name your commits {descriptively} so reviewers understand the change.
e.zh: 提交时取个有描述性的名字,方便审阅者理解改动。

e.en: Each file has a unique {descriptor} used by the operating system.
e.zh: 每个文件都有一个供操作系统使用的唯一描述符。

e.en: 'Cozy' is the perfect {descriptor} for this little café.
e.zh: “温馨”是形容这家小咖啡馆的完美词。

e.en: From the cliff she could just {descry} a sail on the horizon.
e.zh: 从悬崖上她隐约能看见地平线上有一片船帆。

e.en: Critics {descry} subtle political themes in his latest film.
e.zh: 评论家在他最新的电影中察觉到了微妙的政治主题。

desdemona.t: n. 苔丝狄蒙娜（《奥赛罗》女主角）

e.en: In the play, {Desdemona} is tragically wronged by her jealous husband.
e.zh: 在剧中，苔丝狄蒙娜被她善妒的丈夫冤枉，下场悲惨。

e.en: The actress played {Desdemona} with quiet, heartbreaking dignity.
e.zh: 那位女演员把苔丝狄蒙娜演得安静又令人心碎。

e.en: Vandals tried to {desecrate} the war memorial last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有破坏者企图亵渎那座战争纪念碑。

e.en: It would {desecrate} the temple to wear shoes inside.
e.zh: 穿鞋进入寺庙会是对圣地的亵渎。

desecrated.t: v. desecrate 的过去式；亵渎

e.en: Someone {desecrated} the old cemetery with spray paint.
e.zh: 有人用喷漆亵渎了那座古老的墓园。

e.en: The shrine was {desecrated} during the war and never repaired.
e.zh: 那座神龛在战争中被亵渎，再也没有修复。

e.en: The community condemned the {desecration} of the gravesite.
e.zh: 社区强烈谴责对墓地的亵渎行为。

e.en: Cutting down the sacred tree felt like an act of {desecration}.
e.zh: 砍倒那棵神树感觉像是一种亵渎行为。

e.en: It took years of activism to {desegregate} public schools.
e.zh: 花了多年抗争才让公立学校废除种族隔离。

e.en: The court ordered the city to {desegregate} its housing programs.
e.zh: 法院命令该市废除住房项目中的种族隔离。

desegregated.t: v. desegregate 的过去式；废除种族隔离

e.en: The buses were finally {desegregated} after months of protest.
e.zh: 经过数月抗议，公交车终于废除了种族隔离。

e.en: By 1970, most southern schools had been {desegregated}.
e.zh: 到1970年，大多数南方学校已废除种族隔离。

e.en: School {desegregation} reshaped American education in the 1960s.
e.zh: 学校废除种族隔离在1960年代重塑了美国教育。

e.en: The {desegregation} order met fierce resistance from local officials.
e.zh: 废除种族隔离的命令遭到当地官员的强烈抵制。

e.en: Click the checkbox again to {deselect} that item.
e.zh: 再点一下复选框就能取消选中那一项。
