e.en: Press Escape to {deselect} all the highlighted files.
e.zh: 按 Escape 键可以取消选中所有高亮的文件。

e.en: Repeated exposure leads to gradual {desensitization} to violent images.
e.zh: 反复接触会让人对暴力画面逐渐麻木。

e.en: The therapy uses {desensitization} to help patients overcome phobias.
e.zh: 该疗法利用脱敏来帮助患者克服恐惧症。

e.en: Constant news alerts can {desensitize} us to real tragedies.
e.zh: 不断的新闻推送会让我们对真正的悲剧变得麻木。

e.en: Doctors {desensitize} allergic patients with tiny doses over time.
e.zh: 医生通过长期小剂量给药让过敏患者脱敏。

e.en: Years of action films left him {desensitized} to on-screen violence.
e.zh: 多年的动作片让他对银幕暴力麻木了。

e.en: She felt {desensitized} after scrolling through bad news all day.
e.zh: 刷了一整天坏消息后，她感觉麻木了。

desert.t:
n. 沙漠
v. 抛弃；遗弃

e.en: We drove across the {desert} for hours without seeing anyone.
e.zh: 我们驱车穿越沙漠数小时，一个人也没看到。

e.en: His friends never {desert} him when things get tough.
e.zh: 日子艰难时，他的朋友从不抛弃他。

deserted.t:
adj. 荒废的；无人的
v. 抛弃

e.en: The streets were completely {deserted} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，街道上空无一人。

e.en: He {deserted} the army and fled across the border.
e.zh: 他从军队开小差，逃过了边境。

e.en: The {deserter} was caught hiding in a nearby village.
e.zh: 那名逃兵被抓时正藏在附近的村庄里。

e.en: History remembers him as a coward and a {deserter}.
e.zh: 历史把他记作懦夫和逃兵。

e.en: Climate change has accelerated {desertification} across northern Africa.
e.zh: 气候变化加速了北非的荒漠化进程。

e.en: Tree-planting programs aim to slow {desertification} in the region.
e.zh: 植树项目旨在减缓该地区的荒漠化。

deserting.t: v. desert 的现在分词；抛弃

e.en: Soldiers were shot for {deserting} their posts in wartime.
e.zh: 战时擅离岗位的士兵会被枪决。

e.en: Loyal fans aren't {deserting} the team despite a losing season.
e.zh: 尽管赛季失利，忠实球迷并未弃球队而去。

e.en: He was court-martialed for {desertion} during the war.
e.zh: 他因战时逃兵罪被军事法庭审判。

e.en: Her sudden {desertion} left the project without a leader.
e.zh: 她突然撂挑子让这个项目失去了负责人。

e.en: The army faced mass {desertions} in the final weeks of fighting.
e.zh: 战斗的最后几周，军队出现了大规模逃兵。

e.en: Repeated {desertions} weakened the rebel forces significantly.
e.zh: 接连不断的逃兵大大削弱了叛军。

deserts.t:
n. 沙漠（复数）
v. 抛弃

e.en: Many {deserts} are surprisingly cold at night.
e.zh: 许多沙漠到了晚上冷得惊人。

e.en: After cheating customers, he finally got his just {deserts}.
e.zh: 欺骗顾客之后，他终于得到了应有的报应。

e.en: You {deserve} a break after working all weekend.
e.zh: 忙了一整个周末，你该好好休息一下了。

e.en: Honest workers {deserve} fair pay for their effort.
e.zh: 诚实的劳动者理应获得公平的报酬。

deserved.t: adj. 应得的；理所当然的

e.en: She {deserved} every bit of the praise she received.
e.zh: 她得到的每一句赞美都当之无愧。

e.en: After the long hike, a hot meal felt well {deserved}.
e.zh: 长途徒步后，一顿热饭感觉是应得的犒劳。

deservedly.t: adv. 应得地；理所当然地

e.en: The film was {deservedly} nominated for several awards.
e.zh: 这部电影获得多项提名，实至名归。

e.en: He was {deservedly} fired after lying to his manager.
e.zh: 他对经理撒谎后被解雇，咎由自取。

deserves.t: v. deserve 的第三人称单数；应得

e.en: Every kid {deserves} a safe place to learn.
e.zh: 每个孩子都应该有一个安全的学习环境。

e.en: This restaurant {deserves} all the hype on social media.
e.zh: 这家餐厅在社交媒体上的热度，名副其实。

e.en: The scholarship goes to a {deserving} student each year.
e.zh: 该奖学金每年颁给一位品学兼优的学生。

e.en: Her debut novel is {deserving} of wider attention.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说值得更多关注。

e.en: Strong winds quickly {desiccate} the topsoil after plowing.
e.zh: 耕地后强风很快就让表层土壤变干。

e.en: Manufacturers {desiccate} the fruit before sealing the package.
e.zh: 生产商在封装前会先把水果脱水干燥。

e.en: The {desiccated} leaves crumbled at the slightest touch.
e.zh: 那些干枯的叶子轻轻一碰就碎了。

e.en: He sprinkled {desiccated} coconut over the cake.
e.zh: 他在蛋糕上撒了一些椰丝。

e.en: Proper packaging prevents {desiccation} of the fresh herbs.
e.zh: 妥善包装可以防止新鲜香草脱水变干。

e.en: Prolonged drought caused widespread {desiccation} of the wetlands.
e.zh: 长期干旱导致湿地大面积干涸。

desiderata.t: n. 所需之物（desideratum 的复数）

e.en: The committee listed several {desiderata} for the new system.
e.zh: 委员会列出了对新系统的几项期望要求。

e.en: Affordability and reliability are key {desiderata} for most buyers.
e.zh: 价格合理和可靠性是大多数买家最看重的条件。

e.en: Speed is an important {desideratum} in any payment app.
e.zh: 速度是任何支付应用都不可或缺的要求。

e.en: Privacy has become a major {desideratum} for modern users.
e.zh: 隐私已成为现代用户的一项主要诉求。

design.t:
v. 设计
n. 设计；方案

e.en: The new app has a clean, minimalist {design}.
e.zh: 这款新应用有着简洁极简的设计风格。

e.en: Engineers will {design} the bridge to withstand earthquakes.
e.zh: 工程师会把这座桥设计成能抗地震。

designate.t:
v. 指定；任命
adj. 已受委任的

e.en: Please {designate} one person to lead the meeting.
e.zh: 请指定一个人来主持这次会议。

e.en: The city plans to {designate} this park as protected land.
e.zh: 市政府计划把这座公园指定为保护用地。

e.en: Smoking is only allowed in {designated} areas of the airport.
e.zh: 机场只允许在指定区域吸烟。

e.en: She was {designated} as the team's spokesperson.
e.zh: 她被指定为团队的发言人。

designates.t: v. 指定；任命（第三人称单数）

e.en: The red label {designates} items that are non-refundable.
e.zh: 红色标签表示该商品不可退款。

e.en: The boss {designates} a new project lead every quarter.
e.zh: 老板每季度都会指定一位新的项目负责人。

e.en: The mayor signed an order {designating} the building a landmark.
e.zh: 市长签署命令，将该建筑列为地标。

e.en: They are {designating} certain hours for quiet study only.
e.zh: 他们正划定某些时段为安静自习时间。

e.en: The town earned World Heritage {designation} last year.
e.zh: 该镇去年获得了世界遗产的称号。

e.en: His official {designation} is senior research fellow.
e.zh: 他的正式职称是高级研究员。

designed.t:
adj. 特意设计的
v. 设计（过去式）

e.en: This chair was {designed} for long hours at the desk.
e.zh: 这把椅子是为长时间伏案工作而设计的。

e.en: She {designed} the entire website in just two weeks.
e.zh: 她仅用两周就设计好了整个网站。

e.en: The CEO's {designee} will attend the meeting on her behalf.
e.zh: 首席执行官的指定代表将代她出席会议。

e.en: Sign the form and have your {designee} witness it.
e.zh: 签好表格，并让你指定的代理人作见证。

designer.t:
n. 设计师
adj. 名牌的

e.en: She works as a {designer} at a small fashion studio.
e.zh: 她在一家小型时装工作室当设计师。

e.en: He carries a {designer} bag everywhere he goes.
e.zh: 他走到哪里都带着名牌设计师包。

e.en: The company hired three new {designers} this month.
e.zh: 公司这个月新聘了三位设计师。

e.en: Top {designers} showcased their collections at fashion week.
e.zh: 顶级设计师们在时装周上展示了他们的新作。

designing.t:
v. 设计中
adj. 有心机的

e.en: He spent the weekend {designing} a logo for the cafe.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在为那家咖啡馆设计标志。

e.en: Be careful — she's a {designing} woman with hidden motives.
e.zh: 小心点——她是个心机很深、另有目的的女人。

designs.t:
n. 设计（复数）
v. 设计（第三人称单数）

e.en: The architect's {designs} won several international awards.
e.zh: 那位建筑师的设计获得了多项国际奖项。

e.en: Our team {designs} mobile apps for small businesses.
e.zh: 我们团队为小企业设计手机应用。

e.en: Location greatly affects the {desirability} of a property.
e.zh: 地段很大程度上决定了房产的吸引力。

e.en: They debated the {desirability} of working from home full-time.
e.zh: 他们讨论了完全居家办公是否可取。

e.en: A quiet neighborhood is {desirable} for families with kids.
e.zh: 对有孩子的家庭来说，安静的小区是首选。

e.en: Strong communication skills are highly {desirable} in this role.
e.zh: 这个职位非常看重出色的沟通能力。

desire.t:
v. 渴望；想要
n. 欲望；心愿

e.en: She has a strong {desire} to travel the world.
e.zh: 她有一种强烈的愿望想环游世界。

e.en: Many people {desire} financial independence by their forties.
e.zh: 许多人希望在四十多岁时实现财务自由。

e.en: The medicine produced the {desired} effect within hours.
e.zh: 这种药几个小时内就产生了预期的效果。

e.en: He always {desired} a quieter life in the countryside.
e.zh: 他一直渴望在乡下过更宁静的生活。

desires.t:
v. 渴望（第三人称单数）
n. 欲望（复数）

e.en: Everyone {desires} to be loved and understood.
e.zh: 每个人都渴望被爱和被理解。

e.en: The book explores the hidden {desires} of its characters.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了人物内心隐藏的渴望。

e.en: Customers {desiring} a refund should contact support directly.
e.zh: 希望退款的顾客请直接联系客服。

e.en: She lay awake, {desiring} nothing more than a quiet morning.
e.zh: 她躺着睡不着，只渴望一个安静的早晨。

e.en: The students were {desirous} of better learning resources.
e.zh: 学生们渴望获得更好的学习资源。

e.en: He seemed {desirous} to please his new boss.
e.zh: 他似乎很想讨好新老板。

e.en: The court ordered the company to {desist} from false advertising.
e.zh: 法院命令该公司停止虚假广告行为。

e.en: Please {desist} from using your phone during the exam.
e.zh: 考试期间请停止使用手机。

e.en: My laptop is sitting on the {desk} by the window.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑就放在窗边的桌子上。

e.en: Please check in at the front {desk} when you arrive.
e.zh: 到达后请在前台办理登记。

e.en: The office has rows of standing {desks} for employees.
e.zh: 办公室里摆着一排排员工用的站立式办公桌。

e.en: Students cleaned out their {desks} on the last day.
e.zh: 学生们在最后一天清理了自己的课桌。

desktop.t:
n. 桌面；台式电脑
adj. 桌面的

e.en: I saved the file directly to my {desktop} for quick access.
e.zh: 我把文件直接存到桌面方便取用。

e.en: This game runs better on a {desktop} than a laptop.
e.zh: 这款游戏在台式机上比笔记本运行得更好。

e.en: Most gamers still prefer custom-built {desktops} over laptops.
e.zh: 多数玩家仍偏爱自己组装的台式机而非笔记本。

e.en: Their cluttered {desktops} were full of random shortcut icons.
e.zh: 他们凌乱的桌面上布满了各种快捷方式图标。

desolate.t:
adj. 荒凉的；凄凉的
v. 使荒芜

e.en: The town felt {desolate} after the factory shut down.
e.zh: 工厂关闭后,这座小镇显得一片荒凉。

e.en: She looked {desolate} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到那个消息时,她神情十分凄凉。

e.en: The hurricane {desolated} entire coastal villages overnight.
e.zh: 飓风一夜之间摧毁了沿海的整片村庄。

e.en: He was utterly {desolated} by his best friend's death.
e.zh: 挚友的离世让他悲痛欲绝。

e.en: Photos of the war zone showed scenes of utter {desolation}.
e.zh: 战区的照片展现出彻底荒凉的景象。

e.en: A deep sense of {desolation} settled over her after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后,一种深深的凄凉感笼罩着她。

e.en: The poem describes the quiet {desolations} of forgotten towns.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了被遗忘小镇的寂静荒凉。

e.en: History books rarely capture the personal {desolations} of war.
e.zh: 史书很少记录战争带来的个人哀痛。

e.en: The lab measured the {desorption} rate of gas from the surface.
e.zh: 实验室测量了气体从表面脱附的速率。

e.en: Heating the material triggers {desorption} of trapped molecules.
e.zh: 加热该材料会引发被困分子的解吸。

despair.t:
n. 绝望
v. 感到绝望

e.en: Don't {despair} — there are still options we haven't tried.
e.zh: 别绝望,我们还有没试过的办法。

e.en: A wave of {despair} hit him when the deal fell through.
e.zh: 交易告吹时,一阵绝望涌上他心头。

e.en: She gave a {despairing} sigh and closed her laptop.
e.zh: 她绝望地叹了口气,合上了笔记本电脑。

e.en: His {despairing} tone worried everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 他绝望的语气让会议上的每个人都很担心。

e.en: He stared {despairingly} at the empty bank account.
e.zh: 他绝望地盯着空空如也的银行账户。

e.en: She shook her head {despairingly} at the messy room.
e.zh: 她对着凌乱的房间绝望地摇了摇头。

despairs.t: v. 绝望（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandfather often {despairs} of modern technology.
e.zh: 我爷爷常常对现代科技感到绝望。

e.en: She never {despairs}, no matter how tough things get.
e.zh: 无论情况多艰难,她从不绝望。

despatch.t:
v. 发送；派遣（dispatch 变体）
n. 急件

e.en: Please {despatch} the package by tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 请在明早之前把包裹寄出。

e.en: The order was ready for {despatch} within an hour.
e.zh: 订单一小时内就备好可以发货了。

e.en: The {despatcher} radioed the driver about a route change.
e.zh: 调度员用无线电通知司机更改路线。

e.en: She works as a {despatcher} for an ambulance service.
e.zh: 她在一家救护车服务公司当调度员。

despenser.t: n. 分配者（Despenser 家族姓氏）

e.en: The soap {despenser} in the bathroom needs refilling.
e.zh: 洗手间的皂液器需要加液了。

e.en: He installed a coin {despenser} near the laundry machines.
e.zh: 他在洗衣机旁安装了一台硬币兑换机。

e.en: The film features a lonely {desperado} riding into town.
e.zh: 影片讲述了一个孤独的亡命之徒骑马进城的故事。

e.en: He played the role of a charming {desperado} in the western.
e.zh: 他在那部西部片中饰演一个迷人的亡命之徒。

e.en: I'm {desperate} for a coffee after that long meeting.
e.zh: 开完那个长会后,我急需一杯咖啡。

e.en: Refugees made {desperate} attempts to cross the border.
e.zh: 难民们孤注一掷地试图越过边境。

e.en: She {desperately} searched her bag for the missing keys.
e.zh: 她拼命地在包里翻找丢失的钥匙。

e.en: The startup {desperately} needs more funding to survive.
e.zh: 这家初创公司急需更多资金才能存活。

e.en: Out of {desperation}, he took a loan from a stranger.
e.zh: 出于绝望,他向陌生人借了钱。

e.en: You could hear the {desperation} in her voice on the call.
e.zh: 电话里能听出她声音中的绝望。

e.en: The novel captures the small {desperations} of suburban life.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉了郊区生活中那些细小的绝望。

e.en: Her diary recorded the daily {desperations} of a young mother.
e.zh: 她的日记记录下一位年轻母亲日复一日的窘迫与无助。

e.en: Lying to your own family is a {despicable} thing to do.
e.zh: 对自己的家人撒谎是一件卑鄙的事。

e.en: The villain's {despicable} schemes finally caught up with him.
e.zh: 那个反派卑鄙的阴谋最终自食其果。

e.en: I {despise} apps that bombard users with notifications.
e.zh: 我鄙视那些不停推送通知轰炸用户的应用。

e.en: Many voters {despise} negative campaign ads.
e.zh: 许多选民厌恶负面竞选广告。

despised.t:
v. 鄙视（过去式）
adj. 受人鄙视的

e.en: As a kid, I {despised} eating cooked carrots.
e.zh: 小时候我特别讨厌吃煮熟的胡萝卜。

e.en: The {despised} dictator was finally driven from power.
e.zh: 那个遭人唾弃的独裁者最终被赶下了台。

despises.t: v. 鄙视、看不起（第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat absolutely {despises} the new vacuum cleaner.
e.zh: 我家猫对那台新吸尘器深恶痛绝。

e.en: He {despises} people who cut in line at the airport.
e.zh: 他鄙视那些在机场插队的人。

despising.t: v. 鄙视、蔑视（现在分词）

e.en: She grew up {despising} the snobbery of her classmates.
e.zh: 她从小就鄙视同学们那种势利的做派。

e.en: He left the company, {despising} its toxic culture.
e.zh: 他厌恶公司有毒的文化,最终选择离开。

e.en: {Despite} the rain, the concert went ahead as planned.
e.zh: 尽管下雨,演唱会仍按计划进行。

e.en: She got the job {despite} having no formal degree.
e.zh: 尽管没有正式学位,她还是得到了那份工作。

e.en: Mining companies often {despoil} the surrounding landscape.
e.zh: 矿业公司常常破坏周边的自然景观。

e.en: Tourists can {despoil} fragile ecosystems if not careful.
e.zh: 游客若不当心,会破坏脆弱的生态系统。

e.en: He was branded a {despoiler} of the country's heritage.
e.zh: 他被指责为这个国家文化遗产的破坏者。

e.en: The novel's villain is a ruthless {despoiler} of forests.
e.zh: 小说中的反派是一个肆意破坏森林的恶徒。

e.en: Activists protested the {despoliation} of the rainforest.
e.zh: 环保人士抗议对雨林的肆意破坏。

e.en: The war led to widespread {despoliation} of cultural sites.
e.zh: 那场战争导致大量文化遗址遭到掠夺破坏。

e.en: A sense of {despondency} spread through the team after losing.
e.zh: 输球之后,一种沮丧情绪在队中蔓延。

e.en: He sank into {despondency} after losing his job.
e.zh: 丢掉工作后,他陷入了深深的沮丧。

e.en: She felt {despondent} after another rejection email.
e.zh: 又收到一封拒信后,她感到十分沮丧。

e.en: Fans were {despondent} when their team got eliminated.
e.zh: 球队被淘汰后,球迷们灰心丧气。

e.en: He stared {despondently} at the rejection letter on his desk.
e.zh: 他沮丧地盯着桌上的拒信。

e.en: She walked home {despondently} after failing the exam.
e.zh: 考试失利后,她垂头丧气地走回家。

e.en: History remembers him as a cruel {despot}.
e.zh: 历史将他记作一位残暴的暴君。

e.en: The new manager runs the office like a petty {despot}.
e.zh: 新经理把办公室管得像个小暴君的领地。

e.en: The country suffered under decades of {despotic} rule.
e.zh: 这个国家在几十年的专制统治下饱受苦难。

e.en: Employees complained about the boss's {despotic} style.
e.zh: 员工们抱怨老板那种专制的作风。

e.en: The revolution aimed to end centuries of {despotism}.
e.zh: 这场革命旨在终结数百年的专制统治。

e.en: Critics warned that the new law could lead to {despotism}.
e.zh: 批评者警告说新法律可能滑向专制。

e.en: What's for {dessert} tonight — ice cream or cake?
e.zh: 今晚甜点吃什么——冰淇淋还是蛋糕?

e.en: She always saves room for {dessert} at restaurants.
e.zh: 她在餐厅里总会留出肚子来吃甜点。

destabilisation.t: n. 动摇、失稳（英式拼写）

e.en: Sanctions risk further {destabilisation} of the region.
e.zh: 制裁可能加剧该地区的不稳定。

e.en: Experts warn of economic {destabilisation} from rising debt.
e.zh: 专家警告债务上升会引发经济动荡。

destabilise.t: v. 使不稳定、动摇（英式拼写）

e.en: Rumors can quickly {destabilise} financial markets.
e.zh: 谣言会迅速扰乱金融市场的稳定。

e.en: Foreign interference threatens to {destabilise} the government.
e.zh: 外国干预可能会动摇该政府的稳定。

destabilising.t: v. 使不稳定（现在分词，英式）

e.en: Crypto crashes had a {destabilising} effect on the economy.
e.zh: 加密货币崩盘对经济造成了动摇性影响。

e.en: The leak is {destabilising} the company's leadership team.
e.zh: 这次泄露正在动摇公司管理层的稳定。

e.en: Analysts fear {destabilization} of the global supply chain.
e.zh: 分析人士担心全球供应链会出现动荡。

e.en: The coup caused widespread political {destabilization}.
e.zh: 这场政变造成了大范围的政治动荡。

e.en: A sudden rate hike could {destabilize} small banks.
e.zh: 突然加息可能会动摇小型银行的稳定。

e.en: Misinformation campaigns aim to {destabilize} elections.
e.zh: 虚假信息行动企图扰乱选举的稳定。

e.en: The scandal {destabilized} the entire ruling party.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻动摇了整个执政党。

e.en: Climate change has {destabilized} weather patterns globally.
e.zh: 气候变化在全球范围内打乱了天气规律。

destabilizing.t: v. 使不稳定（现在分词）

e.en: AI deepfakes are a {destabilizing} force in politics.
e.zh: AI深度伪造正在成为政治中的一股动荡力量。

e.en: The protest is {destabilizing} the local economy.
e.zh: 这场抗议正在动摇当地经济的稳定。

e.en: Bali remains a top {destination} for honeymooners.
e.zh: 巴厘岛仍是蜜月旅行者的热门目的地。

e.en: Please enter your {destination} into the GPS app.
e.zh: 请在导航应用里输入你的目的地。

e.en: This site lists the cheapest flight {destinations} this month.
e.zh: 这个网站列出了本月最便宜的航班目的地。

e.en: Mountain {destinations} are booked solid for the holidays.
e.zh: 假期的山区度假地已被订满。

e.en: Her parents tried to {destine} her for a medical career.
e.zh: 她父母想让她注定走上从医这条路。

e.en: Critics {destine} the film for awards season glory.
e.zh: 评论家预言这部电影注定将在颁奖季大放异彩。

e.en: This album seems {destined} to top the charts.
e.zh: 这张专辑似乎注定要登上排行榜榜首。

e.en: The package was {destined} for an address in Tokyo.
e.zh: 这个包裹是寄往东京一个地址的。

e.en: The novel follows the intertwined {destinies} of three sisters.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了三姐妹彼此交织的命运。

e.en: Voters feel they hold their country's {destinies} in their hands.
e.zh: 选民们觉得国家的命运掌握在自己手中。

e.en: She believes meeting him was her {destiny}.
e.zh: 她相信遇见他就是自己的命运。

e.en: You can shape your own {destiny} through hard work.
e.zh: 你可以通过努力塑造自己的命运。

e.en: The charity helps families left {destitute} by the floods.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助因洪水而一贫如洗的家庭。

e.en: After the scam, he was completely {destitute}.
e.zh: 被骗之后,他变得身无分文。

e.en: The war pushed thousands of families into utter {destitution}.
e.zh: 战争把数千个家庭推向了赤贫的境地。

e.en: He spoke openly about his years of {destitution} after the layoff.
e.zh: 他坦然谈起失业后那几年穷困潦倒的日子。

e.en: One careless click can {destroy} all your unsaved work.
e.zh: 一次不小心的点击就能毁掉你所有未保存的工作。

e.en: The storm threatened to {destroy} the wooden bridge overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雨眼看就要在一夜之间摧毁那座木桥。

e.en: The fire {destroyed} half of the old library last night.
e.zh: 昨晚的大火烧毁了那座老图书馆的一半。

e.en: That one bad review nearly {destroyed} the small restaurant.
e.zh: 那一条差评几乎毁掉了那家小餐馆。

destroyer.t:
n. 驱逐舰
n. 破坏者

e.en: The navy launched a new guided-missile {destroyer} last month.
e.zh: 海军上个月新下水了一艘导弹驱逐舰。

e.en: Critics called the policy a {destroyer} of small businesses.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策是小企业的杀手。

e.en: Heavy rain is slowly {destroying} the mountain road.
e.zh: 持续的大雨正在慢慢毁掉那条山路。

e.en: Stop {destroying} your phone by charging it overnight.
e.zh: 别再整夜充电毁你的手机了。

destroys.t: v. 摧毁（第三人称单数）

e.en: Stress quietly {destroys} both your sleep and your focus.
e.zh: 压力会悄悄地破坏你的睡眠和专注力。

e.en: Sunlight gradually {destroys} the colors of cheap fabric.
e.zh: 阳光会逐渐让劣质布料褪色损坏。

e.en: The engineer pressed the self-{destruct} button as a last resort.
e.zh: 工程师万不得已按下了自毁按钮。

e.en: Old hard drives often have a built-in {destruct} mechanism for security.
e.zh: 旧硬盘出于安全考虑常设有内置的自毁机制。

e.en: In the new game, almost every wall is {destructible}.
e.zh: 在这款新游戏里,几乎每一面墙都能被打破。

e.en: The packaging looks tough but is surprisingly {destructible}.
e.zh: 那包装看着结实,其实很容易被破坏。

e.en: The earthquake caused widespread {destruction} across the coastal town.
e.zh: 地震在沿海小镇造成了大面积的破坏。

e.en: Deforestation is leading to the {destruction} of countless habitats.
e.zh: 森林砍伐正在毁掉无数生物的栖息地。

e.en: The museum documents the many {destructions} the city has survived.
e.zh: 博物馆记录了这座城市经历过的多次毁灭。

e.en: Historians compared the {destructions} caused by both world wars.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了两次世界大战造成的破坏。

destructive.t: adj. 破坏性的、毁灭性的

e.en: Constant criticism can be deeply {destructive} to a relationship.
e.zh: 不断的指责会对一段感情造成极大的伤害。

e.en: The hurricane was the most {destructive} storm in a decade.
e.zh: 那场飓风是十年来最具破坏力的风暴。

e.en: He acted {destructively} whenever he felt cornered or ignored.
e.zh: 每当感到被逼或被忽视,他就会做出破坏性的举动。

e.en: The toddler {destructively} pulled every book off the shelf.
e.zh: 那小孩把书架上的书一本本扯下来,搞得一团糟。

e.en: Scientists were stunned by the sheer {destructiveness} of the new weapon.
e.zh: 科学家们对这种新武器的巨大破坏力感到震惊。

e.en: Therapy helped him recognize the {destructiveness} of his old habits.
e.zh: 治疗让他认识到旧习惯的破坏性。

destructor.t:
n. 析构函数（编程）
n. 焚化炉

e.en: In C++, the class {destructor} runs when the object goes out of scope.
e.zh: 在 C++ 中,对象离开作用域时会调用类的析构函数。

e.en: Forgetting to define a {destructor} can lead to memory leaks.
e.zh: 忘记定义析构函数可能会导致内存泄漏。

e.en: Many old grammar rules have fallen into {desuetude} online.
e.zh: 许多旧的语法规则在网络上已经无人使用。

e.en: The law remained on the books but had drifted into {desuetude}.
e.zh: 那条法律虽未废除,却早已名存实亡。

e.en: The plant installed a new {desulphurisation} system to cut emissions.
e.zh: 该工厂安装了新的脱硫系统以减少排放。

e.en: Flue gas {desulphurisation} is now standard at most coal stations.
e.zh: 烟气脱硫已成为大多数燃煤电厂的标配。

e.en: He flipped {desultorily} through the magazine while waiting.
e.zh: 等候时他漫不经心地翻着杂志。

e.en: They chatted {desultorily} about the weather and old friends.
e.zh: 他们有一搭没一搭地聊着天气和老朋友。

e.en: The meeting ended after a {desultory} discussion about budgets.
e.zh: 会议在一场漫无边际的预算讨论后散场。

e.en: His {desultory} reading habits made it hard to finish any book.
e.zh: 他东翻西看的阅读习惯让他很难读完一本书。

e.en: In the script, {det} is short for detective in every scene heading.
e.zh: 在剧本里,每个场景标题中的 det 都是 detective 的缩写。

e.en: The form just had a blank labeled {det} with no explanation.
e.zh: 那张表格上只有一个标着 det 的空格,没有任何说明。

e.en: Gently {detach} the cable before moving the monitor.
e.zh: 在移动显示器之前,请轻轻拔下电缆。

e.en: She tried to {detach} herself emotionally from the project.
e.zh: 她试着让自己在情感上抽离出这个项目。

detachable.t: adj. 可拆卸的、可分离的

e.en: This laptop has a fully {detachable} keyboard for tablet mode.
e.zh: 这款笔记本有可拆卸键盘,能切换到平板模式。

e.en: The jacket comes with a {detachable} hood for rainy days.
e.zh: 这件外套配有可拆卸的帽子,方便下雨天使用。

detached.t:
adj. 分离的、独立的
adj. 超然的、冷静的

e.en: He gave a cool, {detached} answer that surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他给出了一个冷静而疏离的回答,让大家都很意外。

e.en: They bought a small {detached} house on the edge of town.
e.zh: 他们在城边买了一栋小独栋房屋。

e.en: The screen easily {detaches} from the base with one click.
e.zh: 屏幕只需一按就能从底座上拆下。

e.en: She {detaches} herself from drama at work to stay sane.
e.zh: 她让自己远离工作中的是非,以保持理智。

detaching.t: v. 分离；拆卸（现在分词）

e.en: Be careful when {detaching} the battery from the drone.
e.zh: 从无人机上拆电池时要小心。

e.en: {Detaching} from social media for a week really cleared my head.
e.zh: 远离社交媒体一周真的让我的脑子清静了不少。

detachment.t:
n. 超然；冷漠
n. 分遣队

e.en: She watched the argument with cool {detachment}.
e.zh: 她以一种冷静的疏离感看着那场争吵。

e.en: A small {detachment} of soldiers was sent to guard the bridge.
e.zh: 一小队士兵被派去守卫那座桥。

e.en: Several {detachments} were deployed along the disputed border.
e.zh: 数支小分队被部署在争议边境一带。

e.en: The film explores the emotional {detachments} of modern life.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了现代生活中的种种情感疏离。

detail.t:
n. 细节
v. 详述

e.en: Could you explain that last point in more {detail}?
e.zh: 你能把最后那一点讲得更详细一些吗?

e.en: The artist captures every {detail} of the city skyline.
e.zh: 那位艺术家把城市天际线的每个细节都画了出来。

e.en: She sent a {detailed} report on the bug and how to reproduce it.
e.zh: 她发来了一份详细的报告,说明了那个 bug 和复现步骤。

e.en: The map is surprisingly {detailed} for such a small app.
e.zh: 对一个这么小的应用来说,这张地图细致得出乎意料。

detailing.t:
n. 细节装饰
v. 详述（现在分词）

e.en: He sent a long email {detailing} every issue he found.
e.zh: 他发来一封长邮件,详细列出了他发现的每个问题。

e.en: Car {detailing} can make an old vehicle look almost new.
e.zh: 汽车精洗美容能让一辆旧车看起来几乎像新的一样。

e.en: Please double-check your shipping {details} before checkout.
e.zh: 结账前请再次确认你的收货信息。

e.en: The contract {details} every fee and cancellation rule clearly.
e.zh: 合同清楚地写明了每一项费用和取消规则。

e.en: Police can {detain} a suspect for up to 24 hours without charge.
e.zh: 警方可以在不起诉的情况下拘留嫌疑人最多 24 小时。

e.en: I won't {detain} you any longer—thanks for your time.
e.zh: 我就不再耽误你了,谢谢你抽时间。

e.en: Two passengers were briefly {detained} at the airport for questioning.
e.zh: 两名乘客在机场被短暂扣留接受询问。

e.en: Sorry I'm late—I got {detained} by a meeting that ran over.
e.zh: 抱歉我迟到了,被一个超时的会议耽搁了。

e.en: Lawyers were finally allowed to meet with the {detainee}.
e.zh: 律师终于获准与那名被拘留者会面。

e.en: The report demanded better living conditions for every {detainee}.
e.zh: 报告要求改善每一名被拘留者的居住条件。

detaining.t: v. 拘留；扣押（现在分词）

e.en: Officers are accused of {detaining} protesters without proper cause.
e.zh: 警员被指控在没有正当理由的情况下拘留抗议者。

e.en: I'm sorry for {detaining} you with such a long story.
e.zh: 抱歉用这么长的故事耽误了你的时间。

e.en: His {detainment} at the border lasted nearly six hours.
e.zh: 他在边境被扣留了将近六个小时。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the legality of her client's {detainment}.
e.zh: 律师质疑当事人遭到拘留的合法性。

detains.t: v. 拘留（第三人称单数）

e.en: The customs officer often {detains} travelers with unusual luggage.
e.zh: 那位海关官员经常会扣下行李异常的旅客。

e.en: A long phone call sometimes {detains} him at the office.
e.zh: 一通长长的电话有时会把他困在办公室里。

e.en: Modern phones can {detect} a fall and call emergency services.
e.zh: 现代手机能检测到摔倒并自动拨打急救电话。

e.en: It's hard to {detect} sarcasm in a text message.
e.zh: 在短信里很难察觉到讽刺的语气。

e.en: Stealth coatings reduce the {detectability} of the aircraft on radar.
e.zh: 隐身涂层降低了这架飞机在雷达上的可探测性。

e.en: Researchers are working to improve the {detectability} of early tumors.
e.zh: 研究人员正在努力提高早期肿瘤的可检出率。

e.en: The virus is barely {detectable} in the first few days of infection.
e.zh: 病毒在感染初期几乎检测不出来。

e.en: There was a {detectable} hint of nervousness in her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音里带着一丝可以察觉的紧张。

e.en: The antivirus {detected} a suspicious file in your downloads folder.
e.zh: 杀毒软件在你的下载文件夹里检测到了一个可疑文件。

e.en: She {detected} a slight accent in his English right away.
e.zh: 她一下就听出他英语里带着一点口音。

e.en: This sensor is great at {detecting} even tiny changes in temperature.
e.zh: 这个传感器能很好地探测到极小的温度变化。

e.en: The model is good at {detecting} spam in noisy comment threads.
e.zh: 该模型很擅长在杂乱的评论中识别出垃圾信息。

e.en: Early {detection} of cancer dramatically improves survival rates.
e.zh: 早期发现癌症能显著提高生存率。

e.en: The app uses face {detection} to unlock the screen.
e.zh: 这款应用通过人脸识别来解锁屏幕。

e.en: The system logged hundreds of malware {detections} in one day.
e.zh: 系统在一天内记录了数百次恶意软件检测。

e.en: Recent {detections} of the rare bird have excited local birdwatchers.
e.zh: 最近发现这种稀有鸟类让当地观鸟者非常兴奋。

detective.t:
n. 侦探
adj. 侦探的

e.en: The {detective} questioned every guest who attended the party.
e.zh: 那位侦探询问了参加聚会的每一位客人。

e.en: She loves curling up with a good {detective} novel on weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢周末窝在沙发上看一本好侦探小说。

e.en: Two {detectives} arrived at the scene within ten minutes.
e.zh: 两名侦探在十分钟内赶到了现场。

e.en: The show follows a team of {detectives} solving cold cases.
e.zh: 这部剧讲的是一队侦探侦破悬案的故事。

e.en: Please test your smoke {detector} at least once a month.
e.zh: 请每月至少测试一次你的烟雾报警器。

e.en: The metal {detector} beeped loudly at the airport gate.
e.zh: 金属探测器在机场安检口大声响了起来。

detects.t: v. 检测（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {detects} fake news and flags suspicious sources.
e.zh: 这款应用能识别假新闻并标记可疑来源。

e.en: The watch {detects} an irregular heartbeat and warns the user.
e.zh: 这款手表能检测到心跳异常并提醒用户。

e.en: The dial clicks into a {detent} at each preset position.
e.zh: 旋钮在每个预设位置都会咔哒一声卡入定位槽。

e.en: A small spring-loaded {detent} keeps the lever in place.
e.zh: 一个小弹簧定位销让操纵杆保持在原位。

e.en: The two countries entered a fragile {detente} after years of tension.
e.zh: 两国在多年紧张关系后进入了脆弱的缓和期。

e.en: A brief {detente} between the rival teams ended after the trade.
e.zh: 两支死对头球队之间短暂的缓和在那次交易后告吹。

detention.t:
n. 拘留
n. 课后留校

e.en: He got a week of after-school {detention} for skipping class.
e.zh: 他因为逃课被罚了一周的课后留校。

e.en: Human rights groups criticized the long {detention} of asylum seekers.
e.zh: 人权组织批评了对寻求庇护者的长期拘留。

e.en: He got two {detentions} this week for skipping class.
e.zh: 他这周因为逃课被留堂了两次。

e.en: The report criticized prolonged {detentions} without trial.
e.zh: 该报告批评了未经审判的长期拘留。

e.en: Higher fines won't {deter} reckless drivers.
e.zh: 提高罚款并不能阻止鲁莽驾驶者。

e.en: Bad weather didn't {deter} fans from camping outside.
e.zh: 恶劣天气也没能阻挡粉丝在外面露营。

e.en: Pour a capful of {detergent} into the washing machine.
e.zh: 往洗衣机里倒一盖洗衣液。

e.en: This {detergent} works well on grease stains.
e.zh: 这种洗涤剂对油渍很有效。

e.en: His health began to {deteriorate} after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他的健康状况开始恶化。

e.en: Roads quickly {deteriorate} without regular maintenance.
e.zh: 道路如果不定期维护会很快损坏。

e.en: Relations between the two countries have {deteriorated} sharply.
e.zh: 两国关系急剧恶化。

e.en: The old photos {deteriorated} after years in the attic.
e.zh: 那些旧照片在阁楼放了多年后已经损坏。

deteriorates.t: v. 恶化（第三人称单数）

e.en: Fresh fish quickly {deteriorates} if left unrefrigerated.
e.zh: 鲜鱼不冷藏的话很快就会变质。

e.en: Her eyesight {deteriorates} a bit each year.
e.zh: 她的视力每年都在下降一点。

e.en: Doctors are worried about her {deteriorating} condition.
e.zh: 医生们担心她日益恶化的病情。

e.en: The bridge is {deteriorating} faster than engineers predicted.
e.zh: 这座桥的损坏速度比工程师预计的还要快。

e.en: The painting shows visible signs of {deterioration}.
e.zh: 这幅画上有明显的劣化痕迹。

e.en: Doctors noted a sudden {deterioration} in his memory.
e.zh: 医生注意到他的记忆力突然衰退。

e.en: The exact age of the fossil is not easily {determinable}.
e.zh: 这块化石的确切年龄不太容易确定。

e.en: The damages must be {determinable} from the contract terms.
e.zh: 损害赔偿必须能够根据合同条款来确定。

e.en: The theory assumes complete {determinacy} of physical events.
e.zh: 该理论假设物理事件具有完全的确定性。

e.en: Critics question the {determinacy} of legal rules in hard cases.
e.zh: 批评者质疑法律规则在疑难案件中的确定性。

determinant.t:
n. 决定因素
n. （数学）行列式

e.en: Education is a key {determinant} of future income.
e.zh: 教育是未来收入的一个关键决定因素。

e.en: Diet is the main {determinant} of long-term health.
e.zh: 饮食是长期健康的主要决定因素。

e.en: The contract has a {determinate} end date next March.
e.zh: 这份合同有一个明确的结束日期,在明年三月。

e.en: Tomato varieties are either {determinate} or vining.
e.zh: 番茄品种要么是有限生长型,要么是蔓生型。

determination.t:
n. 决心
n. 测定；确定

e.en: She finished the marathon through sheer {determination}.
e.zh: 她凭着坚定的决心跑完了马拉松。

e.en: The court awaits a final {determination} of the facts.
e.zh: 法庭等待对事实做出最终判定。

e.en: Price is often the {determinative} factor for shoppers.
e.zh: 价格往往是购物者的决定性因素。

e.en: His testimony proved {determinative} in the trial.
e.zh: 他的证词在审判中起到了决定作用。

e.en: Scientists are trying to {determine} the cause of the outbreak.
e.zh: 科学家们正在试图确定这次疫情的原因。

e.en: Your test score will {determine} your final grade.
e.zh: 你的考试成绩将决定你的最终等级。

determined.t:
adj. 坚定的
v. 确定（过去式）

e.en: She's {determined} to learn Japanese before her trip.
e.zh: 她下定决心要在旅行前学好日语。

e.en: Investigators {determined} that the fire was accidental.
e.zh: 调查人员认定这场火灾是意外事故。

e.en: He {determinedly} pursued his dream of becoming a pilot.
e.zh: 他坚定地追求成为飞行员的梦想。

e.en: She walked {determinedly} into the manager's office.
e.zh: 她坚定地走进经理办公室。

e.en: The word "the" is the most common English {determiner}.
e.zh: "the" 是英语中最常见的限定词。

e.en: Skill is a major {determiner} of success in sports.
e.zh: 技术是运动成功的一个主要决定因素。

e.en: Articles and possessives are types of {determiners}.
e.zh: 冠词和物主代词都属于限定词。

e.en: Genetics and lifestyle are key {determiners} of longevity.
e.zh: 基因和生活方式是寿命的关键决定因素。

determines.t: v. 决定（第三人称单数）

e.en: Hard work largely {determines} how far you go.
e.zh: 努力在很大程度上决定你能走多远。

e.en: The judge {determines} whether evidence is admissible.
e.zh: 法官来判定证据是否可被采纳。

e.en: Cost was the {determining} factor in our choice.
e.zh: 成本是我们做出选择的决定因素。

e.en: They spent hours {determining} the best route.
e.zh: 他们花了几个小时来确定最佳路线。

e.en: Strict {determinism} leaves no room for free will.
e.zh: 严格的决定论不给自由意志留任何余地。

e.en: Many philosophers reject genetic {determinism}.
e.zh: 许多哲学家反对基因决定论。

dev.t: n. 开发；开发者（develop/developer 的缩写）

e.en: The {dev} team pushed a hotfix late last night.
e.zh: 开发团队昨晚很晚推送了一个热修复。

e.en: Test the feature in {dev} before deploying to production.
e.zh: 上线之前先在开发环境测试这个功能。

deva.t: n. 提婆；（印度教、佛教中的）天神

e.en: In Hindu mythology, a {deva} is a celestial being.
e.zh: 在印度教神话中,提婆是一种天界的神灵。

e.en: The temple painting depicts a {deva} bringing offerings.
e.zh: 寺庙的画作描绘了一位天神带来供品。

devaluation.t: n. 货币贬值；价值降低

e.en: The currency {devaluation} made imported goods more expensive.
e.zh: 货币贬值让进口商品变得更贵。

e.en: Investors worry about a sudden {devaluation} of the peso.
e.zh: 投资者担心比索会突然贬值。

devalue.t: v. 使贬值；贬低（价值或重要性）

e.en: Constant criticism can {devalue} an employee's confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评会贬损员工的自信心。

e.en: The government may {devalue} the currency to boost exports.
e.zh: 政府可能会让货币贬值以促进出口。

devalued.t:
v. devalue 的过去式
adj. 贬值的

e.en: The peso has {devalued} sharply against the dollar this year.
e.zh: 今年比索对美元大幅贬值。

e.en: She felt {devalued} when her ideas were ignored in meetings.
e.zh: 她的想法在会上被忽视,让她感到自己不被重视。

devaluing.t: v. devalue 的现在分词；使贬值

e.en: Inflation is steadily {devaluing} household savings.
e.zh: 通货膨胀正在不断使家庭存款贬值。

e.en: Stop {devaluing} your own work just to please critics.
e.zh: 不要为了讨好批评者而贬低自己的成果。

devastate.t: v. 彻底破坏；使极度震惊、悲痛

e.en: A single typhoon can {devastate} entire coastal villages.
e.zh: 一场台风就能摧毁整个沿海村庄。

e.en: Losing the championship would {devastate} the whole team.
e.zh: 输掉冠军会让整个团队心碎。

devastated.t:
adj. 极度震惊、心碎的
v. 摧毁（过去式）

e.en: She was {devastated} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 她听到这个消息时心碎欲裂。

e.en: The earthquake {devastated} several historic neighborhoods.
e.zh: 地震摧毁了好几个历史悠久的街区。

devastates.t: v. devastate 的第三人称单数

e.en: Each wildfire season {devastates} thousands of acres of forest.
e.zh: 每个野火季都会毁掉数千英亩森林。

e.en: A bad review {devastates} him more than it should.
e.zh: 一条差评对他打击之大,超出了正常程度。

devastating.t: adj. 毁灭性的；令人震惊的

e.en: The flood had a {devastating} impact on local farmers.
e.zh: 洪水对当地农民造成了毁灭性打击。

e.en: Her resignation was {devastating} news for the team.
e.zh: 她辞职的消息对团队来说是个沉重打击。

devastatingly.t: adv. 毁灭性地；令人震惊地

e.en: The argument was {devastatingly} effective and ended the debate.
e.zh: 那个论点极具杀伤力,直接结束了辩论。

e.en: She looked {devastatingly} beautiful in the evening gown.
e.zh: 她穿着晚礼服美得惊人。

e.en: Drone footage revealed the full {devastation} after the hurricane.
e.zh: 无人机画面展现了飓风过后的全面破坏。

e.en: The war left a trail of {devastation} across the region.
e.zh: 战争在整个地区留下了一片狼藉。

develop.t: v. 开发、研发；发展、培养

e.en: Our team is working hard to {develop} a new mobile app.
e.zh: 我们团队正在努力开发一款新的手机应用。

e.en: Children {develop} language skills very quickly.
e.zh: 孩子们能很快发展出语言能力。

developable.t: adj. 可开发的；可发展的

e.en: The city zoned the riverside as {developable} land.
e.zh: 市政府将河边地带划为可开发用地。

e.en: Her rough sketch contains a {developable} idea worth exploring.
e.zh: 她那张草图里有一个值得发展的想法。

developed.t:
adj. 发达的；成熟的
v. develop 的过去式

e.en: Engineers {developed} a faster algorithm for the search engine.
e.zh: 工程师为搜索引擎开发了一种更快的算法。

e.en: She has {developed} a strong interest in classical music.
e.zh: 她对古典音乐产生了浓厚的兴趣。

developer.t: n. 开发者；（房地产）开发商

e.en: The {developer} fixed the bug within an hour.
e.zh: 开发者在一小时内修复了这个 bug。

e.en: A real estate {developer} bought the entire block.
e.zh: 一家房地产开发商买下了整个街区。

developing.t:
adj. 发展中的
v. 开发、发展（现在分词）

e.en: She is {developing} a new feature for the dashboard.
e.zh: 她正在为仪表盘开发一个新功能。

e.en: Aid programs often focus on {developing} countries.
e.zh: 援助项目往往聚焦于发展中国家。

e.en: The app is still in early {development} and may have bugs.
e.zh: 这款应用仍处于早期开发阶段,可能有 bug。

e.en: Reading aloud helps a child's language {development}.
e.zh: 朗读有助于孩子的语言发展。

e.en: Pediatricians track children's {developmental} milestones carefully.
e.zh: 儿科医生会仔细追踪孩子的发育里程碑。

e.en: The toy is designed to support early {developmental} skills.
e.zh: 这款玩具旨在帮助孩子早期发展各项技能。

developmentally.t: adv. 在发展上；发育上地

e.en: The activities are {developmentally} appropriate for toddlers.
e.zh: 这些活动在发育阶段上很适合幼儿。

e.en: He is {developmentally} ahead of most kids his age.
e.zh: 他的发育水平比同龄大多数孩子要超前。

developments.t: n. 新进展、新动态（development 的复数）

e.en: Stay tuned for further {developments} in the investigation.
e.zh: 请继续关注本次调查的最新进展。

e.en: New {developments} in AI are changing how we work.
e.zh: 人工智能领域的新进展正在改变我们的工作方式。

develops.t: v. develop 的第三人称单数

e.en: The startup {develops} tools for remote design teams.
e.zh: 这家初创公司为远程设计团队开发工具。

e.en: A child {develops} empathy through everyday interactions.
e.zh: 孩子通过日常互动逐渐培养出同理心。

devi.t: n. 提毗；（印度教中的）女神

e.en: Worshippers offered flowers to the goddess {Devi} at dawn.
e.zh: 信徒们在黎明时向女神提毗献上鲜花。

e.en: The temple is dedicated to {Devi}, the divine mother.
e.zh: 这座寺庙供奉的是神圣母亲提毗女神。

e.en: Sociologists study {deviance} from accepted social norms.
e.zh: 社会学家研究偏离被广泛接受的社会规范的行为。

e.en: His mild {deviance} from the rules surprised his coworkers.
e.zh: 他对规则的小小越界让同事们感到意外。

e.en: The novel explores themes of crime and {deviancy}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了犯罪与越轨行为的主题。

e.en: He saw any creativity as a kind of {deviancy}.
e.zh: 他把任何创造性都视为一种越轨行为。

deviant.t:
adj. 偏离常规的
n. 行为异常者

e.en: The study examined {deviant} behavior among teenagers.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了青少年中的越轨行为。

e.en: His ideas were once considered {deviant} but are now mainstream.
e.zh: 他的观点曾被视为离经叛道,如今却成了主流。

e.en: He acted {deviantly} just to provoke a reaction online.
e.zh: 他在网上故意做出格的举动只为博取关注。

e.en: The character behaves {deviantly} throughout the entire novel.
e.zh: 这个角色在整部小说中行为都偏离常规。

e.en: The system flagged a few statistical {deviants} in the dataset.
e.zh: 系统在数据集中标出了几个统计上的异常值。

e.en: Society has long been quick to label nonconformists as {deviants}.
e.zh: 社会长期以来很容易把不合群的人贴上越轨者的标签。

deviate.t: v. 偏离（正轨、话题、计划）

e.en: Don't {deviate} from the recipe if you want it to taste right.
e.zh: 想要味道正宗就别偏离食谱。

e.en: The plane had to {deviate} from its course due to a storm.
e.zh: 由于风暴，飞机不得不偏离航线。

deviated.t: v. deviate 的过去式；已偏离

e.en: He {deviated} from the script and improvised a joke.
e.zh: 他偏离了剧本，即兴讲了个笑话。

e.en: The study {deviated} significantly from the original plan.
e.zh: 这项研究明显偏离了最初的计划。

e.en: Any {deviation} from protocol must be reported immediately.
e.zh: 任何偏离规程的行为都必须立即上报。

e.en: The standard {deviation} measures how spread out the data is.
e.zh: 标准差用来衡量数据的离散程度。

e.en: You can sign in on up to five {device} accounts at once.
e.zh: 你最多可以同时在五个设备账号上登录。

e.en: This little {device} measures your heart rate accurately.
e.zh: 这个小装置可以精确测量你的心率。

e.en: Most smart {devices} now connect to your phone via Bluetooth.
e.zh: 如今大多数智能设备都通过蓝牙连接手机。

e.en: The app syncs seamlessly across all your {devices}.
e.zh: 这款应用可以在你所有设备上无缝同步。

e.en: The {devil} is in the details when it comes to contracts.
e.zh: 说到合同，魔鬼藏在细节里。

e.en: That clever little {devil} figured out the puzzle in seconds.
e.zh: 那个机灵鬼几秒钟就解开了谜题。

deviled.t: adj. 加辣酱调味的（如 deviled egg）

e.en: She brought a tray of {deviled} eggs to the picnic.
e.zh: 她带了一盘魔鬼蛋去野餐。

e.en: My grandma's {deviled} ham sandwiches were legendary.
e.zh: 我奶奶做的香辣火腿三明治堪称一绝。

e.en: He gave her a {devilish} grin before pressing the button.
e.zh: 他露出一个调皮的坏笑，然后按下了按钮。

e.en: That's a {devilish} puzzle—I've been stuck for hours.
e.zh: 这道题真是刁钻，我已经卡了好几个小时。

e.en: The dessert was {devilishly} rich and impossible to resist.
e.zh: 这甜点浓郁得让人无法抗拒。

e.en: She smiled {devilishly} as she revealed the surprise.
e.zh: 她调皮地笑着，揭晓了那个惊喜。

e.en: The kids were up to some {devilment} in the backyard.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院捣鼓着什么调皮事。

e.en: There's always a hint of {devilment} in his eyes.
e.zh: 他眼里总带着一丝顽皮。

e.en: The Tasmanian {devils} are nocturnal carnivores native to Australia.
e.zh: 袋獾是澳大利亚本土的夜行肉食动物。

e.en: Those little {devils} ate all the cookies before dinner.
e.zh: 那几个小坏蛋在晚饭前把饼干都吃光了。

devious.t: adj. 诡计多端的；迂回的

e.en: He came up with a {devious} plan to win the game.
e.zh: 他想出了一个狡猾的计划来赢得比赛。

e.en: Her {devious} smile suggested she was hiding something.
e.zh: 她诡谲的笑容暗示她在隐瞒什么。

e.en: He {deviously} rerouted the funds through a shell company.
e.zh: 他狡猾地通过一家空壳公司转移了资金。

e.en: She {deviously} changed the topic whenever money came up.
e.zh: 每次提到钱，她就狡黠地把话题岔开。

e.en: His {deviousness} eventually cost him the trust of his team.
e.zh: 他的奸诈最终让他失去了团队的信任。

e.en: There's a hint of {deviousness} in the villain's every line.
e.zh: 反派的每句台词里都透着一股狡诈。

devise.t: v. 设计、想出（方案、计划）

e.en: Engineers had to {devise} a clever fix for the bug.
e.zh: 工程师不得不想出一个巧妙的办法来修复这个bug。

e.en: Let's {devise} a better strategy before the meeting tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们在明天开会前想出一个更好的策略吧。

devised.t: v. devise 的过去式；想出

e.en: She {devised} a clever way to organize all the files.
e.zh: 她想出了一个巧妙的方法来整理所有文件。

e.en: The team {devised} a new algorithm to speed up search.
e.zh: 团队设计了一种新算法来加快搜索速度。

devises.t: v. devise 的第三人称单数

e.en: He always {devises} creative workarounds when tools fail.
e.zh: 工具出问题时，他总能想出有创意的变通办法。

e.en: The startup {devises} new payment solutions for small businesses.
e.zh: 这家初创公司为小企业设计新的支付方案。

devising.t: v. devise 的现在分词；筹划

e.en: They are {devising} a strategy to enter the Asian market.
e.zh: 他们正在制定进军亚洲市场的策略。

e.en: She spent the weekend {devising} puzzles for the escape room.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在为密室设计谜题。

devizes.t: n. 迪韦齐斯（英国一城镇名）

e.en: We stopped in {Devizes} for lunch on our way to Bath.
e.zh: 去巴斯的路上，我们在德维齐斯停下来吃了午饭。

e.en: {Devizes} is a quiet market town in Wiltshire, England.
e.zh: 德维齐斯是英格兰威尔特郡一座安静的集镇。

e.en: As a {determinist}, he believes every event is preordained.
e.zh: 作为一个决定论者,他相信一切都是注定的。

e.en: She took a {determinist} view of human behavior.
e.zh: 她对人类行为持决定论的观点。

deterministic.t: adj. 确定性的；决定论的

e.en: The algorithm is fully {deterministic} and reproducible.
e.zh: 这个算法是完全确定性的,可以复现。

e.en: Classical physics offers a {deterministic} view of the universe.
e.zh: 经典物理学提供了一种决定论式的宇宙观。

e.en: Nuclear {deterrence} shaped Cold War strategy.
e.zh: 核威慑塑造了冷战时期的战略。

e.en: Harsh sentences are meant to provide {deterrence}.
e.zh: 严厉的判决是为了起到威慑作用。

deterrent.t:
n. 威慑物
adj. 威慑的

e.en: A loud alarm is an effective burglar {deterrent}.
e.zh: 响亮的警报是一种有效的防盗手段。

e.en: High taxes act as a {deterrent} to smoking.
e.zh: 高额税收对吸烟起到威慑作用。

e.en: Cameras and lights are common crime {deterrents}.
e.zh: 摄像头和照明是常见的犯罪威慑手段。

e.en: Fines alone are weak {deterrents} for big companies.
e.zh: 对大公司来说,光靠罚款威慑力很弱。

e.en: I {detest} doing laundry on weekends.
e.zh: 我特别讨厌在周末洗衣服。

e.en: They {detest} dishonesty above all else.
e.zh: 他们最痛恨的就是不诚实。

detestable.t: adj. 可憎的；令人讨厌的

e.en: Bullying is a {detestable} habit.
e.zh: 欺凌是一种令人憎恶的行为。

e.en: He found the politician's lies utterly {detestable}.
e.zh: 他觉得那位政客的谎言极其可憎。

e.en: She made no secret of her {detestation} of cruelty.
e.zh: 她毫不掩饰对残忍行为的痛恨。

e.en: His {detestation} for the regime was well known.
e.zh: 他对那个政权的憎恶是众所周知的。

e.en: As a kid, I {detested} broccoli with a passion.
e.zh: 小时候我特别讨厌西兰花。

e.en: The widely {detested} law was finally repealed.
e.zh: 那条广受厌恶的法律终于被废除了。

e.en: He spent the meeting silently {detesting} every word spoken.
e.zh: 开会时他默默地厌恶着每一句话。

e.en: While {detesting} crowds, she still went to the concert.
e.zh: 尽管讨厌人多,她还是去了那场演唱会。

detests.t: v. 憎恶（第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat {detests} water more than anything.
e.zh: 我家猫最讨厌的就是水。

e.en: She {detests} being interrupted mid-sentence.
e.zh: 她最讨厌话说到一半被人打断。

e.en: No challenger has managed to {dethrone} the champion.
e.zh: 还没有挑战者能把冠军拉下王座。

e.en: New apps may soon {dethrone} the market leader.
e.zh: 新的应用可能很快会取代市场领头羊。

e.en: The king was {dethroned} after the revolution.
e.zh: 国王在革命之后被废黜了。

e.en: Streaming services have {dethroned} traditional cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务已经把传统有线电视拉下了王座。

e.en: Engineers will {detonate} the old building tomorrow.
e.zh: 工程师明天会爆破这栋旧楼。

e.en: The bomb failed to {detonate} on impact.
e.zh: 那枚炸弹撞击时没能引爆。

e.en: Crews are {detonating} unexploded shells from the war.
e.zh: 工作人员正在引爆战争遗留的未爆炮弹。

e.en: A {detonating} fuse is used in controlled demolitions.
e.zh: 导爆索用于受控爆破中。

e.en: The {detonation} shattered windows several blocks away.
e.zh: 爆炸震碎了几个街区外的窗户。

e.en: Engineers timed the {detonation} to the millisecond.
e.zh: 工程师把爆炸时间精确控制到毫秒。

e.en: Police safely removed the {detonator} from the device.
e.zh: 警方安全地从装置上拆下了雷管。

e.en: He pressed the {detonator} from a safe distance.
e.zh: 他在安全距离外按下了引爆器。

detour.t:
n. 绕行路
v. 绕道而行

e.en: We took a long {detour} around the construction.
e.zh: 我们绕了很远的路避开施工区。

e.en: Traffic forced us to {detour} through downtown.
e.zh: 路况迫使我们绕道穿过市中心。

e.en: She's doing a one-week digital {detox} from social media.
e.zh: 她正在进行为期一周的社交媒体数字戒断。

e.en: He checked into a clinic to {detox} from alcohol.
e.zh: 他住进诊所进行酒精戒断治疗。

e.en: The liver plays a key role in {detoxification}.
e.zh: 肝脏在排毒中起着关键作用。

e.en: He completed a 30-day {detoxification} program.
e.zh: 他完成了为期30天的戒毒疗程。

e.en: The brand markets the drink as a natural {detoxifier}.
e.zh: 该品牌把这款饮料宣传为天然排毒饮品。

e.en: Doctors warn that no pill is a true {detoxifier}.
e.zh: 医生警告说没有任何药片是真正的排毒剂。

e.en: Drinking water helps the body {detoxify} naturally.
e.zh: 喝水有助于身体自然排毒。

e.en: It can take weeks to fully {detoxify} after long use.
e.zh: 长期使用后可能需要数周才能完全戒断。

e.en: She swears by {detoxifying} green smoothies in the morning.
e.zh: 她对早晨的排毒蔬果汁深信不疑。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {detoxifying} long-term patients.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门为长期患者做戒断治疗。

e.en: A few typos don't really {detract} from the essay.
e.zh: 几个错别字其实并不会影响这篇文章的质量。

e.en: Don't let small flaws {detract} from your achievement.
e.zh: 别让小瑕疵削弱你的成就感。

e.en: The loud music {detracted} from the romantic dinner.
e.zh: 吵闹的音乐让浪漫晚餐大打折扣。

e.en: Nothing {detracted} from the joy of seeing her again.
e.zh: 再次见到她的喜悦丝毫未减。

e.en: Without {detracting} from his talent, the script was weak.
e.zh: 无意贬低他的才华,但剧本确实很弱。

e.en: Cheap props were {detracting} from an otherwise great show.
e.zh: 廉价的道具让本来很棒的演出大打折扣。

e.en: Her speech contained no {detraction} from her opponent.
e.zh: 她的演讲中没有任何对对手的诋毁。

e.en: Constant {detraction} of colleagues hurts team morale.
e.zh: 不断贬低同事会损害团队士气。

e.en: Every popular leader has at least one loud {detractor}.
e.zh: 每位受欢迎的领导人至少都有一个高声诋毁者。

e.en: He's a longtime {detractor} of the new policy.
e.zh: 他长期以来都是这项新政策的批评者。

detracts.t: v. 减损（第三人称单数）

e.en: The loud music {detracts} from the otherwise calm atmosphere.
e.zh: 喧闹的音乐破坏了原本平静的氛围。

e.en: One typo hardly {detracts} from the quality of her essay.
e.zh: 一个小错字几乎不影响她文章的质量。

e.en: He works late every night to the {detriment} of his health.
e.zh: 他每晚加班,损害了自己的健康。

e.en: Skipping breakfast can be a real {detriment} to focus.
e.zh: 不吃早餐确实会影响注意力。

e.en: Too much screen time is {detrimental} to children's eyesight.
e.zh: 过多使用屏幕对儿童视力有害。

e.en: The new policy proved {detrimental} to small businesses.
e.zh: 新政策对小企业造成了不利影响。

e.en: Stress can {detrimentally} affect both sleep and mood.
e.zh: 压力会对睡眠和情绪造成负面影响。

e.en: The drought {detrimentally} impacted this year's harvest.
e.zh: 干旱对今年的收成造成了不利影响。

e.en: The report listed several {detriments} of long commutes.
e.zh: 报告列出了长途通勤的几项弊端。

e.en: Air pollution remains one of the major {detriments} to public health.
e.zh: 空气污染仍是公共健康的主要危害之一。

e.en: Geologists studied the {detrital} sediment along the riverbed.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了河床沿岸的碎屑沉积物。

e.en: The cliff is composed mostly of {detrital} rock fragments.
e.zh: 这座悬崖主要由碎屑岩石组成。

e.en: Leaves and twigs formed a layer of {detritus} on the forest floor.
e.zh: 树叶和小树枝在林地上形成了一层碎屑。

e.en: After the party, the kitchen was buried in {detritus}.
e.zh: 派对结束后,厨房里堆满了杂物残渣。

e.en: Different {detrituses} accumulate in distinct layers of the seabed.
e.zh: 不同种类的碎屑物在海床的不同层中堆积。

e.en: The lab compared {detrituses} from several mountain streams.
e.zh: 实验室比较了几条山间溪流中的碎屑样本。

e.en: She moved to {Detroit} to work in the auto industry.
e.zh: 她搬到底特律从事汽车行业工作。

e.en: {Detroit} is famous for its Motown music heritage.
e.zh: 底特律以其摩城音乐遗产闻名。

e.en: Mom always cleaned scrapes with a drop of {Dettol}.
e.zh: 妈妈总是用一滴滴露清洗擦伤。

e.en: He wiped the counter with {Dettol} before cooking.
e.zh: 他做饭前用滴露擦了一下台面。

e.en: The match reached {deuce} in the final game of the set.
e.zh: 这盘的最后一局比赛打成了平分。

e.en: She drew a {deuce} of hearts from the deck.
e.zh: 她从牌堆里抽到一张红心二。

e.en: The film ends with a clumsy {deus} ex machina.
e.zh: 这部电影以一个生硬的天降神兵结尾。

e.en: Latin phrases like {deus} appear often in old church inscriptions.
e.zh: 像 deus 这样的拉丁词常出现在古老的教堂铭文中。

e.en: The pastor cited a verse from {Deut} during the sermon.
e.zh: 牧师在讲道中引用了《申命记》里的一节经文。

e.en: My Bible margin notes use {Deut} as shorthand for Deuteronomy.
e.zh: 我圣经页边的注释用 Deut 作为《申命记》的缩写。

e.en: {Deuterium} is a heavy isotope of hydrogen used in nuclear research.
e.zh: 氘是用于核研究的氢的重同位素。

e.en: Heavy water contains {deuterium} instead of regular hydrogen.
e.zh: 重水中含有的是氘,而不是普通氢。

e.en: A {deuteron} consists of one proton and one neutron.
e.zh: 氘核由一个质子和一个中子组成。

e.en: Physicists accelerated the {deuteron} to study nuclear reactions.
e.zh: 物理学家加速氘核以研究核反应。

e.en: {Deuteronomy} is the fifth book of the Hebrew Bible.
e.zh: 《申命记》是希伯来圣经的第五卷书。

e.en: The teacher read a passage from {Deuteronomy} aloud.
e.zh: 老师朗读了《申命记》中的一段经文。

e.en: She studied {Deutsch} for two years before moving to Berlin.
e.zh: 她搬到柏林之前学了两年德语。

e.en: The label on the box was printed in {Deutsch}.
e.zh: 盒子上的标签是用德语印的。

e.en: He opened a savings account at {Deutsche} Bank.
e.zh: 他在德意志银行开了一个储蓄账户。

e.en: The {Deutsche} Welle broadcasts news in many languages.
e.zh: 德国之声以多种语言播报新闻。

e.en: He proudly called himself a {Deutscher} born in Munich.
e.zh: 他自豪地称自己是出生在慕尼黑的德国人。

e.en: Every {Deutscher} I met spoke excellent English.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个德国人英语都说得很好。

e.en: They drove across {Deutschland} on the famous autobahn.
e.zh: 他们沿着著名的高速公路穿越了德国。

e.en: {Deutschland} is known for its precision engineering.
e.zh: 德国以精密工程闻名。

e.en: Before the euro, prices were listed in {deutschmark}.
e.zh: 在欧元出现之前,价格都以德国马克标示。

e.en: My grandfather still keeps a few old {deutschmark} notes.
e.zh: 我祖父还留着几张旧的德国马克纸币。

e.en: The dancers performed a graceful pas de {deux}.
e.zh: 舞者表演了一段优雅的双人舞。

e.en: In French, {deux} simply means the number two.
e.zh: 在法语中,deux 就是数字“二”的意思。

e.en: The room was {devoid} of any decoration or warmth.
e.zh: 房间里毫无装饰，也没有一丝温暖。

e.en: His response was {devoid} of emotion, almost robotic.
e.zh: 他的回答毫无感情，几乎像机器人。

devolution.t: n. 权力下放；职责移交

e.en: Scotland gained more powers through {devolution} from London.
e.zh: 苏格兰通过权力下放从伦敦获得了更多自主权。

e.en: The {devolution} of authority let local councils make faster decisions.
e.zh: 权力下放让地方议会能更快地做出决定。

e.en: Talks tend to {devolve} into arguments when people are tired.
e.zh: 人累了的时候，谈话往往会演变成争吵。

e.en: Power should {devolve} to local communities, not stay centralized.
e.zh: 权力应该下放到地方社区，而不是集中在上层。

devolved.t:
adj. 已下放的（权力）
v. devolve 的过去式

e.en: The discussion quickly {devolved} into name-calling on social media.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上，讨论很快就沦为相互谩骂。

e.en: Health policy is partly {devolved} to the regional governments.
e.zh: 卫生政策的一部分权力已下放给地方政府。

e.en: We rented a cottage in {Devon} for our summer holiday.
e.zh: 我们在德文郡租了一栋小别墅过暑假。

e.en: {Devon} is famous for its cream teas and rugged coastline.
e.zh: 德文郡以奶油茶点和崎岖的海岸线闻名。

e.en: These fossils date back to the {Devonian} period, 400 million years ago.
e.zh: 这些化石可追溯到四亿年前的泥盆纪。

e.en: The museum has a stunning collection of {Devonian} fish fossils.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了一批令人惊叹的泥盆纪鱼类化石。

e.en: The naval base at {Devonport} is one of the largest in Europe.
e.zh: 德文波特海军基地是欧洲最大的海军基地之一。

e.en: She caught the ferry from {Devonport} across to the city.
e.zh: 她从德文波特乘渡轮过海到市区。

e.en: We had scones with {Devonshire} cream and strawberry jam.
e.zh: 我们吃了配德文郡奶油和草莓酱的司康饼。

e.en: The Duke of {Devonshire} owns one of England's grandest estates.
e.zh: 德文郡公爵拥有英格兰最宏伟的庄园之一。

e.en: I want to {devote} more time to learning Mandarin this year.
e.zh: 今年我想抽出更多时间来学普通话。

e.en: She decided to {devote} her career to climate research.
e.zh: 她决定将自己的职业生涯投入气候研究。

e.en: He is a {devoted} father who never misses a soccer game.
e.zh: 他是个尽职的爸爸，从不缺席孩子的足球比赛。

e.en: The band has a small but {devoted} fan base online.
e.zh: 这支乐队在网上有一群虽小但忠实的粉丝。

e.en: She cared for her aging mother {devotedly} for many years.
e.zh: 她多年来一直悉心照料年迈的母亲。

e.en: Fans waited {devotedly} outside the stadium in the rain.
e.zh: 粉丝们冒雨在体育场外痴心等候。

e.en: He's a longtime {devotee} of vintage film cameras.
e.zh: 他是复古胶片相机的资深爱好者。

e.en: As a yoga {devotee}, she practices every single morning.
e.zh: 作为瑜伽爱好者，她每天早上都坚持练习。

e.en: Coffee {devotees} lined up before the new café opened.
e.zh: 咖啡发烧友们在新咖啡馆开门前就排起了队。

e.en: The temple was packed with {devotees} during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间，寺庙里挤满了虔诚的信徒。

e.en: He {devotes} every weekend to volunteering at the shelter.
e.zh: 他每个周末都用来在收容所做志愿者。

e.en: The author {devotes} an entire chapter to her childhood.
e.zh: 作者用了一整章来写她的童年。

e.en: She's {devoting} her summer to building a side project.
e.zh: 她正把整个暑假用来做一个副业项目。

e.en: He's {devoting} more energy to his family these days.
e.zh: 他最近把更多精力放在家庭上。

e.en: Her {devotion} to her students is admired by everyone.
e.zh: 她对学生的尽心尽力受到所有人的敬佩。

e.en: The dog showed unwavering {devotion} to its owner.
e.zh: 那只狗对主人忠心不二。

e.en: She reads a short {devotional} passage every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会读一段简短的灵修文字。

e.en: The album features traditional {devotional} songs from India.
e.zh: 这张专辑收录了印度的传统宗教歌曲。

e.en: He performs his morning {devotions} before checking his phone.
e.zh: 他早上做完祷告才看手机。

e.en: Many families gather for evening {devotions} during Ramadan.
e.zh: 许多家庭在斋月期间聚在一起做晚间祷告。

devour.t: v. 狼吞虎咽；如饥似渴地阅读

e.en: The kids will {devour} that pizza in five minutes flat.
e.zh: 那块披萨孩子们五分钟内就能一扫而光。

e.en: I tend to {devour} mystery novels in a single sitting.
e.zh: 我看推理小说常常一口气读完。

e.en: She's a real {devourer} of historical biographies.
e.zh: 她是个不折不扣的历史传记狂热读者。

e.en: The dragon in the legend was a {devourer} of villages.
e.zh: 传说中那条龙是吞食村庄的恶兽。

e.en: He sat on the couch {devouring} a giant burger.
e.zh: 他坐在沙发上大口吞着一个巨无霸汉堡。

e.en: She's been {devouring} every book on the bestseller list.
e.zh: 她一直在如饥似渴地读畅销榜上的每一本书。

e.en: Her grandmother is a {devout} Catholic who attends mass daily.
e.zh: 她奶奶是个虔诚的天主教徒，每天都去做弥撒。

e.en: He's a {devout} fan of the team and never misses a match.
e.zh: 他是该队的铁杆粉丝，从不错过任何一场比赛。

e.en: She prayed {devoutly} every night before going to sleep.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前都虔诚地祷告。

e.en: He {devoutly} believes that hard work eventually pays off.
e.zh: 他笃信努力终会有回报。

e.en: Morning {dew} sparkled on the grass in the garden.
e.zh: 清晨的露珠在花园的草地上闪闪发光。

e.en: My shoes got soaked walking through the {dew}-covered lawn.
e.zh: 走过沾满露水的草坪，我的鞋全湿透了。

dewar.t: n. 杜瓦瓶（真空保温容器）

e.en: The lab stores liquid nitrogen in a vacuum-insulated {Dewar}.
e.zh: 实验室用真空保温的杜瓦瓶储存液氮。

e.en: He poured tea from a stainless-steel {Dewar} flask.
e.zh: 他从一个不锈钢杜瓦保温瓶里倒出茶。

dewatered.t:
adj. 已脱水的
v. dewater 的过去式

e.en: The sludge is {dewatered} before being sent to the landfill.
e.zh: 污泥经过脱水处理后才被送往填埋场。

e.en: They {dewatered} the construction site before pouring concrete.
e.zh: 他们在浇筑混凝土前先把工地排干了水。

e.en: The mine uses powerful pumps for {dewatering} the deep tunnels.
e.zh: 矿井用大功率水泵给深层隧道排水。

e.en: {Dewatering} the basement took the whole afternoon.
e.zh: 把地下室的水排干花了整整一个下午。

e.en: We picked wild {dewberry} for jam along the country road.
e.zh: 我们沿着乡间小路采野露莓做果酱。

e.en: The candle has a sweet {dewberry} and vanilla scent.
e.zh: 这支蜡烛散发着甜甜的露莓和香草味。

e.en: A single {dewdrop} hung from the tip of the leaf.
e.zh: 一颗露珠悬在叶尖上。

e.en: She photographed a {dewdrop} reflecting the entire flower.
e.zh: 她拍下一颗映出整朵花的露珠。

e.en: Libraries organize books using the {Dewey} decimal system.
e.zh: 图书馆用杜威十进分类法整理图书。

e.en: John {Dewey}'s ideas still shape modern education theory.
e.zh: 约翰·杜威的思想至今仍影响着现代教育理论。

e.en: The school follows a {Deweyan} approach focused on learning by doing.
e.zh: 这所学校采用杜威式的做中学教育理念。

e.en: Her teaching style has a strong {Deweyan} flavor.
e.zh: 她的教学风格带有浓厚的杜威色彩。

e.en: The old hound's {dewlap} swayed as he trotted across the yard.
e.zh: 那只老猎犬跑过院子时，颈下的垂肉左右晃动。

e.en: Bulls often have a thick {dewlap} hanging beneath the throat.
e.zh: 公牛的喉咙下方常有一片厚厚的垂皮。

dewsbury.t: n. 杜斯伯里（英国地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Dewsbury}, a town in West Yorkshire.
e.zh: 她在西约克郡的杜斯伯里镇长大。

e.en: The train from Leeds to {Dewsbury} takes about fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 从利兹到杜斯伯里的火车大约需要十五分钟。

dewy.t: adj. 沾满露水的；清新的

e.en: The {dewy} grass soaked through her sneakers on the morning walk.
e.zh: 晨间散步时，沾满露水的草地浸湿了她的运动鞋。

e.en: The actress had a fresh, {dewy} complexion in every photo.
e.zh: 那位女演员在每张照片里都有着水润清新的肤质。

dexamethasone.t: n. 地塞米松（一种激素药）

e.en: Doctors prescribed {dexamethasone} to reduce the swelling around her brain.
e.zh: 医生开了地塞米松来减轻她大脑周围的肿胀。

e.en: {Dexamethasone} became a key drug for treating severe COVID cases.
e.zh: 地塞米松成为治疗重症新冠的关键药物之一。

dexter.t:
adj. 右侧的（纹章学）
n. 德克斯特（人名）

e.en: The shield bore a red lion on the {dexter} side.
e.zh: 盾牌右侧绘有一只红色的狮子。

e.en: He named his golden retriever {Dexter} after the TV character.
e.zh: 他给自己的金毛犬取名德克斯特，灵感来自那部电视剧。

e.en: Surgeons need remarkable manual {dexterity} to perform delicate operations.
e.zh: 外科医生需要极高的手部灵巧度才能完成精细手术。

e.en: Her {dexterity} with chopsticks impressed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 她使用筷子的娴熟程度让饭桌上的每个人都印象深刻。

e.en: The pianist's {dexterous} fingers flew across the keyboard.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家灵巧的手指在键盘上飞舞。

e.en: Cats are surprisingly {dexterous} when chasing small toys.
e.zh: 猫追逐小玩具时灵活得令人惊讶。

e.en: He {dexterously} sliced the onion into paper-thin rings.
e.zh: 他熟练地把洋葱切成薄如纸片的圈。

e.en: The juggler {dexterously} kept five balls in the air.
e.zh: 那位杂耍演员灵巧地让五个球同时在空中飞舞。

e.en: The energy drink lists {dextrose} as its main sweetener.
e.zh: 这款能量饮料把葡萄糖列为主要甜味剂。

e.en: Nurses gave the dehydrated patient an IV of {dextrose}.
e.zh: 护士给脱水的病人注射了葡萄糖点滴。

e.en: Her {dextrous} handling of the knife showed years of training.
e.zh: 她娴熟的刀工显示出多年的训练功底。

e.en: Octopuses are remarkably {dextrous} at opening sealed jars.
e.zh: 章鱼在打开密封罐子方面灵巧得惊人。

dfc.t: n. 飞行优异十字勋章

e.en: The pilot was awarded the {DFC} for bravery during the mission.
e.zh: 那位飞行员因任务中表现英勇而被授予杰出飞行十字勋章。

e.en: His grandfather earned a {DFC} flying bombers in World War II.
e.zh: 他的祖父在二战中驾驶轰炸机时获得了杰出飞行十字勋章。

dha.t: n. DHA（一种 omega-3 脂肪酸）

e.en: Fish oil supplements are rich in omega-3 and {DHA}.
e.zh: 鱼油补充剂富含欧米伽-3和DHA。

e.en: Pediatricians recommend {DHA} for healthy infant brain development.
e.zh: 儿科医生推荐补充DHA以促进婴儿大脑健康发育。

dhaka.t: n. 达卡（孟加拉国首都）

e.en: {Dhaka} is the bustling capital of Bangladesh.
e.zh: 达卡是孟加拉国繁忙的首都。

e.en: Traffic in {Dhaka} can be overwhelming for first-time visitors.
e.zh: 达卡的交通对初到的游客来说可能令人难以招架。

dharma.t: n. 佛法；达摩（佛教、印度教教义）

e.en: Buddhist monks devote their lives to studying the {dharma}.
e.zh: 佛教僧侣终其一生都在研习佛法。

e.en: He believed teaching was his true {dharma} in this life.
e.zh: 他相信教书是他此生真正的使命。

e.en: The elderly man wore a white cotton {dhoti} to the temple.
e.zh: 那位老人穿着白色棉布腰布去寺庙。

e.en: Gandhi famously wore a simple {dhoti} as a symbol of protest.
e.zh: 甘地以身着简朴的腰布作为抗议的象征而闻名。

e.en: A wooden {dhow} sailed slowly across the Persian Gulf at sunset.
e.zh: 一艘木制单桅帆船在日落时缓缓驶过波斯湾。

e.en: Tourists in Zanzibar can take a sunset {dhow} cruise.
e.zh: 在桑给巴尔的游客可以乘坐单桅帆船欣赏日落。

dhss.t: n. 英国卫生与社会保障部（缩写）

e.en: He went to the {DHSS} office to claim unemployment benefits.
e.zh: 他去社会保障部办公室申请失业救济金。

e.en: The {DHSS} was reorganized into separate departments in 1988.
e.zh: 卫生与社会保障部于1988年被重组为多个独立部门。

e.en: Flights to Denver land at {DIA}, one of America's largest airports.
e.zh: 飞往丹佛的航班降落在美国最大的机场之一丹佛国际机场。

e.en: The {DIA} provides intelligence support to the U.S. military.
e.zh: 国防情报局为美国军方提供情报支持。

e.en: Type 2 {diabetes} can often be managed through diet and exercise.
e.zh: 二型糖尿病通常可以通过饮食和运动来控制。

e.en: Her grandmother was diagnosed with {diabetes} at age sixty.
e.zh: 她的祖母在六十岁时被诊断出患有糖尿病。

diabetic.t:
adj. 糖尿病的
n. 糖尿病患者

e.en: The café offers {diabetic}-friendly desserts with no added sugar.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供不加糖、适合糖尿病人的甜点。

e.en: As a {diabetic}, he checks his blood sugar several times daily.
e.zh: 作为一名糖尿病患者，他每天要测好几次血糖。

e.en: The villain hatched a {diabolic} plan to flood the city.
e.zh: 那个反派策划了一个邪恶的计划，要淹没整座城市。

e.en: His laughter had a {diabolic} edge that made her shiver.
e.zh: 他的笑声带着一丝魔鬼般的意味，让她不寒而栗。

e.en: The traffic this morning was absolutely {diabolical}.
e.zh: 今早的交通简直糟糕透顶。

e.en: She came up with a {diabolical} prank for April Fools' Day.
e.zh: 她想出了一个愚人节的恶魔级恶作剧。

e.en: The escape room puzzle was {diabolically} clever.
e.zh: 那道密室逃脱的谜题设计得鬼斧神工。

e.en: He grinned {diabolically} as he revealed the surprise.
e.zh: 他露出魔鬼般的笑容，揭晓了那个惊喜。

diachronic.t: adj. 历时的（语言学，研究语言演变）

e.en: Linguists use a {diachronic} approach to study how words evolve.
e.zh: 语言学家用历时的方法研究词汇的演变。

e.en: The book offers a {diachronic} analysis of English grammar.
e.zh: 这本书对英语语法进行了历时性分析。

diacritical.t: adj. 变音符号的；区别性的

e.en: French uses several {diacritical} marks like accents and cedillas.
e.zh: 法语使用多种变音符号，比如重音符和软音符。

e.en: Spanish keyboards make typing {diacritical} marks easy.
e.zh: 西班牙语键盘让输入变音符号变得很方便。

e.en: The queen wore a jeweled {diadem} during the coronation ceremony.
e.zh: 女王在加冕仪式上戴着一顶镶满宝石的王冠。

e.en: A golden {diadem} was discovered in the ancient tomb.
e.zh: 考古人员在那座古墓中发现了一顶金冠。

diadora.t: n. 迪亚多纳（意大利运动品牌）

e.en: He bought a pair of {Diadora} sneakers for casual wear.
e.zh: 他买了一双迪亚多纳运动鞋当作日常穿着。

e.en: {Diadora} is an Italian sportswear brand founded in 1948.
e.zh: 迪亚多纳是1948年创立的一家意大利运动品牌。

diagenetic.t: adj. 成岩作用的（地质学）

e.en: Geologists study {diagenetic} changes that turn sediment into rock.
e.zh: 地质学家研究将沉积物转变为岩石的成岩变化。

e.en: The fossils showed clear signs of {diagenetic} alteration.
e.zh: 这些化石显示出明显的成岩作用变化痕迹。

e.en: Many anxiety disorders are {diagnosable} through standard clinical interviews.
e.zh: 许多焦虑症都可以通过标准的临床访谈来诊断。

e.en: Not every mood swing is a {diagnosable} mental illness.
e.zh: 并不是每一次情绪波动都是可被诊断的精神疾病。

e.en: Doctors use blood tests to {diagnose} thyroid problems.
e.zh: 医生通过血液检查来诊断甲状腺问题。

e.en: It can be hard to {diagnose} bugs in legacy code.
e.zh: 在老旧代码中诊断出错误可能非常困难。

diagnosed.t: v. 诊断（diagnose 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She was {diagnosed} with asthma when she was eight.
e.zh: 她八岁时被诊断出患有哮喘。

e.en: The mechanic {diagnosed} the noise as a worn brake pad.
e.zh: 修车师傅判断那个噪音是刹车片磨损造成的。

diagnoses.t:
n. 诊断（diagnosis 复数）
v. 诊断（第三人称单数）

e.en: The clinic offers second opinions on complex {diagnoses}.
e.zh: 这家诊所为复杂的诊断结果提供第二意见。

e.en: AI tools can help doctors confirm difficult {diagnoses}.
e.zh: 人工智能工具可以帮助医生确认棘手的诊断结果。

diagnosing.t: v. 诊断（diagnose 的现在分词）

e.en: The vet had trouble {diagnosing} what was wrong with the cat.
e.zh: 兽医一时难以诊断出那只猫到底出了什么问题。

e.en: {Diagnosing} memory leaks requires careful profiling of the application.
e.zh: 诊断内存泄漏需要对应用程序进行细致的性能分析。

e.en: The {diagnosis} came as a shock to the entire family.
e.zh: 这个诊断结果让全家人都震惊不已。

e.en: Early {diagnosis} of cancer greatly improves survival rates.
e.zh: 癌症的早期诊断能大大提高存活率。

diagnostic.t:
adj. 诊断的
n. 诊断程序

e.en: The mechanic ran a full {diagnostic} test on the engine.
e.zh: 修车师傅对发动机进行了全面的诊断测试。

e.en: Modern hospitals rely on advanced {diagnostic} imaging equipment.
e.zh: 现代医院依赖先进的诊断成像设备。

diagnostically.t: adv. 诊断上；作为诊断手段

e.en: The rash is {diagnostically} important for identifying the disease.
e.zh: 这种皮疹在诊断该疾病方面具有重要意义。

e.en: Blood tests can be {diagnostically} useful in unclear cases.
e.zh: 在病情不明时，血液检查在诊断上很有帮助。

diagnostician.t: n. 诊断医师；诊断专家

e.en: She is regarded as the hospital's most skilled {diagnostician}.
e.zh: 她被公认为医院里最优秀的诊断专家。

e.en: A good {diagnostician} listens carefully to the patient's full history.
e.zh: 一名优秀的诊断医师会仔细聆听病人的完整病史。

e.en: The car's onboard {diagnostics} flagged a problem with the sensor.
e.zh: 汽车的车载诊断系统标记出传感器存在问题。

e.en: Browser {diagnostics} can quickly reveal slow-loading scripts.
e.zh: 浏览器的诊断工具能快速找出加载缓慢的脚本。

diagonal.t:
n. 对角线
adj. 斜的；对角的

e.en: Draw a {diagonal} line from one corner of the square to the other.
e.zh: 从正方形的一个角到另一个角画一条对角线。

e.en: The shirt has bold {diagonal} stripes across the front.
e.zh: 那件衬衫的正面有醒目的斜条纹。

e.en: The bishop in chess can only move {diagonally}.
e.zh: 国际象棋中的象只能斜着走。

e.en: She crossed the parking lot {diagonally} to save time.
e.zh: 为了节省时间，她斜穿过停车场。

diagram.t:
n. 示意图；图表
v. 用图解说明

e.en: The manual includes a clear {diagram} of every part.
e.zh: 说明书里包含了每个零件的清晰图示。

e.en: Let me sketch a quick {diagram} to explain the workflow.
e.zh: 让我快速画个图来解释这个工作流程。

diagrammatic.t: adj. 图解的；示意图式的

e.en: The textbook uses {diagrammatic} representations to explain electrical circuits.
e.zh: 这本教科书用图解的方式来讲解电路。

e.en: A {diagrammatic} summary helps readers grasp complex ideas quickly.
e.zh: 图解式的概要能帮助读者快速理解复杂的概念。

e.en: The process is shown {diagrammatically} on the next page.
e.zh: 这一流程在下一页以图示方式呈现。

e.en: He explained the algorithm {diagrammatically} on the whiteboard.
e.zh: 他在白板上用图示讲解了那个算法。

e.en: The presentation included several {diagrams} of the new product.
e.zh: 那场演示中包含了几张新产品的示意图。

e.en: Students often learn faster from {diagrams} than from long paragraphs.
e.zh: 比起长段落，学生通常通过图示能学得更快。

dial.t:
v. 拨号；拨打
n. 表盘；刻度盘

e.en: Just {dial} the front desk if you need extra towels.
e.zh: 如果你需要额外的毛巾，直接拨打前台电话即可。

e.en: The watch has a sleek black {dial} with silver hands.
e.zh: 这只手表有着简洁的黑色表盘和银色指针。

e.en: Each region of Italy has its own distinctive {dialect}.
e.zh: 意大利每个地区都有自己独特的方言。

e.en: She speaks the local {dialect} fluently with her grandmother.
e.zh: 她和奶奶能流利地说当地方言。

e.en: The novel preserves many {dialectal} expressions from rural Yorkshire.
e.zh: 这部小说保留了许多约克郡乡村的方言表达。

e.en: There are subtle {dialectal} differences between northern and southern speakers.
e.zh: 南北方言之间存在着细微的差异。

e.en: Hegel's {dialectic} explores how opposing ideas produce new truths.
e.zh: 黑格尔的辩证法探讨对立观念如何产生新的真理。

e.en: The debate became a lively {dialectic} between the two scholars.
e.zh: 这场辩论成为两位学者之间一次精彩的思辨交锋。

e.en: Marx developed a {dialectical} approach to understanding history.
e.zh: 马克思发展出一种理解历史的辩证方法。

e.en: Therapists often use {dialectical} behavior therapy to treat anxiety.
e.zh: 治疗师经常使用辩证行为疗法来治疗焦虑。

e.en: The two philosophies are {dialectically} opposed yet deeply connected.
e.zh: 这两种哲学在辩证上对立，却又紧密相连。

e.en: He argued {dialectically}, weighing each side before drawing conclusions.
e.zh: 他以辩证的方式论证，在下结论前权衡各方观点。

dialed.t: v. 拨号（dial 的过去式）

e.en: She {dialed} the number twice but no one answered.
e.zh: 她拨了两次号都没人接。

e.en: He {dialed} back the brightness on his phone screen.
e.zh: 他把手机屏幕亮度调低了。

dialing.t: v. 拨号（dial 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {dialing} customer service to dispute the charge.
e.zh: 我正在拨打客服电话来申诉这笔费用。

e.en: The radio host kept {dialing} up the energy in the studio.
e.zh: 那位电台主持人不断为录音棚增添活力。

e.en: He kept {dialling} her number until the line connected.
e.zh: 他一直拨她的号码,直到接通为止。

e.en: The {dialling} code for London is 020.
e.zh: 伦敦的电话区号是020。

dialog.t: n. 对话框（UI 弹窗）；对话

e.en: A confirmation {dialog} popped up before the file was deleted.
e.zh: 删除文件前弹出了一个确认对话框。

e.en: The two leaders opened a constructive {dialog} on trade.
e.zh: 两位领导人就贸易问题展开了建设性对话。

e.en: The teacher used a {dialogic} approach to engage every student.
e.zh: 老师采用对话式教学法来吸引每位学生。

e.en: Her novel has a deeply {dialogic} structure.
e.zh: 她的小说具有强烈的对话体结构。

e.en: Therapy often relies on a {dialogical} relationship between client and counselor.
e.zh: 心理治疗常依赖来访者与咨询师之间的对话关系。

e.en: The workshop encouraged a {dialogical} exchange of ideas.
e.zh: 研讨会鼓励参与者进行对话式的思想交流。

e.en: Modal {dialogs} should never block important user actions.
e.zh: 模态对话框不应阻挡重要的用户操作。

e.en: The game's witty {dialogs} make every character memorable.
e.zh: 游戏中俏皮的对白让每个角色都令人难忘。

dialogue.t:
n. 对话；交流
v. 对话

e.en: The film's natural {dialogue} feels surprisingly real.
e.zh: 这部电影自然的对白让人感觉非常真实。

e.en: We need an open {dialogue} between management and staff.
e.zh: 管理层与员工之间需要坦诚的对话。

e.en: Plato's {dialogues} are still studied in philosophy classes today.
e.zh: 柏拉图的对话录至今仍是哲学课的教材。

e.en: The conference hosted {dialogues} on climate policy.
e.zh: 会议举办了多场关于气候政策的对话。

dials.t:
n. 表盘（复数）
v. 拨号（第三人称单数）

e.en: Vintage watches often have beautifully detailed {dials}.
e.zh: 老式手表的表盘往往做工精美。

e.en: He {dials} his mother every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 他每周日晚上都会给母亲打电话。

e.en: She goes to the clinic for {dialysis} three times a week.
e.zh: 她每周去诊所做三次透析。

e.en: Kidney patients often depend on {dialysis} for survival.
e.zh: 肾病患者常常依赖透析来维持生命。

e.en: Water is weakly {diamagnetic} and repels strong magnets.
e.zh: 水具有弱抗磁性,会排斥强磁体。

e.en: Graphite shows clearly {diamagnetic} behavior in the experiment.
e.zh: 石墨在实验中表现出明显的抗磁性。

diamante.t: n. 仿钻；人造钻石饰品

e.en: She wore a sparkling {diamante} brooch to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚闪亮的人造钻石胸针出席晚会。

e.en: The dress was trimmed with {diamante} along the neckline.
e.zh: 那件连衣裙的领口镶着人造钻石。

e.en: The pizza is about thirty centimeters in {diameter}.
e.zh: 这块比萨直径约三十厘米。

e.en: Engineers measured the pipe's {diameter} before installation.
e.zh: 工程师在安装前测量了管道的直径。

e.en: The drill set includes bits of various {diameters}.
e.zh: 这套钻头包含多种不同直径的钻嘴。

e.en: Telescope lenses come in many different {diameters}.
e.zh: 望远镜镜片有许多不同的直径规格。

diametrically.t: adv. 截然地；完全相反地

e.en: Their views on the issue are {diametrically} opposed.
e.zh: 他们对这个问题的看法截然相反。

e.en: The two strategies are {diametrically} different in approach.
e.zh: 这两种策略在方法上完全相反。

e.en: He proposed with a stunning {diamond} ring.
e.zh: 他用一枚璀璨的钻戒求婚。

e.en: The pitcher walked slowly off the {diamond}.
e.zh: 投手缓缓走下棒球场。

diamonds.t: n. 钻石（复数）；方块（扑克花色）

e.en: The necklace is studded with tiny {diamonds}.
e.zh: 这条项链镶嵌着许多细小的钻石。

e.en: Morning dew on the grass sparkled like {diamonds}.
e.zh: 草地上的晨露像钻石一样闪闪发光。

e.en: She planted pink {dianthus} along the garden border.
e.zh: 她在花园边沿种了一排粉色石竹。

e.en: {Dianthus} thrives in well-drained, sunny soil.
e.zh: 石竹在排水良好、阳光充足的土壤中长势良好。

e.en: Many insects enter {diapause} to survive harsh winters.
e.zh: 许多昆虫通过滞育来度过严酷的冬天。

e.en: Researchers study how temperature triggers {diapause} in moths.
e.zh: 研究人员研究温度如何诱发飞蛾的滞育。

e.en: The baby needs a clean {diaper} before bedtime.
e.zh: 宝宝睡前需要换一片干净的尿布。

e.en: Don't forget to pack a spare {diaper} in the bag.
e.zh: 别忘了在包里装一片备用尿布。

e.en: We buy {diapers} in bulk to save money.
e.zh: 我们都是大批量购买尿布以省钱。

e.en: Cloth {diapers} are more eco-friendly than disposable ones.
e.zh: 布尿布比一次性尿布更环保。

e.en: She wore a {diaphanous} silk scarf over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她肩上披着一条轻薄透明的丝巾。

e.en: The curtains were so {diaphanous} that sunlight poured through.
e.zh: 窗帘极为轻薄透明,阳光直接洒了进来。

e.en: Singers learn to breathe deeply using the {diaphragm}.
e.zh: 歌手学习用横膈膜进行深呼吸。

e.en: The camera's {diaphragm} controls how much light enters.
e.zh: 相机的光圈控制进入的光线量。

e.en: Doctors recommend {diaphragmatic} breathing for anxiety relief.
e.zh: 医生建议通过腹式呼吸来缓解焦虑。

e.en: The yoga class focused on slow, {diaphragmatic} breaths.
e.zh: 这节瑜伽课着重于缓慢的腹式呼吸。

e.en: Her childhood {diaries} reveal a vivid imagination.
e.zh: 她童年的日记展现了丰富的想象力。

e.en: Many soldiers kept {diaries} during the war.
e.zh: 许多士兵在战争期间都坚持写日记。

e.en: Anne Frank is perhaps the world's most famous {diarist}.
e.zh: 安妮·弗兰克或许是世界上最著名的日记作家。

e.en: As a {diarist}, he recorded daily life in great detail.
e.zh: 作为一名日记作者,他详细记录了日常生活。

e.en: Drink plenty of fluids if you have {diarrhea}.
e.zh: 如果腹泻,请多喝水补充水分。

e.en: The contaminated water caused widespread {diarrhea} in the village.
e.zh: 受污染的水在村里引发了大范围的腹泻。

e.en: {Diarrheal} diseases remain a major cause of child mortality.
e.zh: 腹泻类疾病仍是儿童死亡的主要原因之一。

e.en: Clean water dramatically reduces {diarrheal} infections.
e.zh: 清洁的水能大幅减少腹泻类感染。

e.en: Travelers' {diarrheas} are often caused by unfamiliar bacteria.
e.zh: 旅行者腹泻常由不熟悉的细菌引起。

e.en: Chronic {diarrheas} should always be checked by a doctor.
e.zh: 慢性腹泻应由医生检查诊治。

e.en: The child was hospitalized with severe {diarrhoea}.
e.zh: 那个孩子因严重腹泻被送进医院。

e.en: Spicy food sometimes gives him {diarrhoea}.
e.zh: 辛辣食物有时会让他腹泻。

e.en: Vaccines have reduced {diarrhoeal} illness in many countries.
e.zh: 疫苗在许多国家减少了腹泻类疾病。

e.en: Sanitation projects target the spread of {diarrhoeal} infections.
e.zh: 卫生项目重点防控腹泻类感染的传播。

diarrhoeas.t: n. 腹泻（英式拼写，复数）

e.en: Persistent {diarrhoeas} can lead to dangerous dehydration.
e.zh: 持续性腹泻可能导致危险的脱水。

e.en: Doctors classify {diarrhoeas} by their underlying causes.
e.zh: 医生根据病因对腹泻进行分类。

e.en: She writes in her {diary} every night before sleeping.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前都会写日记。

e.en: My {diary} is fully booked this week.
e.zh: 我这周的日程已经排满了。

e.en: The speaker walked confidently onto the {dias}.
e.zh: 演讲者自信地走上讲台。

e.en: A microphone stood at the center of the {dias}.
e.zh: 讲台中央立着一支麦克风。

diaspora.t: n. 海外侨民；族群离散

e.en: The Chinese {diaspora} maintains strong cultural ties worldwide.
e.zh: 海外华人在全球保持着深厚的文化联系。

e.en: Festivals help unite the {diaspora} with their homeland.
e.zh: 节日帮助海外侨民与故乡保持联系。

e.en: Her {diastolic} blood pressure was slightly elevated.
e.zh: 她的舒张压略有偏高。

e.en: Doctors monitor both systolic and {diastolic} readings.
e.zh: 医生会同时监测收缩压和舒张压数值。

e.en: A single {diatom} can be seen only under a microscope.
e.zh: 单个硅藻只能在显微镜下才能看到。

e.en: Each {diatom} has an intricate glass-like shell.
e.zh: 每个硅藻都有一层精致的玻璃状外壳。

e.en: Most pop songs are written in a {diatonic} scale.
e.zh: 大多数流行歌曲都使用自然音阶创作。

e.en: The melody stays strictly {diatonic} throughout the piece.
e.zh: 整首乐曲的旋律始终严格遵循自然音阶。

diatribe.t: n. 长篇抨击；痛骂文章

e.en: He launched into a furious {diatribe} against the new policy.
e.zh: 他对新政策展开了一场愤怒的抨击。

e.en: Her column read like a {diatribe} rather than analysis.
e.zh: 她的专栏读起来更像谩骂而非分析。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {diazepam} to ease her anxiety.
e.zh: 医生开了地西泮来缓解她的焦虑。

e.en: {Diazepam} should never be mixed with alcohol.
e.zh: 地西泮绝不能与酒精同服。

dibble.t:
n. 点播器
v. 打洞种植

e.en: Use a {dibble} to make neat holes for the seedlings.
e.zh: 用点播器为幼苗整齐地挖出种植孔。

e.en: She likes to {dibble} small holes before planting bulbs.
e.zh: 她喜欢在种球茎前先戳出小孔。

dice.t:
n. 骰子
v. 切成丁

e.en: Roll the {dice} to see who goes first.
e.zh: 掷骰子决定谁先来。

e.en: Please {dice} the onions finely for the soup.
e.zh: 请把洋葱切成小丁用来煮汤。

diced.t:
v. 切成丁（过去式）
adj. 切丁的

e.en: He {diced} the carrots before adding them to the pan.
e.zh: 他把胡萝卜切成丁后再倒进锅里。

e.en: The salad came topped with {diced} avocado.
e.zh: 沙拉上面铺着切丁的牛油果。

e.en: Driving in this fog feels a bit {dicey}.
e.zh: 在这种雾里开车有点冒险。

e.en: Investing all your savings in one stock is {dicey}.
e.zh: 把全部积蓄投到一只股票上风险很大。

e.en: They replaced the lawn with low-maintenance {dichondra}.
e.zh: 他们用易于打理的马蹄金替换了草坪。

e.en: {Dichondra} forms a soft green carpet over the soil.
e.zh: 马蹄金在土壤上形成一片柔软的绿毯。

e.en: Researchers used a {dichotic} listening test to study attention.
e.zh: 研究人员用双耳分听测试来研究注意力。

e.en: In the {dichotic} task, each ear hears different words.
e.zh: 在双耳分听任务中,两耳分别听到不同的词。

e.en: The {dichotomization} of complex data often loses key information.
e.zh: 将复杂数据二分化往往会丢失关键信息。

e.en: Statisticians warn against the {dichotomization} of continuous variables.
e.zh: 统计学家警告不要将连续变量进行二分化。

e.en: It's risky to {dichotomize} people as either winners or losers.
e.zh: 将人简单地划分为赢家或输家是危险的。

e.en: Researchers sometimes {dichotomize} scores to simplify their analysis.
e.zh: 研究者有时会把分数二分化以简化分析。

e.en: The survey {dichotomized} responses into 'agree' and 'disagree'.
e.zh: 这项调查把回答二分为“同意”和“不同意”。

e.en: He {dichotomized} the world into friends and enemies.
e.zh: 他把世界简单地划分为朋友和敌人。

e.en: The debate became {dichotomous}, with no room for nuance.
e.zh: 辩论变得非黑即白，没有任何中间地带。

e.en: Biologists study the {dichotomous} branching of certain plants.
e.zh: 生物学家研究某些植物的二叉分枝结构。

e.en: He {dichotomously} divides people into winners and losers.
e.zh: 他将人简单地二分为赢家和输家。

e.en: The tree branches {dichotomously} from the main trunk.
e.zh: 这棵树从主干二叉分枝。

e.en: There's a clear {dichotomy} between her words and actions.
e.zh: 她的言行之间存在明显的矛盾。

e.en: The film explores the {dichotomy} of good and evil.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了善与恶的二元对立。

e.en: Don't be a {dick} about it—just apologize already.
e.zh: 别这么混蛋，赶紧道个歉就行了。

e.en: The private {dick} followed the suspect for hours.
e.zh: 这位私家侦探跟踪嫌疑人好几个小时。

e.en: What the {dickens} is going on in here?
e.zh: 这里到底在搞什么名堂？

e.en: She read every novel {dickens} ever published.
e.zh: 她读遍了狄更斯出版过的每一本小说。

dickensian.t: adj. 狄更斯小说式的；贫困阴郁的

e.en: The orphanage had truly {dickensian} living conditions.
e.zh: 这家孤儿院的生活条件简直像狄更斯小说里那样悲惨。

e.en: The factory's {dickensian} workshop shocked the inspectors.
e.zh: 工厂里那种狄更斯式的车间让检查员震惊不已。

e.en: She studied {dietetics} at university to become a nutritionist.
e.zh: 她在大学学习营养学,想成为营养师。

e.en: Modern {dietetics} combines biology, chemistry, and behavioral science.
e.zh: 现代营养学结合了生物学、化学和行为科学。

e.en: My {dietician} suggested cutting back on processed foods.
e.zh: 我的营养师建议我少吃加工食品。

e.en: The hospital hired a {dietician} to plan patient meals.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一名营养师来安排病人的餐食。

dieting.t:
n. 节食；饮食控制
v. 节食（dieting 的现在分词）

e.en: She has been {dieting} for three months without much success.
e.zh: 她节食三个月了,但效果不太明显。

e.en: Crash {dieting} can actually slow down your metabolism.
e.zh: 极端节食实际上会减慢新陈代谢。

e.en: A registered {dietitian} helped me build a healthier meal plan.
e.zh: 一位注册营养师帮我制定了更健康的饮食计划。

e.en: The {dietitian} reviewed my food diary at every appointment.
e.zh: 那位营养师在每次复诊时都会查看我的饮食日记。

e.en: Marlene {Dietrich} was a legendary German-American film star.
e.zh: 玛琳·黛德丽是一位传奇的德裔美籍电影明星。

e.en: My neighbor {Dietrich} moved here from Berlin last summer.
e.zh: 我的邻居迪特里希去年夏天从柏林搬来这里。

diets.t:
n. 饮食；节食方案
v. 节食（第三人称单数）

e.en: Fad {diets} rarely produce lasting weight loss results.
e.zh: 流行的节食方法很少能带来持久的减重效果。

e.en: Different cultures have very different traditional {diets}.
e.zh: 不同文化有截然不同的传统饮食习惯。

e.en: The phrase "Mon {Dieu}" means "My God" in French.
e.zh: "Mon Dieu"在法语中的意思是"我的天"。

e.en: The old chapel bears the inscription "À {Dieu}" above the door.
e.zh: 那座古老的小教堂门上刻着"献给上帝"的铭文。

diff.t: n. 差异；diff 文件（代码比对）

e.en: Run git {diff} to see what changed before committing.
e.zh: 提交前运行 git diff 看看改动了什么。

e.en: The reviewer asked me to explain the large {diff} in this file.
e.zh: 审核人让我解释这个文件里大量的改动差异。

e.en: Our opinions {differ} on how to handle the budget cuts.
e.zh: 我们对如何处理预算削减的看法不同。

e.en: The two products {differ} mainly in price and battery life.
e.zh: 这两款产品主要在价格和电池寿命上有差异。

differed.t: v. 不同；有分歧（过去式）

e.en: Her account {differed} significantly from what witnesses reported.
e.zh: 她的说法与目击者的描述大相径庭。

e.en: The final design {differed} only slightly from the original sketch.
e.zh: 最终设计与最初的草图只有细微差别。

e.en: There is a huge {difference} between knowing and understanding.
e.zh: 知道和理解之间有巨大的差别。

e.en: Small daily habits make a real {difference} over time.
e.zh: 日常的小习惯久而久之会带来真正的改变。

e.en: Cultural {differences} can lead to misunderstandings at work.
e.zh: 文化差异可能导致工作中的误解。

e.en: Let's set aside our {differences} and finish the project.
e.zh: 我们把分歧放一边,先把项目做完吧。

different.t: adj. 不同的；各式各样的

e.en: Her new haircut makes her look completely {different}.
e.zh: 她的新发型让她看起来完全不一样了。

e.en: We tried three {different} restaurants this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我们试了三家不同的餐厅。

differentiable.t: adj. 可微分的；可区分的

e.en: This function is {differentiable} at every point in its domain.
e.zh: 这个函数在定义域内的每一点都可微。

e.en: Neural networks rely on {differentiable} operations for training.
e.zh: 神经网络依靠可微运算来进行训练。

differential.t:
adj. 差别的；微分的
n. 差额；微分

e.en: The {differential} in salaries between the two teams is striking.
e.zh: 两个团队之间的薪资差距相当显著。

e.en: He's taking a {differential} equations course this semester.
e.zh: 这学期他在上微分方程课。

e.en: The drug affects men and women {differentially}, studies show.
e.zh: 研究显示这种药对男性和女性的作用有差异。

e.en: Tax policies often impact income groups {differentially}.
e.zh: 税收政策对不同收入群体往往产生不同影响。

e.en: It's hard to {differentiate} the twins from a distance.
e.zh: 远远地很难分辨这对双胞胎。

e.en: Strong branding helps companies {differentiate} themselves from competitors.
e.zh: 强有力的品牌能帮助公司与竞争对手区分开来。

differentiated.t: v. 区分（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The teacher {differentiated} her lessons to suit each student.
e.zh: 老师根据每个学生的情况调整了她的课程。

e.en: Their premium service is clearly {differentiated} from the basic plan.
e.zh: 他们的高级服务与基础套餐有明显区别。

differentiates.t: v. 区分（第三人称单数）

e.en: What {differentiates} this phone is its incredible camera.
e.zh: 这款手机的与众不同之处在于它出色的相机。

e.en: Excellent customer support {differentiates} the company from rivals.
e.zh: 优秀的客户服务使该公司从竞争对手中脱颖而出。

e.en: {Differentiating} between fact and opinion is an essential skill.
e.zh: 区分事实与观点是一项重要的技能。

e.en: The startup is {differentiating} itself through sustainable packaging.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正通过可持续包装来打造差异化。

e.en: Product {differentiation} is key to surviving in a crowded market.
e.zh: 在拥挤的市场中,产品差异化是生存的关键。

e.en: Cell {differentiation} is a fundamental concept in biology.
e.zh: 细胞分化是生物学中的一个基本概念。

e.en: If I could do it again, I would handle things {differently}.
e.zh: 如果能重来,我会用不同的方式处理这件事。

e.en: People learn {differently}, so teaching styles should vary.
e.zh: 每个人学习方式不同,所以教学风格应当有所变化。

differing.t:
adj. 不同的
v. 有分歧（现在分词）

e.en: The team has {differing} views on the project deadline.
e.zh: 团队对项目截止日期持有不同的看法。

e.en: Customers gave {differing} reviews about the new restaurant.
e.zh: 顾客们对这家新餐厅给出了不一样的评价。

differs.t: v. 不同（第三人称单数）

e.en: This model {differs} from the previous one in three key ways.
e.zh: 这一款与上一款在三个关键方面有所不同。

e.en: Her writing style {differs} dramatically from her brother's.
e.zh: 她的写作风格与她哥哥的截然不同。

e.en: Learning a new language is {difficult} but rewarding.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言很难,但很值得。

e.en: He can be {difficult} to work with when stressed.
e.zh: 他在压力大时会变得难以相处。

e.en: The company faced financial {difficulties} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间这家公司遭遇了财务困难。

e.en: She overcame many {difficulties} to finish her degree.
e.zh: 她克服了重重困难才完成了学位。

e.en: I had {difficulty} sleeping after drinking so much coffee.
e.zh: 喝了那么多咖啡后我很难入睡。

e.en: You can adjust the game's {difficulty} in the settings menu.
