e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里调整游戏难度。

e.en: His {diffidence} in meetings hides a sharp analytical mind.
e.zh: 他在会议上的羞怯掩盖了他敏锐的分析能力。

e.en: She spoke with surprising {diffidence} for someone so accomplished.
e.zh: 对于一个如此有成就的人来说,她说话出奇地谦逊腼腆。

diffident.t: adj. 缺乏自信的；羞怯的

e.en: He was too {diffident} to ask for a promotion.
e.zh: 他太腼腆了,不敢开口要求升职。

e.en: She gave a {diffident} smile when introduced to the crowd.
e.zh: 被介绍给众人时,她露出了一丝羞怯的微笑。

e.en: The new intern {diffidently} raised her hand to ask a question.
e.zh: 新来的实习生怯生生地举手提问。

e.en: He {diffidently} suggested an alternative approach during the meeting.
e.zh: 会上他怯怯地提出了一个不同的方案。

e.en: Light waves {diffract} when they pass through a narrow slit.
e.zh: 光波通过狭缝时会发生衍射。

e.en: The crystal will {diffract} X-rays in a predictable pattern.
e.zh: 该晶体会以可预测的图样衍射X射线。

diffracted.t: v. 衍射（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The laser beam {diffracted} as it hit the grating.
e.zh: 激光束打到光栅时发生了衍射。

e.en: Sunlight {diffracted} through the misty droplets formed a rainbow.
e.zh: 阳光经过雾气中的小水滴衍射后形成了彩虹。

e.en: X-ray {diffraction} helped scientists discover the structure of DNA.
e.zh: X射线衍射帮助科学家发现了DNA的结构。

e.en: The {diffraction} pattern revealed the spacing between atoms.
e.zh: 衍射图样揭示了原子之间的间距。

diffuse.t:
v. 扩散；传播
adj. 弥漫的；冗长的

e.en: Soft curtains {diffuse} the harsh afternoon sunlight nicely.
e.zh: 轻柔的窗帘很好地柔化了刺眼的午后阳光。

e.en: She tried to {diffuse} the tension with a quick joke.
e.zh: 她试图用一个小玩笑缓和紧张的气氛。

diffused.t:
adj. 弥漫的
v. 扩散（过去式）

e.en: The lamp {diffused} a warm glow across the room.
e.zh: 那盏灯将温暖的光晕散布在整个房间。

e.en: Her calm tone quickly {diffused} the heated argument.
e.zh: 她平静的语气很快化解了这场激烈的争论。

e.en: The infection had spread {diffusely} throughout the lung tissue.
e.zh: 感染已经弥漫性地扩散到整个肺组织。

e.en: Light entered the studio {diffusely} through the frosted glass.
e.zh: 光线透过磨砂玻璃漫散地照进工作室。

e.en: I put lavender oil in the {diffuser} before bedtime.
e.zh: 我睡前在香薰机里加了薰衣草精油。

e.en: A softbox {diffuser} makes portrait lighting much more flattering.
e.zh: 柔光箱扩散器让人像照明显得更加柔和。

diffuses.t: v. 扩散（第三人称单数）

e.en: Oxygen {diffuses} from the lungs into the bloodstream.
e.zh: 氧气从肺部扩散到血液中。

e.en: Humor often {diffuses} awkward moments at family dinners.
e.zh: 幽默常常能化解家庭聚餐中的尴尬时刻。

e.en: She is skilled at {diffusing} conflicts between team members.
e.zh: 她很擅长化解团队成员之间的冲突。

e.en: The fog was {diffusing} the streetlights into soft halos.
e.zh: 雾气把街灯散射成一圈圈柔和的光晕。

e.en: The {diffusion} of perfume across the room happens within seconds.
e.zh: 香水在房间里扩散开来只需几秒钟。

e.en: Social media accelerated the {diffusion} of new ideas worldwide.
e.zh: 社交媒体加速了新思想在全球的传播。

e.en: Heat transfer in solids is largely a {diffusive} process.
e.zh: 固体中的热传递主要是一种扩散过程。

e.en: Pollutants spread through groundwater via slow {diffusive} motion.
e.zh: 污染物通过缓慢的扩散运动在地下水中蔓延。

dig.t:
v. 挖掘；深究
n. 挖苦；挖掘

e.en: The dog likes to {dig} holes in the backyard.
e.zh: 那只狗喜欢在后院挖洞。

e.en: Reporters had to {dig} deeper to uncover the real story.
e.zh: 记者们必须深入挖掘才能揭开事情的真相。

digerati.t: n. 数字精英；科技达人

e.en: The conference attracted Silicon Valley's most influential {digerati}.
e.zh: 这次大会吸引了硅谷最具影响力的数字精英。

e.en: She became one of the {digerati} after launching her successful startup.
e.zh: 创办了成功的初创公司后,她成了数字精英中的一员。

digest.t:
v. 消化；领会
n. 摘要；文摘

e.en: It takes hours to fully {digest} a heavy meal.
e.zh: 完全消化一顿大餐需要几个小时。

e.en: I subscribe to a weekly news {digest} every Monday morning.
e.zh: 我每周一早上都会收到一份新闻摘要。

digested.t: v. 消化（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Once I {digested} the bad news, I felt much calmer.
e.zh: 消化了那个坏消息之后,我感觉平静多了。

e.en: The protein is easily {digested} by most healthy adults.
e.zh: 大多数健康成年人都能轻松消化这种蛋白质。

e.en: The farm uses an anaerobic {digester} to process animal waste.
e.zh: 这家农场使用厌氧消化器处理动物粪便。

e.en: A biogas {digester} can turn food scraps into renewable energy.
e.zh: 沼气消化器可以把厨余转化为可再生能源。

digestibility.t: n. 可消化性；易消化程度

e.en: Cooking improves the {digestibility} of many vegetables.
e.zh: 烹饪能提高许多蔬菜的消化率。

e.en: Pet food brands often advertise the {digestibility} of their formulas.
e.zh: 宠物食品品牌常常宣传其配方的易消化性。

digestible.t: adj. 易消化的；易理解的

e.en: The article breaks complex science into {digestible} chunks for beginners.
e.zh: 这篇文章把复杂的科学拆成易懂的小段。

e.en: Steamed vegetables are more {digestible} than raw ones.
e.zh: 蒸过的蔬菜比生的更容易消化。

e.en: A short walk after dinner aids {digestion}.
e.zh: 晚饭后散散步有助于消化。

e.en: Stress can seriously affect your {digestion}.
e.zh: 压力会严重影响你的消化功能。

dicker.t:
v. 讨价还价
n. 小额交易

e.en: They began to {dicker} over the price of the car.
e.zh: 他们开始为这辆车的价格讨价还价。

e.en: I refuse to {dicker} with street vendors anymore.
e.zh: 我不想再和街边小贩讨价还价了。

e.en: Stop being such a {dickhead} to the new intern.
e.zh: 别再对新来的实习生那么混蛋了。

e.en: That {dickhead} cut me off in traffic this morning.
e.zh: 今早那个混蛋开车强行插我的队。

dickie.t:
n. 假衬衫前胸
n. 小鸟 (儿语)

e.en: He wore a fake {dickie} under his suit jacket.
e.zh: 他在西装外套里穿了一件假衬衫前襟。

e.en: The vintage shop sold an old velvet {dickie}.
e.zh: 那家复古店在卖一件旧的丝绒假领。

e.en: Emily {dickinson} wrote nearly 1,800 poems in her lifetime.
e.zh: 艾米莉·狄金森一生写了将近一千八百首诗。

e.en: The professor lectured on {dickinson} and her reclusive life.
e.zh: 教授讲解了狄金森及其隐居的一生。

dicky.t:
adj. 摇摇欲坠的、不可靠的
n. 假衬衫前襟

e.en: My grandfather has a {dicky} heart these days.
e.zh: 我爷爷最近心脏不太好。

e.en: He felt a bit {dicky} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他感觉有点不舒服。

e.en: The lawyer recorded notes on his {dictaphone} after court.
e.zh: 庭审结束后律师用录音机记录笔记。

e.en: Old offices used a {dictaphone} for typing letters later.
e.zh: 老式办公室用口述录音机录下内容供日后打字。

dictate.t:
v. 口述、听写
v. 命令、规定

e.en: The boss tried to {dictate} every detail of the project.
e.zh: 老板试图对项目的每个细节都指手画脚。

e.en: She would {dictate} her emails while driving to work.
e.zh: 她常在开车上班时口述邮件内容。

e.en: The CEO {dictated} the entire memo to her assistant.
e.zh: 首席执行官把整份备忘录口述给了助理。

e.en: Tradition has long {dictated} how the festival is celebrated.
e.zh: 长久以来传统决定着这个节日的庆祝方式。

dictates.t:
v. 口述、规定（三单）
n. 命令、要求

e.en: Common sense {dictates} that you wear a helmet here.
e.zh: 常识告诉你在这里要戴头盔。

e.en: He follows the {dictates} of his conscience above all.
e.zh: 他凡事首先遵从自己良心的指引。

e.en: She was {dictating} a letter when the phone rang.
e.zh: 电话响起时她正在口述一封信。

e.en: Stop {dictating} how I should live my own life.
e.zh: 别再对我该怎么生活指手画脚了。

e.en: The teacher gave the class a French {dictation} exercise.
e.zh: 老师让全班做了一个法语听写练习。

e.en: He uses voice {dictation} to write emails on his phone.
e.zh: 他用语音听写在手机上写邮件。

e.en: The {dictator} ruled the country with an iron fist.
e.zh: 这位独裁者以铁腕统治这个国家。

e.en: My little brother acts like a {dictator} at home.
e.zh: 我弟弟在家里像个小霸王。

e.en: His {dictatorial} management style drove employees to quit.
e.zh: 他独断专行的管理风格逼得员工纷纷辞职。

e.en: The new manager has a rather {dictatorial} attitude.
e.zh: 新经理的态度相当专横霸道。

e.en: History rarely remembers {dictators} kindly in the long run.
e.zh: 长远来看，历史很少善待独裁者。

e.en: Several {dictators} were overthrown during the last century.
e.zh: 上个世纪有好几个独裁者被推翻。

e.en: The country lived under a brutal {dictatorship} for decades.
e.zh: 这个国家在残酷的独裁统治下度过了几十年。

e.en: They feared the democracy might slide into {dictatorship}.
e.zh: 他们担心民主制度会滑向独裁。

e.en: News anchors are trained for clear and precise {diction}.
e.zh: 新闻主播会接受清晰准确发音的训练。

e.en: The poet's {diction} feels both modern and timeless.
e.zh: 这位诗人的用词既现代又永恒。

e.en: Most {dictionaries} now offer free apps and websites.
e.zh: 现在大多数词典都提供免费的应用和网站。

e.en: She owns rare {dictionaries} dating back to the 1800s.
e.zh: 她收藏着追溯到十九世纪的稀有词典。

e.en: I keep an English {dictionary} open while reading novels.
e.zh: 我读小说时会一直开着一本英语词典。

e.en: His name should be in the {dictionary} next to "stubborn."
e.zh: 他的名字应该印在词典里“固执”那一条旁边。

e.en: His favorite {dictum} was "never trust a quiet dog."
e.zh: 他最爱的格言是“别信安静的狗”。

e.en: The judge cited an old legal {dictum} in her ruling.
e.zh: 法官在裁决中引用了一句古老的法律格言。

e.en: She {did} all her homework before dinner last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在晚餐前就做完了所有作业。

e.en: What {did} you have for breakfast this morning?
e.zh: 你今天早上吃了什么？

e.en: The novel feels too {didactic} to enjoy as fiction.
e.zh: 这本小说说教意味太浓，作为小说读起来不够有趣。

e.en: His teaching style is engaging rather than dryly {didactic}.
e.zh: 他的教学风格很吸引人，而不是枯燥的说教。

e.en: Critics accused the film of heavy-handed {didacticism}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这部电影说教意味过重。

e.en: Good storytelling avoids the trap of obvious {didacticism}.
e.zh: 好的叙事会避开明显说教的陷阱。

didcot.t: n. 迪德科特（英国地名）

e.en: The train to {didcot} leaves from platform three.
e.zh: 开往迪德科特的火车从三号站台出发。

e.en: She caught a connection at {didcot} on her way home.
e.zh: 她回家途中在迪德科特换乘。

e.en: That salesman tried to {diddle} me out of fifty bucks.
e.zh: 那个推销员想骗走我五十块钱。

e.en: Don't let online scammers {diddle} you with fake offers.
e.zh: 别让网络骗子用假优惠把你骗了。

diderot.t: n. 狄德罗（法国哲学家）

e.en: {diderot} edited one of the most ambitious encyclopedias ever.
e.zh: 狄德罗主编了史上最雄心勃勃的百科全书之一。

e.en: The philosophy class spent a week discussing {diderot}.
e.zh: 哲学课花了一周时间讨论狄德罗。

didgeridoo.t: n. 迪吉里杜管（澳洲原住民乐器）

e.en: He learned to play the {didgeridoo} during his trip to Australia.
e.zh: 他在澳大利亚旅行时学会了吹迪吉里杜管。

e.en: The {didgeridoo} produced a deep, droning sound.
e.zh: 迪吉里杜管发出低沉而持续的嗡鸣声。

e.en: My older sister, my {didi}, taught me how to cook.
e.zh: 我姐姐教会了我做饭。

e.en: In Hindi, {didi} is an affectionate word for elder sister.
e.zh: 在印地语里，didi 是对姐姐的亲切称呼。

dido.t:
n. 狄多（迦太基女王）
n. 恶作剧

e.en: Queen {dido} founded the ancient city of Carthage.
e.zh: 狄多女王建立了古老的迦太基城。

e.en: The opera retells the tragic story of {dido}.
e.zh: 这部歌剧重述了狄多的悲剧故事。

didsbury.t: n. 迪兹伯里（英国地名）

e.en: She rents a flat in {didsbury}, south of Manchester.
e.zh: 她在曼彻斯特南边的迪兹伯里租了一套公寓。

e.en: There are great cafes all along {didsbury} village.
e.zh: 迪兹伯里村一带有许多很棒的咖啡馆。

didst.t: v. (古语) do 的第二人称过去式

e.en: "Why {didst} thou leave the kingdom?" the old king asked.
e.zh: 老国王问道：“你为何离开王国？”

e.en: Shakespeare often wrote "{didst} thou" in his plays.
e.zh: 莎士比亚在剧作中常用 didst thou 这样的说法。

e.en: The baby needed a fresh {didy} after the long nap.
e.zh: 长时间的午睡之后，宝宝需要换一块干净的尿布。

e.en: Grandma still calls a diaper a {didy} sometimes.
e.zh: 奶奶有时还把尿布叫做 didy。

die.t:
v. 死亡
n. 模具、骰子

e.en: The flowers will {die} if you forget to water them.
e.zh: 如果你忘了浇水，这些花就会枯死。

e.en: He rolled a six on the {die} and won the game.
e.zh: 他掷出一个六点，赢得了这局游戏。

e.en: The forest is suffering severe {dieback} due to drought.
e.zh: 由于干旱，这片森林正经历严重的枯梢现象。

e.en: Scientists study {dieback} in oak trees across Europe.
e.zh: 科学家在研究欧洲各地橡树的枯梢病。

e.en: My phone {died} right before I could call a taxi.
e.zh: 我刚要打车，手机就没电关机了。

e.en: Her grandfather {died} peacefully in his sleep last week.
e.zh: 她爷爷上周在睡梦中安详地去世了。

e.en: San {diego} has some of the best beaches in California.
e.zh: 圣迭戈拥有加州一些最好的海滩。

e.en: My friend {diego} just moved to Mexico City.
e.zh: 我朋友迭戈刚搬到墨西哥城。

diehard.t:
n. 顽固分子
adj. 死硬的

e.en: He's a {diehard} fan of the Lakers, win or lose.
e.zh: 无论输赢，他都是湖人队的铁杆球迷。

e.en: Only {diehard} supporters showed up in the rain.
e.zh: 只有最忠实的支持者才会冒雨到场。

dieldrin.t: n. 狄氏剂（一种杀虫剂）

e.en: {dieldrin} was banned after scientists discovered its toxic effects.
e.zh: 科学家发现狄氏剂的毒性后，它就被禁用了。

e.en: Old farms still test for {dieldrin} in their soil.
e.zh: 老农场仍会检测土壤中是否残留狄氏剂。

dielectric.t:
n. 电介质
adj. 非导电的

e.en: Capacitors rely on a {dielectric} material between two plates.
e.zh: 电容器依靠两个极板之间的电介质材料工作。

e.en: Engineers chose a ceramic {dielectric} for the new chip.
e.zh: 工程师为新芯片选用了陶瓷介电材料。

diem.t: n. (拉丁语) 日，如 per diem 每日津贴

e.en: My company pays a generous per {diem} for travel.
e.zh: 我们公司出差时会给一笔丰厚的每日津贴。

e.en: Carpe {diem} is tattooed on his left forearm.
e.zh: 他的左前臂上纹着“及时行乐”。

e.en: Battle of {dien} Bien Phu changed Vietnam's history forever.
e.zh: 奠边府战役永远改变了越南的历史。

e.en: The chemistry student studied {dien} ligands in metal complexes.
e.zh: 这位化学学生在研究金属配合物中的二烯配体。

dieppe.t: n. 迪耶普（法国港口城市）

e.en: We took the ferry from Newhaven to {dieppe} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐渡轮从纽黑文去了迪耶普。

e.en: The 1942 raid on {dieppe} was a costly Allied operation.
e.zh: 1942 年突袭迪耶普是盟军一次代价惨重的行动。

dies.t:
v. die 的三单
n. 模具（复数）

e.en: My laptop battery {dies} after just two hours of use.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑电池只用两小时就没电了。

e.en: In the play, the hero {dies} in the final act.
e.zh: 在这部剧中，主角在最后一幕死去。

e.en: Many trucks still run on {diesel} rather than electricity.
e.zh: 许多卡车仍然烧柴油而不是用电。

e.en: The price of {diesel} jumped again this week.
e.zh: 柴油价格本周又涨了。

diet.t:
n. 饮食、日常食物
v. 节食

e.en: She started a low-carb {diet} after the holidays.
e.zh: 假期结束后她开始了低碳水饮食。

e.en: A balanced {diet} keeps your energy levels steady.
e.zh: 均衡的饮食能让你的精力保持稳定。

e.en: The doctor gave me strict {dietary} guidelines after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后医生给了我严格的饮食指导。

e.en: Many people have {dietary} restrictions due to allergies or beliefs.
e.zh: 许多人因过敏或信仰而有饮食限制。

e.en: Every {dieter} struggles with cravings during the first week.
e.zh: 每个节食者在第一周都会与食欲作斗争。

e.en: The app helps each {dieter} log calories quickly.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助每位节食者快速记录卡路里。

e.en: The hospital serves {dietetic} meals to patients with diabetes.
e.zh: 医院为糖尿病患者提供特制的饮食餐。

e.en: She bought {dietetic} cookies that contain less sugar.
e.zh: 她买了含糖量较少的特制饮食饼干。

digestive.t:
adj. 消化的
n. 助消化食物

e.en: Yogurt is good for the {digestive} system.
e.zh: 酸奶对消化系统有好处。

e.en: He takes herbal tea to ease {digestive} discomfort.
e.zh: 他喝草药茶来缓解肠胃不适。

digests.t:
v. 消化；领会
n. 摘要

e.en: The app sends weekly {digests} of top news stories.
e.zh: 这款应用每周发送热门新闻摘要。

e.en: A baby's stomach {digests} milk faster than solid food.
e.zh: 婴儿的胃消化牛奶比固体食物更快。

e.en: A yellow {digger} was clearing rubble at the site.
e.zh: 一台黄色挖掘机正在工地清理瓦砾。

e.en: My nephew loves toy trucks and {digger} sets.
e.zh: 我侄子很喜欢玩具卡车和挖土机套装。

digging.t:
v. 挖掘（dig 的现在分词）
n. 发掘

e.en: The dog kept {digging} holes in the backyard.
e.zh: 那只狗一直在后院挖洞。

e.en: Reporters are {digging} into the company's finances.
e.zh: 记者们正在深挖那家公司的财务情况。

e.en: Y2K-style {digicam} photos are trending on social media again.
e.zh: 千禧年风格的数码相机照片在社交媒体上又火了。

e.en: She bought a vintage {digicam} for travel vlogs.
e.zh: 她买了一台复古数码相机来拍旅行视频。

digit.t:
n. 数字（0-9）；位
n. 手指、脚趾

e.en: Please enter the last four {digit} of your card number.
e.zh: 请输入卡号的最后四位数字。

e.en: The thumb is the strongest {digit} on the human hand.
e.zh: 拇指是人手上最有力的一根手指。

digital.t:
adj. 数字的；数码的
adj. 电子的、线上的

e.en: Most newspapers now publish a {digital} edition online.
e.zh: 大多数报纸现在都在网上发行电子版。

e.en: She bought a {digital} watch for her morning runs.
e.zh: 她买了一块电子手表用于晨跑。

e.en: Doctors once used {digitalis} to treat heart conditions.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用洋地黄治疗心脏病。

e.en: Foxglove plants contain the compound {digitalis}.
e.zh: 毛地黄植物中含有洋地黄这种成分。

e.en: The bank's {digitalisation} project cut paperwork in half.
e.zh: 这家银行的数字化项目让纸质文件减少了一半。

e.en: Schools are pushing the {digitalisation} of textbooks.
e.zh: 学校正在推动教科书的数字化。

e.en: Different {digitalisations} of public services produced mixed results.
e.zh: 公共服务的各种数字化方案产生了不一的结果。

e.en: The report compares {digitalisations} across European cities.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了欧洲各城市的数字化进程。

e.en: The library plans to {digitalise} its rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 图书馆计划将其珍贵手稿数字化。

e.en: Small clinics struggle to {digitalise} patient records.
e.zh: 小型诊所很难把病历资料数字化。

e.en: The museum has fully {digitalised} its photo archive.
e.zh: 博物馆已经把照片档案完全数字化了。

e.en: Most government forms have been {digitalised} since 2020.
e.zh: 自2020年起大多数政府表格已实现数字化。

e.en: This software {digitalises} old VHS tapes in minutes.
e.zh: 这款软件几分钟就能把老旧录像带数字化。

e.en: The team {digitalises} historical maps for researchers.
e.zh: 团队为研究人员把历史地图数字化。

e.en: They are {digitalising} thousands of vinyl records this year.
e.zh: 他们今年正在把数千张黑胶唱片数字化。

e.en: The hospital is slowly {digitalising} its admin workflow.
e.zh: 这家医院正在逐步将行政流程数字化。

e.en: {Digitalization} has transformed how small businesses operate.
e.zh: 数字化彻底改变了小企业的运营方式。

e.en: Rural areas often lag behind in {digitalization}.
e.zh: 农村地区在数字化方面常常落后。

e.en: Recent {digitalizations} of court records improved public access.
e.zh: 近期法院记录的数字化提升了公众查询的便利性。

e.en: Regional {digitalizations} differ widely in scope and budget.
e.zh: 各地区的数字化项目在规模和预算上差别很大。

e.en: Our goal is to {digitalize} every paper invoice by June.
e.zh: 我们的目标是在六月前把所有纸质发票数字化。

e.en: Many startups help traditional shops {digitalize} their sales.
e.zh: 许多初创公司帮助传统商店实现销售数字化。

e.en: The school {digitalized} its entire library catalog last year.
e.zh: 这所学校去年把整个图书馆目录都数字化了。

e.en: Once {digitalized}, the documents became searchable instantly.
e.zh: 文件一旦数字化,立刻就能进行搜索。

e.en: This platform {digitalizes} contracts and stores them securely.
e.zh: 这个平台把合同数字化并安全存储。

e.en: The new system {digitalizes} every step of the application.
e.zh: 新系统将申请流程的每一步都数字化。

e.en: The team is {digitalizing} customer records to improve service.
e.zh: 团队正在把客户资料数字化以提升服务质量。

e.en: Many factories are {digitalizing} their production lines.
e.zh: 许多工厂正在对生产线进行数字化改造。

digitally.t: adv. 以数字方式；在线地

e.en: You can sign the contract {digitally} on your phone.
e.zh: 你可以在手机上以电子方式签署合同。

e.en: The image was {digitally} restored to remove scratches.
e.zh: 这张图片经过数字修复以去除划痕。

e.en: We hired an intern to {digitise} the old company files.
e.zh: 我们请了一位实习生来把公司的旧档案数字化。

e.en: It takes hours to {digitise} a single audio cassette.
e.zh: 把一盘录音带数字化要花好几个小时。

e.en: The national archive has {digitised} millions of historical photos.
e.zh: 国家档案馆已将数百万张历史照片数字化。

e.en: Once {digitised}, the maps are free to download.
e.zh: 一旦数字化,这些地图便可免费下载。

e.en: The {digitization} of medical records has saved countless hours.
e.zh: 病历的数字化节省了大量时间。

e.en: Libraries received funding for the {digitization} of rare books.
e.zh: 图书馆获得了珍本书籍数字化的资金支持。

e.en: I want to {digitize} all my grandfather's old letters.
e.zh: 我想把祖父所有的旧信件都数字化保存。

e.en: Companies use AI to {digitize} handwritten forms quickly.
e.zh: 公司用人工智能快速把手写表格数字化。

e.en: The {digitized} version of the manuscript is freely available.
e.zh: 这份手稿的数字化版本可以免费查阅。

e.en: She {digitized} her family's home videos last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末把家里的家庭录像数字化了。

e.en: Architects use a {digitizer} to convert sketches into CAD files.
e.zh: 建筑师用数字化仪把手绘草图转成CAD文件。

e.en: The tablet's {digitizer} is sensitive to pen pressure.
e.zh: 这款平板的数字化感应板能感知笔的压力。

e.en: She gave a {dignified} response to the rude question.
e.zh: 面对那个无礼的问题,她作出了得体的回应。

e.en: The funeral was a quiet, {dignified} ceremony.
e.zh: 葬礼是一场安静而庄重的仪式。

e.en: His calm demeanor {dignifies} the entire courtroom.
e.zh: 他沉稳的举止让整个法庭显得庄重。

e.en: Such a serious reply only {dignifies} a silly rumor.
e.zh: 如此严肃地回应反而抬高了这个无聊的谣言。

e.en: I refuse to {dignify} that accusation with a response.
e.zh: 我拒绝回应那种指控,以免抬举它。

e.en: Simple uniforms can {dignify} workers in any profession.
e.zh: 简单的制服能让任何行业的员工显得体面。

dignifying.t: v. 使显得尊贵（进行时）

e.en: She walked away without {dignifying} his insult.
e.zh: 她转身离开,不去理会他的侮辱。

e.en: The mayor spoke about {dignifying} the lives of the homeless.
e.zh: 市长谈到要让无家可归者活得有尊严。

e.en: A foreign {dignitary} visited the palace this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午有一位外国政要参观了王宫。

e.en: Every {dignitary} at the summit received a private briefing.
e.zh: 峰会上的每位要员都获得了一份机密简报。

e.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with {dignity} and respect.
e.zh: 每个人都应当被有尊严地对待并受到尊重。

e.en: She faced the illness with remarkable {dignity}.
e.zh: 面对疾病她表现出了非凡的尊严。

e.en: The cardiologist prescribed {digoxin} for her irregular heartbeat.
e.zh: 心脏科医生为她的心律不齐开了地高辛。

e.en: Patients on {digoxin} need regular blood-level checks.
e.zh: 服用地高辛的病人需要定期检测血药浓度。

e.en: Sorry, I {digress} — let me get back to the main point.
e.zh: 抱歉跑题了,让我回到正题。

e.en: The professor tends to {digress} into personal anecdotes.
e.zh: 那位教授常常跑题讲起个人轶事。

e.en: After a brief {digression}, she returned to her argument.
e.zh: 短暂离题后,她又回到了自己的论点。

e.en: The book's many {digression} sections actually enrich the story.
e.zh: 书中众多的离题段落反而让故事更丰富。

e.en: His lectures are entertaining but a bit {digressive}.
e.zh: 他的讲座很有趣,但有点跑题。

e.en: The novel's {digressive} style isn't for everyone.
e.zh: 这本小说离题式的写法并非人人喜欢。

digs.t:
v. 挖掘（三单）
n. 住处；挖苦话

e.en: He always {digs} the garden before planting tomatoes.
e.zh: 他总是先翻土再种番茄。

e.en: The comedian threw a few {digs} at his rival on stage.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员在台上对对手讽刺了几句。

e.en: High {dihydrotestosterone} levels are linked to male pattern baldness.
e.zh: 双氢睾酮水平偏高与男性脱发有关。

e.en: The drug blocks the conversion of testosterone to {dihydrotestosterone}.
e.zh: 这种药物能阻断睾酮转化为双氢睾酮。

dijon.t: n. 第戎（法国城市）；第戎芥末

e.en: I love a sandwich with ham and {dijon} mustard.
e.zh: 我喜欢夹火腿和第戎芥末酱的三明治。

e.en: Whisk olive oil and {dijon} for a quick salad dressing.
e.zh: 把橄榄油和第戎芥末酱搅一搅就是简易沙拉酱。

e.en: The {dike} held back floodwaters during the heavy storm.
e.zh: 在暴风雨中那道堤坝挡住了洪水。

e.en: Workers reinforced the {dike} after the river rose.
e.zh: 河水上涨后工人们加固了堤坝。

diktat.t: n. 强制命令；霸王条款

e.en: Employees resented the new dress-code {diktat} from management.
e.zh: 员工们对管理层颁布的着装规定深感不满。

e.en: The treaty was seen by many as a foreign {diktat}.
e.zh: 许多人认为这份条约是外国强加的命令。

e.en: Without repairs, even sturdy buildings will eventually {dilapidate}.
e.zh: 没有维护,再坚固的建筑最终也会破败。

e.en: Cheap materials cause houses to {dilapidate} within a decade.
e.zh: 廉价材料会让房子十年内就破败不堪。

dilapidated.t: adj. 破旧的；年久失修的

e.en: They bought a {dilapidated} farmhouse and slowly restored it.
e.zh: 他们买下了一栋破旧的农舍,慢慢翻修。

e.en: The {dilapidated} bridge was finally closed for safety.
e.zh: 那座破旧的桥终于因安全问题被关闭。

e.en: Years of neglect led to the mansion's {dilapidation}.
e.zh: 多年无人打理使这座大宅破败不堪。

e.en: The report describes the {dilapidation} of public housing.
e.zh: 报告描述了公共住房的破败状况。

e.en: The doctor noted slight {dilatation} of the blood vessels.
e.zh: 医生注意到血管有轻微扩张。

e.en: Pupil {dilatation} can indicate certain neurological issues.
e.zh: 瞳孔扩张可能提示某些神经系统问题。

e.en: Your pupils naturally {dilate} in dim light.
e.zh: 在昏暗光线下瞳孔会自然放大。

e.en: The eye drops will {dilate} your pupils for the exam.
e.zh: 这些眼药水会让瞳孔散大以便检查。

e.en: The patient's pupils were {dilated} after the eye exam.
e.zh: 做完眼科检查后病人的瞳孔是散大的。

e.en: She had {dilated} blood vessels due to the heat.
e.zh: 她因为天热血管扩张了。

e.en: The doctor measured the {dilation} of her pupils carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细测量了她瞳孔的扩张程度。

e.en: Time {dilation} is a key concept in relativity.
e.zh: 时间膨胀是相对论中的一个关键概念。

e.en: The surgeon used a {dilator} to widen the passage.
e.zh: 外科医生用扩张器扩大通道。

e.en: This nasal {dilator} helps people breathe better at night.
e.zh: 这种鼻扩张器能帮助人们夜间更顺畅地呼吸。

e.en: His {dilatory} response cost the team the contract.
e.zh: 他拖拉的回应让团队失去了合同。

e.en: The committee was criticized for its {dilatory} tactics.
e.zh: 该委员会因其拖延战术而受到批评。

e.en: The shop sells a wide range of {dildo} products discreetly.
e.zh: 那家店低调地售卖各种假阳具产品。

e.en: She bought a silicone {dildo} from an online store.
e.zh: 她从网店买了一个硅胶假阳具。

e.en: I face a real {dilemma} about which job to accept.
e.zh: 我真的很纠结该接受哪份工作。

e.en: The ethical {dilemma} kept the doctor awake all night.
e.zh: 那道伦理难题让医生彻夜难眠。

e.en: Modern parents face new {dilemmas} about screen time.
e.zh: 现代父母在屏幕使用时间上面临新的难题。

e.en: The book explores moral {dilemmas} in wartime medicine.
e.zh: 这本书探讨战时医学中的道德困境。

dilettante.t: n. 半吊子；业余涉猎者

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a mere {dilettante} in art.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为艺术上的业余玩票者。

e.en: She refuses to be seen as a {dilettante} writer.
e.zh: 她拒绝被视为一个浅尝辄止的作家。

e.en: We flew into {Dili}, the capital of East Timor.
e.zh: 我们飞抵东帝汶首都帝力。

e.en: The conference will be held in {Dili} next March.
e.zh: 会议将于明年三月在帝力举行。

e.en: Her {diligence} on the project impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 她在项目上的勤奋给整个团队留下深刻印象。

e.en: Investors must do due {diligence} before signing the deal.
e.zh: 投资者在签约前必须做尽职调查。

e.en: The lawyer completed several {diligences} before closing the deal.
e.zh: 律师在交易完成前做了几项尽职调查。

e.en: Annual {diligences} are required for all major suppliers.
e.zh: 所有主要供应商每年都需进行尽职调查。

e.en: She is a {diligent} student who never misses class.
e.zh: 她是一个从不缺课的勤奋学生。

e.en: Be {diligent} when reviewing the contract terms.
e.zh: 审查合同条款时要认真细致。

e.en: He worked {diligently} to finish the report by Friday.
e.zh: 他勤奋工作以便在周五前完成报告。

e.en: The team trained {diligently} for the upcoming championship.
e.zh: 团队为即将到来的冠军赛刻苦训练。

e.en: Add fresh {dill} to the salmon for extra flavor.
e.zh: 在三文鱼上加些新鲜莳萝增添风味。

e.en: I love {dill} pickles with my sandwich.
e.zh: 我喜欢三明治配莳萝腌黄瓜。

dilute.t:
v. 稀释；冲淡
adj. 稀的

e.en: Please {dilute} the juice with some water before drinking.
e.zh: 请把果汁加水稀释后再喝。

e.en: Issuing more shares will {dilute} existing shareholders' stakes.
e.zh: 发行更多股票会稀释现有股东的股份。

e.en: The paint was too {diluted} to cover the wall properly.
e.zh: 涂料稀释得太薄,无法很好地覆盖墙面。

e.en: Her authority felt {diluted} after the restructuring.
e.zh: 重组后她的权威感觉被削弱了。

e.en: The new funding round caused significant {dilution} for early investors.
e.zh: 新一轮融资让早期投资者股权大幅稀释。

e.en: Proper {dilution} of the chemical is critical for safety.
e.zh: 正确稀释这种化学品对安全至关重要。

dim.t:
adj. 昏暗的；模糊的
v. 变暗

e.en: The lights were too {dim} to read by.
e.zh: 灯光太暗,看书都看不清。

e.en: Her chances of winning look {dim} this year.
e.zh: 她今年获胜的希望看起来很渺茫。

dime.t: n. 一角硬币（美国/加拿大）

e.en: I found a shiny {dime} on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 我在人行道上捡到一枚亮闪闪的十美分硬币。

e.en: The app gives advice without charging a {dime}.
e.zh: 这个应用免费提供建议,一分钱都不收。

e.en: This update adds a new {dimension} to the gameplay.
e.zh: 这次更新为游戏玩法增添了新的维度。

e.en: Please check the {dimension} of the box before shipping.
e.zh: 请在发货前检查箱子的尺寸。

e.en: The app renders {dimensional} models you can rotate freely.
e.zh: 这个应用可以渲染你能自由旋转的立体模型。

e.en: Her characters feel rich and {dimensional}, not flat.
e.zh: 她笔下的人物饱满立体,而非扁平单薄。

e.en: Reducing {dimensionality} helps the model train much faster.
e.zh: 降维有助于模型训练得更快。

e.en: High {dimensionality} can make data visualization quite tricky.
e.zh: 高维度会让数据可视化变得相当棘手。

dimensionless.t: adj. 无量纲的；无因次的

e.en: The Reynolds number is a {dimensionless} quantity in fluid dynamics.
e.zh: 雷诺数是流体力学中的一个无量纲量。

e.en: Engineers prefer {dimensionless} ratios for cross-system comparisons.
e.zh: 工程师偏好用无量纲比值进行跨系统比较。

dimensions.t: n. 尺寸；维度（dimension 的复数）

e.en: Please confirm the {dimensions} of the package before shipping.
e.zh: 请在发货前确认包裹的尺寸。

e.en: This problem has political and economic {dimensions} too.
e.zh: 这个问题还涉及政治和经济层面。

e.en: The protein forms a stable {dimer} under these conditions.
e.zh: 该蛋白质在此条件下形成稳定的二聚体。

e.en: Researchers detected a {dimer} structure in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在样品中检测到二聚体结构。

dimes.t: n. 一角硬币（dime 的复数）

e.en: He keeps a jar full of old {dimes} on his desk.
e.zh: 他桌上放着一罐装满旧十美分硬币的瓶子。

e.en: The machine only accepts quarters, not {dimes}.
e.zh: 这台机器只接受25美分硬币,不收10美分的。

e.en: The lab uses {dimethyl} sulfoxide as a common solvent.
e.zh: 实验室常用二甲基亚砜作为溶剂。

e.en: This compound contains a {dimethyl} group at the center.
e.zh: 这种化合物中心带有一个二甲基基团。

e.en: Practice will {diminish} the pain over a few weeks.
e.zh: 几周的练习能减轻这种疼痛。

e.en: Nothing can {diminish} her love for her children.
e.zh: 没有什么能减弱她对孩子的爱。

e.en: His influence has {diminished} since leaving the company.
e.zh: 自从离开公司,他的影响力就减弱了。

e.en: The pianist played a {diminished} chord with feeling.
e.zh: 钢琴家充满感情地弹奏了一个减和弦。

e.en: Stress {diminishes} your ability to focus on tasks.
e.zh: 压力会削弱你专注于任务的能力。

e.en: Each retelling slightly {diminishes} the impact of the story.
e.zh: 每讲一次故事的冲击力都会稍稍减弱。

diminishing.t: adj. 递减的；逐渐减少的

e.en: We're seeing {diminishing} returns from the marketing campaign.
e.zh: 我们看到这场营销活动的回报正在递减。

e.en: Her enthusiasm seemed to be slowly {diminishing} over time.
e.zh: 她的热情似乎随着时间在慢慢减退。

e.en: The treaty resulted in a {diminishment} of military tensions.
e.zh: 该条约带来了军事紧张关系的缓和。

e.en: He felt a {diminishment} of his status after the demotion.
e.zh: 降职后他感到自己地位有所下降。

e.en: The orchestra ended the piece with a soft {diminuendo}.
e.zh: 乐队以一段柔和的渐弱结束了这首曲子。

e.en: The composer marked a long {diminuendo} in the final bars.
e.zh: 作曲家在最后几小节标注了长长的渐弱记号。

e.en: There has been a noticeable {diminution} in air quality.
e.zh: 空气质量出现了明显的下降。

e.en: The report warns of a {diminution} in consumer confidence.
e.zh: 报告警告消费者信心正在下降。

diminutive.t:
adj. 小巧的
n. 昵称；指小词

e.en: The {diminutive} kitten fit easily inside his coat pocket.
e.zh: 那只小巧的猫咪轻松地装进了他的外套口袋。

e.en: "Tommy" is the {diminutive} form of Thomas.
e.zh: Tommy 是 Thomas 的昵称形式。

e.en: She wore a soft {dimity} dress to the garden party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件柔软的棱纹平布连衣裙参加花园派对。

e.en: The curtains were made of pale blue {dimity}.
e.zh: 窗帘是用淡蓝色棱纹平布做的。

e.en: The room was {dimly} lit by a single candle.
e.zh: 房间被一支蜡烛微弱地照亮着。

e.en: I can {dimly} remember meeting her years ago.
e.zh: 我依稀记得多年前见过她。

e.en: The lights {dimmed} as the movie was about to start.
e.zh: 电影即将开始时灯光变暗了。

e.en: Recent setbacks haven't {dimmed} her optimism at all.
e.zh: 近期的挫折丝毫没有削弱她的乐观。

dimmer.t:
n. 调光器
adj. 更暗的

e.en: Install a {dimmer} switch to control the brightness easily.
e.zh: 装一个调光开关,可以方便地控制亮度。

e.en: The hallway feels {dimmer} since we changed the bulbs.
e.zh: 换了灯泡后走廊感觉更暗了。

e.en: Auto-{dimming} headlights help reduce glare for oncoming drivers.
e.zh: 自动调光大灯有助于减少对面驾驶员的眩光。

e.en: The screen keeps {dimming} every few seconds.
e.zh: 屏幕每隔几秒就会变暗一次。

e.en: My eyes slowly adjusted to the {dimness} of the cave.
e.zh: 我的眼睛慢慢适应了洞穴里的昏暗。

e.en: The {dimness} of the lamp made reading difficult.
e.zh: 灯光的昏暗让阅读变得困难。

dimorphic.t: adj. 二态的；两种形态的

e.en: Many bird species are sexually {dimorphic} in plumage color.
e.zh: 许多鸟类在羽毛颜色上具有性别二态性。

e.en: This fungus shows {dimorphic} growth depending on temperature.
e.zh: 这种真菌根据温度呈现两种不同的生长形态。

e.en: Sexual {dimorphism} is striking in peacocks and peahens.
e.zh: 孔雀的雌雄二态性表现得十分明显。

e.en: Researchers studied size {dimorphism} between male and female spiders.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了雌雄蜘蛛之间的体型二态性。

e.en: She has a cute {dimple} when she smiles.
e.zh: 她笑起来有一个可爱的酒窝。

e.en: There's a small {dimple} on the surface of the golf ball.
e.zh: 高尔夫球表面有一个小凹坑。

dimpled.t: adj. 有酒窝的；有凹陷的

e.en: The baby's {dimpled} cheeks made everyone smile.
e.zh: 宝宝带酒窝的脸颊让每个人都微笑起来。

e.en: He served the soup in a {dimpled} ceramic bowl.
e.zh: 他用一个带凹纹的陶瓷碗盛汤端上来。

e.en: Don't be such a {dimwit} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么笨,先看说明书。

e.en: The character is portrayed as a lovable {dimwit}.
e.zh: 这个角色被刻画成一个可爱的傻瓜。

e.en: The museum's {diplodocus} skeleton stretches across the entire hall.
e.zh: 博物馆里的梁龙骨架横跨了整个大厅。

e.en: A full-grown {diplodocus} could reach almost thirty meters long.
e.zh: 成年梁龙的体长可达近三十米。

diploid.t:
adj. 二倍体的
n. 二倍体

e.en: Most human body cells are {diploid}, carrying two chromosome sets.
e.zh: 大多数人体细胞是二倍体,带有两套染色体。

e.en: The biologist compared {diploid} and haploid stages of the plant.
e.zh: 那位生物学家比较了这种植物的二倍体和单倍体阶段。

e.en: She framed her college {diploma} above her desk.
e.zh: 她把大学毕业证书装裱挂在书桌上方。

e.en: You'll need a high school {diploma} to apply.
e.zh: 申请该职位需要高中毕业证书。

e.en: Quiet {diplomacy} ended the dispute before it escalated.
e.zh: 低调的外交斡旋在争端升级前就将其平息。

e.en: Telling your boss bad news requires real {diplomacy}.
e.zh: 向老板汇报坏消息需要真正的处事手腕。

e.en: The graduates proudly held up their new {diplomas}.
e.zh: 毕业生们自豪地举起了崭新的毕业证书。

e.en: Online courses now offer recognized {diplomas} in many fields.
e.zh: 网络课程如今在许多领域都能提供受认可的文凭。

e.en: The young {diplomat} was posted to the embassy in Tokyo.
e.zh: 这位年轻外交官被派驻到东京的大使馆。

e.en: You need to be a real {diplomat} at family dinners.
e.zh: 在家庭聚餐时你得做个真正会处事的人。

e.en: She is a board-certified {diplomate} in internal medicine.
e.zh: 她是经认证的内科委员会专科医师。

e.en: Becoming a {diplomate} required years of training and exams.
e.zh: 成为专科委员会认证医师需要多年的培训和考试。

e.en: The two nations restored {diplomatic} relations after decades.
e.zh: 两国在几十年后恢复了外交关系。

e.en: She gave a {diplomatic} answer to the awkward question.
e.zh: 她对那个尴尬的问题给出了一个圆滑的回答。

e.en: He {diplomatically} declined the invitation without offending anyone.
e.zh: 他得体地婉拒了邀请,没有得罪任何人。

e.en: She handled the complaint {diplomatically} and kept the client.
e.zh: 她圆融地处理了投诉,留住了客户。

e.en: Foreign {diplomats} gathered at the embassy for the reception.
e.zh: 各国外交官齐聚大使馆出席招待会。

e.en: Several {diplomats} were expelled following the spying scandal.
e.zh: 间谍丑闻发生后,几名外交官被驱逐出境。

e.en: The patient complained of sudden {diplopia} after the accident.
e.zh: 病人主诉事故后突然出现复视。

e.en: Untreated {diplopia} can make driving extremely dangerous.
e.zh: 未经治疗的复视会使开车变得极其危险。

e.en: Water has a strongly {dipolar} structure that helps dissolve salts.
e.zh: 水具有很强的偶极结构，有助于溶解盐类。

e.en: The molecule shows {dipolar} behavior in an electric field.
e.zh: 该分子在电场中表现出偶极特性。

e.en: A simple antenna often uses a half-wave {dipole} design.
e.zh: 简单的天线常采用半波偶极子设计。

e.en: Each water molecule acts like a tiny {dipole}.
e.zh: 每个水分子都像一个微小的偶极子。

dipped.t:
v. 浸，蘸（过去式）
v. 下降

e.en: She {dipped} the cookie into her hot coffee.
e.zh: 她把饼干浸到热咖啡里。

e.en: Stock prices {dipped} sharply after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报公布后股价大幅下跌。

e.en: He used a metal {dipper} to scoop water from the well.
e.zh: 他用金属勺从井里舀水。

e.en: The Big {Dipper} is easy to spot in the night sky.
e.zh: 北斗七星在夜空中很容易辨认。

dipping.t:
v. 浸，蘸（进行时）
adj. 下倾的

e.en: The chips come with three {dipping} sauces.
e.zh: 薯条配有三种蘸酱。

e.en: Temperatures are {dipping} below freezing tonight.
e.zh: 今晚气温将降至零度以下。

e.en: My aunt has a {dippy} sense of humor that everyone loves.
e.zh: 我姑妈有一种傻乎乎的幽默感，大家都喜欢。

e.en: That's a {dippy} idea, but it might just work.
e.zh: 那是个傻点子，但说不定真行得通。

dips.t:
n. 蘸酱；下降
v. 浸，蘸

e.en: The road {dips} sharply just before the bridge.
e.zh: 道路在桥前急剧下降。

e.en: She brought chips and three different {dips} to the party.
e.zh: 她带了薯片和三种蘸酱来参加聚会。

e.en: Some {dipshit} parked across two spaces again.
e.zh: 又有个蠢货横跨两个车位停车了。

e.en: Don't be a {dipshit} and read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别犯蠢，先看说明书。

e.en: The novel's hero struggles with {dipsomania} and lost love.
e.zh: 小说主角同时承受着酗酒癖和失恋之痛。

e.en: Doctors once treated {dipsomania} as a moral failing.
e.zh: 医生曾经把酗酒癖视为一种道德缺陷。

dipstick.t: n. 量油尺，液位计量杆

e.en: Pull out the {dipstick} to check the engine oil level.
e.zh: 拔出油尺检查机油液位。

e.en: Wipe the {dipstick} clean before taking a reading.
e.zh: 读数前先把油尺擦干净。

e.en: The museum displayed a medieval {diptych} of carved ivory.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件中世纪的象牙雕刻双联画。

e.en: Her photo {diptych} pairs an old portrait with a new one.
e.zh: 她的双联摄影作品把一张旧肖像与一张新肖像并置。

e.en: Type {dir} in the command prompt to list folder contents.
e.zh: 在命令提示符里输入 dir 可以列出文件夹内容。

e.en: The script reads every file in the current {dir}.
e.zh: 脚本会读取当前目录下的每个文件。

dire.t: adj. 可怕的；紧急严峻的

e.en: The refugees are in {dire} need of clean water.
e.zh: 难民们急需干净的饮用水。

e.en: Missing the deadline could have {dire} consequences.
e.zh: 错过截止日期可能带来严重后果。

direct.t:
adj. 直接的
v. 指导，指挥

e.en: Is there a {direct} flight from Beijing to Boston?
e.zh: 有从北京到波士顿的直飞航班吗？

e.en: Please {direct} all questions to the support team.
e.zh: 请把所有问题转交给客服团队。

directed.t:
adj. 定向的
v. 指导（过去式）

e.en: She {directed} the new manager to the conference room.
e.zh: 她把新经理领到了会议室。

e.en: The film was {directed} by a first-time filmmaker.
e.zh: 这部电影由一位新人导演执导。

e.en: He spent years {directing} commercials before making a feature.
e.zh: 他执导了多年广告才开始拍长片。

e.en: A police officer was {directing} traffic at the intersection.
e.zh: 一名警察正在路口指挥交通。

e.en: We're walking in the wrong {direction} — the cafe is back there.
e.zh: 我们走错方向了，咖啡馆在那边。

e.en: The team needs clearer {direction} from management.
e.zh: 团队需要管理层给出更明确的方向。

directional.t: adj. 定向的，有方向性的

e.en: A {directional} microphone picks up sound from one side only.
e.zh: 定向麦克风只接收来自一侧的声音。

e.en: Always use your {directional} signals before turning.
e.zh: 转弯前一定要打方向灯。

e.en: The study examines the {directionality} of the relationship between sleep and mood.
e.zh: 该研究探讨睡眠与情绪之间关系的方向性。

e.en: Sound {directionality} matters a lot in surround systems.
e.zh: 在环绕声系统中，声音的方向性非常重要。

e.en: The forecast is {directionally} correct, even if the numbers shift.
e.zh: 即使具体数字会变，预测的方向大致是对的。

e.en: These two graphs move {directionally} together over time.
e.zh: 这两张图随时间在方向上同步变化。

directionless.t: adj. 没有方向的，迷茫的

e.en: After graduating, he felt completely {directionless} for a year.
e.zh: 毕业后，他有整整一年感到迷茫无方向。

e.en: The meeting was long and {directionless}.
e.zh: 那场会议又长又没有重点。

directions.t: n. 方向；使用说明；路线指引

e.en: Could you give me {directions} to the nearest subway?
e.zh: 可以告诉我去最近地铁站怎么走吗？

e.en: Read all the {directions} before assembling the shelf.
e.zh: 组装书架前请先看完所有说明。

directive.t:
n. 指令，指示
adj. 指导的

e.en: The CEO issued a new {directive} on remote work.
e.zh: 首席执行官发布了关于远程办公的新指令。

e.en: His tone was firm and {directive}, leaving no room for debate.
e.zh: 他语气坚决且具命令性，不容争辩。

e.en: You can email me {directly} if you have questions.
e.zh: 如果有问题可以直接给我发邮件。

e.en: The post office is {directly} across the street.
e.zh: 邮局就在街对面正对面的位置。

e.en: I appreciate your {directness} — just tell me the truth.
e.zh: 我欣赏你的直率，请直接告诉我真相。

e.en: Her {directness} sometimes shocks more reserved colleagues.
e.zh: 她的直接有时让较内敛的同事感到吃惊。

e.en: The {director} called for another take of the scene.
e.zh: 导演要求这场戏再拍一条。

e.en: She was promoted to {director} of marketing last month.
e.zh: 她上个月升任市场营销总监。

e.en: The intelligence {directorate} oversees foreign operations.
e.zh: 该情报局负责管理对外行动。

e.en: Funding decisions are made by the research {directorate}.
e.zh: 经费决定由研究理事会作出。

e.en: The film marks her {directorial} debut.
e.zh: 这部电影是她的导演处女作。

e.en: His {directorial} style favors long, quiet takes.
e.zh: 他的导演风格偏爱长而安静的镜头。

e.en: The script scans all {directories} under the project root.
e.zh: 脚本会扫描项目根目录下的所有目录。

e.en: Old phone {directories} are now collector's items.
e.zh: 旧的电话簿如今成了收藏品。

e.en: The board of {directors} meets every quarter.
e.zh: 董事会每季度召开一次会议。

e.en: Several famous {directors} attended the festival.
e.zh: 几位著名导演出席了电影节。

directorship.t: n. 主管职位，董事职位

e.en: She accepted the {directorship} of the new research center.
e.zh: 她接受了新研究中心的主任职位。

e.en: His {directorship} lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他的董事任期持续了近十年。

e.en: Save the file in your home {directory}.
e.zh: 把文件保存到你的主目录里。

e.en: Look up her number in the staff {directory}.
e.zh: 在员工通讯录里查她的电话号码。

e.en: The app {directs} you to the nearest charging station.
e.zh: 这款应用会引导你前往最近的充电站。

e.en: She {directs} a small theater company in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 她在布鲁克林经营一家小剧团。

e.en: A slow {dirge} played as the procession passed.
e.zh: 队伍经过时奏起了缓慢的挽歌。

e.en: The album closes with a haunting {dirge} for lost friends.
e.zh: 专辑以一首悼念逝友的凄美挽歌作结。

dirigible.t:
n. 飞艇
adj. 可操纵的

e.en: A massive {dirigible} floated silently over the city.
e.zh: 一艘巨大的飞艇静静地飘过城市上空。

e.en: The museum displays a model of an early {dirigible}.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了一架早期飞艇的模型。

e.en: The country follows a largely {dirigiste} economic model.
e.zh: 该国采用的基本上是国家统制的经济模式。

e.en: Critics call the new policy overly {dirigiste}.
e.zh: 批评者认为新政策过于干预经济。

e.en: The Highland soldier carried a small {dirk} at his belt.
e.zh: 那名高地士兵腰间别着一把小匕首。

e.en: Museums often display ornate Scottish {dirk} blades.
e.zh: 博物馆里常陈列装饰华丽的苏格兰匕首。

e.en: She wore a traditional {dirndl} to the Bavarian festival.
e.zh: 她穿着传统的德式连衣裙参加巴伐利亚节庆。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {dirndl} dresses for Oktoberfest.
e.zh: 这家店出售为啤酒节定制的手工迪恩德尔裙。

e.en: The proposal received several {disapprovals} from the board.
e.zh: 该提案收到了董事会的几次否决。

e.en: Critics' {disapprovals} did not stop the film's success.
e.zh: 评论家的反对并没有阻止这部电影的成功。

e.en: My grandparents {disapprove} of tattoos and piercings.
e.zh: 我祖父母不赞成纹身和穿孔。

e.en: Many users {disapprove} of the app's new pricing model.
e.zh: 许多用户不赞成这款应用的新定价模式。

e.en: His loan application was {disapproved} by the bank.
e.zh: 他的贷款申请被银行拒绝了。

e.en: She {disapproved} of the way her son spent his weekends.
e.zh: 她不赞成儿子度过周末的方式。

disapproves.t: v. 不赞成（第三人称单数）

e.en: My boss {disapproves} of working from coffee shops.
e.zh: 我老板不赞成在咖啡店办公。

e.en: He clearly {disapproves} of the team's casual dress code.
e.zh: 他显然不赞成团队的休闲着装规定。

disapproving.t:
adj. 不以为然的
v. 不赞成（现在分词）

e.en: She gave him a {disapproving} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去不赞成的目光。

e.en: His mother's {disapproving} silence said everything.
e.zh: 母亲不悦的沉默说明了一切。

disapprovingly.t: adv. 不以为然地；反对地

e.en: The librarian frowned {disapprovingly} at the loud students.
e.zh: 图书管理员不悦地皱眉看着吵闹的学生。

e.en: He shook his head {disapprovingly} when she mentioned it.
e.zh: 她提到这事时,他不赞成地摇了摇头。

e.en: Her warm smile can {disarm} even the angriest customer.
e.zh: 她温暖的微笑能让最愤怒的顾客也消气。

e.en: The treaty required both nations to {disarm} gradually.
e.zh: 该条约要求两国逐步裁军。

e.en: The two countries signed a nuclear {disarmament} agreement.
e.zh: 两国签署了核裁军协议。

e.en: Activists have long called for global {disarmament}.
e.zh: 活动人士长期以来一直呼吁全球裁军。

disarming.t: adj. 让人放下戒心的；令人消气的

e.en: He has a {disarming} honesty that puts everyone at ease.
e.zh: 他有一种让人卸下防备的真诚。

e.en: Her {disarming} smile won over the entire interview panel.
e.zh: 她令人解除戒心的微笑赢得了整个面试小组的好感。

e.en: He spoke {disarmingly} about his own failures and doubts.
e.zh: 他坦率得让人卸下防备地谈起自己的失败与疑虑。

e.en: The CEO was {disarmingly} candid in the interview.
e.zh: 那位CEO在采访中坦诚得让人放下戒心。

e.en: Please don't {disarrange} the books I just sorted.
e.zh: 请不要把我刚整理好的书弄乱。

e.en: A sudden gust can {disarrange} her perfectly styled hair.
e.zh: 一阵突来的风就能吹乱她精心打理的发型。

e.en: The office was in complete {disarray} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家后办公室一片混乱。

e.en: The team fell into {disarray} when their captain left.
e.zh: 队长离开后,球队陷入了混乱。

e.en: The museum displayed the careful {disarticulation} of the dinosaur skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了恐龙骨架被精心拆解后的样子。

e.en: Surgeons studied the {disarticulation} of the shoulder joint after the injury.
e.zh: 外科医生研究了受伤后肩关节的脱位情况。

e.en: You need a special tool to {disassemble} the new iPhone.
e.zh: 拆解新款 iPhone 需要专用工具。

e.en: Engineers had to {disassemble} the engine to find the leak.
e.zh: 工程师不得不拆开发动机来找漏油点。

e.en: He {disassembled} the old computer and sold the parts online.
e.zh: 他把旧电脑拆开,把零件挂到网上卖。

e.en: The bookshelf arrived {disassembled} in a flat cardboard box.
e.zh: 书架是拆装好装在扁平纸箱里寄来的。

e.en: The repair guide includes step-by-step {disassembly} photos.
e.zh: 维修指南附有逐步拆解的图片。

e.en: Improper {disassembly} of the battery can cause a fire.
e.zh: 电池拆解不当可能引起起火。

e.en: The brand tried to {disassociate} itself from the controversial influencer.
e.zh: 该品牌试图与那位争议网红撇清关系。

e.en: It's hard to {disassociate} the song from that summer trip.
e.zh: 很难把那首歌和那次夏日旅行分开来听。

e.en: Her public {disassociation} from the project surprised many fans.
e.zh: 她公开与该项目划清界限,让很多粉丝感到意外。

e.en: The report called for full {disassociation} from the parent company.
e.zh: 报告要求与母公司彻底切割关系。

e.en: The launch was a complete {disaster} — the servers crashed instantly.
e.zh: 这次上线彻底翻车,服务器瞬间就崩了。

e.en: Volunteers rushed in to help after the natural {disaster}.
e.zh: 自然灾害发生后,志愿者迅速赶来支援。

e.en: Climate change is making extreme weather {disasters} more frequent.
e.zh: 气候变化让极端天气灾害变得越来越频繁。

e.en: His first three startups were all {disasters}, but he kept going.
e.zh: 他前三次创业都惨败,但他没有放弃。

e.en: Skipping the backup turned out to be a {disastrous} decision.
e.zh: 没做备份这件事最后被证明是个灾难性的决定。

e.en: The team suffered a {disastrous} loss in the final round.
e.zh: 球队在决赛轮遭遇了惨败。

e.en: The product launch went {disastrously} wrong on day one.
e.zh: 产品上线第一天就糟糕得一塌糊涂。

e.en: He {disastrously} underestimated how long the migration would take.
e.zh: 他严重低估了迁移所需的时间。

e.en: The CEO was quick to {disavow} the leaked internal memo.
e.zh: CEO 迅速撇清了与那份外泄内部备忘录的关系。

e.en: Several lawmakers {disavow} the extreme views of their party's fringe.
e.zh: 几位议员公开否认本党极端派的观点。

e.en: His public {disavowal} of the rumor calmed investors.
e.zh: 他公开否认谣言,安抚了投资者。

e.en: The party issued a strong {disavowal} of the violent protest.
e.zh: 该党发表声明,强烈谴责并撇清那场暴力抗议。

e.en: The band decided to {disband} after their final tour.
e.zh: 乐队在最后一次巡演结束后决定解散。

e.en: Officials moved to {disband} the controversial committee last week.
e.zh: 官员上周着手解散这个有争议的委员会。

e.en: The startup {disbanded} its hardware team to focus on software.
e.zh: 这家创业公司解散了硬件团队,专注于做软件。

e.en: After three albums together, the group quietly {disbanded}.
e.zh: 出过三张专辑之后,这个组合悄无声息地解散了。

e.en: Fans were heartbroken at the news of the band {disbanding}.
e.zh: 听到乐队解散的消息,粉丝们都心碎了。

e.en: The committee is {disbanding} after completing its final report.
e.zh: 委员会在完成最终报告后正式解散。

e.en: The {disbandment} of the task force was announced this morning.
e.zh: 今早官方宣布了该专案小组的解散决定。

e.en: Members opposed the sudden {disbandment} of their longtime club.
e.zh: 成员们反对突然解散这个老牌俱乐部的决定。

e.en: The court voted to {disbar} the lawyer for repeated misconduct.
e.zh: 法院投票决定吊销这位律师的执业资格,因其屡次违规。

e.en: Judges rarely {disbar} attorneys without overwhelming evidence.
e.zh: 没有确凿证据,法官极少取消律师的执业资格。

e.en: He is fighting his {disbarment} in a higher court.
e.zh: 他正在上级法院对吊销执照的处分提起申诉。

e.en: The scandal led to the swift {disbarment} of two senior partners.
e.zh: 这起丑闻导致两位资深合伙人被迅速吊销律师资格。

disbarred.t: v. 取消律师资格（过去式）

e.en: The attorney was {disbarred} after stealing from his clients' accounts.
e.zh: 这位律师因挪用客户账户资金而被取消执业资格。

e.en: Once {disbarred}, returning to legal practice is extremely difficult.
e.zh: 一旦被吊销执照,想再执业可以说是难上加难。

e.en: She stared at the screen in total {disbelief}.
e.zh: 她目瞪口呆地盯着屏幕,完全不敢相信。

e.en: There was widespread {disbelief} when the company filed for bankruptcy.
e.zh: 公司申请破产时,众人普遍感到难以置信。

e.en: I have no reason to {disbelieve} her side of the story.
e.zh: 我没有理由不相信她那一面的说法。

e.en: Many readers {disbelieve} statistics that lack a clear source.
e.zh: 很多读者并不相信那些没有明确出处的数据。

e.en: He gave me a {disbelieving} look when I said I cooked it.
e.zh: 我说这是我自己做的,他露出一脸不信的表情。

e.en: The audience sat in {disbelieving} silence after the twist ending.
e.zh: 反转结局之后,观众都难以置信地沉默不语。

e.en: She shook her head {disbelievingly} at the price tag.
e.zh: 她看着那个价格标签,难以置信地摇了摇头。

e.en: He stared {disbelievingly} as the underdog scored the winning goal.
e.zh: 看到弱队踢进绝杀球,他难以置信地盯着球场。

e.en: The bank will {disburse} the loan funds within five business days.
e.zh: 银行会在五个工作日内发放这笔贷款。

e.en: Charities {disburse} aid faster when documents are submitted online.
e.zh: 在线提交材料时,慈善机构发放援助会更快。

e.en: The first {disbursement} of scholarship money arrived this morning.
e.zh: 第一笔奖学金已在今天上午到账。

e.en: Tracking each {disbursement} keeps the project budget transparent.
e.zh: 追踪每一笔款项的支出能让项目预算保持透明。

e.en: He still buys music on {disc} instead of streaming it.
e.zh: 他还是买实体光盘听音乐,而不是用流媒体。

e.en: The doctor said a slipped {disc} was causing her back pain.
e.zh: 医生说她的腰痛是椎间盘突出引起的。

e.en: Please {discard} any food past its expiration date.
e.zh: 请把所有过期的食物都扔掉。

e.en: You can {discard} two cards and draw new ones each turn.
e.zh: 每回合你可以弃掉两张牌,然后再抽新的。

discarded.t:
adj. 被丢弃的
v. 丢弃（过去式）

e.en: She {discarded} the old draft and started writing from scratch.
e.zh: 她丢掉了旧稿,从头开始重写。

e.en: Volunteers cleaned up {discarded} masks left along the hiking trail.
e.zh: 志愿者清理了登山道上随手丢弃的口罩。

e.en: Before {discarding} your phone, make sure to wipe all data.
e.zh: 扔掉旧手机前,记得把所有数据清除干净。

e.en: He kept {discarding} ideas until only the strongest one remained.
e.zh: 他不断淘汰想法,直到只剩下最有力的那一个。

discards.t: v. 丢弃（第三人称单数）

e.en: The thrift store sells what other people {discards} as treasure.
e.zh: 二手店把别人丢掉的东西当作宝贝来卖。

e.en: Place your {discards} face up in the middle of the table.
e.zh: 把弃掉的牌正面朝上放在桌子中央。

e.en: It's hard to {discern} sarcasm in short text messages.
e.zh: 在简短的短信里很难分辨出讽刺的语气。

e.en: Investors must {discern} real trends from passing hype.
e.zh: 投资者必须能区分真正的趋势和一时的炒作。

e.en: There was no {discernable} difference between the two coffee samples.
e.zh: 两份咖啡样品之间没有可察觉的差别。

e.en: A faint smell of smoke was barely {discernable} in the room.
e.zh: 房间里隐约能闻到一丝烟味。

discernible.t: adj. 可辨认的；看得出的

e.en: There's a {discernible} improvement in the new model's response speed.
e.zh: 新模型在响应速度上有明显可见的提升。

e.en: The handwriting was barely {discernible} on the faded postcard.
e.zh: 那张褪色明信片上的字迹几乎看不清楚。

e.en: The room grew {discernibly} colder after the heater shut off.
e.zh: 暖气一关,房间就明显变冷了。

e.en: Her tone shifted {discernibly} when the topic changed to money.
e.zh: 话题一转到钱,她的语气就明显变了。

discerning.t: adj. 有眼光的；有鉴赏力的

e.en: This menu is designed for the {discerning} coffee drinker.
e.zh: 这份菜单是为有品位的咖啡爱好者设计的。

e.en: A {discerning} editor can spot weak arguments in seconds.
e.zh: 眼光敏锐的编辑能在几秒内看出薄弱的论点。

e.en: Good design requires both creativity and {discernment}.
e.zh: 好的设计既需要创造力,也需要鉴赏力。

e.en: Parents teach kids {discernment} when navigating online content.
e.zh: 家长会教孩子在浏览网络内容时学会判断和辨别。

discharge.t:
v. 排出；释放；出院
n. 排放物；解雇

e.en: The hospital plans to {discharge} her tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 医院计划明天上午让她出院。

e.en: The factory was fined for illegal {discharge} into the river.
e.zh: 这家工厂因向河中非法排污而被罚款。

e.en: He was {discharged} from the army after eight years of service.
e.zh: 服役八年后,他从部队退役了。

e.en: The battery {discharged} overnight because of a buggy app.
e.zh: 因为一个有 bug 的 app,电池一晚上就耗光了。

e.en: The {din} of the construction site woke me early.
e.zh: 工地的喧闹声很早就把我吵醒了。

e.en: I could barely hear her over the {din} of traffic.
e.zh: 在车流的喧闹声中我几乎听不见她说话。

dinar.t: n. 第纳尔（多国货币单位）

e.en: He exchanged dollars for the local {dinar} at the airport.
e.zh: 他在机场把美元换成了当地的第纳尔。

e.en: The {dinar} has weakened against the euro this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度第纳尔对欧元有所走弱。

dine.t: v. 用餐，进餐（尤指正餐）

e.en: We plan to {dine} at the new Italian restaurant tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚打算在那家新开的意大利餐厅用餐。

e.en: Members can {dine} for free on their birthdays.
e.zh: 会员在生日当天可以免费用餐。

diner.t:
n. 小餐馆
n. 用餐者

e.en: Let's grab breakfast at the {diner} on the corner.
e.zh: 我们去街角那家小餐馆吃早餐吧。

e.en: Each {diner} received a complimentary glass of wine.
e.zh: 每位用餐者都获赠了一杯葡萄酒。

dinero.t: n. 钱（俚语，源自西班牙语）

e.en: He's making serious {dinero} from his side hustle.
e.zh: 他靠副业赚了不少钱。

e.en: That fancy car must have cost some real {dinero}.
e.zh: 那辆豪车肯定花了一大笔钱。

e.en: We squeezed a small {dinette} into the kitchen corner.
e.zh: 我们在厨房角落塞下了一个小餐桌椅组。

e.en: The apartment came with a charming {dinette} set.
e.zh: 这间公寓配有一套精致的小餐桌椅。

ding.t:
n. 叮当声
v. 碰伤，撞凹

e.en: My phone made a soft {ding} when the message arrived.
e.zh: 消息到达时我的手机轻轻响了一声。

e.en: There's a small {ding} on the car door.
e.zh: 车门上有一个小凹痕。

dingbat.t:
n. 装饰字符
n. 傻瓜（俚语）

e.en: The designer added decorative {dingbat} symbols between paragraphs.
e.zh: 设计师在段落之间加了装饰性的小图饰符号。

e.en: My uncle calls his forgetful neighbor a lovable {dingbat}.
e.zh: 我叔叔把那位健忘的邻居称作可爱的傻瓜。

e.en: They rowed the small {dinghy} back to the yacht.
e.zh: 他们划着小舢板回到游艇上。

e.en: A rubber {dinghy} carried the survivors to shore.
e.zh: 一艘橡皮艇把幸存者送到了岸边。

e.en: The cottage sat in a quiet wooded {dingle}.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在一处幽静的林间小谷里。

e.en: Children played beside the stream in the {dingle}.
e.zh: 孩子们在小山谷的溪边玩耍。

e.en: A wild {dingo} crossed the dusty outback road.
e.zh: 一只野生澳洲野犬穿过尘土飞扬的内陆公路。

e.en: Farmers built fences to keep the {dingo} away from sheep.
e.zh: 农民筑起围栏以阻止澳洲野犬靠近羊群。

dingwall.t: n. 丁沃尔（苏格兰地名）

e.en: We took the train north to {Dingwall} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐火车北上到了丁沃尔。

e.en: The town of {Dingwall} sits in the Scottish Highlands.
e.zh: 丁沃尔镇位于苏格兰高地。

e.en: The hotel room was {dingy} and smelled of smoke.
e.zh: 酒店房间又脏又暗,还有一股烟味。

e.en: She refused to wear the {dingy} old curtains as costume.
e.zh: 她拒绝把那些又脏又旧的窗帘当戏服穿。

dining.t:
n. 就餐
v. dine 的现在分词

e.en: We had a long conversation in the {dining} room.
e.zh: 我们在餐厅里聊了很久。

e.en: Fine {dining} restaurants often require reservations weeks ahead.
e.zh: 高级餐厅通常需要提前几周预订。

dink.t: n. 丁克（双收入无子女家庭）

e.en: She hit a perfect {dink} just over the net.
e.zh: 她打出一个完美的轻吊球,刚好过网。

e.en: In pickleball, a soft {dink} can frustrate aggressive opponents.
e.zh: 在匹克球中,一个轻巧的吊球能让进攻型对手很沮丧。

e.en: They live in a {dinky} apartment near the park.
e.zh: 他们住在公园附近一套小巧的公寓里。

e.en: The cafe served coffee in {dinky} little cups.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆用小巧的杯子盛咖啡。

e.en: What time should we have {dinner} tonight?
e.zh: 我们今晚几点吃晚饭?

e.en: She invited her boss over for {dinner}.
e.zh: 她邀请老板来家里吃晚饭。

e.en: The charity hosts free {dinners} for the homeless every week.
e.zh: 那家慈善机构每周为无家可归者提供免费晚餐。

e.en: Family {dinners} on Sundays have become a cherished tradition.
e.zh: 周日的家庭晚餐已经成了一个珍贵的传统。

e.en: The kids always get hungry just before {dinnertime}.
e.zh: 孩子们总是在晚餐时间前就饿了。

e.en: Please put your phones away at {dinnertime}.
e.zh: 晚餐时间请把手机收起来。

e.en: They received a beautiful set of {dinnerware} as a wedding gift.
e.zh: 他们收到了一套漂亮的餐具作为结婚礼物。

e.en: The store sells affordable ceramic {dinnerware} online.
e.zh: 这家店在网上销售实惠的陶瓷餐具。

dino.t: n. 恐龙（昵称，dinosaur 缩写）

e.en: My son wore a green {dino} costume for Halloween.
e.zh: 我儿子万圣节穿了一件绿色的恐龙服装。

e.en: The toddler clutched his plush {dino} all night.
e.zh: 小家伙整晚都抱着他的恐龙毛绒玩具。

e.en: A bloom of {dinoflagellate} cells turned the bay bright red.
e.zh: 一群甲藻让海湾变成了鲜红色。

e.en: Some {dinoflagellate} species glow blue when the water moves.
e.zh: 某些甲藻在水流扰动时会发出蓝光。

dinosaur.t:
n. 恐龙
n. 过时的人或事物

e.en: My nephew can name every {dinosaur} in the museum.
e.zh: 我侄子能叫出博物馆里每一只恐龙的名字。

e.en: That fax machine is a complete {dinosaur} in modern offices.
e.zh: 在现代办公室里,那台传真机完全是个老古董。

e.en: Scientists believe {dinosaurs} went extinct after a massive asteroid impact.
e.zh: 科学家认为恐龙在一次巨大的小行星撞击后灭绝。

e.en: Critics say these companies are {dinosaurs} unable to adapt.
e.zh: 评论人士说这些公司是无法适应变化的老古董。

dint.t: n. 凹痕（by dint of 凭借）

e.en: By {dint} of hard work, she finished the marathon.
e.zh: 凭借努力训练,她跑完了马拉松。

e.en: He earned his promotion by {dint} of sheer persistence.
e.zh: 他全凭坚持不懈赢得了升职。

diocesan.t:
adj. 教区的
n. 教区主教

e.en: The {diocesan} office announced a new bishop yesterday.
e.zh: 教区办公室昨天宣布了新主教的人选。

e.en: She sits on the {diocesan} education committee.
e.zh: 她担任教区教育委员会的委员。

e.en: The bishop oversees every parish in the {diocese}.
e.zh: 主教负责管理教区内的每一个堂区。

e.en: Our {diocese} runs three schools and a hospital.
e.zh: 我们教区运营着三所学校和一家医院。

diocletian.t: n. 戴克里先（罗马皇帝）

e.en: Emperor {Diocletian} reorganized the Roman empire into administrative tetrarchies.
e.zh: 戴克里先皇帝把罗马帝国重组为四帝共治的行政体系。

e.en: Tourists still visit the palace of {Diocletian} in Split.
e.zh: 游客们至今仍会参观斯普利特的戴克里先宫。

e.en: A simple {diode} only lets current flow in one direction.
e.zh: 一只简单的二极管只允许电流单向流动。

e.en: The light-emitting {diode} replaced the old incandescent bulb.
e.zh: 发光二极管取代了老式白炽灯泡。

dionysiac.t: adj. 酒神狄俄尼索斯的，狂欢的

e.en: The festival had a wild, {dionysiac} atmosphere all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末的节日都洋溢着狂热放纵的氛围。

e.en: Critics described the painting as ecstatic and {dionysiac}.
e.zh: 评论家形容这幅画充满狂喜与酒神般的激情。

e.en: Nietzsche contrasted Apollonian order with {Dionysian} chaos.
e.zh: 尼采把阿波罗式的秩序与酒神式的混乱进行了对比。

e.en: The party descended into a {Dionysian} celebration of music.
e.zh: 聚会演变成一场酒神式的狂欢音乐庆典。

dionysius.t: n. 狄俄尼索斯（希腊酒神）

e.en: Ancient writers credited {Dionysius} with founding the tyranny of Syracuse.
e.zh: 古代作家认为狄奥尼西奥斯建立了叙拉古的僭主统治。

e.en: The monk {Dionysius} wrote influential mystical theology in Greek.
e.zh: 修士狄奥尼修斯用希腊文写下了影响深远的神秘神学。

e.en: My new glasses correct nearly two {diopter} of myopia.
e.zh: 我的新眼镜矫正了将近两个屈光度的近视。

e.en: The optician measured the lens strength in {diopter} units.
e.zh: 验光师以屈光度为单位测量了镜片的度数。

e.en: She wore a vintage {Dior} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件复古迪奥礼服出席晚会。

e.en: The {Dior} flagship store reopened on the Champs-Élysées.
e.zh: 迪奥旗舰店在香榭丽舍大街重新开业。

e.en: The kids built a rainforest {diorama} for their science project.
e.zh: 孩子们为科学课作业做了一个雨林立体模型。

e.en: A detailed Civil War {diorama} fills the museum's main hall.
e.zh: 一个细致的内战立体场景占据着博物馆的主厅。

e.en: Her grandmother whispered "{Dios} mio" whenever she was startled.
e.zh: 她奶奶每次受惊都会低声说"我的天"。

e.en: The old hymn began with the phrase "{Dios} es amor".
e.zh: 那首古老的赞美诗以"上帝是爱"开头。

e.en: Plants absorb carbon {dioxide} during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中吸收二氧化碳。

e.en: Rising carbon {dioxide} levels are warming the planet.
e.zh: 不断上升的二氧化碳浓度正在加热地球。

e.en: Various nitrogen {dioxides} contribute to urban smog formation.
e.zh: 各种二氧化氮化合物是城市雾霾形成的一大原因。

e.en: The lab studied how sulfur {dioxides} affect plant leaves.
e.zh: 实验室研究了二氧化硫类气体如何影响植物叶片。

dioxin.t: n. 二恶英（有毒化合物）

e.en: The factory was fined for releasing {dioxin} into the river.
e.zh: 该工厂因向河中排放二噁英而被处以罚款。

e.en: Long-term exposure to {dioxin} can cause serious health problems.
e.zh: 长期接触二噁英会导致严重的健康问题。

dip.t:
v. 蘸，浸
n. 下降，蘸酱

e.en: Let's {dip} our feet in the cool stream.
e.zh: 我们把脚伸进凉爽的小溪里泡一下吧。

e.en: Stocks took a sharp {dip} after the announcement.
e.zh: 消息公布后股价大幅下跌。

diphenhydramine.t: n. 苯海拉明（抗过敏药）

e.en: The doctor recommended {diphenhydramine} for her allergic reaction.
e.zh: 医生推荐她服用苯海拉明缓解过敏反应。

e.en: Many sleep aids contain {diphenhydramine} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 许多助眠药以苯海拉明作为主要有效成分。

e.en: Childhood vaccines have nearly eliminated {diphtheria} in many countries.
e.zh: 儿童疫苗已让白喉在许多国家几乎绝迹。

e.en: An outbreak of {diphtheria} alarmed health officials last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天一场白喉疫情让卫生官员十分警觉。

e.en: Different strains of {diphtherias} can vary in toxin production.
e.zh: 不同的白喉菌株在毒素产生上可能存在差异。

e.en: Historic accounts describe the {diphtherias} that swept European cities.
e.zh: 历史记载描述了曾席卷欧洲城市的多次白喉疫情。

e.en: The word "coin" contains a clear {diphthong} sound.
e.zh: "coin"这个词中含有一个明显的双元音。

e.en: English learners often struggle with the {diphthong} in "now".
e.zh: 英语学习者常常觉得"now"中的双元音很难发好。

dirt.t:
n. 污垢；泥土
n. 八卦、丑闻

e.en: The kids came home covered in {dirt} after playing.
e.zh: 孩子们玩完回家全身都是泥土。

e.en: Tabloids love digging up {dirt} on celebrities.
e.zh: 小报最喜欢挖明星的丑闻。

e.en: Only a real {dirtbag} would steal from a charity.
e.zh: 只有真正的烂人才会偷慈善机构的钱。

e.en: The climber lived a happy {dirtbag} life out of his van.
e.zh: 那名攀岩者住在面包车里，过着随性的流浪生活。

e.en: The {dirtiness} of the kitchen shocked the inspector.
e.zh: 厨房的脏乱程度让检查员震惊。

e.en: She complained about the {dirtiness} of the train station.
e.zh: 她抱怨火车站太脏。

dirty.t:
adj. 脏的；下流的
v. 弄脏

e.en: Throw your {dirty} clothes in the laundry basket.
e.zh: 把脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

e.en: He won the election by playing a {dirty} game.
e.zh: 他靠耍卑鄙手段赢得了选举。

e.en: Don't {dis} my taste in music until you've heard the album.
e.zh: 在听完整张专辑之前，别贬低我的音乐品味。

e.en: The rapper's new track is a clear {dis} aimed at his rival.
e.zh: 这位说唱歌手的新歌明显是针对对手的挑衅之作。

e.en: The {disa} orchid is the national flower of Cape Town's mountains.
e.zh: 红色山兰是开普敦山区的代表花卉。

e.en: Hikers spotted a rare red {disa} blooming on the cliff.
e.zh: 徒步者在崖壁上发现了一株罕见的红色山兰。

disabilities.t: n. 残疾；障碍（disability 的复数）

e.en: The building has ramps for people with {disabilities}.
e.zh: 这栋楼设有方便残障人士的坡道。

e.en: Many learning {disabilities} can be managed with proper support.
e.zh: 许多学习障碍在恰当支持下都能得到改善。

e.en: The law protects employees from {disability} discrimination.
e.zh: 法律保护员工免受残疾歧视。

e.en: He receives a small {disability} payment each month.
e.zh: 他每月领取一小笔残疾补助金。

e.en: You can {disable} notifications in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里关闭通知。

e.en: Please {disable} the alarm before opening the back door.
e.zh: 打开后门前请先解除警报。

e.en: The submit button is {disabled} until you fill in your email.
e.zh: 在填写邮箱之前，提交按钮处于不可用状态。

e.en: The museum offers free entry to {disabled} visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆对残障人士免费开放。

disablement.t: n. 丧失能力；残疾状态

e.en: The insurance covers temporary {disablement} due to injury.
e.zh: 该保险涵盖因受伤导致的暂时性丧失工作能力。

e.en: Permanent {disablement} entitles workers to additional benefits.
e.zh: 永久性丧失劳动能力可使员工获得额外补偿。

disables.t: v. 禁用；使失效（disable 的三单）

e.en: Pressing this switch {disables} the engine immediately.
e.zh: 按下这个开关会立即关闭引擎。

e.en: A single bug {disables} the entire login flow.
e.zh: 一个小漏洞就会让整个登录流程瘫痪。

disabling.t:
v. 正在禁用
adj. 使人丧失能力的

e.en: The update is {disabling} background apps to save battery.
e.zh: 更新正在禁用后台应用以节省电量。

e.en: She suffered a {disabling} injury during the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松中受了致残的伤。

disabuse.t: v. 使醒悟；纠正（错误认识）

e.en: Let me {disabuse} you of the idea that coding is easy.
e.zh: 我得纠正你认为编程很简单的想法。

e.en: The teacher tried to {disabuse} students of common myths.
e.zh: 老师试图破除学生们的常见误解。

e.en: Working remotely has one big {disadvantage}: isolation.
e.zh: 远程工作有一个很大的缺点:孤独感。

e.en: Small teams are at a {disadvantage} when bidding for contracts.
e.zh: 小团队在竞标合同时处于劣势。

disadvantaged.t: adj. 处于不利地位的；弱势的

e.en: The program supports {disadvantaged} children in rural areas.
e.zh: 该项目帮助农村地区的弱势儿童。

e.en: Students from {disadvantaged} backgrounds get extra tutoring.
e.zh: 来自贫困家庭的学生可以获得额外辅导。

disadvantageous.t: adj. 不利的；造成劣势的

e.en: Signing now would be {disadvantageous} to our long-term plans.
e.zh: 现在签约对我们的长期计划不利。

e.en: The exchange rate is {disadvantageous} for tourists this week.
e.zh: 本周的汇率对游客不利。

disadvantages.t:
n. 劣势（复数）
v. 使处于不利

e.en: This phone has more {disadvantages} than the older model.
e.zh: 这款手机比旧款有更多缺点。

e.en: Poor lighting {disadvantages} workers in the night shift.
e.zh: 昏暗的灯光使夜班工人处于不利地位。

e.en: Constant policy changes can {disaffect} loyal employees.
e.zh: 不断变化的政策会让忠诚的员工心生不满。

e.en: Poor leadership tends to {disaffect} the entire team.
e.zh: 糟糕的领导往往会让整个团队失去信心。

disaffected.t: adj. 心怀不满的；离心的

e.en: {Disaffected} voters stayed home on election day.
e.zh: 心怀不满的选民在选举日没有去投票。

e.en: The CEO tried to win back {disaffected} customers.
e.zh: 首席执行官试图赢回不满的客户。

e.en: Growing {disaffection} among staff led to mass resignations.
e.zh: 员工日益不满,导致大规模辞职。

e.en: The survey revealed widespread {disaffection} with management.
e.zh: 调查显示员工对管理层普遍不满。

e.en: {Disafforestment} in the Amazon threatens countless species.
e.zh: 亚马逊地区的森林砍伐威胁着无数物种。

e.en: Activists protested the {disafforestment} of protected land.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议对保护地的森林砍伐。

disaggregate.t: v. 分解；拆分（数据、整体）

e.en: Analysts {disaggregate} the data by age and region.
e.zh: 分析师按年龄和地区将数据细分。

e.en: We need to {disaggregate} sales figures to find the trend.
e.zh: 我们需要拆分销售数据才能发现趋势。

e.en: The report includes {disaggregated} statistics by gender.
e.zh: 报告包含按性别细分的统计数据。

e.en: {Disaggregated} data revealed hidden inequalities.
e.zh: 细分数据揭示了隐藏的不平等。

e.en: Data {disaggregation} helps reveal disparities across groups.
e.zh: 数据细分有助于揭示各群体之间的差异。

e.en: The study calls for further {disaggregation} of income statistics.
e.zh: 该研究呼吁进一步细分收入统计数据。

e.en: Experts {disagree} on whether coffee is healthy.
e.zh: 专家们对咖啡是否健康意见不一。

e.en: I have to {disagree} with your conclusion here.
e.zh: 在这一点上我必须不同意你的结论。

disagreeable.t: adj. 令人不快的；难相处的

e.en: He has a {disagreeable} habit of interrupting people.
e.zh: 他有个令人讨厌的打断别人的习惯。

e.en: The medicine left a {disagreeable} taste in my mouth.
e.zh: 这药在我嘴里留下了难闻的味道。

e.en: The room was {disagreeably} hot all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午房间里都热得令人难受。

e.en: She responded {disagreeably} when asked to help.
e.zh: 被请求帮忙时,她不悦地回应。

e.en: The two scientists {disagreed} about the experiment's results.
e.zh: 两位科学家对实验结果有不同看法。

e.en: We {disagreed} on which restaurant to choose.
e.zh: 我们在选哪家餐厅上意见不一。

e.en: The judges kept {disagreeing} throughout the competition.
e.zh: 评委们在整个比赛中一直意见不合。

e.en: There's nothing wrong with politely {disagreeing} in meetings.
e.zh: 在会议上礼貌地表示反对并没有什么不妥。

e.en: There's a clear {disagreement} between the two managers.
e.zh: 两位经理之间存在明显的分歧。

e.en: Their {disagreement} over budget delayed the project.
e.zh: 他们在预算上的分歧推迟了项目进度。

e.en: Minor {disagreements} are normal in any healthy team.
e.zh: 任何健康的团队中小分歧都很正常。

e.en: The couple worked through their {disagreements} calmly.
e.zh: 这对夫妇平静地化解了彼此的分歧。

e.en: My doctor {disagrees} with the diagnosis from the clinic.
e.zh: 我的医生不同意诊所的诊断结果。

e.en: She {disagrees} with almost everything her boss proposes.
e.zh: 她几乎不同意老板提出的任何建议。

e.en: The referee may {disallow} the goal after video review.
e.zh: 裁判在视频回放后可能会判进球无效。

e.en: New rules {disallow} phones during exams.
e.zh: 新规定禁止在考试期间使用手机。

disambiguate.t: v. 消除歧义；明确区分

e.en: Good documentation helps {disambiguate} confusing API names.
e.zh: 好的文档有助于厘清易混淆的API名称。

e.en: Please {disambiguate} which John you mean in the email.
e.zh: 请在邮件中明确你指的是哪个约翰。

e.en: My keys always {disappear} when I'm running late.
e.zh: 我快迟到时钥匙总会不见。

e.en: The notification will {disappear} after a few seconds.
e.zh: 通知会在几秒钟后消失。

e.en: Police are investigating the sudden {disappearance} of the hiker.
e.zh: 警方正在调查那名徒步者的突然失踪。

e.en: The {disappearance} of bees worries many farmers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂的消失让许多农民感到担忧。

e.en: A series of mysterious {disappearances} shocked the small town.
e.zh: 一连串神秘的失踪事件震惊了这个小镇。

e.en: The forest is known for unexplained {disappearances}.
e.zh: 这片森林以无法解释的失踪事件而闻名。

e.en: My wallet {disappeared} from the table when I wasn't looking.
e.zh: 我没注意时钱包就从桌上不见了。

e.en: The error message {disappeared} after I refreshed the page.
e.zh: 刷新页面后错误信息就消失了。

e.en: Print newspapers are slowly {disappearing} from cafes.
e.zh: 纸质报纸正慢慢从咖啡馆消失。

e.en: The magician kept {disappearing} behind the curtain.
e.zh: 魔术师不断地在幕布后消失。

e.en: The popup {disappears} automatically after ten seconds.
e.zh: 弹窗会在十秒后自动消失。

e.en: Snow {disappears} quickly under the spring sunshine.
e.zh: 春日阳光下,积雪很快就融化了。

e.en: I don't want to {disappoint} my parents again this year.
e.zh: 我不想今年再让父母失望。

e.en: The new sequel may {disappoint} longtime fans of the series.
e.zh: 新续集可能会让系列的老粉丝失望。

e.en: She felt {disappointed} when the concert was canceled.
e.zh: 演唱会被取消时她感到很失望。

e.en: I'm a little {disappointed} with the food quality here.
e.zh: 我对这里的食物质量有点失望。

e.en: The movie's ending was really {disappointing}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局真的很令人失望。

e.en: Sales numbers this quarter were {disappointing}.
e.zh: 本季度的销售数字令人失望。

e.en: The product launch was {disappointingly} quiet.
e.zh: 产品发布会出乎意料地冷清,令人失望。

e.en: Attendance at the event was {disappointingly} low.
e.zh: 活动的出席率低得令人失望。

disappointment.t: n. 失望；令人失望的事

e.en: I could hear the {disappointment} in her voice.
e.zh: 我能从她的声音中听出失望。

e.en: The meal was a major {disappointment} given the price.
e.zh: 考虑到价格,这顿饭太令人失望了。

e.en: Life is full of small {disappointments} you learn to handle.
e.zh: 生活中充满了你要学着应对的小失望。

e.en: Despite many {disappointments}, she kept pursuing her dream.
e.zh: 尽管经历了许多失望,她仍坚持追逐梦想。

e.en: This restaurant rarely {disappoints} its loyal customers.
e.zh: 这家餐厅很少让老顾客失望。

e.en: The new update {disappoints} users who wanted dark mode.
e.zh: 新更新让想要深色模式的用户感到失望。

e.en: Her parents expressed strong {disapprobation} of the marriage.
e.zh: 她父母对这桩婚事表示强烈反对。

e.en: Public {disapprobation} forced the politician to resign.
e.zh: 公众的强烈不满迫使这位政客辞职。

e.en: The teacher shook her head in {disapproval}.
e.zh: 老师不赞同地摇了摇头。

e.en: He expressed {disapproval} of the new dress code.
e.zh: 他对新的着装要求表示不赞成。

e.en: Engineers tested the {discharger} to make sure the capacitor was safe.
e.zh: 工程师测试了放电器,确保电容已经安全。

e.en: The lab uses an automatic {discharger} to drain old battery packs.
e.zh: 实验室用自动放电器来给旧电池包放电。

discharges.t:
v. 排出；释放；解雇
n. 排放物

e.en: The plant {discharges} treated water back into the bay every hour.
e.zh: 工厂每小时把处理过的水排回海湾。

e.en: Lightning {discharges} can interfere with sensitive electronic equipment.
e.zh: 闪电放电会干扰精密的电子设备。

e.en: My laptop keeps {discharging} even when it's plugged in.
e.zh: 我的笔记本插着电源还一直在掉电。

e.en: Inspectors caught the company {discharging} chemicals into the storm drain.
e.zh: 检查人员发现该公司将化学品排入了雨水管道。

e.en: He became a devoted {disciple} of the minimalist lifestyle.
e.zh: 他成了极简生活方式的忠实拥护者。

e.en: The chef trained as a young {disciple} under a Michelin master.
e.zh: 这位厨师年轻时拜在一位米其林大师门下学艺。

e.en: His online {disciples} share his productivity tips on every platform.
e.zh: 他的网络追随者在各大平台上分享他的效率心得。

e.en: The yoga teacher trained dozens of {disciples} over twenty years.
e.zh: 这位瑜伽老师二十年来培养了数十名弟子。

discipleship.t: n. 门徒的身份或时期

e.en: Years of {discipleship} shaped her approach to teaching art.
e.zh: 多年的师徒学习塑造了她教授艺术的方式。

e.en: The book explores the meaning of {discipleship} in modern life.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了门徒之道在现代生活中的意义。

disciplinarian.t: n. 严格执行纪律的人

e.en: Her father was a strict {disciplinarian} who valued punctuality.
e.zh: 她父亲是个严厉的人,非常看重守时。

e.en: The new coach is less of a {disciplinarian} than the previous one.
e.zh: 新教练没有上一任那么严厉。

e.en: The employee faces {disciplinary} action after leaking confidential data.
e.zh: 该员工因泄露机密数据将面临纪律处分。

e.en: School policy outlines clear {disciplinary} procedures for cheating.
e.zh: 学校政策对作弊行为列出了明确的纪律处理流程。

discipline.t:
n. 纪律；学科
v. 训练；惩戒

e.en: Daily writing takes a lot of {discipline}.
e.zh: 坚持每天写作需要很强的自律。

e.en: Computer science is a fast-changing academic {discipline}.
e.zh: 计算机科学是一门发展飞快的学科。

disciplined.t: adj. 守纪律的；训练有素的

e.en: She's incredibly {disciplined} about going to the gym every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上去健身房,自律得让人佩服。

e.en: The team {disciplined} two players for missing practice repeatedly.
e.zh: 球队对两名屡次缺席训练的球员进行了处罚。

disciplines.t:
n. 学科；纪律
v. 训练

e.en: Modern AI research draws from many academic {disciplines}.
e.zh: 现代人工智能研究融合了许多学科的成果。

e.en: He {disciplines} his time strictly to avoid burnout at work.
e.zh: 他严格安排自己的时间,避免在工作中精疲力竭。

e.en: {Disciplining} a toddler requires patience and consistency.
e.zh: 管教幼儿需要耐心,也需要前后一致。

e.en: The manager is {disciplining} the team for missing the deadline again.
e.zh: 经理正在因团队再次错过截止日期而采取处分措施。

e.en: The author tried to {disclaim} responsibility for the leaked draft.
e.zh: 作者试图否认对泄露草稿负责。

e.en: Companies often {disclaim} liability for third-party content on their platforms.
e.zh: 公司通常会声明对平台上第三方内容不承担责任。

e.en: Every investment ad ends with a small-print {disclaimer}.
e.zh: 每则投资广告结尾都有一段小字免责声明。

e.en: He added a quick {disclaimer} before sharing his hot take.
e.zh: 他在发表犀利观点前先加了一句免责说明。

e.en: Influencers must {disclose} when a post is sponsored.
e.zh: 网红必须公开声明帖子是否为商业推广。

e.en: The startup refused to {disclose} its monthly revenue figures.
e.zh: 这家初创公司拒绝披露每月营收数字。

e.en: The company {disclosed} a major data breach last Friday.
e.zh: 该公司上周五披露了一起重大数据泄露事件。

e.en: He never {disclosed} how much he paid for the apartment.
e.zh: 他从未透露过买这套公寓花了多少钱。

e.en: The annual report {discloses} all executive compensation packages.
e.zh: 年度报告披露了所有高管的薪酬方案。

e.en: This app {discloses} which trackers it shares your data with.
e.zh: 该应用会披露它把你的数据共享给哪些追踪器。

e.en: She was fired for {disclosing} confidential client information.
e.zh: 她因泄露客户机密信息而被解雇。

e.en: The lawyer warned against {disclosing} too much on social media.
e.zh: 律师告诫不要在社交媒体上透露过多信息。

e.en: Full {disclosure}: I used to work at that company.
e.zh: 先声明一下：我以前在那家公司工作过。

e.en: The {disclosure} of the documents shocked investors worldwide.
e.zh: 这些文件的公开震惊了全球投资者。

e.en: Recent {disclosures} revealed widespread surveillance of journalists.
e.zh: 最新披露的信息显示记者遭到大规模监控。

e.en: Public companies must file regular financial {disclosures} with regulators.
e.zh: 上市公司必须定期向监管机构提交财务披露文件。

disco.t: n. 迪斯科舞厅；迪斯科音乐

e.en: My parents met at a {disco} back in 1978.
e.zh: 我父母是1978年在一家迪斯科舞厅认识的。

e.en: The playlist mixes modern pop with classic {disco} hits.
e.zh: 这个歌单把现代流行和经典迪斯科金曲混在一起。

e.en: Old {discoes} across the city have been turned into co-working spaces.
e.zh: 市里以前的迪斯科舞厅都被改造成了共享办公空间。

e.en: In the eighties, suburban {discoes} were packed every weekend.
e.zh: 在八十年代，郊区的迪斯科舞厅每个周末都人满为患。

discography.t: n. 唱片目录；发行作品列表

e.en: Her {discography} now spans more than two decades.
e.zh: 她的唱片作品集如今已跨越二十多年。

e.en: Spotify lists every track in the band's official {discography}.
e.zh: Spotify 收录了这支乐队官方唱片集中的每首曲目。

e.en: There's a yellow {discoloration} on the ceiling from a leak.
e.zh: 天花板上因渗水留下了一块黄色的污渍。

e.en: Sunscreen helps prevent {discoloration} of the skin over time.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于防止皮肤随时间出现色斑。

e.en: The old photographs have {discolored} after decades in the attic.
e.zh: 这些老照片在阁楼里放了几十年后已经褪色了。

e.en: Coffee gradually {discolored} the white kitchen counter.
e.zh: 咖啡渐渐把白色的厨房台面染脏了。

e.en: Strong sunlight can {discolour} the curtains within months.
e.zh: 强烈的阳光几个月就能让窗帘褪色。

e.en: Cheap detergent may {discolour} delicate fabrics over time.
e.zh: 廉价洗涤剂用久了可能会让娇贵的衣物变色。

e.en: The doctor checked the strange {discolouration} on her arm.
e.zh: 医生检查了她手臂上奇怪的变色斑块。

e.en: Hard water often causes brown {discolouration} around the drain.
e.zh: 硬水常常会在下水口周围形成褐色的污渍。

e.en: The pages had {discoloured} to a soft yellow over the years.
e.zh: 这些纸页多年下来已经泛成了淡黄色。

e.en: He noticed a {discoloured} patch on the wooden floor.
e.zh: 他注意到木地板上有一块变色的斑迹。

e.en: Sudden plot twists tend to {discombobulate} first-time viewers.
e.zh: 突如其来的剧情反转往往会让初次观看的人一头雾水。

e.en: Loud open offices can {discombobulate} people trying to focus.
e.zh: 嘈杂的开放式办公室会让想专注的人晕头转向。

discombobulated.t: adj. 困惑的；不知所措的

e.en: I felt completely {discombobulated} after the long red-eye flight.
e.zh: 那趟红眼航班之后我整个人都晕乎乎的。

e.en: The surprise question left the candidate visibly {discombobulated}.
e.zh: 那个意外的问题让候选人明显有些不知所措。

e.en: Pointed questions from the audience can {discomfit} even seasoned speakers.
e.zh: 观众尖锐的提问连资深演讲者也会被问得难堪。

e.en: The reporter's follow-up was meant to {discomfit} the minister.
e.zh: 记者的追问意在让部长下不来台。

e.en: He looked {discomfited} when asked about the missing funds.
e.zh: 被问到那笔失踪的款项时，他显得很尴尬。

e.en: She was clearly {discomfited} by the unexpected applause.
e.zh: 那阵意外的掌声让她明显有些局促不安。

e.en: There was a {discomfiting} silence after his blunt remark.
e.zh: 他直白的话后出现了一阵令人尴尬的沉默。

e.en: The survey results were {discomfiting} for senior management.
e.zh: 调查结果让高层管理者颇感难堪。

e.en: His obvious {discomfiture} during the interview was hard to watch.
e.zh: 他在采访中明显的窘态让人看着都难受。

e.en: She hid her {discomfiture} behind a polite, frozen smile.
e.zh: 她用礼貌而僵硬的微笑掩饰自己的尴尬。

discomfort.t:
n. 不适；不安
v. 使不适

e.en: Patients often report mild {discomfort} after the procedure.
e.zh: 患者在手术后通常会感到轻微不适。

e.en: There's some {discomfort} in talking openly about salaries at work.
e.zh: 在公司里公开谈论工资多少有点让人不自在。

e.en: The documentary raises some genuinely {discomforting} questions about AI.
e.zh: 这部纪录片提出了一些关于人工智能的真正令人不安的问题。

e.en: It was {discomforting} to hear my voice played back so loudly.
e.zh: 听到自己的声音被这么大声地放出来挺让人不自在的。

e.en: Long flights come with their usual minor {discomforts}.
e.zh: 长途飞行总免不了那些常见的小不适。

e.en: The new chair eliminates many of the {discomforts} of remote work.
e.zh: 这把新椅子消除了远程办公的许多不适感。

e.en: Nothing seems to {discompose} her, even during a crisis.
e.zh: 似乎没有什么能让她乱了方寸，即便是危机时刻。

e.en: Hostile questions failed to {discompose} the experienced diplomat.
e.zh: 那些不友好的提问也没能让这位资深外交官失态。

e.en: Sudden silence on a video call can {disconcert} the speaker.
e.zh: 视频会议中突然的沉默会让讲话者感到不安。

e.en: His intense stare seemed designed to {disconcert} the witness.
e.zh: 他锐利的目光似乎就是为了让证人慌乱。

e.en: She was {disconcerted} by how empty the office felt on Mondays.
e.zh: 周一办公室空荡荡的感觉让她有些不安。

e.en: He looked {disconcerted} when his name was mispronounced on stage.
e.zh: 在台上名字被念错时，他显得有些慌乱。

disconcerting.t: adj. 令人不安的；使人困惑的

e.en: It's {disconcerting} how accurately the algorithm predicts my mood.
e.zh: 算法对我情绪的预测准得让人有点心慌。

e.en: There was a {disconcerting} delay before the website finally loaded.
e.zh: 网站迟迟才加载出来，让人有些不安。

e.en: The chatbot responded {disconcertingly} fast to every personal question.
e.zh: 对每个私人问题，那个聊天机器人都回得快得让人心慌。

e.en: The streets were {disconcertingly} quiet for a Friday night.
e.zh: 作为周五的夜晚，街上安静得令人不安。

e.en: A single counterexample can {disconfirm} an otherwise tidy theory.
e.zh: 一个反例就足以推翻一套看似完美的理论。

e.en: Researchers ran new trials hoping to {disconfirm} the original finding.
e.zh: 研究人员开展了新实验，希望能否定最初的结论。

disconnect.t:
v. 断开连接
n. 脱节

e.en: There's a real {disconnect} between management and frontline staff.
e.zh: 管理层和一线员工之间存在着明显的脱节。

e.en: Remember to {disconnect} the charger before unplugging the device.
e.zh: 拔下设备前记得先断开充电器的连接。

e.en: My laptop kept getting {disconnected} from the office Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 我的笔记本一直连不稳办公室的Wi-Fi。

e.en: He felt strangely {disconnected} from his old college friends.
e.zh: 他对大学老朋友们有种说不出的疏离感。

e.en: Many remote workers describe a growing sense of {disconnectedness}.
e.zh: 许多远程工作者描述了一种与日俱增的疏离感。

e.en: The film captures the {disconnectedness} of modern city life beautifully.
e.zh: 这部影片精彩地刻画了现代都市生活的疏离感。

e.en: {Disconnecting} from work emails on weekends has improved my sleep.
e.zh: 周末不看工作邮件之后，我的睡眠好了很多。

e.en: The router keeps {disconnecting} every few minutes during video calls.
e.zh: 视频通话时路由器每隔几分钟就掉一次线。

e.en: A brief {disconnection} caused everyone to drop off the call.
e.zh: 短暂的断网让所有人都掉线了。

e.en: She wrote about the {disconnection} many feel in big cities.
e.zh: 她写到许多人在大城市里所感受到的那种疏离感。

disconnects.t:
v. 断开
n. 脱节之处

e.en: The app automatically {disconnects} after ten minutes of inactivity.
e.zh: 应用在闲置十分钟后会自动断开连接。

e.en: There are obvious {disconnects} between the policy and how it's enforced.
e.zh: 政策本身与执行方式之间存在明显的脱节。

disconsolate.t: adj. 沮丧的；郁郁寡欢的

e.en: The fans looked {disconsolate} after the team's last-minute loss.
e.zh: 球队最后一刻输球后，球迷们一脸沮丧。

e.en: He sat {disconsolate} on the bench, staring at his phone.
e.zh: 他闷闷不乐地坐在长椅上，盯着手机出神。

disconsolately.t: adv. 忧郁地；郁郁不乐地

e.en: She wandered {disconsolately} through the empty airport at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分，她在空荡荡的机场里失魂落魄地走着。

e.en: He stared {disconsolately} at the rejection email on his screen.
e.zh: 他怅然若失地盯着屏幕上那封拒信。

discontent.t:
n. 不满；不满情绪
adj. 不满的

e.en: There's growing {discontent} among employees about return-to-office rules.
e.zh: 员工对返岗办公的规定越来越不满。

e.en: Low pay is the main source of {discontent} in this industry.
e.zh: 低薪是这个行业不满情绪的主要来源。

discontented.t: adj. 不满的；心怀不满的

e.en: Many {discontented} users have switched to a competing app.
e.zh: 许多心怀不满的用户已经转用了竞争对手的应用。

e.en: She grew increasingly {discontented} with her stagnant career.
e.zh: 她对自己停滞不前的职业越来越不满。

e.en: The company announced the {discontinuance} of its budget phone line.
e.zh: 该公司宣布停产其入门机型系列。

e.en: Users were unhappy about the abrupt {discontinuance} of free storage.
e.zh: 用户对免费存储空间的突然取消感到不满。

e.en: The {discontinuation} of the popular feature angered many subscribers.
e.zh: 这个热门功能的取消激怒了许多订阅用户。

e.en: Doctors recommend gradual {discontinuation} rather than stopping the medication abruptly.
e.zh: 医生建议逐步停药，而不是骤然停用。

e.en: The brand will {discontinue} its smartwatch line next year.
e.zh: 该品牌明年将停产其智能手表系列。

e.en: Please {discontinue} use if you experience any side effects.
e.zh: 如出现任何副作用，请停止使用。

discontinued.t: adj. 已停产的；已停用的

e.en: My favorite shampoo was suddenly {discontinued} last month.
e.zh: 我最爱的洗发水上个月突然停产了。

e.en: The studio {discontinued} the show after just one season.
e.zh: 工作室仅播了一季就把这部剧砍掉了。

e.en: There's a clear {discontinuity} in the data after the system upgrade.
e.zh: 系统升级后，数据出现了明显的断层。

e.en: The new CEO created some {discontinuity} in the company's strategy.
e.zh: 新任CEO让公司战略出现了一些断层。

e.en: The signal was {discontinuous}, dropping every few seconds.
e.zh: 信号断断续续，每隔几秒就掉一次。

e.en: Progress in research is often {discontinuous} rather than steady.
e.zh: 科研的进展往往是跳跃式的，而非稳步推进。

discord.t:
n. 不和；纷争
n. 不和谐音

e.en: There's growing {discord} between the two co-founders over strategy.
e.zh: 两位联合创始人因战略问题之间的分歧越来越大。

e.en: Our team chats mostly on {Discord} instead of Slack now.
e.zh: 我们团队现在主要在 Discord 上聊天，不太用 Slack 了。

e.en: There's a clear {discordance} between his words and his actions.
e.zh: 他的言行之间存在明显的矛盾。

e.en: The survey revealed {discordance} between leadership and frontline views.
e.zh: 调查显示管理层与一线员工的看法存在分歧。

discordant.t: adj. 不和谐的；不一致的

e.en: A {discordant} note interrupted the otherwise smooth performance.
e.zh: 一个不和谐的音符打断了原本流畅的演出。

e.en: His cheerful tone felt {discordant} given the bad news.
e.zh: 考虑到那个坏消息，他欢快的语气显得格外不合时宜。

e.en: The old {discotheque} downtown reopened as a trendy nightclub.
e.zh: 市中心的老迪斯科舞厅重新开业，成了潮流夜店。

e.en: She danced all night at a Paris {discotheque} in 1978.
e.zh: 1978年她在巴黎的迪厅跳了一整夜舞。

discount.t:
n. 折扣；优惠
v. 打折；不予重视

e.en: Members get a 20% {discount} on every order.
e.zh: 会员每笔订单可享八折优惠。

e.en: Don't {discount} the possibility of rain this weekend.
e.zh: 别忽视这个周末下雨的可能性。

e.en: All winter coats are {discounted} until Sunday.
e.zh: 所有冬季外套打折促销至本周日。

e.en: He {discounted} her warning and missed the deadline.
e.zh: 他没把她的警告当回事，结果错过了截止日期。

discounter.t: n. 折扣店；折扣零售商

e.en: The online {discounter} undercuts every major retailer.
e.zh: 这家网络折扣商的价格比所有大零售商都低。

e.en: Costco became the largest {discounter} in North America.
e.zh: 好市多成为北美最大的折扣零售商。

discounting.t:
v. 打折；折现
n. 贴现

e.en: The store is heavily {discounting} last season's stock.
e.zh: 这家店正在大幅打折清理上季库存。

e.en: You're {discounting} how hard the exam really was.
e.zh: 你低估了那场考试到底有多难。

discounts.t:
n. 折扣（复数）
v. 打折（第三人称单数）

e.en: Students can claim extra {discounts} with a valid ID.
e.zh: 学生凭有效证件可享受额外折扣。

e.en: He always {discounts} advice from people younger than him.
e.zh: 他总是不把比他年轻的人的建议当回事。

e.en: Don't let one bad grade {discourage} you from trying again.
e.zh: 别让一次低分让你失去再尝试的勇气。

e.en: Higher prices are meant to {discourage} excessive water use.
e.zh: 涨价是为了抑制过度用水。

e.en: She felt {discouraged} after the third job rejection.
e.zh: 被第三家公司拒绝后她有些灰心。

e.en: Visitors are {discouraged} from feeding the wild monkeys.
e.zh: 不鼓励游客喂食野生猴子。

e.en: Despite constant {discouragement}, she finished her novel.
e.zh: 尽管一路被泼冷水，她还是写完了小说。

e.en: A little {discouragement} early on can derail a beginner.
e.zh: 初期一点点打击就可能让新手放弃。

discourages.t: v. 使泄气；劝阻（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {discourages} late-night scrolling with gentle reminders.
e.zh: 这款应用通过温和提醒劝阻深夜刷手机。
