e.en: He always {dissembles} when his boss asks about deadlines.
e.zh: 老板问起截止日期时,他总是含糊其词。

e.en: The character cleverly {dissembles} her true motives.
e.zh: 这个角色巧妙地掩饰了她的真实动机。

e.en: Stop {dissembling} and tell me what really happened.
e.zh: 别再装模作样了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: His {dissembling} answers raised everyone's suspicions.
e.zh: 他闪烁其词的回答引起了所有人的怀疑。

disseminate.t: v. 散布，传播（信息、思想）

e.en: Social media helps researchers {disseminate} findings quickly.
e.zh: 社交媒体帮助研究人员快速传播研究成果。

e.en: The agency works to {disseminate} accurate health information.
e.zh: 该机构致力于传播准确的健康信息。

e.en: The report was widely {disseminated} across news outlets.
e.zh: 该报告在各大新闻媒体上广泛传播。

e.en: Activists {disseminated} the petition through email lists.
e.zh: 活动人士通过邮件列表传播这份请愿书。

disseminates.t: v. 传播（第三人称单数）

e.en: The CDC {disseminates} guidelines to hospitals nationwide.
e.zh: 美国疾控中心向全国医院发布指南。

e.en: This newsletter {disseminates} weekly tech updates to subscribers.
e.zh: 该简报每周向订阅者发送科技资讯。

e.en: They were accused of {disseminating} false information online.
e.zh: 他们被指控在网上散布虚假信息。

e.en: The team focuses on {disseminating} research to the public.
e.zh: 该团队专注于向公众传播研究成果。

e.en: Rapid {dissemination} of news shapes public opinion today.
e.zh: 如今新闻的快速传播塑造着公众舆论。

e.en: The grant funds the {dissemination} of educational materials.
e.zh: 这笔资助用于传播教育材料。

e.en: The journal tracks {disseminations} of its articles online.
e.zh: 该期刊追踪其文章在网上的传播情况。

e.en: Multiple {disseminations} of the rumor spread it globally.
e.zh: 这则谣言经过多次传播扩散到了全球。

e.en: Twitter became a powerful {disseminator} of breaking news.
e.zh: 推特成为突发新闻的强大传播媒介。

e.en: She is a leading {disseminator} of climate research findings.
e.zh: 她是气候研究成果的主要传播者。

e.en: The proposal caused {dissension} among board members.
e.zh: 该提案在董事会成员中引发了分歧。

e.en: Internal {dissension} weakened the political party badly.
e.zh: 内部分歧严重削弱了这个政党。

e.en: Old {dissensions} resurfaced during the leadership election.
e.zh: 在领导层选举中,旧有的分歧再次浮现。

e.en: The team overcame their {dissensions} to win the championship.
e.zh: 团队克服了内部分歧,赢得了冠军。

dissent.t:
n. 异议，不同意见
v. 持异议

e.en: The judge wrote a powerful {dissent} against the ruling.
e.zh: 那位法官就该裁决撰写了一份有力的异议书。

e.en: Online platforms increasingly suppress political {dissent}.
e.zh: 网络平台越来越多地压制政治异见。

e.en: He was the lone {dissenter} on an otherwise unanimous board.
e.zh: 他是这个原本一致同意的董事会中唯一的反对者。

e.en: The {dissenter} refused to sign the joint statement.
e.zh: 那位异议者拒绝在联合声明上签字。

e.en: Justice Roberts wrote a sharp {dissenting} opinion.
e.zh: 罗伯茨大法官撰写了一份尖锐的反对意见。

e.en: A few {dissenting} voices objected to the new policy.
e.zh: 少数反对的声音对新政策提出了异议。

e.en: Years of {dissention} finally split the church into factions.
e.zh: 多年的纷争最终使教会分裂成派系。

e.en: The merger caused {dissention} between the two leadership teams.
e.zh: 合并在两个领导团队之间引发了不和。

distilled.t:
adj. 蒸馏的
v. 提炼（distill 的过去式）

e.en: Always use {distilled} water in the steam iron.
e.zh: 蒸汽熨斗里要用蒸馏水。

e.en: She {distilled} the report into three key points.
e.zh: 她把报告精炼成三个要点。

e.en: The {distiller} won an award for its single malt whisky.
e.zh: 这家酿酒厂的单一麦芽威士忌得了奖。

e.en: He works as a master {distiller} in Scotland.
e.zh: 他在苏格兰担任首席酿酒师。

e.en: We toured a small {distillery} in the Scottish Highlands.
e.zh: 我们参观了苏格兰高地的一家小酿酒厂。

e.en: The {distillery} produces about 2,000 bottles a year.
e.zh: 这家蒸馏酒厂每年生产约 2000 瓶酒。

distilling.t:
v. 蒸馏；提炼
n. 蒸馏过程

e.en: He spent the afternoon {distilling} his notes into a summary.
e.zh: 他花了一下午把笔记精炼成一份总结。

e.en: The factory has been {distilling} whiskey for over a century.
e.zh: 这家工厂酿造威士忌已超过一个世纪。

distills.t: v. 蒸馏；提炼（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her speech {distills} years of activism into ten minutes.
e.zh: 她的演讲把多年的行动主义浓缩在十分钟里。

e.en: The plant {distills} crude oil into gasoline and diesel.
e.zh: 这家工厂将原油提炼成汽油和柴油。

distinct.t: adj. 明显的；截然不同的

e.en: There is a {distinct} difference between the two flavors.
e.zh: 这两种口味之间有明显的差别。

e.en: I had the {distinct} feeling someone was watching me.
e.zh: 我有一种明确的感觉,有人在看着我。

distinction.t:
n. 区别；差异
n. 殊荣

e.en: The teacher drew a clear {distinction} between facts and opinions.
e.zh: 老师明确区分了事实与观点。

e.en: She graduated with {distinction} from a top university.
e.zh: 她以优异成绩从一所顶尖大学毕业。

e.en: The book makes useful {distinctions} between similar concepts.
e.zh: 这本书对相近的概念做了有益的区分。

e.en: He has earned several academic {distinctions} this year.
e.zh: 他今年获得了多项学术荣誉。

e.en: The cafe has a {distinctive} smell of cinnamon and coffee.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种独特的肉桂和咖啡香气。

e.en: Her writing style is immediately {distinctive} and recognizable.
e.zh: 她的写作风格一眼就能认出,非常独特。

e.en: The dish is {distinctively} flavored with smoked paprika.
e.zh: 这道菜带有烟熏辣椒粉特有的风味。

e.en: He dresses {distinctively}, always in bold colors.
e.zh: 他穿衣很有个人风格,总爱穿大胆的颜色。

e.en: The brand's {distinctiveness} comes from its handmade packaging.
e.zh: 这个品牌的独特之处在于它的手工包装。

e.en: Critics praised the film for its visual {distinctiveness}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部电影具有独特的视觉风格。

e.en: I {distinctly} remember locking the front door this morning.
e.zh: 我清清楚楚记得今早锁了前门。

e.en: The wine has a {distinctly} fruity aroma.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒带有明显的果香。

e.en: The {distinctness} of her voice made the recording instantly recognizable.
e.zh: 她声音的独特性让那段录音一下子就能被认出来。

e.en: Each brand fights to maintain its {distinctness} in a crowded market.
e.zh: 在拥挤的市场中，每个品牌都在努力保持自己的辨识度。

e.en: It's hard to {distinguish} the twins from across the room.
e.zh: 从房间另一头很难分辨出这对双胞胎。

e.en: Good designers {distinguish} themselves through attention to small details.
e.zh: 优秀的设计师靠对细节的关注让自己脱颖而出。

distinguishable.t: adj. 可区分的；可辨别的

e.en: The two paint colors are barely {distinguishable} under dim lighting.
e.zh: 在昏暗的灯光下，这两种漆色几乎看不出区别。

e.en: Her handwriting is easily {distinguishable} from her sister's.
e.zh: 她的字迹很容易和她姐姐的区分开来。

e.en: A {distinguished} professor will deliver the keynote speech tonight.
e.zh: 今晚将由一位德高望重的教授发表主旨演讲。

e.en: He looked very {distinguished} in his tailored gray suit.
e.zh: 他穿着定制的灰色西装，看起来气度不凡。

distinguishes.t: v. 区分；辨别（第三人称单数）

e.en: What {distinguishes} this app is its clean, intuitive interface.
e.zh: 这款应用的与众不同之处在于它简洁直观的界面。

e.en: A trained ear easily {distinguishes} live music from a recording.
e.zh: 训练有素的耳朵能轻易分辨现场演奏和录音。

distinguishing.t:
adj. 区别性的
v. 区分

e.en: The cat has no {distinguishing} marks on its black fur.
e.zh: 那只猫黑色的毛上没有任何明显的标记。

e.en: {Distinguishing} fact from opinion online is harder than ever.
e.zh: 在网上区分事实和观点比以往任何时候都更难。

e.en: Cheap lenses can {distort} the edges of your photos.
e.zh: 廉价镜头会让照片边缘出现变形。

e.en: Tabloids often {distort} celebrities' words to sell more copies.
e.zh: 小报常常歪曲名人的话以增加销量。

e.en: The audio sounded {distorted} because the microphone was too close.
e.zh: 因为麦克风太近，音频听起来有些失真。

e.en: Anxiety can give you a {distorted} view of yourself.
e.zh: 焦虑会让你对自己产生扭曲的看法。

e.en: The funhouse mirrors kept {distorting} our reflections hilariously.
e.zh: 哈哈镜不断把我们的影像扭曲得很搞笑。

e.en: He accused the media of {distorting} his original statement.
e.zh: 他指责媒体歪曲了他原本的说法。

e.en: Turn the gain down to avoid {distortion} on the recording.
e.zh: 把增益调低，避免录音出现失真。

e.en: The article was a complete {distortion} of what actually happened.
e.zh: 这篇文章完全歪曲了事情的真相。

e.en: Wide-angle lenses introduce noticeable {distortions} near the edges.
e.zh: 广角镜头会在边缘产生明显的畸变。

e.en: Therapy helped her recognize the cognitive {distortions} in her thinking.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她意识到自己思维中的认知扭曲。

distorts.t: v. 扭曲；歪曲（第三人称单数）

e.en: Stretching the photo {distorts} the faces in unflattering ways.
e.zh: 拉伸照片会让人脸变得很难看。

e.en: Selective editing {distorts} the speaker's actual message.
e.zh: 选择性剪辑歪曲了说话者的真实意思。

distract.t: v. 使分心；转移注意力

e.en: Please don't {distract} the driver while he's parking.
e.zh: 司机停车时请不要分散他的注意力。

e.en: I play music to {distract} myself from boring chores.
e.zh: 我会放音乐来分散自己做无聊家务的注意力。

distracted.t: adj. 心神不宁的；分心的

e.en: She seemed {distracted} during the meeting and missed the question.
e.zh: 开会时她心不在焉，没听到那个问题。

e.en: {Distracted} driving causes thousands of accidents each year.
e.zh: 分心驾驶每年造成数千起事故。

e.en: He nodded {distractedly} while scrolling through his phone.
e.zh: 他一边刷手机，一边心不在焉地点头。

e.en: She stirred her coffee {distractedly}, lost in thought.
e.zh: 她若有所思地搅着咖啡，心思全不在这里。

e.en: The puppy was the biggest {distracter} during my video call.
e.zh: 视频通话时，那只小狗是最让人分心的因素。

e.en: Each multiple-choice question contains one answer and three {distracter} options.
e.zh: 每道选择题都包含一个正确答案和三个干扰选项。

e.en: The flickering light was really {distracting} during the exam.
e.zh: 考试时那盏闪烁的灯真让人分心。

e.en: I find background music more {distracting} than helpful when coding.
e.zh: 写代码时，我觉得背景音乐与其说是帮助，不如说更让人分心。

e.en: His new haircut was {distractingly} bright orange.
e.zh: 他的新发型是亮橙色，看着特别让人分神。

e.en: The notification sound was {distractingly} loud in the quiet office.
e.zh: 在安静的办公室里，提示音吵得让人没法专心。

distraction.t:
n. 分心；干扰
n. 消遣

e.en: I keep my phone in another room to avoid {distraction}.
e.zh: 我把手机放在另一个房间，以免分心。

e.en: Going hiking was a welcome {distraction} from work stress.
e.zh: 去远足是从工作压力中难得的一种放松。

e.en: Working from home comes with all sorts of {distractions}.
e.zh: 在家工作会遇到各种各样让人分心的事。

e.en: He turned off notifications to eliminate {distractions} while studying.
e.zh: 他关掉了通知，避免学习时被打扰。

e.en: The flashing ads on the page were highly {distractive}.
e.zh: 页面上闪烁的广告非常让人分心。

e.en: Avoid {distractive} background patterns when designing slides.
e.zh: 做幻灯片时要避免使用容易让人分心的背景图案。

distractor.t: n. 干扰项；分散注意力的事物

e.en: Each wrong option is a carefully written {distractor} on the test.
e.zh: 考试中每个错误选项都是精心设计的干扰项。

e.en: Social media is the biggest {distractor} for most students today.
e.zh: 对当今大多数学生来说，社交媒体是最大的干扰源。

distracts.t: v. 使分心（第三人称单数）

e.en: The constant pinging of messages {distracts} me from deep work.
e.zh: 消息不停的提示音让我没法进入深度工作。

e.en: A noisy keyboard {distracts} everyone in a shared office.
e.zh: 在共享办公室里，吵闹的键盘声会让所有人分心。

e.en: The landlord threatened to {distrain} on the tenant's property for unpaid rent.
e.zh: 房东威胁要因未付租金扣押租客的财产。

e.en: Old laws allowed creditors to {distrain} goods to recover debts.
e.zh: 旧时的法律允许债权人扣押物品以追讨债务。

distraint.t: n. 扣押财物（法律术语）

e.en: The court issued a {distraint} order against the company's assets.
e.zh: 法院对该公司的资产发出了扣押令。

e.en: {Distraint} is a legal way to seize property to satisfy a debt.
e.zh: 扣押是一种用以抵偿债务而扣留财产的合法手段。

e.en: She seemed {distrait} all evening, barely touching her food.
e.zh: 她整晚都心神不宁，几乎没怎么吃东西。

e.en: The {distrait} writer stared out the window for hours.
e.zh: 那位心不在焉的作家盯着窗外看了好几个小时。

distraught.t: adj. 心烦意乱的；忧心忡忡的

e.en: The {distraught} parents searched all night for their missing child.
e.zh: 心急如焚的父母彻夜寻找走失的孩子。

e.en: She was {distraught} after losing the contract she'd worked on for months.
e.zh: 丢了筹备数月的合同后，她痛苦得不能自已。

distress.t:
n. 痛苦；忧伤
v. 使苦恼

e.en: The puppy showed clear signs of {distress} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，小狗明显表现出不安的样子。

e.en: Don't {distress} yourself over a few negative comments online.
e.zh: 不必为网上几条负面评论而苦恼。

e.en: She was visibly {distressed} after reading the email.
e.zh: 看完那封邮件后，她明显非常难过。

e.en: Many wear {distressed} jeans for that worn-in, casual look.
e.zh: 很多人穿做旧的牛仔裤，营造出那种随性磨损的感觉。

distresses.t:
n. 痛苦（复数）
v. 使苦恼

e.en: It {distresses} me to see animals treated cruelly.
e.zh: 看到动物被虐待让我非常痛心。

e.en: The factory artificially {distresses} the leather to look vintage.
e.zh: 工厂会人为做旧皮革，使其看起来有复古感。

distressful.t: adj. 痛苦的；令人苦恼的

e.en: Losing the job was a {distressful} experience for the whole family.
e.zh: 失业对全家人来说都是一段痛苦的经历。

e.en: She avoids {distressful} news before going to bed.
e.zh: 她睡前会避免看令人难过的新闻。

distressing.t: adj. 令人痛苦的；令人难过的

e.en: The video contains {distressing} scenes that may upset some viewers.
e.zh: 该视频包含可能让部分观众感到不安的画面。

e.en: It's {distressing} to watch a friend struggle with depression.
e.zh: 看着朋友被抑郁困扰，让人非常难过。

e.en: The wait times at the clinic were {distressingly} long.
e.zh: 诊所的等待时间长得让人难以忍受。

e.en: Customer service was {distressingly} unhelpful when I called.
e.zh: 我打电话时，客服态度差得让人心累。

distributable.t: adj. 可分配的；可分发的

e.en: After taxes, the {distributable} profit was much smaller than expected.
e.zh: 扣税后，可分配利润比预期少了很多。

e.en: The library packages the code into a {distributable} binary.
e.zh: 该程序库将代码打包成可分发的二进制文件。

e.en: Volunteers will {distribute} water bottles along the marathon route.
e.zh: 志愿者会沿着马拉松路线发放瓶装水。

e.en: We use a CDN to {distribute} content faster worldwide.
e.zh: 我们使用CDN在全球更快地分发内容。

distributed.t:
adj. 分布式的（系统）
v. 分发

e.en: The relief workers {distributed} food to hundreds of families.
e.zh: 救援人员向数百个家庭发放了食物。

e.en: Modern databases run on a {distributed} cluster of servers.
e.zh: 现代数据库运行在分布式的服务器集群上。

distributes.t: v. 分发；分配（第三人称单数）

e.en: The company {distributes} its products through online retailers.
e.zh: 该公司通过线上零售商分销自己的产品。

e.en: This algorithm {distributes} the workload evenly across all cores.
e.zh: 该算法将工作负载均匀分配到所有核心上。

e.en: They spent the morning {distributing} flyers around the neighborhood.
e.zh: 他们一上午都在小区里发传单。

e.en: The system handles load by {distributing} requests across multiple servers.
e.zh: 该系统通过将请求分发到多台服务器来处理负载。

e.en: Netflix changed how movie {distribution} works around the world.
e.zh: Netflix改变了全球电影发行的方式。

e.en: The chart shows the age {distribution} of our users.
e.zh: 图表显示了我们用户的年龄分布。

e.en: The study revealed {distributional} differences between rural and urban incomes.
e.zh: 该研究揭示了城乡收入之间的分布差异。

e.en: Tax reform raised concerns about {distributional} fairness.
e.zh: 税制改革引发了人们对分配公平性的担忧。

e.en: Linux comes in many {distributions} like Ubuntu and Fedora.
e.zh: Linux有很多发行版，比如Ubuntu和Fedora。

e.en: Statisticians compare two {distributions} to spot meaningful differences.
e.zh: 统计学家会比较两个分布以找出有意义的差异。

e.en: Math class today covered the {distributive} property of multiplication.
e.zh: 今天数学课讲的是乘法的分配律。

e.en: The party campaigned on {distributive} justice and fair wages.
e.zh: 该党的竞选纲领是分配正义和合理工资。

e.en: They became the official {distributor} for the brand in Asia.
e.zh: 他们成为了该品牌在亚洲的官方经销商。

e.en: The car wouldn't start because the {distributor} cap was cracked.
e.zh: 汽车发动不了，因为分电器盖裂了。

e.en: We're looking for {distributors} to expand into European markets.
e.zh: 我们正在寻找经销商，以拓展欧洲市场。

e.en: Several {distributors} pulled the product after the recall.
e.zh: 召回事件后，多家分销商下架了该产品。

e.en: He bought a Toyota {distributorship} in his hometown last year.
e.zh: 去年他在家乡买下了一家丰田经销商的代理权。

e.en: The exclusive {distributorship} agreement covers all of Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 这份独家经销协议覆盖整个东南亚地区。

e.en: The financial {district} is unusually quiet on weekends.
e.zh: 金融区周末出奇地安静。

e.en: Our school {district} just announced a longer summer break.
e.zh: 我们学区刚刚宣布要延长暑假。

e.en: The city's historic {districts} attract millions of tourists yearly.
e.zh: 这座城市的历史街区每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: Voting {districts} were redrawn after the latest census.
e.zh: 最新一次人口普查后，选区被重新划分。

distrust.t:
n. 不信任
v. 怀疑、不信任

e.en: Years of broken promises bred deep {distrust} of the government.
e.zh: 多年的食言导致人们对政府深深的不信任。

e.en: Many users {distrust} apps that ask for too many permissions.
e.zh: 许多用户不信任那些索要过多权限的应用。

e.en: He grew {distrustful} of strangers after being scammed online.
e.zh: 被网上骗过之后，他对陌生人变得很警惕。

e.en: Cats are naturally {distrustful} of new people in the house.
e.zh: 猫天生就会对家里来的新面孔保持警惕。

e.en: Please don't {disturb} her — she's finally taking a nap.
e.zh: 请别打扰她，她好不容易才睡个午觉。

e.en: Hikers are reminded not to {disturb} the wildlife in the park.
e.zh: 提醒徒步者不要惊扰公园里的野生动物。

e.en: Police were called about a {disturbance} at the bar.
e.zh: 警方接到酒吧发生骚乱的报警。

e.en: Even a small {disturbance} can wake the baby up.
e.zh: 即使一点小动静也会把宝宝吵醒。

e.en: Weather {disturbances} are expected along the coast tonight.
e.zh: 今晚沿海地区预计会有天气扰动。

e.en: She suffered sleep {disturbances} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后她睡眠一直不安稳。

disturbed.t: adj. 心神不宁的；被打扰的

e.en: Sorry, I hope I haven't {disturbed} your work.
e.zh: 抱歉,希望我没有打扰到你的工作。

e.en: He was deeply {disturbed} by the news report.
e.zh: 那条新闻报道让他深感不安。

e.en: The cat is the main {disturber} of my afternoon nap.
e.zh: 那只猫是我午睡的头号捣乱分子。

e.en: History remembers him as a {disturber} of the peace.
e.zh: 历史把他记作扰乱和平的人。

disturbing.t: adj. 令人不安的、扰乱的

e.en: The video contains {disturbing} scenes of violence.
e.zh: 该视频包含令人不安的暴力场面。

e.en: It's {disturbing} how quickly fake news spreads online.
e.zh: 假新闻在网上传播之快令人担忧。

e.en: The error rate is {disturbingly} high in production.
e.zh: 生产环境的错误率高得令人不安。

e.en: His reply sounded {disturbingly} similar to a scam.
e.zh: 他的回复听起来像诈骗,令人警觉。

disturbs.t: v. 打扰、扰乱（第三人称单数）

e.en: Loud music {disturbs} the neighbors every weekend.
e.zh: 大声的音乐每个周末都吵到邻居。

e.en: What {disturbs} me most is the lack of evidence.
e.zh: 最让我不安的是缺乏证据。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new copper {disulphate} compound.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的二硫酸铜化合物。

e.en: Sodium {disulphate} is sometimes used as a preservative.
e.zh: 二硫酸钠有时被用作防腐剂。

e.en: Hydrogen {disulphide} has a strong, unpleasant smell.
e.zh: 二硫化氢有一股强烈刺鼻的气味。

e.en: Proteins are stabilized by internal {disulphide} bonds.
e.zh: 蛋白质靠内部二硫键来保持稳定。

e.en: Civil war led to the temporary {disunion} of the states.
e.zh: 内战导致各州一度分裂。

e.en: Political {disunion} weakened the country's economy.
e.zh: 政治上的分裂削弱了该国经济。

e.en: Misinformation can quickly {disunite} a community.
e.zh: 虚假信息会很快让一个社区分裂。

e.en: The scandal threatened to {disunite} the ruling party.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻可能让执政党分崩离析。

e.en: Internal {disunity} cost the team the championship.
e.zh: 内部不团结让球队丢掉了冠军。

e.en: Voters punished the party for its visible {disunity}.
e.zh: 选民因该党明显的分裂而抛弃了它。

e.en: The old factory has fallen into {disuse}.
e.zh: 那座旧工厂已经废弃不用了。

e.en: Many local dialects are sliding into {disuse}.
e.zh: 许多地方方言正在逐渐消失。

disused.t: adj. 废弃的、不再使用的

e.en: They turned the {disused} warehouse into a gallery.
e.zh: 他们把废弃的仓库改造成了画廊。

e.en: Hikers explored the {disused} railway tunnel.
e.zh: 徒步者探索了那条废弃的铁路隧道。

e.en: "Table" and "window" are common {disyllabic} words.
e.zh: "table" 和 "window" 都是常见的双音节词。

e.en: Chinese names are often {disyllabic} in modern usage.
e.zh: 现代汉语中,人名常常是双音节的。

dit.t: n. 摩斯电码中的点（短音）

e.en: Morse code uses a short {dit} and a longer dah.
e.zh: 摩尔斯电码用短音 dit 和长音 dah。

e.en: Each {dit} lasts only a fraction of a second.
e.zh: 每个短点只持续几分之一秒。

ditch.t:
n. 沟渠、壕沟
v. 抛弃、甩掉

e.en: Let's {ditch} the meeting and grab lunch instead.
e.zh: 我们翘掉会议去吃午饭吧。

e.en: The car skidded into a muddy {ditch}.
e.zh: 汽车打滑冲进了一条泥沟里。

ditching.t: v. 抛弃；挖沟（ditch 的现在分词）

e.en: She's {ditching} her old phone for a newer model.
e.zh: 她要把旧手机换成新款的。

e.en: The pilot practiced {ditching} the plane in water.
e.zh: 飞行员练习把飞机迫降到水面上。

dither.t:
v. 犹豫不决
n. 抖动、抖色（图像处理）

e.en: Stop {dither}ing and just pick a restaurant!
e.zh: 别再犹豫了,随便选一家餐厅吧!

e.en: Audio engineers add {dither} to reduce digital noise.
e.zh: 音频工程师加入抖动信号来减少数字噪声。

e.en: He {dithered} for weeks before accepting the offer.
e.zh: 他犹豫了好几周才接受那份录用通知。

e.en: The image was {dithered} to fit the limited palette.
e.zh: 图像经过抖动处理以适应有限的调色板。

dithering.t:
n. 抖动处理（图像）
v. 犹豫不决

e.en: Stop {dithering} and make a decision already.
e.zh: 别再优柔寡断了,赶紧做决定吧。

e.en: {Dithering} smooths color transitions in low-bit images.
e.zh: 抖动算法能让低位图像的颜色过渡更平滑。

dithers.t: v. 犹豫不决（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {dithers} when ordering at a new café.
e.zh: 在新咖啡馆点单时他总是犹豫不决。

e.en: She {dithers} between two job offers every night.
e.zh: 她每晚都在两份工作邀请之间摇摆不定。

e.en: She plays a {ditsy} character in the new sitcom.
e.zh: 她在这部新情景喜剧里演一个迷糊的角色。

e.en: Don't act so {ditsy}; you know the answer.
e.zh: 别装糊涂了,你知道答案的。

ditto.t:
adv. 同上、同前
n. 同上符号

e.en: "I love sushi." "{Ditto}, especially salmon."
e.zh: "我爱吃寿司。""我也是,特别是三文鱼。"

e.en: He hates Mondays, and {ditto} for me.
e.zh: 他讨厌星期一,我也一样。

e.en: The village of {Ditton} sits beside the river Thames.
e.zh: 迪顿村坐落在泰晤士河边上。

e.en: She grew up near {Ditton} in southern England.
e.zh: 她在英格兰南部的迪顿附近长大。

e.en: He hummed a cheerful {ditty} while washing dishes.
e.zh: 他一边洗碗一边哼着欢快的小曲。

e.en: The kids made up a silly {ditty} about their teacher.
e.zh: 孩子们编了一首关于老师的搞笑小调。

e.en: I felt like a total {ditz} after locking myself out.
e.zh: 把自己锁在门外后我觉得自己像个糊涂虫。

e.en: She acts like a {ditz} but is secretly brilliant.
e.zh: 她表面迷糊,其实聪明得很。

e.en: My {ditzy} friend forgot her own birthday again.
e.zh: 我那个迷糊的朋友又忘了自己的生日。

e.en: The movie features a {ditzy} but lovable heroine.
e.zh: 这部电影主角是个迷糊却可爱的女主。

diuretic.t:
n. 利尿剂
adj. 利尿的

e.en: Coffee has a mild {diuretic} effect on most people.
e.zh: 咖啡对大多数人有轻微的利尿作用。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {diuretic} for her blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生给她开了利尿剂来降血压。

diurnal.t: adj. 白天活动的；每日的

e.en: Squirrels are {diurnal} animals, active during the day.
e.zh: 松鼠是昼行性动物,白天活动。

e.en: The plant follows a strict {diurnal} rhythm.
e.zh: 这种植物遵循严格的昼夜节律。

div.t: n. HTML 中的 div 标签（分区）

e.en: Wrap the content in a {div} with a custom class.
e.zh: 把内容放进一个带自定义类名的 div 里。

e.en: Each card is rendered as a separate {div} element.
e.zh: 每张卡片都被渲染成一个独立的 div 元素。

e.en: The opera {diva} received a standing ovation.
e.zh: 那位歌剧女主角获得了全场起立鼓掌。

e.en: Don't be such a {diva} about the seating.
e.zh: 别为座位的事这么耍大牌好吗。

e.en: The professor tends to {divagate} from the main topic.
e.zh: 那位教授总是会偏离主题。

e.en: Try not to {divagate} when answering interview questions.
e.zh: 回答面试问题时尽量别东拉西扯。

e.en: She lounged on the velvet {divan} reading a novel.
e.zh: 她斜靠在丝绒长沙发上看小说。

e.en: The hotel room had an antique {divan} by the window.
e.zh: 酒店房间窗边摆着一张古董长榻。

dive.t:
v. 潜水、跳水；俯冲
n. 跳水

e.en: Let's {dive} into the data and find the bug.
e.zh: 我们来深入研究数据,找出那个 bug。

e.en: She made a perfect {dive} from the ten-meter board.
e.zh: 她从十米跳台完成了一次完美跳水。

e.en: He {dived} into the pool to cool off.
e.zh: 他跳进泳池里凉快一下。

e.en: Stock prices {dived} after the disappointing earnings.
e.zh: 业绩令人失望后,股价应声暴跌。

diver.t: n. 潜水员；跳水运动员

e.en: The {diver} surfaced after exploring the coral reef.
e.zh: 潜水员探索完珊瑚礁后浮出水面。

e.en: She trained as an Olympic {diver} from age six.
e.zh: 她从六岁起就接受奥运跳水运动员的训练。

e.en: Our opinions {diverge} on how to handle the budget.
e.zh: 在如何处理预算上,我们的意见出现分歧。

e.en: The path will {diverge} just past the old oak tree.
e.zh: 过了那棵老橡树,小路就会分岔。

e.en: The {divisional} manager visits each branch every quarter.
e.zh: 部门经理每个季度都会巡视各分公司。

e.en: Our team won the {divisional} championship last weekend.
e.zh: 我们队上周末赢得了分区冠军。

divisions.t: n. 分部；部门；分歧（division 的复数）

e.en: The company has six {divisions} across three continents.
e.zh: 该公司在三大洲设有六个事业部。

e.en: Deep political {divisions} continue to split the country.
e.zh: 深刻的政治分歧持续撕裂着这个国家。

divisive.t: adj. 引起分歧的；造成不和的

e.en: Immigration remains a {divisive} issue in many countries.
e.zh: 移民问题在许多国家仍是一个争议性话题。

e.en: His {divisive} comments sparked outrage on social media.
e.zh: 他挑拨性的言论在社交媒体上引发了愤怒。

e.en: The new leader hopes to heal years of {divisiveness}.
e.zh: 新领导人希望弥合多年来的分裂局面。

e.en: Social media often amplifies {divisiveness} between political groups.
e.zh: 社交媒体常加剧不同政治阵营间的对立。

e.en: In this equation, six is the {divisor}.
e.zh: 在这个等式里，六是除数。

e.en: Find the greatest common {divisor} of these two numbers.
e.zh: 求这两个数的最大公约数。

divorce.t:
n./v. 离婚
v. 分离；脱离

e.en: They filed for {divorce} after twelve years of marriage.
e.zh: 他们结婚十二年后提出了离婚。

e.en: You can't {divorce} the design from its cultural context.
e.zh: 设计无法脱离其文化背景。

divorced.t:
adj. 离婚的
v. 离婚（过去式）

e.en: My parents got {divorced} when I was eight.
e.zh: 我八岁时父母离了婚。

e.en: His theories seem completely {divorced} from real life.
e.zh: 他的理论似乎完全脱离了现实生活。

e.en: She's a successful {divorcee} who started her own business.
e.zh: 她是位事业有成的离异女士，自己开了公司。

e.en: The dating app caters to professional {divorcee} clients.
e.zh: 这款约会应用专为职业离异人士服务。

divorces.t:
n. 离婚（复数）
v. 离婚（第三人称单数）

e.en: The number of {divorces} has dropped over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里离婚数量有所下降。

e.en: He {divorces} his personal feelings from business decisions.
e.zh: 他把个人情感和商业决策完全分开。

e.en: She is {divorcing} her husband after years of conflict.
e.zh: 经过多年争执，她正与丈夫办理离婚。

e.en: Critics warn against {divorcing} ethics from technology development.
e.zh: 批评者警告不要把伦理与科技发展割裂开来。

divot.t: n. (打球时铲起的) 草皮块

e.en: The golfer replaced the {divot} after his powerful swing.
e.zh: 挥杆有力之后，那位高尔夫球手把草皮放回原处。

e.en: My boots left a deep {divot} in the wet lawn.
e.zh: 我的靴子在湿草坪上留下了一个深坑。

e.en: The witness refused to {divulge} her source's identity.
e.zh: 证人拒绝透露其消息来源的身份。

e.en: Please don't {divulge} the surprise party plans to him.
e.zh: 请别把惊喜派对的计划告诉他。

e.en: Let's {divvy} up the pizza before it gets cold.
e.zh: 我们趁披萨没凉先分一下吧。

e.en: They {divvy} the profits equally among the four partners.
e.zh: 他们把利润在四位合伙人间平分。

e.en: Dorothea {Dix} fought for better mental health care in America.
e.zh: 多萝西娅·迪克斯为美国争取更好的心理健康护理。

e.en: The street is named after Senator {Dix} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 这条街以19世纪的迪克斯参议员命名。

dixie.t: n. 美国南部各州的别称

e.en: The band played an old {Dixie} tune at the festival.
e.zh: 乐队在音乐节上演奏了一首老南方曲子。

e.en: She poured lemonade into a paper {Dixie} cup.
e.zh: 她把柠檬水倒进迪克西纸杯里。

dixons.t: n. 迪克森（英国电器零售商）

e.en: I bought my first laptop at {Dixons} years ago.
e.zh: 我多年前在迪克森电器买了第一台笔记本电脑。

e.en: The old {Dixons} store on the high street has closed.
e.zh: 主街上那家老迪克森电器店已经关门了。

diy.t: n. 自己动手做（Do It Yourself 的缩写）

e.en: He built the bookshelf as a weekend {DIY} project.
e.zh: 他把书架当作周末DIY项目自己做了。

e.en: Many homeowners prefer {DIY} repairs to save money.
e.zh: 很多业主为了省钱更愿意自己动手修理。

e.en: She lit a small {diya} on the windowsill for Diwali.
e.zh: 她在窗台上为排灯节点了一盏小油灯。

e.en: The temple glowed with hundreds of flickering {diya} lamps.
e.zh: 寺庙里数百盏摇曳的迪雅油灯闪烁生辉。

e.en: {Dizygotic} twins develop from two separately fertilized eggs.
e.zh: 异卵双胞胎由两个分别受精的卵子发育而来。

e.en: The study compared {dizygotic} and identical twins for genetic traits.
e.zh: 该研究比较了异卵双胞胎与同卵双胞胎的遗传特征。

e.en: She stood up too fast and swayed {dizzily} for a moment.
e.zh: 她起得太快,晕乎乎地晃了一下。

e.en: The kite spun {dizzily} in the strong autumn wind.
e.zh: 风筝在秋风中头晕目眩般地打转。

e.en: Sudden {dizziness} can be a sign of low blood pressure.
e.zh: 突然的头晕可能是低血压的征兆。

e.en: Drink more water if you feel {dizziness} after exercise.
e.zh: 如果运动后感到头晕,就多喝点水。

e.en: I felt {dizzy} after spinning around with the kids.
e.zh: 和孩子们转圈玩之后,我感到一阵头晕。

e.en: The roller coaster left everyone laughing and {dizzy}.
e.zh: 过山车下来后,大家都笑着、晕乎乎的。

dizzying.t: adj. 令人眩晕的；令人目眩的

e.en: Tech stocks have risen at a {dizzying} pace this year.
e.zh: 科技股今年以令人眼花缭乱的速度上涨。

e.en: From the cliff edge, the drop was truly {dizzying}.
e.zh: 从悬崖边望下去,落差真是令人头晕目眩。

djellaba.t: n. 杰拉巴（阿拉伯人的连帽长袍）

e.en: He wore a striped {djellaba} through the Marrakesh market.
e.zh: 他穿着条纹长袍走过马拉喀什的市场。

e.en: The hooded {djellaba} kept the desert chill away at night.
e.zh: 那件带帽长袍夜里挡住了沙漠的寒气。

e.en: {Djibouti} hosts several foreign military bases on the Red Sea.
e.zh: 吉布提在红海沿岸驻有多个外国军事基地。

e.en: Ships pass {Djibouti} on the busy route to the Suez Canal.
e.zh: 船只经过吉布提,前往繁忙的苏伊士运河航线。

e.en: The festival lineup features {DJs} from twelve different countries.
e.zh: 音乐节阵容汇集了来自十二个国家的DJ。

e.en: Top {DJs} now stream their sets live on Twitch.
e.zh: 顶级DJ现在会在Twitch上直播他们的现场表演。

dlp.t: n. 数字光处理技术（Digital Light Processing）

e.en: The new projector uses {DLP} technology for sharper images.
e.zh: 这台新投影仪采用DLP技术,画面更清晰。

e.en: Our company deployed {DLP} software to prevent data leaks.
e.zh: 我们公司部署了DLP软件来防止数据泄露。

e.en: Take the {DLR} from Bank to reach Canary Wharf quickly.
e.zh: 从Bank站乘DLR轻轨可以快速到达金丝雀码头。

e.en: The {DLR} runs through east London without any drivers.
e.zh: DLR轻轨穿越伦敦东区,全程无人驾驶。

dme.t: n. 测距设备（Distance Measuring Equipment）

e.en: Pilots tune the {DME} to measure distance to the airport.
e.zh: 飞行员调谐DME来测量距机场的距离。

e.en: Medicare often covers {DME} like wheelchairs and oxygen tanks.
e.zh: 医保通常会覆盖轮椅和氧气罐等耐用医疗设备。

e.en: Police matched {DNA} from the scene to the suspect.
e.zh: 警方将现场的DNA与嫌疑人匹配上了。

e.en: Innovation is part of this company's {DNA}.
e.zh: 创新是这家公司骨子里的基因。

e.en: The lab compared {DNAs} from several extinct species.
e.zh: 实验室比较了几种已灭绝物种的DNA样本。

e.en: Researchers extracted ancient {DNAs} from frozen mammoth tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员从冷冻猛犸象组织中提取了古DNA样本。

e.en: Add {DNase} to the sample to remove genomic contamination.
e.zh: 在样品中加入DNA酶,以去除基因组污染。

e.en: The drug contains recombinant {DNase} to thin lung mucus.
e.zh: 该药物含有重组DNA酶,用于稀释肺部黏液。

e.en: The {Dnestr} river flows from Ukraine into the Black Sea.
e.zh: 德涅斯特河从乌克兰流入黑海。

e.en: Old fortresses still stand along the banks of the {Dnestr}.
e.zh: 古老的堡垒至今仍矗立在德涅斯特河两岸。

e.en: The deadline is tight but still {doable} with overtime.
e.zh: 截止日期很紧,但加班还是能做到的。

e.en: Running five kilometers feels {doable} after weeks of training.
e.zh: 经过几周训练,跑五公里感觉是可以做到的。

dobbin.t: n. 多宾（马的常用名，泛指老实的马）

e.en: Old {Dobbin} pulled the cart slowly up the hill.
e.zh: 老马多宾慢慢地把车拉上山坡。

e.en: The children fed apples to gentle {Dobbin} in the field.
e.zh: 孩子们在田里给温顺的老马多宾喂苹果。

e.en: Her {Doberman} barks fiercely whenever the doorbell rings.
e.zh: 门铃一响,她的杜宾犬就会凶猛地叫。

e.en: A well-trained {Doberman} can be a loyal family pet.
e.zh: 训练有素的杜宾犬可以成为忠诚的家庭宠物。

doc.t: n. 文档（document 缩写）；医生（doctor 缩写）

e.en: The {doc} said I need more rest and water.
e.zh: 医生说我需要多休息、多喝水。

e.en: Save the {doc} as a PDF before sending it.
e.zh: 发送前请把文档另存为PDF。

docent.t: n. (博物馆) 讲解员；大学讲师

e.en: The museum {docent} explained each painting in vivid detail.
e.zh: 博物馆讲解员生动地介绍了每幅画作。

e.en: She volunteers as a {docent} at the natural history museum.
e.zh: 她在自然历史博物馆做志愿讲解员。

diverged.t: v. 分歧、偏离（divergeの过去式）

e.en: Their careers {diverged} sharply after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业之后,他们的职业道路明显分道扬镳。

e.en: The two species {diverged} millions of years ago.
e.zh: 这两个物种在数百万年前就已分化。

divergence.t:
n. 分歧、差异
n. 分叉、偏离

e.en: There's a clear {divergence} between theory and practice.
e.zh: 理论与实践之间存在明显的差异。

e.en: The chart shows a {divergence} in market trends.
e.zh: 图表显示出市场走势出现分化。

e.en: Small {divergences} in pronunciation reveal a speaker's region.
e.zh: 细微的发音差异能透露出说话者的地域。

e.en: Analysts noted key {divergences} between the two reports.
e.zh: 分析师注意到两份报告之间的关键分歧。

divergent.t:
adj. 不同的、有差异的
adj. 发散的

e.en: The committee held wildly {divergent} views on the policy.
e.zh: 委员会成员对该政策持有截然不同的看法。

e.en: Creative tasks reward {divergent} thinking over rote answers.
e.zh: 创造性任务更看重发散思维而非死记硬背。

diverges.t: v. 分歧、偏离（第三人称单数）

e.en: The road {diverges} into two narrow trails ahead.
e.zh: 前方道路分成两条狭窄的小径。

e.en: His version {diverges} significantly from the official report.
e.zh: 他的说法与官方报告存在很大差异。

diverging.t: v. 分岔、偏离（现在分词）

e.en: The siblings have {diverging} views on their mother's care.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹对母亲的照护问题意见不一。

e.en: Two {diverging} trails meet again near the lake.
e.zh: 两条分开的小径在湖边再次交汇。

divers.t: adj. 若干的、各种的（古用）

e.en: Professional {divers} explored the shipwreck for artifacts.
e.zh: 专业潜水员搜寻沉船中的文物。

e.en: Rescue {divers} searched the river through the night.
e.zh: 救援潜水员通宵搜索那条河。

diverse.t: adj. 多样的、各种各样的

e.en: The team brings together people from {diverse} backgrounds.
e.zh: 团队汇聚了来自不同背景的人。

e.en: The city offers {diverse} food options on every street.
e.zh: 这座城市的每条街都有各式各样的美食。

e.en: The portfolio is {diversely} invested across many sectors.
e.zh: 该投资组合在多个行业间进行了多元化配置。

e.en: Audiences responded {diversely} to the controversial film.
e.zh: 观众对这部争议性电影反应各异。

e.en: {Diversification} helps reduce risk in any investment portfolio.
e.zh: 分散投资有助于降低投资组合的风险。

e.en: The company's {diversification} into software paid off.
e.zh: 公司向软件领域多元化发展取得了回报。

diversified.t:
adj. 多元化的
v. 使多样化（过去式）

e.en: She {diversified} her income with freelance writing.
e.zh: 她通过自由撰稿让自己的收入来源更多元。

e.en: A well-{diversified} portfolio weathers market downturns better.
e.zh: 分散得当的投资组合更能抵御市场下行。

diversify.t: v. 使多样化、分散（投资等）

e.en: Experts advise investors to {diversify} their holdings.
e.zh: 专家建议投资者分散自己的持仓。

e.en: The brand wants to {diversify} into skincare next year.
e.zh: 该品牌打算明年拓展到护肤产品领域。

diversion.t:
n. 转移、改道
n. 消遣

e.en: The road closure created a {diversion} through the village.
e.zh: 道路封闭迫使车辆改道穿过村庄。

e.en: Gaming is a welcome {diversion} after a long workday.
e.zh: 漫长工作日后，打游戏是一种很好的消遣。

diversionary.t: adj. 转移注意力的、佯攻的

e.en: The troops launched a {diversionary} attack to confuse the enemy.
e.zh: 部队发动了一次佯攻以迷惑敌人。

e.en: His angry tweet was just a {diversionary} tactic.
e.zh: 他那条愤怒的推文只是个转移视线的伎俩。

e.en: Heavy traffic forced several {diversions} on the highway.
e.zh: 交通拥堵迫使高速公路上设置了多处改道。

e.en: The resort offers plenty of {diversions} for kids.
e.zh: 该度假村为孩子们提供了许多娱乐活动。

e.en: The festival celebrates the cultural {diversities} of our city.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝我们城市的多元文化。

e.en: Biologists study the {diversities} found in tropical forests.
e.zh: 生物学家研究热带森林中的物种多样性。

e.en: The team values {diversity} of background and opinion.
e.zh: 团队重视背景和观点的多样性。

e.en: Coral reefs support an amazing {diversity} of marine life.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁孕育了惊人多样的海洋生物。

divert.t:
v. 转移、使转向
v. 使消遣

e.en: Engineers plan to {divert} the river around the dam.
e.zh: 工程师计划让河流绕过大坝改道。

e.en: Cartoons can {divert} a fussy toddler for hours.
e.zh: 动画片能让爱闹的小孩开心好几个小时。

e.en: The flight was {diverted} to Denver due to fog.
e.zh: 由于大雾，航班被改飞至丹佛。

e.en: She {diverted} funds from marketing to product development.
e.zh: 她把营销预算转用于产品开发。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her stomach pain as {diverticulitis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的腹痛为憩室炎。

e.en: A high-fiber diet may help prevent {diverticulitis} flare-ups.
e.zh: 高纤维饮食有助于预防憩室炎发作。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {diverticulum} in the colon.
e.zh: 扫描显示结肠内有一个小憩室。

e.en: An inflamed {diverticulum} can cause severe abdominal pain.
e.zh: 发炎的憩室会引起严重的腹痛。

divertimento.t: n. 嬉游曲（一种轻松的古典乐曲）

e.en: Mozart's {divertimento} played softly during the dinner party.
e.zh: 晚宴上轻轻播放着莫扎特的嬉游曲。

e.en: The orchestra opened with a cheerful {divertimento}.
e.zh: 乐团以一首欢快的嬉游曲开场。

diverting.t: adj. 有趣的、使人消遣的

e.en: The novel was a {diverting} read on the long flight.
e.zh: 这本小说是长途飞行中一本有趣的读物。

e.en: Police are {diverting} traffic away from the accident scene.
e.zh: 警方正引导车辆绕开事故现场。

e.en: The ballet included a charming {divertissement} between acts.
e.zh: 芭蕾舞剧在幕间穿插了一段迷人的插舞。

e.en: Her painting hobby is a pleasant {divertissement} from work.
e.zh: 绘画爱好是她工作之余愉快的消遣。

diverts.t: v. 转移（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new app {diverts} notifications during focus hours.
e.zh: 这款新应用会在专注时段屏蔽通知。

e.en: A clever joke often {diverts} attention from awkward moments.
e.zh: 一个巧妙的玩笑常能化解尴尬的气氛。

dives.t:
v. 潜水、跳水（第三人称单数）
n. 俯冲

e.en: The hawk {dives} suddenly to catch its prey.
e.zh: 那只鹰猛然俯冲下来捕捉猎物。

e.en: Bitcoin {dives} ten percent after the regulator's announcement.
e.zh: 监管机构宣布后，比特币暴跌了百分之十。

e.en: The university plans to {divest} from fossil fuel companies.
e.zh: 该大学计划撤资退出化石燃料公司。

e.en: Activists urged the firm to {divest} its arms holdings.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促该公司剥离其军火资产。

e.en: The company {divested} its struggling European division last year.
e.zh: 该公司去年剥离了陷入困境的欧洲分部。

e.en: He {divested} himself of all corporate stock before running.
e.zh: 参选前，他出售了所有公司股票。

e.en: The {divestiture} of the media unit raised two billion dollars.
e.zh: 剥离媒体部门为公司筹得二十亿美元。

e.en: Regulators demanded {divestiture} as a condition of the merger.
e.zh: 监管机构要求资产剥离作为合并的条件。

e.en: Climate activists pushed for full {divestment} from oil stocks.
e.zh: 气候活动人士推动彻底撤出石油股。

e.en: The {divestment} campaign gained support across many campuses.
e.zh: 撤资运动在许多校园里获得了支持。

divi.t: n. 分红（dividend 的口语缩写）

e.en: Shareholders received a generous {divi} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度股东获得了可观的股息分红。

e.en: Let's {divi} up the pizza before the movie starts.
e.zh: 我们在电影开始前把披萨分了吧。

divide.t:
v. 分、划分
n. 分歧、差距

e.en: Let's {divide} the project into smaller tasks.
e.zh: 我们把项目拆分成几个小任务吧。

e.en: A wide cultural {divide} separates the two generations.
e.zh: 两代人之间存在巨大的文化鸿沟。

divided.t:
adj. 分开的、有分歧的
v. 分（过去式）

e.en: The team is {divided} on which framework to use.
e.zh: 团队在使用哪个框架的问题上意见分歧。

e.en: She {divided} the cake equally among the children.
e.zh: 她把蛋糕平均分给了孩子们。

dividend.t:
n. 股息、红利
n. （数）被除数

e.en: The company will pay a quarterly {dividend} of fifty cents.
e.zh: 公司将派发每股五十美分的季度股息。

e.en: Investing time in learning pays a huge {dividend} later.
e.zh: 花时间学习日后会带来丰厚回报。

e.en: A glass {divider} separates the kitchen from the dining area.
e.zh: 一道玻璃隔断把厨房和餐厅分开。

e.en: Use a tab {divider} to organize your binder.
e.zh: 用标签分隔页来整理你的活页夹。

divides.t: v. 分、划分（第三人称单数）

e.en: A long fence {divides} the two properties.
e.zh: 一道长长的栅栏把两处房产隔开。

e.en: This issue deeply {divides} voters across the country.
e.zh: 这个议题让全国选民产生深刻分歧。

dividing.t: v. 划分、分开（现在分词）

e.en: The teacher is {dividing} students into discussion groups.
e.zh: 老师正在把学生分成讨论小组。

e.en: A thin wall is {dividing} the two apartments.
e.zh: 一堵薄墙将两间公寓隔开。

e.en: Ancient priests used bones for {divination} about the future.
e.zh: 古代祭司用骨头来占卜未来。

e.en: Tarot cards are a popular form of {divination} today.
e.zh: 塔罗牌是当今流行的占卜方式之一。

e.en: The shaman performed several {divinations} before the harvest.
e.zh: 萨满在丰收前进行了几次占卜。

e.en: Ancient texts describe {divinations} based on bird flight patterns.
e.zh: 古籍记载了根据鸟飞轨迹进行的占卜。

e.en: The runes have {divinatory} meanings in Norse tradition.
e.zh: 符文在北欧传统中具有占卜意义。

e.en: She studies the {divinatory} practices of ancient civilizations.
e.zh: 她研究古代文明的占卜习俗。

divine.t:
adj. 神的、神圣的
v. 占卜、推测

e.en: The cathedral's architecture inspires a sense of the {divine}.
e.zh: 大教堂的建筑令人感受到神性的庄严。

e.en: This chocolate cake tastes absolutely {divine}.
e.zh: 这块巧克力蛋糕的味道简直绝妙。

e.en: The choir sang {divinely} during the Christmas service.
e.zh: 圣诞礼拜上唱诗班的演唱美妙动人。

e.en: She believes she was {divinely} guided to this career.
e.zh: 她相信自己是受神指引走上这条职业道路的。

e.en: The village {diviner} predicted heavy rain for next week.
e.zh: 村里的占卜师预言下周会有大雨。

e.en: A {diviner} uses a forked stick to find groundwater.
e.zh: 探水者用一根分叉的木棍寻找地下水。

diving.t:
n. 潜水、跳水
v. 潜水（现在分词）

e.en: We went scuba {diving} along the Great Barrier Reef.
e.zh: 我们沿着大堡礁去潜水了。

e.en: Tech stocks are {diving} after disappointing earnings reports.
e.zh: 科技股因财报不佳而暴跌。

e.en: The documentary recorded several deep-sea {divings} off Japan.
e.zh: 纪录片记录了在日本附近的几次深海下潜。

e.en: His morning pool {divings} keep him in great shape.
e.zh: 他早晨的跳水训练让他保持着良好状态。

divining.t: v. 占卜、推测（现在分词）

e.en: He held a {divining} rod, searching for hidden water.
e.zh: 他握着探水棒，寻找隐藏的水源。

e.en: She is skilled at {divining} people's true intentions.
e.zh: 她善于看透人们的真实意图。

divinity.t:
n. 神性、神
n. 神学

e.en: He studied {divinity} at Yale before becoming a pastor.
e.zh: 他在成为牧师前曾在耶鲁学习神学。

e.en: Hindus worship many forms of {divinity} across the country.
e.zh: 印度教徒在全国各地崇拜多种形式的神祇。

e.en: The emperor's {divinization} happened shortly after his death.
e.zh: 皇帝在死后不久便被神化。

e.en: Roman culture practiced the {divinization} of popular rulers.
e.zh: 罗马文化盛行将受爱戴的统治者神化。

e.en: Twelve is {divisible} by both three and four.
e.zh: 十二既能被三整除，也能被四整除。

e.en: The estate is not easily {divisible} among the heirs.
e.zh: 这份遗产难以在继承人之间平分。

division.t:
n. 划分、部门
n. （数）除法

e.en: She works in the marketing {division} of the company.
e.zh: 她在公司的市场部门工作。

e.en: Long {division} can be tricky for fourth graders.
e.zh: 长除法对四年级学生来说有点难。

e.en: She's a {doer}, not just a talker.
e.zh: 她是个实干家,不只是说说而已。

e.en: Startups need {doer} types who ship features fast.
e.zh: 创业公司需要能快速交付的实干派。

does.t: v. do 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {does} yoga every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都会做瑜伽。

e.en: This update {does} fix the login bug.
e.zh: 这次更新确实修复了登录漏洞。

e.en: He wore soft {doeskin} gloves to the winter ceremony.
e.zh: 他戴着柔软的鹿皮手套出席冬季典礼。

e.en: The jacket was lined with genuine {doeskin}.
e.zh: 这件夹克的内衬是真正的鹿皮。

e.en: Gentlemen used to {doff} their hats to greet ladies.
e.zh: 绅士们以前会脱帽向女士致意。

e.en: He'll {doff} his coat as soon as he steps inside.
e.zh: 他一进门就会脱下外套。

dog.t:
n. 狗
v. 尾随；纠缠

e.en: My {dog} barks whenever the doorbell rings.
e.zh: 门铃一响,我的狗就会叫。

e.en: Health issues continued to {dog} him throughout his career.
e.zh: 健康问题在他整个职业生涯中纠缠不休。

e.en: The {dogcatcher} took the stray to the local shelter.
e.zh: 捕狗员把那只流浪狗带去了当地收容所。

e.en: He couldn't get elected as {dogcatcher} in this town.
e.zh: 在这个镇上他连捕狗员都选不上。

doge.t: n. 威尼斯/热那亚共和国总督

e.en: The {doge} ruled Venice for several centuries.
e.zh: 威尼斯总督统治了这座城市数个世纪。

e.en: The {doge} meme features a Shiba Inu with broken English.
e.zh: Doge 表情包是一只配着蹩脚英语的柴犬。

dogfight.t: n. 空中缠斗；激烈争斗

e.en: The pilots engaged in an intense {dogfight} over the Pacific.
e.zh: 飞行员们在太平洋上空展开了激烈的空战。

e.en: The election turned into a bitter {dogfight}.
e.zh: 那场选举演变成了一场激烈的混战。

e.en: {Dogfighting} is illegal in most countries today.
e.zh: 斗狗在如今大多数国家都是非法的。

e.en: Police arrested several men for organizing {dogfighting}.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了几名组织斗狗的男子。

e.en: The fisherman caught a small {dogfish} near the reef.
e.zh: 渔夫在礁石附近抓到了一条小角鲨。

e.en: {Dogfish} are common in the cold Atlantic waters.
e.zh: 角鲨在寒冷的大西洋水域很常见。

dogged.t: adj. 顽强的；坚持不懈的

e.en: Her {dogged} determination finally paid off in court.
e.zh: 她锲而不舍的决心最终在法庭上得到了回报。

e.en: The {dogged} reporter pursued the story for years.
e.zh: 那位坚持不懈的记者追踪这个新闻多年。

doggedly.t: adv. 顽强地；坚持不懈地

e.en: He {doggedly} pursued his goal of becoming a pilot.
e.zh: 他坚持不懈地追求成为飞行员的目标。

e.en: The team {doggedly} debugged the issue all night.
e.zh: 团队整夜锲而不舍地调试这个问题。

e.en: Her {doggedness} impressed even the toughest critics.
e.zh: 她的坚毅连最严苛的评论家都为之折服。

e.en: It took sheer {doggedness} to finish the marathon.
e.zh: 完成马拉松全靠那股顽强劲儿。

e.en: The greeting card was filled with cheesy {doggerel}.
e.zh: 那张贺卡上写满了肉麻的打油诗。

e.en: Critics dismissed his poems as mere {doggerel}.
e.zh: 评论家把他的诗作贬为不入流的打油诗。

e.en: The kids begged for a {doggie} bag at the restaurant.
e.zh: 孩子们在餐厅里嚷着要打包袋。

e.en: What a cute little {doggie} you have!
e.zh: 你这只小狗狗真可爱!

doggo.t:
n. 狗狗（网络俚语）
adv. 藏匿不动

e.en: Look at that fluffy {doggo} chasing its tail!
e.zh: 看那只毛茸茸的小狗在追自己的尾巴!

e.en: My {doggo} loves rolling around in the snow.
e.zh: 我家的小狗超爱在雪地里打滚。

e.en: This {doggone} printer is jammed again!
e.zh: 这台讨厌的打印机又卡纸了!

e.en: It's a {doggone} shame the concert was canceled.
e.zh: 演唱会被取消真是太可惜了。

doggy.t:
n. 小狗
adj. 像狗的

e.en: We dropped our pet off at {doggy} daycare.
e.zh: 我们把宠物送到了狗狗日托所。

e.en: The little {doggy} wagged its tail excitedly.
e.zh: 那只小狗兴奋地摇着尾巴。

e.en: He built a wooden {doghouse} for the family pet.
e.zh: 他为家里的宠物搭了一个木头狗屋。

e.en: After forgetting their anniversary, he was in the {doghouse}.
e.zh: 忘了结婚纪念日后,他被妻子冷落了。

e.en: The fairway has a sharp {dogleg} to the left.
e.zh: 球道向左有一个急转弯。

e.en: The trail makes a {dogleg} around the boulder.
e.zh: 小路绕着大圆石拐了个弯。

doglike.t: adj. 像狗一样的；忠诚的

e.en: He gazed at her with {doglike} devotion.
e.zh: 他用狗一般忠诚的眼神注视着她。

e.en: The fox has a {doglike} appearance from a distance.
e.zh: 狐狸远看长得像狗一样。

e.en: He refused to accept the party's rigid {dogma}.
e.zh: 他拒绝接受党派那僵化的教条。

e.en: Modern science challenges old religious {dogma}.
e.zh: 现代科学挑战着古老的宗教教条。

e.en: She's too {dogmatic} to consider other viewpoints.
e.zh: 她过于教条,听不进其他观点。

e.en: His {dogmatic} approach to teaching frustrated students.
e.zh: 他教条式的教学方法让学生们很沮丧。

e.en: He {dogmatically} insisted his method was the only way.
e.zh: 他武断地坚称自己的方法是唯一可行的。

e.en: She refused to {dogmatically} follow industry trends.
e.zh: 她拒绝盲目地追随行业潮流。

e.en: He studied Christian {dogmatics} at the seminary.
e.zh: 他在神学院学习基督教教义学。

e.en: The professor wrote a textbook on Protestant {dogmatics}.
e.zh: 那位教授写了一本新教教义学的教材。

e.en: Political {dogmatism} prevents real dialogue today.
e.zh: 政治教条主义阻碍着如今真正的对话。

e.en: Her {dogmatism} made collaboration almost impossible.
e.zh: 她的教条主义让合作几乎无法进行。

e.en: He's a {dogmatist} who never questions his beliefs.
e.zh: 他是个教条主义者,从不质疑自己的信念。

e.en: The {dogmatist} dismissed all opposing research.
e.zh: 那个教条主义者驳斥了所有反对的研究。

dogs.t:
n. dog 的复数
v. 尾随

e.en: Two {dogs} were playing fetch in the park.
e.zh: 两只狗在公园里玩接飞盘。

e.en: Bad luck has {dogs} him at every turn.
e.zh: 霉运在每个转折处都纠缠着他。

dogsbody.t: n. 打杂的；做苦差的人

e.en: As an intern, she was treated like the office {dogsbody}.
e.zh: 作为实习生,她被当作办公室的杂务工。

e.en: He was tired of being the team's {dogsbody}.
e.zh: 他厌倦了在团队里当打杂的。

e.en: They crossed the frozen tundra by {dogsled} for three days.
e.zh: 他们乘狗拉雪橇穿越冰冻苔原走了三天。

e.en: The {dogsled} race in Alaska attracts thousands of spectators.
e.zh: 阿拉斯加的狗拉雪橇比赛吸引了成千上万的观众。

e.en: The {dogwood} tree blooms with white flowers every spring.
e.zh: 山茱萸树每年春天都会开出白色的花。

e.en: She planted a {dogwood} near the fence last year.
e.zh: 她去年在篱笆旁种了一棵山茱萸。

doh.t:
n. 哆（音符 do）
int. 啊哦（懊恼声）

e.en: "{Doh}!" he muttered after locking his keys in the car.
e.zh: "哎呀!"他把钥匙锁在车里后嘟囔道。

e.en: She slapped her forehead and said "{doh}" at the silly mistake.
e.zh: 她拍了拍额头,为这个愚蠢的错误说了声"哎呀"。

e.en: Every published paper now includes a {doi} for permanent reference.
e.zh: 现在每篇发表的论文都包含一个DOI作为永久标识。

e.en: You can locate the article quickly using its {doi}.
e.zh: 你可以使用文章的DOI快速找到它。

doing.t:
v. do 的现在分词
n. 所作所为

e.en: What are you {doing} this weekend?
e.zh: 你这周末打算做什么?

e.en: She is {doing} her best to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 她正在尽最大努力按时完成项目。

e.en: The newspaper reports on the {doings} of celebrities every day.
e.zh: 这家报纸每天都报道名人的动态。

e.en: Grandma loves hearing about the {doings} of her grandchildren.
e.zh: 奶奶喜欢听孙子孙女们的近况。

doit.t: n. 旧时小额铜币；少许

e.en: The startup's slogan is simply "{doit}" without overthinking.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的口号就是简单的"做就对了"。

e.en: Stop hesitating and just {doit} already.
e.zh: 别再犹豫了,赶紧去做吧。

e.en: He trains at the karate {dojo} three nights a week.
e.zh: 他每周三晚上在空手道道场训练。

e.en: The coding {dojo} helps developers practice new techniques together.
e.zh: 这个编程道场帮助开发者一起练习新技术。

e.en: The movie sounds incredible in {Dolby} surround.
e.zh: 这部电影在杜比环绕声下听起来效果惊人。

e.en: My new headphones support {Dolby} Atmos for spatial audio.
e.zh: 我的新耳机支持杜比全景声以实现空间音频。

doldrum.t: n. 低迷；消沉（多用复数）

e.en: The summer {doldrum} left the small town feeling abandoned.
e.zh: 夏日的萧条让这座小镇显得无人问津。

e.en: Sales hit a {doldrum} in the middle of February.
e.zh: 销售在二月中旬陷入低迷。

doldrums.t: n. 低迷期；无风带；消沉

e.en: The economy has been stuck in the {doldrums} all year.
e.zh: 经济一整年都陷入低迷。

e.en: A weekend trip helped pull her out of the {doldrums}.
e.zh: 周末出游帮她走出了情绪低谷。

dole.t:
n. 失业救济金
v. 少量发放

e.en: Volunteers {dole} out hot meals to homeless people each evening.
e.zh: 志愿者们每晚向无家可归的人分发热饭菜。

e.en: Many families relied on the {dole} during the recession.
e.zh: 许多家庭在经济衰退期间依靠失业救济金生活。

e.en: The puppy gave her a {doleful} look from the cage.
e.zh: 小狗从笼子里向她投来悲伤的目光。

e.en: He sang a {doleful} ballad about lost love.
e.zh: 他唱了一首关于失去爱情的悲伤民谣。

e.en: She sighed {dolefully} as the train pulled away.
e.zh: 火车驶离时她忧伤地叹了口气。

e.en: The dog whined {dolefully} when his owner left.
e.zh: 主人离开时,狗哀伤地呜咽着。

e.en: She received a porcelain {doll} for her birthday.
e.zh: 她生日时收到了一个瓷娃娃。

e.en: My niece carries her favorite {doll} everywhere she goes.
e.zh: 我侄女走到哪里都带着她最喜欢的洋娃娃。

e.en: This coffee costs only one {dollar} at the corner shop.
e.zh: 街角小店的这杯咖啡只要一美元。

e.en: The {dollar} weakened against the euro last week.
e.zh: 美元上周兑欧元走软。

e.en: The country debated full {dollarization} to fight hyperinflation.
e.zh: 该国为对抗恶性通胀而讨论全面美元化。

e.en: {Dollarization} can stabilize prices but limits monetary policy.
e.zh: 美元化可以稳定物价,但会限制货币政策。

e.en: He saved a few hundred {dollars} for the trip.
e.zh: 他为这次旅行存了几百美元。

e.en: The repair will cost thousands of {dollars}.
e.zh: 这次维修要花费数千美元。

e.en: Her grandfather built a wooden {dollhouse} with tiny furniture.
e.zh: 她爷爷做了一个带迷你家具的木制玩具屋。

e.en: The Victorian {dollhouse} sat in the corner of the playroom.
e.zh: 那座维多利亚风格的玩具屋摆在游戏室的角落里。

e.en: The rescue dog turned out to be surprisingly {docile}.
e.zh: 那只救助来的狗居然出奇地温顺。

e.en: He prefers {docile} horses for beginner riding lessons.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用温顺的马来给新手上骑马课。

e.en: The toddler {docilely} followed her mother through the airport.
e.zh: 那个小女孩乖乖地跟着妈妈穿过机场。

e.en: He nodded {docilely} and signed every page she pushed forward.
e.zh: 他顺从地点头,在她递过来的每一页上都签了字。

e.en: Golden retrievers are loved for their gentle {docility}.
e.zh: 金毛猎犬因温顺听话而深受喜爱。

e.en: Her quiet {docility} hid a surprisingly stubborn streak.
e.zh: 她安静顺从的外表下藏着出人意料的倔强。

dock.t:
n. 码头；船坞
v. 停靠；扣除

e.en: The fishing boats {dock} here every evening at sunset.
e.zh: 渔船每天傍晚日落时分在这里靠岸。

e.en: Drag the icon to the {dock} for quick access.
e.zh: 把图标拖到程序坞里,方便快速打开。

e.en: The cruise ship {docked} in Naples just before noon.
e.zh: 那艘邮轮在中午前抵达那不勒斯靠岸。

e.en: My boss {docked} my pay for arriving late three times.
e.zh: 老板因为我三次迟到扣了我的工资。

docker.t:
n. 码头工人
（技术语境）Docker 容器工具

e.en: We ship the app inside a {Docker} container for consistency.
e.zh: 为了保持一致性,我们用Docker容器来交付这个应用。

e.en: The old {docker} unloaded crates along the Liverpool waterfront.
e.zh: 那位老码头工人在利物浦码头边卸下板条箱。

docket.t: n. 事项清单；案件摘要

e.en: The judge has a busy {docket} of cases this week.
e.zh: 法官这周的案件审理表排得很满。

e.en: Climate policy is high on the committee's {docket} today.
e.zh: 气候政策在委员会今天的议程上排得很靠前。

docking.t:
n. 对接；停泊
v. 靠岸（进行时）

e.en: The spacecraft completed {docking} with the station overnight.
e.zh: 飞船在夜间完成了与空间站的对接。

e.en: The laptop's {docking} station adds extra USB ports easily.
e.zh: 笔记本的扩展坞可以轻松增加USB接口。

e.en: The old {dockland} warehouses are now trendy art studios.
e.zh: 老码头区的仓库如今变成了时尚的艺术工作室。

e.en: Property prices in the {dockland} district keep climbing.
e.zh: 码头区的房价持续上涨。

docklands.t: n. 码头区域；港口地带

e.en: London's {Docklands} transformed from industrial port to financial hub.
e.zh: 伦敦的港区从工业码头变成了金融中心。

e.en: We took the train through the {Docklands} to Greenwich.
e.zh: 我们坐火车穿过码头区前往格林威治。

docks.t:
n. 码头（复数）
v. 停靠（第三人称）

e.en: Ferries leave the {docks} every twenty minutes in summer.
e.zh: 夏天渡轮每二十分钟从码头出发一班。

e.en: Workers loaded coffee crates onto trucks at the {docks}.
e.zh: 工人们在码头把咖啡箱装上卡车。

dockside.t:
n. 码头边
adj. 码头旁的

e.en: We ate fresh oysters at a {dockside} restaurant in Maine.
e.zh: 我们在缅因州一家码头边的餐厅吃了新鲜生蚝。

e.en: Cranes lined the {dockside} ready for the morning shipment.
e.zh: 起重机沿着码头一字排开,等着早上的货物。

e.en: Every {dockworker} on the pier wore a bright safety vest.
e.zh: 码头上每个工人都穿着鲜亮的安全背心。

e.en: The {dockworker} guided the crane operator with hand signals.
e.zh: 那名码头工人用手势指引起重机操作员。

e.en: The naval {dockyard} has built warships for two centuries.
e.zh: 这座海军船坞已经造了两个世纪的军舰。

e.en: Tourists now visit the historic {dockyard} in Portsmouth.
e.zh: 游客现在会参观朴次茅斯的历史船坞。

e.en: Read the API {docs} before integrating the payment service.
e.zh: 接入支付服务前,先看一下API文档。

e.en: We collaborate on Google {Docs} during every design review.
e.zh: 每次设计评审我们都用谷歌文档协作。

doctor.t:
n. 医生；博士
v. 篡改；伪造

e.en: You should see a {doctor} if the cough lasts longer.
e.zh: 如果咳嗽时间再长,你该去看医生了。

e.en: He earned his {doctor} of philosophy in computational biology.
e.zh: 他在计算生物学领域获得了博士学位。

doctoral.t: adj. 博士的；博士学位的

e.en: She defended her {doctoral} thesis on quantum networks last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天答辩了关于量子网络的博士论文。

e.en: The university offers fully funded {doctoral} positions in AI.
e.zh: 这所大学提供全额资助的人工智能博士岗位。

e.en: He earned a {doctorate} in linguistics from Stanford in 2018.
e.zh: 他于2018年在斯坦福获得了语言学博士学位。

e.en: Pursuing a {doctorate} usually takes between four and six years.
e.zh: 读博士通常需要四到六年时间。

doctored.t: v. 被篡改；被伪造（过去式）

e.en: Investigators found that the photo had been digitally {doctored}.
e.zh: 调查人员发现这张照片经过了数字篡改。

e.en: He {doctored} his coffee with two spoons of sugar.
e.zh: 他在咖啡里加了两勺糖调味。

doctoring.t:
v. 篡改；做手脚
n. 行医

e.en: Editors caught him {doctoring} the spreadsheet to hide losses.
e.zh: 编辑发现他在篡改电子表格以掩盖亏损。

e.en: She enjoys {doctoring} simple recipes with fresh herbs.
e.zh: 她喜欢用新鲜香草来改造简单的食谱。

doctors.t:
n. 医生（复数）
v. 篡改（第三人称）

e.en: The {doctors} agreed she needed surgery within the week.
e.zh: 医生们一致认为她需要在一周内手术。

e.en: Many young {doctors} feel burnt out after long night shifts.
e.zh: 许多年轻医生在长时间夜班后感到精疲力尽。

doctrinaire.t:
adj. 教条主义的
n. 教条主义者

e.en: His {doctrinaire} approach left no room for compromise.
e.zh: 他教条式的做法让人毫无妥协余地。

e.en: The party rejected its old {doctrinaire} stance on trade.
e.zh: 该党摒弃了过去在贸易问题上的教条立场。

e.en: The two churches split over a small {doctrinal} difference.
e.zh: 两座教堂因一个小小的教义分歧而分裂。

e.en: {Doctrinal} debates filled the seminary classrooms every afternoon.
e.zh: 每天下午,教义辩论充斥着神学院的课堂。

e.en: The two denominations remain {doctrinally} close despite separate leadership.
e.zh: 这两个教派尽管领导层不同,在教义上仍然相近。

e.en: His sermons were {doctrinally} sound but emotionally flat.
e.zh: 他的布道在教义上无懈可击,但情感上平淡。

e.en: The {doctrine} of free speech is central to democracy.
e.zh: 言论自由的原则是民主的核心。

e.en: Military {doctrine} has shifted toward cyber defense.
e.zh: 军事理论已转向网络防御。

e.en: Religious {doctrines} often vary between denominations.
e.zh: 宗教教义在不同教派之间常有差异。

e.en: The court rejected outdated legal {doctrines}.
e.zh: 法院驳回了过时的法律原则。

e.en: Netflix released a {docudrama} about the Enron scandal.
e.zh: 网飞推出了一部关于安然丑闻的纪实剧。

e.en: The {docudrama} blends real footage with dramatized scenes.
e.zh: 这部纪实剧将真实片段与戏剧化场景结合在一起。

document.t:
n. 文档；文件
v. 记录；证明

e.en: Please sign the {document} before leaving the office.
e.zh: 请在离开办公室前签署这份文件。

e.en: Researchers {document} every step of the experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员记录实验的每一个步骤。

e.en: Nature {documentaries} are popular on streaming platforms.
e.zh: 自然纪录片在流媒体平台上很受欢迎。

e.en: She watches crime {documentaries} every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都看犯罪纪录片。

documentary.t:
n. 纪录片
adj. 纪实的

e.en: The {documentary} explores climate change in the Arctic.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了北极的气候变化。

e.en: He filmed a {documentary} about street musicians in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他拍了一部关于东京街头音乐家的纪录片。

e.en: The API {documentation} is clear and well-organized.
e.zh: 该 API 文档清晰且结构良好。

e.en: You need proper {documentation} to claim the refund.
e.zh: 你需要完整的证明文件才能申请退款。

e.en: Different software {documentations} follow different style guides.
e.zh: 不同软件的文档遵循不同的风格规范。

e.en: The team compared {documentations} from several frameworks.
e.zh: 团队比较了几个框架的文档。

documented.t:
adj. 有文件证明的
v. 记录（过去式）

e.en: She {documented} the entire renovation on her blog.
e.zh: 她在博客上记录了整个装修过程。

e.en: The side effects are well {documented} in medical journals.
e.zh: 这些副作用在医学期刊中已有详尽记载。

documenting.t: v. 记录；用文件证明（进行时）

e.en: He spent years {documenting} life in remote villages.
e.zh: 他花了数年时间记录偏远村庄的生活。

e.en: Engineers are {documenting} the new system's architecture.
e.zh: 工程师们正在记录新系统的架构。

documents.t:
n. 文件（复数）
v. 记录（第三人称）

e.en: Upload your tax {documents} to the secure portal.
e.zh: 请将你的报税文件上传到安全门户。

e.en: The app automatically {documents} your daily activity.
e.zh: 这款应用会自动记录你每天的活动。

dodder.t:
v. 蹒跚；颤巍巍地走
n. 菟丝子

e.en: The old man began to {dodder} as he crossed the street.
e.zh: 那位老人过马路时开始步履蹒跚。

e.en: Don't {dodder} around — we're already late.
e.zh: 别磨蹭了,我们已经迟到了。

doddering.t: adj. 步履蹒跚的；摇摇晃晃的

e.en: A {doddering} grandfather slowly climbed the stairs.
e.zh: 一位步履蹒跚的爷爷慢慢爬上楼梯。

e.en: The film mocked the {doddering} bureaucrats in charge.
e.zh: 这部电影嘲讽了那些颤颤巍巍的官僚。

doddle.t: n. 轻而易举的事（英式口语）

e.en: Setting up the new router was a complete {doddle}.
e.zh: 设置新路由器简直易如反掌。

e.en: The exam was a {doddle} after weeks of practice.
e.zh: 经过几周练习后,考试简单得不得了。

dodge.t:
v. 闪避；躲开
n. 躲闪；花招

e.en: He tried to {dodge} the question about his salary.
e.zh: 他试图回避关于薪水的问题。

e.en: She had to {dodge} a cyclist on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 她不得不在人行道上躲开一个骑车的人。

e.en: The kids screamed with joy on the {dodgem} cars.
e.zh: 孩子们在碰碰车上兴奋地尖叫。

e.en: Every fair has a {dodgem} ride near the entrance.
e.zh: 每个游乐场入口附近都有碰碰车项目。

dodger.t: n. 躲避者；逃避责任的人

e.en: He's a known tax {dodger} with offshore accounts.
e.zh: 他是个有海外账户的逃税者。

e.en: The draft {dodger} fled to Canada in the 1960s.
e.zh: 那名逃避兵役者在1960年代逃到了加拿大。

e.en: The politician kept {dodging} reporters' tough questions.
e.zh: 那位政客一直在回避记者的尖锐问题。

e.en: She was {dodging} puddles on her way to work.
e.zh: 她在上班路上一直在躲避水坑。

dodgy.t: adj. 可疑的；靠不住的；有风险的

e.en: That website looks pretty {dodgy} — don't enter your card.
e.zh: 那个网站看起来很可疑,别输入你的银行卡。

e.en: My knee has been a bit {dodgy} since the marathon.
e.zh: 自从跑了马拉松,我的膝盖一直有点不舒服。

dodo.t: n. 渡渡鸟；过时的人或事物

e.en: The {dodo} went extinct in the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 渡渡鸟在十七世纪灭绝了。

e.en: Fax machines are going the way of the {dodo}.
e.zh: 传真机正在像渡渡鸟一样走向消亡。

e.en: A {doe} and her fawn wandered into the meadow.
e.zh: 一只母鹿和她的小鹿走进了草地。

e.en: The hunter spotted a {doe} drinking from the stream.
e.zh: 猎人看到一只母鹿在溪边饮水。

dollop.t:
n. 一小团（软食物）
v. 舀一团

e.en: Add a {dollop} of sour cream on top of the soup.
e.zh: 在汤上加一勺酸奶油。

e.en: She finished the pancakes with a generous {dollop} of jam.
e.zh: 她在松饼上加了厚厚的一勺果酱。

e.en: Her shelf was lined with vintage {dolls} from the 1950s.
e.zh: 她的架子上摆满了1950年代的复古洋娃娃。

e.en: The girls played with {dolls} all afternoon.
e.zh: 女孩们整个下午都在玩洋娃娃。

dolly.t:
n. 小推车；摄影移动车
n. 小娃娃

e.en: Use a {dolly} to move the heavy refrigerator into the kitchen.
e.zh: 用手推车把这台沉重的冰箱搬进厨房。

e.en: The cameraman pushed the {dolly} smoothly along the track.
e.zh: 摄影师沿着轨道平稳地推动着移动摄影车。

dolmen.t: n. 石桌坟（史前巨石墓）

e.en: The ancient stone {dolmen} stood alone on the hillside.
e.zh: 那座古老的石支石墓孤零零地立在山坡上。

e.en: Tourists photographed the {dolmen} dating back four thousand years.
e.zh: 游客们拍下了这座有四千年历史的支石墓。

e.en: The cliffs are made of pale gray {dolomite}.
e.zh: 这些悬崖是由浅灰色的白云岩构成的。

e.en: Geologists collected {dolomite} samples from the quarry.
e.zh: 地质学家从采石场采集了白云岩样本。

dolomites.t: n. 多洛米蒂山脉；白云石（复数）

e.en: We hiked through the {Dolomites} for a week last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在多洛米蒂山徒步了一周。

e.en: The {Dolomites} are famous for their dramatic limestone peaks.
e.zh: 多洛米蒂山以其壮观的石灰岩山峰而闻名。

dolor.t: n. 悲痛、哀伤（文学用语）

e.en: The poem expresses deep {dolor} over a lost friendship.
e.zh: 这首诗表达了对失去友谊的深切悲痛。

e.en: Her face showed the {dolor} of years of hardship.
e.zh: 她的脸上流露出多年艰辛的悲伤。

e.en: A {dolorous} melody played softly in the background.
e.zh: 一首悲伤的旋律在背景中轻轻响起。

e.en: He told the {dolorous} tale of his exile.
e.zh: 他讲述了自己流亡的悲惨故事。

e.en: A {dolphin} leaped out of the water beside our boat.
e.zh: 一只海豚从我们船边跃出水面。

e.en: The {dolphin} is known for its intelligence and playfulness.
e.zh: 海豚以其聪明和顽皮而闻名。

e.en: A pod of {dolphins} followed the ship for miles.
e.zh: 一群海豚跟着船游了好几英里。

e.en: Children watched the {dolphins} perform tricks at the aquarium.
e.zh: 孩子们在水族馆里观看海豚表演特技。

e.en: Don't be such a {dolt} and read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么笨,先读说明书。

e.en: He felt like a {dolt} after sending the email to everyone.
e.zh: 把邮件发给所有人之后,他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

e.en: His {doltish} grin made everyone burst into laughter.
e.zh: 他那愚蠢的笑容让大家都笑了出来。

e.en: It was a {doltish} mistake that cost the company millions.
e.zh: 这是一个让公司损失数百万的愚蠢错误。

dom.t:
n. 支配方（BDSM 中）
n. 域（domain 缩写）

e.en: JavaScript can manipulate the {DOM} to update web pages dynamically.
e.zh: JavaScript可以操作DOM来动态更新网页。

e.en: React abstracts the {DOM} with a virtual representation for performance.
e.zh: React通过虚拟表示来抽象DOM以提升性能。

e.en: I registered a new {domain} for my personal blog yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天为我的个人博客注册了一个新域名。

e.en: Cybersecurity is outside my professional {domain}.
e.zh: 网络安全超出了我的专业领域。

domaine.t: n. 酒庄（法语，常见于葡萄酒名）

e.en: The wine comes from a famous {domaine} in Burgundy.
e.zh: 这款酒来自勃艮第一个著名的酒庄。

e.en: They visited a small {domaine} producing organic Pinot Noir.
e.zh: 他们参观了一家生产有机黑皮诺的小酒庄。

e.en: She owns several {domains} for her side projects.
e.zh: 她为自己的副业项目拥有好几个域名。

e.en: The research spans multiple academic {domains}.
e.zh: 这项研究横跨多个学术领域。

e.en: Tourists gazed up at the painted {dome} of the cathedral.
e.zh: 游客们仰望大教堂彩绘的圆顶。

e.en: The stadium's retractable {dome} closes during rain.
e.zh: 这座体育场的可伸缩穹顶在下雨时会关闭。

e.en: The {domed} ceiling of the chapel was covered in frescoes.
e.zh: 小教堂的穹形天花板上布满了壁画。

e.en: They serve dessert under a {domed} glass cover.
e.zh: 他们用穹形玻璃罩盖着上甜点。

domesday.t: n. 末日审判书（英国土地调查册）

e.en: The {Domesday} Book recorded English landholdings in 1086.
e.zh: 《末日审判书》记录了1086年英格兰的土地所有情况。

e.en: Historians still consult the {Domesday} survey for medieval data.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍参考末日审判书获取中世纪资料。

domestic.t:
adj. 国内的；家庭的
n. 家佣

e.en: {Domestic} flights are usually cheaper than international ones.
e.zh: 国内航班通常比国际航班便宜。

e.en: He shares the {domestic} chores equally with his partner.
e.zh: 他和伴侣平等地分担家务。

e.en: The film performed better {domestically} than overseas.
e.zh: 这部电影在国内的表现比海外更好。

e.en: The product is manufactured {domestically} to support local jobs.
e.zh: 该产品在国内生产,以支持本地就业。

e.en: Humans began to {domesticate} dogs over fifteen thousand years ago.
e.zh: 人类在一万五千多年前开始驯养狗。

e.en: It's nearly impossible to {domesticate} a fully grown wild fox.
e.zh: 驯化一只成年野狐几乎是不可能的。

domesticated.t: adj. 已驯化的；习惯家居的

e.en: Cats were {domesticated} in ancient Egypt thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 猫在数千年前的古埃及被驯化。

e.en: He's become quite {domesticated} since getting married.
e.zh: 他结婚后变得很顾家了。

domesticates.t: v. 驯化（第三人称单数）

e.en: Wheat is one of the earliest plant {domesticates} in human history.
e.zh: 小麦是人类历史上最早的栽培植物之一。

e.en: The farmer carefully {domesticates} each new breed of goat.
e.zh: 农夫细心驯养每一种新品种的山羊。

e.en: {Domesticating} wild animals takes many generations of selective breeding.
e.zh: 驯化野生动物需要许多代的选择性育种。

e.en: She enjoyed {domesticating} the small farmhouse with cozy decor.
e.zh: 她喜欢用温馨的装饰把小农舍布置得像家一样。

e.en: The {domestication} of horses transformed ancient warfare and travel.
e.zh: 马的驯化改变了古代的战争和旅行方式。

e.en: Researchers study the genetic effects of {domestication} on wolves.
e.zh: 研究人员研究驯化对狼的遗传影响。

e.en: Several independent {domestications} of rice occurred across Asia.
e.zh: 水稻在亚洲各地发生了几次独立的驯化。

e.en: Archaeologists debate the timing of early animal {domestications}.
e.zh: 考古学家对早期动物驯化的时间存有争议。

domesticities.t: n. 家庭生活、家居氛围（复数）

e.en: The novel explores the small {domesticities} of suburban married life.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了郊区已婚生活中琐碎的家庭日常。

e.en: She found comfort in the daily {domesticities} of cooking and cleaning.
e.zh: 她在烹饪和打扫这些日常家务中找到了慰藉。

domesticity.t: n. 家庭生活、居家氛围

e.en: After years of travel, he embraced quiet {domesticity}.
e.zh: 在多年漂泊之后,他开始享受平静的家庭生活。

e.en: The painting captures the warmth of nineteenth-century {domesticity}.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉了十九世纪家庭生活的温馨。

domicile.t:
n. 住所、户籍地
v. 定居

e.en: Please confirm your legal {domicile} on the tax form.
e.zh: 请在税表上确认你的合法居住地。

e.en: He chose to {domicile} his company in Singapore for tax reasons.
e.zh: 出于税务原因,他选择将公司注册在新加坡。

e.en: The elderly woman receives {domiciliary} care twice a week.
e.zh: 这位老太太每周接受两次居家照护。

e.en: {Domiciliary} visits help patients who can't travel to clinics.
e.zh: 上门访视帮助那些无法去诊所的病人。

e.en: The team established clear {dominance} in the first half.
e.zh: 球队在上半场就确立了明显的统治地位。

e.en: Apple's {dominance} in the smartphone market is shrinking.
e.zh: 苹果在智能手机市场的主导地位正在缩小。

dominances.t: n. 支配地位（复数，罕用）

e.en: Researchers compared regional {dominances} across several industries.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了多个行业中各地区的主导地位。

e.en: The book examines cultural {dominances} throughout history.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了历史上各种文化主导现象。

dominant.t: adj. 占主导地位的、主要的

e.en: Google is still the {dominant} search engine worldwide.
e.zh: 谷歌仍是全球占主导地位的搜索引擎。

e.en: Brown eyes are a {dominant} genetic trait in humans.
e.zh: 棕色眼睛是人类的显性遗传特征。

e.en: The painting features {dominantly} red and orange tones.
e.zh: 这幅画以红色和橙色调为主。

e.en: Her voice carried {dominantly} across the crowded room.
e.zh: 她的声音在拥挤的房间里格外突出。

dominate.t: v. 主宰、支配、占据主导

e.en: Tech giants {dominate} the global advertising market.
e.zh: 科技巨头主导着全球广告市场。

e.en: Tall buildings {dominate} the city skyline.
e.zh: 高楼大厦在城市天际线中占据主导地位。

e.en: The discussion was {dominated} by a few loud voices.
e.zh: 讨论被几个大声说话的人主导了。

e.en: Brazil {dominated} the match from start to finish.
e.zh: 巴西队从头到尾主宰了整场比赛。

dominates.t: v. 主宰（第三人称单数）

e.en: Climate change {dominates} headlines this week.
e.zh: 气候变化本周占据各大头条。

e.en: A massive oak tree {dominates} the garden.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的橡树在花园里十分显眼。

dominating.t:
adj. 占主导的
v. 主宰（现在分词）

e.en: She gave a {dominating} performance in the final.
e.zh: 她在决赛中表现非常强势。

e.en: The smell of garlic was {dominating} the kitchen.
e.zh: 大蒜的味道在厨房里弥漫得最浓。

e.en: The empire sought world {domination} through trade.
e.zh: 该帝国试图通过贸易实现世界霸权。

e.en: Netflix's {domination} of streaming faces new challengers.
e.zh: 网飞在流媒体领域的霸主地位正面临新挑战。

e.en: History records many short-lived {dominations} by warlords.
e.zh: 历史上记载了许多军阀短暂的统治时期。

e.en: Colonial {dominations} reshaped much of the world.
e.zh: 殖民统治重塑了世界的大部分地区。

e.en: He became the clear {dominator} of the chess tournament.
e.zh: 他成了那场国际象棋锦标赛的绝对霸主。

e.en: That player is the league's reigning {dominator}.
e.zh: 那名球员是联赛中当之无愧的统治者。

e.en: The film features a mysterious {dominatrix} character.
e.zh: 这部电影中有一个神秘的女王角色。

e.en: She played a {dominatrix} in the controversial play.
e.zh: 她在那部争议性话剧中饰演女王角色。

e.en: The old {domine} delivered a thoughtful Sunday sermon.
e.zh: 那位老牧师做了一场深思的周日讲道。

e.en: Villagers respected the {domine} for his wisdom.
e.zh: 村民们因他的智慧而尊敬这位牧师。

e.en: Good managers lead, they don't {domineer} over staff.
e.zh: 好的管理者懂得领导,而不是对下属颐指气使。

e.en: He tried to {domineer} every conversation at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时他总想主宰每一场对话。

e.en: Her {domineering} boss made the office tense.
e.zh: 她那位专横的老板让办公室气氛紧张。

e.en: He grew up with a {domineering} father.
e.zh: 他在一个专横的父亲身边长大。

domingo.t: n. 多明戈（西语男性名/姓）

e.en: Plácido {Domingo} is one of opera's greatest tenors.
e.zh: 普拉西多·多明戈是歌剧界最伟大的男高音之一。

e.en: The festival on {Domingo} drew thousands of locals.
e.zh: 多明戈的节日吸引了成千上万的当地人。

dominica.t: n. 多米尼克（加勒比岛国）

e.en: {Dominica} is known for its lush rainforests and waterfalls.
e.zh: 多米尼克以茂密的雨林和瀑布闻名。

e.en: They booked a diving trip to {Dominica} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们订了去多米尼克的潜水之旅。

dominican.t:
adj. 多米尼加的
n. 多米尼加人；多明我会修士

e.en: She is a proud {Dominican} living in New York.
e.zh: 她是一位生活在纽约的多米尼加人,深感自豪。

e.en: We loved the food during our {Dominican} vacation.
e.zh: 我们在多米尼加度假期间非常喜欢那里的食物。

e.en: The kingdom held {dominion} over vast lands.
e.zh: 那个王国统治着广袤的土地。

e.en: Canada was once a British {dominion}.
e.zh: 加拿大曾经是英国的自治领。

e.en: One bank failure triggered a {domino} effect across markets.
e.zh: 一家银行倒闭引发了市场上的多米诺效应。

e.en: My grandfather taught me how to play {domino}.
e.zh: 我祖父教我玩多米诺骨牌。

e.en: The Latin word {dominus} means lord or master.
e.zh: 拉丁语 dominus 意为主人或老爷。

e.en: Slaves addressed their owner as {dominus} in Rome.
e.zh: 在罗马,奴隶称他们的主人为 dominus。

don.t:
v. 穿上（衣物）
n. 先生；大学教师

e.en: I always {don} a jacket before heading out.
e.zh: 出门前我总会披上一件外套。

e.en: The mafia {don} controlled the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 那位黑手党头目控制着整个街区。

dona.t: n. 夫人（西班牙语尊称）

e.en: Everyone in the village called her {Dona} Maria.
e.zh: 村里人都叫她玛丽亚太太。

e.en: {Dona} Clara hosted the dinner party last night.
e.zh: 克拉拉夫人昨晚举办了那场晚宴。

e.en: Many readers {donate} to Wikipedia each year.
e.zh: 每年都有许多读者向维基百科捐款。

e.en: You can {donate} blood at the local clinic.
e.zh: 你可以在当地诊所献血。

donated.t: v. 捐赠（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {donated} her old laptop to the school.
e.zh: 她把旧笔记本电脑捐给了学校。

e.en: Fans {donated} over a million dollars to the charity.
e.zh: 粉丝们向这家慈善机构捐赠了一百多万美元。

donates.t: v. 捐赠（第三人称单数）

e.en: The company {donates} a portion of every sale to charity.
e.zh: 该公司将每笔销售的一部分捐给慈善机构。

e.en: He {donates} his time to tutor underprivileged kids.
e.zh: 他抽出时间辅导贫困儿童。

e.en: Thanks for {donating} to our crowdfunding campaign!
e.zh: 感谢您向我们的众筹活动捐款!

e.en: She's {donating} clothes to the shelter this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末她要向收容所捐衣服。

e.en: A small monthly {donation} can make a big difference.
e.zh: 每月一笔小额捐款也能带来很大改变。

e.en: The museum survives largely on private {donation}.
e.zh: 该博物馆主要依靠私人捐赠维持运营。

e.en: The nonprofit relies on {donations} from supporters.
e.zh: 这家非营利组织依靠支持者的捐款。

e.en: Online {donations} have surged after the disaster.
e.zh: 灾难发生后,线上捐款激增。

doncaster.t: n. 唐卡斯特（英国城市）

e.en: {Doncaster} is famous for its historic horse racing.
e.zh: 唐卡斯特以其历史悠久的赛马而闻名。

e.en: The train from London to {Doncaster} takes ninety minutes.
e.zh: 从伦敦到唐卡斯特的火车需要九十分钟。

done.t:
adj. 完成的；做好的
v. do 的过去分词

e.en: I'm finally {done} with my homework for tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的作业我终于做完了。

e.en: How would you like your steak {done}?
e.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟?

donegal.t: n. 多尼戈尔（爱尔兰郡）

e.en: {Donegal} has some of Ireland's most stunning coastlines.
e.zh: 多尼戈尔拥有爱尔兰最壮丽的海岸线之一。

e.en: We bought a wool sweater on our trip to {Donegal}.
e.zh: 我们在多尼戈尔旅行时买了一件羊毛衫。

doneness.t: n. 熟度（肉、菜的烹熟程度）

e.en: Check the {doneness} of the cake with a toothpick.
e.zh: 用牙签检查蛋糕是否烤熟。

e.en: He prefers his steak at medium {doneness}.
e.zh: 他喜欢牛排五分熟的程度。

e.en: Vietnamese currency is the {dong}, not the yuan.
e.zh: 越南的货币是越南盾,不是人民币。

e.en: The bell gave a deep {dong} at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分,钟发出低沉的当当声。

e.en: {Donington} Park hosts major motorsport events each year.
e.zh: 唐宁顿公园每年都会举办重要的赛车赛事。

e.en: Fans flocked to the rock festival at {Donington}.
e.zh: 粉丝们涌向唐宁顿的摇滚音乐节。

e.en: A stubborn {donkey} refused to cross the bridge.
e.zh: 一头倔驴怎么也不肯过桥。

e.en: The {donkey} carried supplies up the mountain trail.
e.zh: 那头驴沿着山路驮着物资上山。

e.en: Local farmers still use {donkeys} to haul firewood.
e.zh: 当地农民仍然用驴来驮木柴。

e.en: We saw wild {donkeys} grazing in the desert.
e.zh: 我们看到野驴在沙漠里吃草。

e.en: {Donna} just got promoted to senior engineer.
e.zh: 唐娜刚刚被提升为高级工程师。

e.en: My friend {Donna} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我朋友唐娜在市中心经营一家小面包店。

donnish.t: adj. 学究气的；书呆子气的

e.en: He has a {donnish} habit of correcting everyone's grammar.
e.zh: 他有种学究气,总爱纠正别人的语法。

e.en: The professor's {donnish} manner amused his students.
e.zh: 那位教授一本正经的学究做派让学生们觉得有趣。

e.en: The town hall meeting turned into a complete {donnybrook}.
e.zh: 那场市政厅会议变成了一场彻底的混战。

e.en: Their family dinner ended in a noisy {donnybrook}.
e.zh: 他们的家庭晚餐以一场吵闹的争执收场。

donor.t: n. 捐赠者；献血/器官者

e.en: The hospital is searching for a kidney {donor}.
e.zh: 医院正在寻找肾脏捐献者。

e.en: A generous {donor} funded the new library wing.
e.zh: 一位慷慨的捐赠者资助了新图书馆侧翼。

e.en: The charity thanked its {donors} at the annual gala.
e.zh: 该慈善机构在年度晚会上感谢了捐赠者。

e.en: Blood {donors} are urgently needed this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天急需献血者。

donut.t: n. 甜甜圈（doughnut 的变体）

e.en: I grabbed a coffee and a glazed {donut} for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐买了一杯咖啡和一个糖霜甜甜圈。

e.en: The shop sells the best chocolate {donut} in town.
e.zh: 这家店卖着全城最好吃的巧克力甜甜圈。

e.en: He hummed a cheerful {doo}-wop tune in the shower.
e.zh: 他在淋浴时哼着一首欢快的嘟喔普调子。

e.en: The singers added a soft {doo} behind the chorus.
e.zh: 歌手们在副歌背后加入了轻柔的嘟声。

doodad.t: n. 小玩意儿；不知名小零件

e.en: My drawer is full of random {doodad} from old gadgets.
e.zh: 我抽屉里塞满了旧设备上各种零碎小玩意儿。

e.en: What's that little {doodad} on top of your monitor?
e.zh: 你显示器上面那个小玩意儿是什么?

doodle.t:
v. 随手涂鸦
n. 涂鸦图

e.en: I always {doodle} in my notebook during boring meetings.
e.zh: 开无聊会议时,我总在本子上随手涂鸦。

e.en: She drew a quick {doodle} of her cat on the napkin.
e.zh: 她在餐巾纸上随手画了一幅自家猫的涂鸦。

e.en: Don't be such a {doofus} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么笨啦——先看看说明书。

e.en: He played a lovable {doofus} in the sitcom.
e.zh: 他在情景喜剧里扮演了一个可爱的傻瓜。

doohickey.t: n. 小玩意儿；叫不出名的东西

e.en: Hand me that {doohickey} next to the screwdriver.
e.zh: 把螺丝刀旁边那个小玩意儿递给我。

e.en: This {doohickey} keeps the cables from tangling.
e.zh: 这个小玩意儿能让线缆不打结。

doolally.t: adj. 疯疯癫癫的（英式俚语）

e.en: I'll go {doolally} if this printer jams again.
e.zh: 如果打印机再卡纸,我就要疯掉了。

e.en: The kids drove their babysitter completely {doolally}.
e.zh: 那些孩子把保姆折腾得彻底崩溃。

e.en: Doctor {Doolittle} is famous for talking to animals.
e.zh: 杜立德医生以会和动物对话而闻名。

e.en: My niece adores the Doctor {Doolittle} books.
e.zh: 我侄女非常喜欢《杜立德医生》系列丛书。

doom.t:
n. 厄运；毁灭
v. 注定

e.en: Critics predicted {doom} for the startup after its first product flopped.
e.zh: 首款产品失败后，评论人士预言这家初创公司将走向毁灭。

e.en: The dark clouds gave the valley a sense of {doom}.
e.zh: 乌云让整个山谷弥漫着一种不祥的气息。

doomed.t: adj. 注定失败的；在劫难逃的

e.en: The mission was {doomed} from the start due to bad weather.
e.zh: 由于天气恶劣，这次任务从一开始就注定失败。

e.en: Without funding, the project seemed {doomed} to fail.
e.zh: 没有资金，这个项目似乎注定要失败。

e.en: His reckless spending {dooms} the family business to bankruptcy.
e.zh: 他挥霍无度让家族企业注定走向破产。

e.en: Ignoring climate science {dooms} future generations to harder lives.
e.zh: 忽视气候科学让后代注定要过更艰难的生活。

dormant.t: adj. 休眠的；暂停活动的

e.en: The volcano has been {dormant} for over three hundred years.
e.zh: 这座火山已经休眠了三百多年。

e.en: My old startup idea sat {dormant} until I had funding.
e.zh: 我那个旧的创业点子一直搁置着，直到拿到资金。

dormer.t: n. 屋顶老虎窗（凸出的窗）

e.en: Sunlight streamed through the small {dormer} window upstairs.
e.zh: 阳光从楼上小小的老虎窗洒了进来。

e.en: The cottage had two {dormer} windows poking out of the roof.
e.zh: 那座小屋的屋顶上突出着两扇老虎窗。

e.en: Tiny {dormice} curl up to sleep through the cold winter.
e.zh: 小小的睡鼠会蜷起身子睡过整个寒冬。

e.en: Conservationists released {dormice} back into the woodland.
e.zh: 保育人员把睡鼠放归林地。

e.en: The university built three new {dormitories} for incoming students.
e.zh: 这所大学为新生新建了三栋宿舍楼。

e.en: Most {dormitories} on campus include free Wi-Fi and laundry.
e.zh: 校园里大多数宿舍都提供免费 Wi-Fi 和洗衣服务。

dormitory.t: n. 集体宿舍；学生宿舍

e.en: She shares a {dormitory} room with three other students.
e.zh: 她和另外三个学生合住一间宿舍。

e.en: The campus {dormitory} has a curfew at midnight.
e.zh: 学校宿舍午夜实行宵禁。

dormouse.t: n. 睡鼠（小型啮齿动物）

e.en: A tiny {dormouse} curled up inside the hollow log.
e.zh: 一只小睡鼠蜷缩在空心木头里。

e.en: The {dormouse} hibernates through the cold winter months.
e.zh: 睡鼠在寒冷的冬季会冬眠。

dorms.t: n. 宿舍（dorm 的复数，口语）

e.en: Freshmen usually live in the {dorms} on campus.
e.zh: 大一新生通常住在校内宿舍。

e.en: The {dorms} were noisy the night before finals.
e.zh: 期末考试前一晚,宿舍里特别吵闹。

dornier.t: n. 道尼尔（德国飞机制造商）

e.en: The museum displays a restored {dornier} flying boat.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一架修复过的多尼尔飞艇。

e.en: Engineers studied the original {dornier} aircraft designs from Germany.
e.zh: 工程师研究了来自德国的多尼尔飞机原始设计。

dorrit.t: n. 朵丽（狄更斯小说人物名）

e.en: Dickens wrote Little {Dorrit} as a critique of debt prisons.
e.zh: 狄更斯写《小杜丽》批判了债务监狱。

e.en: The professor assigned {Dorrit} for next week's class.
e.zh: 教授布置下周课上讨论《小杜丽》。

e.en: The shark's {dorsal} fin sliced through the water.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍划破了水面。

e.en: Doctors examined the {dorsal} surface of her foot.
e.zh: 医生检查了她脚的背面。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking along the {Dorset} coast.
e.zh: 我们整个周末在多塞特海岸徒步旅行。

e.en: {Dorset} is famous for its dramatic Jurassic cliffs.
e.zh: 多塞特郡以其壮观的侏罗纪悬崖闻名。

dorsiflexion.t: n. 背屈（关节向背侧弯曲）

e.en: The therapist measured ankle {dorsiflexion} after the injury.
e.zh: 理疗师在受伤后测量了踝关节的背屈角度。

e.en: Limited {dorsiflexion} can affect your walking gait.
e.zh: 背屈受限会影响你的走路姿势。

e.en: A small mole appeared on the {dorsum} of his hand.
e.zh: 他手背上长出了一颗小痣。

e.en: The vet examined the {dorsum} of the cat carefully.
e.zh: 兽医仔细检查了那只猫的背部。

dortmund.t: n. 多特蒙德（德国城市）

e.en: {Dortmund} is known for its passionate football fans.
e.zh: 多特蒙德以其狂热的足球迷而闻名。

e.en: She moved to {Dortmund} for an engineering job.
e.zh: 她为了一份工程师工作搬到了多特蒙德。

dory.t:
n. 平底小渔船
n. 海鲂（鱼）

e.en: The fisherman rowed his small {dory} out at dawn.
e.zh: 渔夫黎明时分划着他的小渔船出海。

e.en: A wooden {dory} was tied to the dock.
e.zh: 一艘木制小渔船被系在码头上。

dos.t:
n. 应做之事（常与 don'ts 对举）
n. DOS 操作系统

e.en: Read the {dos} and don'ts before starting the project.
e.zh: 开始项目前请阅读注意事项和禁忌。

e.en: My grandfather still remembers using {DOS} on his computer.
e.zh: 我爷爷还记得在电脑上使用 DOS 系统。

e.en: We ordered a crispy {dosa} with coconut chutney.
e.zh: 我们点了一份配椰子酸辣酱的脆薄饼。

e.en: The South Indian restaurant serves the best {dosa} in town.
e.zh: 那家南印度餐厅做的薄饼是城里最好吃的。

e.en: Always follow the recommended {dosage} on the label.
e.zh: 请始终遵循标签上推荐的剂量。

e.en: The doctor adjusted her {dosage} after the blood test.
e.zh: 血液检查后医生调整了她的用药剂量。

dose.t:
n. 一剂；一次的量
v. 给…服药

e.en: Take one {dose} of the medicine every six hours.
e.zh: 每六小时服用一剂这种药。

e.en: He needs a healthy {dose} of skepticism online.
e.zh: 他在网上需要保持适度的怀疑态度。

dosed.t: v. 服用（dose 的过去式）

e.en: The nurse {dosed} the patient with painkillers.
e.zh: 护士给病人服用了止痛药。

e.en: She {dosed} her coffee with extra sugar this morning.
e.zh: 今早她在咖啡里加了不少糖。

e.en: Two {doses} of the vaccine are needed for full protection.
e.zh: 需要接种两剂疫苗才能获得完全保护。

e.en: He gets daily {doses} of news from his phone.
e.zh: 他每天通过手机获取大量新闻信息。

e.en: I've got no {dosh} left until payday.
e.zh: 发工资前我已经没钱了。

e.en: He made some quick {dosh} selling old games.
e.zh: 他卖旧游戏赚了点快钱。

e.en: Workers wear a {dosimeter} to measure radiation exposure.
e.zh: 工人们佩戴剂量计以测量辐射暴露量。

e.en: Her {dosimeter} showed unusually high readings that week.
e.zh: 那周她的辐射剂量计显示读数异常偏高。

e.en: Proper {dosing} is critical for children's medication.
e.zh: 儿童用药的正确剂量至关重要。

e.en: The app reminds patients of their {dosing} schedule.
e.zh: 该应用会提醒病人按时服药。

doss.t: v. 随便凑合过夜（英式俚语）

e.en: He had to {doss} on his friend's couch for weeks.
e.zh: 他不得不在朋友的沙发上凑合睡了好几周。

e.en: Some students just {doss} around all summer.
e.zh: 有些学生整个夏天就是无所事事地混日子。

dosser.t: n. 露宿者；流浪汉（英俚）

e.en: The old {dosser} slept under the bridge each night.
e.zh: 那个老流浪汉每晚都睡在桥下。

e.en: Don't be such a {dosser} — help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别这么懒散,过来帮忙洗碗。

e.en: The detective compiled a thick {dossier} on the suspect.
e.zh: 侦探整理了一份关于嫌疑人的厚厚档案。

e.en: Reporters obtained a leaked {dossier} from the company.
e.zh: 记者从那家公司获得了一份泄露的档案。

e.en: He found a {dossy} job that pays surprisingly well.
e.zh: 他找到了一份轻松又出乎意料地高薪的工作。

e.en: That class is totally {dossy} — barely any homework.
e.zh: 那门课特别水,几乎没什么作业。

dost.t: v. do 的古英语第二人称形式

e.en: The old hymn asks, "Why {dost} thou weep?"
e.zh: 那首古老的赞美诗问道:“你为何哭泣?”

e.en: Shakespeare often wrote lines like "{dost} thou love me?"
e.zh: 莎士比亚常写出“你可爱我?”这样的句子。

dostoevsky.t: n. 陀思妥耶夫斯基（俄国作家）

e.en: She read every novel by {Dostoevsky} during college.
e.zh: 大学期间她读完了陀思妥耶夫斯基的每一本小说。

e.en: {Dostoevsky} explored guilt and redemption in his fiction.
e.zh: 陀思妥耶夫斯基在小说中探讨了罪恶与救赎。

dot.t:
n. 点；圆点
v. 加点于；星罗棋布

e.en: There's a small red {dot} on the map.
e.zh: 地图上有一个小小的红点。

e.en: Please {dot} every i in the document.
e.zh: 请把文件里每个 i 上面的点都加上。

e.en: Even in his {dotage}, he kept writing letters daily.
e.zh: 即便到了高龄,他每天仍坚持写信。

e.en: She visited her grandfather often in his {dotage}.
e.zh: 她在祖父年迈昏聩时常去探望他。

dote.t: v. 溺爱；过分宠爱（常接 on）

e.en: Grandparents tend to {dote} on their first grandchild.
e.zh: 祖父母往往特别溺爱第一个孙辈。

e.en: He continues to {dote} on his rescue dog.
e.zh: 他对那只救助来的狗依然宠爱有加。

e.en: Her {doting} parents bought her another new phone.
e.zh: 她那对溺爱孩子的父母又给她买了部新手机。

e.en: The {doting} owner posts daily photos of her cat.
e.zh: 那位宠猫如命的主人每天都发她猫的照片。

e.en: The screen showed three pulsing {dots} loading the message.
e.zh: 屏幕上三个跳动的圆点显示消息正在加载。

e.en: Her dress had tiny white {dots} on a blue background.
e.zh: 她的裙子是蓝底白色小圆点图案。

e.en: Please sign on the {dotted} line at the bottom.
e.zh: 请在最下方的虚线上签名。

e.en: Wildflowers {dotted} the meadow last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天,野花点缀着整片草地。

dotty.t: adj. 疯疯癫癫的；着迷的

e.en: My aunt is going a bit {dotty} in her old age.
e.zh: 我姑妈年纪大了,有点糊涂了。

e.en: He's absolutely {dotty} about classic motorcycles.
e.zh: 他对老式摩托车简直痴迷得不行。

double.t:
adj. 双倍的；双人的
v. 加倍；翻倍

e.en: I'd like a {double} espresso, please.
e.zh: 我要一杯双份浓缩咖啡,谢谢。

e.en: Sales {double} every December during the holiday rush.
e.zh: 销售额在每年十二月节日期间翻倍。

e.en: He would never {double-cross} his closest friends.
e.zh: 他绝不会出卖自己最亲密的朋友。

e.en: The spy planned a clever {double-cross} of his handlers.
e.zh: 那名间谍精心策划了一场对上线的背叛。

doubled.t: v. 加倍了（double 的过去式）

e.en: House prices have {doubled} in the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里房价翻了一番。

e.en: She {doubled} over laughing at his joke.
e.zh: 她被他的笑话逗得弯下腰大笑。

doubleheader.t: n. 一日连赛两场的比赛

e.en: The team played a {doubleheader} against their biggest rivals.
e.zh: 球队和头号对手打了一场连场双赛。

e.en: Sunday's {doubleheader} drew a record crowd to the stadium.
e.zh: 周日的双连赛吸引了创纪录的观众涌入体育场。

e.en: There's a strange {doubleness} in his public statements.
e.zh: 他的公开声明中透着一种奇怪的两面性。

e.en: The novel explores the {doubleness} of human nature.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了人性的双重性。

e.en: They won the mixed {doubles} final last weekend.
e.zh: 他们上周末赢得了混合双打决赛。

e.en: The bar {doubles} as a coffee shop in the morning.
e.zh: 那家酒吧早上还兼作咖啡馆。

doublespeak.t: n. 含糊其辞的话；双关官腔

e.en: Politicians often hide bad news behind clever {doublespeak}.
e.zh: 政客们常用巧妙的模糊语言掩盖坏消息。

e.en: Corporate {doublespeak} makes layoffs sound like opportunities.
e.zh: 企业的双关辞令把裁员说得像机遇一样。

doublet.t:
n. 紧身短上衣
n. 一对；双峰

e.en: The actor wore a velvet {doublet} for the play.
e.zh: 演员穿着一件天鹅绒紧身上衣表演这出戏。

e.en: In English, "frail" and "fragile" form a {doublet}.
e.zh: 在英语中,frail 和 fragile 构成一对同源词。

e.en: The company is {doubling} its workforce next year.
e.zh: 该公司明年将把员工数量增加一倍。

e.en: Rents are {doubling} faster than wages can keep up.
e.zh: 房租翻倍的速度比工资上涨快得多。

doomsayer.t: n. 末日预言者；悲观论者

e.en: Every office has a {doomsayer} who predicts layoffs each quarter.
e.zh: 每个办公室都有一个每季度都预言裁员的悲观论者。

e.en: The economist was dismissed as a {doomsayer} until the crash hit.
e.zh: 那位经济学家曾被当作悲观预言家，直到崩盘真的发生。

e.en: The cult prepared bunkers for an imaginary {doomsday} event.
e.zh: 那个邪教为想象中的世界末日准备了地堡。

e.en: Tech bloggers love writing {doomsday} headlines about AI.
e.zh: 科技博主特别喜欢写关于人工智能的末日式标题。

e.en: The market {doomster} keeps warning about an imminent crash.
e.zh: 那位市场唱衰者不断警告即将到来的崩盘。

e.en: Don't be such a {doomster} — the launch went fine.
e.zh: 别那么悲观，发布会进行得挺顺利的。
