e.en: We hiked along the banks of the River {Doon} in Scotland.
e.zh: 我们沿着苏格兰的杜恩河岸徒步旅行。

e.en: The poet Burns wrote lovingly about the bonnie banks of {Doon}.
e.zh: 诗人彭斯深情地写过杜恩河美丽的河岸。

e.en: Please close the {door} quietly when you leave.
e.zh: 离开时请轻轻关上门。

e.en: This internship opens the {door} to many career options.
e.zh: 这次实习为很多职业选择打开了大门。

e.en: The {doorbell} rang just as dinner was being served.
e.zh: 门铃响起时，晚饭刚刚端上桌。

e.en: Smart {doorbell} cameras let you see visitors from your phone.
e.zh: 智能门铃摄像头让你能用手机看到访客。

e.en: He's so tall he has to duck under every {doorframe}.
e.zh: 他个子太高，每个门框都得低头钻过去。

e.en: The kids' heights were marked in pencil on the {doorframe}.
e.zh: 门框上用铅笔标记着孩子们的身高。

e.en: She leaned against the {doorjamb} watching the rain.
e.zh: 她靠在门框上，看着外面的雨。

e.en: The cat scratched the wooden {doorjamb} every morning.
e.zh: 那只猫每天早上都在木门框上磨爪子。

e.en: The {doorkeeper} checked our invitations before letting us in.
e.zh: 门卫核对了我们的邀请函才放行。

e.en: An elderly {doorkeeper} greeted every guest by name.
e.zh: 一位年长的看门人用名字向每位客人问好。

e.en: Editors act as {doorkeepers} deciding which stories get published.
e.zh: 编辑充当看门人，决定哪些报道得以发表。

e.en: The museum's {doorkeepers} politely turned away latecomers.
e.zh: 博物馆的门卫礼貌地把迟到者请了回去。

e.en: The brass {doorknob} felt cold under her hand.
e.zh: 那个黄铜门把手在她手下冰凉冰凉的。

e.en: He polished the {doorknob} until it shone like gold.
e.zh: 他把门把手擦得像金子一样发亮。

e.en: The hostel had {doorless} showers, which felt awkward at first.
e.zh: 那家青旅的淋浴间没有门，一开始让人挺不自在。

e.en: Open offices and {doorless} meeting rooms hurt deep focus.
e.zh: 开放式办公区和无门会议室会影响深度专注。

e.en: The hotel {doorman} hailed a taxi for us in seconds.
e.zh: 酒店门童几秒钟就帮我们叫到了出租车。

e.en: A friendly {doorman} greets every resident by name.
e.zh: 一位友善的门卫用名字向每位住户打招呼。

e.en: Wipe your shoes on the {doormat} before coming inside.
e.zh: 进屋前请在门垫上擦擦鞋。

e.en: Stop being a {doormat} and stand up for yourself at work.
e.zh: 别再当老好人了，在工作中要为自己说话。

doornail.t: n. 门钉（常用于 dead as a doornail）

e.en: After three days in the heat, the battery was dead as a {doornail}.
e.zh: 在高温下放了三天，电池彻底报废了。

e.en: My old laptop is dead as a {doornail} after the spill.
e.zh: 洒了水之后，我的旧笔记本彻底坏掉了。

e.en: Jewish families often attach a mezuzah to the {doorpost}.
e.zh: 犹太家庭常常在门柱上钉一个经文盒。

e.en: He carved his initials into the wooden {doorpost} as a child.
e.zh: 他小时候在木门柱上刻下了自己的名字缩写。

e.en: All the {doors} in the office lock automatically at night.
e.zh: 办公室的所有门到晚上都会自动上锁。

e.en: Learning English opens many {doors} in international careers.
e.zh: 学好英语会为国际职业发展打开许多扇门。

e.en: Don't trip over the {doorsill} on your way out.
e.zh: 出门时小心别被门槛绊倒。

e.en: Rainwater seeped under the worn wooden {doorsill}.
e.zh: 雨水从磨损的木门槛下渗了进来。

e.en: A package was waiting on the {doorstep} when I got home.
e.zh: 我到家时门口台阶上放着一个包裹。

e.en: The new café opened right on our {doorstep}.
e.zh: 新开的咖啡馆就开在我们家门口。

e.en: She used a heavy book as a {doorstop} during the move.
e.zh: 搬家时她用一本厚书当门挡。

e.en: That novel is so thick it could double as a {doorstop}.
e.zh: 那本小说厚得简直可以当门挡用。

e.en: He paused in the {doorway} before stepping inside.
e.zh: 他在门口停了一下才走进去。

e.en: This scholarship is a {doorway} to studying abroad.
e.zh: 这份奖学金是通往海外留学的大门。

e.en: The old house had narrow {doorways} and low ceilings.
e.zh: 那栋老房子门洞狭窄，天花板也很低。

e.en: Internships often serve as {doorways} into competitive industries.
e.zh: 实习常常是进入竞争激烈行业的大门。

e.en: Lilacs bloomed every spring in the {dooryard}.
e.zh: 每年春天，门前的小院里丁香花都会盛开。

e.en: Chickens wandered freely around the farmhouse {dooryard}.
e.zh: 鸡群在农舍门前的院子里自由地走来走去。

doozy.t: n. 非同寻常之物；超棒/超糟的东西

e.en: That last math problem was a real {doozy}.
e.zh: 最后那道数学题真是个大难题。

e.en: The storm last night was a {doozy} — trees down everywhere.
e.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨真够厉害的，到处都是倒下的树。

e.en: Social media apps are designed to trigger {dopamine} hits.
e.zh: 社交媒体应用就是为了不断刺激多巴胺分泌而设计的。

e.en: Exercise releases {dopamine} and improves your mood.
e.zh: 运动会释放多巴胺，让心情变好。

e.en: Parkinson's disease damages {dopaminergic} neurons in the brain.
e.zh: 帕金森病会损伤大脑中的多巴胺能神经元。

e.en: The drug targets {dopaminergic} pathways to treat depression.
e.zh: 该药物通过作用于多巴胺能通路来治疗抑郁症。

e.en: Boron is a common {dopant} used in silicon semiconductors.
e.zh: 硼是硅半导体中常用的掺杂剂。

e.en: Adding a {dopant} changes the electrical properties of the crystal.
e.zh: 加入掺杂剂可以改变晶体的电学性质。

dope.t:
n. 毒品；情报
adj. 酷的（俚语）

e.en: That new skateboard trick is seriously {dope}.
e.zh: 那个新滑板动作真的酷毙了。

e.en: The athlete was banned for using {dope} before the race.
e.zh: 那位运动员因比赛前使用兴奋剂被禁赛。

dopey.t: adj. 昏昏沉沉的；迟钝的

e.en: The cold medicine made me feel {dopey} all afternoon.
e.zh: 感冒药让我整个下午都昏昏沉沉的。

e.en: He gave a {dopey} grin when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时，他露出傻乎乎的笑容。

doping.t: n. 使用兴奋剂；（半导体）掺杂

e.en: The cyclist tested positive for {doping} and lost his title.
e.zh: 那位自行车手药检呈阳性，被剥夺了冠军头衔。

e.en: Silicon {doping} controls how chips conduct electricity.
e.zh: 硅的掺杂决定了芯片如何导电。

doppelganger.t: n. 二重身；长相极像的人

e.en: I met my {doppelganger} at the conference last week.
e.zh: 上周开会时我遇到了一个长得跟我一模一样的人。

e.en: The actor's stunt double looks like his exact {doppelganger}.
e.zh: 那位演员的特技替身长得简直就是他的翻版。

e.en: Weather forecasters use {Doppler} radar to track storms.
e.zh: 气象预报员使用多普勒雷达追踪风暴。

e.en: The {Doppler} effect explains why a siren's pitch changes.
e.zh: 多普勒效应解释了为什么警笛的音调会变化。

e.en: My niece watches {Dora} the Explorer every morning.
e.zh: 我侄女每天早上都看《爱探险的朵拉》。

e.en: They named their puppy {Dora} after the cartoon character.
e.zh: 他们给小狗取名朵拉，灵感来自那个动画角色。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {dorado} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤制了新鲜的鲯鳅鱼。

e.en: Spanish explorers searched endlessly for the lost city of El {Dorado}.
e.zh: 西班牙探险家们苦苦寻找传说中的黄金之城。

dorchester.t: n. 多切斯特（英国地名）

e.en: We stayed at The {Dorchester} during our London trip.
e.zh: 伦敦之旅期间我们住在多切斯特酒店。

e.en: {Dorchester} is a historic market town in southern England.
e.zh: 多切斯特是英格兰南部一座历史悠久的集镇。

dordogne.t: n. 多尔多涅（法国省/河）

e.en: We rented a stone cottage in the {Dordogne} for the summer.
e.zh: 我们在多尔多涅租了一栋石头小屋度过夏天。

e.en: The {Dordogne} region is famous for prehistoric cave paintings.
e.zh: 多尔多涅地区以史前洞穴壁画而闻名。

dorian.t:
n. 多利安（人名）
adj. 多利亚的

e.en: Wilde's novel about {Dorian} Gray remains a classic.
e.zh: 王尔德关于道林·格雷的小说至今仍是经典。

e.en: The jazz solo was played in {Dorian} mode.
e.zh: 那段爵士独奏是用多利亚调式演奏的。

doric.t: adj. 多立克式的（建筑柱式）

e.en: The temple's {Doric} columns stood for over two thousand years.
e.zh: 那座神庙的多立克柱式屹立了两千多年。

e.en: Architects chose a simple {Doric} style for the courthouse.
e.zh: 建筑师为那座法院选择了简约的多立克风格。

e.en: I felt like a total {dork} wearing socks with sandals.
e.zh: 穿凉鞋配袜子让我觉得自己像个十足的呆瓜。

e.en: He's a lovable {dork} who quotes Star Wars constantly.
e.zh: 他是个可爱的书呆子，整天引用《星球大战》的台词。

dorking.t: n. 多尔金（英国地名/鸡种）

e.en: The town of {Dorking} sits in the Surrey hills.
e.zh: 多金镇坐落在萨里郡的丘陵地带。

e.en: We drove through {Dorking} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边的路上经过了多金镇。

dorky.t: adj. 呆里呆气的；土气的

e.en: My dad still wears those {dorky} cargo shorts on weekends.
e.zh: 我爸周末还在穿那些土里土气的工装短裤。

e.en: The {dorky} mascot somehow became the brand's biggest hit.
e.zh: 那个呆萌的吉祥物意外成了品牌最受欢迎的形象。

e.en: My freshman {dorm} room was barely big enough for a bed.
e.zh: 我大一的宿舍小得几乎只放得下一张床。

e.en: Most students decorate their {dorm} with posters and lights.
e.zh: 大多数学生会用海报和灯串装饰宿舍。

e.en: Tulip bulbs need a period of cold {dormancy} to bloom.
e.zh: 郁金香球茎需要经历一段低温休眠期才能开花。

e.en: The volcano emerged from {dormancy} after centuries of silence.
e.zh: 那座火山在沉寂数百年后结束了休眠期。

e.en: The diver found a gold {doubloon} in the wreck.
e.zh: 潜水员在沉船中发现了一枚金币。

e.en: Pirates traditionally counted their treasure in {doubloon} coins.
e.zh: 海盗们历来用西班牙古金币来清点宝藏。

e.en: After the warning, she became {doubly} cautious online.
e.zh: 经过那次警告后,她在网上加倍谨慎。

e.en: Winning the award made him {doubly} grateful for his team.
e.zh: 获奖让他对团队加倍感激。

doubt.t:
v. 怀疑
n. 疑虑

e.en: I {doubt} the package will arrive before Friday.
e.zh: 我怀疑包裹周五前到不了。

e.en: There's no {doubt} that exercise improves mental health.
e.zh: 毫无疑问,运动有助于改善心理健康。

doubted.t: v. doubt 的过去式，怀疑

e.en: Many people {doubted} the startup would survive its first year.
e.zh: 很多人怀疑这家初创公司挺不过第一年。

e.en: She never {doubted} her decision to move abroad.
e.zh: 她从未怀疑过自己出国的决定。

e.en: Even the biggest {doubter} was impressed by the demo.
e.zh: 就连最怀疑的人也被这次演示打动了。

e.en: He silenced every {doubter} with his Olympic performance.
e.zh: 他用奥运赛场的表现让所有怀疑者哑口无言。

e.en: It's {doubtful} whether the meeting will happen tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天能否开会还很难说。

e.en: She gave him a {doubtful} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去怀疑的目光。

e.en: He shook his head {doubtfully} at the proposal.
e.zh: 他对这个提议半信半疑地摇了摇头。

e.en: "Are you sure?" she asked {doubtfully}.
e.zh: “你确定吗?”她半信半疑地问道。

doubting.t:
v. 怀疑（doubt 的现在分词）
adj. 多疑的

e.en: Stop {doubting} yourself and submit the application.
e.zh: 别再怀疑自己了,把申请递交上去吧。

e.en: He kept {doubting} the accuracy of the news report.
e.zh: 他一直怀疑那则新闻报道的准确性。

e.en: She will {doubtless} arrive late as usual.
e.zh: 她肯定又会像往常一样迟到。

e.en: The new policy {doubtless} has flaws worth discussing.
e.zh: 这项新政策无疑存在值得讨论的缺陷。

e.en: He {doubtlessly} knew the answer before anyone else.
e.zh: 他无疑比任何人都更早知道答案。

e.en: The team will {doubtlessly} win the championship this year.
e.zh: 这支队伍今年肯定会赢得冠军。

doubts.t: n./v. doubt 的复数/单三形式

e.en: She has serious {doubts} about the new manager's plan.
e.zh: 她对新经理的计划有严重怀疑。

e.en: He never {doubts} his ability to finish on time.
e.zh: 他从不怀疑自己能按时完成。

douce.t: adj. 温和的；稳重的（苏格兰用法）

e.en: The old shopkeeper had a {douce} and gentle manner.
e.zh: 那位老店主举止温和文雅。

e.en: She gave a {douce} smile to the visiting child.
e.zh: 她对来访的孩子露出温柔的微笑。

douche.t:
n. 灌洗器
v. 冲洗（身体部位）

e.en: Doctors warn that frequent {douche} use can cause infections.
e.zh: 医生警告频繁冲洗可能引发感染。

e.en: He acted like a total {douche} at the party.
e.zh: 他在派对上表现得像个十足的混蛋。

dough.t:
n. 面团
n. 钱（俚语）

e.en: Knead the {dough} for ten minutes before baking.
e.zh: 烘焙前把面团揉十分钟。

e.en: He's making serious {dough} from his streaming channel.
e.zh: 他靠直播频道赚了不少钱。

doughboy.t: n. 美国步兵（尤指一战）

e.en: My grandfather served as a {doughboy} in World War One.
e.zh: 我祖父在一战时是名美国步兵。

e.en: The museum displayed letters written by a young {doughboy}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一位年轻美军士兵写的信件。

e.en: I grabbed a glazed {doughnut} on my way to work.
e.zh: 我上班路上买了个糖霜甜甜圈。

e.en: The car spun a perfect {doughnut} in the empty lot.
e.zh: 那辆车在空地上漂亮地甩了个圈。

e.en: The {doughty} firefighter rescued three people from the blaze.
e.zh: 那位英勇的消防员从火场救出了三人。

e.en: She remains a {doughty} defender of press freedom.
e.zh: 她仍是新闻自由的勇敢捍卫者。

e.en: The bread came out pale and {doughy} in the middle.
e.zh: 面包出炉时中间苍白发黏。

e.en: His {doughy} face turned red after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑后他那张松软的脸涨得通红。

e.en: We hired a {doula} to support us during labor.
e.zh: 我们请了一位陪产师在分娩时陪伴我们。

e.en: The {doula} guided her through breathing exercises calmly.
e.zh: 陪产师平静地引导她做呼吸练习。

e.en: Grandma kept her {doulton} figurines locked in the cabinet.
e.zh: 奶奶把她的道尔顿瓷偶锁在柜子里。

e.en: The antique shop sold a rare {doulton} vase yesterday.
e.zh: 古董店昨天卖出了一只稀有的道尔顿花瓶。

e.en: The {dour} expression on his face worried everyone.
e.zh: 他脸上阴沉的表情让所有人担心。

e.en: She gave a {dour} response to the cheerful greeting.
e.zh: 面对热情的问候,她给了个冷冰冰的回应。

e.en: The coach {dourly} announced that practice would continue all weekend.
e.zh: 教练板着脸宣布整个周末都要继续训练。

e.en: He stared {dourly} at the rejection letter on his desk.
e.zh: 他阴沉地盯着桌上那封拒信。

douse.t: v. 浇水熄灭；把…浸入水中

e.en: Firefighters worked quickly to {douse} the kitchen flames.
e.zh: 消防员迅速行动扑灭厨房的火焰。

e.en: Don't {douse} your salad in dressing before tasting it.
e.zh: 别没尝过就把沙拉浇满酱汁。

dousing.t: v. douse 的现在分词，浇灭

e.en: A sudden rain shower was {dousing} the picnic guests.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的阵雨浇透了野餐的客人们。

e.en: He's {dousing} the campfire before heading to bed.
e.zh: 他在睡觉前把营火浇熄。

e.en: A white {dove} landed gracefully on the church roof.
e.zh: 一只白鸽优雅地停在教堂屋顶上。

e.en: She {dove} into the pool without hesitation.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳入泳池。

e.en: An old wooden {dovecot} stood at the edge of the garden.
e.zh: 花园边上立着一座古老的木鸽舍。

e.en: The farmer cleaned the {dovecot} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 农夫每周日早上都会清扫鸽舍。

e.en: Pigeons fluttered in and out of the stone {dovecote}.
e.zh: 鸽子在石砌鸽舍里飞进飞出。

e.en: The estate's {dovecote} dates back to the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 庄园里的鸽舍可追溯到十七世纪。

dover.t: n. 多佛（英国港口城市）

e.en: The ferry to {Dover} takes about ninety minutes from Calais.
e.zh: 从加莱到多佛的渡轮约需九十分钟。

e.en: We saw the white cliffs of {Dover} from the deck.
e.zh: 我们从甲板上看到了多佛的白色悬崖。

e.en: The bride released two white {doves} after the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式结束后新娘放飞了两只白鸽。

e.en: Political {doves} prefer diplomacy over military intervention.
e.zh: 政治鸽派更倾向外交手段而非军事干预。

dovetail.t:
v. 吻合；紧密结合
n. 燕尾榫

e.en: Our schedules {dovetail} perfectly for the joint project.
e.zh: 我们的日程对联合项目衔接得天衣无缝。

e.en: The carpenter cut a precise {dovetail} joint by hand.
e.zh: 木匠手工切出了一个精准的燕尾榫。

dovetailing.t: v. 紧密吻合（dovetail 的现在分词）

e.en: Her research is {dovetailing} nicely with the team's goals.
e.zh: 她的研究和团队目标契合得很好。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {dovetailing} drawer corners in the workshop.
e.zh: 他下午在工坊里做抽屉角的燕尾接合。

e.en: The senator took a {dovish} stance on military spending.
e.zh: 那位参议员在军费问题上立场温和。

e.en: Markets rallied after the central bank's {dovish} comments.
e.zh: 央行发表鸽派言论后市场出现反弹。

dow.t: n. 道琼斯指数（Dow Jones 简称）

e.en: The {Dow} closed up two hundred points on Friday.
e.zh: 道琼斯指数周五收盘上涨两百点。

e.en: Investors watched the {Dow} nervously throughout the trading day.
e.zh: 投资者整个交易日都紧张地盯着道指。

e.en: The {dowager} duchess hosted tea every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 那位太后公爵夫人每周日下午都会举办茶会。

e.en: She carried herself with the dignity of a {dowager}.
e.zh: 她举止间透着遗孀贵妇般的端庄。

dowdy.t: adj. 穿着土气的；过时的

e.en: She refused to wear the {dowdy} sweater her aunt sent.
e.zh: 她不肯穿姨妈寄来的那件土气毛衣。

e.en: The old hotel looked {dowdy} compared to its glossy neighbors.
e.zh: 那家老酒店与光鲜的邻居相比显得寒酸过时。

e.en: Insert a wooden {dowel} to hold the two pieces together.
e.zh: 插入一根木销钉把两块板固定在一起。

e.en: The instructions say to glue each {dowel} before assembly.
e.zh: 说明书要求在组装前给每根榫钉涂胶。

e.en: Her late husband left her a generous {dower} of land.
e.zh: 她已故的丈夫给她留下了一大片寡妇产业的土地。

e.en: The novel describes a widow fighting for her {dower} rights.
e.zh: 小说描写了一位寡妇为她的亡夫遗产权而抗争。

down.t:
adv./prep. 向下
adj. 情绪低落的

e.en: The server has been {down} since early this morning.
e.zh: 服务器从今天清晨起就一直瘫痪。

e.en: She walked {down} the stairs carrying a heavy box.
e.zh: 她抱着一个沉重的箱子走下楼梯。

down-to-earth.t: adj. 务实的；脚踏实地的

e.en: Despite his fame, he remains a {down-to-earth} guy.
e.zh: 尽管成名,他依然是个脚踏实地的人。

e.en: I appreciate her {down-to-earth} approach to parenting advice.
e.zh: 我很欣赏她在育儿建议上务实的态度。

downbeat.t:
adj. 悲观的；低调的
n. 强拍

e.en: The CEO struck a {downbeat} tone about next year's outlook.
e.zh: 首席执行官对明年的前景给出了悲观的论调。

e.en: Drummers count the {downbeat} to keep the band together.
e.zh: 鼓手数着重拍来让乐队保持同步。

downcast.t: adj. 垂头丧气的；向下看的

e.en: He looked {downcast} after hearing the rejection news.
e.zh: 听到被拒的消息后他显得很沮丧。

e.en: She kept her eyes {downcast} during the awkward conversation.
e.zh: 在尴尬的对话中她一直低垂着眼。

downdraft.t: n. 下沉气流；下行通风

e.en: A sudden {downdraft} shook the small plane violently.
e.zh: 一股突如其来的下沉气流剧烈地摇晃着小飞机。

e.en: The chimney needs cleaning to prevent dangerous {downdraft} problems.
e.zh: 烟囱需要清理以防出现危险的倒灌问题。

e.en: Earnings forecasts have been revised {downwardly} again this month.
e.zh: 本月盈利预测再次被下调。

e.en: The arrow on the chart pointed {downwardly} all year.
e.zh: 图表上的箭头全年都向下指。

e.en: Slowly tilt the camera {downwards} to capture the floor.
e.zh: 把相机慢慢向下倾斜,拍到地面。

e.en: Temperatures are heading {downwards} as winter approaches.
e.zh: 随着冬天临近,气温正在不断下降。

e.en: Try not to stand {downwind} of the campfire smoke.
e.zh: 尽量别站在营火烟雾的下风处。

e.en: The deer caught our scent because we were {downwind}.
e.zh: 因为我们在下风处,鹿闻到了我们的气味。

downwinder.t: n. 核试验下风区居民

e.en: Every {downwinder} living near the test site faced higher cancer risks.
e.zh: 住在试验场下风向的居民都面临更高的癌症风险。

e.en: The documentary follows one {downwinder} fighting for compensation.
e.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了一位下风受害者争取赔偿的过程。

downy.t: adj. 绒毛般的；毛茸茸的

e.en: The chick was covered in soft, {downy} yellow feathers.
e.zh: 这只小鸡身上覆盖着柔软的黄色绒毛。

e.en: She wrapped the baby in a {downy} blanket for the night.
e.zh: 她用一条松软的毯子把宝宝裹起来过夜。

e.en: In some cultures, families still negotiate large {dowries} before weddings.
e.zh: 在某些文化中,家庭至今仍会在婚前商议丰厚的嫁妆。

e.en: The novel describes how {dowries} shaped daughters' futures.
e.zh: 小说描写了嫁妆如何决定女儿们的命运。

e.en: Her family offered a generous {dowry} when she married.
e.zh: 她出嫁时,家里给了一笔丰厚的嫁妆。

e.en: Demanding a {dowry} is illegal in many countries today.
e.zh: 如今在很多国家,索要嫁妆是违法的。

dowse.t: v. 用探杖寻找水源或矿脉

e.en: Old farmers used a forked stick to {dowse} for water.
e.zh: 老农民用一根分叉的树枝来探测地下水。

e.en: He claims he can {dowse} for hidden pipes in the yard.
e.zh: 他声称自己能在院子里探测到隐藏的水管。

dowser.t: n. 用探杖寻水/矿的人

e.en: The village hired a {dowser} to find a new well.
e.zh: 村里请了一位探水人来寻找新水井的位置。

e.en: Skeptics doubt that any {dowser} can truly locate underground water.
e.zh: 怀疑论者认为没有哪位探水师真能找到地下水。

e.en: The plane uses {Dowty} propellers known for their reliability.
e.zh: 这架飞机使用以可靠性著称的Dowty螺旋桨。

e.en: Engineers at {Dowty} designed landing gear for many airliners.
e.zh: Dowty公司的工程师为许多客机设计过起落架。

e.en: The congregation rose to sing the {doxology} after the sermon.
e.zh: 布道之后,会众起立颂唱赞美诗。

e.en: Many Sunday services end with a traditional {doxology}.
e.zh: 许多周日礼拜会以一首传统的赞美颂结束。

e.en: The patient began chemotherapy with {doxorubicin} last week.
e.zh: 这位病人上周开始接受多柔比星化疗。

e.en: {Doxorubicin} is widely used to treat several types of cancer.
e.zh: 多柔比星被广泛用于治疗多种癌症。

doxycycline.t: n. 强力霉素；多西环素

e.en: The doctor prescribed {doxycycline} for her tick bite.
e.zh: 医生给她开了多西环素治疗蜱虫叮咬。

e.en: Travelers often take {doxycycline} to prevent malaria.
e.zh: 旅行者常服用多西环素来预防疟疾。

e.en: He's considered the {doyen} of modern food critics.
e.zh: 他被视为现代美食评论界的元老。

e.en: The {doyen} of the orchestra gave a moving farewell speech.
e.zh: 乐团的元老级人物发表了动人的告别演说。

doyenne.t: n. 资深女性；女界前辈

e.en: She is the undisputed {doyenne} of British fashion journalism.
e.zh: 她是英国时尚新闻界公认的女掌门人。

e.en: The {doyenne} of the dance world finally announced her retirement.
e.zh: 舞蹈界的女前辈终于宣布退休。

e.en: Grandpa likes to {doze} in his armchair after lunch.
e.zh: 爷爷喜欢午饭后在扶手椅上打个盹。

e.en: I always {doze} off during long meetings on Friday afternoons.
e.zh: 我每次周五下午开长会都会打瞌睡。

e.en: Please pick up a {dozen} eggs on your way home.
e.zh: 回家路上请买一打鸡蛋。

e.en: There were a {dozen} people waiting outside the store.
e.zh: 店外有十几个人在等着。

e.en: {Dozens} of fans gathered outside the singer's hotel.
e.zh: 数十名粉丝聚集在那位歌手的酒店外。

e.en: She has read {dozens} of books on Chinese history.
e.zh: 她读过几十本关于中国历史的书。

dozer.t: n. 推土机（bulldozer 的简称）

e.en: A huge {dozer} was clearing the construction site at dawn.
e.zh: 天刚亮,一台巨大的推土机就在清理施工场地。

e.en: The {dozer} pushed mounds of dirt to the edge of the field.
e.zh: 推土机把一堆堆泥土推到田地的边缘。

dozes.t: v. doze 的第三人称单数；打瞌睡

e.en: The cat usually {dozes} on the windowsill all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只猫通常整个下午都在窗台上打盹。

e.en: He often {dozes} off whenever a documentary comes on.
e.zh: 每次播纪录片他都会打瞌睡。

e.en: The cat is {dozing} on the warm windowsill.
e.zh: 猫咪正在温暖的窗台上打盹。

e.en: I caught him {dozing} during the afternoon meeting.
e.zh: 我发现他在下午的会议上打瞌睡。

e.en: I feel {dozy} after that big lunch.
e.zh: 吃完那顿丰盛的午餐后我有点犯困。

e.en: Don't be so {dozy} — pay attention!
e.zh: 别这么迷迷糊糊的——专心点!

dphil.t: n. 哲学博士学位（Doctor of Philosophy）

e.en: She earned a {DPhil} in physics from Oxford.
e.zh: 她在牛津取得了物理学博士学位。

e.en: He's currently working on his {DPhil} thesis.
e.zh: 他目前正在撰写博士论文。

dpi.t: n. 每英寸点数（分辨率单位）

e.en: Print the poster at 300 {dpi} for clarity.
e.zh: 以 300 dpi 打印海报以保证清晰度。

e.en: Gaming mice often support adjustable {dpi} settings.
e.zh: 游戏鼠标通常支持可调节的 dpi 设置。

dpp.t: n. 缩写；常指检察总长或数据保护政策

e.en: The {DPP} decided not to prosecute the case.
e.zh: 检察长决定不对该案提起诉讼。

e.en: Lightroom and {DPP} are popular RAW photo editors.
e.zh: Lightroom 和 DPP 都是流行的 RAW 照片编辑器。

dpr.t: n. 缩写；常指数据保护条例

e.en: The team uses {DPR} for high-end game graphics.
e.zh: 该团队使用 DPR 来制作高端游戏画面。

e.en: Adjust the {DPR} for sharper rendering on retina screens.
e.zh: 调整 DPR 以在视网膜屏上获得更清晰的渲染。

dps.t: n. 每秒伤害（damage per second）

e.en: Our raid needs another high-{DPS} player tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚的副本还需要一个高输出玩家。

e.en: The mage build maximizes {DPS} against single targets.
e.zh: 这套法师配装能最大化对单体目标的输出。

e.en: The {DRA} oversees disaster response in the region.
e.zh: DRA 负责监督该地区的灾害应对工作。

e.en: She filed her report with the {DRA} office.
e.zh: 她向 DRA 办公室提交了报告。

e.en: The office walls were a {drab} shade of gray.
e.zh: 办公室的墙壁是一种单调的灰色。

e.en: Her life felt {drab} until she moved abroad.
e.zh: 在出国之前,她觉得生活枯燥乏味。

drabble.t:
n. 百词微型小说
v. 弄湿弄脏

e.en: He posted a hundred-word {drabble} on his blog.
e.zh: 他在博客上发了一篇百字微小说。

e.en: Writing a {drabble} forces you to be concise.
e.zh: 写百字微小说会迫使你言简意赅。

e.en: The {drabness} of the suburb depressed her.
e.zh: 郊区的单调乏味让她感到压抑。

e.en: Bright cushions broke up the {drabness} of the room.
e.zh: 鲜艳的靠垫打破了房间的沉闷。

drabnesses.t: n. drabness 的复数；单调乏味

e.en: The poet contrasted urban {drabnesses} with rural color.
e.zh: 诗人将城市的种种单调与乡村的色彩相对照。

e.en: He catalogued the {drabnesses} of postwar architecture.
e.zh: 他记录下战后建筑的种种乏味之处。

e.en: Greece used the {drachma} before adopting the euro.
e.zh: 希腊在采用欧元之前使用德拉克马。

e.en: He found an old {drachma} coin in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里发现了一枚旧德拉克马硬币。

e.en: The new privacy law has {draconian} penalties.
e.zh: 新的隐私法规定了严苛的处罚。

e.en: Critics called the curfew rules {draconian}.
e.zh: 批评者称宵禁规定过于严厉。

e.en: Bram Stoker's {Dracula} remains a classic horror novel.
e.zh: 布拉姆·斯托克的《德古拉》仍是经典恐怖小说。

e.en: The kid dressed up as {Dracula} for Halloween.
e.zh: 那孩子万圣节扮成了德古拉伯爵。

draft.t:
n. 草稿；草案
v. 起草；征召

e.en: I'll send you the first {draft} by Friday.
e.zh: 我会在周五前把初稿发给你。

e.en: There's a cold {draft} coming from the window.
e.zh: 有一股冷风从窗户吹进来。

e.en: She {drafted} the email but hasn't sent it yet.
e.zh: 她起草了邮件,但还没有发送。

e.en: He was {drafted} into the army at eighteen.
e.zh: 他十八岁时被征召入伍。

e.en: Each {draftee} reported to the training camp on Monday.
e.zh: 每位应征入伍者周一到训练营报到。

e.en: The {draftee} was nervous about leaving home.
e.zh: 这名新兵对离家感到紧张。

e.en: The {drafter} of the bill explained its main goals.
e.zh: 该法案的起草人解释了其主要目标。

e.en: She's the lead {drafter} on the policy team.
e.zh: 她是政策团队的首席起草人。

e.en: He's {drafting} a proposal for the new client.
e.zh: 他正在为新客户起草一份提案。

e.en: The architect spent hours {drafting} the floor plan.
e.zh: 建筑师花了几个小时绘制平面图。

e.en: As a {draftnik}, he refused to serve in the war.
e.zh: 作为一名拒服兵役者,他拒绝参战。

e.en: The {draftnik} fled across the border to avoid service.
e.zh: 那名逃兵役者越境以躲避服役。

e.en: I keep all my email {drafts} in one folder.
e.zh: 我把所有邮件草稿都放在一个文件夹里。

e.en: Close the door — the {drafts} are freezing.
e.zh: 把门关上——这穿堂风冷死了。

e.en: The {draftsman} prepared detailed blueprints for the bridge.
e.zh: 制图员为这座桥准备了详细的蓝图。

e.en: He worked as a {draftsman} before becoming an architect.
e.zh: 在成为建筑师之前,他做过制图员。

draftsmanship.t: n. 制图技巧；起草能力

e.en: Her {draftsmanship} is evident in every clean line.
e.zh: 她的制图功底体现在每一条干净的线条上。

e.en: The exhibit celebrates the {draftsmanship} of Renaissance masters.
e.zh: 展览展示了文艺复兴时期大师们的绘图技艺。

e.en: The old farmhouse is cold and {drafty} in winter.
e.zh: 那座老农舍在冬天又冷又透风。

e.en: Close that window — it's getting {drafty}.
e.zh: 把窗户关上——开始漏风了。

drag.t:
v. 拖；拽
n. 阻力；累赘

e.en: You can {drag} the file into the folder.
e.zh: 你可以把文件拖进文件夹。

e.en: Long meetings really {drag} on Friday afternoons.
e.zh: 周五下午的长会真是拖沓难熬。

downed.t: v. 击落；喝下（down 的过去式）

e.en: He {downed} his coffee and rushed out the door.
e.zh: 他一口喝完咖啡就冲出了门。

e.en: Crews removed several {downed} trees after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后工人们清走了几棵倒下的大树。

downer.t: n. 令人沮丧的事；镇静剂

e.en: Rain on our wedding day was a real {downer}.
e.zh: 婚礼当天下雨真是让人扫兴。

e.en: Don't be such a {downer} at every team meeting.
e.zh: 别每次团队开会都这么扫兴。

e.en: His arrogance ultimately led to his political {downfall}.
e.zh: 他的傲慢最终导致了他在政治上的垮台。

e.en: Sugary drinks have been the {downfall} of my diet.
e.zh: 含糖饮料一直是我节食失败的元凶。

e.en: History books are full of dramatic political {downfalls}.
e.zh: 历史书中充满了戏剧性的政治垮台。

e.en: The article lists common {downfalls} of small startup founders.
e.zh: 这篇文章列举了小型创业者常见的失败原因。

downgrade.t:
v. 降级；贬低
n. 降级

e.en: Analysts plan to {downgrade} the stock after weak earnings.
e.zh: 在财报疲软后,分析师计划下调该股评级。

e.en: I had to {downgrade} my phone plan to save money.
e.zh: 为了省钱我不得不把手机套餐降级。

e.en: The hurricane was {downgraded} to a tropical storm overnight.
e.zh: 那场飓风一夜之间被降级为热带风暴。

e.en: Moody's {downgraded} the country's credit rating last week.
e.zh: 穆迪上周下调了该国的信用评级。

e.en: Several airlines are {downgrading} service on shorter regional flights.
e.zh: 多家航空公司正在下调短途支线航班的服务标准。

e.en: He's {downgrading} from a luxury sedan to a compact car.
e.zh: 他正把豪华轿车换成更小的紧凑型车。

e.en: Don't be {downhearted}—you'll do better on the next test.
e.zh: 别灰心,下次考试你会考得更好。

e.en: She felt {downhearted} after losing the chess tournament finals.
e.zh: 输掉象棋锦标赛决赛后她感到很沮丧。

downhill.t:
adv. 下坡地
adj. 下坡的；每况愈下的

e.en: My health has gone {downhill} since the surgery last year.
e.zh: 自从去年手术后我的健康每况愈下。

e.en: The kids raced their bikes {downhill} after school.
e.zh: 放学后孩子们骑车一路冲下山坡。

downhiller.t: n. 高山速降滑雪运动员

e.en: The Austrian {downhiller} set a new track record yesterday.
e.zh: 那位奥地利速降滑雪选手昨天创下新的赛道纪录。

e.en: Every serious {downhiller} trains intensely for the Olympic season.
e.zh: 每位认真的速降滑雪手都为奥运赛季刻苦训练。

e.en: Sheep grazed peacefully across the rolling {downland}.
e.zh: 绵羊在起伏的丘陵草地上安静地吃草。

e.en: We hiked through the southern {downland} all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在南部的丘陵草地上徒步。

downlink.t: n. 下行链路（卫星到地面）

e.en: The satellite {downlink} failed during the live broadcast.
e.zh: 卫星下行链路在直播过程中中断。

e.en: Engineers established a stable {downlink} with the orbiting probe.
e.zh: 工程师与在轨探测器建立了稳定的下行链路。

download.t:
v. 下载
n. 下载的文件

e.en: The {download} should finish in about two minutes.
e.zh: 下载大约还有两分钟就完成。

e.en: You can {download} the app from the official website.
e.zh: 你可以从官网下载这个应用。

e.en: The course includes {downloadable} worksheets for every lesson.
e.zh: 这门课程为每节课配有可下载的练习题。

e.en: All purchased songs are {downloadable} for offline listening.
e.zh: 所有购买的歌曲都可以下载到离线收听。

e.en: I {downloaded} three new podcasts before the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行前我下载了三个新播客。

e.en: She accidentally {downloaded} malware from a sketchy website.
e.zh: 她不小心从一个可疑网站下载了恶意软件。

e.en: My laptop is slow because it's {downloading} a huge update.
e.zh: 我的笔记本很慢,因为正在下载一个巨大的更新。

e.en: She spent the evening {downloading} photos from her old camera.
e.zh: 她花了一个晚上从旧相机里下载照片。

downloads.t:
n. 下载（复数）
v. 下载（第三人称）

e.en: The app already has over a million {downloads} on the store.
e.zh: 这款应用在商店里的下载量已经超过一百万。

e.en: She {downloads} podcasts every morning before her commute.
e.zh: 她每天早上通勤前都会下载播客。

e.en: The brand went {downmarket} to attract budget shoppers.
e.zh: 该品牌走低端路线以吸引预算有限的消费者。

e.en: This neighborhood feels a bit {downmarket} compared to downtown.
e.zh: 这个街区跟市中心比显得有些档次偏低。

downpatrick.t: n. 唐郡（北爱尔兰地名）

e.en: My grandmother grew up in {Downpatrick}, Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 我奶奶在北爱尔兰的唐帕特里克长大。

e.en: The cathedral in {Downpatrick} is said to hold Saint Patrick's grave.
e.zh: 据说唐帕特里克的大教堂里安葬着圣帕特里克。

e.en: They saved for years to afford the {downpayment} on a house.
e.zh: 他们攒了好多年才付得起买房的首付。

e.en: A larger {downpayment} usually means a smaller monthly mortgage.
e.zh: 首付付得越多,每月按揭通常就越少。

e.en: Leaves had clogged the {downpipe} during the autumn storms.
e.zh: 秋天的暴风雨把落水管堵满了树叶。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the rusted {downpipe} on my old car.
e.zh: 修车师傅把我旧车上锈蚀的下排气管换掉了。

e.en: Officials tried to {downplay} the seriousness of the data breach.
e.zh: 官员们试图淡化此次数据泄露的严重性。

e.en: Don't {downplay} your achievements during a job interview.
e.zh: 面试时不要刻意贬低自己的成就。

e.en: We got soaked walking home in the sudden {downpour}.
e.zh: 我们走回家的路上突遇暴雨,被淋成了落汤鸡。

e.en: The picnic was canceled because of a heavy {downpour}.
e.zh: 因为一场倾盆大雨,野餐被取消了。

downright.t:
adv. 完全地；彻底地
adj. 彻头彻尾的

e.en: That comment was {downright} rude and uncalled for.
e.zh: 那番话简直就是无理取闹,完全没必要。

e.en: The coffee here is {downright} amazing in the morning.
e.zh: 这里早晨的咖啡好喝得不得了。

e.en: The salmon swim {downriver} after spawning in the spring.
e.zh: 鲑鱼在春天产卵后会顺流而下。

e.en: Their cabin sits a few miles {downriver} from the bridge.
e.zh: 他们的小木屋在桥下游几英里处。

e.en: You should {downshift} before climbing that steep hill.
e.zh: 上那个陡坡之前你应该把档位降低。

e.en: After burning out, she decided to {downshift} her career.
e.zh: 在身心俱疲之后,她决定放慢工作节奏。

e.en: The main {downside} of the job is the long commute.
e.zh: 这份工作最大的缺点就是通勤时间太长。

e.en: Every investment has a {downside} you should consider.
e.zh: 任何投资都有需要考虑的不利之处。

e.en: The company plans to {downsize} its overseas operations next year.
e.zh: 公司计划明年缩减其海外业务规模。

e.en: After retirement, they decided to {downsize} to a smaller apartment.
e.zh: 退休后,他们决定换一套更小的公寓。

downsized.t: v. 已缩减规模（过去式）

e.en: He was {downsized} from his job during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间他被公司裁员了。

e.en: They {downsized} their home after the kids moved out.
e.zh: 孩子们搬走后,他们换了一套更小的房子。

downsizes.t: v. 缩减规模（第三人称）

e.en: Whenever the market dips, that firm {downsizes} its workforce.
e.zh: 每当市场下行,那家公司就会裁减员工。

e.en: She always {downsizes} her wardrobe at the end of summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏末都会精简自己的衣柜。

downsizing.t:
n. 裁员；精简
v. 缩减（进行时）

e.en: The {downsizing} announcement worried everyone in the office.
e.zh: 裁员的消息让办公室里的每个人都很担心。

e.en: Many empty nesters are {downsizing} to condos these days.
e.zh: 如今许多空巢老人都搬到了小公寓。

e.en: The team is hoping to reverse its recent {downslide} in the standings.
e.zh: 球队希望扭转最近在排名上的下滑趋势。

e.en: Sales have been on a steady {downslide} since March.
e.zh: 自三月以来销售额一直在稳步下滑。

downslope.t:
n. 下坡
adv. 向下坡

e.en: Strong winds rushed {downslope} from the mountain ridge.
e.zh: 强风从山脊顺着山坡呼啸而下。

e.en: The cabin sits on the {downslope} side of the hill.
e.zh: 小木屋坐落在山坡的下坡一侧。

e.en: Water gushed out of the {downspout} during the rainstorm.
e.zh: 暴雨期间,水从落水管里哗哗地涌出来。

e.en: He attached a barrel to the {downspout} to collect rainwater.
e.zh: 他在落水管下接了个桶来收集雨水。

downstage.t:
adv. 在舞台前方
adj. 舞台前部的

e.en: The actor stepped {downstage} to deliver his final monologue.
e.zh: 演员走到舞台前部,完成了最后的独白。

e.en: Lighting focused on the dancer standing {downstage}.
e.zh: 灯光聚焦在站在舞台前方的舞者身上。

downstairs.t:
adv. 在楼下
n. 楼下

e.en: I heard someone moving around {downstairs} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我听到楼下厨房里有人在走动。

e.en: She ran {downstairs} to answer the doorbell.
e.zh: 她跑下楼去开门。

downstream.t:
adv. 顺流而下
adj. 下游的（河流/产业链）

e.en: Pollution from the factory affects villages {downstream}.
e.zh: 工厂的污染影响着下游的村庄。

e.en: Any delay here causes problems {downstream} in the supply chain.
e.zh: 这里任何延误都会给供应链下游环节带来问题。

downstroke.t: n. 下划笔画；向下冲程

e.en: The guitarist started the riff with a heavy {downstroke}.
e.zh: 吉他手用一记有力的下扫弦开始了那段即兴。

e.en: On the {downstroke}, the piston compresses the fuel mixture.
e.zh: 活塞在下行冲程时压缩燃料混合气。

e.en: Keep your wrists firm during the {downswing} for a cleaner shot.
e.zh: 下杆时手腕要保持稳固,这样击球才更干净。

e.en: The economy is in a clear {downswing} this quarter.
e.zh: 这个季度经济明显处于下行阶段。

downtime.t: n. 停机时间；空闲时间

e.en: The server {downtime} cost the company thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 服务器停机让公司损失了数千美元。

e.en: I use my {downtime} on weekends to read novels.
e.zh: 周末闲下来的时候我会看小说。

downton.t: n. 唐顿（地名，如《唐顿庄园》）

e.en: My mom binge-watched {Downton} Abbey over the weekend.
e.zh: 我妈妈周末把《唐顿庄园》一口气追完了。

e.en: Fans were thrilled when a new {Downton} film was announced.
e.zh: 得知新一部《唐顿》电影开拍,粉丝们激动不已。

downtown.t:
n. 市中心
adv. 在市中心

e.en: We're meeting for dinner {downtown} after work.
e.zh: 我们下班后约在市中心一起吃晚饭。

e.en: Parking near the {downtown} stadium can be a nightmare.
e.zh: 市中心体育场附近的停车简直让人崩溃。

e.en: Many American {downtowns} struggled after malls drew shoppers away.
e.zh: 在购物中心抢走顾客后,美国许多市中心都陷入困境。

e.en: Revitalizing {downtowns} has become a priority for several mayors.
e.zh: 重振市中心已成为几位市长的工作重点。

downtrodden.t: adj. 受压迫的；被欺压的

e.en: The novel tells the story of {downtrodden} factory workers in the 1900s.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了1900年代受压迫工厂工人的故事。

e.en: The charity advocates for the {downtrodden} and homeless.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为受欺压者和无家可归者发声。

e.en: The company laid off staff during the economic {downturn}.
e.zh: 经济低迷期间,公司裁掉了部分员工。

e.en: Tech stocks suffered a sharp {downturn} last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度科技股出现了大幅下跌。

downward.t:
adj. 向下的
adv. 向下地

e.en: House prices have shown a {downward} trend this year.
e.zh: 今年房价呈现下行趋势。

e.en: The plane began a steep {downward} descent toward the runway.
e.zh: 飞机开始向跑道急剧下降。

e.en: The main {drawback} of this phone is short battery life.
e.zh: 这款手机的主要缺点是电池续航短。

e.en: Living downtown has one big {drawback}: the noise.
e.zh: 住在市中心有个大缺点:吵。

e.en: Remote work has clear benefits but also several {drawbacks}.
e.zh: 远程办公有明显好处,但也存在一些弊端。

e.en: Consider the {drawbacks} before signing a long-term lease.
e.zh: 在签长期租约之前先想想缺点。

e.en: The castle's {drawbridge} slowly lowered across the moat.
e.zh: 城堡的吊桥缓缓放下,横跨护城河。

e.en: Tourists watched the {drawbridge} rise to let ships pass.
e.zh: 游客们看着吊桥升起,让船只通过。

e.en: Pull the {drawcord} to tighten the hood around your face.
e.zh: 拉一下抽绳就能把帽子收紧贴在脸边。

e.en: These shorts have an elastic waist and a soft {drawcord}.
e.zh: 这条短裤有松紧腰带和柔软的抽绳。

drawdown.t: n. 回撤；减少（金融/水位）

e.en: The fund saw a sharp {drawdown} during the market crash.
e.zh: 该基金在市场崩盘期间出现了大幅回撤。

e.en: Officials announced a gradual {drawdown} of troops next year.
e.zh: 官员宣布明年将逐步撤军。

e.en: My passport is in the top {drawer} of the desk.
e.zh: 我的护照在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

e.en: She slammed the kitchen {drawer} shut by accident.
e.zh: 她不小心砰地关上了厨房抽屉。

e.en: All the {drawers} in the dresser are full of socks.
e.zh: 五斗柜的每个抽屉都塞满了袜子。

e.en: Label the {drawers} so the kids can find things.
e.zh: 在抽屉上贴标签,孩子们就能找到东西了。

drawing.t:
n. 图画；绘图
v. 拉；抽取（draw 进行时）

e.en: She's {drawing} a portrait of her grandmother.
e.zh: 她正在画她奶奶的肖像。

e.en: The architect's {drawing} clearly showed the new layout.
e.zh: 建筑师的图纸清晰地展示了新布局。

e.en: His sketchbook is full of {drawings} of city streets.
e.zh: 他的速写本里全是城市街景的画作。

e.en: The museum displayed rare {drawings} by Leonardo da Vinci.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了达芬奇的几幅珍贵素描。

e.en: He spoke with a slow Texas {drawl} that charmed everyone.
e.zh: 他说话带着慢悠悠的德州口音,把大家都迷住了。

e.en: She tends to {drawl} her words when she's tired.
e.zh: 她累的时候说话会拖长腔。

drawn.t:
v. draw 的过去分词
adj. 憔悴的

e.en: I've always been {drawn} to quiet coastal towns.
e.zh: 我一直被宁静的海滨小镇所吸引。

e.en: The curtains were {drawn} tightly against the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 窗帘紧紧拉上,挡住了午后的阳光。

draws.t: v. 抽取；绘制（draw 三单）

e.en: This park {draws} thousands of visitors every weekend.
e.zh: 这个公园每个周末都吸引成千上万的游客。

e.en: He {draws} cartoons for a popular online magazine.
e.zh: 他为一本热门网络杂志画漫画。

e.en: Tighten the {drawstring} on your hoodie before going outside.
e.zh: 出门前把卫衣上的抽绳收紧。

e.en: The bag has a simple {drawstring} closure at the top.
e.zh: 这个袋子顶部是简单的抽绳开口设计。

e.en: A heavy {dray} loaded with barrels rolled past the brewery.
e.zh: 一辆装满酒桶的重型货运马车从酿酒厂前驶过。

e.en: Horses once pulled a {dray} through these cobbled streets.
e.zh: 曾经有马匹拉着货运车穿过这些鹅卵石街道。

e.en: Michael {Drayton} was an Elizabethan poet known for sonnets.
e.zh: 迈克尔·德雷顿是一位以十四行诗闻名的伊丽莎白时代诗人。

e.en: We drove through {Drayton} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们开车经过德雷顿前往海岸。

dread.t:
v. 畏惧；害怕
n. 恐惧

e.en: I {dread} Monday morning meetings more than anything.
e.zh: 我最害怕星期一早上的会议。

e.en: A sense of {dread} filled her as the phone rang.
e.zh: 电话响起时,一种恐惧涌上她的心头。

dreaded.t: adj. 令人畏惧的；可怕的

e.en: He finally opened the {dreaded} email from his boss.
e.zh: 他终于打开了那封他害怕已久的老板邮件。

e.en: She {dreaded} telling her parents about the failed exam.
e.zh: 她害怕告诉父母考试不及格的事。

e.en: The weather has been absolutely {dreadful} all week.
e.zh: 这一整周的天气真是糟透了。

e.en: I just heard some {dreadful} news from the hospital.
e.zh: 我刚从医院听到一个糟糕的消息。

e.en: I'm {dreadfully} sorry for missing your birthday party.
e.zh: 非常抱歉我错过了你的生日聚会。

e.en: The first draft was {dreadfully} written and confusing.
e.zh: 初稿写得糟糕透顶,让人摸不着头脑。

e.en: She's been {dreading} this conversation for weeks.
e.zh: 她已经害怕这次谈话好几周了。

e.en: I'm {dreading} the long flight back home tomorrow.
e.zh: 我很怕明天回家那趟漫长的航班。

e.en: He twisted a single {dreadlock} between his fingers.
e.zh: 他用手指捻着一根脏辫。

e.en: She added one decorative bead to each {dreadlock}.
e.zh: 她在每根脏辫上加了一颗装饰珠。

e.en: The {dreadlocked} musician strummed his guitar on stage.
e.zh: 那位留着脏辫的乐手在台上弹着吉他。

e.en: A {dreadlocked} traveler shared stories around the campfire.
e.zh: 一位留着脏辫的旅人在篝火旁讲述故事。

e.en: The {dreadnought} battleship dominated naval power before WWI.
e.zh: 无畏舰在一战前主宰着海上力量。

e.en: He plays a vintage {dreadnought} guitar with rich tone.
e.zh: 他弹着一把音色饱满的复古D型吉他。

dreads.t:
v. 畏惧（三单）
n. 脏辫（复数）

e.en: She {dreads} the thought of moving to another city.
e.zh: 她一想到要搬到另一个城市就发怵。

e.en: He grew his {dreads} out for nearly five years.
e.zh: 他把脏辫留了将近五年。

dream.t:
n. 梦；梦想
v. 做梦；梦想

e.en: I had a strange {dream} about flying over the ocean.
e.zh: 我做了一个奇怪的梦，梦见自己飞过海洋。

e.en: Her {dream} is to open a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 她的梦想是在市中心开一家小面包店。

dreamboat.t: n. 梦中情人；极具魅力的人

e.en: The new lead actor is an absolute {dreamboat}.
e.zh: 新来的男主角真是个迷人的帅哥。

e.en: Teen magazines used to call him a {dreamboat}.
e.zh: 少女杂志以前都称他为梦中情人。

e.en: She hung a {dreamcatcher} above her bed for good luck.
e.zh: 她在床头挂了一个捕梦网祈求好运。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {dreamcatcher} ornaments.
e.zh: 这家店出售手工制作的捕梦网饰品。

e.en: As a kid, I {dreamed} of becoming an astronaut.
e.zh: 小时候，我梦想成为一名宇航员。

e.en: She {dreamed} about her grandmother last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚梦见了她的祖母。

e.en: He's a {dreamer} who never quite finishes his projects.
e.zh: 他是个空想家，从来不能真正完成他的项目。

e.en: Every great inventor starts as a {dreamer}.
e.zh: 每一位伟大的发明家最初都是个梦想家。

dreamily.t: adv. 出神地；如梦似幻地

e.en: She stared {dreamily} out the window during class.
e.zh: 上课时她出神地望着窗外。

e.en: He spoke {dreamily} about his upcoming trip to Japan.
e.zh: 他陶醉地谈起即将到来的日本之行。

e.en: The song has a soft {dreaminess} that calms me.
e.zh: 这首歌有种柔和的梦幻感，让我平静下来。

e.en: I love the {dreaminess} of these watercolor paintings.
e.zh: 我喜欢这些水彩画的梦幻感。

e.en: Stop {dreaming} and start working on your goals.
e.zh: 别再幻想了，开始为目标努力吧。

e.en: I was {dreaming} about pizza when the alarm rang.
e.zh: 闹钟响时我正梦见披萨。

e.en: The kids drifted off to {dreamland} after the long hike.
e.zh: 孩子们在长途徒步后就进入了梦乡。

e.en: This beach resort feels like a tropical {dreamland}.
e.zh: 这个海滨度假村感觉像是热带梦境。

e.en: After the long flight, I fell into a {dreamless} sleep.
e.zh: 经过长途飞行后，我陷入了无梦的沉睡。

e.en: She enjoyed a deep, {dreamless} nap on the couch.
e.zh: 她在沙发上享受了一次深沉无梦的小憩。

e.en: The foggy forest had a {dreamlike} quality.
e.zh: 雾蒙蒙的森林有一种如梦似幻的感觉。

e.en: His new film features {dreamlike} visuals and slow pacing.
e.zh: 他的新片有梦幻般的画面和缓慢的节奏。

e.en: Follow your {dreams}, even when others doubt you.
e.zh: 追随你的梦想，即使别人怀疑你。

e.en: She rarely remembers her {dreams} after waking up.
e.zh: 她醒来后很少记得自己的梦。

dreamscape.t: n. 梦幻景象；梦境画面

e.en: The painting depicts a surreal {dreamscape} of floating islands.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了漂浮岛屿的超现实梦境。

e.en: The video game's {dreamscape} levels are stunning.
e.zh: 这款游戏的梦境关卡非常惊艳。

dreamtime.t: n. 梦创时代（澳洲原住民神话）

e.en: Aboriginal stories often refer to the sacred {dreamtime}.
e.zh: 原住民的故事常提到神圣的梦创时代。

e.en: The exhibit explores {dreamtime} myths and creation legends.
e.zh: 展览探索梦创时代的神话与创世传说。

dreamworld.t: n. 梦幻世界；虚幻世界

e.en: He lives in a {dreamworld} and ignores reality.
e.zh: 他活在幻想世界里，无视现实。

e.en: The novel pulls readers into a vivid {dreamworld}.
e.zh: 这部小说将读者带入一个生动的梦幻世界。

e.en: The cafe has a {dreamy} atmosphere with soft lighting.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆灯光柔和，氛围梦幻。

e.en: She gave him a {dreamy} smile across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他露出陶醉的微笑。

e.en: The poem describes the cold and {drear} winter moors.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了寒冷阴郁的冬日荒原。

e.en: A {drear} silence settled over the empty house.
e.zh: 一片沉闷的寂静笼罩着空荡的房子。

e.en: Rain fell {drearily} on the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 雨阴沉地落在空荡的停车场上。

e.en: He stared {drearily} at the unfinished report.
e.zh: 他无精打采地盯着未完成的报告。

e.en: The {dreariness} of February makes everyone want a vacation.
e.zh: 二月的沉闷让每个人都想去度假。

e.en: Bright colors break up the office's {dreariness}.
e.zh: 鲜艳的色彩打破了办公室的沉闷。

e.en: It was a cold, {dreary} Monday morning in November.
e.zh: 那是十一月一个寒冷沉闷的周一早晨。

e.en: The meeting was long and absolutely {dreary}.
e.zh: 会议又长又极其乏味。

e.en: Most reality TV is just commercial {dreck}.
e.zh: 大多数真人秀只是商业垃圾节目。

e.en: He complained that the new album was total {dreck}.
e.zh: 他抱怨说这张新专辑完全是垃圾。

dredge.t:
v. 疏浚；打捞
n. 挖泥船

e.en: They plan to {dredge} the harbor next spring.
e.zh: 他们计划明年春天疏浚港口。

e.en: Don't {dredge} up old arguments during dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时别再翻旧账了。

e.en: Workers {dredged} tons of mud from the river bottom.
e.zh: 工人们从河底挖出了几吨淤泥。

e.en: The reporter {dredged} up a scandal from years ago.
e.zh: 记者翻出了多年前的一桩丑闻。

e.en: A massive {dredger} cleared the shipping channel overnight.
e.zh: 一艘大型挖泥船连夜清理了航道。

e.en: The {dredger} was anchored just outside the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘挖泥船就停泊在港口外。

dredging.t:
v. 疏浚（进行时）
n. 疏浚作业

e.en: The {dredging} project will deepen the canal significantly.
e.zh: 这项疏浚工程将大幅加深运河。

e.en: Stop {dredging} up things I said years ago.
e.zh: 别再翻出我多年前说过的话了。

e.en: She poured out the coffee {dregs} and rinsed the cup.
e.zh: 她倒掉咖啡渣，把杯子冲洗干净。

e.en: Only the {dregs} of the wine remained in the bottle.
e.zh: 瓶子里只剩下一点酒渣了。

dragged.t: v. drag 的过去式；拖、拽

e.en: He {dragged} his suitcase up the stairs.
e.zh: 他把行李箱拖上了楼梯。

e.en: The lecture {dragged} on for three hours.
e.zh: 讲座拖拖拉拉地讲了三个小时。

dragging.t:
v. drag 的现在分词；拖拽
adj. 缓慢冗长的

e.en: Stop {dragging} your feet and finish the report.
e.zh: 别再拖拖拉拉了,把报告写完。

e.en: She was {dragging} a heavy box across the room.
e.zh: 她正拖着一个沉重的箱子穿过房间。

dragnet.t: n. 拖网；（警方的）搜捕网

e.en: Police launched a {dragnet} to catch the suspect.
e.zh: 警方撒下大网搜捕嫌疑人。

e.en: The {dragnet} extended across three states overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间搜捕网扩展到三个州。

e.en: The knight slew the {dragon} guarding the castle.
e.zh: 骑士斩杀了守卫城堡的恶龙。

e.en: Chinese New Year features a colorful {dragon} dance.
e.zh: 中国新年有一场色彩斑斓的舞龙表演。

e.en: A bright blue {dragonfly} hovered over the pond.
e.zh: 一只亮蓝色的蜻蜓在池塘上盘旋。

e.en: The {dragonfly} darted between the reeds.
e.zh: 那只蜻蜓在芦苇间穿梭。

dragoon.t:
n. 龙骑兵
v. 胁迫、强迫

e.en: They tried to {dragoon} him into joining the committee.
e.zh: 他们想强迫他加入委员会。

e.en: A {dragoon} on horseback led the parade.
e.zh: 一名骑兵在马上领着游行队伍。

drags.t: v. 拖、拽（drag 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The dog always {drags} its leash on walks.
e.zh: 那只狗每次散步都会拽着牵引绳。

e.en: Time really {drags} when you're bored.
e.zh: 无聊的时候时间真的过得很慢。

e.en: The {dragster} reached 300 mph in seconds.
e.zh: 那辆短程加速赛车几秒内就达到了三百英里每小时。

e.en: He builds custom {dragster} engines in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里改装短程加速赛车的引擎。

drain.t:
v. 排干、流尽
n. 排水管、下水道

e.en: Hair keeps clogging the bathroom {drain}.
e.zh: 头发老是堵住浴室的下水道。

e.en: Long meetings really {drain} my energy.
e.zh: 漫长的会议真的会消耗我的精力。

e.en: Poor {drainage} caused the backyard to flood.
e.zh: 排水不良导致后院被淹。

e.en: The new {drainage} system handles heavy rain easily.
e.zh: 新的排水系统能轻松应对暴雨。

e.en: She left the wet dishes on the {drainboard}.
e.zh: 她把湿盘子放在了滴水板上。

e.en: The kitchen has a stainless steel {drainboard} beside the sink.
e.zh: 厨房水槽旁边有一块不锈钢沥水板。

drained.t:
adj. 精疲力竭的
v. 排干（drain 的过去式）

e.en: I felt completely {drained} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后我感到精疲力竭。

e.en: He {drained} the pasta and added the sauce.
e.zh: 他把意面沥干,然后加入酱汁。

e.en: Place the wet cups on the {drainer} to dry.
e.zh: 把湿杯子放在沥水架上晾干。

e.en: That client is a real energy {drainer}.
e.zh: 那个客户真是个能量黑洞。

draining.t:
adj. 让人筋疲力尽的
v. 排水中

e.en: Caring for a newborn is emotionally {draining}.
e.zh: 照顾新生儿在情感上让人筋疲力尽。

e.en: The plumber is {draining} water from the pipes.
e.zh: 水管工正在把管道里的水排出。

e.en: A {drainpipe} runs along the side of the house.
e.zh: 一根排水管沿着房子的侧面延伸。

e.en: The cat climbed up the {drainpipe} to the roof.
e.zh: 那只猫顺着排水管爬上了屋顶。

drains.t:
v. 排干（drain 的第三人称单数）
n. 下水道

e.en: The plumber unclogged all the {drains} this morning.
e.zh: 水管工今天早上疏通了所有下水道。

e.en: Worrying about money really {drains} my mental energy.
e.zh: 为钱发愁真的很消耗我的精神能量。

e.en: A {drake} swam ahead of the female ducks.
e.zh: 一只公鸭在母鸭前面游着。

e.en: The colorful {drake} stood out on the lake.
e.zh: 那只色彩鲜艳的公鸭在湖面上格外显眼。

dralon.t: n. 一种合成腈纶纤维（商标名）

e.en: The sofa is upholstered in soft {dralon} fabric.
e.zh: 沙发用柔软的腈纶面料包覆。

e.en: {Dralon} curtains resist fading in the sun.
e.zh: 腈纶窗帘在阳光下不易褪色。

dram.t: n. 打兰（少量酒或重量单位）

e.en: He poured himself a {dram} of whisky.
e.zh: 他给自己倒了一小杯威士忌。

e.en: Just a {dram} of vanilla finishes the recipe.
e.zh: 再加一点点香草精,这道菜就完成了。

e.en: She studied {drama} at university in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的大学学习戏剧。

e.en: There's always so much {drama} in the group chat.
e.zh: 群聊里总是充满各种狗血戏码。

e.en: Korean {dramas} are hugely popular across Asia.
e.zh: 韩剧在亚洲各地广受欢迎。

e.en: He avoids the petty {dramas} at the office.
e.zh: 他不参与办公室里那些鸡毛蒜皮的纷争。

e.en: There was a {dramatic} drop in temperature overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间气温骤降。

e.en: Don't be so {dramatic} — it's just a scratch.
e.zh: 别那么夸张——只是一道划痕而已。

e.en: Sales increased {dramatically} after the redesign.
e.zh: 重新设计后销售额大幅增长。

e.en: She {dramatically} flung open the door.
e.zh: 她戏剧性地一把推开了门。

dramatics.t: n. 演戏、戏剧表演；夸张行为

e.en: Cut the {dramatics} and tell me what happened.
e.zh: 别演了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: He joined the school {dramatics} club last semester.
e.zh: 他上学期加入了学校的戏剧社。

dramatisation.t: n. 戏剧改编（英式拼写）

e.en: The film is a {dramatisation} of real wartime events.
e.zh: 这部电影是对真实战时事件的戏剧化改编。

e.en: Her {dramatisation} of the argument made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 她对那场争吵的夸张演绎逗笑了大家。

dramatise.t: v. 改编成戏剧；夸张（英式拼写）

e.en: Writers often {dramatise} history to make it engaging.
e.zh: 作家常把历史戏剧化以吸引读者。

e.en: Please don't {dramatise} every small problem at work.
e.zh: 请别把工作中每件小事都小题大做。

dramatised.t: v. dramatise 的过去式；戏剧化的

e.en: The novel was {dramatised} for a TV miniseries.
e.zh: 这部小说被改编成了电视迷你剧。

e.en: He {dramatised} the story to keep the kids listening.
e.zh: 他把故事讲得绘声绘色,让孩子们听得入迷。

e.en: Shakespeare remains the most studied {dramatist} in English.
e.zh: 莎士比亚仍是英语世界最受研究的剧作家。

e.en: She trained as a {dramatist} at a London theatre school.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的一所戏剧学校接受剧作家训练。

e.en: Modern {dramatists} often blend humor with social critique.
e.zh: 现代剧作家常将幽默与社会批评融合。

e.en: Several young {dramatists} won awards at the festival.
e.zh: 几位年轻剧作家在戏剧节上获奖。

e.en: This documentary uses {dramatization} to recreate key moments.
e.zh: 这部纪录片用戏剧化手法重现关键时刻。

e.en: His {dramatization} of the incident felt over the top.
e.zh: 他对那起事件的戏剧化描述显得太夸张了。

dramatize.t: v. 改编成戏剧；夸张渲染

e.en: The producers plan to {dramatize} the bestselling memoir.
e.zh: 制片人计划把这本畅销回忆录改编成戏剧。

e.en: Try not to {dramatize} the situation in front of clients.
e.zh: 在客户面前尽量别把情况说得太严重。

dramatized.t: v. dramatize 的过去式；被改编的

e.en: The trial was {dramatized} in a popular courtroom series.
e.zh: 那场审判被改编进了一部热门法庭剧。

e.en: She {dramatized} her commute story for laughs at dinner.
e.zh: 她在饭桌上把通勤经历讲得很夸张,逗大家笑。

e.en: The {dramaturge} helped the director shape the script.
e.zh: 戏剧顾问协助导演打磨剧本。

e.en: Every major theater hires a {dramaturge} for new productions.
e.zh: 每家大剧院都会为新剧目聘请戏剧顾问。

dramaturgy.t: n. 编剧艺术、戏剧构作学

e.en: She studies {dramaturgy} at a graduate theatre program.
e.zh: 她在研究生戏剧项目中研究戏剧构作。

e.en: Good {dramaturgy} balances pacing, conflict, and theme.
e.zh: 好的戏剧构作能平衡节奏、冲突与主题。

drank.t: v. drink 的过去式；喝、饮

e.en: I {drank} three cups of coffee before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前我喝了三杯咖啡。

e.en: She {drank} water slowly after her long run.
e.zh: 长跑之后她慢慢地喝了水。

drape.t:
v. 披、覆盖
n. 窗帘、悬垂

e.en: {Drape} the blanket over the back of the sofa.
e.zh: 把毯子搭在沙发靠背上。

e.en: Heavy velvet {drape} hung across the theatre stage.
e.zh: 厚重的天鹅绒幕布横挂在剧院舞台前。

draped.t: v. drape 的过去式；披挂着的

e.en: She {draped} a scarf gracefully around her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把围巾优雅地披在肩上。

e.en: Vines {draped} over the old garden wall.
e.zh: 藤蔓垂挂在老花园的墙上。

e.en: His grandfather ran a small {draper} shop downtown.
e.zh: 他祖父在市中心开了一家小布店。

e.en: The local {draper} sold fabric by the meter.
e.zh: 当地的布商按米卖布。

e.en: Heavy {draperies} blocked all the morning sunlight.
e.zh: 厚重的窗帘挡住了所有清晨的阳光。

e.en: The hotel lobby featured silk {draperies} and gold trim.
e.zh: 酒店大堂装饰着丝绸帷幔和金边。

e.en: Soft {drapery} framed the tall living room windows.
e.zh: 柔软的帷幔点缀着客厅的高窗。

e.en: The sculptor carved {drapery} folds with stunning realism.
e.zh: 雕塑家把衣褶刻得逼真传神。

draping.t:
v. 披覆、悬挂
n. 立体裁剪

e.en: She is {draping} fabric on a mannequin for the design.
e.zh: 她正在人台上立体裁剪布料以完成设计。

e.en: Ivy was {draping} down from the balcony railings.
e.zh: 常春藤从阳台栏杆上垂挂下来。

e.en: The company took {drastic} steps to cut costs.
e.zh: 公司采取了大刀阔斧的措施削减成本。

e.en: Don't make {drastic} changes to the diet overnight.
e.zh: 不要一夜之间对饮食做出极端改变。

e.en: Sales dropped {drastically} after the new tax.
e.zh: 新税出台后销量急剧下降。

e.en: The interface has changed {drastically} since last year.
e.zh: 这个界面比去年大幅改动了。

drat.t: int. 该死、讨厌（轻度咒骂）

e.en: "{Drat}!" she muttered when her keys fell into the drain.
e.zh: "该死!"她看到钥匙掉进下水道时低声咒骂。

e.en: {Drat}, I forgot to save the document again.
e.zh: 糟了,我又忘了保存文档。

draught.t: n. 穿堂风；一饮、生啤（英式拼写）

e.en: Close the window — there's a cold {draught} coming in.
e.zh: 把窗户关上,有冷风灌进来。

e.en: He ordered a {draught} beer at the corner pub.
e.zh: 他在街角的酒吧点了一杯生啤。

draughts.t: n. 西洋跳棋（英式）；气流（复数）

e.en: Old houses often have chilly {draughts} in winter.
e.zh: 老房子冬天常有冷飕飕的穿堂风。

e.en: They played {draughts} together every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 他们每个周日下午一起下国际跳棋。

e.en: The {draughtsman} prepared detailed plans for the bridge.
e.zh: 绘图员为这座桥绘制了详细的图纸。

e.en: He worked as a {draughtsman} before becoming an architect.
e.zh: 他在成为建筑师之前曾做过制图员。

draughtsmanship.t: n. 绘图技艺、制图水平

e.en: Her {draughtsmanship} impressed every senior engineer on the team.
e.zh: 她的制图功底让团队里每位资深工程师都赞叹。

e.en: The exhibit highlights da Vinci's extraordinary {draughtsmanship}.
e.zh: 展览着重展示了达芬奇非凡的制图技艺。

draughty.t: adj. 透风的、有穿堂风的

e.en: The cottage was charming but a bit {draughty} in winter.
e.zh: 那座小屋很迷人,只是冬天有点漏风。

e.en: Move your desk away from that {draughty} old window.
e.zh: 把书桌从那扇漏风的旧窗户旁移开。

draw.t:
v. 画、绘制；抽取、吸引
n. 平局；抽签

e.en: Can you {draw} a quick map to the cafe?
e.zh: 你能画张去咖啡馆的简易地图吗?

e.en: The match ended in a {draw} after extra time.
e.zh: 加时赛后比赛以平局结束。

dreidel.t: n. 陀螺（犹太光明节玩具）

e.en: The children spun the {dreidel} during Hanukkah.
e.zh: 光明节期间孩子们玩起了陀螺。

e.en: Each {dreidel} has four Hebrew letters on its sides.
e.zh: 每个陀螺四面都刻有希伯来字母。

e.en: A sudden storm could {drench} you in seconds.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的暴雨能让你瞬间湿透。

e.en: {Drench} the salad with olive oil before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前给沙拉淋上大量橄榄油。

e.en: I got {drenched} walking home without an umbrella.
e.zh: 我没带伞走回家，结果浑身湿透了。

e.en: The pancakes were {drenched} in maple syrup.
e.zh: 煎饼上浇满了枫糖浆。

drenching.t:
v. 使湿透（drench 的现在分词）
adj. 倾盆的

e.en: A {drenching} rain caught us on the hiking trail.
e.zh: 我们在徒步时被一场倾盆大雨淋透了。

e.en: She's {drenching} the plants with too much water.
e.zh: 她给植物浇了太多水，都泡透了。

dresden.t: n. 德累斯顿（德国城市）

e.en: We visited {Dresden} on our trip through Germany.
e.zh: 我们在德国旅行时游览了德累斯顿。

e.en: The museum displays delicate {Dresden} porcelain figurines.
e.zh: 博物馆展出着精致的德累斯顿瓷偶。

dress.t:
n. 连衣裙；服装
v. 穿衣；打扮

e.en: She bought a red {dress} for the wedding.
e.zh: 她为参加婚礼买了一条红色连衣裙。

e.en: Please {dress} warmly; it's freezing outside.
e.zh: 请穿暖和点，外面冷极了。

dressage.t: n. 花式骑术；马场马术

e.en: She trains horses for Olympic-level {dressage} competitions.
e.zh: 她训练马匹参加奥运级别的盛装舞步比赛。

e.en: {Dressage} requires years of patience and precise skill.
e.zh: 盛装舞步需要多年的耐心和精准的技术。

dressed.t: adj. 穿好衣服的；打扮好的

e.en: He {dressed} quickly and rushed out the door.
e.zh: 他迅速穿好衣服冲出门去。

e.en: Everyone was {dressed} in black at the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼上每个人都穿着黑色衣服。

e.en: My socks are in the top drawer of the {dresser}.
e.zh: 我的袜子放在五斗柜最上面的抽屉里。

e.en: She's a sharp {dresser} who always looks polished.
e.zh: 她很会穿衣打扮，看起来总是很精致。

dresses.t:
n. 连衣裙（复数）
v. 穿衣（第三人称单数）

e.en: She owns more {dresses} than she can possibly wear.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙多得根本穿不完。

e.en: He always {dresses} casually, even at formal events.
e.zh: 即使在正式场合，他也总是穿得很随意。

dressing.t:
n. 调味酱；敷料
v. 穿衣

e.en: I'd like ranch {dressing} on my salad, please.
e.zh: 请给我的沙拉配上牧场酱。

e.en: The nurse changed the {dressing} on his wound.
e.zh: 护士给他更换了伤口上的敷料。

e.en: My grandmother was a skilled {dressmaker} in the 1950s.
e.zh: 我奶奶在五十年代是一位手艺精湛的女装裁缝。

e.en: The {dressmaker} took my measurements for the wedding gown.
e.zh: 裁缝给我量了婚纱的尺寸。

dressmaking.t: n. 女装裁缝业；做女装

e.en: She runs a small {dressmaking} business from home.
e.zh: 她在家经营一家小型女装定制店。

e.en: {Dressmaking} classes start next Monday at the community center.
e.zh: 裁缝课下周一在社区中心开课。

dressy.t: adj. 服装讲究的；正式的

e.en: Wear something {dressy} for the dinner party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚晚宴穿得稍微正式一点。

e.en: These shoes are too {dressy} for a casual hike.
e.zh: 这双鞋对于休闲徒步来说太正式了。

drew.t: v. draw 的过去式；画、拉

e.en: She {drew} a quick sketch on the napkin.
e.zh: 她在餐巾纸上快速画了一张草图。

e.en: The concert {drew} a crowd of ten thousand people.
e.zh: 这场演唱会吸引了一万人前来。

drexel.t: n. 德雷塞尔（人名/大学名）

e.en: He earned his engineering degree from {Drexel} University.
e.zh: 他在德雷塞尔大学获得了工程学学位。

e.en: {Drexel} is known for its co-op program in Philadelphia.
e.zh: 德雷塞尔大学以其在费城的带薪实习项目闻名。

drg.t: n. 疾病诊断相关分组（医保术语）

e.en: Hospitals bill Medicare based on the assigned {DRG} code.
e.zh: 医院按照分配的疾病诊断分组代码向医保收费。

e.en: Each {DRG} groups patients with similar treatment costs.
e.zh: 每个诊断分组将治疗成本相近的病人归为一类。

dri.t: n. 每日建议摄入量（Dietary Reference Intake）

e.en: Vitamin C {DRI} for adults is around 90 milligrams daily.
e.zh: 成年人维生素C每日推荐摄入量约为90毫克。

e.en: Nutrition labels often reference the {DRI} guidelines.
e.zh: 营养标签经常参考膳食营养素参考摄入量指南。

e.en: He paid back the loan in {drib} and drabs.
e.zh: 他零零碎碎地把贷款还清了。

e.en: News of the merger came out in tiny {drib} bits.
e.zh: 合并消息一点一点地零星传出。

dribble.t:
v. 运球（篮球/足球）；滴落
n. 细流

e.en: Watch the point guard {dribble} past two defenders.
e.zh: 看那位控卫运球突破了两名防守球员。

e.en: A little juice began to {dribble} down his chin.
e.zh: 果汁开始从他下巴上滴下来。

e.en: He {dribbled} the ball confidently down the court.
e.zh: 他自信地运球冲过球场。

e.en: Sauce {dribbled} onto her shirt during dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时酱汁滴到了她的衬衫上。

dribbler.t: n. 运球者；滴流的东西

e.en: Messi is widely considered the best {dribbler} in soccer history.
e.zh: 梅西被普遍认为是足球史上最出色的盘带高手。

e.en: The young {dribbler} dazzled the crowd with fancy moves.
e.zh: 那位年轻的盘带手用花哨的动作惊艳了观众。

dribbles.t: v. 运球；滴落（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {dribbles} the basketball between his legs effortlessly.
e.zh: 他轻松地在双腿间运篮球。

e.en: A few {dribbles} of paint fell onto the floor.
e.zh: 几滴油漆滴到了地板上。

dribbling.t:
v. 运球（现在分词）
n. 运球动作

e.en: Her {dribbling} skills improved after months of practice.
e.zh: 经过几个月的练习，她的运球技术进步了。

e.en: Water was {dribbling} from the leaky faucet all night.
e.zh: 漏水的水龙头整夜都在滴水。

dried.t:
adj. 干燥的；晒干的
v. dry 的过去式

e.en: She added some {dried} cranberries to the salad.
e.zh: 她在沙拉里加了一些蔓越莓干。

e.en: He {dried} his hands on the kitchen towel.
e.zh: 他用厨房毛巾擦干了手。

drier.t:
n. 烘干机；干燥剂
adj. 更干的

e.en: The air feels much {drier} in winter.
e.zh: 冬天的空气感觉干燥得多。

e.en: This soil is {drier} than the soil in the other pot.
e.zh: 这盆土比另一盆土更干。

dries.t: v. 弄干；变干（第三人称单数）

e.en: The paint {dries} in about two hours.
e.zh: 这种油漆大约两小时就会干。

e.en: She {dries} her hair with a towel before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前用毛巾把头发擦干。

drift.t:
v. 漂流；漂移
n. 趋势；漂移

e.en: My thoughts began to {drift} during the long meeting.
e.zh: 开长会时我的思绪开始飘忽起来。

e.en: There was a thick {drift} of snow against the door.
e.zh: 门边堆着厚厚的一堆雪。

e.en: The boat {drifted} silently across the lake.
e.zh: 小船静静地漂过湖面。

e.en: We slowly {drifted} apart after college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后我们渐渐疏远了。

e.en: He lived like a {drifter}, never staying long anywhere.
e.zh: 他像个流浪汉,从不在一个地方久留。

e.en: The novel's main character is a lonely {drifter}.
e.zh: 小说的主角是个孤独的漂泊者。

drifting.t:
v. 漂流（现在分词）
n. 漂移（赛车技术）

e.en: Snow was {drifting} across the empty road.
e.zh: 雪花飘过空荡荡的马路。

e.en: He kept {drifting} off during the lecture.
e.zh: 他在课上不停地走神。

drifts.t:
v. 漂流（第三人称单数）
n. 漂流（复数）

e.en: Huge snow {drifts} blocked the mountain pass.
e.zh: 巨大的雪堆封住了山口。

e.en: Her attention often {drifts} when she's tired.
e.zh: 她累的时候注意力常常飘走。

e.en: We collected {driftwood} along the beach for the bonfire.
e.zh: 我们沿着海滩捡浮木来生篝火。

e.en: The artist makes sculptures out of {driftwood}.
e.zh: 那位艺术家用浮木做雕塑。

drill.t:
n. 电钻；训练
v. 钻孔；操练

e.en: Can you pass me the electric {drill}?
e.zh: 能把电钻递给我吗?

e.en: The school holds a fire {drill} every semester.
e.zh: 学校每学期都举行一次消防演习。

e.en: He {drilled} a small hole in the wall for the screw.
e.zh: 他在墙上钻了个小孔来拧螺丝。

e.en: The coach {drilled} the team on basic passing skills.
e.zh: 教练反复训练队员的基本传球技巧。

e.en: The oil rig hired an experienced {driller}.
e.zh: 那座钻井平台雇了一位经验丰富的钻井工。

e.en: He works as a {driller} on offshore platforms.
e.zh: 他在海上平台担任钻井工人。

drilling.t:
n. 钻井；钻孔
v. 钻（现在分词）

e.en: The neighbors are {drilling} into the wall again.
e.zh: 邻居又在墙上钻孔了。

e.en: Offshore {drilling} can damage marine ecosystems.
e.zh: 海上钻探可能破坏海洋生态系统。

drills.t:
n. 电钻；演练（复数）
v. 钻孔（第三人称单数）

e.en: The army runs combat {drills} every morning.
e.zh: 部队每天早上进行战斗演练。

e.en: Cordless {drills} are easier to use in tight spaces.
e.zh: 无绳电钻在狭小空间里更好用。

e.en: "How charming," she remarked {drily}.
e.zh: "真可爱啊,"她冷淡地说道。

e.en: He commented {drily} on the so-called masterpiece.
e.zh: 他对这所谓的杰作冷冷地评论了一番。

drink.t:
n. 饮料
v. 喝；饮用

e.en: Would you like a cold {drink} with your meal?
e.zh: 用餐要配一杯冷饮吗?

e.en: You should {drink} more water during the day.
e.zh: 你白天应该多喝点水。

drinkable.t: adj. 可饮用的；适合喝的

e.en: The tap water here is perfectly {drinkable}.
e.zh: 这里的自来水完全可以直接喝。

e.en: This wine is cheap but surprisingly {drinkable}.
e.zh: 这酒虽便宜,但意外地好喝。

e.en: He's a heavy coffee {drinker}.
e.zh: 他是个咖啡重度爱好者。

e.en: She's not much of a {drinker} at parties.
e.zh: 她在派对上不太喝酒。

drinking.t:
n. 饮酒；喝水
v. 喝（现在分词）

e.en: {Drinking} too much soda is bad for your teeth.
e.zh: 喝太多汽水对牙齿不好。

e.en: The well provides clean {drinking} water for the village.
e.zh: 这口井为村子提供干净的饮用水。

drinks.t:
n. 饮料（复数）
v. 喝（第三人称单数）

e.en: Let's grab some {drinks} after work.
e.zh: 下班后我们去喝一杯吧。

e.en: She {drinks} green tea every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都喝绿茶。

drip.t:
v. 滴下；滴落
n. 水滴；点滴

e.en: I can hear water {drip} from the faucet.
e.zh: 我能听见水龙头在滴水。

e.en: The nurse adjusted the saline {drip}.
e.zh: 护士调整了盐水点滴。

dripping.t:
adj. 湿淋淋的
v. 滴水（现在分词）

e.en: Sweat was {dripping} down his forehead.
e.zh: 汗水正从他额头上滴下来。

e.en: She came home {dripping} wet from the rain.
e.zh: 她被雨淋得湿透回了家。

e.en: The kids made a {drippy} mess with their popsicles.
e.zh: 孩子们吃冰棒滴得到处都是。

e.en: This {drippy} faucet keeps me up at night.
e.zh: 这个漏水的水龙头吵得我睡不着。

e.en: The cave was full of beautiful {dripstone} formations.
e.zh: 洞穴里布满了美丽的石钟乳构造。

e.en: Tourists admired the giant {dripstone} columns.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着巨大的石笋柱。

drivable.t: adj. 可驾驶的；可行驶的

e.en: The car is old but still {drivable}.
e.zh: 这辆车虽旧,但还能开。

e.en: After the repairs, the truck is fully {drivable} again.
e.zh: 修好之后,卡车又能正常上路了。

drive.t:
v. 驾驶；驱动
n. 驱动器；车道

e.en: I usually {drive} to work in the morning.
e.zh: 我通常早上开车去上班。

e.en: Her ambition and {drive} impressed the whole team.
e.zh: 她的雄心和干劲让整个团队印象深刻。

drivel.t:
n. 废话；胡言
v. 胡扯

e.en: Most of what he says online is pure {drivel}.
e.zh: 他网上说的大多是废话连篇。

e.en: I can't watch this {drivel} on TV anymore.
e.zh: 我再也看不下去电视上这种废话节目了。

driveline.t: n. 传动系；动力传动轴

e.en: The mechanic inspected the truck's {driveline} for damage.
e.zh: 机修工检查了卡车传动系统是否损坏。

e.en: A vibration in the {driveline} usually means trouble.
e.zh: 传动系统抖动通常意味着出了问题。

driven.t: adj. 有干劲的；由…驱动的

e.en: She's a highly {driven} engineer who loves a challenge.
e.zh: 她是一位非常有干劲、喜欢挑战的工程师。

e.en: He has {driven} this old truck for twenty years.
e.zh: 这辆旧卡车他已经开了二十年。

driver.t:
n. 驱动程序
n. 司机

e.en: The Uber {driver} arrived in just two minutes.
e.zh: 优步司机两分钟就到了。

e.en: Please install the latest printer {driver}.
e.zh: 请安装最新的打印机驱动程序。

driverless.t: adj. 无人驾驶的；自动驾驶的

e.en: {Driverless} cars are being tested in several cities.
e.zh: 无人驾驶汽车正在多个城市进行测试。

e.en: He took a ride in a {driverless} taxi yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天坐了一辆无人驾驶出租车。

drivers.t: n. 驱动程序（复数）；司机（复数）

e.en: All {drivers} must wear seatbelts at all times.
e.zh: 所有司机必须始终系好安全带。

e.en: Update your graphics {drivers} for better performance.
e.zh: 更新你的显卡驱动以获得更好的性能。

drives.t:
n. 驱动器（复数）
v. 驾驶/驱动（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {drives} her daughter to school every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上开车送女儿上学。

e.en: External hard {drives} are useful for backups.
e.zh: 移动硬盘很适合用来备份数据。

e.en: The {driveshaft} broke and the car wouldn't move.
e.zh: 传动轴断了,车开不动了。

e.en: Replacing a {driveshaft} can be expensive.
e.zh: 更换传动轴可能会很贵。

drivetrain.t: n. 动力总成；传动系统

e.en: The new model has a more efficient {drivetrain}.
e.zh: 新款车型的传动系统更高效。

e.en: Electric cars have a much simpler {drivetrain}.
e.zh: 电动车的传动系统要简单得多。

driveway.t: n. 私家车道（通往车库的路）

e.en: He parked the car in the {driveway}.
e.zh: 他把车停在了私家车道上。

e.en: The kids drew chalk pictures on the {driveway}.
e.zh: 孩子们在车道上用粉笔画画。

driving.t:
n. 驾驶
adj. 推动的；强劲的

e.en: She's been {driving} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 她开车已经超过二十年了。

e.en: Rising costs are {driving} customers to cheaper brands.
e.zh: 成本上涨正促使顾客转向更便宜的品牌。

e.en: His daily {drivings} between cities are exhausting.
e.zh: 他每天在各城市间的奔波让他疲惫不堪。

e.en: The reckless {drivings} of taxis worried tourists.
e.zh: 出租车的莽撞驾驶让游客心生不安。

drizzle.t:
n. 毛毛雨
v. 淋少量（酱汁等）

e.en: A light {drizzle} started as we left the cafe.
e.zh: 我们离开咖啡馆时开始下起了毛毛雨。

e.en: {Drizzle} some olive oil over the salad before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在沙拉上淋一点橄榄油。

drizzling.t: v. 下毛毛雨（现在分词）

e.en: It was {drizzling} when I walked to the station.
e.zh: 我走去车站时正下着毛毛雨。

e.en: The chef is {drizzling} chocolate over the dessert.
e.zh: 厨师正在甜点上淋巧克力酱。

e.en: London had a cold, {drizzly} afternoon.
e.zh: 伦敦的下午又冷又下着毛毛雨。

e.en: I love staying in with a book on {drizzly} days.
e.zh: 下毛毛雨的日子里我喜欢在家看书。

drogheda.t: n. 德罗赫达（爱尔兰城市）

e.en: We took the train north to {Drogheda} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车北上去德罗赫达过周末。

e.en: {Drogheda} is a historic town near the Irish coast.
e.zh: 德罗赫达是爱尔兰海岸附近的一座历史名城。

e.en: The pilot deployed the {drogue} parachute on landing.
e.zh: 飞行员在着陆时打开了减速伞。

e.en: A small {drogue} helped slow the spacecraft's descent.
e.zh: 一个小型减速伞帮助飞船减缓下降速度。

droid.t: n. 机器人（科幻用语，android 缩写）

e.en: The little {droid} rolled across the spaceship floor.
e.zh: 那个小机器人在飞船地板上滚来滚去。

e.en: My favorite Star Wars character is a gold {droid}.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的《星球大战》角色是一个金色机器人。

droit.t: n. 权利（法律术语，源自法语）

e.en: The lord claimed an ancient {droit} over the land.
e.zh: 领主主张对这片土地拥有古老的权利。

e.en: In feudal law, every {droit} had its limits.
e.zh: 在封建法律中,每项权利都有其界限。

e.en: He told the story with a {droll} smile.
e.zh: 他带着一丝滑稽的微笑讲了那个故事。

e.en: Her {droll} sense of humor made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 她那种古怪的幽默感让大家都笑了。

e.en: His speeches were full of clever {drollery}.
e.zh: 他的演讲里满是机智诙谐的笑料。

e.en: The old comedian was famous for his gentle {drollery}.
e.zh: 那位老喜剧演员以温和的滑稽风格闻名。

e.en: "Lovely weather," he said {drolly} as it poured rain.
e.zh: "天气真好,"他在大雨中滑稽地说道。

e.en: She {drolly} suggested we hire a unicorn instead.
e.zh: 她滑稽地建议我们干脆雇一只独角兽算了。

e.en: A {dromedary} has just one hump on its back.
e.zh: 单峰驼的背上只有一个驼峰。

e.en: We rode a {dromedary} through the desert at sunset.
e.zh: 我们日落时骑着单峰驼穿越沙漠。

e.en: The old engine made a low {dron} as it warmed up.
e.zh: 老旧的发动机预热时发出低沉的嗡鸣声。

e.en: A faint {dron} of bees came from the garden.
e.zh: 花园里传来一阵微弱的蜜蜂嗡鸣。

drone.t:
n. 无人机
v. 嗡嗡作响；单调地说

e.en: A delivery {drone} dropped the package on my balcony.
e.zh: 一架快递无人机把包裹送到了我的阳台上。

e.en: His monotone voice was a constant {drone} during the lecture.
e.zh: 他单调的嗓音在整堂课上像嗡嗡声一样持续不断。

e.en: A black {drongo} perched on the wire, flicking its forked tail.
e.zh: 一只黑卷尾鸟停在电线上,摆动着分叉的尾巴。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {drongo} chasing insects above the field.
e.zh: 观鸟者看到一只卷尾鸟在田野上空追捕昆虫。

droning.t: v. 嗡嗡作响；单调地说（现在分词）

e.en: The professor kept {droning} on about tax law for an hour.
e.zh: 教授就税法喋喋不休地讲了整整一个小时。

e.en: I fell asleep to the {droning} sound of the air conditioner.
e.zh: 我在空调的嗡嗡声中睡着了。

e.en: The puppy started to {drool} when he smelled bacon.
e.zh: 小狗一闻到培根的味道就开始流口水。

e.en: Fans {drool} over the new phone's sleek design online.
e.zh: 粉丝们在网上对这款新手机的时尚设计赞不绝口。

e.en: The baby was {drooling} all over his bib while teething.
e.zh: 宝宝长牙时口水流得围嘴上到处都是。

e.en: She's been {drooling} over that handbag for weeks.
e.zh: 她已经盯着那个手提包流口水好几个星期了。

droop.t:
v. 下垂；低垂
n. 下垂

e.en: The flowers began to {droop} after a day without water.
e.zh: 花朵缺水一天后开始耷拉下来。

e.en: His shoulders {droop} whenever he gets bad news.
e.zh: 每次听到坏消息,他的肩膀都会垮下来。

e.en: The {drooping} branches almost touched the ground after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后,下垂的树枝几乎要碰到地面了。

e.en: She noticed his {drooping} eyelids and suggested a coffee break.
e.zh: 她注意到他眼皮耷拉,便建议休息一下喝杯咖啡。

droops.t: v. 下垂（第三人称单数）

e.en: The plant always {droops} when I forget to water it.
e.zh: 我一忘记浇水,这盆植物就会蔫下来。

e.en: His mustache {droops} below his lip in a comical way.
e.zh: 他的胡子滑稽地垂到了嘴唇下面。

droopy.t: adj. 下垂的；无精打采的

e.en: The basset hound has the most {droopy} ears I've ever seen.
e.zh: 这只巴吉度猎犬的耳朵是我见过最下垂的。

e.en: She felt {droopy} after pulling an all-nighter for the exam.
e.zh: 考试通宵后她感觉无精打采。

drop.t:
v. 掉落；下降
n. 一滴；下降

e.en: Be careful not to {drop} your phone in the pool.
e.zh: 小心别把手机掉进游泳池里。

e.en: Stock prices saw a sharp {drop} this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午股价大幅下跌。

e.en: There's a steep {drop-off} just past the trail marker.
e.zh: 过了步道标记就是一处陡峭的悬崖。

e.en: Please use the school {drop-off} lane in the morning.
e.zh: 早上请使用学校的下车专用车道。

e.en: He's a college {drop-out} who later founded a tech company.
e.zh: 他是个大学辍学生,后来创办了一家科技公司。

e.en: The {drop-out} rate for online courses remains surprisingly high.
e.zh: 网课的退课率高得惊人。

e.en: Spread a {dropcloth} on the floor before you start painting.
e.zh: 开始刷漆前先在地板上铺一块防尘布。

e.en: The {dropcloth} caught every splatter of paint from the ceiling.
e.zh: 防尘布接住了从天花板溅下来的每一滴油漆。

e.en: A tiny {droplet} of dew clung to each blade of grass.
e.zh: 每片草叶上都挂着一颗小小的露珠。

e.en: The virus spreads through {droplet} transmission in close contact.
e.zh: 该病毒通过近距离飞沫传播。

e.en: He's a high school {dropout} who became a successful chef.
e.zh: 他是个高中辍学生,后来成了一位成功的厨师。

e.en: The app's user {dropout} happens mostly on the signup screen.
e.zh: 该应用的用户流失主要发生在注册页面。

e.en: The school is working hard to reduce {dropouts} this year.
e.zh: 学校今年正努力减少辍学人数。

e.en: Several {dropouts} from the program later became famous entrepreneurs.
e.zh: 该项目的几位退学者后来成了著名企业家。

dropped.t: v. 掉落；下降（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: I {dropped} my keys somewhere between the car and the door.
e.zh: 我把钥匙掉在了从车到门之间的某个地方。

e.en: The band {dropped} their new album last Friday.
e.zh: 乐队上周五发布了他们的新专辑。

e.en: Use the {dropper} to add three drops of oil to the diffuser.
e.zh: 用滴管往香薰机里加三滴精油。

e.en: The medicine comes with a measured {dropper} for accuracy.
e.zh: 这款药附带一个有刻度的滴管以便精准用量。

dropping.t:
v. 掉落（现在分词）
n. 动物粪便

e.en: Temperatures are {dropping} fast as the cold front moves in.
e.zh: 随着冷锋逼近,气温正在迅速下降。

e.en: She kept {dropping} hints about wanting a puppy for Christmas.
e.zh: 她一直暗示想要圣诞节收到一只小狗。

drops.t:
n. 滴剂；（液体的）滴
v. 掉落（第三人称单数）

e.en: A few {drops} of rain landed on the windshield.
e.zh: 几滴雨点落在了挡风玻璃上。

e.en: He {drops} the kids off at school every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上送孩子们去上学。

e.en: In old novels, characters sometimes died of {dropsy}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,人物有时会死于水肿病。

e.en: The vet suspected {dropsy} after noticing the fish's swollen belly.
e.zh: 兽医注意到鱼的肚子肿胀,怀疑是腹水病。

e.en: Geneticists often use {drosophila} to study inheritance patterns.
e.zh: 遗传学家经常用果蝇来研究遗传规律。

e.en: A jar of {drosophila} sat on the lab bench under a lamp.
e.zh: 实验台上灯下放着一罐果蝇。

e.en: Most online comments are pure {dross}, but a few are insightful.
e.zh: 大多数网络评论纯属垃圾,但偶有真知灼见。

e.en: The smith skimmed {dross} off the surface of the molten metal.
e.zh: 铁匠从熔融金属表面撇去了浮渣。

e.en: The region is suffering its worst {drought} in fifty years.
e.zh: 该地区正经历五十年来最严重的旱灾。

e.en: Hollywood is hoping to end its box office {drought} this summer.
e.zh: 好莱坞希望今年夏天结束票房低迷期。

e.en: Climate change is making severe {droughts} more frequent worldwide.
e.zh: 气候变化使全球严重干旱越来越频繁。

e.en: Farmers have learned to plant crops that survive long {droughts}.
e.zh: 农民学会了种植能熬过长期干旱的作物。

drove.t:
v. drive 的过去式，驾驶；驱赶
n. 一大群

e.en: She {drove} eight hours straight to surprise her parents.
e.zh: 她连开了八个小时的车去给父母一个惊喜。

e.en: A {drove} of tourists filled the small mountain village.
e.zh: 成群结队的游客挤满了这个小山村。

drover.t: n. 赶牲口的人；牲畜贩子

e.en: The old {drover} guided the cattle across the dusty plain.
e.zh: 老牧人赶着牛群穿过尘土飞扬的平原。

e.en: A {drover} can spend weeks moving sheep between pastures.
e.zh: 赶畜人可能要花几周时间在牧场之间转移羊群。

e.en: Always supervise children so they don't {drown} in the pool.
e.zh: 一定要看着孩子们,以免他们在泳池里溺水。

e.en: He turned up the music to {drown} out the traffic noise.
e.zh: 他把音乐声调大,以盖过车流的噪音。

drowned.t: v. 溺死（过去式）；被淹没

e.en: The hikers nearly {drowned} when the river suddenly flooded.
e.zh: 河水突然暴涨时,徒步者们差点淹死。

e.en: Her voice was {drowned} out by the roaring crowd.
e.zh: 她的声音被欢呼的人群淹没了。

drowning.t:
n. 溺水
v. 正在溺水/淹没

e.en: The lifeguard rescued a {drowning} swimmer caught in the rip current.
e.zh: 救生员救起了一名被离岸流困住即将溺水的游泳者。

e.en: I'm {drowning} in emails after a week of vacation.
e.zh: 休假一周回来,我都快被邮件淹没了。

drowns.t: v. 淹没；溺死（第三人称单数）

e.en: The waterfall {drowns} out every other sound in the forest.
e.zh: 瀑布的轰鸣盖过了森林里其他所有声音。

e.en: Every year someone {drowns} at this beach during storm season.
e.zh: 每年风暴季都会有人在这片海滩溺亡。

e.en: After lunch I like to {drowse} on the sofa for a while.
e.zh: 午饭后我喜欢在沙发上打个小盹。

e.en: The cat will {drowse} in the sunny window all afternoon.
e.zh: 猫会在阳光照到的窗台上打盹一整个下午。

e.en: She blinked {drowsily} at the alarm clock and rolled over.
e.zh: 她睡眼惺忪地看了看闹钟,翻了个身。

e.en: The toddler waved {drowsily} before falling back asleep.
e.zh: 小宝宝迷迷糊糊地挥了挥手,又睡着了。

e.en: This medication may cause {drowsiness}, so don't drive afterward.
e.zh: 这种药可能会引起嗜睡,服用后请勿开车。

e.en: A heavy lunch always brings on serious {drowsiness} at work.
e.zh: 吃一顿大餐午饭后,工作时总会犯困。

drowsy.t: adj. 昏昏欲睡的；困倦的

e.en: The warm room made everyone in the meeting feel {drowsy}.
e.zh: 温暖的房间让会议上每个人都昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Cold medicine often makes me too {drowsy} to focus.
e.zh: 感冒药经常让我困得没法集中注意力。

drs.t: n. Dr. 的复数，医生们；博士们

e.en: The hospital directory lists all the {drs} alphabetically by surname.
e.zh: 医院通讯录按姓氏字母顺序列出了所有医生。

e.en: Both {drs} agreed that surgery was the safest option.
e.zh: 两位医生都同意手术是最安全的选择。

e.en: The home team is expected to {drub} their winless rivals tonight.
e.zh: 主队预计今晚会大胜尚未取胜的对手。

e.en: Critics continue to {drub} the film for its weak script.
e.zh: 评论家们因剧本薄弱而对这部电影口诛笔伐。

e.en: The champions handed the rookies a serious {drubbing} in the final.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军在决赛中把新人队伍打得落花流水。

e.en: The candidate took a {drubbing} from the press after the gaffe.
e.zh: 那位候选人因失言遭到媒体的猛烈抨击。

drudge.t:
n. 做苦工的人
v. 做单调乏味的工作

e.en: He refuses to {drudge} away at a job he hates.
e.zh: 他拒绝在一份自己讨厌的工作里苦熬下去。

e.en: She felt like a {drudge} after cleaning the office all weekend.
e.zh: 打扫了一整个周末办公室后,她觉得自己像个苦力。

drudgeries.t: n. 单调乏味的苦工（复数）

e.en: Modern appliances have eliminated many household {drudgeries} of the past.
e.zh: 现代家电消除了过去许多繁琐的家务苦差事。

e.en: He listed the daily {drudgeries} that came with running a farm.
e.zh: 他列举了经营农场所伴随的种种日常苦差事。

e.en: Filing tax returns is sheer {drudgery} for most small business owners.
e.zh: 对大多数小企业主来说,报税完全是苦差事。

e.en: Automation has freed workers from much of the factory {drudgery}.
e.zh: 自动化让工人们摆脱了许多枯燥的工厂苦活。

drug.t:
n. 药物；毒品
v. 下药

e.en: The new {drug} has shown promising results in clinical trials.
e.zh: 这种新药在临床试验中显示出令人鼓舞的效果。

e.en: Police arrested two men on {drug} trafficking charges.
e.zh: 警方以贩毒罪逮捕了两名男子。

drugged.t:
v. 给…下药（过去式）
adj. 被麻醉的

e.en: She felt {drugged} and confused after the long flight home.
e.zh: 长途飞行回家后,她感觉昏昏沉沉、迷迷糊糊的。

e.en: Police believe the victim was {drugged} before the robbery.
e.zh: 警方认为受害人在被抢前遭人下了药。

e.en: The film paints him as a former {druggie} turned activist.
e.zh: 这部电影把他刻画成一个由瘾君子转变成的活动家。

e.en: Don't dismiss every homeless person as a {druggie}.
e.zh: 别把每个无家可归的人都当成瘾君子。

e.en: Ask the {druggist} whether this medicine interacts with caffeine.
e.zh: 问问药剂师这种药是否会和咖啡因相互作用。

e.en: The corner {druggist} has been serving the neighborhood for decades.
e.zh: 街角的药剂师已经为这个社区服务了几十年。

druggy.t:
adj. 与毒品有关的
n. 吸毒者

e.en: The film has a hazy, {druggy} atmosphere from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都笼罩着一种迷幻恍惚的氛围。

e.en: He gave me a {druggy} smile and drifted back to sleep.
e.zh: 他给了我一个迷迷糊糊的微笑,又昏睡过去。

e.en: The {drugmaker} announced a new vaccine entering phase three trials.
e.zh: 该制药商宣布一款新疫苗进入三期临床试验。

e.en: Shares of the {drugmaker} soared after positive trial results.
e.zh: 试验结果利好后,这家制药公司的股价飙升。

e.en: Some prescription {drugs} can interact badly with grapefruit juice.
e.zh: 有些处方药与西柚汁同服会产生不良反应。

e.en: He's been clean and off {drugs} for over five years now.
e.zh: 他已经戒毒并保持清醒五年多了。

e.en: I'll stop by the {drugstore} to pick up some cough syrup.
e.zh: 我顺路去药店买点止咳糖浆。

e.en: The {drugstore} on the corner stays open twenty-four hours.
e.zh: 街角那家药店二十四小时营业。

e.en: Most {drugstores} now offer flu shots without an appointment.
e.zh: 大多数药店现在不需预约就能打流感疫苗。

e.en: Big chain {drugstores} have replaced many independent pharmacies downtown.
e.zh: 大型连锁药店已经取代了市中心许多独立药房。

druid.t: n. 德鲁伊（古凯尔特祭司）

e.en: The {druid} performed an ancient ritual under the oak tree.
e.zh: 那位德鲁伊在橡树下举行古老的仪式。

e.en: In the game, my {druid} can transform into a bear.
e.zh: 在游戏里，我的德鲁伊可以变身成熊。

druidical.t: adj. 德鲁伊的；与德鲁伊教有关的

e.en: The stone circle has clear {druidical} origins.
e.zh: 那圈石阵明显源自德鲁伊文化。

e.en: Tourists visit the site for its {druidical} history.
e.zh: 游客们因这里的德鲁伊历史而前来参观。

drum.t:
n. 鼓；圆桶
v. 击鼓

e.en: He learned to play the {drum} when he was eight.
e.zh: 他八岁时学会了打鼓。

e.en: The factory shipped oil in a large metal {drum}.
e.zh: 工厂用一个大金属桶装运石油。

drumbeat.t: n. 鼓声；鼓点；大肆宣传

e.en: A steady {drumbeat} echoed through the parade grounds.
e.zh: 稳定的鼓点在阅兵场上回荡。

e.en: Media kept up a {drumbeat} of criticism against the policy.
e.zh: 媒体对该政策持续不断地进行批评。

e.en: The {drumhead} cracked after years of heavy playing.
e.zh: 那张鼓面经过多年重击后裂开了。

e.en: He tightened the {drumhead} to get a sharper sound.
e.zh: 他绷紧鼓面以获得更清脆的声音。

e.en: The band's new {drummer} keeps perfect time.
e.zh: 乐队的新鼓手节奏感非常好。

e.en: She's the best {drummer} in the school orchestra.
e.zh: 她是校乐团里最棒的鼓手。

drumming.t:
n. 击鼓；鼓声
v. drum 的现在分词

e.en: His {drumming} kept the whole song together.
e.zh: 他的鼓声把整首歌串了起来。

e.en: Rain was {drumming} on the tin roof all night.
e.zh: 雨整夜敲打着铁皮屋顶。

drumroll.t: n. 连续的鼓声（常用于宣布重大事件前）

e.en: And the winner is, {drumroll} please, Maria!
e.zh: 获胜者是，敲鼓声请响起，玛丽亚！

e.en: A long {drumroll} introduced the next performer.
e.zh: 一段长长的鼓声介绍了下一位表演者。

e.en: He plays {drums} in a local jazz band.
e.zh: 他在本地的爵士乐队里打鼓。

e.en: The {drums} arrived in steel containers from the refinery.
e.zh: 这些桶装货从炼油厂用钢制集装箱运到。

e.en: She broke a {drumstick} during the loud finale.
e.zh: 她在激昂的终曲中打断了一根鼓棒。

e.en: My favorite part of the chicken is the {drumstick}.
e.zh: 鸡身上我最喜欢的部位是鸡腿。

drunk.t:
adj. 喝醉的
n. 醉汉

e.en: He was too {drunk} to drive home safely.
e.zh: 他喝得太醉，没法安全开车回家。

e.en: She had {drunk} three cups of coffee before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前她已经喝了三杯咖啡。

e.en: The old {drunkard} stumbled out of the pub at midnight.
e.zh: 那个老酒鬼半夜跌跌撞撞地走出酒吧。

e.en: His father was a {drunkard} who lost every job.
e.zh: 他父亲是个酒鬼，每份工作都丢了。

e.en: A {drunken} argument broke out at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 婚宴上爆发了一场醉酒的争吵。

e.en: He apologized for his {drunken} behavior the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上他为自己醉酒的行为道歉。

e.en: He sang {drunkenly} all the way home from the bar.
e.zh: 他从酒吧一路醉醺醺地唱着歌回家。

e.en: She waved {drunkenly} at strangers across the street.
e.zh: 她醉醺醺地朝街对面的陌生人挥手。

e.en: Public {drunkenness} is illegal in many cities.
e.zh: 在许多城市，公共场合醉酒是违法的。

e.en: His {drunkenness} embarrassed the entire family at dinner.
e.zh: 他的醉态在晚餐时让全家人都很尴尬。

druthers.t: n. 个人的选择或偏好（美口语）

e.en: If I had my {druthers}, I'd work from home forever.
e.zh: 如果让我自己挑，我宁愿永远在家办公。

e.en: Given his {druthers}, he'd skip the meeting entirely.
e.zh: 如果由他做主，他会干脆不参加会议。

druze.t: n. 德鲁兹派（中东一宗教群体）

e.en: The {druze} community has lived in these mountains for centuries.
e.zh: 德鲁兹族社区已在这片山区生活了数个世纪。

e.en: She studied {druze} religious traditions for her thesis.
e.zh: 她为论文研究了德鲁兹派的宗教传统。

dry.t:
adj. 干燥的；乏味的
v. 使变干

e.en: Hang the towel outside so it can {dry} in the sun.
e.zh: 把毛巾挂到外面，让它在阳光下晾干。

e.en: His {dry} sense of humor cracks everyone up.
e.zh: 他冷面式的幽默感让大家都笑个不停。

dryad.t: n. 树仙女；森林女神（希腊神话）

e.en: In the myth, a {dryad} guarded each ancient oak.
e.zh: 传说中，每棵古老的橡树都有一位树精守护。

e.en: The painting depicts a {dryad} dancing in the forest.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位树精在森林中起舞。

e.en: Please move the laundry from the washer to the {dryer}.
e.zh: 请把衣服从洗衣机搬到烘干机里。

e.en: The desert air is much {dryer} than the coast.
e.zh: 沙漠的空气比海岸要干燥得多。

drying.t:
v. 变干
n. 烘干、晾干

e.en: The clothes are {drying} on the line outside.
e.zh: 衣服正挂在外面的晾衣绳上晾干。

e.en: Use a {drying} rack to protect delicate fabrics.
e.zh: 用晾衣架来保护娇贵的衣料。

e.en: The cake was a bit {dryish}, but still tasty.
e.zh: 这蛋糕有点偏干，不过还是挺好吃的。

e.en: He made a {dryish} joke that only a few people got.
e.zh: 他开了个有点冷的玩笑，只有少数人听懂。

e.en: Farmers in this region rely on {dryland} agriculture.
e.zh: 这一带的农民主要靠旱地农业为生。

e.en: Swimmers practice {dryland} training during the off season.
e.zh: 游泳运动员在淡季会进行陆上训练。

e.en: "How original," she remarked {dryly}.
e.zh: 她冷冷地说了一句：“真有创意啊。”

e.en: He commented {dryly} on the manager's latest idea.
e.zh: 他对经理的新点子作了一番冷嘲热讽的评论。

e.en: The {dryness} of the air made my skin itch.
e.zh: 空气的干燥让我皮肤发痒。

e.en: I love the {dryness} of his comedy routine.
e.zh: 我很喜欢他段子里那种冷面幽默。

drystone.t: adj. 干砌的（不用灰浆的石墙）

e.en: A {drystone} wall ran the length of the field.
e.zh: 一道干砌石墙沿着田地一路延伸。

e.en: He learned to build {drystone} walls from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了垒干砌石墙。

e.en: We need to patch the hole in the {drywall}.
e.zh: 我们得把石膏板上的洞补一下。

e.en: The contractor finished the {drywall} in just two days.
e.zh: 承包商只用两天就装完了石膏板墙。

dsc.t: abbr. 差示扫描量热法；数字静态相机

e.en: The chemist ran a {dsc} scan to study the polymer's melting point.
e.zh: 化学家做了差示扫描量热分析以研究聚合物的熔点。

e.en: Our lab just bought a new {dsc} instrument for thermal analysis.
e.zh: 我们实验室刚买了一台新的差示扫描量热仪用于热分析。

dso.t: abbr. 数字存储示波器；深空天体

e.en: The company tracks {dso} to monitor how quickly customers pay.
e.zh: 公司通过应收账款周转天数来监测客户付款速度。

e.en: Reducing {dso} improved our cash flow significantly this quarter.
e.zh: 降低应收账款周转天数显著改善了本季度的现金流。

e.en: Modern phones use a tiny {dsp} chip to clean up audio.
e.zh: 现代手机使用微型数字信号处理芯片来净化音频。

e.en: He wrote firmware for a {dsp} that filters noisy signals.
e.zh: 他为一款数字信号处理器编写固件，用来过滤噪声信号。

e.en: Hospitals rely on a {dss} to support complex treatment choices.
e.zh: 医院依赖决策支持系统来辅助复杂的治疗选择。

e.en: The new {dss} pulls data from every department in real time.
e.zh: 新的决策支持系统实时汇总各部门的数据。

dti.t: abbr. 扩散张量成像；贸工部

e.en: Banks check your {dti} ratio before approving a mortgage.
e.zh: 银行在批准房贷之前会查你的负债收入比。

e.en: A high {dti} can hurt your chances of getting a loan.
e.zh: 较高的负债收入比可能会影响你贷款的机会。

e.en: She uses {dtp} software to lay out the magazine each month.
e.zh: 她每月使用桌面排版软件来设计杂志版面。

e.en: Modern {dtp} tools make professional design accessible to everyone.
e.zh: 现代桌面排版工具让人人都能做出专业设计。

e.en: The home theater supports {dts} surround sound out of the box.
e.zh: 这套家庭影院开箱即支持 DTS 环绕声。

e.en: Movies encoded with {dts} usually have richer audio than stereo.
e.zh: 用 DTS 编码的电影通常比立体声音质更丰富。

e.en: The phone has a {dual} camera system for better photos.
e.zh: 这款手机配有双摄像头系统，拍照效果更好。

e.en: She holds {dual} citizenship in Canada and Japan.
e.zh: 她拥有加拿大和日本的双重国籍。

e.en: Descartes is famous for his mind-body {dualism}.
e.zh: 笛卡尔以其身心二元论而闻名。

e.en: The novel explores the {dualism} of good and evil.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了善与恶的二元对立。

e.en: As a {dualist}, he believed mind and body are separate.
e.zh: 作为一名二元论者，他认为心灵与身体是分开的。

e.en: The philosopher took a {dualist} view of consciousness.
e.zh: 那位哲学家对意识持二元论的观点。

e.en: Many religions present a {dualistic} view of the universe.
e.zh: 许多宗教对宇宙持有二元论的看法。

e.en: Her thinking is too {dualistic}, splitting things into good and bad.
e.zh: 她的思维过于二分，总把事情分成好和坏。

e.en: The film captures the {duality} of human nature beautifully.
e.zh: 这部电影优美地刻画了人性的双重性。

e.en: Light shows a {duality} as both wave and particle.
e.zh: 光呈现出波粒二象性的双重性质。

e.en: Studios often {dub} foreign films into the local language.
e.zh: 制片厂经常会把外国电影配音成本地语言。

e.en: Fans began to {dub} him "the king of comedy".
e.zh: 粉丝开始把他称为“喜剧之王”。
