e.en: We have a layover in {dubai} on the way to Bangkok.
e.zh: 我们在飞往曼谷途中会在迪拜中转。

e.en: The skyline of {dubai} is full of futuristic skyscrapers.
e.zh: 迪拜的天际线上满是未来感十足的摩天大楼。

dubbed.t:
v. 被称为；已配音
adj. 译制的

e.en: The movie was {dubbed} into twelve different languages.
e.zh: 这部电影被配音成十二种不同的语言。

e.en: Critics {dubbed} her the next big tech leader.
e.zh: 评论家把她称为下一位科技界的领军人物。

e.en: The {dubbing} on this anime feels surprisingly natural.
e.zh: 这部动漫的配音听起来出奇地自然。

e.en: She works in {dubbing}, voicing characters for Korean dramas.
e.zh: 她从事配音工作，为韩剧角色配音。

dubious.t: adj. 可疑的；半信半疑的

e.en: The website made some pretty {dubious} health claims.
e.zh: 那个网站做出了一些相当可疑的健康宣传。

e.en: She gave him a {dubious} look when he explained the plan.
e.zh: 他解释计划时，她投来了怀疑的目光。

e.en: He eyed the leftover sushi {dubiously}.
e.zh: 他半信半疑地打量着那盘剩下的寿司。

e.en: She {dubiously} agreed to try his weird recipe.
e.zh: 她将信将疑地答应试一下他那个奇怪的菜谱。

dublin.t: n. 都柏林（爱尔兰首都）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring {dublin}'s old pubs.
e.zh: 我们用一个长周末逛了都柏林的那些老酒吧。

e.en: My flight to {dublin} was delayed by three hours.
e.zh: 我飞往都柏林的航班延误了三个小时。

e.en: As a true {dubliner}, he knows every back street in the city.
e.zh: 作为地道的都柏林人，他熟悉城里的每一条小巷。

e.en: The {dubliner} chatted with tourists outside the pub.
e.zh: 那位都柏林人在酒吧外和游客们聊天。

dubrovnik.t: n. 杜布罗夫尼克（克罗地亚城市）

e.en: The walled old town of {dubrovnik} draws millions of tourists.
e.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克的城墙老城每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: We took a ferry from {dubrovnik} to a nearby island.
e.zh: 我们从杜布罗夫尼克坐渡轮去了附近的一个小岛。

dubs.t: v. 配音；起绰号（dub 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This streaming service offers {dubs} in eight languages.
e.zh: 这个流媒体平台提供八种语言的配音版本。

e.en: Everyone {dubs} him the office tech wizard.
e.zh: 大家都把他称为办公室里的技术达人。

e.en: The young {duc} inherited a vast estate in Burgundy.
e.zh: 这位年轻的公爵继承了勃艮第的一片大庄园。

e.en: In old French novels, the {duc} often hosts grand balls.
e.zh: 在古老的法国小说里，公爵经常举办盛大的舞会。

e.en: The {ducal} palace still draws thousands of tourists each summer.
e.zh: 那座公爵宫殿每年夏天仍吸引成千上万的游客。

e.en: She inherited the {ducal} title after her father's death.
e.zh: 父亲去世后她继承了公爵的头衔。

e.en: The merchant paid one gold {ducat} for the silk.
e.zh: 商人付了一枚金达克特币购买这匹丝绸。

e.en: Old Venetian {ducat} coins now sell for thousands at auction.
e.zh: 古老的威尼斯达克特金币如今在拍卖会上能卖出几千美元。

e.en: The {duchess} hosted a charity gala at her country estate.
e.zh: 公爵夫人在乡间庄园举办了一场慈善晚宴。

e.en: Meghan became a {duchess} after marrying Prince Harry.
e.zh: 梅根嫁给哈里王子后成为了公爵夫人。

duchesse.t: n. 贵妇缎；公爵夫人（法语）

e.en: She wore a gown of cream-colored {duchesse} satin.
e.zh: 她穿了一件奶白色公爵夫人缎制成的礼服。

e.en: The bride chose {duchesse} lace for her veil.
e.zh: 新娘为头纱选了公爵夫人花边。

e.en: Luxembourg is the only remaining grand {duchy} in the world.
e.zh: 卢森堡是世界上唯一现存的大公国。

e.en: The small {duchy} was absorbed into the kingdom in 1815.
e.zh: 这个小公国于1815年被并入王国。

duck.t:
n. 鸭子
v. 低头躲避

e.en: A mother {duck} led her ducklings across the road.
e.zh: 一只母鸭带着小鸭子们穿过马路。

e.en: You should {duck} when walking through that low doorway.
e.zh: 穿过那扇矮门时你得低头。

e.en: The platypus is famous for its strange {duckbill} snout.
e.zh: 鸭嘴兽以其奇特的鸭嘴而闻名。

e.en: He wore a cap with a long {duckbill} brim.
e.zh: 他戴了一顶帽檐很长的鸭舌帽。

duckboard.t: n. 铺在泥地上的木板道

e.en: Soldiers walked along the {duckboard} to avoid the muddy trench floor.
e.zh: 士兵们沿着木板走道走,避开泥泞的战壕地面。

e.en: The garden path used wooden {duckboard} over the wet ground.
e.zh: 花园小径在潮湿的地面上铺了木条板。

e.en: The toddler refused to take a bath without her rubber {duckie}.
e.zh: 这个幼儿没有小黄鸭就不肯洗澡。

e.en: He bought a tiny {duckie} for the baby shower gift.
e.zh: 他为迎婴派对礼物买了一只小鸭子玩偶。

ducking.t: v. 低头躲避；按入水中

e.en: He kept {ducking} my questions about the missing money.
e.zh: 他一直回避我关于失踪资金的问题。

e.en: She avoided the ball by {ducking} behind the couch.
e.zh: 她躲到沙发后面才避开了那个球。

e.en: A fluffy yellow {duckling} followed its mother to the pond.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的黄色小鸭子跟着妈妈走到池塘边。

e.en: The story of the ugly {duckling} teaches kids about self-worth.
e.zh: 丑小鸭的故事教孩子们认识自我价值。

ducks.t:
n. 鸭子（复数）
v. 躲避

e.en: Several {ducks} paddled across the calm lake at sunset.
e.zh: 几只鸭子在日落时分划过平静的湖面。

e.en: She feeds the {ducks} in the park every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 她每周六早上都去公园喂鸭子。

e.en: A thick layer of {duckweed} covered the entire surface of the pond.
e.zh: 一层厚厚的浮萍盖住了整个池塘的水面。

e.en: Fish farmers sometimes harvest {duckweed} as a protein-rich feed.
e.zh: 养鱼户有时会收集浮萍作为高蛋白饲料。

e.en: Angela {Duckworth} popularized the concept of grit in psychology.
e.zh: 安吉拉·达克沃斯让坚毅这一心理学概念广为人知。

e.en: The {Duckworth}-Lewis method adjusts cricket scores during rain delays.
e.zh: 达克沃斯-刘易斯法用于在板球比赛雨中暂停时调整得分。

ducky.t:
adj. 可爱的；极好的
n. 亲爱的（昵称）

e.en: Everything is just {ducky} now that the project is finished.
e.zh: 项目完工了,现在一切都很顺心。

e.en: "That's a {ducky} idea," she said with a sarcastic smile.
e.zh: “真是个妙主意,”她带着讽刺的微笑说。

duct.t: n. 管道；导管（输送气体或液体）

e.en: Cold air flowed through the heating {duct} into the bedroom.
e.zh: 冷空气通过暖气管道流进了卧室。

e.en: He fixed the broken hose with a roll of {duct} tape.
e.zh: 他用一卷胶带修好了破水管。

e.en: The biopsy revealed early-stage {ductal} carcinoma in her left breast.
e.zh: 活检显示她左乳有早期的导管癌。

e.en: Doctors monitor {ductal} changes carefully during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在孕期会仔细监测导管的变化。

ductile.t: adj. (金属) 有延展性的；易变形的

e.en: Copper is highly {ductile} and easy to draw into wire.
e.zh: 铜的延展性很好,容易拉成电线。

e.en: Engineers prefer {ductile} metals for parts that must bend without breaking.
e.zh: 工程师偏爱延性金属来做需要弯曲而不断裂的零件。

e.en: Gold is prized for its remarkable {ductility} and resistance to corrosion.
e.zh: 黄金因其卓越的延展性和抗腐蚀性而备受推崇。

e.en: The new alloy improves {ductility} without sacrificing strength.
e.zh: 这种新合金提高了延展性,同时不损失强度。

ductwork.t: n. 管道系统（尤指通风管）

e.en: Old {ductwork} in the attic was leaking heated air everywhere.
e.zh: 阁楼里老旧的管道系统到处漏暖气。

e.en: The contractor cleaned the {ductwork} before installing the new HVAC system.
e.zh: 承包商在安装新的空调系统前先清理了管道。

dud.t:
n. 哑弹；没用的东西
adj. 失灵的

e.en: The firework turned out to be a {dud} and never exploded.
e.zh: 那个烟花结果是个哑炮,根本没爆。

e.en: His latest movie was a complete {dud} at the box office.
e.zh: 他最新的电影在票房上彻底失败了。

e.en: Wordsworth wrote a famous sonnet sequence about the River {Duddon}.
e.zh: 华兹华斯写过一组关于达顿河的著名十四行诗。

e.en: Hikers love the quiet beauty of the {Duddon} Valley in Cumbria.
e.zh: 徒步者喜爱坎布里亚郡达顿河谷的宁静之美。

dude.t: n. 哥们；家伙（男性口语称呼）

e.en: Hey {dude}, did you see the game last night?
e.zh: 嘿哥们儿,你昨晚看比赛了吗?

e.en: Some {dude} on the subway was singing opera at full volume.
e.zh: 地铁上有个家伙正扯着嗓子唱歌剧。

dudes.t: n. 哥们们；家伙们（dude 的复数）

e.en: A bunch of {dudes} were skateboarding in the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 一群小伙子在空停车场里玩滑板。

e.en: Listen up {dudes}, we leave for the trip at six.
e.zh: 哥们儿们听好,我们六点出发去旅行。

dudgeon.t: n. 愤慨；怨恨（多用于 in high dudgeon）

e.en: She left the meeting in high {dudgeon} after the proposal failed.
e.zh: 提案被否决后,她怒气冲冲地离开了会议。

e.en: He stormed out in {dudgeon} when his idea was mocked.
e.zh: 他的想法遭到嘲笑,便愤然离场。

dudley.t: n. 达德利（人名或地名）

e.en: {Dudley} is a market town in the West Midlands of England.
e.zh: 达德利是英格兰西米德兰兹郡的一个集镇。

e.en: In the Harry Potter books, {Dudley} is Harry's spoiled cousin.
e.zh: 在《哈利·波特》系列中,达力是哈利被宠坏的表哥。

due.t:
adj. 到期的；应给的
prep. 由于（due to）

e.en: The library book is {due} back on Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 这本图书馆的书周五下午到期。

e.en: The flight was delayed {due} to bad weather over the Pacific.
e.zh: 航班因太平洋上空天气恶劣而延误。

duel.t:
n. 决斗；对决
v. 与…决斗

e.en: Hamilton died in a famous {duel} with Aaron Burr.
e.zh: 汉密尔顿在与阿伦·伯尔的著名决斗中身亡。

e.en: The two chess masters faced off in an epic {duel}.
e.zh: 两位国际象棋大师展开了一场史诗级的对决。

e.en: The candidates spent the night {dueling} over tax policy on stage.
e.zh: 候选人们整晚在台上就税收政策唇枪舌剑。

e.en: Two {dueling} pianos provided lively music all evening.
e.zh: 两架对决钢琴整晚提供着欢快的音乐。

e.en: The famous {duelist} had survived more than thirty encounters.
e.zh: 这位著名的决斗者经历了三十多场对决都活了下来。

e.en: He played a French {duelist} in the historical drama.
e.zh: 他在那部历史剧中饰演了一位法国决斗者。

duelling.t: n. 决斗（dueling 的英式拼写）

e.en: The novel describes the {duelling} culture of nineteenth-century Russia.
e.zh: 这部小说描述了十九世纪俄国的决斗文化。

e.en: Two {duelling} guitarists traded blistering solos all night.
e.zh: 两位斗琴的吉他手整晚轮番献上炽热的独奏。

duellist.t: n. 决斗者（duelist 的英式拼写）

e.en: The aging {duellist} finally retired his pistols after one last match.
e.zh: 这位年迈的决斗者在最后一场对决后终于放下了手枪。

e.en: Pushkin himself was a passionate {duellist} who died in combat.
e.zh: 普希金本人就是一位热衷决斗的人,最终死于决斗。

duels.t:
n. 决斗（复数）
v. 决斗（第三人称单数）

e.en: Gentlemen once settled disputes through {duels} at dawn.
e.zh: 绅士们过去常在黎明时分通过决斗解决争端。

e.en: The reality show features cooking {duels} between rival chefs.
e.zh: 这档真人秀以厨师之间的烹饪对决为特色。

e.en: Members must pay their annual {dues} by the end of January.
e.zh: 会员必须在一月底前缴清年费。

e.en: After years of struggle, she finally got her {dues} as an artist.
e.zh: 经过多年奋斗,她终于作为艺术家得到了应有的认可。

e.en: They sang a beautiful {duet} at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 他们在婚宴上献唱了一首动人的二重唱。

e.en: The piano {duet} required perfect timing between both players.
e.zh: 这首钢琴二重奏需要两位演奏者完美的配合。

duff.t:
adj. 劣质的；无用的
n. 布丁

e.en: My old laptop is completely {duff} and won't even turn on.
e.zh: 我的旧笔记本电脑彻底坏了,连开机都开不了。

e.en: Get off your {duff} and help me clean the kitchen.
e.zh: 别坐着了,起来帮我打扫厨房。

duffel.t: n. 粗呢旅行袋；粗绒布

e.en: He packed his {duffel} bag for the weekend camping trip.
e.zh: 他为周末的露营之旅打包好了行李袋。

e.en: The army-issue {duffel} held everything she needed for deployment.
e.zh: 这个军用行李袋装下了她派驻所需的所有东西。

e.en: I'm a complete {duffer} at golf, but I love playing.
e.zh: 我打高尔夫球的水平很烂,但还是喜欢打。

e.en: Don't be a {duffer} — read the manual before assembling it.
e.zh: 别犯傻,组装之前先看说明书。

duffield.t: n. 达菲尔德（地名/姓氏）

e.en: {Duffield} is a quiet village just north of Derby.
e.zh: 达菲尔德是德比市以北的一个安静村庄。

e.en: We stopped for lunch at a pub in {Duffield}.
e.zh: 我们在达菲尔德的一家酒馆停下来吃午饭。

duffle.t: n. 粗呢旅行袋（duffel 的变体）

e.en: She tossed her {duffle} into the trunk and jumped in.
e.zh: 她把行李袋扔进后备箱就跳上了车。

e.en: His worn leather {duffle} had traveled the world with him.
e.zh: 他那只磨旧的皮质行李袋陪他走遍了世界。

dug.t: v. 挖；掘（dig 的过去式）

e.en: The dog {dug} a deep hole in the back garden.
e.zh: 那只狗在后院挖了一个深深的洞。

e.en: Archaeologists {dug} up Roman coins beneath the old church.
e.zh: 考古学家在那座老教堂下挖出了罗马硬币。

dugout.t:
n. 掩体；防空洞
n. (棒球) 球员休息区

e.en: The pitcher waited in the {dugout} between innings.
e.zh: 投手在两局之间在球员席里等待。

e.en: Soldiers sheltered in a muddy {dugout} during the heavy bombardment.
e.zh: 士兵们在猛烈炮击中躲在泥泞的掩体里。

e.en: A small {duiker} darted across the forest path and vanished.
e.zh: 一只小麂羚冲过林间小道,转眼就消失了。

e.en: The {duiker} is one of Africa's smallest and shyest antelopes.
e.zh: 麂羚是非洲最小、最害羞的羚羊之一。

duisburg.t: n. 杜伊斯堡（德国城市）

e.en: {Duisburg} has the largest inland port in the world.
e.zh: 杜伊斯堡拥有世界上最大的内河港口。

e.en: She studied engineering at the University of {Duisburg}-Essen.
e.zh: 她在杜伊斯堡-埃森大学学习工程学。

e.en: The {Duke} of Cambridge attended the opening ceremony yesterday.
e.zh: 剑桥公爵昨天出席了开幕仪式。

e.en: {Duke} University is one of the top schools in North Carolina.
e.zh: 杜克大学是北卡罗来纳州顶尖的学府之一。

dukedom.t: n. 公爵爵位；公爵领地

e.en: The king granted him a {dukedom} for his loyal service.
e.zh: 国王因他忠心耿耿的服务而授予他公爵爵位。

e.en: The {dukedom} passed to his eldest son upon his death.
e.zh: 他去世后,公爵爵位传给了他的长子。

e.en: Her {dulcet} voice made even the news sound soothing.
e.zh: 她甜美的嗓音连念新闻都让人觉得舒缓。

e.en: The {dulcet} tones of the cello filled the candlelit room.
e.zh: 大提琴悦耳的音色充满了烛光摇曳的房间。

e.en: She plucked a folk tune on her hammered {dulcimer}.
e.zh: 她在扬琴上弹奏了一首民间小调。

e.en: The Appalachian {dulcimer} sits flat on the player's lap.
e.zh: 阿巴拉契亚扬琴是平放在演奏者腿上演奏的。

dull.t:
adj. 无聊的；迟钝的；阴沉的
v. 使变钝

e.en: The lecture was so {dull} that half the class fell asleep.
e.zh: 那堂课乏味得让一半的学生都睡着了。

e.en: This knife is too {dull} to cut through the tomato.
e.zh: 这把刀太钝了,切不动番茄。

e.en: The teacher unfairly treated him like a {dullard} in front of everyone.
e.zh: 老师当着大家的面不公平地把他当成笨蛋对待。

e.en: Don't be such a {dullard} — the joke was actually clever.
e.zh: 别这么迟钝,这个笑话其实挺妙的。

dulled.t: v. 使变钝；使减弱（dull 的过去式）

e.en: The painkillers {dulled} the ache in her back.
e.zh: 止痛药减轻了她背部的疼痛。

e.en: Years of routine had {dulled} his enthusiasm for the job.
e.zh: 多年的例行公事消磨了他对工作的热情。

e.en: The {dullness} of the meeting made everyone check their phones.
e.zh: 会议的乏味让大家都在看手机。

e.en: She complained about the {dullness} of the gray winter sky.
e.zh: 她抱怨灰蒙蒙的冬日天空多么沉闷。

e.en: The streetlights glowed {dully} through the heavy fog.
e.zh: 路灯在浓雾中发出昏暗的光。

e.en: He nodded {dully}, too tired to argue further.
e.zh: 他迟钝地点点头,累得无力再争辩。

e.en: We painted the living room with {Dulux} eggshell white.
e.zh: 我们用多乐士蛋壳白漆刷了客厅。

e.en: The hardware store had a sale on {Dulux} weatherproof paint.
e.zh: 五金店的多乐士户外漆正在打折。

e.en: She grew up in {Dulwich}, a leafy suburb of London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦绿树成荫的郊区达利奇长大。

e.en: The {Dulwich} Picture Gallery houses an impressive Old Masters collection.
e.zh: 达利奇美术馆收藏着令人惊叹的古典大师作品。

e.en: The package was {duly} delivered the next morning.
e.zh: 包裹于次日上午如期送达。

e.en: All employees were {duly} notified of the policy change.
e.zh: 所有员工都已按规定收到政策变更通知。

dum.t: n. 达姆（如 dum-dum 达姆弹）

e.en: She hummed a soft {dum}-dum-dum as she worked.
e.zh: 她一边干活一边轻轻哼着嘟嘟嘟的调子。

e.en: This recipe calls for {dum} cooking over very low heat.
e.zh: 这道菜需要用极小火焖煮。

e.en: The Russian {Duma} passed the new tax law yesterday.
e.zh: 俄罗斯杜马昨天通过了新的税法。

e.en: Members of the {Duma} debated the budget for hours.
e.zh: 杜马议员们就预算辩论了数小时。

dumas.t: n. 大仲马（法国作家姓氏）

e.en: Alexandre {Dumas} wrote The Three Musketeers in 1844.
e.zh: 大仲马于1844年创作了《三个火枪手》。

e.en: My favorite {Dumas} novel is The Count of Monte Cristo.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的大仲马小说是《基督山伯爵》。

e.en: That was a really {dumb} mistake to make.
e.zh: 那真是个非常愚蠢的错误。

e.en: She was struck {dumb} by the sudden good news.
e.zh: 突如其来的好消息让她惊得说不出话。

dumbarton.t: n. 邓巴顿（苏格兰地名）

e.en: {Dumbarton} Castle sits on a volcanic rock above the Clyde.
e.zh: 丹巴顿城堡矗立在克莱德河上的火山岩上。

e.en: He drove north to {Dumbarton} for the weekend.
e.zh: 他周末开车北上去了丹巴顿。

e.en: Don't be a {dumbass}—read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别犯傻,先看说明书。

e.en: Some {dumbass} parked across two spaces again.
e.zh: 又有个蠢货把车横跨两个车位停了。

e.en: He lifted a heavy {dumbbell} during his morning workout.
e.zh: 他晨练时举起了一个很重的哑铃。

e.en: I bought an adjustable {dumbbell} set for home use.
e.zh: 我买了一套可调节哑铃在家里用。

e.en: The magician's final trick will {dumbfound} the entire audience.
e.zh: 魔术师的压轴戏会让全场观众目瞪口呆。

e.en: His sudden resignation continues to {dumbfound} his colleagues.
e.zh: 他突然辞职至今仍让同事们震惊不已。

dumbfounded.t: adj. 目瞪口呆的，惊呆的

e.en: She was {dumbfounded} when the lottery ticket actually won.
e.zh: 当彩票真的中奖时,她惊得说不出话来。

e.en: He stared {dumbfounded} at the broken vase on the floor.
e.zh: 他呆呆地盯着地上摔碎的花瓶。

e.en: The child stared {dumbly} at the towering Christmas tree.
e.zh: 孩子呆呆地望着那棵高耸的圣诞树。

e.en: He nodded {dumbly}, unable to find the right words.
e.zh: 他默默点头,一时找不到合适的话来说。

e.en: His sudden {dumbness} after the accident worried the doctors.
e.zh: 事故后他突然失语让医生们很担心。

e.en: The sheer {dumbness} of the prank video went viral.
e.zh: 那段恶搞视频的纯粹愚蠢让它疯传开来。

dumbo.t: n. 笨蛋；小飞象（迪士尼角色）

e.en: My favorite Disney movie as a kid was {Dumbo}.
e.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的迪士尼电影是《小飞象》。

e.en: Don't be such a {dumbo}—the answer was obvious.
e.zh: 别这么笨,答案明摆着呢。

e.en: The audience was {dumbstruck} by her powerful performance.
e.zh: 她震撼的表演让全场观众目瞪口呆。

e.en: He stood {dumbstruck} when she said yes to his proposal.
e.zh: 她答应他的求婚时,他惊得呆住了。

e.en: The restaurant uses a {dumbwaiter} to send food upstairs.
e.zh: 那家餐厅用送菜升降机把食物送上楼。

e.en: The old hotel still has a working wooden {dumbwaiter}.
e.zh: 那家老酒店仍有一台能用的木制送菜电梯。

dumfries.t: n. 邓弗里斯（苏格兰地名）

e.en: {Dumfries} is a market town in southwest Scotland.
e.zh: 邓弗里斯是苏格兰西南部的一座集镇。

e.en: Robert Burns spent his final years living in {Dumfries}.
e.zh: 罗伯特·彭斯生命的最后几年都在邓弗里斯度过。

dumfriesshire.t: n. 邓弗里斯郡（苏格兰）

e.en: Her family farms a small estate in {Dumfriesshire}.
e.zh: 她家族在邓弗里斯郡经营着一处小庄园。

e.en: {Dumfriesshire} is known for its rolling hills and rivers.
e.zh: 邓弗里斯郡以连绵起伏的丘陵和河流闻名。

dummy.t:
n. 假人；虚设物
adj. 虚假的，模拟的

e.en: Crash tests use a {dummy} to measure impact forces.
e.zh: 碰撞测试用假人来测量冲击力。

e.en: The shop window featured a mannequin {dummy} in a red dress.
e.zh: 橱窗里展示着一个穿红裙子的人体模特。

e.en: Margaret {Dumont} starred alongside the Marx Brothers in many films.
e.zh: 玛格丽特·杜蒙特与马克斯兄弟合演过许多电影。

e.en: We drove through {Dumont}, New Jersey, on our way home.
e.zh: 我们回家路上经过了新泽西州的杜蒙特。

dump.t:
v. 丢弃；倾倒
n. 垃圾场；转储文件

e.en: Please don't {dump} your old clothes on the floor.
e.zh: 请别把旧衣服丢在地上。

e.en: The local {dump} closes at six on Sundays.
e.zh: 当地垃圾场周日六点关门。

e.en: She {dumped} him after finding the suspicious texts.
e.zh: 她发现那些可疑短信后就把他甩了。

e.en: Someone {dumped} an old sofa near the bus stop.
e.zh: 有人在公交站附近扔了一张旧沙发。

e.en: A yellow {dumper} truck rumbled onto the construction site.
e.zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车隆隆地驶进工地。

e.en: The {dumper} unloaded gravel near the new foundation.
e.zh: 自卸车在新地基旁卸下了砾石。

dumping.t:
n. 倾销；倾倒
v. 丢弃（进行式）

e.en: Illegal {dumping} of waste has polluted the river badly.
e.zh: 非法倾倒废物已严重污染了这条河。

e.en: The country was accused of {dumping} cheap steel abroad.
e.zh: 该国被指控向海外低价倾销钢材。

e.en: Each {dumpling} was filled with pork and chives.
e.zh: 每个饺子都包着猪肉韭菜馅。

e.en: My grandmother taught me how to fold a perfect {dumpling}.
e.zh: 我奶奶教我怎么包出完美的饺子。

e.en: We ordered steamed {dumplings} and hot tea for lunch.
e.zh: 我们午餐点了蒸饺和热茶。

e.en: Homemade {dumplings} taste so much better than frozen ones.
e.zh: 自家包的饺子比冷冻的好吃太多了。

dumps.t:
n. 沮丧（in the dumps）
v. 丢弃（第三人称）

e.en: He's been down in the {dumps} since losing his job.
e.zh: 自从丢了工作,他就一直情绪低落。

e.en: The truck {dumps} its load at the recycling center.
e.zh: 卡车在回收中心卸下货物。

e.en: They tossed the broken furniture into the {dumpster} outside.
e.zh: 他们把坏家具扔进了外面的大垃圾桶。

e.en: The whole project turned into a complete {dumpster} fire.
e.zh: 整个项目最后变成了一场彻底的灾难。

dumpty.t: n. Humpty Dumpty 中的角色名

e.en: Humpty {Dumpty} sat on a wall in the nursery rhyme.
e.zh: 童谣里矮胖蛋坐在墙上。

e.en: The kids acted out the Humpty {Dumpty} story at school.
e.zh: 孩子们在学校表演了矮胖蛋的故事。

e.en: They stayed in a {dumpy} motel off the highway.
e.zh: 他们住进了高速公路边一家破旧的汽车旅馆。

e.en: She wore a {dumpy} old coat to shovel snow.
e.zh: 她穿着一件臃肿的旧外套出去铲雪。

dun.t:
v. 催讨欠款
adj. 暗褐色的

e.en: The horse had a beautiful {dun} coat with a dark stripe.
e.zh: 那匹马有着漂亮的灰黄色皮毛,带着一道深色条纹。

e.en: Creditors began to {dun} him for the unpaid bills.
e.zh: 债主开始不停催他还清欠款。

e.en: Faye {Dunaway} won an Oscar for her role in Network.
e.zh: 费·唐纳薇凭借《电视台风云》中的角色获得奥斯卡奖。

e.en: {Dunaway}'s performance in Bonnie and Clyde defined an era.
e.zh: 唐纳薇在《雌雄大盗》中的表演定义了一个时代。

e.en: Paul Laurence {Dunbar} was a pioneering African American poet.
e.zh: 保罗·劳伦斯·邓巴是开拓性的非裔美国诗人。

e.en: The fishing village of {Dunbar} sits on Scotland's east coast.
e.zh: 渔村邓巴坐落在苏格兰东海岸。

e.en: Tim {Duncan} is widely regarded as the greatest power forward ever.
e.zh: 蒂姆·邓肯被普遍认为是史上最伟大的大前锋。

e.en: King {Duncan} is murdered early in Shakespeare's Macbeth.
e.zh: 邓肯王在莎士比亚的《麦克白》中早早被杀。

e.en: He felt like a {dunce} for forgetting the meeting time.
e.zh: 他忘了开会时间,觉得自己像个蠢货。

e.en: In old schools, naughty pupils wore a {dunce} cap.
e.zh: 过去的学校里,顽皮学生要戴笨蛋帽。

dundalk.t: n. 敦多克（爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: {Dundalk} lies halfway between Dublin and Belfast.
e.zh: 邓多克位于都柏林和贝尔法斯特的中间。

e.en: She caught the train to {Dundalk} for her cousin's wedding.
e.zh: 她坐火车去邓多克参加表哥的婚礼。

e.en: The protest marched down {Dundas} Street toward the city hall.
e.zh: 游行队伍沿邓达斯街向市政厅行进。

e.en: Henry {Dundas} was a powerful Scottish politician of the 1700s.
e.zh: 亨利·邓达斯是18世纪权倾一时的苏格兰政治家。

e.en: {Dundee} is famous for its marmalade and shipbuilding history.
e.zh: 邓迪以其橘子酱和造船史而闻名。

e.en: She studied medicine at the University of {Dundee}.
e.zh: 她在邓迪大学学习医学。

e.en: Only a {dunderhead} would lock the keys inside the car.
e.zh: 只有蠢货才会把钥匙锁在车里。

e.en: Stop acting like a {dunderhead} and read the manual.
e.zh: 别再像个笨蛋一样,把说明书读一读。

e.en: We climbed to the top of a sandy {dune} at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时分爬上了一座沙丘的顶端。

e.en: The film adaptation of {Dune} won several Academy Awards.
e.zh: 《沙丘》的电影改编获得了多项奥斯卡奖。

dunedin.t: n. 但尼丁（新西兰城市）

e.en: {Dunedin} has the steepest residential street in the world.
e.zh: 达尼丁拥有世界上最陡的住宅街道。

e.en: She moved to {Dunedin} to study at the university.
e.zh: 她搬到达尼丁去大学读书。

dunfermline.t: n. 邓弗姆林（苏格兰城镇）

e.en: {Dunfermline} was once the capital of medieval Scotland.
e.zh: 邓弗姆林曾是中世纪苏格兰的首都。

e.en: Andrew Carnegie was born in {Dunfermline} in 1835.
e.zh: 安德鲁·卡内基1835年出生于邓弗姆林。

e.en: Farmers spread cow {dung} on the fields as fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民把牛粪撒在田里当肥料。

e.en: The beetle rolled a ball of {dung} across the path.
e.zh: 那只甲虫推着一团粪球穿过小路。

e.en: He wore a faded {dungaree} jacket over his white shirt.
e.zh: 他在白衬衫外套了一件褪色的粗布工装外套。

e.en: The factory uniform included thick {dungaree} trousers.
e.zh: 工厂制服包括一条厚实的粗斜纹布工装裤。

dungarvan.t: n. 邓加文（爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: {Dungarvan} sits on the southern coast of Ireland.
e.zh: 邓加文位于爱尔兰南部海岸。

e.en: We had fish and chips at a pub in {Dungarvan}.
e.zh: 我们在邓加文的一家酒吧吃了炸鱼薯条。

dungeness.t: n. 邓杰内斯（英国海岬）

e.en: {Dungeness} crab is a popular delicacy on the West Coast.
e.zh: 珍宝蟹是美国西海岸的热门美味。

e.en: The lighthouse at {Dungeness} guards a remote shingle beach.
e.zh: 邓杰内斯的灯塔守望着一片偏远的卵石海滩。

e.en: The hero escaped the castle's dark {dungeon} just before dawn.
e.zh: 主角在黎明前逃出了城堡阴暗的地牢。

e.en: This {dungeon} in the game has six challenging boss fights.
e.zh: 游戏里这个副本有六场高难度的首领战。

e.en: The rooster crowed proudly from the top of the {dunghill}.
e.zh: 公鸡神气地站在粪堆顶上打鸣。

e.en: Old farms often had a {dunghill} behind the stable for fertilizer.
e.zh: 旧式农场常在马厩后堆个粪堆当肥料。

e.en: He lit a {Dunhill} cigarette and stared out the window.
e.zh: 他点了一支登喜路香烟,望着窗外发呆。

e.en: The store sells luxury {Dunhill} lighters and leather goods.
e.zh: 这家店出售登喜路的高档打火机和皮具。

e.en: He likes to {dunk} cookies in his morning coffee.
e.zh: 他喜欢把饼干蘸进早晨的咖啡里。

e.en: The point guard surprised everyone with a one-handed {dunk}.
e.zh: 控卫一记单手扣篮把全场都惊到了。

dunkel.t: n. 邓克尔（姓氏/深色啤酒）

e.en: I ordered a glass of Bavarian {dunkel} at the beer hall.
e.zh: 我在啤酒馆点了一杯巴伐利亚黑啤。

e.en: This {dunkel} has a smooth, malty flavor with low bitterness.
e.zh: 这款黑啤口感顺滑、麦香浓郁,苦味很轻。

dunker.t: n. 扣篮的球员；蘸食物的人

e.en: He's a famous slam {dunker} known for his vertical leap.
e.zh: 他是一位以弹跳力著称的著名扣将。

e.en: My grandfather is a serious cookie {dunker} at tea time.
e.zh: 我爷爷喝下午茶时特别爱蘸饼干。

dunking.t:
n. 扣篮
v. 蘸（食物入液体）

e.en: She was caught {dunking} her toast into the soup.
e.zh: 她被发现把吐司蘸到汤里吃。

e.en: His powerful {dunking} skills made him a fan favorite.
e.zh: 他强悍的扣篮技术让他成为球迷宠儿。

dunkirk.t: n. 敦刻尔克（法国港口城市）

e.en: The evacuation at {Dunkirk} saved over 300,000 Allied soldiers.
e.zh: 敦刻尔克大撤退救出了三十多万盟军士兵。

e.en: Christopher Nolan's film {Dunkirk} won three Academy Awards.
e.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰执导的《敦刻尔克》拿下了三项奥斯卡奖。

dunlin.t: n. 黑腹滨鹬（一种水鸟）

e.en: A small flock of {dunlin} foraged along the muddy shore.
e.zh: 一小群黑腹滨鹬在泥泞的岸边觅食。

e.en: The {dunlin} is easily recognized by its black belly patch.
e.zh: 黑腹滨鹬靠腹部那块黑斑很容易辨认。

dunlop.t: n. 邓禄普（轮胎品牌、姓氏）

e.en: I bought a new set of {Dunlop} tires for my car.
e.zh: 我给车换了一套全新的邓禄普轮胎。

e.en: The pro player swung his {Dunlop} racket with confidence.
e.zh: 那位职业球员自信地挥动着他的邓禄普球拍。

dunning.t:
n. 催收欠款
adj. 催讨债款的

e.en: The hospital sent her several {dunning} letters about the unpaid bill.
e.zh: 医院就那笔未付账单寄给她好几封催款信。

e.en: The {Dunning}-Kruger effect explains why beginners often overestimate themselves.
e.zh: 邓宁-克鲁格效应解释了为何初学者常高估自己。

e.en: The collection agency {duns} him daily with phone calls.
e.zh: 催收公司每天打电话向他追讨欠款。

e.en: We drove through the quiet Scottish town of {Duns} at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们开车穿过苏格兰宁静的邓斯小镇。

dunstable.t: n. 邓斯特布尔（英格兰城镇）

e.en: My aunt lives in {Dunstable}, a market town in Bedfordshire.
e.zh: 我姑姑住在贝德福德郡的集镇邓斯特布尔。

e.en: The composer John {Dunstable} influenced early Renaissance music in Europe.
e.zh: 作曲家约翰·邓斯泰布尔影响了欧洲早期文艺复兴音乐。

e.en: John {Dunstaple} was an English composer of the fifteenth century.
e.zh: 约翰·邓斯泰普是十五世纪的英国作曲家。

e.en: Scholars often spell his name {Dunstaple} rather than Dunstable.
e.zh: 学者们更常把他的名字拼作Dunstaple而非Dunstable。

e.en: They moved to {Dunwoody}, a leafy suburb north of Atlanta.
e.zh: 他们搬到了亚特兰大北郊绿树成荫的邓伍迪。

e.en: The {Dunwoody} MARTA station is a popular commuter hub.
e.zh: 邓伍迪的MARTA地铁站是热门的通勤枢纽。

duo.t: n. 二人组合；一对搭档

e.en: The comedy {duo} has been performing together for ten years.
e.zh: 这对喜剧搭档已经合作演出十年了。

e.en: Batman and Robin are perhaps the most famous crime-fighting {duo}.
e.zh: 蝙蝠侠和罗宾大概是最著名的打击犯罪二人组。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed him with a small {duodenal} ulcer.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有一处小的十二指肠溃疡。

e.en: {Duodenal} bleeding can cause dark, tarry stools.
e.zh: 十二指肠出血可能导致黑色柏油样大便。

e.en: Chronic {duodenitis} often causes burning pain in the upper abdomen.
e.zh: 慢性十二指肠炎常引起上腹部的灼烧样疼痛。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed mild {duodenitis} but no signs of cancer.
e.zh: 活检确认是轻度十二指肠炎,没有癌变迹象。

e.en: Food enters the {duodenum} right after leaving the stomach.
e.zh: 食物离开胃后会立刻进入十二指肠。

e.en: Bile and pancreatic juice both empty into the {duodenum}.
e.zh: 胆汁和胰液都会排入十二指肠。

duomo.t: n. 意大利主教座堂（大教堂）

e.en: We climbed to the top of the Florence {Duomo} for sunset.
e.zh: 我们爬上佛罗伦萨大教堂的顶端去看日落。

e.en: Milan's {Duomo} is one of the largest cathedrals in the world.
e.zh: 米兰大教堂是世界上最大的主教座堂之一。

duopoly.t: n. 双头垄断；两家公司主导的市场

e.en: Visa and Mastercard form a near {duopoly} in card payments.
e.zh: 维萨和万事达几乎垄断了银行卡支付市场。

e.en: Regulators worry about the smartphone OS {duopoly} of Apple and Google.
e.zh: 监管机构担心苹果与谷歌在手机系统上的双头垄断。

e.en: Several famous singing {duos} reunited for the charity concert.
e.zh: 几对著名的演唱组合为慈善音乐会重聚。

e.en: The streamer plays {duos} with her brother every weekend.
e.zh: 这位主播每个周末都和弟弟双排开黑。

dup.t:
n. 重复项（duplicate 的缩写）
v. 复制

e.en: Programmers sometimes use {dup} as shorthand for duplicate in code.
e.zh: 程序员有时在代码中用dup作为duplicate的简写。

e.en: He hit {dup} on the keyboard to copy the selected line.
e.zh: 他按下dup键复制了所选的那一行。

dupe.t:
n. 平替；被骗者
v. 欺骗

e.en: Scammers often try to {dupe} elderly people out of savings.
e.zh: 骗子常常想方设法骗走老人的积蓄。

e.en: This drugstore lipstick is a perfect {dupe} for the luxury brand.
e.zh: 这支开架口红完美平替了那个大牌。

duped.t: v. 被欺骗（dupe 的过去式）

e.en: Thousands of investors were {duped} by the cryptocurrency scheme.
e.zh: 成千上万的投资者被这个加密货币骗局蒙骗。

e.en: She felt {duped} after realizing the reviews were all fake.
e.zh: 她意识到那些评价全是假的后,觉得自己被骗了。

duplex.t:
n. 双层公寓；复式住宅
adj. 双向的

e.en: They rent the upper floor of a {duplex} near campus.
e.zh: 他们在校园附近租了一栋双拼住宅的楼上。

e.en: The radio uses full {duplex} so both sides can talk simultaneously.
e.zh: 这台对讲机采用全双工,双方可以同时通话。

duplexer.t: n. 双工器（收发共用设备）

e.en: The radar uses a {duplexer} to share one antenna for both transmission and reception.
e.zh: 雷达使用双工器让一根天线同时收发信号。

e.en: A faulty {duplexer} caused the cell tower's signal to drop.
e.zh: 双工器故障导致这座基站信号中断。

duplicate.t:
v. 复制；重复
n. 副本

e.en: Please make a {duplicate} of the contract for our records.
e.zh: 请把合同复印一份留作我们的存档。

e.en: The software automatically detects {duplicate} files on your hard drive.
e.zh: 这款软件会自动检测硬盘上的重复文件。

duplicated.t: v. 已复制（duplicate 的过去式）

e.en: The researcher {duplicated} the experiment to verify the results.
e.zh: 研究员重做了一遍实验以验证结果。

e.en: Several rows in the spreadsheet were accidentally {duplicated}.
e.zh: 电子表格里有好几行被不小心复制了。

duplicates.t:
n. 重复项；副本
v. 复制（第三人称单数）

e.en: The script removes all {duplicates} from the customer email list.
e.zh: 这段脚本会从客户邮箱列表中清除所有重复项。

e.en: The new printer {duplicates} pages on both sides automatically.
e.zh: 这台新打印机会自动双面复印页面。

e.en: Avoiding code {duplication} keeps a project easier to maintain.
e.zh: 避免代码重复能让项目更容易维护。

e.en: The audit revealed costly {duplication} of effort across departments.
e.zh: 审计发现各部门之间存在代价高昂的重复劳动。

e.en: Chromosomal {duplications} can lead to various genetic disorders.
e.zh: 染色体重复可能导致多种遗传性疾病。

e.en: The report flagged several {duplications} in the project budget.
e.zh: 报告指出项目预算中出现了几处重复列支。

e.en: The office still keeps an old key {duplicator} in the basement.
e.zh: 办公室地下室里还留着一台老式配钥匙机。

e.en: This DVD {duplicator} can copy fifteen discs at once.
e.zh: 这台光盘拷贝机一次能复制十五张光盘。

duplicitous.t: adj. 两面三刀的；表里不一的

e.en: Voters punished the {duplicitous} senator at the next election.
e.zh: 选民在下次选举中惩罚了那位两面三刀的参议员。

e.en: His {duplicitous} behavior eventually destroyed all his close friendships.
e.zh: 他口是心非的行事最终毁掉了所有亲密友谊。

e.en: She was shocked by the {duplicity} of her business partner.
e.zh: 生意伙伴的两面三刀让她大为震惊。

e.en: The novel exposes the {duplicity} hidden behind polite society.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了上流社会礼貌外表下的虚伪。

e.en: {DuPont} is a major American chemical company founded in 1802.
e.zh: 杜邦是一家创立于1802年的美国大型化工企业。

e.en: We met for coffee near {Dupont} Circle in Washington.
e.zh: 我们约在华盛顿杜邦环岛附近喝咖啡。

e.en: The surgeon carefully cut through the {dura} to reach the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地切开硬脑膜以到达肿瘤。

e.en: A tear in the {dura} can cause spinal fluid to leak.
e.zh: 硬脑膜撕裂可能导致脑脊液外漏。

e.en: Customers praise the laptop's {durability} after years of daily use.
e.zh: 用户在天天使用多年后都称赞这款笔记本的耐用性。

e.en: Engineers tested the fabric's {durability} under extreme weather conditions.
e.zh: 工程师在极端天气下测试了这种面料的耐用性。

e.en: This backpack is surprisingly {durable} for its low price.
e.zh: 这款背包价格便宜,却出乎意料地耐用。

e.en: They built a {durable} friendship that survived many disagreements.
e.zh: 他们建立了一段经得起多次争执的牢固友谊。

e.en: Sales of consumer {durables} like fridges fell sharply last quarter.
e.zh: 上季度冰箱等耐用消费品的销量大幅下滑。

e.en: Economists watch orders for {durables} as a sign of growth.
e.zh: 经济学家把耐用品订单视为经济增长的指标。

e.en: The bridge was {durably} constructed to withstand decades of heavy traffic.
e.zh: 这座桥建造得很坚固,足以承受数十年的繁忙车流。

e.en: Inflation has fallen {durably} below the central bank's target.
e.zh: 通胀已经持续稳定地降到了央行目标之下。

e.en: A {dural} tear during surgery can cause persistent headaches.
e.zh: 手术中硬膜撕裂可能引起持续性头痛。

e.en: The MRI showed a small {dural} sinus near the brainstem.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示脑干附近有一个小的硬膜窦。

durance.t: n. 长期监禁（文学用语）

e.en: The political prisoner endured years of {durance} in a remote camp.
e.zh: 那位政治犯在偏远的营地里被囚禁多年。

e.en: He vowed to free his comrades from cruel {durance}.
e.zh: 他发誓要把同伴从残酷的囚禁中救出来。

e.en: The meeting's {duration} was limited to thirty minutes.
e.zh: 这次会议的时长被限制在三十分钟以内。

e.en: Please remain seated for the {duration} of the flight.
e.zh: 在整个飞行期间请保持坐在座位上。

e.en: Users can choose from several subscription {durations} on the website.
e.zh: 用户可以在网站上从多种订阅时长里挑选。

e.en: The study compared sleep {durations} across different age groups.
e.zh: 该研究对比了不同年龄群体的睡眠时长。

e.en: {Durban} has some of South Africa's warmest beaches and best surfing.
e.zh: 德班拥有南非最温暖的海滩和最棒的冲浪点。

e.en: We boarded a flight from Johannesburg to {Durban} on Friday.
e.zh: 我们周五搭上了从约翰内斯堡飞往德班的航班。

durbar.t: n. (印度) 宫廷；觐见大典

e.en: The maharaja held a grand {durbar} to celebrate his coronation.
e.zh: 大君举办了盛大的杜尔巴朝觐礼来庆祝登基。

e.en: Tourists admired the carved pillars of the old {durbar} hall.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着旧朝觐殿那些雕花的柱子。

e.en: A confession signed under {duress} is not legally valid.
e.zh: 在胁迫下签署的供词在法律上无效。

e.en: She agreed to the deal only under severe financial {duress}.
e.zh: 她是在严重的经济压力下才同意这桩交易的。

durex.t: n. 杜蕾斯（避孕套品牌）

e.en: The pharmacy keeps {Durex} condoms on the shelf near the register.
e.zh: 药店把杜蕾斯安全套放在收银台旁边的货架上。

e.en: {Durex} is one of the world's best-known condom brands.
e.zh: 杜蕾斯是全球知名度最高的安全套品牌之一。

e.en: {Durham} Cathedral is a stunning example of Norman architecture in England.
e.zh: 达勒姆大教堂是英格兰诺曼建筑的精彩典范。

e.en: She studies medicine at the University of {Durham}.
e.zh: 她在达勒姆大学攻读医学专业。

e.en: The {durian} has a strong smell that many tourists find shocking.
e.zh: 榴莲气味浓烈，许多游客都觉得难以接受。

e.en: He bought a fresh {durian} from the night market in Singapore.
e.zh: 他在新加坡的夜市买了一个新鲜的榴莲。

e.en: Please silence your phone {during} the meeting.
e.zh: 开会期间请把手机调成静音。

e.en: She fell asleep {during} the long flight to Tokyo.
e.zh: 在飞往东京的长途航班上她睡着了。

duro.t: n. 杜罗（旧西班牙银币）

e.en: The old man paid with a single silver {duro} coin.
e.zh: 老人用一枚银质杜罗硬币付了账。

e.en: Collectors still hunt for the rare Spanish {duro} from 1885.
e.zh: 收藏家至今仍在搜寻1885年的稀有西班牙杜罗币。

duroc.t: n. 杜洛克猪（一种红毛猪）

e.en: The farm raises {Duroc} pigs known for their rich, marbled meat.
e.zh: 这家农场饲养杜洛克猪，以肉质多汁有大理石纹路著称。

e.en: A {Duroc} sow can produce large, healthy litters each year.
e.zh: 一头杜洛克母猪每年都能产下健康的大窝仔猪。

e.en: Real Italian pasta is made from {durum} wheat semolina.
e.zh: 正宗的意大利面是用杜兰小麦粗粒粉制作的。

e.en: Farmers in Canada grow {durum} for export to pasta makers.
e.zh: 加拿大农民种植杜兰麦出口给制面厂家。

e.en: We finished the hike just before {dusk} settled over the valley.
e.zh: 我们在暮色笼罩山谷之前刚好完成了徒步。

e.en: Streetlights flicker on at {dusk} every evening.
e.zh: 每晚黄昏时路灯都会闪烁着亮起。

e.en: The painting captures the {dusky} pink sky at sunset.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉了日落时那暗粉色的天空。

e.en: A {dusky} light filled the old library at closing time.
e.zh: 闭馆时分，昏暗的光线弥漫在那座老图书馆里。

dusseldorf.t: n. 杜塞尔多夫（德国城市）

e.en: Our flight lands in {Dusseldorf} early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们的航班明天清晨降落在杜塞尔多夫。

e.en: {Dusseldorf} hosts a major fashion trade fair every year.
e.zh: 杜塞尔多夫每年都举办大型时装贸易博览会。

dust.t:
n. 灰尘；尘土
v. 拂去灰尘

e.en: A thick layer of {dust} covered the abandoned piano.
e.zh: 那架废弃的钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

e.en: Please {dust} the shelves before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人来之前请把架子擦一下灰。

e.en: Throw the empty bottles in the {dustbin} outside.
e.zh: 把空瓶子扔到外面的垃圾桶里。

e.en: The cat knocked over the {dustbin} again last night.
e.zh: 那只猫昨晚又把垃圾桶撞倒了。

e.en: The council collects the {dustbins} every Thursday morning.
e.zh: 市政部门每周四上午来收垃圾桶。

e.en: Foxes had tipped over several {dustbins} along the street.
e.zh: 狐狸把街上好几个垃圾桶都翻倒了。

e.en: She grabbed a feather {duster} and cleaned the bookshelves.
e.zh: 她拿起鸡毛掸子打扫了书架。

e.en: The cowboy wore a long leather {duster} against the wind.
e.zh: 那位牛仔穿着长款皮风衣抵御风寒。

dusting.t:
v. 掸灰尘
n. 薄薄一层（粉末）

e.en: A light {dusting} of snow covered the rooftops overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间薄薄一层雪覆盖了屋顶。

e.en: He spent Saturday morning {dusting} the living room furniture.
e.zh: 他周六上午花时间给客厅家具掸灰。

dustman.t: n. 清洁工；收垃圾的人

e.en: The {dustman} arrives at six every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 清洁工每周二早上六点来收垃圾。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {dustman} in London for thirty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在伦敦做了三十年的清洁工。

e.en: Sweep the broken glass into the {dustpan} carefully.
e.zh: 小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

e.en: She keeps the broom and {dustpan} behind the kitchen door.
e.zh: 她把扫把和簸箕放在厨房门后。

dusty.t: adj. 满是灰尘的；积满灰的

e.en: The old attic was full of {dusty} cardboard boxes.
e.zh: 那间旧阁楼里堆满了落满灰尘的纸箱。

e.en: We drove down a long, {dusty} country road.
e.zh: 我们驶过一条漫长又满是尘土的乡村小路。

dutch.t:
adj. 荷兰的
n. 荷兰语

e.en: Let's go {Dutch} and split the bill evenly.
e.zh: 我们各付各的，把账单平摊吧。

e.en: She is learning {Dutch} before moving to Amsterdam.
e.zh: 她在搬去阿姆斯特丹之前正在学荷兰语。

e.en: A friendly {Dutchman} gave us directions to the museum.
e.zh: 一位友善的荷兰人给我们指了去博物馆的路。

e.en: The {Dutchman} towered over everyone else in the room.
e.zh: 那位荷兰人比屋里所有人都高出一截。

duties.t: n. 职责；任务；税款（duty 的复数）

e.en: Her {duties} include answering emails and scheduling meetings.
e.zh: 她的职责包括回复邮件和安排会议。

e.en: Import {duties} on electronics have risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年电子产品的进口关税大幅上涨。

e.en: He was a {dutiful} son who called his mother every Sunday.
e.zh: 他是个孝顺的儿子，每周日都会给母亲打电话。

e.en: The assistant gave a {dutiful} nod and got back to work.
e.zh: 助理顺从地点了点头，又回去工作了。

e.en: She {dutifully} filed every receipt at the end of the month.
e.zh: 她每月底都尽职地把每一张收据归档。

e.en: The children {dutifully} thanked their grandparents for the gifts.
e.zh: 孩子们规规矩矩地为收到的礼物向祖父母道谢。

e.en: It is every citizen's {duty} to vote in elections.
e.zh: 参加选举投票是每个公民的义务。

e.en: The night nurse comes on {duty} at ten o'clock.
e.zh: 夜班护士十点钟开始值班。

duty-free.t:
adj. 免税的
n. 免税商品

e.en: I bought some perfume at the airport's {duty-free} shop.
e.zh: 我在机场的免税店买了些香水。

e.en: Travelers can purchase {duty-free} liquor before boarding international flights.
e.zh: 旅客可在搭乘国际航班前购买免税酒类。

e.en: She snuggled under a thick {duvet} on the cold morning.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨她蜷缩在厚厚的羽绒被下。

e.en: This {duvet} is filled with goose down for extra warmth.
e.zh: 这条羽绒被填充了鹅绒，更加保暖。

e.en: The hotel provides fresh {duvets} for every new guest.
e.zh: 这家酒店为每位新客人提供干净的羽绒被。

e.en: Lightweight {duvets} are perfect for warm summer nights.
e.zh: 轻薄的羽绒被非常适合温暖的夏夜。

e.en: He still keeps a shelf of old {DVD} movies at home.
e.zh: 他家里还留着一架子的旧DVD电影。

e.en: My laptop no longer has a {DVD} drive built in.
e.zh: 我的笔记本已经不再内置DVD光驱了。

e.en: She donated her old {DVDs} to the local library.
e.zh: 她把自己的旧DVD捐给了当地图书馆。

e.en: Streaming services have largely replaced physical {DVDs}.
e.zh: 流媒体服务已基本取代了实体DVD。

dvi.t: n. DVI 数字视频接口

e.en: The old projector only accepts a {DVI} cable input.
e.zh: 那台旧投影仪只接受DVI线输入。

e.en: I need an adapter to connect my laptop to the {DVI} monitor.
e.zh: 我需要一个转接头才能把笔记本连到那台DVI显示器上。

dvorak.t: n. 德沃夏克（捷克作曲家）；德沃夏克键盘布局

e.en: Some programmers prefer the {Dvorak} keyboard layout for faster typing.
e.zh: 有些程序员偏爱德沃夏克键盘布局，认为打字更快。

e.en: The orchestra performed {Dvorak}'s New World Symphony last night.
e.zh: 昨晚乐团演奏了德沃夏克的《新世界交响曲》。

dwarf.t:
n. 矮人；侏儒
v. 使显得矮小

e.en: The skyscraper seems to {dwarf} every other building nearby.
e.zh: 这座摩天大楼让附近所有建筑都相形见绌。

e.en: A friendly {dwarf} guarded the entrance in the fantasy game.
e.zh: 在那款奇幻游戏里，一个友善的矮人守在入口处。

dwarfed.t: v. 使相形见绌（dwarf 的过去式）

e.en: The new stadium {dwarfed} the small houses around it.
e.zh: 新建的体育场让周围的小房子显得格外渺小。

e.en: Her achievements {dwarfed} those of her competitors.
e.zh: 她的成就让对手们的表现都黯然失色。

dwarfing.t: v. 使矮小；使相形见绌

e.en: The cathedral's spires rise high, {dwarfing} the surrounding rooftops.
e.zh: 大教堂的尖塔高耸入云，让周围的屋顶相形见绌。

e.en: His latest novel sold millions, {dwarfing} his earlier work.
e.zh: 他的新小说销量数百万，让此前作品都黯然失色。

e.en: The bonsai tree had a charming, {dwarfish} appearance.
e.zh: 那棵盆景显得小巧迷人。

e.en: He sketched a {dwarfish} character with a long beard.
e.zh: 他画了一个长着长胡子的矮人形象。

e.en: The doctor explained that {dwarfism} has many genetic causes.
e.zh: 医生解释说侏儒症有多种遗传原因。

e.en: Advocacy groups raise awareness about living with {dwarfism}.
e.zh: 倡导团体致力于让大众了解侏儒症患者的生活。

e.en: Researchers have identified hundreds of distinct {dwarfisms} worldwide.
e.zh: 研究人员已在全球范围内识别出数百种不同的侏儒症类型。

e.en: Different {dwarfisms} are caused by mutations in different genes.
e.zh: 不同类型的侏儒症是由不同基因的突变引起的。

dwarfs.t:
n. 矮人（复数）
v. 使相形见绌

e.en: The new tower {dwarfs} every other building on the skyline.
e.zh: 这座新塔让天际线上的其他建筑都显得渺小。

e.en: Snow White meets seven friendly {dwarfs} in the forest.
e.zh: 白雪公主在森林里遇见了七个友善的小矮人。

dysphoria.t: n. 烦躁不安；性别焦虑

e.en: Gender {dysphoria} can be eased with proper medical support.
e.zh: 通过适当的医疗支持可以缓解性别焦虑。

e.en: She described her morning {dysphoria} to the therapist.
e.zh: 她向治疗师描述了自己早上的情绪低落感。

e.en: He felt {dysphoric} every Monday morning at the office.
e.zh: 每个周一早晨在办公室他都感到情绪低落。

e.en: Some patients report {dysphoric} reactions to the medication.
e.zh: 一些患者反映服药后出现情绪低落的反应。

e.en: Hip {dysplasia} is common in large dog breeds like retrievers.
e.zh: 髋关节发育不良在金毛等大型犬种中很常见。

e.en: Her biopsy showed mild cervical {dysplasia}.
e.zh: 她的活检显示轻度宫颈发育异常。

e.en: The dermatologist removed a {dysplastic} mole from her back.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生切除了她背上一颗发育异常的痣。

e.en: Pathologists examined the {dysplastic} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 病理学家在显微镜下检查了那些发育异常的细胞。

e.en: Patients with heart failure often experience {dyspnea} on exertion.
e.zh: 心衰患者在用力时常会出现呼吸困难。

e.en: Sudden {dyspnea} should always prompt a medical evaluation.
e.zh: 突发的呼吸困难应立即就医检查。

dyspnoea.t: n. 呼吸困难（英式拼写）

e.en: The patient reported worsening {dyspnoea} over the past week.
e.zh: 患者反映过去一周呼吸困难加重。

e.en: Severe {dyspnoea} forced him to sleep sitting upright.
e.zh: 严重的呼吸困难迫使他只能坐着睡觉。

e.en: Emotional {dysregulation} can be treated with cognitive therapy.
e.zh: 情绪失调可以通过认知疗法治疗。

e.en: Sleep deprivation often causes mood {dysregulation} in teens.
e.zh: 睡眠不足常常导致青少年情绪失调。

e.en: {Dysthymia} feels like a low-grade depression that never lifts.
e.zh: 心境恶劣障碍就像一种从不消散的轻度抑郁。

e.en: Years of untreated {dysthymia} affected her career choices.
e.zh: 多年未治疗的心境恶劣障碍影响了她的职业选择。

e.en: The novel paints a chilling {dystopia} ruled by surveillance.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个被监控统治的可怕反乌托邦。

e.en: Some critics call modern social media a digital {dystopia}.
e.zh: 一些评论家称现代社交媒体是数字反乌托邦。

e.en: Teens love {dystopian} fiction like The Hunger Games.
e.zh: 青少年喜欢《饥饿游戏》这类反乌托邦小说。

e.en: The film offers a bleak, {dystopian} vision of the future.
e.zh: 这部电影展现了一幅黯淡的反乌托邦未来图景。

e.en: Muscular {dystrophy} gradually weakens the body's muscles.
e.zh: 肌营养不良症会逐渐削弱身体的肌肉。

e.en: Researchers are developing gene therapies for {dystrophy}.
e.zh: 研究人员正在开发针对营养不良症的基因疗法。

e.en: In Tolkien's stories, {dwarves} are skilled miners and craftsmen.
e.zh: 在托尔金的故事里，矮人是技艺精湛的矿工和工匠。

e.en: The video game features warrior {dwarves} with massive battle axes.
e.zh: 这款电子游戏里有手持巨型战斧的矮人战士。

e.en: Don't call him a {dweeb} just because he loves math.
e.zh: 别因为他喜欢数学就叫他书呆子。

e.en: In high school he was the {dweeb} who fixed everyone's computer.
e.zh: 高中时他是那个给所有人修电脑的呆子。

dwell.t:
v. 居住；停留
v. 细想，老想着（on）

e.en: Try not to {dwell} on past mistakes for too long.
e.zh: 别在过去的错误上纠结太久。

e.en: Many rare birds {dwell} in this protected wetland.
e.zh: 许多珍稀鸟类栖息在这片受保护的湿地中。

e.en: As a city {dweller}, she misses the quiet of the countryside.
e.zh: 作为城市居民，她很怀念乡村的宁静。

e.en: The cave {dweller} emerged only at night to hunt.
e.zh: 那种穴居动物只在夜间出来觅食。

e.en: Their modest {dwelling} sits at the edge of the forest.
e.zh: 他们简朴的住所坐落在森林边缘。

e.en: Stop {dwelling} on what could have been and move forward.
e.zh: 别再纠结那些本可能的事了，向前看吧。

e.en: Our savings began to {dwindle} after the unexpected medical bills.
e.zh: 在那笔意外的医疗费之后，我们的积蓄开始缩水。

e.en: Public interest in the show continues to {dwindle} each season.
e.zh: 观众对这部剧的兴趣每一季都在减退。

e.en: Conservationists are worried about the {dwindling} polar bear population.
e.zh: 环保人士对北极熊数量的不断减少感到忧心。

e.en: He stared at his {dwindling} bank balance with growing concern.
e.zh: 他越发担心地盯着自己日益缩水的银行余额。

e.en: The therapist worked with the mother-daughter {dyad} for months.
e.zh: 治疗师与这对母女组合进行了数月的辅导。

e.en: Researchers studied each {dyad} of twins separately.
e.zh: 研究人员对每一对双胞胎二人组进行了单独研究。

e.en: The course explores {dyadic} communication between close partners.
e.zh: 这门课程探讨亲密伴侣之间的二元沟通。

e.en: Her research focuses on {dyadic} interactions in early childhood.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦于幼儿期的二人互动。

dybbuk.t: n. 恶灵（犹太民间传说中的附体亡魂）

e.en: In Jewish folklore, a {dybbuk} is a spirit that possesses the living.
e.zh: 在犹太民间传说中，迪布克是附身于活人的灵魂。

e.en: The play tells the haunting story of a young woman and a {dybbuk}.
e.zh: 这部戏讲述了一位年轻女子与迪布克之间令人毛骨悚然的故事。

dye.t:
v. 染色
n. 染料

e.en: She decided to {dye} her hair bright pink for the summer.
e.zh: 她决定把头发染成亮粉色过夏天。

e.en: The natural {dye} comes from the roots of a desert plant.
e.zh: 这种天然染料是从一种沙漠植物的根部提取的。

e.en: He {dyed} his old white shirt navy blue last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末他把那件旧白衬衫染成了藏青色。

e.en: Her freshly {dyed} hair shone under the salon lights.
e.zh: 她刚染好的头发在沙龙灯光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: The artisan spent the afternoon {dyeing} silk scarves by hand.
e.zh: 那位工匠花了一下午时间手工染丝巾。

e.en: {Dyeing} fabric with indigo is an ancient craft in this region.
e.zh: 用靛蓝染布是这个地区一项古老的工艺。

e.en: The local {dyer} produces beautiful colors using only plant extracts.
e.zh: 当地的染匠只用植物提取物就能调出美丽的颜色。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {dyer} in a small textile mill.
e.zh: 她的祖父曾在一家小纺织厂当染工。

dyes.t:
n. 染料（复数）
v. 染色（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {dyes} her hair purple every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都把头发染成紫色。

e.en: Natural plant {dyes} produce softer, earthier colors.
e.zh: 天然植物染料能染出更柔和的大地色。

e.en: The factory exports synthetic {dyestuff} to textile mills worldwide.
e.zh: 该工厂向全球纺织厂出口合成染料。

e.en: Ancient artisans extracted {dyestuff} from sea snails.
e.zh: 古代工匠从海螺中提取染料。

dyfed.t: n. 戴费德（英国威尔士旧郡名）

e.en: We hiked along the rugged coast of {Dyfed} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们沿着戴费德郡崎岖的海岸徒步。

e.en: {Dyfed} was a former county in southwest Wales.
e.zh: 戴费德郡曾是威尔士西南部的一个郡。

dying.t:
adj. 垂死的；临终的
v. die 的现在分词

e.en: I'm {dying} to try that new ramen place downtown.
e.zh: 我超想去市中心新开的那家拉面店。

e.en: The {dying} battery forced me to find a charger fast.
e.zh: 快没电的电池逼我赶紧找充电器。

e.en: The Dutch built a massive {dyke} to hold back the sea.
e.zh: 荷兰人建造了一道巨大的堤坝来挡住海水。

e.en: Workers reinforced the {dyke} before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 工人们在风暴来临前加固了堤坝。

e.en: Bob {Dylan} won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2016.
e.zh: 鲍勃·迪伦于2016年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

e.en: My friend {Dylan} just moved to Berlin for work.
e.zh: 我朋友迪伦因工作刚搬去了柏林。

dynamic.t:
adj. 动态的；有活力的
n. 动力，动态

e.en: The team has a really {dynamic} new manager.
e.zh: 团队有了一位非常有活力的新经理。

e.en: This page loads {dynamic} content based on your preferences.
e.zh: 此页面会根据你的偏好加载动态内容。

e.en: Weather forecasting relies on complex {dynamical} systems.
e.zh: 天气预报依赖于复杂的动力系统。

e.en: Researchers study the {dynamical} behavior of orbiting satellites.
e.zh: 研究人员研究在轨卫星的动力学行为。

e.en: The website {dynamically} adjusts its layout for mobile screens.
e.zh: 该网站会根据手机屏幕动态调整布局。

e.en: Prices are calculated {dynamically} based on real-time demand.
e.zh: 价格根据实时需求动态计算。

dynamics.t: n. 动力学；（事物的）动态变化

e.en: Team {dynamics} improved after the new hire joined.
e.zh: 新成员加入后,团队氛围有了改善。

e.en: She studies fluid {dynamics} at MIT.
e.zh: 她在麻省理工学院研究流体力学。

e.en: The startup scene here has incredible {dynamism}.
e.zh: 这里的创业氛围充满了惊人的活力。

e.en: Her speech captured the {dynamism} of the movement.
e.zh: 她的演讲捕捉到了这场运动的活力。

dynamite.t:
n. 炸药
v. 用炸药炸

e.en: Miners used {dynamite} to blast through the rock.
e.zh: 矿工们用炸药炸穿了岩石。

e.en: That new album is absolutely {dynamite}.
e.zh: 那张新专辑简直精彩绝伦。

dynamo.t: n. 发电机；精力充沛的人

e.en: She's a real {dynamo} when it comes to closing deals.
e.zh: 在拿下订单这方面她是个十足的精力充沛的人。

e.en: The bicycle {dynamo} powers the headlight while you pedal.
e.zh: 自行车的发电机在你蹬车时为前灯供电。

e.en: The mechanic tested engine power on a {dynamometer}.
e.zh: 机修工在测功机上测试了发动机功率。

e.en: Athletes use a hand {dynamometer} to measure grip strength.
e.zh: 运动员用手握力计测量握力。

dynast.t: n. 世袭君主，王朝统治者

e.en: The aging {dynast} prepared his eldest son for the throne.
e.zh: 年迈的王朝统治者为长子继位做准备。

e.en: Each {dynast} ruled the kingdom for at least three decades.
e.zh: 每位王朝君主统治这个王国至少三十年。

e.en: The museum showcases {dynastic} treasures from imperial China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自中国帝制时代的王朝珍宝。

e.en: Ancient {dynastic} struggles often ended in bloody coups.
e.zh: 古代的王朝斗争常以血腥政变收场。

e.en: Several {dynasties} ruled China before the modern era.
e.zh: 近代之前有多个王朝统治过中国。

e.en: Sports {dynasties} are rare in today's competitive leagues.
e.zh: 在如今竞争激烈的联赛中,体育王朝十分罕见。

e.en: The Tang {dynasty} is famous for its poetry and art.
e.zh: 唐朝以其诗歌和艺术闻名于世。

e.en: The Warriors built a basketball {dynasty} in the 2010s.
e.zh: 勇士队在二零一零年代建立了篮球王朝。

dyno.t: n. 测功机（dynamometer 的缩写）

e.en: They strapped the car to the {dyno} to measure horsepower.
e.zh: 他们把车固定在测功机上测量马力。

e.en: The climber made a wild {dyno} to reach the next hold.
e.zh: 攀岩者做了一个大胆的跳跃动作够到下一个支点。

e.en: Travelers caught {dysentery} from contaminated drinking water.
e.zh: 旅行者因饮用受污染的水而患上痢疾。

e.en: Without clean water, {dysentery} spread quickly through the camp.
e.zh: 由于缺乏清洁水源,痢疾在营地迅速蔓延。

dysfunction.t: n. 功能失调，机能障碍

e.en: Workplace {dysfunction} drove half the team to quit.
e.zh: 职场失调让团队一半的人辞职了。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild kidney {dysfunction}.
e.zh: 医生诊断出轻微的肾功能障碍。

dysfunctional.t: adj. 功能失调的；不正常的

e.en: They grew up in a deeply {dysfunctional} family.
e.zh: 他们在一个严重失调的家庭中长大。

e.en: The printer has been {dysfunctional} for weeks now.
e.zh: 这台打印机已经坏了好几个星期了。

e.en: Reviewers complained about the app's overall {dysfunctionality}.
e.zh: 评论者抱怨这款应用整体功能失常。

e.en: Years of {dysfunctionality} drove customers to competitors.
e.zh: 多年的功能失调把客户推向了竞争对手。

dyslexia.t: n. 阅读障碍，读写困难

e.en: Many successful entrepreneurs have openly discussed their {dyslexia}.
e.zh: 许多成功的企业家公开谈论过自己的阅读障碍。

e.en: Early intervention helps children with {dyslexia} thrive in school.
e.zh: 早期干预能帮助有阅读障碍的孩子在学校茁壮成长。

dyslexic.t:
adj. 有阅读障碍的
n. 阅读障碍者

e.en: My {dyslexic} brother uses audiobooks instead of paper books.
e.zh: 我有阅读障碍的哥哥用有声书代替纸质书。

e.en: This font is designed to be friendlier for {dyslexic} readers.
e.zh: 这种字体专为阅读障碍读者设计,更友好易读。

e.en: My new {Dyson} vacuum picks up everything off the carpet.
e.zh: 我的新戴森吸尘器把地毯上的脏东西都吸干净了。

e.en: Freeman {Dyson} proposed a famous theoretical megastructure.
e.zh: 弗里曼·戴森提出了一种著名的理论巨型结构。

e.en: Spicy food often triggers her chronic {dyspepsia}.
e.zh: 辛辣食物常常引发她的慢性消化不良。

e.en: The doctor recommended antacids to relieve his {dyspepsia}.
e.zh: 医生建议服用抗酸药来缓解他的消化不良。

dyspeptic.t: adj. 消化不良的；易怒的

e.en: He gave the waiter a {dyspeptic} glare over the cold soup.
e.zh: 他对着冷掉的汤朝服务员投去不满的瞪视。

e.en: The critic wrote a famously {dyspeptic} review of the film.
e.zh: 那位评论家写了一篇出了名刻薄的影评。

e.en: Stroke patients often experience {dysphagia} during recovery.
e.zh: 中风患者在康复期间常会出现吞咽困难。

e.en: A speech therapist helped him manage his {dysphagia}.
e.zh: 言语治疗师帮助他控制吞咽障碍。

dysphonia.t: n. 发声困难，嗓音障碍

e.en: Teachers often develop {dysphonia} from constant lecturing.
e.zh: 老师常常因不停讲课而患上发音障碍。

e.en: Voice therapy can effectively treat chronic {dysphonia}.
e.zh: 嗓音治疗可以有效治疗慢性发音障碍。

dee.t: n. 字母 D；D 形物

daftest.t: a. 愚笨的, 癫狂的, 狂闹的

daintiest.t: a. 秀丽的；美味的；讲究的；挑剔的

daintier.t: a. 秀丽的；美味的；讲究的；挑剔的

dairymen.t: n. 牛奶场男工, 牛奶及乳品商人, 牛奶场主

dallied.t: vi. 戏耍, 玩弄, 闲混\nvt. 浪费

dampest.t:
n. 潮湿, 湿气
a. 潮湿的
vt. 使潮湿, 使阻尼, 抑止
vi. 变潮湿, 衰减

dandiest.t: n. 花花公子\na. 服装浮华的, 极好的

darkest.t: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊\na. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的

deadliest.t: a. 致命的, 致死的\nadv. 非常, 如死一般地

deadlier.t: a. 致命的, 致死的\nadv. 非常, 如死一般地

dearest.t:
n. 亲爱的人
a. 亲爱的, 昂贵的, 严重的, 急迫的
interj. 啊
adv. 深爱地, 高价地

decried.t: vt. 反对, 责难, 诽谤, 诋毁

deftest.t: a. 敏捷熟练的, 灵巧的

descried.t: vt. 看出, 看见, 发现

detoxified.t: vt. 使解毒\n[医] 解毒, 去毒

dicta.t: n. 声明, 格言, 法官意见\n[法] 宣言, 声明, 法官的意见

dilettanti.t: n. 业余爱好者\na. 外行的, 浅薄的

dimmest.t: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的\nvt. 使暗淡\n[计] 数据解释模块

dingiest.t: a. 暗淡的, 昏暗的, 邋遢的

dingier.t: a. 暗淡的, 昏暗的, 邋遢的

dirtiest.t: a. 肮脏的, 卑鄙的\nvt. 弄脏\nvi. 变脏

dirtier.t: a. 肮脏的, 卑鄙的\nvt. 弄脏\nvi. 变脏

dirtied.t: a. 肮脏的, 卑鄙的\nvt. 弄脏\nvi. 变脏

divvied.t: v. 分摊\nn. 分摊, 分配, 瓜分

dizzied.t: a. 晕眩的, 眼花缭乱的\nvt. 使晕眩

dizzier.t: a. 晕眩的, 眼花缭乱的\nvt. 使晕眩

domicils.t: n. 住所, 住宅\nv. (使)定居

dottier.t: a. 多点的, 愚蠢的, 薄弱的

doughtiest.t: a. 强悍的, 勇敢的, 刚强的

dowdiest.t: a. 过时的, 懒散的\nn. 懒散女人, 邋遢女人

dowdier.t: a. 过时的, 懒散的\nn. 懒散女人, 邋遢女人

drabbest.t: a. 土褐色的, 单调的

draughtsmen.t: n. 起草人, 打样人, 制图员, (正式)制图能手

dreamiest.t: a. 空幻的, 梦想的

dreamier.t: a. 空幻的, 梦想的

drowsier.t: a. 昏昏欲睡的\n[医] 倦睡的, 瞌睡的

driest.t:
a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的
vt. 把...弄干
vi. 变干
n. 干, 干涸

dullest.t: a. 钝的, 无趣的, 呆滞的, 阴暗的\nvt. 使迟钝, 使阴暗, 缓和\nvi. 变迟钝, 减少

dumbest.t: a. 哑的, 不说话的, 无声音的\n[医] 哑的

dummied.t: n. 傀儡, 假人, 仿制品\na. 虚设的, 假的, 名义上的

dumpier.t: a. 矮胖的, 粗短的

duskier.t: a. 微暗的, 暗淡的, 暗黑色的, 多黑影的, 黑黝黝的, 微黑色的, 忧郁的

dustmen.t: n. 清洁工人, 睡神

dustier.t: a. 灰尘多的, 无聊的, 含糊的, 粉末状的

dwelt.t: vi. 居住, 居住(于), 存在(于)

e.en: The poem follows a {dactylic} meter throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇采用扬抑抑格律。

e.en: She analyzed the {dactylic} rhythm of the verse.
e.zh: 她分析了诗句的扬抑抑节奏。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {dactylitis} in her fingers.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为手指指炎。

e.en: {Dactylitis} is common in psoriatic arthritis.
e.zh: 指炎在银屑病性关节炎中很常见。

e.en: He learned {dactylology} to communicate with his deaf cousin.
e.zh: 他学习手语以便和聋哑表弟交流。

e.en: {Dactylology} uses finger positions to spell words.
e.zh: 指语法用手指位置来拼写单词。

e.en: Modern forensics relies heavily on {dactyloscopy}.
e.zh: 现代法医学很依赖指纹鉴定。

e.en: {Dactyloscopy} helped identify the suspect.
e.zh: 指纹鉴定帮助确认了嫌疑人身份。

dad-blamed.t: 该死的；可恶的（委婉骂语）

e.en: That {dad-blamed} dog chewed my boots again.
e.zh: 那条该死的狗又啃了我的靴子。

e.en: Where's my {dad-blamed} hat?
e.zh: 我那顶该死的帽子哪儿去了？

e.en: {Dadaism} rejected logic and embraced absurdity.
e.zh: 达达主义反对逻辑，拥抱荒诞。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {Dadaism} in postwar art.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是战后艺术中的达达主义。

dadaistic.t: 达达主义的；荒诞反传统的

e.en: His collages had a clearly {dadaistic} flavor.
e.zh: 他的拼贴画带有明显的达达主义风格。

e.en: The performance was {dadaistic} and provocative.
e.zh: 那场表演充满达达主义色彩，挑衅意味浓厚。

daddled.t: 蹒跚走；摇摇晃晃地走（古旧词）

e.en: The toddler {daddled} across the lawn.
e.zh: 那个学步的小孩摇摇晃晃地穿过草坪。

e.en: He {daddled} home after one too many drinks.
e.zh: 他喝多后踉踉跄跄地走回家。

e.en: She came {daddling} down the path.
e.zh: 她沿着小径蹒跚走来。

e.en: Stop {daddling} and finish your work.
e.zh: 别再磨蹭了，把活儿干完。

e.en: A {daddy-long-legs} crawled up the wall.
e.zh: 一只长脚蜘蛛沿着墙爬了上去。

e.en: The kids screamed at the sight of a {daddy-long-legs}.
e.zh: 孩子们一看到长脚蜘蛛就尖叫起来。

e.en: A {daddy-longlegs} hung from the ceiling.
e.zh: 一只长脚蜘蛛吊在天花板上。

e.en: He gently moved the {daddy-longlegs} outside.
e.zh: 他轻轻把那只长脚蜘蛛挪到屋外。

e.en: Hey {daddy-o}, what's the plan tonight?
e.zh: 嘿，老兄，今晚什么安排？

e.en: Cool it, {daddy-o}, no need to rush.
e.zh: 冷静点，伙计，不用着急。

e.en: The clock had a {daedal} inner mechanism.
e.zh: 那座钟内部结构精巧复杂。

e.en: She admired the {daedal} carvings on the door.
e.zh: 她欣赏着门上精巧繁复的雕刻。

daemonic.t: 恶魔般的；受神灵驱使的

e.en: He played the role with a {daemonic} intensity.
e.zh: 他以恶魔般的张力诠释了这个角色。

e.en: There was something {daemonic} in her gaze.
e.zh: 她的目光中带着一丝恶魔般的神情。

e.en: Don't be such a {daff}, take it seriously.
e.zh: 别傻乎乎的，认真点。

e.en: The children {daff} about in the snow.
e.zh: 孩子们在雪地里嬉闹打趣。

e.en: She giggled {daffily} at the silly joke.
e.zh: 她对着那个傻笑话傻乎乎地咯咯笑。

e.en: He grinned {daffily} as he danced.
e.zh: 他一边跳舞一边傻乎乎地咧嘴笑。

e.en: He was caught smoking {dagga} in the park.
e.zh: 他被发现在公园里吸大麻。

e.en: {Dagga} is illegal to sell in many countries.
e.zh: 在许多国家，售卖大麻都是违法的。

e.en: The plant had {daggerlike} leaves.
e.zh: 那株植物长着匕首般的叶子。

e.en: She gave him a {daggerlike} stare.
e.zh: 她朝他投去匕首般锐利的目光。

dalesman.t: 山谷居民；尤指英格兰北部山谷的居民

e.en: The old {dalesman} knew every path on the moors.
e.zh: 这位年迈的山谷居民熟悉荒原上的每一条小径。

e.en: He spoke with the slow accent of a Yorkshire {dalesman}.
e.zh: 他说话带着约克郡山谷人特有的缓慢口音。

dalit.t: 达利特；印度种姓制度中的贱民

e.en: Many {Dalit} activists have fought for equal rights.
e.zh: 许多达利特活动人士为争取平等权利而奋斗。

e.en: She was the first {Dalit} woman elected to that office.
e.zh: 她是首位当选该职位的达利特女性。

e.en: The boss had no patience for any {dallier} on the team.
e.zh: 老板对团队里任何磨蹭的人都没有耐心。

e.en: He was known as a {dallier} who never finished tasks on time.
e.zh: 他是出了名的磨蹭鬼，从不按时完成任务。

dallisgrass.t: 达利斯草；一种多年生牧草

e.en: Cattle grazed on the lush {dallisgrass} in the pasture.
e.zh: 牛群在牧场上吃着茂密的达利斯草。

e.en: {Dallisgrass} can quickly take over poorly maintained lawns.
e.zh: 达利斯草会迅速侵占疏于打理的草坪。

dalmatic.t: 达尔马提卡；天主教执事所穿的宽袖法衣

e.en: The deacon wore a white {dalmatic} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 执事在典礼上穿着白色的达尔马提卡法衣。

e.en: Embroidered {dalmatics} were displayed in the cathedral museum.
e.zh: 绣花的达尔马提卡法衣陈列在大教堂博物馆里。

daltonian.t: 色盲的；道尔顿原子论的

e.en: He had {daltonian} vision and could not distinguish red from green.
e.zh: 他患有色盲，无法分辨红色和绿色。

e.en: The textbook explained the {daltonian} theory of atoms.
e.zh: 教科书讲解了道尔顿的原子学说。

e.en: {Daltonism} is named after the chemist John Dalton.
e.zh: 色盲症是以化学家约翰·道尔顿的名字命名的。

e.en: His {daltonism} made certain jobs impossible for him.
e.zh: 他的色盲使他无法从事某些工作。

e.en: Engineers tested the {damageability} of the new alloy.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种新合金的易损性。

e.en: The report assessed the {damageability} of structures during earthquakes.
e.zh: 报告评估了建筑物在地震中的易损性。

e.en: Please handle these {damageable} items with care.
e.zh: 请小心处理这些易损物品。

e.en: The shipment contained several {damageable} components.
e.zh: 这批货含有几件易损部件。

damaskeen.t: 在金属上镶嵌花纹；大马士革式雕饰

e.en: Skilled artisans {damaskeen} steel with gold thread.
e.zh: 熟练的工匠在钢上以金丝镶嵌花纹。

e.en: The sword's hilt was {damaskeened} with intricate designs.
e.zh: 剑柄上镶嵌着繁复的大马士革花纹。

damfool.t: 愚蠢的；该死的傻瓜（俚语）

e.en: That was a {damfool} thing to say in front of the boss.
e.zh: 在老板面前说那种话真是愚蠢。

e.en: Stop your {damfool} arguing and get to work.
e.zh: 别再争那些蠢话，赶紧干活。

damiana.t: 达米阿那；一种有药用价值的灌木

e.en: Some herbalists recommend {damiana} as a mild tonic.
e.zh: 一些草药师推荐达米阿那作为温和的滋补品。

e.en: {Damiana} leaves are sometimes brewed into tea.
e.zh: 达米阿那的叶子有时被冲泡成茶。

dammar.t: 达玛树脂；用于清漆的天然树脂

e.en: The painter mixed {dammar} varnish to protect the canvas.
e.zh: 画家调制达玛清漆以保护画布。

e.en: {Dammar} is harvested from trees in Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 达玛树脂采自东南亚的树木。

e.en: The preacher spoke of the {damnability} of greed.
e.zh: 传道人谈到贪婪的可憎。

e.en: Few denied the {damnability} of the regime's crimes.
e.zh: 几乎无人否认该政权罪行的可憎。

e.en: The judge issued a {damnatory} verdict against the company.
e.zh: 法官对该公司作出了定罪判决。

e.en: Critics wrote {damnatory} reviews of the new film.
e.zh: 评论家对这部新片写下了严厉抨击的评论。

damnification.t: 损害；招致损失（法律术语）

e.en: The contract addressed the {damnification} of either party.
e.zh: 合同处理了任一方所受的损害问题。

e.en: He sought legal remedy for the {damnification} of his property.
e.zh: 他就财产受损寻求法律救济。

e.en: The flood threatened to {damnify} the entire harvest.
e.zh: 洪水可能毁掉整季的收成。

e.en: Negligent acts may {damnify} third parties in serious ways.
e.zh: 过失行为可能严重损害第三方利益。

damoclean.t: 达摩克利斯式的；迫在眉睫的危险

e.en: The threat of layoffs hung over them like a {damoclean} sword.
e.zh: 裁员的威胁如达摩克利斯之剑般悬在他们头上。

e.en: He worked under a {damoclean} deadline all month.
e.zh: 整个月他都在迫在眉睫的截止期限下工作。

damoiselle.t: 少女；年轻女子（古语，等同于damsel）

e.en: The knight bowed to the young {damoiselle} at court.
e.zh: 骑士向宫廷里的年轻少女鞠躬致意。

e.en: Old ballads often feature a {damoiselle} in distress.
e.zh: 古老的歌谣常以落难少女为主角。

e.en: The poem describes a fair {damosel} by the river.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了河边一位美丽的少女。

e.en: In medieval romances, the {damosel} often awaits rescue.
e.zh: 在中世纪传奇中，少女常常等待被解救。

e.en: Rossetti's poem features a blessed {damozel} in heaven.
e.zh: 罗塞蒂的诗描绘了天堂里一位受福的少女。

e.en: The painting shows a {damozel} leaning over the golden bar.
e.zh: 画中一位少女斜倚在金色的栏杆上。

e.en: She prefers to {damp-dry} her shirts before ironing.
e.zh: 她喜欢把衬衫半干处理后再熨烫。

e.en: The towels were {damp-dried} and folded neatly.
e.zh: 毛巾被半干烘干后整齐叠好。

e.en: Seedlings often die from {damping-off} in wet soil.
e.zh: 幼苗常因土壤潮湿而患猝倒病死亡。

e.en: Good ventilation helps prevent {damping-off} in greenhouses.
e.zh: 良好通风有助于防止温室中的猝倒病。

e.en: The cellar felt cool and {dampish}.
e.zh: 地窖里凉飕飕，有点潮湿。

e.en: Her hair was still {dampish} from the rain.
e.zh: 她的头发被雨淋得还有点潮。

e.en: They installed a {dampproof} layer in the wall.
e.zh: 他们在墙里装了一层防潮层。

e.en: The basement needs a {dampproof} membrane.
e.zh: 地下室需要一层防潮膜。

e.en: The old farmer muttered about some {damyankee} tourists.
e.zh: 老农嘟囔着抱怨几个该死的北方佬游客。

e.en: He still calls northerners {damyankees} as a joke.
e.zh: 他还开玩笑地把北方人叫做该死的北方佬。

e.en: A small {dance-band} played at the wedding.
e.zh: 一支小型舞曲乐队在婚礼上演奏。

e.en: The {dance-band} struck up a lively waltz.
e.zh: 舞曲乐队奏起了一首欢快的华尔兹。

e.en: The company premiered a new {dance-drama} last night.
e.zh: 剧团昨晚首演了一部新的舞剧。

e.en: The {dance-drama} retells an ancient legend.
e.zh: 这部舞剧重述了一个古老的传说。

e.en: The two crews settled it with a {dance-off}.
e.zh: 两支舞队用一场斗舞决出了胜负。

e.en: She won the {dance-off} with a backflip.
e.zh: 她以一个后空翻赢得了斗舞比赛。

e.en: He led a famous {dance-orchestra} in the 1930s.
e.zh: 他在三十年代领衔一支著名的舞曲管弦乐团。

e.en: The hotel hired a {dance-orchestra} for New Year's Eve.
e.zh: 酒店为除夕夜请来了一支舞曲管弦乐团。

e.en: She moved with a {dancelike} grace.
e.zh: 她举手投足有一种舞蹈般的优雅。

e.en: The fighter's footwork was almost {dancelike}.
e.zh: 那位拳手的步法简直像舞蹈一样。

e.en: The old {dancery} had been turned into a café.
e.zh: 那间老舞厅已经改成了咖啡馆。

e.en: Couples crowded into the smoky {dancery}.
e.zh: 成对的男女挤进烟雾缭绕的舞厅。

e.en: The arch was carved with a bold {dancette}.
e.zh: 拱门上刻着醒目的齿形锯齿纹饰。

e.en: Norman doorways often feature a {dancette} pattern.
e.zh: 诺曼式门廊常以齿形锯齿纹为特色。

e.en: The shield bore a {dancetty} band of gold.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一条金色的齿形锯齿带。

e.en: Heralds described the line as {dancetty}.
e.zh: 纹章学家把那条线描述为齿形锯齿状。

e.en: A French {dancing-master} taught the children minuets.
e.zh: 一位法国舞蹈教师教孩子们跳小步舞。

e.en: The {dancing-master} clapped to keep the rhythm.
e.zh: 舞蹈教师拍手打着节拍。

e.en: He had a {dandiacal} fondness for silk waistcoats.
e.zh: 他像花花公子般偏爱丝绸马甲。

e.en: His {dandiacal} airs amused the rest of the office.
e.zh: 他那花花公子般的做派把办公室其他人都逗乐了。

e.en: This jacket is even {dandier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这件外套比上一件还要花哨。

e.en: He wore a {dandier} cravat for the photo.
e.zh: 他为拍照戴了一条更花哨的领巾。

e.en: His morning {dandification} took nearly an hour.
e.zh: 他每早把自己打扮得花枝招展要花将近一小时。

e.en: She mocked his careful {dandification}.
e.zh: 她取笑他那一丝不苟的精心打扮。

e.en: He arrived in a {dandified} velvet suit.
e.zh: 他穿着一身花哨的天鹅绒西装来了。

e.en: The {dandified} young clerk smelled of cologne.
e.zh: 那个打扮花哨的年轻职员身上一股古龙水味。

e.en: He {dandifies} himself before every dinner party.
e.zh: 他每次晚宴前都要把自己打扮得花枝招展。

e.en: She {dandifies} her son for the school photo.
e.zh: 她把儿子打扮得花枝招展去拍校园照。

e.en: He likes to {dandify} himself with bright bow ties.
e.zh: 他喜欢用鲜艳的领结把自己打扮得花哨。

e.en: Don't try to {dandify} a working uniform.
e.zh: 别把工作制服弄得花里胡哨。

e.en: He spent the morning {dandifying} his appearance.
e.zh: 他一上午都在精心打扮自己的外表。

e.en: She kept {dandifying} the boy until he squirmed.
e.zh: 她一直把那男孩打扮得花枝招展，直到他扭来扭去。

e.en: He was {dandily} dressed for the opera.
e.zh: 他为听歌剧打扮得十分花哨。

e.en: The plan worked out quite {dandily}.
e.zh: 事情进展得相当顺利漂亮。

e.en: Sit down, you cheeky little {dandiprat}!
e.zh: 坐下，你这个调皮的小不点儿！

e.en: The old man called the boy a {dandiprat}.
e.zh: 老人管那男孩叫小不点儿。

e.en: His dark jacket was flecked with {dandriff}.
e.zh: 他深色外套上沾着头皮屑。

e.en: This shampoo claims to remove {dandriff}.
e.zh: 这款洗发水声称能去除头皮屑。

e.en: His scalp felt itchy and {dandruffy}.
e.zh: 他的头皮又痒又有头皮屑。

e.en: She avoided his {dandruffy} dark sweater.
e.zh: 她躲开了他那件沾满头皮屑的深色毛衣。

e.en: The farmer wheeled milk in a {dandy-cart}.
e.zh: 农夫用轻便牛奶车推着牛奶。

e.en: An old {dandy-cart} stood in the barn corner.
e.zh: 谷仓角落里放着一辆旧式轻便牛奶车。

dandyism.t: 纨绔作风；花花公子习气

e.en: Wilde made {dandyism} into an art form.
e.zh: 王尔德把纨绔作风提升为一种艺术。

e.en: His {dandyism} masked a serious intellect.
e.zh: 他的纨绔做派掩盖了严肃的头脑。

e.en: {Danewort} grows along the old churchyard wall.
e.zh: 矮接骨木沿着老教堂墙边生长。

e.en: Herbalists once used {danewort} as a purgative.
e.zh: 草药师曾用矮接骨木作泻药。

e.en: The route looked perfectly {dangerless} on the map.
e.zh: 这条路线在地图上看起来毫无危险。

e.en: No mountain climb is entirely {dangerless}.
e.zh: 没有哪次登山是完全没有危险的。

e.en: The slope was covered in {dangle-berry} bushes.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了垂枝越橘的灌木。

e.en: Birds love the ripe {dangle-berry} fruit.
e.zh: 鸟儿爱吃成熟的垂枝越橘果实。

e.en: A pink {dangle-dolly} swung from the rearview mirror.
e.zh: 一只粉色挂饰玩偶在后视镜下摇晃。

e.en: He collected tacky {dangle-dollies} for his cab.
e.zh: 他给自己的出租车收集俗气的挂饰玩偶。

e.en: We picked {dangleberry} along the forest path.
e.zh: 我们沿着林间小路采垂枝越橘。

e.en: The {dangleberry} ripens in late summer.
e.zh: 垂枝越橘在夏末成熟。

e.en: She added {dangshen} to the chicken soup.
e.zh: 她在鸡汤里加了党参。

e.en: {Dangshen} is a common tonic in Chinese medicine.
e.zh: 党参是中药中常用的补品。

dark-adapted.t: 已适应黑暗的；暗适应的

e.en: Give your eyes ten minutes to become {dark-adapted} before stargazing.
e.zh: 观星前先让眼睛适应黑暗十分钟。

e.en: The {dark-adapted} retina is far more sensitive to faint light.
e.zh: 已适应黑暗的视网膜对微弱光线敏感得多。

dark-browed.t: 眉头紧锁的；面色阴沉的

e.en: The {dark-browed} stranger refused to speak.
e.zh: 那个面色阴沉的陌生人拒绝开口。

e.en: She looked up at her {dark-browed} father nervously.
e.zh: 她紧张地抬头看着眉头紧锁的父亲。

e.en: He wore a {dark-brown} leather jacket.
e.zh: 他穿着一件深棕色的皮夹克。

e.en: Her {dark-brown} eyes sparkled in the candlelight.
e.zh: 她深褐色的眼睛在烛光中闪烁。

e.en: Wear {dark-colored} clothes to hide stains.
e.zh: 穿深色衣服可以遮盖污渍。

e.en: The walls were painted in a {dark-colored} shade.
e.zh: 墙壁被漆成了深色调。

e.en: He chose a {dark-gray} suit for the interview.
e.zh: 他选了一套深灰色西装去面试。

e.en: {Dark-gray} clouds gathered over the mountains.
e.zh: 深灰色的云聚集在山顶上。

e.en: The forest was a sea of {dark-green} pines.
e.zh: 森林是一片深绿色的松树海。

e.en: She wrapped herself in a {dark-green} shawl.
e.zh: 她裹上一条墨绿色的披肩。

e.en: The sky turned a heavy {dark-grey}.
e.zh: 天空变成了沉沉的深灰色。

e.en: He prefers {dark-grey} over black for trousers.
e.zh: 裤子他更喜欢深灰色而非黑色。

e.en: She emerged as the {dark-horse} candidate.
e.zh: 她成为了爆冷的候选人。

e.en: Watch out for the {dark-horse} in the final round.
e.zh: 小心决赛中的那匹黑马。

e.en: The skies began to {darkle} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天色开始变暗。

e.en: His mood seemed to {darkle} as evening fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时，他的心情似乎也阴郁起来。

e.en: They wandered through a {darksome} wood.
e.zh: 他们在一片幽暗的森林中漫步。

e.en: A {darksome} silence filled the old hall.
e.zh: 一种阴森的寂静充满了那座古老的厅堂。

darlin.t: 亲爱的（darling 的口语缩写）

e.en: Hey {darlin}, could you pass the salt?
e.zh: 嘿亲爱的，能把盐递给我吗？

e.en: Don't worry about it, {darlin}.
e.zh: 别担心，亲爱的。

e.en: {Darmstadtium} was first synthesized in 1994.
e.zh: 𫟼于1994年首次被人工合成。

e.en: Only a few atoms of {darmstadtium} have ever been produced.
e.zh: 迄今为止只制造出了几个𫟼原子。

e.en: The farmer pulled up clumps of {darnel} from the wheat.
e.zh: 农夫从麦子里拔起一丛丛毒麦。

e.en: Ancient texts warn against mistaking {darnel} for grain.
e.zh: 古籍警告不要把毒麦误当作谷物。

e.en: Pilgrims waited hours for a moment of {darshan}.
e.zh: 朝圣者等了几个小时，只为瞻仰一刻。

e.en: She traveled to the temple to receive {darshan}.
e.zh: 她前往寺庙以求得瞻仰之福。

e.en: Minnows {dartle} through the shallow stream.
e.zh: 小鱼在浅溪中飞快地来回穿梭。

e.en: Her eyes seemed to {dartle} from face to face.
e.zh: 她的目光似乎在一张张脸上闪动。

daruma.t: 达摩不倒翁（日本传统祈愿玩偶）

e.en: He painted in one eye of the {daruma} when he made his wish.
e.zh: 许愿时他给那个达摩不倒翁画上了一只眼睛。

e.en: A red {daruma} sat on the shelf for good luck.
e.zh: 架子上摆着一个红色的达摩不倒翁，以求好运。

e.en: They boiled {dasheen} as a side dish.
e.zh: 他们把芋头煮熟当作配菜。

e.en: {Dasheen} grows well in tropical soils.
e.zh: 芋头在热带土壤中长势良好。

e.en: He bought custom {dashmats} for his old truck.
e.zh: 他给那辆旧卡车买了定制的仪表台垫。

e.en: {Dashmats} help keep the dashboard from cracking in the sun.
e.zh: 仪表台垫能防止仪表板被太阳晒裂。

e.en: The engineer replaced a worn-out {dashpot} on the door.
e.zh: 工程师更换了门上磨损的缓冲器。

e.en: A hydraulic {dashpot} smooths the valve's motion.
e.zh: 液压缓冲器使阀门的动作变得平稳。

e.en: The machine uses two {dashpots} to dampen vibration.
e.zh: 这台机器用两个缓冲器来减振。

e.en: Old {dashpots} can leak oil over time.
e.zh: 老旧的缓冲器随时间可能漏油。

e.en: He cut a {dashy} figure in his new coat.
e.zh: 他穿着新外套，显得潇洒倜傥。

e.en: She gave him a {dashy} smile and walked off.
e.zh: 她俏皮地一笑，转身走了。

e.en: A {dassie} sunned itself on the rocky ledge.
e.zh: 一只蹄兔在岩石平台上晒太阳。

e.en: Tourists often spot {dassie} on Table Mountain.
e.zh: 游客常在桌山上看到蹄兔。

e.en: The villain's {dastardliness} shocked even his allies.
e.zh: 反派的卑鄙连他的同伙都感到震惊。

e.en: She condemned the {dastardliness} of the attack.
e.zh: 她谴责这次袭击的卑鄙。

daggings.t: 羊身上沾粪的脏毛；剪下的污毛

e.en: The shearer trimmed the {daggings} away first.
e.zh: 剪羊毛工先把脏毛剪掉。

e.en: Buyers won't pay top price for fleece full of {daggings}.
e.zh: 满是脏毛的羊毛卖不上好价钱。

daggle.t: 拖泥带水地走；将衣物拖脏

e.en: Don't {daggle} your skirt in the puddles.
e.zh: 别让裙子在水洼里拖得又湿又脏。

e.en: Children love to {daggle} through wet grass.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢拖着脚穿过湿草地。

daggled.t: 拖湿弄脏；沾染泥水（过去式）

e.en: Her hem {daggled} along the muddy path.
e.zh: 她的裙摆沿着泥泞小路拖得湿脏。

e.en: The dog {daggled} its tail through the puddle.
e.zh: 狗把尾巴拖过水洼弄得湿漉漉的。

daggling.t: 拖在泥水里走；衣物拖湿沾泥

e.en: She arrived with her dress {daggling} in the mud.
e.zh: 她到的时候裙子还在泥里拖着。

e.en: He came in {daggling} water all over the floor.
e.zh: 他进门时把水拖了一地。

daggy.t: 邋遢的；土气的；不入流的

e.en: He turned up wearing his {daggy} old jumper.
e.zh: 他穿着那件邋遢的旧毛衣来了。

e.en: That hairstyle looks a bit {daggy} now.
e.zh: 那个发型现在看起来有点土气。

e.en: The farmer cut a {daglock} off the ewe's hindquarters.
e.zh: 农夫从母羊后腿剪下一团脏毛。

e.en: Wool full of {daglock} clumps fetches a low price.
e.zh: 满是脏结毛的羊毛卖不上价。

dagoba.t: 佛塔；舍利塔（斯里兰卡式）

e.en: We visited an ancient {dagoba} in Sri Lanka.
e.zh: 我们参观了斯里兰卡的一座古佛塔。

e.en: Pilgrims circled the white {dagoba} at dawn.
e.zh: 朝圣者黎明时绕白色舍利塔行走。

daguerreotypy.t: 银版照相术；早期摄影技艺

e.en: He studied {daguerreotypy} in the 1840s.
e.zh: 他在1840年代学习银版照相术。

e.en: Early {daguerreotypy} required very long exposure times.
e.zh: 早期的银版照相术需要长时间曝光。

dahllite.t: 达勒石（一种磷酸钙矿物）

e.en: Geologists identified {dahllite} in the cave deposits.
e.zh: 地质学家在洞穴沉积物中发现达勒石。

e.en: {Dahllite} occurs in some bone and tooth minerals.
e.zh: 达勒石存在于某些骨骼和牙齿矿物中。

e.en: {Dahoon} grows wild in Florida wetlands.
e.zh: 达洪冬青野生于佛罗里达湿地。

e.en: Birds eat the red berries of the {dahoon}.
e.zh: 鸟类啄食达洪冬青的红色浆果。

e.en: Don't {daidle} on your way home.
e.zh: 回家路上别磨蹭。

e.en: The children {daidled} by the burn for hours.
e.zh: 孩子们在小溪边晃了好几个小时。

e.en: Soy products contain {daidzein} and other isoflavones.
e.zh: 大豆制品含有大豆苷元等异黄酮。

e.en: Researchers studied {daidzein}'s effects on bone density.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了大豆苷元对骨密度的影响。

e.en: {Daidzin} converts to daidzein during digestion.
e.zh: 大豆苷在消化过程中转化为大豆苷元。

e.en: The extract was rich in {daidzin}.
e.zh: 该提取物富含大豆苷。

e.en: The {daimio} ruled a vast feudal domain.
e.zh: 这位大名统治着广阔的封建领地。

e.en: Loyal samurai served the {daimio} faithfully.
e.zh: 忠诚的武士尽心侍奉大名。

daimios.t: 大名（日本封建领主，复数）

e.en: The {daimios} gathered at Edo Castle each year.
e.zh: 各位大名每年在江户城聚集。

e.en: Many {daimios} pledged loyalty to the shogun.
e.zh: 许多大名向将军宣誓效忠。

daimon.t: 守护神；内在精灵（希腊语）

e.en: Socrates spoke of his inner {daimon}.
e.zh: 苏格拉底谈到他内心的守护神。

e.en: The poet credited his {daimon} for inspiration.
e.zh: 诗人把灵感归功于他的内在精灵。

daimonic.t: 受神灵驱使的；具有内在激情的

e.en: Her {daimonic} energy drove every project forward.
e.zh: 她那种神灵附体般的能量推动着每个项目。

e.en: He described art as a {daimonic} force.
e.zh: 他把艺术描述为一种神灵般的力量。

daimyo.t: 大名（日本封建时代的领主）

e.en: The {daimyo} commanded thousands of samurai.
e.zh: 那位大名统领着数千名武士。

e.en: Each {daimyo} maintained his own castle and army.
e.zh: 每位大名都拥有自己的城堡和军队。

dainter.t: 更精致的；更娇美的（古英语比较级）

e.en: Her vase is even {dainter} than the rest.
e.zh: 她的花瓶比其他的还要精致。

e.en: This china cup looks {dainter} than the antique one.
e.zh: 这只瓷杯看起来比那件古董还要精致。

daintest.t: 最精致的；最娇美的（古英语最高级）

e.en: She wore the {daintest} slippers I had ever seen.
e.zh: 她穿着我见过最精致的拖鞋。

e.en: It was the {daintest} bouquet on the entire table.
e.zh: 那是整张桌子上最精致的花束。

daintiness.t: 精致优雅；娇小秀气；雅致

e.en: Her movements had a remarkable {daintiness}.
e.zh: 她的动作有种非凡的秀气。

e.en: I admired the {daintiness} of the handmade lace.
e.zh: 我赞叹手工蕾丝的精致。

e.en: The {dairywoman} milked the cows at sunrise.
e.zh: 女奶农在日出时挤牛奶。

e.en: She worked as a {dairywoman} for forty years.
e.zh: 她当了四十年女奶农。

dairywomen.t: 女奶农；女乳品工人（复数）

e.en: Several {dairywomen} ran the farm together.
e.zh: 几位女奶农一起经营农场。

e.en: The {dairywomen} churned butter every morning.
e.zh: 女奶农们每天早上搅黄油。

daishiki.t: 达西基（西非传统宽松上衣）

e.en: He wore a colorful {daishiki} to the festival.
e.zh: 他穿着色彩鲜艳的达西基去参加节日。

e.en: The market sold handmade {daishiki} shirts.
e.zh: 市场上卖手工制作的达西基衫。

daisied.t: 开满雏菊的；点缀着雏菊的

e.en: We picnicked in a {daisied} meadow.
e.zh: 我们在开满雏菊的草地上野餐。

e.en: Children ran across the {daisied} lawn.
e.zh: 孩子们跑过开满雏菊的草坪。

e.en: Letters arrived by {dak} from Calcutta.
e.zh: 信件经驿站从加尔各答送达。

e.en: They traveled by {dak} across the dusty plains.
e.zh: 他们坐驿车穿越尘土飞扬的平原。

e.en: Travelers feared the {dakoit} bands in the hills.
e.zh: 旅行者害怕山里的武装强盗团伙。

e.en: Police captured a notorious {dakoit} yesterday.
e.zh: 警方昨天抓获一名臭名昭著的土匪。

e.en: Anatomists measure from the {dakryon} to the nasion.
e.zh: 解剖学家从泪点量到鼻根点。

e.en: The skull's {dakryon} marks a key craniometric landmark.
e.zh: 头骨的泪点是重要的颅骨测量标志。

e.en: We squeezed onto a crowded {dala-dala} to Arusha.
e.zh: 我们挤上一辆开往阿鲁沙的拥挤小巴。

e.en: The {dala-dala} stopped at every village along the way.
e.zh: 那辆小巴沿途每个村庄都停。

dawg.t: 哥们；老兄（俚语，朋友间的称呼）

e.en: What's up, {dawg}? Long time no see.
e.zh: 哥们最近怎么样？好久不见了。

e.en: My {dawg} always has my back when things get rough.
e.zh: 我兄弟在我遇到麻烦时总是挺我。

dawn-to-dusk.t: 从黎明到黄昏的；全天的

e.en: Farmers often work {dawn-to-dusk} during harvest season.
e.zh: 收获季节里农民常常从早干到晚。

e.en: The festival featured a {dawn-to-dusk} schedule of performances.
e.zh: 这个节日安排了从清晨到傍晚的全天演出。

day-boarder.t: 走读生（在校用餐但不住宿）

e.en: As a {day-boarder}, she ate lunch at school but went home each evening.
e.zh: 作为走读生，她在学校吃午饭，但每晚回家。

e.en: The school accepts both boarders and {day-boarders}.
e.zh: 这所学校同时招收住校生和走读生。

e.en: Her health improved on a {day-by-day} basis.
e.zh: 她的健康状况一天天好转。

e.en: We tracked the project's progress {day-by-day}.
e.zh: 我们逐日跟踪项目的进展。

e.en: They enrolled their toddler in a {day-care} centre nearby.
e.zh: 他们把幼儿送到附近的日托中心。

e.en: Quality {day-care} can be expensive in big cities.
e.zh: 在大城市，优质的日托服务费用不菲。

day-dreamer.t: 爱做白日梦的人；空想者

e.en: His teacher called him a hopeless {day-dreamer}.
e.zh: 老师说他是个无可救药的白日梦想家。

e.en: Even a {day-dreamer} sometimes turns ideas into reality.
e.zh: 就连一个空想者有时也能把想法变成现实。

e.en: He worked as a {day-labourer} on construction sites.
e.zh: 他在工地上做按日计酬的散工。

e.en: Many {day-labourers} gather at the corner each morning.
e.zh: 许多日工每天清晨在街角聚集。

day-neutral.t: 日中性的（不受日照长短影响开花的）

e.en: These {day-neutral} strawberries fruit throughout the season.
e.zh: 这些日中性草莓整个季节都能结果。

e.en: Breeders developed a {day-neutral} variety for year-round harvest.
e.zh: 育种者培育出一种可全年收获的日中性品种。

day-room.t: 日间活动室；公共休息室

e.en: Patients gathered in the {day-room} to watch television.
e.zh: 病人们聚集在日间活动室看电视。

e.en: The hostel's {day-room} is open until midnight.
e.zh: 旅舍的公共休息室开放到午夜。

e.en: She prefers a {day-school} to a boarding school.
e.zh: 比起寄宿学校，她更喜欢走读学校。

e.en: The local {day-school} has a strong music programme.
e.zh: 当地的走读学校有很强的音乐课程。

e.en: Owls sleep during the {day-time} and hunt at night.
e.zh: 猫头鹰白天睡觉，夜里捕食。

e.en: This medication may cause {day-time} drowsiness.
e.zh: 这种药可能会让人白天犯困。

e.en: She handles the {day-to-day} running of the office.
e.zh: 她负责办公室的日常运作。

e.en: On a {day-to-day} basis, things rarely change much.
e.zh: 日复一日地看，情况很少有大变化。

day-trade.t: 日内交易；当日买卖股票

e.en: He quit his job to {day-trade} stocks full-time.
e.zh: 他辞了工作，全职做股票日内交易。

e.en: It's risky to {day-trade} without a clear strategy.
e.zh: 没有清晰策略就做日内交易风险很大。

day-trip.t: 一日游；当天往返的旅行

e.en: We took a {day-trip} to the coast last Saturday.
e.zh: 上周六我们去海边一日游。

e.en: The town is perfect for a {day-trip} from the city.
e.zh: 这个小镇非常适合从城里出发的一日游。

e.en: The village fills with {day-trippers} every weekend.
e.zh: 这个村子每个周末都挤满了一日游游客。

e.en: Most visitors here are {day-trippers} from the capital.
e.zh: 这里的游客大多是从首都来的一日游客。

e.en: Crowds of {day-trippers} flooded the seaside town.
e.zh: 成群的一日游客涌入了这座海滨小城。

e.en: Local cafés rely heavily on summer {day-trippers}.
e.zh: 当地咖啡馆很依赖夏季的一日游客。

e.en: The agency organises {day-trips} to nearby vineyards.
e.zh: 这家旅行社组织前往附近酒庄的一日游。

e.en: We made several {day-trips} during our holiday.
e.zh: 假期里我们安排了好几次一日游。

day-worker.t: 日间工作者；按日计酬的工人

e.en: As a {day-worker}, he earned cash at the end of each shift.
e.zh: 作为日工，他每班结束就领现金。

e.en: The farm hires {day-workers} during the picking season.
e.zh: 农场在采摘季雇用日工。

dayboy.t: 走读男生（学校不住宿的男学生）

e.en: He was a {dayboy} at the local grammar school.
e.zh: 他在当地文法学校做走读生。

e.en: Boarders and {dayboys} mixed easily during lessons.
e.zh: 住校生和走读男生在课堂上相处得很融洽。

daydreamlike.t: 如白日梦般的；恍惚虚幻的

e.en: The film has a {daydreamlike} quality that mesmerises viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影有一种白日梦般的特质，让观众着迷。

e.en: She drifted through the afternoon in a {daydreamlike} haze.
e.zh: 她在恍惚如梦的状态里度过了整个下午。

daydreamy.t: 爱做白日梦的；恍惚出神的

e.en: He had a {daydreamy} look during the long lecture.
e.zh: 在冗长的讲座中他一副出神发呆的样子。

e.en: Her {daydreamy} sketches filled the back of every notebook.
e.zh: 她那些充满白日梦气息的涂鸦塞满了每本笔记本的后面。

dayflower.t: 鸭跖草（一种花朵只开一天的植物）

e.en: The {dayflower}'s blue petals last only a single morning.
e.zh: 鸭跖草的蓝色花瓣只能维持一个清晨。

e.en: Wild {dayflowers} bloomed along the riverbank.
e.zh: 河岸边盛开着野生鸭跖草。

dayfly.t: 蜉蝣（成虫寿命极短的昆虫）

e.en: A {dayfly} lives only a few hours as an adult.
e.zh: 蜉蝣成虫只能存活几小时。

e.en: Trout feed eagerly on swarms of {dayflies}.
e.zh: 鳟鱼热衷于捕食成群的蜉蝣。

daygirl.t: 走读女生（学校不住宿的女学生）

e.en: She enrolled as a {daygirl} at the boarding school.
e.zh: 她在那所寄宿学校以走读女生身份注册。

e.en: The {daygirls} went home as soon as classes ended.
e.zh: 走读女生们一下课就回家了。

dankest.t: 最阴冷潮湿的；最酷的（俚语）

e.en: These are the {dankest} memes I've seen all week.
e.zh: 这是我这周看过最酷的迷因。

e.en: We crawled through the {dankest} corner of the cellar.
e.zh: 我们爬过地窖里最阴冷潮湿的角落。

e.en: The {dankish} air clung to our skin in the old crypt.
e.zh: 古墓里略带阴湿的空气黏在我们皮肤上。

e.en: She wrinkled her nose at the {dankish} smell of the basement.
e.zh: 她对地下室那股略带霉味的气息皱起鼻子。

e.en: The leading {danseur} leapt across the stage with effortless grace.
e.zh: 首席男芭蕾舞者轻盈地跃过舞台。

e.en: Every aspiring {danseur} dreams of partnering a prima ballerina.
e.zh: 每位有抱负的男舞者都梦想与首席女舞者搭档。

e.en: The {danseuse} held her arabesque for what seemed like minutes.
e.zh: 这位女芭蕾舞者将阿拉贝斯克姿势保持了仿佛数分钟之久。

e.en: Critics praised the young {danseuse} for her expressive footwork.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这位年轻女舞者富有表现力的脚下功夫。

dant.t: 制服；驯服；克制（古语动词）

e.en: The knight sought to {dant} the wild beast of the forest.
e.zh: 骑士试图制服森林中的野兽。

e.en: Naught could {dant} her fierce resolve.
e.zh: 没有什么能动摇她坚定的决心。

dao.t: 道；道家学说中的根本原理

e.en: He spent years studying the {dao} with mountain hermits.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间跟山中隐士研习道。

e.en: The book explains how to live in harmony with the {dao}.
e.zh: 这本书阐述了如何与道和谐共处。

dap.t: 轻触水面钓鱼；碰拳问候

e.en: He {dapped} his fly gently onto the surface of the trout stream.
e.zh: 他把假饵轻轻点在鳟鱼溪的水面上。

e.en: The two old friends {dapped} fists before sitting down.
e.zh: 两位老朋友坐下前互相碰了碰拳头。

dapperest.t: 最整洁潇洒的；最帅气利落的

e.en: He was easily the {dapperest} guest at the reception.
e.zh: 他无疑是招待会上最潇洒整洁的客人。

e.en: Even on weekends he remained the {dapperest} man in the office.
e.zh: 即便在周末，他仍是办公室里最帅气利落的人。

dapperling.t: 小白伞菌；矮小整洁之人

e.en: We spotted a tiny {dapperling} growing under the oak tree.
e.zh: 我们在橡树下发现一朵小小的白伞菌。

e.en: The boy stood there like a proud little {dapperling} in his suit.
e.zh: 男孩穿着西装，像个神气的小绅士站在那里。

dapping.t: 蜻蜓点水钓法；轻点钓法

e.en: Trout fishermen swear by {dapping} on breezy summer afternoons.
e.zh: 鳟鱼钓手深信夏日有风的午后用蜻蜓点水钓法最有效。

e.en: He learned {dapping} from his grandfather on the Irish loughs.
e.zh: 他在爱尔兰湖边跟祖父学会了蜻蜓点水钓法。

e.en: She rode a beautiful {dapple-gray} mare through the meadow.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹漂亮的灰斑母马穿过草地。

e.en: The knight's {dapple-gray} stallion drew every eye.
e.zh: 骑士的灰斑公马吸引了所有人的目光。

dapple-grey.t: 灰斑的；灰色斑纹（英式拼法）

e.en: A handsome {dapple-grey} pony stood by the fence.
e.zh: 一匹英俊的灰斑小马站在栅栏边。

e.en: He bought a {dapple-grey} hunter at the autumn sale.
e.zh: 他在秋季拍卖会上买下一匹灰斑猎马。

dappled-gray.t: 带灰色斑点的；灰斑（毛色）

e.en: A {dappled-gray} horse trotted up the dusty road.
e.zh: 一匹带灰色斑点的马沿着尘土飞扬的路小跑过来。

e.en: She painted the {dappled-gray} foal grazing in the field.
e.zh: 她画下那只在田野上吃草的带灰斑小马驹。

e.en: That new car of his is a real {darb}.
e.zh: 他那辆新车真是个好家伙。

e.en: The hat she wore to the party was a {darb}.
e.zh: 她戴去派对的帽子简直是极品。

e.en: The constable clapped the {darbies} on the thief.
e.zh: 警察给小偷戴上了手铐。

e.en: He rattled the {darbies} on his wrists in frustration.
e.zh: 他懊恼地晃动腕上的镣铐。

dare-devil.t: 鲁莽冒失的人；爱冒险者

e.en: That little {dare-devil} climbed onto the roof again.
e.zh: 那个小冒失鬼又爬到屋顶上去了。

e.en: The {dare-devil} pilot flew under the bridge for fun.
e.zh: 这位爱冒险的飞行员为了好玩从桥下飞过。

daredevilry.t: 鲁莽冒险行为；玩命之举

e.en: His teenage {daredevilry} on the motorbike worried his parents.
e.zh: 他青少年时期骑摩托车的鲁莽行径令父母担心。

e.en: The crowd gasped at the acrobat's sheer {daredevilry}.
e.zh: 观众惊叹于杂技演员极度大胆的玩命之举。

e.en: She made a career out of cinematic {daredeviltry}.
e.zh: 她以电影中的玩命特技为职业。

e.en: Their reckless {daredeviltry} on the cliffs ended badly.
e.zh: 他们在悬崖上的鲁莽冒险行径以悲剧收场。

e.en: He spoke with a {dareful} tongue before the king.
e.zh: 他在国王面前言辞大胆。

e.en: Only a {dareful} heart would venture into that forest.
e.zh: 唯有勇敢之心才敢闯入那片森林。

darg.t: 一日工作量（苏格兰方言）

e.en: He earned a fair wage for an honest day's {darg}.
e.zh: 他凭一日辛勤劳作挣得了应得的工钱。

e.en: After a long {darg} in the fields, the farmer collapsed by the fire.
e.zh: 在田里劳作了一整天后，农夫瘫坐在炉火旁。

e.en: The mountains shimmered in the soft {dayglow}.
e.zh: 群山在柔和的日辉中闪烁。

e.en: A faint {dayglow} lingered after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后还残留着一丝微弱的日辉。

e.en: They held a {daylong} conference on climate.
e.zh: 他们举办了为期一整天的气候会议。

e.en: The {daylong} rain finally stopped at dusk.
e.zh: 持续整日的雨终于在黄昏停了。

daymare.t: 白日噩梦；清醒时的梦魇

e.en: The traffic jam felt like a {daymare}.
e.zh: 那场堵车感觉像一场白日噩梦。

e.en: She woke from a strange {daymare} at noon.
e.zh: 她中午从一场奇怪的白日噩梦中惊醒。

e.en: The {dayside} of Mercury is scorching hot.
e.zh: 水星的向阳面酷热难当。

e.en: Sensors recorded temperatures on the planet's {dayside}.
e.zh: 传感器记录了行星向阳面的温度。

e.en: They sought a {daysman} to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 他们找了一位仲裁人来解决纠纷。

e.en: No {daysman} could reconcile the two sides.
e.zh: 没有调解者能让双方和解。

e.en: They set off at the {dayspring}.
e.zh: 他们在破晓时分出发。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {dayspring} of hope.
e.zh: 那首诗歌颂希望的黎明。

e.en: The {daystar} rose above the eastern hills.
e.zh: 启明星升起在东边的山岭之上。

e.en: Ancient poets called the sun the {daystar}.
e.zh: 古代诗人把太阳称作启明星。

e.en: The town is full of {daytrippers} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天小镇里满是一日游游客。

e.en: Most visitors are {daytrippers} from the city.
e.zh: 大多数游客是来自城里的一日游客人。

e.en: The brand specialises in elegant {daywear}.
e.zh: 该品牌专做优雅的日间便服。

e.en: She prefers comfortable {daywear} for the office.
e.zh: 她上班喜欢穿舒适的日装。
