e.en: He earned a living through hard {daywork}.
e.zh: 他靠辛苦的日工谋生。

e.en: The crew was hired on {daywork} terms.
e.zh: 工人是按日工方式雇用的。

e.en: The neon signs were {dazzly} at midnight.
e.zh: 霓虹灯在午夜里耀眼夺目。

e.en: She wore a {dazzly} sequined dress.
e.zh: 她穿着一件闪烁夺目的亮片连衣裙。

e.en: The museum decided to {de-accession} several paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆决定将几幅画从馆藏中除名。

e.en: Curators rarely {de-accession} items without review.
e.zh: 策展人很少不经审查就撤除馆藏。

e.en: The pump is used to {de-aerate} the water.
e.zh: 这台泵用来给水除气。

e.en: You must {de-aerate} the resin before pouring.
e.zh: 在浇注之前必须给树脂除气。

de-atomized.t: 去原子化的；解原子化的

e.en: The team studied {de-atomized} metal particles.
e.zh: 团队研究了去原子化的金属颗粒。

e.en: He wrote about a {de-atomized} community life.
e.zh: 他撰文探讨一种去原子化的社区生活。

e.en: Some farms still {de-beak} laying hens.
e.zh: 一些农场仍会给蛋鸡切喙。

e.en: Welfare laws restrict how chicks may be {de-beaked}.
e.zh: 动物福利法限制了切除雏鸡喙尖的方式。

de-brief.t: 任务后听取汇报；询问情况

e.en: The pilots will {de-brief} after the mission.
e.zh: 飞行员将在任务后接受汇报问询。

e.en: We {de-brief} the team every Friday.
e.zh: 我们每周五都给团队做事后汇报。

e.en: The {de-briefing} lasted nearly two hours.
e.zh: 这次任务后汇报持续了将近两个小时。

e.en: A thorough {de-briefing} followed the operation.
e.zh: 行动结束后进行了一次彻底的情况汇报。

e.en: The plan aims to {de-centralise} decision-making.
e.zh: 该计划旨在使决策权分散。

e.en: They want to {de-centralise} the network.
e.zh: 他们想让这个网络去中心化。

e.en: The reforms {de-centralize} authority across regions.
e.zh: 这些改革把权力分散到各个地区。

e.en: They moved to {de-centralize} the company's structure.
e.zh: 他们着手让公司架构去中心化。

e.en: Many vets refuse to {de-claw} cats.
e.zh: 许多兽医拒绝给猫做去爪手术。

e.en: Some cities have banned the practice of {de-clawing}.
e.zh: 一些城市已禁止给猫去爪的做法。

de-clutch.t: 分离离合器；松开离合器

e.en: You must {de-clutch} before changing gears.
e.zh: 换挡前必须先分离离合器。

e.en: He learned to {de-clutch} smoothly on hills.
e.zh: 他学会了在坡道上平稳地松离合器。

e.en: The navy will {de-commission} the old vessel.
e.zh: 海军将让那艘旧舰艇退役。

e.en: Plans were drawn to {de-commission} the reactor.
e.zh: 已制定计划让这座反应堆退役。

e.en: Engineers tried to {de-couple} the two systems.
e.zh: 工程师试图让两个系统脱钩。

e.en: They want to {de-couple} growth from emissions.
e.zh: 他们希望让经济增长与排放脱钩。

e.en: Some cells can {de-differentiate} into stem cells.
e.zh: 某些细胞能去分化为干细胞。

e.en: Researchers learned to {de-differentiate} mature tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员学会让成熟组织去分化。

e.en: The biopsy showed {de-differentiated} tumor cells.
e.zh: 活检显示出已去分化的肿瘤细胞。

e.en: They cultured {de-differentiated} cells in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室培养了去分化的细胞。

e.en: The school decided to {de-emphasise} standardised tests.
e.zh: 学校决定淡化标准化考试。

e.en: Coaches {de-emphasise} winning at this age.
e.zh: 教练在这个年龄段淡化输赢。

e.en: The new policy {de-emphasises} rote learning.
e.zh: 新政策淡化死记硬背。

e.en: Her teaching style {de-emphasises} grades.
e.zh: 她的教学方式淡化分数。

e.en: The report {de-emphasizes} short-term profits.
e.zh: 该报告淡化了短期利润。

e.en: His speech {de-emphasizes} party loyalty.
e.zh: 他的演讲淡化了党派忠诚。

e.en: Always {de-energise} the circuit before repairs.
e.zh: 维修前务必先给线路断电。

e.en: The technician will {de-energise} the panel.
e.zh: 技术员会给配电盘断电。

e.en: The mediator tried to {de-escalate} the conflict.
e.zh: 调解员设法缓和冲突。

e.en: Officers are trained to {de-escalate} tense situations.
e.zh: 警官受训以缓和紧张局面。

e.en: Talks {de-escalated} the border tension.
e.zh: 会谈缓和了边境紧张局势。

e.en: The crisis was finally {de-escalated} last night.
e.zh: 这场危机昨晚终于得到缓和。

e.en: A calm tone often {de-escalates} an argument.
e.zh: 平和的语气常能让争吵缓和下来。

e.en: The agreement {de-escalates} the trade dispute.
e.zh: 该协议缓和了这场贸易争端。

e.en: Both sides called for {de-escalation}.
e.zh: 双方都呼吁局势缓和。

e.en: The treaty marked a clear {de-escalation}.
e.zh: 该条约标志着明显的局势缓和。

e.en: He proposed several {de-escalatory} measures.
e.zh: 他提出了几项缓和性措施。

e.en: The speech struck a {de-escalatory} tone.
e.zh: 那篇讲话定下了缓和的基调。

e.en: Chefs {de-fat} the broth before serving.
e.zh: 厨师在上汤前先去除脂肪。

e.en: You can {de-fat} the gravy by chilling it.
e.zh: 你可以把肉汁冷藏后再脱脂。

e.en: Ranchers often {de-horn} young calves to prevent injuries.
e.zh: 牧场主常给小牛去角以防受伤。

e.en: The vet was hired to {de-horn} the herd safely.
e.zh: 兽医受雇为牛群安全去角。

e.en: Crews worked all night to {de-ice} the runways.
e.zh: 机组人员通宵为跑道除冰。

e.en: You should {de-ice} the windshield before driving.
e.zh: 开车前你应该把挡风玻璃上的冰除掉。

e.en: Spray some {de-icer} on the frozen lock.
e.zh: 在冻住的锁上喷些除冰剂。

e.en: The plane's {de-icer} prevented ice buildup on the wings.
e.zh: 飞机的除冰装置防止机翼结冰。

e.en: Recyclers must {de-ink} old newspapers before pulping.
e.zh: 回收商在制浆前必须给旧报纸脱墨。

e.en: The mill uses chemicals to {de-ink} recovered paper.
e.zh: 工厂使用化学药剂为回收纸脱墨。

e.en: The lab uses resin filters to {de-ionate} tap water.
e.zh: 实验室用树脂过滤器对自来水进行去离子处理。

e.en: You must {de-ionate} the solution before the experiment.
e.zh: 实验前你必须将溶液去离子化。

de-leveraging.t: 去杠杆化；降低负债比率

e.en: Banks began {de-leveraging} after the financial crisis.
e.zh: 金融危机后,各银行开始去杠杆化。

e.en: The firm's {de-leveraging} reduced its debt significantly.
e.zh: 该公司的去杠杆化大幅降低了债务。

e.en: The exchange decided to {de-list} the troubled company.
e.zh: 交易所决定将这家陷入困境的公司摘牌。

e.en: Regulators may {de-list} firms that miss filing deadlines.
e.zh: 监管机构可能将错过申报期限的公司摘牌。

e.en: Shareholders approved the {de-merger} of the two divisions.
e.zh: 股东批准了两个部门的分拆。

e.en: The {de-merger} created two independent listed companies.
e.zh: 分拆形成了两家独立的上市公司。

e.en: Each plan has its own {de-merit} to consider.
e.zh: 每个方案都有需要考虑的缺点。

e.en: The committee weighed every {de-merit} of the proposal.
e.zh: 委员会权衡了该提案的每一项不足。

e.en: Soldiers spent months {de-mining} the border region.
e.zh: 士兵们花了数月时间在边境地区排雷。

e.en: International teams assist with {de-mining} after the war.
e.zh: 国际队伍在战后协助排雷工作。

e.en: Soldiers were eager to {de-mob} after the war ended.
e.zh: 战争结束后士兵们急切地想要复员。

e.en: The army began to {de-mob} thousands of reservists.
e.zh: 军队开始遣散数千名预备役人员。

de-motivate.t: 使失去动力；使丧失积极性

e.en: Constant criticism can {de-motivate} even strong workers.
e.zh: 持续的批评连能干的员工都会失去动力。

e.en: Unfair pay tends to {de-motivate} the whole team.
e.zh: 不公平的薪酬往往会使整个团队丧失干劲。

de-mystify.t: 使不再神秘；使易于理解

e.en: This book aims to {de-mystify} quantum physics for beginners.
e.zh: 这本书旨在为初学者揭开量子物理的神秘面纱。

e.en: The teacher tried to {de-mystify} the legal jargon.
e.zh: 老师试图把法律术语讲清楚。

e.en: Boiling water helps {de-oxygenate} it for the experiment.
e.zh: 煮沸水有助于为实验去氧。

e.en: Pollution can {de-oxygenate} rivers and harm fish.
e.zh: 污染会使河水缺氧并危害鱼类。

de-politicize.t: 使非政治化；剥离政治色彩

e.en: Reformers want to {de-politicize} the central bank.
e.zh: 改革者希望使中央银行去政治化。

e.en: The judge tried to {de-politicize} the courtroom debate.
e.zh: 法官试图让法庭辩论去政治化。

de-politicized.t: 已去政治化的；非政治化的

e.en: The agency now operates as a {de-politicized} body.
e.zh: 该机构现在作为一个非政治化的实体运作。

e.en: They favor a {de-politicized} approach to public health.
e.zh: 他们主张以非政治化的方式处理公共卫生问题。

de-program.t: 使摆脱思想灌输；解除洗脑

e.en: Specialists worked to {de-program} the cult survivors.
e.zh: 专家们努力帮助这些邪教幸存者解除洗脑。

e.en: It can take years to {de-program} someone.
e.zh: 使一个人摆脱思想灌输可能需要数年。

e.en: A small mistake could {de-rail} the entire negotiation.
e.zh: 一个小失误可能使整个谈判出岔子。

e.en: The accident caused the train to {de-rail}.
e.zh: 事故导致火车脱轨。

e.en: The government threatened to {de-recognize} the rebel province.
e.zh: 政府威胁要撤销对叛乱省份的承认。

e.en: Authorities may {de-recognize} a union for misconduct.
e.zh: 当局可能因违规而撤销对工会的认可。

e.en: You must {de-register} the car before scrapping it.
e.zh: 报废之前你必须先注销车辆登记。

e.en: He forgot to {de-register} from the old address.
e.zh: 他忘记从旧地址办理注销登记。

de-registered.t: 已注销的；已取消注册的

e.en: The {de-registered} vehicle cannot legally be driven.
e.zh: 已注销的车辆不能合法上路。

e.en: Several {de-registered} charities lost their tax status.
e.zh: 数家已注销的慈善机构失去了免税资格。

de-registrations.t: 注销登记；取消注册（复数）

e.en: Vehicle {de-registrations} rose sharply after the policy change.
e.zh: 政策变化后车辆注销登记数量大幅上升。

e.en: The agency processed thousands of {de-registrations} last month.
e.zh: 该机构上月处理了数千项注销登记。

e.en: The government plans to {de-regulate} the airline industry.
e.zh: 政府计划放松对航空业的管制。

e.en: Critics worry it is risky to {de-regulate} banks.
e.zh: 批评者担心放松对银行的管制有风险。

de-seasonalize.t: 消除季节性影响；季节性调整

e.en: Analysts {de-seasonalize} sales data before comparison.
e.zh: 分析师在比较之前对销售数据进行季节性调整。

e.en: You should {de-seasonalize} the figures for accuracy.
e.zh: 为了准确,你应该消除数据的季节性影响。

e.en: The {de-seasonalized} unemployment rate fell last quarter.
e.zh: 经季节调整的失业率上季度下降了。

e.en: They reported {de-seasonalized} figures for clearer trends.
e.zh: 他们公布了季节调整后的数据以呈现更清晰的趋势。

e.en: Please {de-seed} the peppers before chopping them.
e.zh: 请先把辣椒去籽再切。

e.en: It takes patience to {de-seed} a pomegranate.
e.zh: 给石榴去籽需要耐心。

e.en: Add the {de-seeded} chilies to the simmering sauce.
e.zh: 把去籽的辣椒加入正在炖煮的酱汁中。

e.en: She bought a jar of {de-seeded} olives.
e.zh: 她买了一罐去核橄榄。

e.en: Click here to {de-select} all the options at once.
e.zh: 点击此处一次性取消选择所有选项。

e.en: The party voted to {de-select} the controversial candidate.
e.zh: 该党投票决定不再提名这位有争议的候选人。

e.en: The MP faced {de-selection} by his local party.
e.zh: 这位议员面临被本地党组织撤换提名。

e.en: Use Ctrl-click for quick {de-selection} of items.
e.zh: 按住Ctrl键点击可以快速取消选择项目。

e.en: Therapists slowly {de-sensitise} patients to their phobias.
e.zh: 治疗师慢慢使患者对恐惧症脱敏。

e.en: Violent media may {de-sensitise} young viewers.
e.zh: 暴力媒体可能使年轻观众变得麻木。

de-skill.t: 使丧失技能；降低技术要求

e.en: Automation can {de-skill} traditional manufacturing jobs.
e.zh: 自动化可能使传统制造业岗位失去技能要求。

e.en: Critics fear AI will {de-skill} many professions.
e.zh: 批评者担心人工智能会让许多行业丧失技能。

de-skilling.t: 技能弱化；劳动去技能化

e.en: Economists debate the {de-skilling} of factory workers.
e.zh: 经济学家就工厂工人的技能弱化展开辩论。

e.en: Automation accelerates the {de-skilling} of clerical jobs.
e.zh: 自动化加速了文职工作的去技能化。

e.en: The coup threatened to {de-stabilize} the entire region.
e.zh: 这场政变可能动摇整个地区的稳定。

e.en: Sudden capital outflows can {de-stabilize} small economies.
e.zh: 突然的资本外流会使小型经济体陷入不稳定。

e.en: Retailers had to {de-stock} after weak holiday sales.
e.zh: 假日销售疲软后零售商不得不减少库存。

e.en: Farmers may {de-stock} herds during a drought.
e.zh: 干旱期间农民可能会减少牲畜存栏。

de-stocked.t: 已减少库存的；已清仓的

e.en: Suppliers {de-stocked} aggressively before the new tax took effect.
e.zh: 在新税生效前供应商大幅减少了库存。

e.en: The {de-stocked} warehouse looked nearly empty.
e.zh: 清完库存的仓库看起来几乎空空荡荡。

e.en: A long bath helps me {de-stress} after work.
e.zh: 长时间泡澡有助于我下班后放松。

e.en: Yoga is a popular way to {de-stress}.
e.zh: 瑜伽是一种流行的减压方式。

e.en: You should {de-worm} your puppy regularly.
e.zh: 你应该定期给小狗驱虫。

e.en: The vet recommended a pill to {de-worm} the cat.
e.zh: 兽医推荐了一种药丸给猫驱虫。

e.en: The museum decided to {deaccession} several minor paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆决定出售几幅次要的馆藏画作。

e.en: Curators must justify any choice to {deaccession} works.
e.zh: 馆长必须为任何出售馆藏作品的决定提供理由。

e.en: Enzymes {deacetylate} histones to alter gene expression.
e.zh: 酶使组蛋白脱乙酰,从而改变基因表达。

e.en: Researchers used a catalyst to {deacetylate} the compound.
e.zh: 研究人员使用催化剂使该化合物脱乙酰。

e.en: Libraries use {deacidification} to preserve old books.
e.zh: 图书馆使用脱酸法保护旧书。

e.en: Wine {deacidification} can soften an overly tart vintage.
e.zh: 葡萄酒脱酸可以柔化过酸的年份酒。

e.en: Conservators carefully {deacidify} fragile manuscripts.
e.zh: 修复人员小心地为脆弱的手稿脱酸。

e.en: Winemakers can {deacidify} grape juice with calcium carbonate.
e.zh: 酿酒师可用碳酸钙为葡萄汁脱酸。

e.en: Engineers {deacidize} the crude oil before refining.
e.zh: 工程师在炼制前对原油进行脱酸处理。

e.en: They use a special agent to {deacidize} the solution.
e.zh: 他们使用一种特殊药剂使溶液脱酸。

e.en: He was ordained into the {deaconry} last spring.
e.zh: 他去年春天被授予执事职务。

e.en: The {deaconry} carries both spiritual and administrative duties.
e.zh: 执事一职兼具属灵与行政职责。

e.en: He accepted the {deaconship} after years of service.
e.zh: 经过多年服侍他接受了执事的职位。

e.en: Her {deaconship} brought new energy to the parish.
e.zh: 她担任执事为教区注入了新活力。

e.en: Enzymes can {deacylate} fatty acid chains in the cell.
e.zh: 酶可以使细胞中的脂肪酸链脱酰基。

e.en: Researchers tried to {deacylate} the protein in vitro.
e.zh: 研究人员试图在体外使该蛋白脱酰基。

e.en: The {deacylation} step is critical to the reaction.
e.zh: 脱酰基步骤对该反应至关重要。

e.en: Studies revealed unexpected {deacylation} of the substrate.
e.zh: 研究揭示了底物意外的脱酰基反应。

e.en: He used a {dasymeter} to measure the gas density.
e.zh: 他用气体密度计测量气体密度。

e.en: The lab's {dasymeter} needed recalibration.
e.zh: 实验室的气体密度计需要重新校准。

e.en: Most ducks hatch as {dasypaedal} chicks.
e.zh: 多数鸭类破壳时即为生具绒羽的雏鸟。

e.en: {Dasypaedal} young can leave the nest sooner.
e.zh: 生具绒羽的雏鸟能更早离巢。

e.en: The botanist sketched a {dasyphyllous} shrub.
e.zh: 植物学家描绘了一株密叶灌木。

e.en: {Dasyphyllous} herbs thrive on dry slopes.
e.zh: 多毛叶的草本在干旱坡地上生长茂盛。

e.en: The {dasyure} is a small Australian marsupial.
e.zh: 袋鼬是一种小型澳洲有袋类动物。

e.en: A nocturnal {dasyure} crept through the undergrowth.
e.zh: 一只夜行的袋鼬在灌木丛中穿行。

e.en: Many {dasyurine} species are endangered.
e.zh: 许多袋鼬科物种已濒临灭绝。

e.en: Researchers studied the {dasyurine} carnivores.
e.zh: 研究者研究了袋鼬类食肉动物。

e.en: She uploaded the records to the company {data-base}.
e.zh: 她把记录上传到公司数据库。

e.en: The {data-base} stores all customer information.
e.zh: 该数据库存储所有客户信息。

e.en: The library hosts several {data-collections} on climate.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了多个气候数据集。

e.en: Researchers analyzed historic {data-collections} from the archive.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了档案馆的历史资料汇编。

e.en: Connect the cable to the {data-in} port.
e.zh: 把线接到数据输入端口。

e.en: The device buffers the {data-in} stream before processing.
e.zh: 该设备在处理前先缓存输入数据流。

e.en: He dialed up the office on the {data-phone}.
e.zh: 他用数据电话拨通了办公室。

e.en: Old offices used a {data-phone} to send files.
e.zh: 旧式办公室用数据电话发送文件。

data-processor.t: 数据处理器；数据处理员

e.en: The {data-processor} crunches numbers overnight.
e.zh: 那台数据处理器通宵运算数据。

e.en: She works as a {data-processor} at the bank.
e.zh: 她在银行担任数据处理员。

e.en: Engineers consult the chip {databook} for specs.
e.zh: 工程师查阅芯片数据手册以获取规格。

e.en: He keeps a thick {databook} on his desk.
e.zh: 他桌上放着一本厚厚的资料簿。

e.en: Our team handles all {datacomms} infrastructure.
e.zh: 我们团队负责所有数据通信基础设施。

e.en: Reliable {datacomms} are vital for the project.
e.zh: 可靠的数据通信对项目至关重要。

datal.t: 按日计酬的（旧矿工用语）

e.en: He took a {datal} job at the mine.
e.zh: 他在矿上找了份按日计酬的工作。

e.en: {Datal} workers were paid each evening.
e.zh: 按日工每晚领工资。

e.en: The {dataller} arrived early to start work.
e.zh: 那名按日工很早就来上工。

e.en: Old mines hired many a {dataller}.
e.zh: 旧矿场雇用过许多按日计酬的工人。

e.en: He spent years {datalling} at the colliery.
e.zh: 他在煤矿做了多年的按日工。

e.en: {Datalling} was hard but steady labour.
e.zh: 按日做工辛苦但稳定。

e.en: She picked up the {dataphone} to send the file.
e.zh: 她拿起数据电话发送文件。

e.en: The office installed a new {dataphone} system.
e.zh: 办公室安装了一套新的数据电话系统。

e.en: The lab's {dataplotter} produced clean charts.
e.zh: 实验室的数据绘图仪打印出整洁的图表。

e.en: He fed coordinates into the {dataplotter}.
e.zh: 他把坐标输入到数据绘图仪中。

e.en: The Pope appointed a new {datary}.
e.zh: 教皇任命了一位新的册封官。

e.en: The {datary} signed the official decree.
e.zh: 册封官在敕令上签字。

e.en: Engineers compared the {datasheets} of two chips.
e.zh: 工程师比较了两款芯片的规格说明书。

e.en: Download the product {datasheets} from the website.
e.zh: 从网站下载产品数据表。

e.en: They spent the summer at their {datcha}.
e.zh: 他们在乡间别墅度过了整个夏天。

e.en: A small {datcha} sat by the lake.
e.zh: 湖边坐落着一栋小别墅。

e.en: The campus warned students about {date-rape}.
e.zh: 校方提醒学生注意约会强奸。

e.en: Authorities banned the {date-rape} drug.
e.zh: 当局禁用了那种约会迷奸药。

dateable.t: 可注明日期的；可与之约会的

e.en: The artifact is {dateable} to the Bronze Age.
e.zh: 该文物的年代可追溯至青铜时代。

e.en: He's a kind, {dateable} man.
e.zh: 他是个善良、值得交往的男人。

e.en: Each silver piece has a {datemark}.
e.zh: 每件银器都打有日期戳。

e.en: The bottle's {datemark} confirmed its age.
e.zh: 瓶子的日期戳证实了它的年份。

e.en: Latin nouns take {datival} endings for indirect objects.
e.zh: 拉丁语名词作间接宾语时取与格词尾。

e.en: He explained the {datival} forms in detail.
e.zh: 他详细讲解了与格形式。

e.en: German uses the {dative} case for indirect objects.
e.zh: 德语用与格表示间接宾语。

e.en: She conjugated the noun in the {dative}.
e.zh: 她将名词变为与格形式。

e.en: The pronoun functions {datively} here.
e.zh: 这里的代词作与格使用。

e.en: Some verbs take their object {datively}.
e.zh: 某些动词以与格带宾语。

e.en: The {dato} welcomed the visiting officials.
e.zh: 酋长欢迎了来访的官员。

e.en: Tribes once paid tribute to the {dato}.
e.zh: 各部落曾向酋长进贡。

e.en: The geologist identified a vein of {datolite}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴别出一脉硅硼钙石。

e.en: {Datolite} crystals shimmered under the lamp.
e.zh: 硅硼钙石晶体在灯光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: The village respected its aging {datu}.
e.zh: 村民敬重年迈的族长。

e.en: Each clan answered to its own {datu}.
e.zh: 各氏族听命于自己的酋长。

e.en: Hikers were warned about poisonous {datura}.
e.zh: 徒步者被警告小心有毒的曼陀罗。

e.en: {Datura} flowers open at dusk.
e.zh: 曼陀罗的花在黄昏时绽放。

daube.t: 法式炖肉（普罗旺斯名菜）

e.en: She slow-cooked a beef {daube} for hours.
e.zh: 她小火慢炖了几个小时的法式炖牛肉。

e.en: The bistro's {daube} was rich and tender.
e.zh: 小酒馆的法式炖肉浓郁而鲜嫩。

e.en: The critic dismissed the painting as mere {daubery}.
e.zh: 评论家把那幅画斥为拙劣涂鸦。

e.en: His early canvases were just {daubery}.
e.zh: 他早期的画作不过是涂鸦之作。

e.en: The wall was {dauby} with old plaster.
e.zh: 墙上糊着旧灰浆，污痕斑斑。

e.en: Her apron was {dauby} after painting all day.
e.zh: 画了一整天后她的围裙满是涂痕。

daughterhood.t: 女儿身份；为人女的状态

e.en: She wrote a memoir about her {daughterhood}.
e.zh: 她写了一部关于自己女儿身份的回忆录。

e.en: {Daughterhood} brought both joys and burdens.
e.zh: 为人女儿既带来欢乐也带来负担。

e.en: The old king died {daughterless}.
e.zh: 老国王死时无女嗣。

e.en: {Daughterless} couples often adopted nieces.
e.zh: 无女的夫妇常收养侄女。

e.en: Both her {daughters-in-law} came for dinner.
e.zh: 她的两个儿媳都来吃晚饭。

e.en: He spoke fondly of his {daughters-in-law}.
e.zh: 他对儿媳们赞不绝口。

e.en: The {dauphine} attended the royal ball.
e.zh: 太子妃出席了王室舞会。

e.en: Letters from the {dauphine} survive in the archive.
e.zh: 档案中保存着太子妃的书信。

e.en: The young {dauphiness} learned French etiquette.
e.zh: 年轻的太子妃学习法式礼仪。

e.en: Court painters depicted the {dauphiness} often.
e.zh: 宫廷画家常为太子妃作画。

e.en: After mating, the queen ant becomes {dealate} and starts a colony.
e.zh: 交配后，蚁后脱翅并开始建立蚁群。

e.en: Entomologists collected several {dealate} specimens from the soil.
e.zh: 昆虫学家从土壤中收集了几只脱翅的标本。

e.en: {Dealation} occurs in many social insects after their nuptial flight.
e.zh: 许多社会性昆虫在婚飞后会出现脱翅现象。

e.en: Researchers studied the hormonal triggers of {dealation}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了脱翅现象的激素诱因。

e.en: The brewery uses vacuum distillation for {dealcoholization} of its beer.
e.zh: 该啤酒厂使用真空蒸馏对啤酒进行脱醇处理。

e.en: Modern {dealcoholization} preserves much of the wine's original flavor.
e.zh: 现代脱醇技术能保留葡萄酒大部分原有风味。

e.en: The {dealfish} is a slender deep-sea species rarely seen alive.
e.zh: 冠带鱼是一种细长的深海鱼，活体极少见。

e.en: Fishermen occasionally pull a {dealfish} from the nets.
e.zh: 渔民偶尔会从网里拉出一条冠带鱼。

e.en: Engineers use ion exchange to {dealkalize} the boiler feedwater.
e.zh: 工程师使用离子交换对锅炉给水进行脱碱。

e.en: It is necessary to {dealkalize} the solution before the next step.
e.zh: 在下一步之前必须对溶液进行脱碱处理。

e.en: Certain enzymes {dealkylate} drug molecules in the liver.
e.zh: 某些酶在肝脏中对药物分子进行脱烷基反应。

e.en: The catalyst is designed to {dealkylate} aromatic compounds efficiently.
e.zh: 该催化剂被设计用于高效地对芳香族化合物进行脱烷基。

e.en: {Dealloying} of brass can lead to dezincification and structural failure.
e.zh: 黄铜的去合金化会导致脱锌和结构失效。

e.en: Researchers used {dealloying} to create nanoporous gold.
e.zh: 研究人员通过去合金化制备出纳米多孔金。

e.en: Pilgrims walked along the cathedral's {deambulatory} in silence.
e.zh: 朝圣者沿着大教堂的回廊静静行走。

e.en: The cloister served as a {deambulatory} for the monks.
e.zh: 修道院的庭廊是僧侣们漫步沉思的地方。

e.en: Enzymes can {deamidate} glutamine residues in proteins.
e.zh: 酶可使蛋白质中的谷氨酰胺残基发生脱酰胺。

e.en: Heat may {deamidate} milk proteins during processing.
e.zh: 加热可能使乳蛋白在加工过程中脱酰胺。

e.en: {Deamidation} of asparagine is a common protein degradation pathway.
e.zh: 天冬酰胺的脱酰胺作用是一种常见的蛋白降解途径。

e.en: Storage conditions strongly affect the rate of {deamidation}.
e.zh: 储存条件强烈影响脱酰胺作用的速率。

e.en: Adenosine {deaminase} deficiency causes a severe immune disorder.
e.zh: 腺苷脱氨酶缺乏会导致严重的免疫缺陷症。

e.en: The {deaminase} converts cytidine into uridine.
e.zh: 这种脱氨酶将胞苷转化为尿苷。

e.en: The liver helps to {deaminate} excess amino acids.
e.zh: 肝脏帮助对过量的氨基酸进行脱氨。

e.en: Bacteria can {deaminate} certain substrates to release ammonia.
e.zh: 细菌可将某些底物脱氨从而释放出氨。

e.en: {Deamination} of amino acids produces ammonia in the body.
e.zh: 氨基酸的脱氨作用会在体内产生氨。

e.en: Spontaneous {deamination} of cytosine can cause DNA mutations.
e.zh: 胞嘧啶的自发脱氨作用可引起DNA突变。

e.en: The circuit causes a slight {deamplification} of the input signal.
e.zh: 该电路会对输入信号产生轻微的减幅作用。

e.en: Engineers measured the {deamplification} introduced by the filter.
e.zh: 工程师测量了滤波器引入的减幅量。

deanglicize.t: 去英国化；消除英式特征

e.en: Activists tried to {deanglicize} the place names after independence.
e.zh: 独立后活动人士试图对地名进行去英国化。

e.en: The reform sought to {deanglicize} the school curriculum.
e.zh: 该改革试图对学校课程进行去英国化。

e.en: She was offered the {deanship} of the law school.
e.zh: 她获得了法学院院长的职位。

e.en: During his {deanship}, the faculty doubled in size.
e.zh: 在他担任院长期间，教职员工人数翻了一番。

e.en: Catalytic {dearomatization} converts benzene rings into useful intermediates.
e.zh: 催化去芳构化可将苯环转化为有用的中间体。

e.en: The reaction relies on {dearomatization} of the phenol substrate.
e.zh: 该反应依赖于苯酚底物的去芳构化。

dearterialization.t: 动脉血变静脉血；去动脉化

e.en: Lung disease can lead to {dearterialization} of pulmonary blood.
e.zh: 肺部疾病可导致肺血出现去动脉化现象。

e.en: The surgeon described a partial {dearterialization} of the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生描述了对肿瘤进行部分去动脉化的手术。

e.en: Operators must {deash} the boiler at regular intervals.
e.zh: 操作人员必须定期对锅炉进行除灰。

e.en: The plant uses water sprays to {deash} the flue gas.
e.zh: 该工厂使用水喷雾对烟气进行除灰。

e.en: {Deashing} improves the efficiency of the combustion system.
e.zh: 除灰作业能提高燃烧系统的效率。

e.en: The sugar refinery includes a {deashing} step before crystallization.
e.zh: 糖厂在结晶前包含一道脱灰工序。

e.en: They walked {deasil} around the standing stones.
e.zh: 他们顺时针绕着立石行走。

e.en: The ritual requires moving {deasil} three times.
e.zh: 这个仪式要求顺时针方向走三圈。

deassigned.t: 已撤销分配的；已解除指派的

e.en: The task was {deassigned} from her after the project shifted.
e.zh: 项目调整后，这项任务被从她那里撤回。

e.en: All {deassigned} resources returned to the shared pool.
e.zh: 所有被解除指派的资源都返回到共享池中。

e.en: The pirate flag bore a grinning {death's-head}.
e.zh: 那面海盗旗上有一个咧嘴笑的骷髅头。

e.en: A {death's-head} moth landed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只骷髅头蛾停在了窗台上。

e.en: His grandfather barely survived a Nazi {death-camp}.
e.zh: 他的祖父勉强从纳粹死亡集中营中幸存下来。

e.en: Historians documented the horrors of every {death-camp}.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了每一座死亡集中营的恐怖。

death-roll.t: 死亡名单；死亡翻滚（鳄鱼捕食动作）

e.en: The newspaper printed the war's grim {death-roll}.
e.zh: 报纸刊登了这场战争惨痛的死亡名单。

e.en: The crocodile performed a violent {death-roll} to subdue its prey.
e.zh: 鳄鱼以猛烈的死亡翻滚制服了猎物。

death-trap.t: 死亡陷阱；极其危险的地方

e.en: That old building is a fire {death-trap}.
e.zh: 那栋老建筑是个火灾死亡陷阱。

e.en: The narrow mountain pass became a {death-trap} in winter.
e.zh: 那条狭窄的山口在冬天成了死亡陷阱。

e.en: Eating a single {deathcup} can be fatal.
e.zh: 误食一颗毒鹅膏就可能致命。

e.en: Foragers must learn to recognize the {deathcup} mushroom.
e.zh: 采菇人必须学会辨认毒鹅膏蘑菇。

e.en: The family gathers each year on his {deathday}.
e.zh: 家人每年都会在他的忌日聚会。

e.en: She lit a candle to mark her mother's {deathday}.
e.zh: 她点燃一支蜡烛来纪念母亲的忌日。

dead-alive.t: 半死不活的；死气沉沉的

e.en: The town felt {dead-alive} on Sunday afternoons.
e.zh: 周日下午，这座小镇显得死气沉沉。

e.en: He gave a {dead-alive} reply, devoid of feeling.
e.zh: 他给出一个半死不活、毫无感情的回答。

dead-and-alive.t: 沉闷乏味的；死气沉沉的

e.en: She hated living in such a {dead-and-alive} village.
e.zh: 她讨厌住在如此沉闷乏味的村子里。

e.en: It was a {dead-and-alive} office with no energy.
e.zh: 那是个毫无活力、死气沉沉的办公室。

dead-ass.t: 完全地；千真万确地（俚语）

e.en: I'm {dead-ass} serious about quitting.
e.zh: 我说要辞职是百分百认真的。

e.en: He {dead-ass} walked out without a word.
e.zh: 他真的就一句话不说走出去了。

dead-beat.t: 游手好闲的人；筋疲力尽的

e.en: Her ex-husband was a total {dead-beat}.
e.zh: 她前夫是个彻头彻尾的懒汉。

e.en: After the hike I was {dead-beat}.
e.zh: 徒步之后我累得不行。

e.en: The road ended in a {dead-end}.
e.zh: 这条路走到尽头是个死胡同。

e.en: He quit his {dead-end} job last month.
e.zh: 上个月他辞掉了那份没前途的工作。

dead-endedness.t: 无出路状态；走投无路的处境

e.en: The novel captures the {dead-endedness} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉到了小镇生活的无出路感。

e.en: She felt the {dead-endedness} of her career.
e.zh: 她感到自己事业的毫无前途。

dead-head.t: 无客空驶的车；摘除残花

e.en: The truck made a {dead-head} run back to the depot.
e.zh: 那辆卡车空载返回车场。

e.en: Remember to {dead-head} the roses each week.
e.zh: 记得每周摘除玫瑰的残花。

e.en: The race ended in a {dead-heat}.
e.zh: 这场比赛以并列第一结束。

e.en: Polls show the candidates in a {dead-heat}.
e.zh: 民调显示两位候选人不分上下。

e.en: We must meet the {dead-line} on Friday.
e.zh: 我们必须赶上周五的截止日期。

e.en: The editor extended the {dead-line} by two days.
e.zh: 编辑把截稿期延长了两天。

e.en: Negotiations reached a {dead-lock}.
e.zh: 谈判陷入僵局。

e.en: The two sides {dead-locked} over wages.
e.zh: 双方在薪资问题上僵持不下。

e.en: Her impression of the boss was {dead-on}.
e.zh: 她模仿老板模仿得惟妙惟肖。

e.en: His prediction turned out to be {dead-on}.
e.zh: 他的预测结果完全准确。

dead-pan.t: 面无表情的；不动声色的

e.en: He delivered the joke with a {dead-pan} expression.
e.zh: 他面无表情地讲出那个笑话。

e.en: Her {dead-pan} humour cracks me up.
e.zh: 她那种冷面幽默让我笑翻。

e.en: The peaches are {dead-ripe} and ready to eat.
e.zh: 这些桃子已经熟透，可以吃了。

e.en: Pick the figs when they're {dead-ripe}.
e.zh: 等无花果熟透了再摘。

e.en: She's {dead-set} on going to medical school.
e.zh: 她铁了心要上医学院。

e.en: He was {dead-set} against the proposal.
e.zh: 他坚决反对这项提议。

dead-tree.t: 纸质（出版物）；传统印刷的

e.en: He still prefers the {dead-tree} edition of the paper.
e.zh: 他仍然偏爱报纸的纸质版。

e.en: Few magazines survive in {dead-tree} form today.
e.zh: 如今以纸质形式存活的杂志已经不多了。

e.en: I'm {deadass} not joking right now.
e.zh: 我现在真的不是开玩笑。

e.en: He {deadass} ate the whole pizza alone.
e.zh: 他真的一个人把整张披萨吃光了。

e.en: The thermostat has a small {deadband} to prevent rapid cycling.
e.zh: 恒温器设有一个小的死区，以防频繁启停。

e.en: Engineers tuned the controller's {deadband}.
e.zh: 工程师调整了控制器的死区。

e.en: The lamb was {deadborn} that morning.
e.zh: 那只羊羔当天早上是死产的。

e.en: In old records, {deadborn} infants were noted separately.
e.zh: 在旧档案里，死产婴儿是单独登记的。

e.en: In the comic, the ghost calls himself a {deadee}.
e.zh: 漫画里那个鬼魂自称是个死人。

e.en: He joked about joining the {deadees} someday.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己总有一天也会变成死人一员。

e.en: The investigation hit a {deadend}.
e.zh: 调查陷入了死胡同。

e.en: This street is a {deadend}.
e.zh: 这条街是死路一条。

deadest.t: 最死寂的；最毫无生气的

e.en: It was the {deadest} night the bar had ever seen.
e.zh: 那是这家酒吧最冷清的一晚。

e.en: Tuesdays are usually our {deadest} day.
e.zh: 周二通常是我们生意最冷清的一天。

e.en: Grandpa was a {deadeye} with a rifle.
e.zh: 爷爷用步枪百发百中。

e.en: She's a {deadeye} from the three-point line.
e.zh: 她在三分线外百发百中。

e.en: The bodies were taken to the {deadhouse}.
e.zh: 尸体被送到了停尸房。

e.en: The old hospital still had a {deadhouse} in back.
e.zh: 那家老医院后面还留着一间太平间。

deadish.t: 略显死气的；半死不活的

e.en: The plant looked {deadish} but recovered.
e.zh: 这盆植物看着半死不活，但后来缓过来了。

e.en: His eyes had a {deadish} stare.
e.zh: 他的眼神有点呆滞无神。

e.en: Install a {deadlatch} for extra security.
e.zh: 装一个防撬锁以加强安全。

e.en: The door uses a {deadlatch} mechanism.
e.zh: 这扇门采用自动锁舌结构。

e.en: Sailors closed the {deadlight} before the storm.
e.zh: 水手在风暴来临前关上了舷窗盖板。

e.en: Each porthole has a metal {deadlight}.
e.zh: 每个舷窗都配有金属遮光板。

e.en: Don't be such a {deadneck} about it.
e.zh: 别在这事上当个榆木脑袋。

e.en: He called the rude driver a {deadneck}.
e.zh: 他骂那个粗鲁的司机是个蠢货。

e.en: The system requires a {deadstart} after the crash.
e.zh: 系统崩溃后需要进行冷启动。

e.en: Engineers performed a full {deadstart} of the mainframe.
e.zh: 工程师对主机进行了完整的冷启动。

e.en: This town is total {deadsville} on weekdays.
e.zh: 这小镇工作日里完全死气沉沉。

e.en: The party turned into {deadsville} after midnight.
e.zh: 派对过了午夜就变得冷清无比。

deadworks.t: 船的水上部分；干舷以上结构

e.en: The {deadworks} of the ship were repainted.
e.zh: 船的水上部分被重新刷漆。

e.en: Waves slammed against the {deadworks}.
e.zh: 海浪拍打着船的干舷部分。

e.en: The plant must {deaerate} the feedwater first.
e.zh: 工厂必须先对给水进行除气处理。

e.en: Vacuum is used to {deaerate} the liquid.
e.zh: 利用真空对液体进行脱气。

e.en: Boilers need careful {deaeration} of water.
e.zh: 锅炉需要对水进行仔细的除气处理。

e.en: {Deaeration} prevents corrosion in pipes.
e.zh: 除气可以防止管道腐蚀。

e.en: The {deaerator} removes oxygen from the boiler feed.
e.zh: 除气器去除锅炉给水中的氧气。

e.en: Maintenance staff inspected the {deaerator}.
e.zh: 维护人员检查了除气器。

e.en: The system is currently {deaering} the coolant.
e.zh: 系统正在对冷却液进行除气。

e.en: After {deaering}, the water is sent to the boiler.
e.zh: 除气之后，水被送入锅炉。

e.en: My grandmother got a new {deaf-aid} last week.
e.zh: 我奶奶上周配了一个新的助听器。

e.en: He adjusted his {deaf-aid} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时他调了一下助听器。

e.en: Modern {deaf-aids} are nearly invisible.
e.zh: 现代助听器几乎看不出来。

e.en: The clinic fits {deaf-aids} for free.
e.zh: 这家诊所免费为顾客适配助听器。

deaf-and-dumb.t: 聋哑的（旧用法，今多视为冒犯）

e.en: The old textbook used the term {deaf-and-dumb}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用了"聋哑"这种说法。

e.en: Today, calling someone {deaf-and-dumb} is offensive.
e.zh: 如今，称人为"聋哑"是带有冒犯意味的。

e.en: He has been {deaf-mute} since birth.
e.zh: 他天生就是聋哑人。

e.en: The school once served only {deaf-mute} students.
e.zh: 这所学校过去只招收聋哑学生。

e.en: The book documents the lives of {deaf-mutes}.
e.zh: 这本书记录了聋哑人的生活。

e.en: Many {deaf-mutes} communicate fluently in sign language.
e.zh: 许多聋哑人能用手语流利交流。

e.en: The infection led to congenital {deaf-mutism}.
e.zh: 那种感染导致了先天性聋哑。

e.en: Doctors studied the causes of {deaf-mutism}.
e.zh: 医生们研究了聋哑症的成因。

deafferented.t: 去传入神经的；切断传入神经的

e.en: The {deafferented} limb lost most sensation.
e.zh: 那条被去传入神经的肢体几乎失去了知觉。

e.en: Researchers studied {deafferented} cortical neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了去传入神经的皮层神经元。

e.en: Grandpa is a bit {deafish} these days.
e.zh: 爷爷最近耳朵有点背。

e.en: She speaks loudly because her father is {deafish}.
e.zh: 她说话很大声，因为她父亲耳朵有点背。

e.en: The journal article focused on {deafmutism}.
e.zh: 那篇期刊文章聚焦于聋哑症。

e.en: {Deafmutism} can be caused by various factors.
e.zh: 聋哑症可由多种原因引起。

e.en: The mill achieves {deagglomeration} of the powder.
e.zh: 这台研磨机能将粉末解聚分散。

e.en: {Deagglomeration} improves pigment dispersion.
e.zh: 解聚处理可以改善颜料的分散性。

e.en: You must {deair} the syringe before injecting.
e.zh: 注射前必须排出针筒里的空气。

e.en: The pump is used to {deair} the cooling system.
e.zh: 这台泵用于给冷却系统排气。

deal-breaker.t: 导致破局的因素；不可接受的条件

e.en: For her, smoking is a {deal-breaker}.
e.zh: 对她来说，抽烟是无法接受的硬伤。

e.en: The price hike turned out to be a {deal-breaker}.
e.zh: 涨价最终导致交易告吹。

deal-maker.t: 善于谈判的人；交易撮合者

e.en: She has a reputation as a tough {deal-maker}.
e.zh: 她以谈判强硬著称。

e.en: Every successful firm needs a good {deal-maker}.
e.zh: 每家成功的公司都需要一位优秀的交易撮合人。

e.en: The rope was about a {decametre} long.
e.zh: 那根绳子大约十米长。

e.en: They measured the field in {decametres}.
e.zh: 他们用十米为单位丈量这块地。

e.en: The army's sudden {decampment} surprised everyone.
e.zh: 军队突然撤营，让所有人都感到意外。

e.en: His midnight {decampment} left debts unpaid.
e.zh: 他半夜溜走，留下一堆未还的债务。

e.en: {Decane} is a component of gasoline.
e.zh: 癸烷是汽油的成分之一。

e.en: They synthesized pure {decane} in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室合成了纯净的癸烷。

e.en: {Decanol} is used in some perfumes.
e.zh: 癸醇被用于某些香水中。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {decanol}.
e.zh: 反应产生了少量癸醇。

e.en: The wine improved after careful {decantation}.
e.zh: 经过细心倾析后，酒的口感更好了。

e.en: {Decantation} separates liquid from sediment.
e.zh: 倾析法可以把液体和沉淀物分开。

decapacitate.t: 使丧失能力；使精子失能

e.en: Certain proteins {decapacitate} sperm cells.
e.zh: 某些蛋白质会使精子失去受精能力。

e.en: The chemical {decapacitates} the enzyme.
e.zh: 这种化学物质会使该酶失去活性。

e.en: Sperm {decapacitation} is a reversible process.
e.zh: 精子失能是一个可逆的过程。

e.en: They studied {decapacitation} in mammalian cells.
e.zh: 他们研究哺乳动物细胞中的失能现象。

decapeptide.t: 十肽（含十个氨基酸的肽）

e.en: The {decapeptide} showed strong biological activity.
e.zh: 这种十肽显示出很强的生物活性。

e.en: They synthesized a new {decapeptide} for testing.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种新的十肽用于测试。

e.en: The fly is known as an ant {decapitator}.
e.zh: 这种蝇被称为蚂蚁斩首者。

e.en: The novel describes a ruthless {decapitator}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了一个残忍的斩首者。

e.en: Some strawberries are naturally {decaploid}.
e.zh: 有些草莓天然是十倍体。

e.en: The plant turned out to be a {decaploid}.
e.zh: 这种植物结果是一种十倍体。

e.en: Crabs and lobsters are {decapods}.
e.zh: 螃蟹和龙虾都是十足类动物。

e.en: The {decapod} buried itself in the sand.
e.zh: 这种十足类动物把自己埋在沙里。

e.en: Shrimp belong to the {decapodous} order.
e.zh: 虾属于十足目动物。

e.en: He examined a {decapodous} specimen.
e.zh: 他检查了一个十足类标本。

e.en: The lab uses an automatic tube {decapper}.
e.zh: 这间实验室使用自动试管开盖机。

e.en: She bought a bottle {decapper} online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一个开瓶器。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {decapsulated} kidney.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了去除被膜的肾脏。

e.en: They studied {decapsulated} bacteria under the microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下研究去掉荚膜的细菌。

e.en: Renal {decapsulation} can relieve pressure.
e.zh: 肾脏剥膜术可以缓解压力。

e.en: Chip {decapsulation} exposes the silicon die.
e.zh: 芯片开盖能露出硅晶片。

e.en: They {decarbonate} the water before testing.
e.zh: 他们在测试前先去除水中的碳酸。

e.en: Heat is used to {decarbonate} the solution.
e.zh: 用加热的方法将溶液脱碳酸。

e.en: The {decarbonated} water tasted flat.
e.zh: 脱去碳酸的水喝起来没有气泡。

e.en: They used {decarbonated} samples in the experiment.
e.zh: 他们在实验中使用了脱碳酸的样品。

e.en: Boiling {decarbonates} the mineral water.
e.zh: 煮沸能让矿泉水脱碳酸。

e.en: The process {decarbonates} the liquid quickly.
e.zh: 这个过程能迅速使液体脱碳酸。

e.en: They are {decarbonating} the boiler feedwater.
e.zh: 他们正在对锅炉给水进行脱碳酸处理。

e.en: {Decarbonating} the soda removed its fizz.
e.zh: 给苏打脱碳酸后气泡就没了。

e.en: {Decarbonation} is a key step in water treatment.
e.zh: 脱碳酸是水处理中的关键步骤。

e.en: The plant performs ocean {decarbonation}.
e.zh: 这家工厂进行海洋脱碳处理。

e.en: We must {decarbonise} the energy sector.
e.zh: 我们必须让能源部门脱碳。

e.en: Many countries plan to {decarbonise} by 2050.
e.zh: 许多国家计划在2050年前实现脱碳。

e.en: They run a fully {decarbonised} factory.
e.zh: 他们经营一家完全脱碳的工厂。

e.en: The fleet has been {decarbonised} successfully.
e.zh: 这支车队已经成功实现脱碳。

e.en: Engineers installed a new {decarboniser} unit.
e.zh: 工程师们安装了一台新的脱碳装置。

e.en: The {decarboniser} cleans engine deposits.
e.zh: 这种脱碳剂能清除发动机积碳。

e.en: {Decarbonization} is essential to fight climate change.
e.zh: 脱碳是应对气候变化的必要措施。

e.en: The company set ambitious {decarbonization} targets.
e.zh: 该公司制定了雄心勃勃的脱碳目标。

e.en: Cities are racing to {decarbonize} transportation.
e.zh: 各城市正争相让交通运输脱碳。

e.en: It is hard to {decarbonize} heavy industry.
e.zh: 重工业的脱碳很有难度。

e.en: Their factory is now fully {decarbonized}.
e.zh: 他们的工厂现已完全脱碳。

e.en: A {decarbonized} grid relies on renewables.
e.zh: 脱碳后的电网依赖可再生能源。

e.en: This policy {decarbonizes} the power sector.
e.zh: 这项政策让电力行业脱碳。

e.en: The new fuel {decarbonizes} shipping fleets.
e.zh: 这种新燃料让船队实现脱碳。

e.en: They are {decarbonizing} the steel industry.
e.zh: 他们正在让钢铁行业脱碳。

e.en: {Decarbonizing} aviation remains a challenge.
e.zh: 航空业的脱碳仍是一大挑战。

e.en: The bacteria produce a specific {decarboxylase}.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生一种特定的脱羧酶。

e.en: {Decarboxylase} activity was measured in samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了样品中的脱羧酶活性。

e.en: Heating can {decarboxylate} the acid.
e.zh: 加热可以让这种酸脱羧。

e.en: They {decarboxylate} the cannabis before extraction.
e.zh: 他们在萃取之前先让大麻脱羧。

e.en: {Decarboxylation} releases carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 脱羧作用会释放二氧化碳。

e.en: This enzyme catalyzes {decarboxylation} reactions.
e.zh: 这种酶催化脱羧反应。

e.en: Furnaces {decarburise} the steel surface.
e.zh: 炉子会让钢的表面脱碳。

e.en: They {decarburise} the metal before forging.
e.zh: 他们在锻造前先让金属脱碳。

e.en: Surface {decarburization} weakens the steel.
e.zh: 表面脱碳会削弱钢材的强度。

e.en: They studied {decarburization} during heat treatment.
e.zh: 他们研究热处理过程中的脱碳现象。

e.en: High temperatures {decarburize} the alloy.
e.zh: 高温会让这种合金脱碳。

e.en: They {decarburize} the steel to soften it.
e.zh: 他们让钢脱碳以使其变软。

e.en: The process {decarburizes} the outer layer.
e.zh: 这个工艺会让外层脱碳。

e.en: Heat treatment {decarburizes} the metal slowly.
e.zh: 热处理会让金属慢慢脱碳。

e.en: The farm covers about ten {decares}.
e.zh: 这座农场约有十个十公亩。

e.en: Land is sold by the {decare} here.
e.zh: 这里的土地是按十公亩出售的。

e.en: Postwar {decartelization} reshaped German industry.
e.zh: 战后的卡特尔解体重塑了德国工业。

e.en: They pushed for the {decartelization} of media.
e.zh: 他们推动媒体行业解除垄断。

decasualise.t: 使（劳工）摆脱临时雇佣身份

e.en: The union fought to {decasualise} dock work.
e.zh: 工会努力让码头工作摆脱临时工性质。

e.en: Reforms aimed to {decasualise} the port labour force.
e.zh: 改革旨在使港口劳工脱离临时雇佣制。

decasualization.t: 临时雇佣制的废除；正式化

e.en: The {decasualization} of dock labour took decades.
e.zh: 码头劳工临时雇佣制的废除花了数十年。

e.en: He wrote about the {decasualization} of port workers.
e.zh: 他撰文论述港口工人脱离临时工制度的过程。

decasualize.t: 使（劳工）摆脱临时雇佣身份

e.en: Reformers wanted to {decasualize} the workforce.
e.zh: 改革者希望使劳动力脱离临时雇佣制。

e.en: The policy aimed to {decasualize} dockworkers.
e.zh: 该政策旨在让码头工人转为正式雇用。

e.en: The poem uses a {decasyllabic} line throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗自始至终采用十音节诗行。

e.en: He prefers {decasyllabic} verse to free verse.
e.zh: 他偏爱十音节诗胜于自由诗。

e.en: Each line is a perfect {decasyllable}.
e.zh: 每一行都是工整的十音节诗。

e.en: The sonnet relies on the {decasyllable}.
e.zh: 这首十四行诗依靠十音节诗行构成。

e.en: Store {decayable} food in the fridge.
e.zh: 易腐食品请存放在冰箱中。

e.en: The isotope is {decayable} over millennia.
e.zh: 该同位素会在千年间发生衰变。

e.en: Children are more {deceivable} than adults.
e.zh: 孩子比成年人更容易受骗。

e.en: Even experts proved {deceivable} by the forgery.
e.zh: 连专家也被这件赝品骗了过去。

e.en: He warned against the {deceivableness} of appearances.
e.zh: 他告诫人们外表具有欺骗性。

e.en: The {deceivableness} of the young troubled her.
e.zh: 年轻人易受蒙骗这点让她忧心。

e.en: The label was {deceivably} worded to mislead buyers.
e.zh: 标签措辞具有欺骗性，会误导买家。

e.en: He smiled {deceivably} at the camera.
e.zh: 他对着镜头露出虚伪的笑容。

e.en: Engineers tested the car's {decelerability} on wet roads.
e.zh: 工程师在湿路面上测试了这辆车的减速能力。

e.en: The aircraft's {decelerability} exceeds the spec.
e.zh: 该飞机的减速性能超过了规格要求。

e.en: The probe deployed a {decelerator} before landing.
e.zh: 探测器在着陆前展开了减速装置。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the {decelerator} for safety.
e.zh: 工程师为安全起见重新设计了减速器。

e.en: The {decelerometer} measures braking performance.
e.zh: 减速度计用于测量制动性能。

e.en: He attached a {decelerometer} to the test vehicle.
e.zh: 他在测试车上安装了减速度计。

decemvir.t: 古罗马十人委员会成员

e.en: Each {decemvir} held considerable authority.
e.zh: 每位十人委员会成员都握有相当大的权力。

e.en: The {decemvir} drafted parts of the early law.
e.zh: 这位十人委员参与起草了早期法律的一部分。

e.en: The {decemviral} reforms shaped Roman law.
e.zh: 十人委员会的改革塑造了罗马法。

e.en: Historians debate the {decemviral} period.
e.zh: 历史学家对十人委员会时期争论不休。

decemvirate.t: 古罗马十人委员会（的统治）

e.en: The {decemvirate} ruled briefly in early Rome.
e.zh: 十人委员会在罗马早期短暂掌权。

e.en: Power soon corrupted the {decemvirate}.
e.zh: 权力很快腐蚀了这个十人委员会。

e.en: The {decemviri} compiled the Twelve Tables.
e.zh: 十人委员们编纂了《十二铜表法》。

e.en: Romans grew wary of the {decemviri}.
e.zh: 罗马人开始对这些十人委员产生戒心。

e.en: The {decemvirs} held supreme power for a year.
e.zh: 十人委员们掌握最高权力达一年。

e.en: Citizens protested against the {decemvirs}.
e.zh: 市民们抗议这些十人委员。

e.en: Each {decenary} consisted of ten households.
e.zh: 每个十户区由十户人家组成。

e.en: They held a {decenary} celebration of the founding.
e.zh: 他们举办了建立十周年的纪念活动。

decennaries.t: 十年期；十周年纪念（复数）

e.en: The town marked several {decennaries} of its founding.
e.zh: 该镇举办了多次建镇十周年纪念。

e.en: Records survive from earlier {decennaries}.
e.zh: 早先十年期的记录留存至今。

e.en: They published a {decennary} report on progress.
e.zh: 他们发布了一份十年期的进展报告。

e.en: The {decennary} review covers a full decade.
e.zh: 这次十年回顾涵盖了完整的十年。

e.en: Several {decennia} passed before the project finished.
e.zh: 项目完成之前过了好几个十年。

e.en: The text spans many {decennia} of history.
e.zh: 文本跨越了许多个十年的历史。

e.en: The {decenniad} saw rapid technological change.
e.zh: 这十年见证了科技的迅速变革。

e.en: He wrote a memoir of that {decenniad}.
e.zh: 他为那个十年写了一部回忆录。

e.en: A full {decennium} passed without major reform.
e.zh: 整整十年过去了，却没有重大改革。

e.en: The {decennium} brought enormous social change.
e.zh: 这十年带来了巨大的社会变革。

e.en: Two {decenniums} of research culminated in the book.
e.zh: 两个十年的研究最终凝结成这本书。

e.en: Many {decenniums} have shaped the city's skyline.
e.zh: 几个十年塑造了这座城市的天际线。

e.en: The lens showed slight {decentration} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔过之后镜片出现了轻微偏心。

e.en: Piaget studied the child's {decentration} of thought.
e.zh: 皮亚杰研究了儿童思维的去中心化过程。

e.en: The reform aims to {decentre} decision-making.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在使决策去中心化。

e.en: Activists want to {decentre} western perspectives.
e.zh: 活动人士希望让西方视角不再居于中心。

e.en: The book explores the {decentring} of authorship.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了作者地位的去中心化。

e.en: {Decentring} the curriculum took years of work.
e.zh: 让课程去中心化花了多年功夫。

e.en: The species shows clear signs of {decephalization}.
e.zh: 该物种显示出明显的脑部退化迹象。

e.en: Researchers studied {decephalization} in parasites.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了寄生虫的去头化现象。

e.en: He used {deceptional} tactics to win the deal.
e.zh: 他用欺骗手段赢得了那笔交易。

e.en: The ad relied on {deceptional} imagery.
e.zh: 那则广告依靠欺骗性的图像来宣传。

e.en: Her {deceptious} smile hid her real intentions.
e.zh: 她那带有欺骗性的笑容掩饰了真实意图。

e.en: The salesman gave a {deceptious} pitch.
e.zh: 那名推销员做了一番充满欺骗的推介。

decerebrate.t: 去大脑的；去大脑（实验动物）

e.en: The patient showed {decerebrate} posturing.
e.zh: 病人出现了去大脑强直姿势。

e.en: Researchers used a {decerebrate} cat in the study.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验中使用了去大脑的猫。

e.en: The {decerebrated} animal still showed reflexes.
e.zh: 去大脑后的动物仍表现出反射动作。

e.en: They studied muscle tone in {decerebrated} subjects.
e.zh: 他们研究了去大脑动物的肌张力。

decerebrates.t: 使去大脑（第三人称单数）

e.en: The procedure {decerebrates} the test animal.
e.zh: 该手术会使实验动物去大脑。

e.en: He carefully {decerebrates} each specimen.
e.zh: 他小心地对每个样本实施去大脑手术。

decerebrating.t: 正在去大脑；去大脑（动名词）

e.en: {Decerebrating} the rat allowed the reflex study.
e.zh: 对大鼠去大脑后才得以进行反射研究。

e.en: The lab manual describes the {decerebrating} procedure.
e.zh: 实验手册描述了去大脑的操作步骤。

e.en: The agency {decertified} the failing school.
e.zh: 该机构取消了这所不合格学校的认证。

e.en: Their union was {decertified} after the vote.
e.zh: 投票后他们的工会被取消了认证。

e.en: He delivered a {deathful} blow to his enemy.
e.zh: 他给敌人致命的一击。

e.en: The poet wrote of a {deathful} silence.
e.zh: 诗人写下死寂般的沉默。

e.en: The {deathfulness} of the plague terrified the village.
e.zh: 瘟疫的致命性令村民恐惧。

e.en: She sensed the {deathfulness} of the empty ward.
e.zh: 她感到空病房的死亡气息。

e.en: A {deathlike} silence fell over the room.
e.zh: 房间里陷入死一般的寂静。

e.en: His {deathlike} pallor worried the doctor.
e.zh: 他死人般的苍白让医生担忧。

deathliness.t: 死气沉沉的状态；死亡感

e.en: The {deathliness} of the morgue unsettled her.
e.zh: 太平间的死气让她不安。

e.en: He noted the {deathliness} in her tone.
e.zh: 他察觉到她语气里的死气。

deathnium.t: 死亡中心；半导体复合中心

e.en: Engineers measured {deathnium} centers in the silicon wafer.
e.zh: 工程师测量了硅片中的复合中心。

e.en: {Deathnium} reduces minority carrier lifetime in semiconductors.
e.zh: 复合中心缩短半导体少数载流子寿命。

deathroll.t: 死亡翻滚；鳄鱼制服猎物的翻滚

e.en: The crocodile performed a {deathroll} to subdue prey.
e.zh: 鳄鱼用死亡翻滚制服猎物。

e.en: Alligators use the {deathroll} to tear flesh apart.
e.zh: 短吻鳄用死亡翻滚撕裂猎物。

e.en: The {deathsman} stood beside the wooden scaffold.
e.zh: 刽子手站在木制绞架旁。

e.en: A black-hooded {deathsman} entered the chamber.
e.zh: 一个戴黑头罩的行刑者走进刑房。

e.en: The wounded soldier turned his face {deathward}.
e.zh: 受伤的士兵把脸转向死亡的方向。

e.en: Time marches steadily {deathward} for everyone.
e.zh: 对每个人来说时光都稳步走向死亡。

deathy.t: 死气沉沉的；像死人般的

e.en: Her {deathy} complexion startled the nurse.
e.zh: 她死人般的脸色让护士吃惊。

e.en: The room had a {deathy} chill about it.
e.zh: 房间里弥漫着一股死人般的寒意。

deave.t: 使震耳欲聋；使变聋（方言）

e.en: The bagpipes {deave} my ears every parade.
e.zh: 风笛每次游行都把我耳朵震聋。

e.en: Stop shouting—you'll {deave} the neighbors.
e.zh: 别喊了，会把邻居震聋的。

debag.t: 扒下某人的裤子（英式恶作剧）

e.en: They tried to {debag} him as a prank.
e.zh: 他们想恶作剧地扒他的裤子。

e.en: It is rude to {debag} someone in public.
e.zh: 在公共场合扒人裤子很无礼。

debagged.t: 被扒掉裤子；扒裤动作的过去式

e.en: He was {debagged} during the initiation prank.
e.zh: 他在入会恶作剧中被扒了裤子。

e.en: The freshman got {debagged} by his roommates.
e.zh: 新生被室友们扒了裤子。

e.en: The notorious {debagger} struck again at the party.
e.zh: 那个臭名昭著的扒裤者又在派对上动手了。

e.en: Campus police finally caught the {debagger}.
e.zh: 校警终于抓住了那个扒裤者。

debanker.t: 赢光庄家的赌客；让庄家输光的人

e.en: The lucky {debanker} cleaned out the casino's table.
e.zh: 那个幸运的赢家把赌桌赢得精光。

e.en: Few players manage to be a {debanker} at roulette.
e.zh: 很少有人能在轮盘赌中赢光庄家。

e.en: The {debarkation} of troops took several hours.
e.zh: 部队的下船花了好几个小时。

e.en: Passengers patiently awaited their {debarkation}.
e.zh: 乘客们耐心地等待下船。

debarment.t: 禁止参与；除名；取消资格

e.en: The lawyer faced {debarment} for serious misconduct.
e.zh: 律师因严重不当行为面临除名。

e.en: His {debarment} from the contest was final.
e.zh: 他被取消比赛资格已成定局。

debarrass.t: 使摆脱；使解除困扰；脱身

e.en: She tried to {debarrass} herself of the heavy suitcase.
e.zh: 她试图摆脱沉重的行李箱。

e.en: He could not {debarrass} his mind of worry.
e.zh: 他无法摆脱心中的忧虑。

e.en: He spoke {debasingly} of his political rivals.
e.zh: 他贬低地谈论政治对手。

e.en: The film portrayed women {debasingly} throughout.
e.zh: 那部电影自始至终以贬损方式描绘女性。

e.en: She is {debatably} the best player on the team.
e.zh: 她可以说是队中最好的球员。

e.en: {Debatably}, the policy did more harm than good.
e.zh: 可以争辩的是，该政策弊大于利。

e.en: The final outcome remains highly {debateable}.
e.zh: 最终结果仍很有争议。

e.en: His central claim is genuinely {debateable}.
e.zh: 他的核心主张确实有争议。

e.en: The matter required serious {debatement} in council.
e.zh: 这件事需要在议会认真辩论。

e.en: After much {debatement}, they reached a compromise.
e.zh: 经过多番辩论，他们达成了妥协。

debauchee.t: 放荡者；纵欲之人；荒淫者

e.en: He was branded a {debauchee} by polite society.
e.zh: 上流社会给他贴上了放荡者的标签。

e.en: The young heir became a notorious {debauchee}.
e.zh: 那位年轻的继承人成了臭名昭著的纵欲者。

e.en: The novel chronicles his moral {debauchment} carefully.
e.zh: 小说细致记录了他的道德堕落。

e.en: Their {debauchment} shocked the entire village.
e.zh: 他们的纵欲行为震惊了整个村庄。

debeader.t: 轮胎钢丝圈拆除机；去珠机

e.en: Workers fed the old tire into the {debeader}.
e.zh: 工人把旧轮胎送进去珠机。

e.en: The {debeader} removes steel beads from scrap tires.
e.zh: 去珠机从废轮胎上去除钢丝圈。

e.en: Farmers sometimes {debeak} chickens to prevent pecking.
e.zh: 农民有时给鸡剪喙以防互啄。

e.en: It is controversial to {debeak} laying hens.
e.zh: 给蛋鸡剪喙是有争议的做法。

debenture-holder.t: 公司债券持有人；债权人

e.en: Each {debenture-holder} receives fixed annual interest.
e.zh: 每位公司债券持有人都获得固定年息。

e.en: A {debenture-holder} has priority over equity shareholders.
e.zh: 公司债券持有人的权益优先于股东。

debenture-holders.t: 公司债券持有人（复数形式）

e.en: {Debenture-holders} were paid before equity investors.
e.zh: 公司债券持有人比股权投资者先获偿付。

e.en: The company informed its {debenture-holders} of the merger.
e.zh: 公司将合并事宜通知其债券持有人。

e.en: The plant uses {debenzolization} to purify coke gas.
e.zh: 该厂用脱苯工艺净化焦炉煤气。

e.en: {Debenzolization} removes benzene from coke oven gas.
e.zh: 脱苯工艺从焦炉煤气中去除苯。

e.en: His {debile} state worsened with each passing day.
e.zh: 他衰弱的状态日益加剧。

e.en: She tenderly nursed her {debile} grandfather.
e.zh: 她细心照顾衰弱的祖父。

debismuthise.t: 脱铋；从金属中除去铋杂质

e.en: Workers had to {debismuthise} the lead bullion first.
e.zh: 工人必须先给粗铅脱铋。

e.en: The refinery uses zinc to {debismuthise} the metal.
e.zh: 精炼厂用锌给金属脱铋。

debite.t: 分配出售；记入借方（罕用）

e.en: Old merchants would {debite} their goods at fairs.
e.zh: 旧时商人会在集市上分卖货物。

e.en: The clerk had to {debite} each transaction precisely.
e.zh: 职员需要精确记录每笔账。

debiteuse.t: 玻璃制造中的供料槽；拉引器

e.en: Molten glass flowed through the {debiteuse} slot.
e.zh: 熔融玻璃从供料槽中流出。

e.en: The {debiteuse} controls sheet thickness during drawing.
e.zh: 供料槽在拉引时控制玻璃片的厚度。

debitor.t: 借方；债务人（拉丁法律用语）

e.en: The ledger listed each {debitor} clearly by name.
e.zh: 账本按姓名清楚列出每个借方。

e.en: The {debitor} ultimately failed to repay the loan.
e.zh: 债务人最终未能偿还贷款。

debitterize.t: 除去苦味；进行脱苦处理

e.en: Producers {debitterize} olives before packaging them.
e.zh: 生产商在包装前给橄榄脱苦。

e.en: Soaking can {debitterize} certain wild greens.
e.zh: 浸泡可以去除某些野菜的苦味。

deblocking.t: 解除封锁；去除阻塞或粘连

e.en: {Deblocking} the data took several long hours.
e.zh: 解除数据阻塞花了好几个小时。

e.en: Engineers worked on {deblocking} the clogged pipeline.
e.zh: 工程师着手疏通堵塞的管道。

e.en: Passengers may now {deboard} the aircraft safely.
e.zh: 乘客现在可以安全地下飞机了。

e.en: We waited patiently to {deboard} after landing.
e.zh: 着陆后我们耐心等待下机。

debonaire.t: 温文尔雅的；风度翩翩的

e.en: He greeted us with a {debonaire} smile.
e.zh: 他以风度翩翩的微笑迎接我们。

e.en: His {debonaire} manner charmed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他温文尔雅的举止让满屋人着迷。

e.en: {Debonding} of the laminate caused the structural failure.
e.zh: 层压板脱粘导致了结构故障。

e.en: Engineers studied {debonding} in advanced composite materials.
e.zh: 工程师研究先进复合材料的脱粘问题。

debonnaire.t: 温文尔雅的；风度翩翩的

e.en: The prince had a {debonnaire} air about him.
e.zh: 那位王子带着温文尔雅的气质。

e.en: She admired his {debonnaire} bearing at court.
e.zh: 她欣赏他在宫廷中风度翩翩的仪态。

e.en: The spacecraft fired its engines to {deboost}.
e.zh: 飞船点燃引擎以减速。

e.en: Mission control planned the {deboost} maneuver carefully.
e.zh: 任务控制中心仔细规划了减速机动。

debooster.t: 减速器；降压装置；减压器

e.en: The {debooster} reduced the brake line pressure.
e.zh: 减压器降低了制动管路的压力。

e.en: Engineers installed a {debooster} on the hydraulic system.
e.zh: 工程师在液压系统上安装了减压器。

e.en: The company invested to {debottleneck} the refinery.
e.zh: 公司投资以消除炼油厂的瓶颈。

e.en: Engineers worked hard to {debottleneck} the production line.
e.zh: 工程师努力消除生产线的瓶颈。

e.en: The {debouchment} of troops onto the plain surprised the enemy.
e.zh: 部队涌出至平原，令敌人措手不及。

e.en: Fishing boats gathered at the river's {debouchment}.
e.zh: 渔船聚集在河流出口处。

e.en: They camped near the {debouchure} of the stream.
e.zh: 他们在溪流出口附近扎营。

e.en: The {debouchure} widened into a small bay.
e.zh: 那河口扩展成一个小海湾。

debride.t: 清创；清除创面坏死组织

e.en: Surgeons must {debride} the wound before suturing.
e.zh: 外科医生必须先清创再缝合伤口。

e.en: The nurse needed to {debride} the burn carefully.
e.zh: 护士需要小心地给烧伤处清创。

debruised.t: 纹章学中被横纹覆压的

e.en: In the coat of arms the lion was {debruised} by a bend.
e.zh: 在纹章中，狮子被斜带覆压。

e.en: The shield's eagle appeared {debruised} by a fess.
e.zh: 盾上的鹰被横带覆压。

e.en: Each {debt-holder} received a partial repayment.
e.zh: 每位债权人都得到了部分偿付。

e.en: The company negotiated with its largest {debt-holders}.
e.zh: 该公司与最大的债权人进行了谈判。

debt-redden.t: 负债累累的；债务缠身的

e.en: The {debt-redden} merchant could not sleep at night.
e.zh: 那个负债累累的商人夜不能寐。

e.en: He inherited a {debt-redden} estate from his uncle.
e.zh: 他从叔叔那里继承了一份债务缠身的产业。

debt-ridden.t: 负债累累的；债务缠身的

e.en: The {debt-ridden} country sought IMF assistance.
e.zh: 这个负债累累的国家向国际货币基金组织求援。

e.en: He bought a {debt-ridden} business and turned it around.
e.zh: 他收购了一家债务缠身的企业并使其扭亏为盈。

debtless.t: 无债的；不欠债的；无债一身轻

e.en: After years of saving, she finally became {debtless}.
e.zh: 经过多年储蓄，她终于无债一身轻。

e.en: A {debtless} household sleeps soundly at night.
e.zh: 无债的家庭夜里睡得安稳。

debtor-in-possession.t: 占有破产财产的债务人

e.en: The {debtor-in-possession} continued operating during bankruptcy.
e.zh: 占有破产财产的债务人在破产期间继续经营。

e.en: As a {debtor-in-possession}, the firm retained its assets.
e.zh: 作为占有破产财产的债务人，公司保留了资产。

e.en: The professor was a famous {debuncher} of pseudoscience.
e.zh: 这位教授是有名的伪科学揭穿者。

e.en: Online {debunchers} target conspiracy theories every day.
e.zh: 网络戳穿者每天针对阴谋论进行揭露。

e.en: The {deburring} process improved the part's surface finish.
e.zh: 去毛刺工序改善了零件的表面光洁度。

e.en: He spent the morning {deburring} machined components.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在给加工件去毛刺。

debutanization.t: 脱丁烷；脱丁烷工艺过程

e.en: The refinery uses {debutanization} to remove butane.
e.zh: 炼油厂使用脱丁烷工艺去除丁烷。

e.en: Proper {debutanization} stabilizes the gasoline product.
e.zh: 妥当的脱丁烷使汽油产品保持稳定。

e.en: A {debutanizer} column separates lighter hydrocarbons.
e.zh: 脱丁烷塔分离较轻的烃类。

e.en: The new {debutanizer} improved overall yield.
e.zh: 新的脱丁烷塔提高了总产率。

e.en: He referred to each ten-year span as a {decad}.
e.zh: 他把每个十年阶段称作一旬。

e.en: The poet composed a {decad} of sonnets.
e.zh: 诗人创作了十首十四行诗。

e.en: Critics decried the {decadency} of the late empire.
e.zh: 评论家谴责帝国末期的颓废堕落。

e.en: His novels expose the moral {decadency} of society.
e.zh: 他的小说揭示了社会的道德颓败。

decaffeinate.t: 给（咖啡或茶）脱去咖啡因

e.en: Manufacturers {decaffeinate} the beans using carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 厂家使用二氧化碳给咖啡豆脱咖啡因。

e.en: Some teas are {decaffeinated} for evening drinking.
e.zh: 有些茶为晚间饮用而脱去了咖啡因。

decaffeinates.t: 脱去咖啡因（第三人称单数）

e.en: This new process gently {decaffeinates} green coffee beans.
e.zh: 这种新工艺温和地给生咖啡豆脱去咖啡因。

e.en: She {decaffeinates} her own beans at home.
e.zh: 她在家自己给咖啡豆脱咖啡因。

decaffeinating.t: 正在脱去咖啡因（现在分词）

e.en: The factory specializes in {decaffeinating} coffee beans.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门为咖啡豆脱去咖啡因。

e.en: They are {decaffeinating} the new tea blend now.
e.zh: 他们正在为新茶饮脱去咖啡因。

e.en: Swiss-water {decaffeination} preserves coffee flavor well.
e.zh: 瑞士水法脱咖啡因能很好保留咖啡风味。

e.en: {Decaffeination} reduces caffeine to trace levels.
e.zh: 脱咖啡因工艺将咖啡因降至微量水平。

e.en: A regular {decagon} has ten equal sides.
e.zh: 正十边形有十条相等的边。

e.en: The pavilion is built in the shape of a {decagon}.
e.zh: 那座亭子建成十边形。

e.en: The temple has a {decagonal} floor plan.
e.zh: 那座庙有十边形的平面布局。

e.en: He sketched a {decagonal} window frame.
e.zh: 他画了一个十边形的窗框草图。

e.en: Add one {decagram} of yeast to the dough.
e.zh: 在面团里加入十克酵母。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {decagrams} of butter.
e.zh: 食谱要求加入二十克黄油。

e.en: Botanists noted the {decagynous} flower's ten styles.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种十雌蕊花的十枚花柱。

e.en: A {decagynous} species was identified in the rainforest.
e.zh: 在雨林中发现了一种十雌蕊植物。

e.en: Geometric {decahedra} appear in many crystal structures.
e.zh: 十面体出现在许多晶体结构中。

e.en: The students built paper {decahedra} for class.
e.zh: 学生们为课堂制作了纸十面体。

decahedral.t: 十面体的；具有十个面的

e.en: The crystal showed a {decahedral} structure.
e.zh: 这种晶体呈十面体结构。

e.en: He drew a {decahedral} solid on the board.
e.zh: 他在黑板上画了一个十面体。

decahedron.t: 十面体；有十个面的多面体

e.en: A {decahedron} is a solid with ten faces.
e.zh: 十面体是有十个面的立体。

e.en: She folded a perfect paper {decahedron}.
e.zh: 她折出了一个完美的纸十面体。

e.en: The exhibit featured several wooden {decahedrons}.
e.zh: 展品中有几个木制十面体。

e.en: Children stacked colorful {decahedrons} in class.
e.zh: 孩子们在课堂上堆叠彩色十面体。

e.en: Industrial solvents include {decahydronaphthalene} and toluene.
e.zh: 工业溶剂包括十氢萘和甲苯。

e.en: {Decahydronaphthalene} is sold under the trade name decalin.
e.zh: 十氢萘以商品名癸烷出售。

decalage.t: 双翼夹角差；发展不同步现象

e.en: Biplane wings can have positive or negative {decalage}.
e.zh: 双翼飞机的机翼可有正或负的迎角差。

e.en: Piaget studied horizontal {decalage} in cognitive development.
e.zh: 皮亚杰研究认知发展中的水平不同步现象。

e.en: Acid causes the {decalcification} of teeth.
e.zh: 酸会导致牙齿脱钙。

e.en: {Decalcification} of bones signals osteoporosis.
e.zh: 骨骼脱钙是骨质疏松的信号。

decalcified.t: 已脱钙的；钙质流失了的

e.en: The {decalcified} eggshell became flexible and rubbery.
e.zh: 脱钙后的蛋壳变得柔韧富弹性。

e.en: Patients with {decalcified} bones break them easily.
e.zh: 骨骼脱钙的患者容易骨折。

decalcifies.t: 使脱钙；除去钙质（第三人称）

e.en: Lemon juice gradually {decalcifies} the bone sample.
e.zh: 柠檬汁逐渐让骨样本脱钙。

e.en: This solution {decalcifies} tissue for microscopy.
e.zh: 这种溶液给组织脱钙以备显微镜观察。

e.en: Vinegar can {decalcify} an eggshell overnight.
e.zh: 醋一夜之间就能让蛋壳脱钙。

e.en: Lab technicians {decalcify} bone samples for sectioning.
e.zh: 实验员给骨样本脱钙以便切片。

e.en: {Decalcomania} was a popular Victorian craft hobby.
e.zh: 贴花艺术是维多利亚时期流行的手工爱好。

e.en: The artist used {decalcomania} to transfer images onto wood.
e.zh: 艺术家用贴花技法将图像转印到木头上。

e.en: Steel exhibits {decalescence} during heating phase changes.
e.zh: 钢在加热相变过程中出现降温现象。

e.en: Smiths once used {decalescence} to gauge forging temperature.
e.zh: 铁匠曾用降温现象来判断锻造温度。

e.en: {Decalin} is widely used as an industrial solvent.
e.zh: 癸烷被广泛用作工业溶剂。

e.en: Researchers heated the sample in {decalin}.
e.zh: 研究人员在十氢萘中加热样品。

e.en: He bought a {decaliter} of cooking oil for the festival.
e.zh: 他为节日买了十升食用油。

e.en: The recipe called for two {decaliters} of broth.
e.zh: 食谱需要二十升高汤。

e.en: The barrel held one {decalitre} of cider.
e.zh: 这桶装着十升苹果酒。

e.en: Vendors measured wine by the {decalitre}.
e.zh: 商贩按十升计量葡萄酒。

e.en: He preached on the {decalog} every Sunday.
e.zh: 他每个周日都讲十诫。

e.en: The {decalog} forms the moral basis of Judaism.
e.zh: 十诫构成了犹太教的道德基础。

decamerous.t: 十基数的；以十为基数的

e.en: The flower is {decamerous}, with ten petals.
e.zh: 这种花是十基数的，有十枚花瓣。

e.en: Botanists classified the species as {decamerous}.
e.zh: 植物学家将该物种归为十基数植物。

e.en: The new bypass aims at traffic {decongestion} downtown.
e.zh: 新建的绕城路旨在缓解市中心交通拥堵。

e.en: Nasal {decongestion} sprays can offer quick relief.
e.zh: 鼻腔减充血喷雾可迅速缓解症状。

deconsecrate.t: 使（教堂等）失去神圣性；解除圣化

e.en: The diocese voted to {deconsecrate} the old chapel.
e.zh: 教区投票决定将这座旧礼拜堂解除圣化。

e.en: They had to {deconsecrate} the church before selling it.
e.zh: 他们必须先解除教堂的圣化才能将其出售。

deconsecrated.t: 已解除圣化的；已还俗的

e.en: The {deconsecrated} church now houses a bookstore.
e.zh: 这座已解除圣化的教堂如今是一家书店。

e.en: They live in a beautifully restored {deconsecrated} chapel.
e.zh: 他们住在一座修缮精美、已还俗的礼拜堂里。

e.en: The bishop formally {deconsecrates} the abandoned cathedral.
e.zh: 主教正式解除了这座废弃大教堂的圣化。

e.en: A short ceremony {deconsecrates} the chapel each year.
e.zh: 每年一场简短的仪式将那座礼拜堂解除圣化。

e.en: They are {deconsecrating} the chapel before demolition.
e.zh: 他们正在拆除前将礼拜堂解除圣化。

e.en: The priest is {deconsecrating} the altar today.
e.zh: 神父今天正在为祭坛解除圣化。

e.en: The {deconsecration} of the church drew local protests.
e.zh: 教堂的解除圣化仪式引发了当地的抗议。

e.en: After {deconsecration}, the building became a museum.
e.zh: 解除圣化后，这栋建筑改建成了博物馆。

deconstructivist.t: 解构主义的；解构主义者

e.en: The museum is a famous {deconstructivist} building.
e.zh: 这座博物馆是著名的解构主义建筑。

e.en: She admires {deconstructivist} architects like Gehry.
e.zh: 她欣赏盖里这样的解构主义建筑师。

e.en: Workers sprayed a {decontaminant} on the affected floor.
e.zh: 工人们在受污染的地面喷洒去污剂。

e.en: The lab keeps a powerful {decontaminant} on hand.
e.zh: 实验室常备一种强力净化剂。

e.en: The {decontaminator} cleans tools after each operation.
e.zh: 这台净化装置在每次手术后清洁器械。

e.en: He worked as a {decontaminator} at the nuclear site.
e.zh: 他在那座核设施担任去污员。

e.en: Critics say the quote {decontextualize} her real meaning.
e.zh: 批评人士说这一引文使她的本意脱离了语境。

e.en: Don't {decontextualize} his remarks to score points.
e.zh: 不要为了攻击而把他的话脱离语境。

e.en: We {deconvolve} the signal to recover the original waveform.
e.zh: 我们对信号进行反卷积以还原原始波形。

e.en: Software can {deconvolve} blurred microscope images.
e.zh: 软件可以对模糊的显微镜图像进行反卷积处理。

e.en: Doctors administered drugs for {decorporation} of plutonium.
e.zh: 医生使用药物以排出体内的钚。

e.en: Rapid {decorporation} therapy reduces long-term risk.
e.zh: 快速的体内排出治疗能降低长期风险。

decorrelator.t: 去相关器（信号处理装置）

e.en: The audio system uses a {decorrelator} for stereo width.
e.zh: 该音频系统使用去相关器拓宽立体声。

e.en: Engineers added a {decorrelator} to reduce echo.
e.zh: 工程师加入去相关器以减少回声。

e.en: The mill must {decorticate} the seeds before pressing.
e.zh: 工厂必须先给种子剥皮再压榨。

e.en: Surgeons sometimes {decorticate} the lung to restore function.
e.zh: 外科医生有时会剥除肺表层以恢复功能。

decorticated.t: 已去皮的；已剥除皮质的

e.en: They sell {decorticated} sesame seeds in bulk.
e.zh: 他们大量出售去皮的芝麻。

e.en: The patient was left {decorticated} after surgery.
e.zh: 病人术后处于去皮质状态。

e.en: The machine {decorticates} the rice husks efficiently.
e.zh: 这台机器能高效地剥除稻壳。

e.en: This enzyme {decorticates} the bean coat easily.
e.zh: 这种酶能轻松去除豆皮。

e.en: Farmers bought a new {decorticator} for hemp processing.
e.zh: 农民购置了一台新剥皮机来处理大麻。

e.en: The {decorticator} broke down during harvest season.
e.zh: 那台脱壳机在收获季节坏了。

decreation.t: 反创造；自我消解（神学/哲学概念）

e.en: Weil's idea of {decreation} fascinates many readers.
e.zh: 薇依关于反创造的思想令许多读者着迷。

e.en: The poem explores themes of {decreation} and grace.
e.zh: 这首诗探讨了反创造与恩典的主题。

e.en: The president issued a {decree-law} to address the crisis.
e.zh: 总统颁布了一项法令以应对危机。

e.en: Parliament later overturned the controversial {decree-law}.
e.zh: 议会随后推翻了那项有争议的法令。

decreeable.t: 可作为法令颁布的；可裁定的

e.en: The matter is hardly {decreeable} without further evidence.
e.zh: 没有更多证据，此事很难裁定。

e.en: Such reforms are not easily {decreeable} by one minister.
e.zh: 这样的改革不是一位部长就能轻易颁布的。

e.en: The court issued a final {decreet} against the debtor.
e.zh: 法院对债务人作出了最终判决书。

e.en: He appealed the {decreet} within the allowed period.
e.zh: 他在规定期限内对该判决书提起上诉。

e.en: Salt crystals {decrepitate} loudly when thrown into fire.
e.zh: 盐晶体投入火中会爆裂作响。

e.en: Some minerals {decrepitate} as they lose water.
e.zh: 一些矿物在失水时会爆裂。

decrepitated.t: 已爆裂的；经过焙烧爆裂处理的

e.en: The {decrepitated} crystals were then ground to powder.
e.zh: 经爆裂处理的晶体随后被磨成粉末。

e.en: He examined the {decrepitated} salt under the microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下观察那些已爆裂的盐粒。

e.en: Rock salt {decrepitates} sharply over the open flame.
e.zh: 岩盐在明火上会发出尖锐的爆裂声。

e.en: The mineral {decrepitates} as moisture escapes.
e.zh: 水分逸出时矿物会爆裂作响。

e.en: The crystals were {decrepitating} loudly in the crucible.
e.zh: 坩埚中的晶体正在大声爆裂。

e.en: You could hear the salt {decrepitating} in the fire.
e.zh: 你能听到盐在火中爆裂作响。

decrepitation.t: 焙烧爆裂；受热爆裂作用

e.en: {Decrepitation} of the salt produced sharp popping sounds.
e.zh: 盐的爆裂产生了尖锐的劈啪声。

e.en: Geologists study {decrepitation} to estimate fluid inclusions.
e.zh: 地质学家研究焙烧爆裂以估算流体包裹体。

e.en: A {decrescent} moon hung low over the hills.
e.zh: 一弯亏缺的残月低悬在群山之上。

e.en: The music ends on a long {decrescent} chord.
e.zh: 乐曲在一个长长的渐弱和弦中结束。

e.en: The pope's {decretal} settled the doctrinal dispute.
e.zh: 教皇的训令解决了那场教义争端。

e.en: Medieval lawyers studied collections of papal {decretal}s.
e.zh: 中世纪法学家研究教皇训令的汇编。

e.en: The king issued a {decretive} order banning duels.
e.zh: 国王颁布了一道禁止决斗的命令。

e.en: Theologians distinguish God's {decretive} will from His preceptive will.
e.zh: 神学家区分上帝的命定旨意与诫命旨意。

e.en: The judge made a {decretory} pronouncement on the case.
e.zh: 法官就此案作出了裁决性的宣告。

e.en: That was a {decretory} moment in the country's history.
e.zh: 那是这个国家历史上具有决定意义的时刻。

e.en: Her {decrial} of the policy made headlines.
e.zh: 她对该政策的谴责登上了头条。

e.en: There was widespread {decrial} of the new tax.
e.zh: 新税收引发了广泛谴责。

e.en: He became a vocal {decrier} of corporate greed.
e.zh: 他成为大声谴责企业贪婪的人。

e.en: Even her usual {decrier}s admitted the plan worked.
e.zh: 连一向非难她的人也承认这个计划奏效了。

e.en: They campaigned for the {decriminalisation} of cannabis.
e.zh: 他们为大麻除罪化展开运动。

e.en: The {decriminalisation} of the offense was widely debated.
e.zh: 该罪行的非刑罪化引发了广泛讨论。

e.en: Several countries plan to {decriminalise} small drug possession.
e.zh: 几个国家计划将少量持有毒品非罪化。

e.en: Activists urged lawmakers to {decriminalise} sex work.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促立法者将性工作非罪化。

e.en: The rebels sought to {decrown} the unpopular king.
e.zh: 叛军试图废黜这位不得民心的国王。

e.en: Parliament moved to {decrown} the disgraced monarch.
e.zh: 议会着手废黜这位名誉扫地的君主。

e.en: {Decrustation} of the boiler restored its efficiency.
e.zh: 锅炉除垢恢复了它的效率。

e.en: The cleaning crew handled the {decrustation} of the pipes.
e.zh: 清洁工负责清除管道内的硬壳。

e.en: Colonization led to severe {deculturation} of the indigenous people.
e.zh: 殖民统治导致了原住民严重的文化丧失。

e.en: Scholars debate the long-term effects of {deculturation}.
e.zh: 学者们争论去文化化的长期影响。

e.en: The factory machine {decoils} steel from large reels.
e.zh: 工厂的机器把大卷的钢材展开。

e.en: Operators {decoil} the wire before feeding it into the cutter.
e.zh: 操作员把铁丝展开后送入切割机。

e.en: The {decoiler} feeds metal sheets into the press.
e.zh: 开卷机把金属板送入冲压机。

e.en: Each {decoiler} on the line handles ten tonnes of steel.
e.zh: 生产线上每台开卷机能处理十吨钢材。

e.en: The mechanic had to {decoke} the engine cylinders.
e.zh: 技师不得不清除发动机汽缸里的积碳。

e.en: Old steam engines needed regular crews to {decoke} them.
e.zh: 旧式蒸汽机需要专人定期清除积炭。

decoked.t: 已清除积碳的；除过焦的

e.en: Workers {decoked} the furnace last weekend.
e.zh: 工人们上周末清除了炉子里的积碳。

e.en: Once we {decoked} the boiler, efficiency rose sharply.
e.zh: 我们清除锅炉里的积炭后，效率大幅提高。

e.en: He {decokes} the pipe before each long voyage.
e.zh: 每次远航前他都会给管道除焦。

e.en: Maintenance staff routinely {decokes} the diesel engine.
e.zh: 维修人员定期清除柴油机的积碳。

e.en: The plant scheduled a full {decoking} of the cracker unit.
e.zh: 工厂安排对裂解装置进行彻底除焦。

e.en: Routine {decoking} extends the life of the equipment.
e.zh: 定期除焦能延长设备的使用寿命。

e.en: The martyr was {decollated} on the city square.
e.zh: 殉道者在城市广场上被斩首。

e.en: Workers {decollated} the carbon copies into separate stacks.
e.zh: 工人将复写副本分成不同的堆。

e.en: The machine {decollates} carbon-copy sets neatly.
e.zh: 这台机器能整齐地分开复写纸副本。

e.en: This machine quickly {decollates} the printout sets.
e.zh: 这台机器能迅速把打印副本分开。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {decollating} stacks of invoices.
e.zh: 她花了一下午把发票分开。

e.en: He stood by the printer, {decollating} the long forms.
e.zh: 他站在打印机旁，把长长的表单分开。

e.en: The painting depicts the {decollation} of the saint.
e.zh: 画作描绘的是这位圣人被斩首的场面。

e.en: The {decollation} of John the Baptist is a religious feast.
e.zh: 施洗约翰被斩首之日是一个宗教节日。

e.en: We bought a new {decollator} for the printing room.
e.zh: 我们给印刷室买了一台新的分页机。

e.en: The old {decollator} jammed in the middle of the run.
e.zh: 那台旧分页机在工作中卡住了。

e.en: She wore a {decollete} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一件低胸礼服参加晚会。

e.en: The dress had a daring {decollete} neckline.
e.zh: 这件礼服有大胆的低胸领口。

e.en: Lens defects caused the beam's {decollimation}.
e.zh: 透镜缺陷导致光束失去准直。

e.en: Vibration in the mount caused beam {decollimation}.
e.zh: 支架振动导致光束失准直。

e.en: African {decolonisation} accelerated after the war.
e.zh: 战后非洲的去殖民化进程加快了。

e.en: Many countries achieved {decolonisation} in the 1960s.
e.zh: 许多国家在二十世纪六十年代实现了非殖民化。

e.en: Strong sunlight will {decolor} the upholstery.
e.zh: 强烈的阳光会使家具的布面褪色。

e.en: Repeated washes will {decolor} the dark jeans.
e.zh: 反复清洗会使深色牛仔裤褪色。

e.en: Add a small amount of {decolorant} to the solution.
e.zh: 在溶液中加入少量脱色剂。

e.en: The lab tested a new {decolorant} for industrial use.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一种新的工业用脱色剂。

e.en: Charcoal can {decolorise} sugar syrup effectively.
e.zh: 活性炭能有效地使糖浆脱色。

e.en: We use activated carbon to {decolorise} crude oil samples.
e.zh: 我们用活性炭使原油样品脱色。

e.en: The chemist added a pinch of {decolorite} to the flask.
e.zh: 化学家在烧瓶中加入少许脱色剂。

e.en: Industrial {decolorite} powders clarify dye solutions.
e.zh: 工业脱色剂粉末能澄清染料溶液。

e.en: Bleach is used to {decolorize} stained linens.
e.zh: 漂白剂用来使污渍床单脱色。

e.en: Hydrogen peroxide can {decolorize} stained surfaces.
e.zh: 双氧水可以使有污渍的表面脱色。

e.en: He added a {decolorizer} to clarify the wine.
e.zh: 他加入脱色剂使葡萄酒澄清。

e.en: The plant added a {decolorizer} to the wastewater stream.
e.zh: 工厂在废水流中加入了脱色剂。

e.en: Hot water can {decolour} delicate fabrics.
e.zh: 热水会使细腻的布料褪色。

e.en: Strong sunlight will {decolour} the curtains.
e.zh: 强烈的阳光会使窗帘褪色。

e.en: Apply a mild {decolourant} to the silk.
e.zh: 给丝绸涂一层温和的脱色剂。

e.en: She poured a few drops of {decolourant} into the basin.
e.zh: 她在盆里倒了几滴脱色剂。

e.en: The curtains were {decoloured} by years of sun.
e.zh: 窗帘被多年的阳光晒得褪了色。

e.en: The old painting had {decoloured} after centuries.
e.zh: 这幅古画历经数百年已经褪色。

e.en: The chemist studied the {decolouring} process closely.
e.zh: 化学家仔细研究了脱色过程。

e.en: Industrial {decolouring} agents are tightly regulated.
e.zh: 工业脱色剂受到严格管制。

e.en: Bone char can {decolourise} crude sugar.
e.zh: 骨炭可以使粗糖脱色。

e.en: Sugar refiners {decolourise} syrup using bone char.
e.zh: 糖精炼厂使用骨炭使糖浆脱色。

e.en: This filter {decolourises} the water within minutes.
e.zh: 这种过滤器几分钟内就能让水脱色。

e.en: The new resin {decolourises} oils faster than charcoal.
e.zh: 新型树脂使油脱色比木炭还要快。

e.en: Chemists {decolourize} the solution with activated carbon.
e.zh: 化学家用活性炭使溶液脱色。

e.en: Workers {decolourize} the cloth before printing patterns.
e.zh: 工人在印花前先给布料脱色。

e.en: Bleach quickly {decolours} dark cotton.
e.zh: 漂白剂很快就能使深色棉布褪色。

e.en: Acid spills {decolours} the lab benches over time.
e.zh: 酸溅出来会让实验台慢慢褪色。

decometer.t: 台卡导航接收仪；相位测距仪

e.en: Old ships still carried a {decometer} for navigation.
e.zh: 老式船只仍然配备一种台卡导航接收仪用于定位。

e.en: The {decometer} dial showed the lane number clearly.
e.zh: 导航仪的刻度盘清晰显示出航道编号。

e.en: The {decommitment} ceremony marked her departure.
e.zh: 解除承诺的仪式标志着她的离开。

e.en: Their {decommitment} from the alliance shocked allies.
e.zh: 他们退出联盟的决定让盟友们震惊。

e.en: He {decommitted} from the project after the dispute.
e.zh: 争执后他撤回了对项目的承诺。

e.en: She {decommitted} from the conference at the last moment.
e.zh: 最后一刻她取消了出席会议的承诺。

e.en: Patients with heart failure may suddenly {decompensate}.
e.zh: 心衰病人可能会突然出现失代偿。

e.en: Without medication, the patient could {decompensate} quickly.
e.zh: 没有药物治疗，病人可能很快出现失代偿。

e.en: Doctors monitored her closely for signs of {decompensation}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察她是否出现失代偿迹象。

e.en: Cardiac {decompensation} requires immediate hospital care.
e.zh: 心脏失代偿需要立即住院治疗。

e.en: Engineers tested the material's {decomposability} in soil.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种材料在土壤中的可分解性。

e.en: The {decomposability} of plastics varies hugely by type.
e.zh: 塑料的可降解性因类型不同差异很大。

e.en: We need {decomposable} packaging for the products.
e.zh: 我们需要可分解的产品包装。

e.en: We chose {decomposable} cutlery for the picnic.
e.zh: 我们选了可分解的餐具去野餐。

decomposite.t: 多回复叶的；再次复合的

e.en: The botanist examined a {decomposite} leaf structure.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了一种多回复叶的叶片结构。

e.en: Some ferns produce {decomposite} fronds with fine divisions.
e.zh: 有些蕨类植物长出多回复叶，分裂细密。

e.en: The fern displayed a {decompound} frond pattern.
e.zh: 这种蕨类植物的叶子呈多回复叶式。

e.en: Mathematicians sometimes {decompound} an equation into simpler parts.
e.zh: 数学家有时把方程分解成更简单的部分。

e.en: He {decompounded} the chemical mixture for analysis.
e.zh: 他将化合物分解开来以便分析。

e.en: The botanist drew a {decompounded} leaf for her notes.
e.zh: 植物学家在笔记上画了一片多回复叶。

e.en: She is {decompounding} the formula step by step.
e.zh: 她正在一步步分解这个化学式。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {decompounding} the chemical formulas.
e.zh: 他花了一下午分解这些化学式。

e.en: A {decompressor} eased the pressure inside the tank.
e.zh: 减压器减轻了罐内的压力。

e.en: Divers rely on a {decompressor} to surface safely.
e.zh: 潜水员靠减压装置安全上浮。

e.en: The plan aims to {deconcentrate} wealth across regions.
e.zh: 该计划旨在将财富分散到各地区。

e.en: The reform sought to {deconcentrate} authority among regions.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在把权力分散到各地区。

e.en: The reform pushed for {deconcentration} of power.
e.zh: 这项改革推动权力的分散。

e.en: Industry {deconcentration} can boost competition.
e.zh: 产业的分散化能促进竞争。

decondition.t: 使体能下降；使适应能力减弱

e.en: Long bed rest can {decondition} an athlete quickly.
e.zh: 长期卧床会很快使运动员体能下降。

e.en: Weeks in space {decondition} the muscles severely.
e.zh: 在太空待数周会严重削弱肌肉机能。

deconditioned.t: 体能衰退的；适应能力下降的

e.en: After the illness, she felt completely {deconditioned}.
e.zh: 病后她感到体能完全衰退。

e.en: The {deconditioned} runner needed months to recover.
e.zh: 这位体能下降的跑者花了几个月才恢复。

e.en: New roads should {decongest} the city center.
e.zh: 新道路应该能缓解市中心的交通拥堵。

e.en: Bypass roads were built to {decongest} the highway.
e.zh: 为缓解高速公路拥堵修建了绕行路。

decivilize.t: 使非文明化；使丧失教化

e.en: Critics argued that the prolonged war would {decivilize} an entire generation.
e.zh: 评论者认为旷日持久的战争会让整整一代人丧失文明素养。

e.en: They feared that constant cruelty in the media might {decivilize} young viewers.
e.zh: 他们担心媒体中持续的残忍内容会使年轻观众变得野蛮。

deck-chair.t: 折叠躺椅；甲板上的帆布躺椅

e.en: She fell asleep in a {deck-chair} beside the hotel pool.
e.zh: 她在酒店泳池边的躺椅上睡着了。

e.en: We unfolded the striped {deck-chairs} on the lawn.
e.zh: 我们在草坪上展开那几张条纹躺椅。

deck-edged.t: 飞行甲板边缘的；舷侧安装的

e.en: The carrier's {deck-edged} elevator lifted planes up from the hangar.
e.zh: 航母的舷侧升降机把飞机从机库提升上来。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the {deck-edged} platform for greater safety.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了舷侧平台以提高安全性。

deck-hand.t: 甲板水手；船上做杂活的普通船员

e.en: He worked as a {deck-hand} on a small fishing boat.
e.zh: 他在一艘小渔船上当甲板水手。

e.en: The young {deck-hand} scrubbed the deck every morning.
e.zh: 那位年轻的水手每天早上都擦洗甲板。

deck-house.t: 船上的甲板室；舱面建筑物

e.en: The captain stood smoking outside the {deck-house}.
e.zh: 船长在甲板室外面抽着烟。

e.en: Cargo and equipment were stored beside the {deck-house}.
e.zh: 货物和设备堆放在舱面建筑物旁边。

deck-mounting.t: 甲板安装；台面式安装方式

e.en: The new faucet uses simple {deck-mounting} on the countertop.
e.zh: 新水龙头采用简单的台面式安装。

e.en: All {deck-mounting} hardware comes included in the box.
e.zh: 所有台面安装配件都随箱附带。

deckel.t: 造纸用的纸边框；造纸机夹板

e.en: The papermaker carefully lifted the {deckel} from the mold.
e.zh: 造纸工人小心地从纸模上取下纸边框。

e.en: A wooden {deckel} shapes the rough edge of handmade paper.
e.zh: 木制夹板塑造出手工纸的毛边。

deckhouse.t: 船舶甲板上的舱室；舱面建筑

e.en: Smoke poured from the burning {deckhouse}.
e.zh: 浓烟从燃烧的甲板舱室冒出。

e.en: The radio room was located inside the {deckhouse}.
e.zh: 无线电室设在舱面建筑内。

deckie.t: 口语中的甲板水手；普通船员

e.en: The young {deckie} hauled in the heavy mooring line.
e.zh: 年轻的水手拉上沉重的系泊缆。

e.en: He started his career as a {deckie} on a North Sea trawler.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯始于北海拖网渔船的甲板水手。

deckle-edged.t: 纸张边缘呈毛边的；未经裁齐的

e.en: She wrote the invitation on {deckle-edged} stationery.
e.zh: 她在毛边信纸上写下请柬。

e.en: The poetry book had beautifully {deckle-edged} pages.
e.zh: 那本诗集的纸页有漂亮的毛边。

declad.t: 去除外层包覆；剥除外墙覆面

e.en: Workers had to {declad} the reactor pipes for inspection.
e.zh: 工人不得不剥除反应堆管道的外层进行检查。

e.en: The old building was {declad} to expose the original brickwork.
e.zh: 老建筑被剥除外墙以显露原有的砖砌结构。

declarable.t: 可申报的；可正式宣布的

e.en: All {declarable} items must be listed on the customs form.
e.zh: 所有应申报物品必须列在海关申报表上。

e.en: The interest income is {declarable} as taxable earnings.
e.zh: 该利息收入需作为应税所得申报。

e.en: The {declarant} signed the affidavit before the notary.
e.zh: 声明人在公证员面前签署了书面陈述。

e.en: Each {declarant} must provide proof of identity at the counter.
e.zh: 每位申报人都必须在柜台出示身份证明。

declaratorily.t: 以宣告方式；以正式声明方式

e.en: The court ruled {declaratorily} on the validity of the contract.
e.zh: 法院就合同效力作出了宣告性判决。

e.en: He spoke {declaratorily}, leaving no room for dissent.
e.zh: 他以宣告的口吻发言,容不得反驳。

declass.t: 使降低社会等级；使丧失阶级地位

e.en: Industrial decline {declassed} thousands of skilled workers.
e.zh: 工业衰退让成千上万的技术工人丧失了原有阶级地位。

e.en: The reform threatened to {declass} the old landed gentry.
e.zh: 这项改革有可能让旧式地主阶层降级。

declasse.t: 降级的；社会地位下降的

e.en: He felt distinctly {declasse} after losing his managerial post.
e.zh: 丢掉管理职位后,他明显感到地位下降。

e.en: Her family had become {declasse} during the long depression.
e.zh: 在漫长的大萧条中,她的家庭已沦落了社会地位。

declaw.t: 给动物去除爪子；削弱其威力

e.en: Many vets now refuse to {declaw} cats on ethical grounds.
e.zh: 出于伦理考虑,许多兽医如今拒绝给猫去爪。

e.en: The new bill would effectively {declaw} the regulatory agency.
e.zh: 这项新法案实际上会让监管机构丧失威慑力。

declensional.t: 词形变化的；与变格相关的

e.en: Latin students must memorize all the {declensional} endings.
e.zh: 学拉丁语的学生必须背熟所有变格词尾。

e.en: The textbook lists every {declensional} pattern in a chart.
e.zh: 这本教材用表格列出每一种变格形式。

declimatization.t: 丧失气候适应能力；脱适应过程

e.en: Astronauts can experience {declimatization} after returning to Earth.
e.zh: 宇航员返回地球后可能会经历脱适应。

e.en: Long indoor work can cause {declimatization} to cold weather.
e.zh: 长期室内工作会导致对寒冷气候失去适应力。

declinable.t: 可词形变化的；可被拒绝的

e.en: Latin nouns are {declinable} according to grammatical case.
e.zh: 拉丁语名词根据语法格而发生变化。

e.en: The job offer is {declinable} without any penalty.
e.zh: 这份工作邀请可以无任何代价地拒绝。

declinate.t: 向下弯曲的；俯垂下倾的

e.en: The flower had long {declinate} stamens curving outward.
e.zh: 那朵花有着向外俯垂的长雄蕊。

e.en: Some willow species feature gracefully {declinate} branches.
e.zh: 某些柳树品种有优雅下垂的枝条。

declinational.t: 偏角的；与磁偏角有关的

e.en: The compass shows clear {declinational} variation in this region.
e.zh: 在这一地区,罗盘显示出明显的磁偏角变化。

e.en: Astronomers carefully calculated the {declinational} shift.
e.zh: 天文学家仔细计算了赤纬偏移。

declinator.t: 测量磁偏角的仪器；磁偏计

e.en: Surveyors used a {declinator} to find true north accurately.
e.zh: 测量员用磁偏计来精确测定真北方向。

e.en: The {declinator} measured the magnetic deviation aboard ship.
e.zh: 该磁偏计测量了船上的磁偏差。

declinatory.t: 拒绝的；具有推辞性质的

e.en: He filed a {declinatory} plea before the trial began.
e.zh: 他在开庭前提出了管辖权异议。

e.en: Her tone was politely {declinatory} but unmistakably firm.
e.zh: 她的语气虽然客气却明显是拒绝的。

declinature.t: 正式拒绝；婉言推辞之举

e.en: His {declinature} of the ambassadorship surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他婉拒大使一职令所有人都很意外。

e.en: The company sent a formal {declinature} of the merger proposal.
e.zh: 公司正式发函拒绝了这项合并提议。

declinism.t: 衰落论思想；衰退主义观点

e.en: The book sharply criticizes American {declinism} in the media.
e.zh: 该书尖锐批评了美国媒体上的衰落论调。

e.en: {Declinism} has become a popular narrative among pundits.
e.zh: 衰退主义已成为评论员中流行的叙事。

declinist.t: 信奉衰落论者；衰退主义者

e.en: {Declinists} predict the empire's collapse within a few decades.
e.zh: 衰落论者预言这个帝国将在几十年内崩溃。

e.en: She is no {declinist}; she remains stubbornly optimistic.
e.zh: 她绝不是衰落论者,她依然固执地保持乐观。

declinometer.t: 磁偏角测量仪器；测斜仪

e.en: The ship's {declinometer} corrected the compass heading.
e.zh: 船上的磁偏计修正了罗盘航向。

e.en: He calibrated the {declinometer} carefully before sailing.
e.zh: 他在出航前仔细校准了磁偏计。

declivate.t: 向下倾斜的；下斜走向的

e.en: The rough path took a sharply {declivate} turn into the valley.
e.zh: 那条崎岖的小径急剧下倾,转入山谷。

e.en: The cottage roof had a strongly {declivate} angle to shed snow.
e.zh: 小屋的屋顶有一个明显的下倾角度以便落雪。

declivitous.t: 陡峭向下倾斜的；下坡陡峻的

e.en: The {declivitous} road wound steeply down the mountainside.
e.zh: 那条陡峻下倾的公路沿山坡蜿蜒而下。

e.en: Hikers struggled along the {declivitous} forest trail.
e.zh: 徒步者沿着陡峭下坡的林间小径艰难行走。

declivous.t: 向下倾斜的；下坡走向的

e.en: The garden ended in a gently {declivous} slope toward the river.
e.zh: 花园在朝河流方向缓缓下倾的斜坡处结束。

e.en: Water rushed quickly down the {declivous} stone channel.
e.zh: 水沿着下倾的石砌水道飞快流下。

declot.t: 溶解血栓；去除凝块阻塞

e.en: Doctors used special medication to {declot} the blocked artery.
e.zh: 医生用特效药物溶解了堵塞动脉的血栓。

e.en: The procedure aims to {declot} small blood vessels in the leg.
e.zh: 该手术旨在清除腿部小血管中的血栓。

declutch.t: 脱开离合器；分离离合装置

e.en: Always remember to {declutch} before changing gears smoothly.
e.zh: 换挡前一定要记得先分离离合器。

e.en: He had to {declutch} quickly to avoid stalling on the hill.
e.zh: 他不得不迅速踩离合,以免在坡上熄火。

declutched.t: 已脱开离合器；分离了离合装置

e.en: She {declutched} smoothly and slowed for the corner.
e.zh: 她平稳地踩下离合器,减速准备过弯。

e.en: The driver {declutched} just as the engine began to rev.
e.zh: 就在发动机开始拉高转速时司机踩下了离合器。

declutches.t: 脱开离合器；分离离合的现在式单数

e.en: The driver {declutches} every time he shifts up a gear.
e.zh: 司机每次升档时都会踩下离合器。

e.en: She {declutches} carefully before braking on the steep descent.
e.zh: 在陡坡下行刹车前,她小心地分离离合器。

declutching.t: 脱开离合器的动作；分离离合操作

e.en: {Declutching} smoothly between gears takes considerable practice.
e.zh: 换挡时平稳踩离合需要相当多的练习。

e.en: Double-{declutching} is a useful technique on older trucks.
e.zh: 在较旧的卡车上,两脚离合是一种实用技巧。

decoat.t: 去除涂层；脱除表面覆膜

e.en: Workers must thoroughly {decoat} the metal before repainting it.
e.zh: 工人必须彻底去除金属上的涂层才能重新喷漆。

e.en: A chemical bath will gently {decoat} the delicate components.
e.zh: 化学浴可以温和地脱除精密部件上的涂层。

e.en: The silkworms {decocoon} once they have fully matured.
e.zh: 蚕完全成熟后就会破茧而出。

e.en: After years of isolation she felt finally ready to {decocoon}.
e.zh: 在多年的封闭后,她终于感觉准备好破茧而出了。

e.en: Traditional herbalists {decoct} dried roots to make medicine.
e.zh: 传统草药师将干根煎煮成汤药。

e.en: You must {decoct} the willow bark for at least an hour.
e.zh: 你必须把柳树皮煎煮至少一小时。

decocted.t: 经过煎煮的；熬制提取出来的

e.en: The freshly {decocted} liquid had a strikingly bitter taste.
e.zh: 刚煎好的汤药味道异常苦涩。

e.en: She slowly drank the {decocted} herbal brew before bed.
e.zh: 睡前她慢慢喝下熬好的草药汤。

decocts.t: 煎煮提取（现在式单数）；熬药

e.en: The pharmacy {decocts} traditional Chinese herbs every morning.
e.zh: 这家药房每天早上煎煮中药材。

e.en: He carefully {decocts} the willow bark for natural pain relief.
e.zh: 他精心煎煮柳树皮来天然止痛。

decohere.t: 失去量子相干性；发生退相干

e.en: Quantum states quickly {decohere} when they interact with the environment.
e.zh: 量子态在与环境相互作用时会迅速退相干。

e.en: The qubits will {decohere} if the system warms up even slightly.
e.zh: 系统稍微升温,量子比特就会退相干。

decoherence.t: 量子退相干现象；失相干过程

e.en: {Decoherence} remains a major obstacle in building quantum computers.
e.zh: 退相干仍是制造量子计算机的一大障碍。

e.en: Engineers fight {decoherence} by cooling the chips to near absolute zero.
e.zh: 工程师将芯片冷却到近绝对零度以对抗退相干。

decoherer.t: 退相干装置；早期无线电的解相干器

e.en: Early wireless receivers used a {decoherer} to reset the coherer.
e.zh: 早期无线电接收机用解相干器复位检波器。

e.en: The {decoherer} tapped the coherer to restore its sensitivity.
e.zh: 解相干器轻敲检波器以恢复其灵敏度。

decohesion.t: 失去粘合力；材料脱粘现象

e.en: Material {decohesion} can rapidly lead to structural failure.
e.zh: 材料脱粘可能迅速导致结构破坏。

e.en: Engineers studied the {decohesion} of layers in the composite panel.
e.zh: 工程师研究了复合板各层之间的脱粘现象。

e.en: His sudden {decession} from the council surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他突然从议会退出，令众人惊讶。

e.en: The {decession} of the bishop was formally announced.
e.zh: 主教的离任已正式宣布。

dechlorinate.t: 除去水中的氯气；脱氯处理

e.en: We must {dechlorinate} the water before adding fish.
e.zh: 加鱼之前必须把水脱氯。

e.en: Activated carbon can {dechlorinate} tap water effectively.
e.zh: 活性炭能有效给自来水脱氯。

dechlorination.t: 脱氯作用；除去氯气的过程

e.en: The {dechlorination} of pool water requires careful chemistry.
e.zh: 泳池水的脱氯需要细致的化学处理。

e.en: Industrial {dechlorination} reduces serious environmental risks today.
e.zh: 工业脱氯如今降低了严重的环境风险。

dechlorophyllization.t: 脱叶绿素作用；除去叶绿素的过程

e.en: The {dechlorophyllization} of leaves occurs in autumn.
e.zh: 叶子在秋天发生脱叶绿素作用。

e.en: Chemists studied the {dechlorophyllization} of fresh spinach.
e.zh: 化学家研究了新鲜菠菜的脱叶绿素过程。

dechristianize.t: 使去基督教化；削弱基督教影响

e.en: The revolutionaries tried to {dechristianize} public life.
e.zh: 革命者试图使公共生活去基督教化。

e.en: Few movements truly {dechristianize} an entire culture.
e.zh: 很少有运动真正能让整个文化去基督教化。

dechristianized.t: 已去基督教化的；被去基督教化的

e.en: Many holidays were {dechristianized} after the revolution.
e.zh: 革命后许多节日被去基督教化。

e.en: The {dechristianized} village rejected the old festivals.
