e.zh: 这个去基督教化的村庄抛弃了旧节庆。

dechristianizing.t: 正在去基督教化；削弱基督教化

e.en: The regime was steadily {dechristianizing} the schools.
e.zh: 该政权正稳步使学校去基督教化。

e.en: {Dechristianizing} an entire culture takes generations.
e.zh: 让整个文化去基督教化需要几代人时间。

dechromisation.t: 脱铬作用；除去铬元素的过程

e.en: Industrial waste requires careful {dechromisation} before disposal.
e.zh: 工业废料处理前需要仔细脱铬。

e.en: Researchers developed cheaper methods of {dechromisation}.
e.zh: 研究人员开发了更便宜的脱铬方法。

deciare.t: 公亩的十分之一；十平方米

e.en: Each {deciare} equals exactly ten square metres.
e.zh: 每分艾尔正好等于十平方米。

e.en: Old French records list land in {deciares}.
e.zh: 旧法国地契用分艾尔来记录地块。

decibar.t: 分巴；十分之一巴的压力单位

e.en: Ocean depth is often expressed in {decibars}.
e.zh: 海洋深度常用分巴来表示。

e.en: One {decibar} corresponds to roughly one metre of seawater.
e.zh: 一分巴大约相当于一米海水深度。

e.en: The technician used a {decibelmeter} to check noise levels.
e.zh: 技术员用分贝计检查噪声水平。

e.en: A pocket {decibelmeter} can warn you of harmful sound.
e.zh: 便携分贝计可以提醒你噪声是否有害。

e.en: Whether the program halts is not always {decidable}.
e.zh: 程序是否会停机并非总是可判定的。

e.en: The court ruled the case fully {decidable} under existing law.
e.zh: 法院裁定该案完全可依现行法律裁决。

e.en: His {decidophobia} made even ordering coffee an ordeal.
e.zh: 他的决策恐惧症让连点咖啡都成了煎熬。

e.en: Therapists sometimes treat {decidophobia} with small daily choices.
e.zh: 心理医师有时通过日常小决定来治疗决策恐惧症。

e.en: After childbirth, the {decidua} is shed from the uterus.
e.zh: 分娩后蜕膜会从子宫中脱落。

e.en: The embryo implants into the {decidua} of the womb.
e.zh: 胚胎着床于子宫蜕膜中。

e.en: Most placental mammals are {deciduate} animals.
e.zh: 大多数胎盘哺乳动物属于有蜕膜动物。

e.en: {Deciduate} placentas leave maternal tissue at birth.
e.zh: 有蜕膜型胎盘在分娩时会带出母体组织。

deciduoma.t: 蜕膜瘤；妊娠后形成的良性肿瘤

e.en: The pathologist identified a benign {deciduoma}.
e.zh: 病理学家诊断出一例良性蜕膜瘤。

e.en: {Deciduoma} can develop after pregnancy in rare cases.
e.zh: 在罕见情况下，妊娠后可能形成蜕膜瘤。

decigram.t: 分克；等于十分之一克的重量

e.en: She weighed the powder to the nearest {decigram}.
e.zh: 她把粉末称到最近的分克数。

e.en: Each tablet contains five {decigrams} of the active drug.
e.zh: 每片含五分克的有效成分。

decigramme.t: 分克；英式拼写的十分之一克

e.en: British pharmacists once measured in {decigrammes}.
e.zh: 英国药剂师曾用分克作为计量单位。

e.en: One {decigramme} equals a hundred milligrams.
e.zh: 一分克等于一百毫克。

decilitre.t: 分升；十分之一升的容量单位

e.en: The recipe calls for one {decilitre} of cream.
e.zh: 食谱需要一分升奶油。

e.en: European bottles often list contents in {decilitres}.
e.zh: 欧洲瓶装饮料常以分升标注容量。

decillion.t: 十的三十三次方；百万的十次方

e.en: Astronomers rarely deal with numbers as large as a {decillion}.
e.zh: 天文学家很少处理大到十的三十三次方的数字。

e.en: A {decillion} grains of sand would dwarf every desert.
e.zh: 十的三十三次方粒沙子比所有沙漠都多。

decillionth.t: 第十的三十三次方个；十的负三十三次方

e.en: He calculated the answer to the {decillionth} decimal place.
e.zh: 他把答案算到十的三十三次方位小数。

e.en: Such a {decillionth} fraction is impossible to measure directly.
e.zh: 如此微小的分数无法直接测量。

decimalise.t: 使十进制化；改用十进位

e.en: Britain decided to {decimalise} its currency in 1971.
e.zh: 英国于一九七一年决定使货币十进位化。

e.en: Some countries refused to {decimalise} their old measures.
e.zh: 有些国家拒绝把旧度量改为十进制。

decimalism.t: 十进制主义；推崇十进位制的思想

e.en: Nineteenth century reformers strongly championed {decimalism} everywhere.
e.zh: 十九世纪改革者到处大力推崇十进制主义。

e.en: Critics of {decimalism} preferred the older imperial units.
e.zh: 反对十进制主义的人更喜欢旧式英制单位。

decimalist.t: 十进制支持者；主张十进位制的人

e.en: Every {decimalist} welcomed the new currency reform.
e.zh: 每个十进制支持者都欢迎这次货币改革。

e.en: He was a passionate {decimalist} who opposed imperial units.
e.zh: 他是热情的十进制支持者，反对英制单位。

decimalization.t: 十进位化；改为十进制的过程

e.en: Britain's {decimalization} of currency caused brief confusion.
e.zh: 英国货币的十进位化曾造成短暂混乱。

e.en: The {decimalization} of weights simplified school lessons.
e.zh: 度量的十进位化简化了课堂教学。

decimalize.t: 使十进制化；改为十进位

e.en: Engineers wanted to {decimalize} every old measurement.
e.zh: 工程师想把所有旧式计量都改为十进制。

e.en: Australia chose to {decimalize} its currency in 1966.
e.zh: 澳大利亚于一九六六年选择使货币十进制化。

decimalized.t: 已十进制化的；改成十进位的

e.en: The {decimalized} system made calculations far easier.
e.zh: 十进制化的体系使计算容易得多。

e.en: Once they {decimalized} the coins, accounting sped up.
e.zh: 一旦把硬币改为十进制，会计工作就加快了。

decimalizes.t: 把数值改为十进制；十进位化

e.en: The bill {decimalizes} every remaining unit of weight.
e.zh: 这项法案把所有剩下的重量单位都十进制化。

e.en: She {decimalizes} the figures before importing them.
e.zh: 她在导入前把数据十进制化。

decimalizing.t: 正在十进制化；正改为十进位

e.en: {Decimalizing} the currency took several careful years.
e.zh: 把货币十进制化花了几年小心准备。

e.en: They are slowly {decimalizing} the country's old measures.
e.zh: 他们正缓慢地把全国旧度量十进制化。

decimator.t: 大量歼灭者；电子降采样器

e.en: Famine acted as the cruel {decimator} of the village.
e.zh: 饥荒成为这个村庄无情的杀伤者。

e.en: The audio engineer used a {decimator} to thin the signal.
e.zh: 音频工程师用降采样器精简信号。

decimeter.t: 分米；十分之一米的长度单位

e.en: The pencil was about two {decimeters} long.
e.zh: 这支铅笔大约两分米长。

e.en: Children learn to convert {decimeters} into centimeters.
e.zh: 孩子们学着把分米换算成厘米。

decimetre.t: 分米；十分之一米的长度单位

e.en: The fish measured three {decimetres} from head to tail.
e.zh: 这条鱼从头到尾长三分米。

e.en: British schools still teach length in {decimetres}.
e.zh: 英国学校仍用分米教授长度。

decimillimeter.t: 十分之一毫米；微米级长度单位

e.en: The micrograph showed details below one {decimillimeter}.
e.zh: 显微图显示出小于一分毫米的细节。

e.en: Engineers measured the gap to the nearest {decimillimeter}.
e.zh: 工程师把缝隙测到最近的分毫米。

decimillimetre.t: 十分之一毫米；微米级长度单位

e.en: Scientists detected motion of less than a {decimillimetre}.
e.zh: 科学家测到小于一分毫米的位移。

e.en: Each {decimillimetre} equals a tenth of a millimetre.
e.zh: 每分毫米等于十分之一毫米。

decineper.t: 分奈培；衰减单位的十分之一奈培

e.en: The audio engineer specified attenuation in {decinepers}.
e.zh: 音频工程师以分奈培指定衰减值。

e.en: One {decineper} measures a tiny logarithmic ratio.
e.zh: 一分奈培表示一个极小的对数比值。

decinormal.t: 零点一当量浓度的；化学滴定常用浓度

e.en: The lab used a {decinormal} acid solution for the titration.
e.zh: 实验室用零点一当量浓度的酸做滴定。

e.en: {Decinormal} reagents are common in classical chemistry.
e.zh: 零点一当量浓度的试剂在经典化学中很常见。

decipherment.t: 解读；破译；释读古代文字

e.en: The {decipherment} of Linear B took decades of work.
e.zh: 线性文字B的破译花了数十年时间。

e.en: Her {decipherment} of the diary moved the family deeply.
e.zh: 她对日记的解读令全家深受感动。

e.en: Every team needs a clear {decision-maker} in a crisis.
e.zh: 每个团队在危机中都需要明确的决策者。

e.en: She is the ultimate {decision-maker} in this company.
e.zh: 她是这家公司最终的决策者。

decision-problem.t: 判定问题；可计算理论中的判定问题

e.en: The halting question is a classic {decision-problem}.
e.zh: 停机问题是经典的判定问题。

e.en: Computer scientists classify each {decision-problem} by complexity.
e.zh: 计算机学家按复杂度对每个判定问题分类。

decision-problems.t: 判定问题（复数形式）；可判定性问题

e.en: Many {decision-problems} are provably unsolvable in general.
e.zh: 许多判定问题在一般情形下被证明不可解。

e.en: Textbooks list dozens of famous {decision-problems}.
e.zh: 教科书列出了数十个著名的判定问题。

decisionmaker.t: 决策者；决定事项的负责人

e.en: The CEO is the chief {decisionmaker} on hiring.
e.zh: 首席执行官是招聘方面的主要决策者。

e.en: Smart organizations empower every {decisionmaker} with data.
e.zh: 聪明的组织用数据赋能每位决策者。

decistere.t: 分立方米；十分之一立方米的体积

e.en: The woodyard sold logs by the {decistere}.
e.zh: 木场按分立方米出售圆木。

e.en: Each {decistere} of firewood weighs about a hundred kilos.
e.zh: 每分立方米柴火约重一百公斤。

e.en: The patient's prolonged {decumbence} caused bedsores.
e.zh: 病人长期卧床导致褥疮。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {decumbence} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后观察他的卧床状态。

e.en: The plant's {decumbency} helped it survive strong winds.
e.zh: 这种植物匍匐生长有助于抵御强风。

e.en: Her {decumbency} after the fall worried her family.
e.zh: 她摔倒后一直卧床不起，让家人担心。

e.en: The vines grew {decumbently} along the wall base.
e.zh: 藤蔓沿着墙根匍匐生长。

e.en: He lay {decumbently} on the cool tiles.
e.zh: 他俯卧在凉爽的瓷砖上。

e.en: The astrologer cast a chart for the patient's {decumbiture}.
e.zh: 占星师为病人的卧病时刻起了一张星盘。

e.en: His {decumbiture} lasted three weeks.
e.zh: 他卧病在床长达三周。

decumulation.t: 退休后的资产消耗；财富缩减

e.en: Retirees face the challenge of {decumulation} planning.
e.zh: 退休人员面临养老金消耗规划的挑战。

e.en: The fund offers a {decumulation} strategy for older clients.
e.zh: 该基金为年长客户提供资产支取策略。

e.en: Production rose to a {decuple} of last year's output.
e.zh: 产量增加到去年的十倍。

e.en: They aim to {decuple} their profits this decade.
e.zh: 他们计划在这十年内将利润扩大十倍。

e.en: The company {decupled} its workforce in five years.
e.zh: 该公司五年内将员工人数增至十倍。

e.en: Their savings {decupled} after the investment paid off.
e.zh: 投资见效后，他们的存款翻了十倍。

e.en: The composer wrote a tricky {decuplet} for the violin.
e.zh: 作曲家为小提琴写了一段棘手的十连音。

e.en: Each {decuplet} of samples was analyzed separately.
e.zh: 每十个一组的样本被分别分析。

e.en: They are {decupling} server capacity for the launch.
e.zh: 他们正在将服务器容量扩大十倍以应对发布。

e.en: The factory keeps {decupling} its annual output.
e.zh: 这家工厂的年产量不断增至十倍。

e.en: The Roman cavalry was organized into {decuries}.
e.zh: 古罗马骑兵以十人组为单位编制。

e.en: Several {decuries} marched in the formation.
e.zh: 几个十人小队行进在队列中。

e.en: The {decurion} commanded ten cavalrymen.
e.zh: 十人队长指挥十名骑兵。

e.en: He was promoted to {decurion} after the battle.
e.zh: 战役过后他被晋升为十人队长。

decurler.t: 去卷曲装置（用于纸张或薄膜）

e.en: The {decurler} flattens the paper before printing.
e.zh: 去卷曲装置在印刷前将纸张抚平。

e.en: Engineers replaced the worn {decurler} on the press.
e.zh: 工程师更换了印刷机上磨损的去卷曲器。

e.en: The mushroom has clearly {decurrent} gills.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇有明显的下延菌褶。

e.en: Botanists noted the {decurrent} leaf bases.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到下延的叶基。

e.en: The bird has a long, {decurved} bill.
e.zh: 这只鸟有一根长而向下弯曲的喙。

e.en: Note the {decurved} petals of the flower.
e.zh: 请注意这朵花向下弯曲的花瓣。

e.en: Each {decury} answered to its decurion.
e.zh: 每个十人组都听命于其十人队长。

e.en: A Roman {decury} consisted of ten soldiers.
e.zh: 一个古罗马十人组由十名士兵组成。

e.en: The leaves {decussate} along the stem.
e.zh: 叶子沿茎呈十字对生排列。

e.en: Two roads {decussate} at the village center.
e.zh: 两条路在村中心交叉成十字形。

e.en: The plant displays neatly {decussated} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子整齐地十字对生。

e.en: The pattern of {decussated} lines confused the eye.
e.zh: 交叉成十字的线条让人眼花缭乱。

e.en: The branches grow {decussately} from the trunk.
e.zh: 枝条从树干上十字交叉地生长。

e.en: The fibers were arranged {decussately} for strength.
e.zh: 为了增强强度，纤维以十字形交叉排列。

decussates.t: 交叉成X形（第三人称单数）

e.en: The optic nerve {decussates} at the chiasm.
e.zh: 视神经在视交叉处呈X形交叉。

e.en: Each pair of leaves {decussates} with the next.
e.zh: 每对叶子与下一对呈十字交叉。

e.en: The {decussating} fibers form a striking pattern.
e.zh: 交叉成十字形的纤维形成醒目的图案。

e.en: Anatomists studied the {decussating} nerve tracts.
e.zh: 解剖学家研究了交叉的神经束。

e.en: The {decussation} of motor fibers occurs in the medulla.
e.zh: 运动纤维的交叉发生在延髓。

e.en: Doctors examined the optic {decussation} on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描影像上检查了视神经交叉。

e.en: The product contains a {decyl} alcohol derivative.
e.zh: 该产品含有癸醇衍生物。

e.en: Chemists studied the {decyl} group's reactivity.
e.zh: 化学家研究了癸基的反应活性。

e.en: {Decylene} is used in some industrial processes.
e.zh: 癸烯用于一些工业流程中。

e.en: They synthesized {decylene} in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室合成了癸烯。

e.en: The artisan crafted a {dedal} maze of inlaid wood.
e.zh: 工匠打造了一座精巧错综的镶木迷宫。

e.en: Her novel weaves a {dedal} plot of betrayals.
e.zh: 她的小说编织出一段错综复杂的背叛情节。

e.en: Spectators watched the match from the {dedans}.
e.zh: 观众从凹室观众席观看比赛。

e.en: A ball struck into the {dedans} scored a point.
e.zh: 球打进观众席凹室即得一分。

e.en: The engineer measured the gear's {dedendum} carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细测量了齿轮的齿根高。

e.en: A correct {dedendum} ensures smooth meshing.
e.zh: 正确的齿根高确保齿轮顺畅啮合。

e.en: The book opens with a {dedicative} inscription.
e.zh: 这本书以一段献辞开篇。

e.en: He wrote a {dedicative} note to his mentor.
e.zh: 他给恩师写了一段献辞。

e.en: The {dedicator} of the volume thanked his teachers.
e.zh: 该书的题献者感谢了他的老师们。

e.en: She is a tireless {dedicator} to the cause.
e.zh: 她是这项事业不知疲倦的奉献者。

dedifferentiate.t: 去分化（细胞回到未分化状态）

e.en: Some plant cells can {dedifferentiate} and form new tissue.
e.zh: 某些植物细胞可以去分化并形成新组织。

e.en: Researchers made the cells {dedifferentiate} in culture.
e.zh: 研究人员让细胞在培养中去分化。

e.en: The tumor contained {dedifferentiated} cells.
e.zh: 肿瘤含有去分化的细胞。

e.en: They studied {dedifferentiated} stem cells in detail.
e.zh: 他们详细研究了去分化的干细胞。

dedifferentiation.t: 去分化（细胞返回未分化状态的过程）

e.en: {Dedifferentiation} plays a key role in regeneration.
e.zh: 去分化在再生过程中起关键作用。

e.en: Scientists observed {dedifferentiation} in the salamander limb.
e.zh: 科学家在蝾螈肢体中观察到去分化现象。

dediploidization.t: 去二倍化（细胞从二倍体变为单倍体）

e.en: {Dediploidization} can occur during certain cell divisions.
e.zh: 去二倍化可能在某些细胞分裂中发生。

e.en: They studied {dediploidization} in yeast strains.
e.zh: 他们研究了酵母菌株中的去二倍化现象。

e.en: Geologists found evidence of {dedolomitization} in the limestone.
e.zh: 地质学家在石灰岩中发现了去白云石化的证据。

e.en: {Dedolomitization} altered the rock's porosity significantly.
e.zh: 去白云石化大大改变了岩石的孔隙率。

e.en: The conclusion follows {deducibly} from the premises.
e.zh: 结论可从前提中推导得出。

e.en: His guilt was {deducibly} clear from the evidence.
e.zh: 从证据中可以推断出他的罪行。

deductivism.t: 演绎主义（哲学/科学方法论）

e.en: Popper's philosophy emphasizes {deductivism} over induction.
e.zh: 波普尔的哲学强调演绎主义而非归纳法。

e.en: Critics challenged the {deductivism} in his methodology.
e.zh: 批评者质疑他方法论中的演绎主义。

deductivist.t: 演绎主义者；演绎主义的

e.en: As a {deductivist}, he distrusts inductive arguments.
e.zh: 作为演绎主义者，他不信任归纳论证。

e.en: Her {deductivist} approach shaped the research design.
e.zh: 她的演绎主义方法塑造了研究设计。

e.en: Workers must {dedust} the grain before storage.
e.zh: 工人必须在储存前给谷物除尘。

e.en: The system can {dedust} large industrial spaces.
e.zh: 该系统可以为大型工业空间除尘。

e.en: He played a {dee-toned} chord on the guitar.
e.zh: 他在吉他上弹了一个D调和弦。

e.en: The choir sang in a {dee-toned} key.
e.zh: 合唱团以D调演唱。

e.en: She changed her surname by {deed-poll}.
e.zh: 她通过单方契约更改了姓氏。

e.en: The lawyer drew up a {deed-poll} for the name change.
e.zh: 律师为改名起草了一份单方契约。

e.en: The old {deedbox} held the family papers.
e.zh: 那只旧契据箱里装着家族文件。

e.en: He locked the will inside the {deedbox}.
e.zh: 他把遗嘱锁进契据保管箱里。

deedful.t: 行动果敢的；多有作为的

e.en: He was a {deedful} leader, not just a talker.
e.zh: 他是一位行动果敢的领导者，而不仅是空谈者。

e.en: The town honored its {deedful} citizens.
e.zh: 小镇表彰了那些有作为的市民。

deedless.t: 无所作为的；不付诸行动的

e.en: His promises were many but {deedless}.
e.zh: 他承诺很多却毫无行动。

e.en: A {deedless} life left him full of regret.
e.zh: 碌碌无为的一生让他充满遗憾。

e.en: She was a {deedy} young woman, always busy helping others.
e.zh: 她是一位勤勉的年轻女子，总忙于帮助他人。

e.en: His {deedy} nature made him popular in the village.
e.zh: 他积极行动的性格让他在村里很受欢迎。

e.en: There has been a {deemphasis} on standardized testing.
e.zh: 对标准化考试的重视已被淡化。

e.en: The new policy signals a {deemphasis} of military spending.
e.zh: 新政策意味着军费开支的弱化。

e.en: The teacher tried to {deemphasize} grades.
e.zh: 老师努力淡化分数的重要性。

e.en: They {deemphasized} the role of luck in their success.
e.zh: 他们淡化了运气在成功中的作用。

e.en: The {deep-chested} hound bayed at the moon.
e.zh: 那只胸膛宽厚的猎犬对着月亮长嚎。

e.en: He was a {deep-chested} man with a booming voice.
e.zh: 他是个胸膛宽厚、嗓音洪亮的男人。

e.en: She worked as a {deep-cover} agent for years.
e.zh: 她做了多年的深度卧底特工。

e.en: The {deep-cover} operation was finally exposed.
e.zh: 那次深度卧底行动最终被揭穿。

e.en: Chicago is famous for its {deep-dish} pizza.
e.zh: 芝加哥以其厚底披萨闻名。

e.en: She baked a {deep-dish} apple pie.
e.zh: 她烤了一个深盘苹果派。

e.en: The harbor cannot accommodate {deep-draft} vessels.
e.zh: 该港口无法容纳深吃水的船只。

e.en: {Deep-draft} ships need dredged channels.
e.zh: 深吃水船舶需要疏浚过的航道。

e.en: The factory produces {deep-drawn} metal cans.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产深拉成型的金属罐。

e.en: {Deep-drawn} parts are common in automotive bodies.
e.zh: 深拉成型零件在汽车车身中很常见。

deep-dyed.t: 根深蒂固的；彻头彻尾的

e.en: He is a {deep-dyed} villain in the novel.
e.zh: 他是小说中彻头彻尾的反派。

e.en: Their {deep-dyed} prejudice was hard to shake.
e.zh: 他们根深蒂固的偏见难以撼动。

e.en: She offered her {deep-felt} condolences.
e.zh: 她致以深切的慰问。

e.en: His {deep-felt} gratitude was obvious.
e.zh: 他深切的感激之情显而易见。

deep-fries.t: 油炸（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: He {deep-fries} the dough in hot oil.
e.zh: 他把面团放入热油中油炸。

e.en: She always {deep-fries} the tofu first.
e.zh: 她总是先把豆腐油炸一下。

e.en: We {deep-froze} the berries last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天把浆果冷冻了起来。

e.en: She {deep-froze} the bread to keep it fresh.
e.zh: 她把面包冷冻起来以保持新鲜。

e.en: You can {deep-fry} the spring rolls until crisp.
e.zh: 你可以把春卷油炸至酥脆。

e.en: Don't {deep-fry} food too often—it's unhealthy.
e.zh: 别太常吃油炸食物，不健康。

e.en: {Deep-frying} requires careful temperature control.
e.zh: 油炸需要小心控制温度。

e.en: She is {deep-frying} fish for dinner.
e.zh: 她正在油炸鱼准备晚餐。

deep-laid.t: 深谋远虑的；精心策划的

e.en: Their {deep-laid} plot was finally uncovered.
e.zh: 他们精心策划的阴谋终于被揭露。

e.en: It was a {deep-laid} scheme to seize power.
e.zh: 这是一个精心策划的夺权阴谋。

e.en: The startup attracted {deep-pocketed} investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司吸引了财力雄厚的投资者。

e.en: Only {deep-pocketed} buyers can afford this property.
e.zh: 只有财力雄厚的买家才买得起这处房产。

deep-read.t: 博览群书的；学识渊博的

e.en: He was {deep-read} in classical philosophy.
e.zh: 他对古典哲学博览群书。

e.en: She is a {deep-read} scholar of medieval texts.
e.zh: 她是研究中世纪文献的博学学者。

e.en: His {deep-rooted} fear of heights never went away.
e.zh: 他根深蒂固的恐高症从未消失。

e.en: There are {deep-rooted} problems in the system.
e.zh: 该系统存在根深蒂固的问题。

e.en: They went on a {deep-sea} fishing trip.
e.zh: 他们去了一趟深海捕鱼之旅。

e.en: {Deep-sea} creatures often glow in the dark.
e.zh: 深海生物常常在黑暗中发光。

e.en: She has a {deep-seated} mistrust of authority.
e.zh: 她对权威有根深蒂固的不信任。

e.en: The conflict reflects {deep-seated} cultural differences.
e.zh: 这场冲突反映了根深蒂固的文化差异。

e.en: He had {deep-set} blue eyes.
e.zh: 他有一双深陷的蓝眼睛。

e.en: Her {deep-set} eyes gave her a thoughtful look.
e.zh: 她深陷的双眼让她显得若有所思。

e.en: They decided to {deep-six} the whole project.
e.zh: 他们决定把整个项目彻底丢弃。

e.en: The committee {deep-sixed} my proposal.
e.zh: 委员会把我的提案束之高阁。

e.en: NASA launched a {deep-space} probe last year.
e.zh: 美国航天局去年发射了一枚深空探测器。

e.en: They study signals from {deep-space} objects.
e.zh: 他们研究来自深空天体的信号。

e.en: The {deep-voiced} narrator drew everyone in.
e.zh: 那位嗓音低沉的旁白吸引了所有人。

e.en: He's a tall, {deep-voiced} man.
e.zh: 他是个高个子、嗓音低沉的男人。

e.en: The leaves turned {deep-yellow} in autumn.
e.zh: 树叶在秋天变成了深黄色。

e.en: She wore a {deep-yellow} scarf.
e.zh: 她戴着一条深黄色的围巾。

e.en: She sent him a {deepfelt} letter of thanks.
e.zh: 她给他写了一封深情致谢的信。

e.en: His {deepfelt} apology moved everyone.
e.zh: 他深切的道歉感动了所有人。

e.en: Put the meat in the {deepfreeze} right away.
e.zh: 马上把肉放进冷冻柜。

e.en: You can {deepfreeze} cooked rice for later.
e.zh: 你可以把煮熟的米饭冷冻起来稍后食用。

e.en: They served {deepfried} shrimp as an appetizer.
e.zh: 他们把油炸虾作为开胃菜。

e.en: I rarely eat {deepfried} food anymore.
e.zh: 我很少再吃油炸食品了。

e.en: She likes to {deepfry} potatoes at home.
e.zh: 她喜欢在家油炸土豆。

e.en: You can {deepfry} the dumplings until golden.
e.zh: 你可以把饺子炸至金黄。

e.en: The reforms had {deepgoing} effects on society.
e.zh: 这些改革对社会产生了深远的影响。

e.en: It was a {deepgoing} analysis of the issue.
e.zh: 这是对该问题的深入分析。

e.en: The water here is {deepish}, so be careful.
e.zh: 这里的水有点深，小心一点。

e.en: She has a {deepish} voice for a child.
e.zh: 对一个孩子来说，她的嗓音略显低沉。

e.en: The {deepmouthed} hounds bayed through the woods.
e.zh: 叫声低沉的猎犬在林间长嚎。

e.en: A pack of {deepmouthed} dogs followed the hunter.
e.zh: 一群叫声低沉的猎犬跟着猎人。

e.en: The port handles {deepwater} cargo ships.
e.zh: 该港口可处理深水货船。

e.en: They specialize in {deepwater} oil drilling.
e.zh: 他们专门从事深水石油钻探。

e.en: The Scottish {deer-hound} is a noble breed.
e.zh: 苏格兰猎鹿犬是一种高贵的犬种。

e.en: He raised a {deer-hound} on the estate.
e.zh: 他在庄园里养了一只猎鹿犬。

e.en: The estate has a large {deer-park}.
e.zh: 这座庄园有一个大鹿园。

e.en: We strolled through the {deer-park} at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们漫步穿过鹿园。

e.en: He wore a jacket made of {deer-skin}.
e.zh: 他穿着一件鹿皮夹克。

e.en: The gloves were soft {deer-skin}.
e.zh: 那双手套是柔软的鹿皮做的。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes is famous for his {deer-stalker} cap.
e.zh: 福尔摩斯以他的猎鹿帽而闻名。

e.en: The {deer-stalker} crept through the heather.
e.zh: 那位猎鹿人悄悄穿过石南丛。

e.en: {Deerberry} bushes grow in sandy woodlands.
e.zh: 鹿莓灌木生长在沙质林地中。

e.en: Birds feast on the ripe {deerberry} fruit.
e.zh: 鸟儿享用着成熟的鹿莓果实。

e.en: A {deerfly} bit my arm during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时一只鹿虻咬了我的胳膊。

e.en: The {deerfly} can deliver a painful bite.
e.zh: 鹿虻叮咬起来非常疼。

e.en: The Scottish {deerhound} is tall and gentle.
e.zh: 苏格兰猎鹿犬体型高大且性情温和。

e.en: He raised a {deerhound} on his country estate.
e.zh: 他在乡下庄园养了一条猎鹿犬。

e.en: She had large, {deerlike} eyes.
e.zh: 她有一双大大的、像鹿一样的眼睛。

e.en: The animal moved with {deerlike} grace.
e.zh: 那只动物动作如鹿般优雅。

deerstalker.t: 猎鹿帽；福尔摩斯式双檐帽

e.en: Sherlock Holmes is famous for his {deerstalker}.
e.zh: 福尔摩斯以那顶猎鹿帽闻名。

e.en: He wore a tweed {deerstalker} in the rain.
e.zh: 他在雨中戴着一顶花呢猎鹿帽。

e.en: They went {deerstalking} in the Highlands.
e.zh: 他们去高地潜行猎鹿。

e.en: {Deerstalking} requires patience and stealth.
e.zh: 潜行猎鹿需要耐心和隐蔽。

e.en: {Deerweed} grows on dry California hillsides.
e.zh: 鹿草生长在加州干燥的山坡上。

e.en: Bees love the yellow flowers of {deerweed}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜爱鹿草的黄色花朵。

deeryard.t: 鹿群越冬地；冬季鹿聚集处

e.en: The herd gathers at the {deeryard} each winter.
e.zh: 鹿群每年冬天都聚集在越冬地。

e.en: Loggers avoided cutting near the {deeryard}.
e.zh: 伐木工避免在鹿越冬地附近砍伐。

deet.t: 避蚊胺；一种驱虫剂成分

e.en: This bug spray contains {deet}.
e.zh: 这款驱虫喷雾含有避蚊胺。

e.en: Apply {deet} before entering the woods.
e.zh: 进入树林前要涂避蚊胺。

e.en: The plant must {deethanize} the gas stream.
e.zh: 装置必须对气流进行脱乙烷处理。

e.en: Engineers {deethanize} natural gas before shipment.
e.zh: 工程师在运输前对天然气进行脱乙烷处理。

e.en: The {deethanizer} separates ethane from heavier gases.
e.zh: 脱乙烷塔将乙烷与较重气体分离。

e.en: They installed a new {deethanizer} at the refinery.
e.zh: 他们在炼油厂安装了一座新的脱乙烷塔。

e.en: The atom emits a photon during {deexcitation}.
e.zh: 原子在退激发时发射出光子。

e.en: {Deexcitation} releases energy as light.
e.zh: 退激发以光的形式释放能量。

e.en: Collisions can {deexcite} the molecules quickly.
e.zh: 碰撞能使分子迅速退激发。

e.en: Photons {deexcite} the atom to its ground state.
e.zh: 光子使原子退激发回到基态。

e.en: Patients should {defaecate} regularly to stay healthy.
e.zh: 患者应规律排便以保持健康。

e.en: The dog needed to {defaecate} in the yard.
e.zh: 那只狗需要在院子里排便。

e.en: Painful {defaecation} can indicate a problem.
e.zh: 排便疼痛可能提示有问题。

e.en: The drug helps regulate {defaecation}.
e.zh: 这种药有助于调节排便。

e.en: The accountant was charged with {defalcation}.
e.zh: 那位会计被指控挪用公款。

e.en: Auditors uncovered a major {defalcation}.
e.zh: 审计员发现了一起重大挪用案。

e.en: The {defalcator} fled with the company funds.
e.zh: 那个挪用公款者携款潜逃。

e.en: Investigators identified the {defalcator} quickly.
e.zh: 调查人员很快锁定了挪用公款者。

e.en: He spoke {defamingly} about his former partner.
e.zh: 他诽谤性地谈论他的前合伙人。

e.en: The article referred to her {defamingly}.
e.zh: 那篇文章以诽谤的方式提到她。

e.en: You can {defat} the broth by chilling it.
e.zh: 将高汤冷藏即可脱脂。

e.en: Skim the surface to {defat} the soup.
e.zh: 撇去表面以给汤脱脂。

e.en: The chef {defats} the stock before serving.
e.zh: 厨师在上菜前给高汤脱脂。

e.en: This solvent {defats} the metal surface.
e.zh: 这种溶剂能给金属表面脱脂。

e.en: They use {defatted} soy flour in the recipe.
e.zh: 配方中使用脱脂大豆粉。

e.en: The {defatted} broth tasted lighter.
e.zh: 脱脂后的高汤口感更清淡。

defcon.t: 戒备状态等级；防御戒备级别

e.en: The military raised the alert to {defcon} two.
e.zh: 军方将戒备等级提高到二级。

e.en: During the crisis, {defcon} levels were tense.
e.zh: 危机期间，戒备等级令人紧张。

e.en: The contract included a {defeasance} clause.
e.zh: 合同中包含废止条款。

e.en: Bond {defeasance} releases the issuer from obligations.
e.zh: 债券废止可解除发行人的义务。

defeasanced.t: 已废止的；附有失效条款的

e.en: The {defeasanced} bonds no longer burden the books.
e.zh: 已废止的债券不再计入账上。

e.en: They held {defeasanced} debt in escrow.
e.zh: 他们将已废止的债务托管。

e.en: The company chose to {defease} the old bonds.
e.zh: 公司选择废止旧债券。

e.en: They will {defease} the loan with treasuries.
e.zh: 他们将用国债来废止该贷款。

e.en: The agreement is {defeasible} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 该协议在特定条件下可被废除。

e.en: He held a {defeasible} interest in the estate.
e.zh: 他对该地产享有可撤销的权益。

e.en: Even strong opponents are {defeatable} with strategy.
e.zh: 即使是强敌，用策略也是可以击败的。

e.en: The boss in this game is {defeatable} at low level.
e.zh: 游戏中的这个首领在低等级也能被击败。

e.en: You must {defeather} the chicken before cooking.
e.zh: 烹饪前必须给鸡拔毛。

e.en: Workers {defeather} the birds at the plant.
e.zh: 工人在工厂里给禽类拔毛。

e.en: Engineers {defeature} the model to simplify analysis.
e.zh: 工程师精简模型特征以便分析。

e.en: War can {defeature} a once-beautiful city.
e.zh: 战争能毁掉一座曾经美丽的城市的容貌。

defeatured.t: 已移除特征的；被毁容的

e.en: The {defeatured} CAD model loaded much faster.
e.zh: 精简特征后的CAD模型加载快多了。

e.en: His {defeatured} face shocked the visitors.
e.zh: 他被毁了容的脸让访客震惊。

e.en: The sugar mill uses a {defecator} to clarify juice.
e.zh: 糖厂使用澄清器来澄清蔗汁。

e.en: The {defecator} removes impurities from the syrup.
e.zh: 澄清器除去糖浆中的杂质。

e.en: The factory aims for {defect-free} production.
e.zh: 工厂力求无缺陷生产。

e.en: They shipped a {defect-free} batch of chips.
e.zh: 他们出货了一批无缺陷的芯片。

e.en: The {defectibility} of human nature troubled him.
e.zh: 人性的易出错性让他困扰。

e.en: Theologians debated the {defectibility} of the church.
e.zh: 神学家们争论教会的易错性。

defectible.t: 易出缺陷的；可能犯错的

e.en: All human institutions are {defectible}.
e.zh: 所有人类机构都可能出错。

e.en: The doctrine assumes a {defectible} will.
e.zh: 该教义假设意志是可能犯错的。

defectivation.t: 缺陷化；产生缺陷的过程

e.en: {Defectivation} of the crystal alters its conductivity.
e.zh: 晶体的缺陷化会改变其导电性。

e.en: Researchers studied the {defectivation} mechanism.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了缺陷化机制。

defectology.t: 缺陷学；缺陷儿童教育学

e.en: Vygotsky founded modern Soviet {defectology}.
e.zh: 维果茨基创立了现代苏联缺陷学。

e.en: She studied {defectology} at the institute.
e.zh: 她在该研究所学习缺陷学。

e.en: The technician used a {defectoscope} on the pipe.
e.zh: 技术员用探伤仪检查管道。

e.en: An ultrasonic {defectoscope} located the crack.
e.zh: 超声探伤仪定位到了裂缝。

e.en: {Defectoscopy} ensures the welds are sound.
e.zh: 探伤检测确保焊缝完好。

e.en: They performed {defectoscopy} on every rail.
e.zh: 他们对每条钢轨进行了探伤。

e.en: The party pushed for {defederalization} of education.
e.zh: 该党推动教育的去联邦化。

e.en: {Defederalization} returns power to the states.
e.zh: 去联邦化将权力归还各州。

defederalize.t: 去联邦化；使脱离联邦管控

e.en: Lawmakers proposed to {defederalize} welfare programs.
e.zh: 立法者提议将福利项目去联邦化。

e.en: They want to {defederalize} highway funding.
e.zh: 他们想让公路拨款脱离联邦控制。

defeminize.t: 使去女性化；除去女性特征

e.en: Some critics say uniforms {defeminize} the wearers.
e.zh: 一些评论者认为制服使穿着者去女性化。

e.en: Hormone changes can {defeminize} the body.
e.zh: 激素变化会使身体去女性化。

e.en: She became the {defendress} of the orphans.
e.zh: 她成了孤儿们的女守护者。

e.en: The queen acted as {defendress} of the faith.
e.zh: 女王充当信仰的女守护者。

e.en: Rebels threatened to {defenestrate} the officials.
e.zh: 叛乱者威胁要把官员扔出窗外。

e.en: The board moved to {defenestrate} the CEO.
e.zh: 董事会动议罢免这位首席执行官。

e.en: The {defenestration} of Prague triggered a war.
e.zh: 布拉格抛窗事件引发了一场战争。

e.en: His sudden {defenestration} shocked the staff.
e.zh: 他被突然罢免让员工震惊。

e.en: The team's {defensemen} blocked every shot.
e.zh: 球队的后卫挡下了每一次射门。

e.en: Two {defensemen} skated back to defend.
e.zh: 两名后卫滑回来防守。

e.en: The {defensibility} of the position was questioned.
e.zh: 该立场的可辩护性受到质疑。

e.en: Engineers assessed the fort's {defensibility}.
e.zh: 工程师评估了堡垒的可防御性。

e.en: He {defensibly} argued for the new policy.
e.zh: 他合情合理地为新政策辩护。

e.en: The decision was {defensibly} made on evidence.
e.zh: 这一决定基于证据，可以站得住脚。

e.en: She spoke {dabblingly} about painting, never claiming real expertise.
e.zh: 她只是浅尝辄止地谈绘画，从不声称自己真正精通。

e.en: He moved {dabblingly} from poetry to politics.
e.zh: 他从诗歌到政治都只是涉猎地接触一下。

e.en: A {dabchick} slipped under the reeds near the bank.
e.zh: 一只小䴙䴘在岸边芦苇旁潜入水中。

e.en: The old guide called the young grebe a {dabchick}.
e.zh: 那位老向导把这只小䴙䴘称作dabchick。

e.en: Several {dabchicks} paddled across the quiet pond.
e.zh: 几只小䴙䴘划过安静的池塘。

e.en: The children watched the {dabchicks} dive for insects.
e.zh: 孩子们看着小䴙䴘潜水捕虫。

e.en: My aunt is a {dabster} at repairing old radios.
e.zh: 我姑妈是修旧收音机的能手。

e.en: He proved a cheerful {dabster} in kitchen improvisation.
e.zh: 事实证明，他在厨房即兴发挥方面是个乐呵呵的老手。

e.en: The score marks {dacapo} after the final chorus.
e.zh: 乐谱在最后一段合唱后标明从头反复。

e.en: The conductor signaled a {dacapo} for the confused singers.
e.zh: 指挥向困惑的歌手示意乐曲从头再来。

dacian.t: 达契亚人的；达契亚语的

e.en: The museum displayed a {Dacian} helmet from the ancient kingdom.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一顶来自古代王国的达契亚头盔。

e.en: Scholars still debate many {Dacian} words and names.
e.zh: 学者们仍在争论许多达契亚语词和名称。

e.en: The cliff was formed from pale gray {dacite}.
e.zh: 这处悬崖由浅灰色英安岩形成。

e.en: Geologists found {dacite} beneath the newer lava flow.
e.zh: 地质学家在较新的熔岩流下发现了英安岩。

e.en: Stop {dackering} about and help me lift this box.
e.zh: 别再磨磨蹭蹭了，来帮我抬这个箱子。

e.en: They spent the afternoon {dackering} around the harbor.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在港口一带闲逛。

e.en: The villagers feared a {dacoit} gang on the road.
e.zh: 村民们害怕路上有一伙土匪。

e.en: The novel turns the {dacoit} into a tragic hero.
e.zh: 这部小说把那个强盗写成了悲剧英雄。

e.en: The police recorded the attack as {dacoity}.
e.zh: 警方把这次袭击登记为结伙抢劫。

e.en: Stories of {dacoity} spread quickly through the district.
e.zh: 关于土匪抢劫的传闻很快传遍了该地区。

dacquoise.t: 达克瓦兹蛋糕；杏仁蛋白甜点

e.en: The bakery sold a crisp hazelnut {dacquoise}.
e.zh: 那家面包店卖一种酥脆的榛子达克瓦兹蛋糕。

e.en: She layered the {dacquoise} with coffee buttercream.
e.zh: 她在达克瓦兹蛋糕中间夹了咖啡奶油霜。

e.en: The chemical acted as a powerful {dacryagogue}.
e.zh: 这种化学物质起到了强烈催泪物的作用。

e.en: Onions contain compounds with a {dacryagogue} effect.
e.zh: 洋葱含有会促使人流泪的化合物。

e.en: The patient showed {dacrygelosis} during the interview.
e.zh: 病人在访谈中表现出边哭边笑的症状。

e.en: Writers sometimes use {dacrygelosis} to suggest emotional collapse.
e.zh: 作家有时用哭笑并发来暗示情绪崩溃。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {dacryocystorhinostomy} for the blocked tear duct.
e.zh: 外科医生建议用泪囊鼻腔吻合术治疗泪道阻塞。

e.en: Her tearing improved after {dacryocystorhinostomy}.
e.zh: 她做完泪囊鼻腔吻合术后流泪症状好转了。

e.en: The resin hardened into a {dacryoid} bead.
e.zh: 树脂硬化成一颗泪滴状的小珠。

e.en: Under the lens, the mineral showed {dacryoid} forms.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这种矿物呈现出似泪滴的形态。

e.en: The lab tested the sample for {dacryolin}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了样本中的泪液蛋白。

e.en: Older papers describe {dacryolin} as a component of tears.
e.zh: 较早的论文把泪液蛋白描述为眼泪的一种成分。

e.en: The protocol included {dactinomycin} for the tumor treatment.
e.zh: 该治疗方案包含用于肿瘤治疗的放线菌素D。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients closely during {dactinomycin} therapy.
e.zh: 医生会在放线菌素D治疗期间密切监测患者。

e.en: Researchers isolated {dactylarin} from a fungal culture.
e.zh: 研究人员从真菌培养物中分离出指霉素。

e.en: The paper reported weak activity for {dactylarin}.
e.zh: 论文报告称指霉素的活性较弱。

e.en: The nurse noted {dactyledema} in both hands.
e.zh: 护士注意到患者双手都有手指水肿。

e.en: Severe {dactyledema} made it hard for him to grip tools.
e.zh: 严重的手指水肿让他很难握住工具。

e.en: The farm hired a {dayworker} during the harvest.
e.zh: 农场在收获季雇了一名日工。

e.en: As a {dayworker}, she finished before the night shift arrived.
e.zh: 作为白班工人，她在夜班到来前完成了工作。

e.en: The mediator focused on {de-escalating} the argument before it became violent.
e.zh: 调解员先设法缓和争吵，避免它演变成暴力。

e.en: Police used calm language when {de-escalating} the tense situation.
e.zh: 警方在缓和紧张局势时使用了平静的措辞。

debouche.t: 流出；走出狭口进入开阔地

e.en: The river will {debouche} into a wide marsh beyond the hills.
e.zh: 这条河会在群山之外流入一片宽阔的沼泽地。

e.en: The troops began to {debouche} from the narrow pass at dawn.
e.zh: 拂晓时，部队开始从狭窄山口进入开阔地。

e.en: The soldiers were ordered to {debus} beside the bridge.
e.zh: 士兵们奉命在桥边下车。

e.en: The driver helped the passengers {debus} safely after the breakdown.
e.zh: 车辆故障后，司机帮助乘客安全下车。

e.en: The old recipe calls for one {decagramme} of salt.
e.zh: 这份老食谱要求加入一十克盐。

e.en: Each packet weighed exactly one {decagramme} on the scale.
e.zh: 每个小包在秤上正好重十克。

e.en: Sodium carbonate {decahydrate} loses water when heated.
e.zh: 十水合碳酸钠受热时会失去水分。

e.en: The lab labeled the crystal as a {decahydrate}.
e.zh: 实验室把这种晶体标为十水合物。

e.en: A {decameter} is equal to ten meters.
e.zh: 一十米等于十米。

e.en: The surveyor marked each {decameter} along the road.
e.zh: 测量员沿着道路每隔十米做一个标记。

e.en: The surface layer was {decarburized} during heat treatment.
e.zh: 表层在热处理过程中被脱碳了。

e.en: The engineer rejected the {decarburized} steel sample.
e.zh: 工程师拒收了这块已脱碳的钢样。

e.en: The court may {decern} liability after hearing the evidence.
e.zh: 法院听取证据后可以判定责任。

e.en: Only a trained eye could {decern} the faint mark.
e.zh: 只有训练有素的眼睛才能辨出那道淡淡的痕迹。

e.en: Condensation formed on the {deckhead} overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间，船舱顶板上结了冷凝水。

e.en: The electrician ran cables along the {deckhead}.
e.zh: 电工沿着舱顶铺设电缆。

e.en: The executioner was ordered to {decollate} the condemned prisoner.
e.zh: 刽子手奉命斩首那名死囚。

e.en: The statue was later found {decollated} in the ruined chapel.
e.zh: 那尊雕像后来在废弃小礼拜堂里被发现头部已被砍去。

e.en: The chemical caused rapid {decoloration} of the dye.
e.zh: 这种化学物质使染料迅速脱色。

e.en: Sunlight led to gradual {decoloration} of the fabric.
e.zh: 阳光使这块布料逐渐褪色。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {decolorimeter} before testing the sample.
e.zh: 技术员在检测样品前校准了脱色测定仪。

e.en: A {decolorimeter} can compare changes in color intensity.
e.zh: 脱色测定仪可以比较颜色强度的变化。

e.en: The graph shows a steady {decrescence} in pressure.
e.zh: 图表显示压力在稳定下降。

e.en: Poets sometimes use {decrescence} to describe fading light.
e.zh: 诗人有时用这个词描写逐渐暗淡的光。

e.en: Heat can cause {decrystallization} in certain polymers.
e.zh: 加热会使某些聚合物发生去结晶。

e.en: The syrup's {decrystallization} restored its smooth texture.
e.zh: 糖浆去结晶后恢复了顺滑质地。

e.en: The nurse changed the patient's {decubitus} to prevent sores.
e.zh: 护士改变病人的卧姿以预防褥疮。

e.en: The chart noted a left lateral {decubitus} position.
e.zh: 病历记录了左侧卧位。

e.en: The patient remained {decumbent} throughout the examination.
e.zh: 检查过程中，病人一直保持躺卧。

e.en: The plant has {decumbent} stems that root at the nodes.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎匍匐生长，并在节处生根。

e.en: We need to {deep-freeze} the samples within an hour.
e.zh: 我们需要在一小时内把样本深度冷冻。

e.en: She stored extra bread in the {deep-freeze}.
e.zh: 她把多余的面包存放在冷冻柜里。

e.en: The market sells {deep-fried} fish with spicy sauce.
e.zh: 市场里卖配辣酱的油炸鱼。

e.en: He avoids {deep-fried} food for health reasons.
e.zh: 出于健康原因，他避免吃油炸食品。

e.en: They searched the {deepmost} chamber of the cave.
e.zh: 他们搜查了洞穴最深处的房间。

e.en: Her {deepmost} fear was never mentioned aloud.
e.zh: 她内心最深的恐惧从未被说出口。

e.en: Only {deferable} maintenance was postponed during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间只推迟了可延期的维护工作。

e.en: The committee marked the issue as {deferable}.
e.zh: 委员会把这个问题标记为可以推迟处理。

e.en: The anatomy text described the {deferent} duct in detail.
e.zh: 解剖学教材详细描述了输送管道。

e.en: Ancient astronomers used a {deferent} to model planetary motion.
e.zh: 古代天文学家用本轮圆来模拟行星运动。

e.en: The payment is {deferrable} until next month.
e.zh: 这笔款项可以延期到下个月支付。

e.en: Nonurgent surgery may be {deferrable} during a crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，非紧急手术可以暂缓。

e.en: The plant uses {deferrization} to improve the water quality.
e.zh: 这家工厂通过除铁来改善水质。

e.en: Incomplete {deferrization} left rust-colored stains in the pipes.
e.zh: 除铁不彻底使管道里留下了铁锈色污渍。

e.en: The child's fever began to {defervesce} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，孩子的烧开始退了。

e.en: Symptoms usually {defervesce} within two days of treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后症状通常会在两天内随退热而缓解。

e.en: The doctor noted clear {defervescence} by the third day.
e.zh: 医生记录到第三天已有明显退热。

e.en: Rapid {defervescence} often follows effective antibiotic treatment.
e.zh: 有效的抗生素治疗后常会迅速退热。

e.en: The child gave a {deffiant} look and refused to move.
e.zh: 那个孩子露出挑衅的表情，拒绝挪动。

e.en: Her {deffiant} speech angered the officials.
e.zh: 她公然反抗的讲话激怒了官员们。

e.en: The mill uses heat to {defiber} the wood chips.
e.zh: 工厂用热力把木片脱纤处理。

e.en: Engineers tested a machine designed to {defiber} plant waste.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一台用于去除植物废料纤维的机器。

e.en: The {defiberer} broke the pulp into fine strands.
e.zh: 脱纤机把纸浆分解成细纤维。

e.en: A faulty {defiberer} slowed the whole production line.
e.zh: 一台故障脱纤机拖慢了整条生产线。

e.en: The {defibrator} separates wood chips into usable fibers.
e.zh: 解纤机把木片分离成可用纤维。

e.en: They replaced the old {defibrator} after repeated breakdowns.
e.zh: 那台旧纤维分离机屡次故障后被更换了。

e.en: Paramedics tried to {defibrillate} the patient in the ambulance.
e.zh: 急救人员在救护车里尝试给病人除颤。

e.en: The device can {defibrillate} a heart during sudden cardiac arrest.
e.zh: 这种设备能在突发心脏骤停时用电击恢复心律。

e.en: The technician must {defibrinate} the blood sample before testing.
e.zh: 技术员必须先去除血样中的纤维蛋白再检测。

e.en: Researchers {defibrinate} plasma to study its clotting behavior.
e.zh: 研究人员去除血浆中的纤维蛋白，以研究其凝血表现。

e.en: The report noted a serious {deficience} in the evidence.
e.zh: 报告指出证据存在严重不足。

e.en: A {deficience} of vitamin D can affect bone health.
e.zh: 维生素D缺乏会影响骨骼健康。

e.en: The {defier} refused to obey the unjust order.
e.zh: 那名反抗者拒绝服从不公正的命令。

e.en: History often turns a bold {defier} into a symbol.
e.zh: 历史常常把勇敢的蔑视者变成一种象征。

e.en: The troops moved into {defilade} behind the ridge.
e.zh: 部队转移到山脊后方的隐蔽阵地。

e.en: Engineers used earthworks to {defilade} the gun position.
e.zh: 工程兵用土垒遮蔽炮位，使其避开敌火。

e.en: The {defiladed} trench was hard to hit from below.
e.zh: 那条受遮蔽的战壕很难从下方击中。

e.en: They placed the vehicles in a {defiladed} position.
e.zh: 他们把车辆停在一个隐蔽阵地里。

e.en: The wall was useful for {defilading} the forward post.
e.zh: 那堵墙有助于遮蔽前沿哨位，避开敌火。

e.en: Officers discussed {defilading} the batteries before dawn.
e.zh: 军官们讨论在黎明前隐蔽炮兵阵地。

definably.t: 可定义地；可明确说明地

e.en: The two groups are {definably} different in their voting habits.
e.zh: 这两个群体在投票习惯上可以明确区分。

e.en: A policy must be {definably} fair before people trust it.
e.zh: 一项政策必须能明确说明其公平性，人们才会信任。

e.en: The contract needs clearer {definement} of each duty.
e.zh: 合同需要更清楚地限定各项职责。

e.en: Philosophers debated the {definement} of personal freedom.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论个人自由的定义。

e.en: In this sentence, democracy is the {definiendum}.
e.zh: 在这个句子中，民主是被定义项。

e.en: The {definiendum} should not appear inside its own definition.
e.zh: 被定义项不应出现在它自己的定义中。

e.en: The phrase after the colon is the {definiens}.
e.zh: 冒号后面的短语就是定义内容。

e.en: A good {definiens} explains the term without circular wording.
e.zh: 好的定义式会解释术语，而不使用循环表述。

e.en: The agency hopes to {definitize} the contract next month.
e.zh: 该机构希望下个月把合同定案。

e.en: Managers met to {definitize} the temporary pricing agreement.
e.zh: 经理们开会确定临时定价协议。

e.en: The statement lacked the {definitude} investors wanted.
e.zh: 这份声明缺少投资者想要的明确性。

e.en: Mathematics gave his argument a sense of {definitude}.
e.zh: 数学让他的论证带有一种确定性。

e.en: The lab stored {deflagrable} powders in sealed containers.
e.zh: 实验室把可爆燃粉末存放在密封容器中。

e.en: Workers treated the {deflagrable} dust as a serious hazard.
e.zh: 工人们把这种易迅燃粉尘视为严重危险。

e.en: Certain powders can {deflagrate} when exposed to a spark.
e.zh: 某些粉末遇到火花时会爆燃。

e.en: The mixture began to {deflagrate} inside the test chamber.
e.zh: 混合物开始在测试舱内迅速燃烧。

deflagrated.t: 已爆燃的；迅速燃烧过的

e.en: The {deflagrated} sample left a thin layer of ash.
e.zh: 爆燃后的样品留下了一层薄灰。

e.en: Investigators examined the residue from the {deflagrated} fuel.
e.zh: 调查人员检查了迅速燃烧后的燃料残渣。

e.en: The powder {deflagrates} when exposed to a spark.
e.zh: 这种粉末遇到火花就会迅速爆燃。

e.en: Unlike a detonating charge, it {deflagrates} through rapid surface burning.
e.zh: 不同于爆轰装药，它通过快速表面燃烧发生爆燃。

deflagrating.t: 正在爆燃的；迅速燃烧的

e.en: The engineer watched the {deflagrating} sample from behind safety glass.
e.zh: 工程师隔着安全玻璃观察正在爆燃的样品。

e.en: A {deflagrating} mixture can still produce dangerous pressure.
e.zh: 迅速燃烧的混合物仍可能产生危险压力。

e.en: The report described the accident as a {deflagration}, not a detonation.
e.zh: 报告把这起事故描述为爆燃，而不是爆轰。

e.en: Proper venting reduces pressure during {deflagration}.
e.zh: 适当泄压可以降低爆燃过程中的压力。

e.en: The technician tested the {deflagrator} before loading the sample.
e.zh: 技术员在装入样品前测试了爆燃器。

e.en: A faulty {deflagrator} delayed the laboratory demonstration.
e.zh: 有故障的点燃装置延误了实验室演示。

e.en: The boat is {deflatable} for easier storage.
e.zh: 这艘船可以放气，便于存放。

e.en: Some economists argue that the asset bubble is still {deflatable}.
e.zh: 一些经济学家认为这个资产泡沫仍然可以被压低。

e.en: The {deflationist} warned that prices would keep falling.
e.zh: 这位通缩论者警告说价格还会继续下跌。

e.en: Her {deflationist} policy favored tight control of public spending.
e.zh: 她的紧缩主义政策倾向于严格控制公共支出。

e.en: The shield is designed to make incoming debris {deflectable}.
e.zh: 这种护盾的设计是为了让飞来的碎片可以被偏转。

e.en: Public anger was not easily {deflectable} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻发生后，公众的愤怒并不容易被转移。

e.en: The panel used a {deflective} surface to redirect the heat.
e.zh: 面板采用偏转表面来改变热量方向。

e.en: His {deflective} answer avoided the real question.
e.zh: 他回避性的回答避开了真正的问题。

e.en: The alloy's {deflectivity} was measured under high stress.
e.zh: 研究人员在高应力下测量了这种合金的偏转能力。

e.en: Good {deflectivity} helps the coating resist small impacts.
e.zh: 良好的偏转性有助于涂层抵御小幅冲击。

e.en: The road crew used a {deflectometer} to test the pavement.
e.zh: 道路施工队用挠度仪检测路面。

e.en: A laser {deflectometer} recorded tiny changes in the beam.
e.zh: 激光偏转测量仪记录了梁体的微小变化。

e.en: The apparatus can {deflegmate} vapor during distillation.
e.zh: 该装置可在蒸馏过程中对蒸汽进行分馏除水。

e.en: Chemists {deflegmate} the mixture to remove heavier condensate.
e.zh: 化学人员对混合物分馏，以去除较重的冷凝物。

e.en: The manual explains {deflegmation} in the distillation column.
e.zh: 手册解释了蒸馏塔中的分馏除水过程。

e.en: Better cooling improved {deflegmation} of the alcohol vapor.
e.zh: 更好的冷却改善了酒精蒸汽的冷凝分离。

e.en: The load may {deflex} the thin metal strip.
e.zh: 这个负载可能会使薄金属条弯曲。

e.en: A prism can {deflex} a narrow beam of light.
e.zh: 棱镜可以使一束窄光发生偏斜。

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's {deflexed} petals.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花向下弯曲的花瓣。

e.en: The {deflexed} needle suggested a weak magnetic field.
e.zh: 偏斜的指针显示磁场较弱。

e.en: The bridge showed slight {deflexion} under the heavy truck.
e.zh: 重型卡车经过时，桥梁出现了轻微弯曲。

e.en: The experiment measured the {deflexion} of charged particles.
e.zh: 实验测量了带电粒子的偏斜。

e.en: The ceramic slurry needs a {deflocculant} to flow smoothly.
e.zh: 陶瓷浆料需要加入分散剂才能顺畅流动。

e.en: Too much {deflocculant} can weaken the final clay body.
e.zh: 解絮凝剂过多可能会削弱最终陶坯的强度。

e.en: Add sodium silicate to {deflocculate} the clay suspension.
e.zh: 加入硅酸钠可以使黏土悬浮液解絮凝。

e.en: The treatment helps {deflocculate} particles in the wastewater.
e.zh: 这种处理有助于分散废水中的颗粒。

e.en: Proper {deflocculation} keeps the glaze mixture stable.
e.zh: 适当的解絮凝能保持釉料混合物稳定。

e.en: The paper discusses {deflocculation} of fine mineral particles.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了细矿物颗粒的分散。

e.en: Gardeners sometimes {deflorate} plants to redirect their growth.
e.zh: 园丁有时会摘去植物的花朵，以调整其生长方向。

e.en: Older legal texts used {deflorate} in a sexual sense.
e.zh: 较早的法律文本中会用这个词表示夺去贞操。

e.en: The {defloration} of the rose bushes upset the gardener.
e.zh: 玫瑰丛被摘花让园丁很不高兴。

e.en: The archaic novel refers darkly to {defloration}.
e.zh: 这部古旧小说含蓄阴沉地提到夺贞。

e.en: The {defluent} stream carried silt into the lower valley.
e.zh: 向下流的溪水把淤泥带进了下游山谷。

e.en: A {defluent} discharge was visible below the pipe.
e.zh: 管道下方可以看到流出的排放物。

e.en: Moisture caused {defluidization} in the powder bed.
e.zh: 水分导致粉末床发生失流化。

e.en: The engineers studied {defluidization} during reactor shutdown.
e.zh: 工程师研究了反应器停机期间的去流态化现象。

e.en: Operators {defoam} the tank before adding the next ingredient.
e.zh: 操作员在加入下一种原料前先给罐体消泡。

e.en: The additive helps {defoam} the paint during mixing.
e.zh: 这种添加剂有助于在搅拌油漆时去除泡沫。

e.en: The brewer added a {defoamer} to control excessive foam.
e.zh: 酿酒师加入消泡剂来控制过多泡沫。

e.en: A silicone {defoamer} improved the coating process.
e.zh: 一种硅类消泡剂改善了涂布工艺。

defoaming.t: 消泡；去除泡沫剂使用或过程

e.en: The brewer added a {defoaming} agent to the tank.
e.zh: 酿酒师往罐里加入了消泡剂。

e.en: Better {defoaming} improved the quality of the coating.
e.zh: 更好的消泡处理提高了涂层质量。

e.en: Turn on the heater to {defog} the windshield.
e.zh: 打开暖风给挡风玻璃除雾。

e.en: She wiped her glasses to {defog} the lenses.
e.zh: 她擦了擦眼镜，让镜片上的雾气散去。

e.en: The rear-window {defogger} stopped working in winter.
e.zh: 冬天后窗除雾器坏了。

e.en: A bathroom mirror {defogger} keeps the glass clear.
e.zh: 浴室镜子的除雾装置能让镜面保持清晰。

e.en: The old statute made it illegal to {deforce} an heir.
e.zh: 旧法规规定非法剥夺继承人的占有权是违法的。

e.en: They tried to {deforce} the tenant from the land.
e.zh: 他们试图强行剥夺租户对土地的占有。

deforced.t: 被非法剥夺占有的；被强占的

e.en: The {deforced} owner sought relief in court.
e.zh: 被非法剥夺占有的业主向法院寻求救济。

e.en: The land was {deforced} during the dispute.
e.zh: 这块土地在纠纷期间被强占了。

deforceor.t: 非法剥夺他人占有者；强占者

e.en: The writ named the {deforceor} as the defendant.
e.zh: 令状把强占者列为被告。

e.en: A {deforceor} could be ordered to restore possession.
e.zh: 非法剥夺他人占有者可能被命令返还占有。

deforciant.t: 不动产转让诉讼中的被告

e.en: The {deforciant} appeared before the court.
e.zh: 该不动产转让诉讼中的被告出庭了。

e.en: In the record, the seller was called the {deforciant}.
e.zh: 在记录中，卖方被称为该诉讼中的被告。

deforcing.t: 非法剥夺占有；强占行为

e.en: The complaint accused them of {deforcing} the widow.
e.zh: 诉状指控他们非法剥夺寡妇的占有权。

e.en: {Deforcing} a lawful owner carried legal consequences.
e.zh: 强占合法所有人的财产会带来法律后果。

e.en: Engineers tested the {deformability} of the new alloy.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种新合金的可变形性。

e.en: High {deformability} helps the material absorb impact.
e.zh: 较高的形变能力有助于材料吸收冲击。

deformalize.t: 使非正式化；去除形式化

e.en: The team chose to {deformalize} the approval process.
e.zh: 团队决定让审批流程不再那么正式。

e.en: Writers often {deformalize} dialogue to sound natural.
e.zh: 作者常把对话写得更口语化，以显得自然。

deformative.t: 造成变形的；有关形变的

e.en: The crash had a {deformative} effect on the frame.
e.zh: 这次撞击使车架发生了变形。

e.en: The study measured {deformative} stress in the rock.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了岩石中的形变应力。

e.en: A {deformeter} recorded tiny changes in the beam.
e.zh: 变形测量仪记录了梁体的细微变化。

e.en: The lab calibrated the {deformeter} before testing.
e.zh: 实验室在测试前校准了形变计。

e.en: Archaeologists planned to {defossate} the buried vessel.
e.zh: 考古人员计划把埋藏的器皿挖掘出来。

e.en: The workers had to {defossate} stones from the trench.
e.zh: 工人们不得不从沟里挖出石块。

e.en: The old computer came with a disk {defragmenter}.
e.zh: 这台旧电脑自带磁盘碎片整理程序。

e.en: Running a {defragmenter} rarely helps modern solid-state drives.
e.zh: 运行碎片整理程序通常帮不了现代固态硬盘。

e.en: The report described a pattern of {defraudment}.
e.zh: 报告描述了一系列诈骗行为。

e.en: Victims sought compensation for the {defraudment}.
e.zh: 受害者为这起欺诈索赔。

e.en: Only travel costs are {defrayable} under this grant.
e.zh: 根据这项补助，只有差旅费可以报销。

e.en: The committee listed which expenses were {defrayable}.
e.zh: 委员会列出了哪些费用可以支付。

e.en: The contract provided for {defrayal} of legal costs.
e.zh: 合同规定了法律费用的承担。

e.en: Public {defrayal} made the project possible.
e.zh: 由公共资金支付费用使这个项目得以实施。

e.en: The bank agreed to {defreeze} the account.
e.zh: 银行同意解除该账户的冻结。

e.en: Place the pipe near warm air to {defreeze} it slowly.
e.zh: 把管道放在暖空气附近，让它慢慢解冻。

e.en: The operator added {defrother} to the flotation cell.
e.zh: 操作员向浮选槽中加入了消泡剂。

e.en: Too much {defrother} can affect the separation process.
e.zh: 消泡剂过多会影响分离过程。

e.en: Gardeners {defruit} young trees to strengthen growth.
e.zh: 园丁会摘掉幼树的果实，以促进生长。

e.en: The storm seemed to {defruit} the whole orchard overnight.
e.zh: 那场风暴似乎一夜之间把整片果园的果实都打落了。

e.en: Technicians must {defuel} the aircraft before maintenance.
e.zh: 技术人员必须在维修前抽除飞机燃料。

e.en: The crew worked overnight to {defuel} the damaged reactor.
e.zh: 工作人员连夜为受损反应堆卸燃料。

defunctive.t: 表示死亡的；与死亡有关的

e.en: The poem uses a {defunctive} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇带有与死亡相关的语调。

e.en: A {defunctive} notice appeared in the local paper.
e.zh: 当地报纸上刊登了一则讣告性质的通知。

e.en: The council voted to {defund} the program.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定停止资助该项目。

e.en: Activists urged lawmakers to {defund} the agency.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促立法者撤销该机构的经费。

e.en: The technician tried to {defuze} the old shell safely.
e.zh: 技术员试图安全地拆除那枚旧炮弹的引信。

e.en: Her calm reply helped {defuze} the argument.
e.zh: 她冷静的回答帮助化解了这场争执。

e.en: Researchers {deganglionate} the tissue before measuring reflex activity.
e.zh: 研究人员在测量反射活动前切除组织中的神经节。

e.en: The {deganglionated} segment showed reduced nerve responses.
e.zh: 被去神经节处理的部分显示出较弱的神经反应。

e.en: Water {degasification} improved the accuracy of the experiment.
e.zh: 水的脱气处理提高了实验的准确性。

e.en: The plant uses vacuum {degasification} before bottling the oil.
e.zh: 工厂在装瓶油品前使用真空脱气。

e.en: The engineer installed a {degasifier} beside the boiler.
e.zh: 工程师在锅炉旁安装了一台脱气器。

e.en: A faulty {degasifier} can leave bubbles in the liquid.
e.zh: 有故障的脱气器会让液体里残留气泡。

e.en: You should {degasify} the solvent before using it.
e.zh: 使用这种溶剂前应先把其中气体除去。

e.en: The system can {degasify} water under low pressure.
e.zh: 该系统能在低压下给水脱气。

e.en: The lab is {degasifying} the samples overnight.
e.zh: 实验室正在对样品进行整夜脱气处理。

e.en: A {degasifying} chamber removes trapped air from resin.
e.zh: 脱气室会除去树脂中困住的空气。

e.en: Technicians {degauss} the hard drives before disposal.
e.zh: 技术人员在处理硬盘前会先消磁。

e.en: The ship was {degaussed} to reduce its magnetic signature.
e.zh: 这艘船经过消磁以降低磁性特征。

e.en: The archive stored only {degaussed} tapes after the audit.
e.zh: 审计后，档案库只保存已消磁的磁带。

e.en: A {degaussed} monitor may show cleaner colors.
e.zh: 消磁后的显示器可能呈现更干净的色彩。

e.en: The office bought a {degausser} for old disks.
e.zh: 办公室买了一台消磁器来处理旧磁盘。

e.en: A powerful {degausser} can erase magnetic media quickly.
e.zh: 强力消磁器能迅速抹除磁性介质上的数据。

e.en: The machine {degausses} each drive in seconds.
e.zh: 这台机器几秒内就能给每块硬盘消磁。

e.en: She {degausses} the monitor whenever colors look distorted.
e.zh: 每当颜色看起来失真时，她就给显示器消磁。

e.en: The mechanic had to {degear} the motor before repair.
e.zh: 机械师必须先拆下电机齿轮再维修。

e.en: Climbers {degear} at the base after the descent.
e.zh: 攀登者下撤后在山脚卸下装备。

e.en: The process can {degelatinize} photographic film waste.
e.zh: 这一工艺能去除废旧摄影胶片中的明胶。

e.en: They {degelatinize} the mixture before further refining.
e.zh: 他们在进一步精炼前先使混合物脱胶。

degender.t: 去性别化；消除性别标记

e.en: The editor tried to {degender} the job description.
e.zh: 编辑试图去掉职位描述中的性别标记。

e.en: Some schools {degender} uniforms to give students more choice.
e.zh: 一些学校将校服去性别化，让学生有更多选择。

e.en: The report described the tissue's slow {degenerescence}.
e.zh: 报告描述了该组织缓慢退化的过程。

e.en: Critics saw moral {degenerescence} in the old regime.
e.zh: 批评者认为旧政权出现了道德衰退。

e.en: Factories {degerm} corn before making refined meal.
e.zh: 工厂在制作精制玉米粉前会去除玉米胚芽。

e.en: The mill can {degerm} grain with minimal waste.
e.zh: 这台磨粉机能以较少损耗给谷物去胚。

e.en: Corn {degermation} separates the germ from the kernel.
e.zh: 玉米去胚会把胚芽从籽粒中分离出来。

e.en: Improved {degermation} raised the quality of the flour.
e.zh: 改进的去胚处理提高了面粉质量。

e.en: The doctor noted patchy {deglabration} on the scalp.
e.zh: 医生注意到头皮上有斑片状脱毛。

e.en: Severe friction caused {deglabration} around the wound.
e.zh: 严重摩擦导致伤口周围毛发脱落。

e.en: Rapid {deglaciation} reshaped the northern valleys.
e.zh: 快速的冰川消退重塑了北部山谷。

e.en: Scientists study {deglaciation} through ancient sediment layers.
e.zh: 科学家通过古代沉积层研究冰消作用。

e.en: The film tries to {deglamorise} life in the army.
e.zh: 这部电影试图去除军旅生活的光鲜滤镜。

e.en: Her memoir {deglamorises} the fashion industry.
e.zh: 她的回忆录让时尚行业不再显得那么迷人。

e.en: The campaign aims to {deglamorize} smoking among teenagers.
e.zh: 这项宣传旨在让青少年不再觉得吸烟很酷。

e.en: The novel {deglamorizes} the myth of easy fame.
e.zh: 这部小说打破了一夜成名的迷人神话。

e.en: After searing the meat, {deglaze} the pan with wine.
e.zh: 煎好肉后，用葡萄酒化开锅底焦渣。

e.en: The chef used broth to {deglaze} the roasting tray.
e.zh: 厨师用高汤把烤盘底部的焦香物化开。

deglazing.t: 用液体溶解锅底焦香物形成酱汁

e.en: After searing the chicken, {deglazing} the pan with wine made a rich sauce.
e.zh: 煎好鸡肉后，用葡萄酒把锅底焦香物化开，做出了浓郁的酱汁。

e.en: The chef taught us that {deglazing} captures flavor stuck to the pan.
e.zh: 厨师教我们，脱釉能把粘在锅底的风味带进酱汁里。

e.en: The video editor used a {deglitcher} to smooth the corrupted footage.
e.zh: 视频剪辑师用去故障工具让损坏的画面变得平顺。

e.en: A good {deglitcher} can remove pops from old digital audio.
e.zh: 好的除错装置可以去掉旧数字音频里的爆音。

deglutinate.t: 使不再黏连；分开胶着物

e.en: The solvent helped {deglutinate} the pages stuck together by glue.
e.zh: 这种溶剂帮助把被胶水粘住的书页分开。

e.en: Technicians tried to {deglutinate} the fibers without tearing them.
e.zh: 技术人员试图把黏连的纤维分开，同时不把它们撕裂。

deglutinated.t: 已解除黏连的；已分开的

e.en: The {deglutinated} samples were easier to examine under the microscope.
e.zh: 解除黏连后的样本更容易在显微镜下观察。

e.en: Once {deglutinated}, the old stamps could be stored separately.
e.zh: 一旦分开，这些旧邮票就可以单独保存。

deglutinating.t: 正在解除黏连的；分离胶着的

e.en: The lab is {deglutinating} the tissue with a mild enzyme solution.
e.zh: 实验室正用温和的酶溶液分离黏连的组织。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {deglutinating} labels from antique bottles.
e.zh: 他花了一下午把古董瓶上的标签小心分离下来。

e.en: Careful {deglutination} prevented damage to the fragile documents.
e.zh: 小心解除黏连避免了脆弱文件受损。

e.en: The procedure relies on slow {deglutination} rather than force.
e.zh: 这个步骤依靠缓慢分离黏连，而不是强行拉开。

e.en: Pain during {deglutition} can be a sign of throat inflammation.
e.zh: 吞咽时疼痛可能是喉咙发炎的迹象。

e.en: The doctor observed the patient's {deglutition} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后观察病人的吞咽动作。

e.en: The therapist assessed the patient's {deglutitious} reflexes after the stroke.
e.zh: 治疗师评估了中风后病人与吞咽有关的反射。

e.en: A {deglutitious} disorder may make ordinary meals difficult.
e.zh: 吞咽相关障碍可能让普通用餐变得困难。

e.en: The restorer had to {degold} the frame before applying new leaf.
e.zh: 修复师必须先去掉画框上的旧金层，再贴上新的金箔。

e.en: Improper chemicals can {degold} plated jewelry too quickly.
e.zh: 不合适的化学品会过快去掉镀金首饰的金层。

e.en: The package label highlights the material's {degradability} in soil.
e.zh: 包装标签强调这种材料在土壤中的可降解性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {degradability} of the new plastic film.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种新塑料薄膜的易分解程度。

e.en: The main {degradand} was detected after the drug sat in heat.
e.zh: 药物受热放置后检测到了主要降解产物。

e.en: Each {degradand} was identified by mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 每一种分解生成物都通过质谱法进行了鉴定。

e.en: Sunlight can trigger {degradative} reactions in some polymers.
e.zh: 阳光会在某些聚合物中引发降解反应。

e.en: The cell uses {degradative} enzymes to break down waste proteins.
e.zh: 细胞利用分解性酶来降解废弃蛋白质。

degradinite.t: 煤中降解植物组织组分

e.en: The geologist identified {degradinite} in the coal sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在煤样中识别出了降解植物组织组分。

e.en: High {degradinite} content can indicate strong biological alteration.
e.zh: 降解植物组织组分含量高，可能说明生物改造作用很强。

degrain.t: 去除颗粒；去除 grain 纹理

e.en: The software can {degrain} a noisy photograph without blurring faces.
e.zh: 这款软件能去除照片噪点，同时不模糊人脸。

e.en: Mill workers {degrain} the hides before further tanning.
e.zh: 制革工人在进一步鞣制前会去除皮革表面的颗粒纹理。

e.en: The filter {degrains} old film while preserving sharp edges.
e.zh: 这个滤镜能去除老电影的颗粒感，同时保留清晰边缘。

e.en: This process {degrains} the surface before polishing begins.
e.zh: 这个工序会在抛光开始前去除表面的颗粒纹理。

e.en: Allergic reactions often involve mast cell {degranulation}.
e.zh: 过敏反应常常涉及肥大细胞脱颗粒。

e.en: The study measured {degranulation} after immune cells met the antigen.
e.zh: 研究测量了免疫细胞接触抗原后的颗粒释放情况。

degras.t: 氧化鱼油制成的皮革油脂

e.en: The tanner applied {degras} to soften the leather.
e.zh: 制革工人涂上皮革油脂来软化皮革。

e.en: Traditional chamois leather was treated with {degras}.
e.zh: 传统麂皮革会用氧化鱼油制成的油脂处理。

e.en: The mechanic chose a strong {degreasant} for the engine parts.
e.zh: 修理工为发动机零件选了一种强力脱脂剂。

e.en: A mild {degreasant} is safer on painted surfaces.
e.zh: 温和的去油污剂用在喷漆表面更安全。

e.en: You should {degrease} the pan before repainting it.
e.zh: 重新喷漆前，你应该先把锅上的油污去掉。

e.en: Workers {degrease} metal parts before welding.
e.zh: 工人在焊接前会给金属零件脱脂。

e.en: The {degreased} surface accepted the primer evenly.
e.zh: 去油后的表面能均匀吸附底漆。

e.en: She stored the {degreased} bones for making a clean broth.
e.zh: 她把脱脂后的骨头存起来，用来熬清爽的汤。

e.en: This cleaner {degreases} kitchen tiles very quickly.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂能很快去除厨房瓷砖上的油污。

e.en: The factory {degreases} each component before coating it.
e.zh: 工厂在给每个部件涂层前都会先脱脂。

e.en: Proper {degreasing} helps paint stick to the metal.
e.zh: 适当的脱脂处理有助于油漆附着在金属上。

e.en: She wore gloves while {degreasing} the oven racks.
e.zh: 她清洗烤箱架油污时戴着手套。

e.en: Farmers use a {degree-day} model to predict insect development.
e.zh: 农民使用度日模型来预测昆虫发育。

e.en: Heating demand is often estimated from {degree-day} totals.
e.zh: 供暖需求常根据度日总量来估算。

e.en: The policy introduced a planned {degression} in subsidies.
e.zh: 这项政策规定补贴将按计划逐步下降。

e.en: A tax {degression} can reduce rates as income falls.
e.zh: 税率递减可以在收入下降时降低税负。

e.en: The program uses a {degressive} payment schedule over five years.
e.zh: 该项目采用五年内逐步降低的付款安排。

e.en: Some countries apply {degressive} tariffs to encourage early investment.
e.zh: 一些国家采用递减关税来鼓励早期投资。

e.en: The tax rate falls {degressively} after each income band.
e.zh: 税率在每个收入档之后逐级递减。

e.en: Payments were reduced {degressively} over five years.
e.zh: 这些款项在五年内逐步降低。

e.en: The plant added a {degritting} stage before filtration.
e.zh: 工厂在过滤前增加了除砂环节。

e.en: Proper {degritting} protects the pumps from damage.
e.zh: 适当去除砂砾可以保护水泵不受损坏。

e.en: Workers {degum} the silk before dyeing it.
e.zh: 工人在染色前先给丝绸脱胶。

e.en: The refinery must {degum} crude vegetable oil.
e.zh: 炼油厂必须去除粗植物油中的胶质。

degussit.t: 十字交叉的；交叉成十字

e.en: The leaves showed a {degussit} arrangement on the stem.
e.zh: 这些叶子在茎上呈十字交叉排列。

e.en: A {degussit} pattern marked the old stone floor.
e.zh: 旧石地板上有十字交叉的纹样。

e.en: The critic paused to {degust} the rare wine.
e.zh: 评论家停下来细品那款稀有葡萄酒。

e.en: They came to {degust} cheeses from several farms.
e.zh: 他们来品尝几家农场出产的奶酪。

e.en: Guests were invited to {degustate} the new menu.
e.zh: 客人受邀品尝新菜单上的菜品。

e.en: She learned to {degustate} tea with careful attention.
e.zh: 她学会了专注地鉴赏茶的滋味。

e.en: The tannery must {dehair} hides before further treatment.
e.zh: 制革厂必须在后续处理前给兽皮去毛。

e.en: A mild cream can {dehair} the skin temporarily.
e.zh: 温和的乳膏可以暂时去除皮肤上的毛发。

e.en: The lab tested {dehardining} methods for mineral water.
e.zh: 实验室测试了矿泉水的软化处理方法。

e.en: Poor {dehardining} left scale inside the pipes.
e.zh: 软化处理不当使管道内留下了水垢。

e.en: Iberian pigs roam freely in the {dehesa}.
e.zh: 伊比利亚猪在疏林牧场里自由活动。

e.en: The {dehesa} supports both grazing and oak woodland.
e.zh: 这种疏林牧场兼有放牧地和橡树林。

e.en: The {dehider} worked quickly at the slaughterhouse.
e.zh: 剥皮工在屠宰场里动作很快。

e.en: A mechanical {dehider} reduces manual labor.
e.zh: 机械剥皮机减少了人工劳动。

e.en: The company decided to {dehire} temporary staff.
e.zh: 公司决定解雇临时员工。

e.en: They may {dehire} the contractor after the audit.
e.zh: 审计之后他们可能会取消雇用该承包商。

e.en: The seed pods {dehisce} when they dry.
e.zh: 种荚干燥后会裂开。

e.en: The surgical wound began to {dehisce} overnight.
e.zh: 手术伤口一夜之间开始开裂。

e.en: Pea pods are {dehiscent} when fully mature.
e.zh: 豌豆荚完全成熟时会裂开。

e.en: The doctor noted a {dehiscent} wound edge.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口边缘已经开裂。

e.en: The capsule {dehisces} along a single seam.
e.zh: 这个蒴果沿一条缝裂开。

e.en: Sometimes an incision {dehisces} after surgery.
e.zh: 有时手术切口会在术后裂开。

e.en: The botanist photographed a {dehiscing} seed pod.
e.zh: 植物学家拍下了正在裂开的种荚。

e.en: The nurse worried about the {dehiscing} wound.
e.zh: 护士担心那处正在开裂的伤口。

e.en: Farmers often {dehorn} calves for safety.
e.zh: 农民常为安全起见给小牛去角。

e.en: The vet refused to {dehorn} the animal without anesthesia.
e.zh: 兽医拒绝在没有麻醉的情况下给动物去角。

e.en: The {dehorned} cattle were easier to transport.
e.zh: 去角后的牛更容易运输。

e.en: A {dehorned} goat stood near the fence.
e.zh: 一只已去角的山羊站在栅栏旁。

e.en: The rancher cleaned the {dehorner} after use.
e.zh: 牧场主使用后清洁了去角工具。

e.en: A skilled {dehorner} can reduce the animal's stress.
e.zh: 熟练的去角者能减轻动物的压力。

e.en: The vet {dehorns} young cattle in spring.
e.zh: 兽医在春天给幼牛去角。

e.en: This tool {dehorns} calves quickly and cleanly.
e.zh: 这种工具能快速干净地给小牛去角。

e.en: The evidence was {dehors} the written contract.
e.zh: 该证据在书面合同之外。

e.en: His claim stands {dehors} the main dispute.
e.zh: 他的主张与主要争议无关。

e.en: The elder tried to {dehort} him from revenge.
e.zh: 长者试图劝阻他不要复仇。

e.en: Her speech sought to {dehort} students from cheating.
e.zh: 她的演讲旨在劝学生不要作弊。

e.en: The sermon became a stern {dehortation} against greed.
e.zh: 那篇布道成了严厉劝阻贪婪的训诫。

e.en: His {dehortation} failed to stop the reckless plan.
e.zh: 他的劝阻没能阻止那个鲁莽计划。

e.en: The pamphlet used a {dehortative} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这本小册子通篇采用劝阻性的语气。

e.en: She wrote a {dehortative} letter about gambling.
e.zh: 她写了一封劝人不要赌博的信。

e.en: The judge gave a {dehortatory} warning to the crowd.
e.zh: 法官向人群发出了告诫性的警告。

e.en: His {dehortatory} remarks discouraged further violence.
e.zh: 他的劝阻性言论遏止了进一步的暴力。

e.en: The teacher {dehorted} the boys from fighting.
e.zh: 老师劝阻那些男孩不要打架。

e.en: He {dehorted} them against taking revenge.
e.zh: 他劝他们不要报复。

e.en: The old priest was a stern {dehorter} of vice.
e.zh: 那位老神父是严厉劝人远离恶习的人。

e.en: She became the group's main {dehorter} against risky shortcuts.
e.zh: 她成了小组里主要劝大家别走危险捷径的人。

e.en: His speech was aimed at {dehorting} them from violence.
e.zh: 他的演讲旨在劝阻他们不要使用暴力。

e.en: The pamphlet kept {dehorting} readers from gambling.
e.zh: 那本小册子不断劝读者不要赌博。

e.en: The mill bought a new rice {dehuller}.
e.zh: 磨坊买了一台新的稻米去壳机。

e.en: A skilled {dehuller} can reduce broken grains.
e.zh: 熟练的去壳工能减少碎米。

e.en: The novel describes the {dehumanisation} caused by war.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了战争造成的非人化。

e.en: Propaganda often begins with the {dehumanisation} of enemies.
e.zh: 宣传往往从把敌人非人化开始。

e.en: The archive needs constant {dehumidification} to protect old papers.
e.zh: 档案馆需要持续除湿来保护旧文件。

e.en: Good {dehumidification} prevents mold in the basement.
e.zh: 良好的除湿能防止地下室发霉。

e.en: The room was {dehumidified} before the instruments arrived.
e.zh: 仪器送到前，房间已经除湿。

e.en: They stored the lenses in a {dehumidified} cabinet.
e.zh: 他们把镜头存放在除湿柜里。

e.en: This machine {dehumidifies} the air very quickly.
e.zh: 这台机器能很快给空气除湿。

e.en: The system {dehumidifies} the greenhouse at night.
e.zh: 这套系统在夜间降低温室湿度。

e.en: We need to {dehumidify} the storage room.
e.zh: 我们需要给储藏室除湿。

e.en: Air conditioners can cool and {dehumidify} indoor air.
e.zh: 空调可以给室内空气降温并除湿。

e.en: A small {dehumidizer} kept the closet dry.
e.zh: 一个小除湿器让衣柜保持干燥。

e.en: The lab installed a chemical {dehumidizer} near the samples.
e.zh: 实验室在样品旁安装了化学干燥装置。

e.en: The farm repaired its corn {dehusher} before harvest.
e.zh: 农场在收获前修好了玉米去皮机。

e.en: A noisy {dehusher} stood beside the threshing machine.
e.zh: 一台吵闹的去壳器放在脱粒机旁边。

e.en: The coconut {dehusker} made the work faster.
e.zh: 椰子脱壳机让工作更快。

e.en: An experienced {dehusker} handled each ear of corn carefully.
e.zh: 经验丰富的去皮工仔细处理每个玉米穗。

e.en: Silica gel is often used as a {dehydrant}.
e.zh: 硅胶常被用作干燥剂。

e.en: The chemist added a {dehydrant} to remove water.
e.zh: 化学师加入脱水剂来除去水分。

e.en: The enzyme {dehydratase} removes water from the molecule.
e.zh: 这种脱水酶会从分子中移除水。

e.en: Researchers measured {dehydratase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞中的脱水酶活性。

e.en: The lab tested blood levels of {dehydroandrosterone}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了血液中的脱氢雄甾酮水平。

e.en: Some studies discuss {dehydroandrosterone} as a steroid hormone.
e.zh: 一些研究把脱氢雄甾酮作为类固醇激素来讨论。

e.en: The expedition carried {dehydrocanned} vegetables for emergencies.
e.zh: 探险队携带了脱水罐装蔬菜以备急用。

e.en: The company sold {dehydrocanned} soup to hikers.
e.zh: 公司向徒步者出售脱水罐装汤。

e.en: The bacterium produces {dehydrochlorinase} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 这种细菌在特定条件下会产生脱氯化氢酶。

e.en: They purified {dehydrochlorinase} for the reaction study.
e.zh: 他们纯化了脱氯化氢酶用于反应研究。

e.en: Heat can {dehydrochlorinate} the compound slowly.
e.zh: 加热会使这种化合物缓慢脱氯化氢。

e.en: The process may {dehydrochlorinate} the plastic during recycling.
e.zh: 回收过程中可能会使塑料脱氯化氢。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {dehydrochlorophyll}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量脱氢叶绿素。

e.en: Scientists compared chlorophyll with {dehydrochlorophyll} in the extract.
e.zh: 科学家比较了提取物中的叶绿素和脱氢叶绿素。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the patient's {dehydrocortisone} treatment history.
e.zh: 医生查看了患者的脱氢可的松治疗史。

e.en: The paper describes {dehydrocortisone} as a corticosteroid compound.
e.zh: 论文把脱氢可的松描述为一种皮质类固醇化合物。

e.en: The extract was analyzed for {dehydrocurdione}.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了提取物中的脱氢莪术二酮。

e.en: They reported {dehydrocurdione} in the plant oil sample.
e.zh: 他们报告植物油样品中含有脱氢莪术二酮。

e.en: The catalyst promotes {dehydrocyclization} at high temperature.
e.zh: 这种催化剂在高温下促进脱氢环化反应。

e.en: Aromatic rings can form through {dehydrocyclization}.
e.zh: 芳香环可以通过脱氢环化形成。

e.en: Blood tests showed low {dehydroepoandrosterone} levels.
e.zh: 血液检测显示脱氢表雄酮水平偏低。

e.en: The supplement label mentioned {dehydroepoandrosterone}.
e.zh: 补充剂标签上提到了脱氢表雄酮。

e.en: The company preserved berries by {dehydrofreezing}.
e.zh: 公司用脱水冷冻法保存浆果。

e.en: Researchers compared {dehydrofreezing} with ordinary freezing.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了脱水冷冻法和普通冷冻。

e.en: The chef used {dehydrofrozen} mushrooms in the stew.
e.zh: 厨师在炖菜中使用了脱水冷冻蘑菇。

e.en: Samples were stored as {dehydrofrozen} fruit slices.
e.zh: 样品以脱水冷冻水果片的形式储存。

e.en: The catalyst can {dehydrogenate} the alcohol under mild conditions.
e.zh: 这种催化剂能在温和条件下使醇脱氢。

e.en: Chemists {dehydrogenate} certain compounds to create double bonds.
e.zh: 化学家会让某些化合物脱氢以形成双键。

e.en: The reaction proceeds by {dehydrogenation} of the starting material.
e.zh: 该反应通过起始物的脱氢过程进行。

e.en: Industrial {dehydrogenation} often requires high temperatures and catalysts.
e.zh: 工业脱氢通常需要高温和催化剂。

e.en: Several {dehydrogenations} occur before the final product forms.
e.zh: 最终产物形成前会发生几次脱氢反应。

e.en: The paper compared two enzymatic {dehydrogenations} in the pathway.
e.zh: 论文比较了该途径中的两种酶促脱氢反应。

e.en: The old report called the process {dehydrogenization}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这个过程称为脱氢化作用。

e.en: Efficient {dehydrogenization} improved the yield of the alkene.
e.zh: 高效脱氢提高了烯烃的产率。

e.en: The base promotes {dehydrohalogenation} of the alkyl bromide.
e.zh: 这种碱促进烷基溴化物发生脱卤化氢反应。

e.en: Students studied {dehydrohalogenation} as a route to alkenes.
e.zh: 学生把脱卤化氢反应作为制备烯烃的一种途径来学习。

e.en: The lab measured {dehydroisoandrosterone} in the serum sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了血清样本中的脱氢异雄酮。

e.en: Older papers sometimes use {dehydroisoandrosterone} for this adrenal steroid.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用脱氢异雄酮指这种肾上腺类固醇。

e.en: The enzyme was said to catalyze {dehydrolysis} in the mixture.
e.zh: 据称这种酶能催化混合物中的脱水解作用。

e.en: Modern authors rarely use {dehydrolysis} in standard reaction names.
e.zh: 现代作者很少在标准反应名称中使用脱水解这个词。

e.en: The treatment may {dehydrolyze} the compound before analysis.
e.zh: 这种处理可能在分析前使该化合物脱水解。

e.en: Few textbooks still use {dehydrolyze} as an ordinary verb.
e.zh: 如今很少有教材还把dehydrolyze当作普通动词使用。

e.en: Fish liver oil contains some {dehydroretinol}.
e.zh: 鱼肝油中含有一些脱氢视黄醇。

e.en: Researchers identified {dehydroretinol} as a vitamin A related compound.
e.zh: 研究人员将脱氢视黄醇鉴定为一种维生素A相关化合物。

e.en: The doctor discussed {dehydrotachysterol} as an older therapy.
e.zh: 医生提到脱氢速甾醇是一种较早的疗法。

e.en: Pharmacists monitored calcium levels during {dehydrotachysterol} treatment.
e.zh: 药师在脱氢速甾醇治疗期间监测钙水平。

e.en: High {dehydrotestosterone} levels can affect hair follicles.
e.zh: 较高的双氢睾酮水平会影响毛囊。

e.en: The medication blocks conversion of testosterone to {dehydrotestosterone}.
e.zh: 这种药物阻断睾酮转化为双氢睾酮。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {dehydrothiamine}.
e.zh: 样本中含有微量脱氢硫胺素。

e.en: Chemists studied {dehydrothiamine} as an oxidized thiamine derivative.
e.zh: 化学家把脱氢硫胺素作为氧化型硫胺素衍生物来研究。

e.en: The therapist tried to {dehypnotize} the patient gently.
e.zh: 治疗师试图温和地解除患者的催眠状态。

e.en: A sudden noise seemed to {dehypnotize} the audience.
e.zh: 一阵突如其来的声音似乎让观众从着迷状态中清醒过来。

e.en: Crews must {deice} the plane before takeoff.
e.zh: 机组人员必须在起飞前给飞机除冰。

e.en: The city uses salt to {deice} busy roads.
e.zh: 市政府用盐给繁忙道路除冰。

e.en: The wings were {deiced} before the flight departed.
e.zh: 航班起飞前，机翼已经除过冰。

e.en: Drivers crossed the {deiced} bridge with more confidence.
e.zh: 司机们更放心地驶过已除冰的桥。

e.en: She sprayed {deicer} on the frozen windshield.
e.zh: 她把除冰剂喷在结冰的挡风玻璃上。

e.en: The airport bought a new {deicer} for winter operations.
e.zh: 机场为冬季运行购买了一台新的除冰设备。

e.en: The ground crew {deices} every aircraft in freezing rain.
e.zh: 地勤人员会在冻雨中给每架飞机除冰。

e.en: This spray {deices} the lock within seconds.
e.zh: 这种喷剂能在几秒内给锁除冰。

e.en: The myth describes a hero accused of {deicide}.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了一位被指控弑神的英雄。

e.en: The theologian treated {deicide} as a grave symbolic charge.
e.zh: 那位神学家把弑神视为严重的象征性指控。

e.en: The flight was delayed for {deicing}.
e.zh: 航班因除冰作业而延误。

e.en: Road crews began {deicing} the highway before dawn.
e.zh: 道路维护人员在黎明前开始给高速公路除冰。

e.en: The word was used {deictically} to point to the speaker.
e.zh: 这个词以指示语方式指向说话者。

e.en: Children often interpret pronouns {deictically} in conversation.
e.zh: 儿童在对话中常按指示语方式理解代词。

e.en: The king claimed {deific} authority over his subjects.
e.zh: 国王声称自己对臣民拥有神圣权威。

e.en: Her fans described her voice in almost {deific} terms.
e.zh: 她的粉丝几乎用神一般的词语形容她的嗓音。

e.en: The poet praised the ruler's {deifical} power.
e.zh: 诗人赞颂统治者神一般的力量。

e.en: Such {deifical} language sounds archaic today.
e.zh: 这种神圣化的说法在今天听起来很古旧。

e.en: The historian called him a {deifier} of military leaders.
e.zh: 历史学家称他是把军事领袖神化的人。

e.en: A {deifier} may turn ordinary success into legend.
e.zh: 神化者可能把普通的成功变成传奇。

e.en: The statue had a {deiform} calm that impressed visitors.
e.zh: 这座雕像有一种神祇般的宁静，令参观者印象深刻。

e.en: Poets once praised kings in {deiform} language.
e.zh: 诗人过去常用近乎神化的语言赞颂国王。

e.en: The painting suggests {deiformity} without showing a halo.
e.zh: 这幅画没有画光环，却暗示出一种神性外形。

e.en: Critics saw political ambition behind the ruler's claimed {deiformity}.
e.zh: 评论者认为统治者宣称自己具有神性，是出于政治野心。

e.en: Words like here and now have a {deiktic} function.
e.zh: here和now这类词具有指示语境的功能。

e.en: The lecturer explained the {deiktic} meaning of the gesture.
e.zh: 讲师解释了那个手势所带有的指示性意义。

e.en: The cleaner used a {deincrustant} to remove mineral deposits.
e.zh: 清洁工使用除垢剂去除矿物沉积。

e.en: A mild {deincrustant} is safer for old ceramic surfaces.
e.zh: 温和的除垢剂对老旧陶瓷表面更安全。

e.en: Some coastal towns began to {deindustrialise} after the shipyards closed.
e.zh: 造船厂关闭后，一些沿海城镇开始去工业化。

e.en: The policy could {deindustrialise} regions that depend on heavy manufacturing.
e.zh: 这项政策可能削弱依赖重工业地区的工业基础。

deindustrialising.t: 去工业化的；削弱工业的

e.en: The report studied a {deindustrialising} city in northern England.
e.zh: 这份报告研究了英格兰北部一座正在去工业化的城市。

e.en: Workers feared the {deindustrialising} effects of cheaper imports.
e.zh: 工人担心廉价进口商品会削弱本地工业。

e.en: Automation did not fully {deindustrialize} the region.
e.zh: 自动化并没有让该地区完全去工业化。

e.en: Bad trade policy can {deindustrialize} a small economy quickly.
e.zh: 糟糕的贸易政策可能迅速削弱一个小经济体的工业。

e.en: The warehouse required {deinsectization} before grain could be stored.
e.zh: 仓库必须先进行除虫处理，才能储存粮食。

e.en: Improper {deinsectization} can leave eggs hidden in wooden crates.
e.zh: 除虫处理不当时，虫卵可能仍藏在木箱里。

e.en: The reform aimed to {deinstitutionalise} patients with stable conditions.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在让病情稳定的患者脱离机构照护。

e.en: Officials promised to {deinstitutionalise} care and expand community services.
e.zh: 官员承诺推动照护去机构化，并扩大社区服务。

e.en: Many {deinstitutionalised} patients needed help finding housing.
e.zh: 许多已脱离机构照护的患者需要帮助寻找住处。

e.en: The charity supports {deinstitutionalised} adults living in the community.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构支持在社区生活的已去机构化成年人。

deinstitutionalization.t: 去机构化；脱离机构照护

e.en: {Deinstitutionalization} changed mental health policy in many countries.
e.zh: 去机构化改变了许多国家的心理健康政策。

e.en: Without housing support, {deinstitutionalization} left some people vulnerable.
e.zh: 如果没有住房支持，脱离机构照护会让一些人陷入脆弱处境。

e.en: The state planned to {deinstitutionalize} long-term psychiatric patients.
e.zh: 该州计划让长期精神科患者脱离机构照护。

e.en: Reformers wanted to {deinstitutionalize} disability services.
e.zh: 改革者希望推动残障服务去机构化。

e.en: Moisture can {deintegrate} the fragile paper over time.
e.zh: 潮气会随着时间推移使脆弱的纸张分解。

e.en: Internal conflict may {deintegrate} the coalition before the election.
e.zh: 内部冲突可能在选举前瓦解这个联盟。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {deintoxication} after the chemical exposure.
e.zh: 化学品暴露后，医生监测他的解毒过程。

e.en: The clinic advertised rapid {deintoxication} for drug dependence.
e.zh: 那家诊所宣传可为药物依赖者提供快速排毒治疗。

e.en: The enzyme controls {deiodination} of thyroid hormones.
e.zh: 这种酶控制甲状腺激素的脱碘作用。

e.en: Researchers measured {deiodination} in the treated water samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了处理后水样中的去碘过程。

e.en: {Deionization} removes charged particles from water.
e.zh: 去离子化会去除水中的带电粒子。

e.en: The lab uses {deionization} before preparing sensitive solutions.
e.zh: 实验室在配制敏感溶液前会先进行去离子处理。

e.en: The system can {deionize} water for laboratory use.
e.zh: 这套系统可以为实验室用水去除离子。

e.en: Technicians {deionize} the rinse water to prevent mineral spots.
e.zh: 技术人员会将冲洗水去离子化，以防留下矿物斑点。

e.en: The aquarium owner installed a {deionizer} for purer water.
e.zh: 水族箱主人安装了去离子器，以获得更纯净的水。

e.en: A broken {deionizer} caused contamination in the lab supply line.
e.zh: 去离子器故障导致实验室供水管线受到污染。

e.en: This filter {deionizes} water before it reaches the tank.
e.zh: 这个过滤器会在水进入水箱前去除其中的离子。

e.en: The cartridge {deionizes} the final rinse in the washer.
e.zh: 这个滤芯会对清洗机的最后冲洗水进行去离子处理。

e.en: At dinner, she proved a witty {deipnosophist}.
e.zh: 晚餐时，她展现出机智的餐桌谈话能力。

e.en: The essay describes the old scholar as a charming {deipnosophist}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把那位老学者描写成一位迷人的餐桌健谈者。

deistical.t: 自然神论的；信奉自然神论的

e.en: His essay defended a {deistical} view of creation.
e.zh: 他的文章为一种自然神论的创世观辩护。

e.en: The preacher criticized the poet's {deistical} language.
e.zh: 那位传道人批评诗人使用带有自然神论色彩的语言。

deistically.t: 以自然神论方式；按自然神论观点

e.en: She interpreted the universe {deistically}, without miracles.
e.zh: 她以自然神论方式理解宇宙，不诉诸神迹。

e.en: The philosopher wrote {deistically} about divine providence.
e.zh: 那位哲学家按自然神论观点论述神的眷顾。

deisticalness.t: 自然神论性质；自然神论色彩

e.en: Critics noted the {deisticalness} of his theology.
e.zh: 评论者指出他的神学带有自然神论色彩。

e.en: The poem's {deisticalness} troubled orthodox readers.
e.zh: 这首诗的自然神论倾向让正统派读者不安。

e.en: The scene gave her a strange {deja} feeling.
e.zh: 这个场景让她产生一种奇怪的似曾相识感。

e.en: He joked that every committee meeting was {deja} again.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说每次委员会会议都像又来了一遍。

e.en: The rejection did not {deject} her for long.
e.zh: 那次拒绝并没有让她沮丧太久。

e.en: Bad news can {deject} even a confident team.
e.zh: 坏消息也可能让一支自信的团队灰心。

e.en: The doctor examined the patient's {dejecta} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查病人的排泄物，以寻找感染迹象。

e.en: Volcanic {dejecta} covered the nearby fields.
e.zh: 火山喷出的碎屑覆盖了附近的田地。

e.en: The long delay was deeply {dejecting} for applicants.
e.zh: 漫长的拖延让申请者非常沮丧。

e.en: She avoided the {dejecting} habit of comparing herself with others.
e.zh: 她避免拿自己和别人比较这种令人灰心的习惯。

e.en: Constant criticism {dejects} young performers quickly.
e.zh: 不断的批评很快会让年轻表演者灰心。

e.en: A rainy start rarely {dejects} experienced hikers.
e.zh: 开头下雨很少会让有经验的徒步者沮丧。

e.en: In that old card game, a {dek} counted as ten.
e.zh: 在那种老式纸牌游戏里，dek算作十点。

e.en: The manuscript used {dek} as a rare spelling for ten.
e.zh: 那份手稿把dek用作“十”的罕见拼法。

e.en: The recipe calls for one {dekagram} of yeast.
e.zh: 这份食谱需要一十克酵母。

e.en: A {dekagram} equals ten grams.
e.zh: 一十克等于十克。

e.en: The code used a {dekahexadecimal} numbering system.
e.zh: 这段代码使用二十六进制编号系统。

e.en: A {dekahexadecimal} digit can represent twenty-six values.
e.zh: 一个二十六进制数字可以表示二十六个值。

e.en: The tank holds one {dekaliter} of water.
e.zh: 这个水箱能装一十升水。

e.en: They measured the wine by the {dekaliter}.
e.zh: 他们按十升为单位计量葡萄酒。

e.en: The barrel contained a full {dekalitre} of cider.
e.zh: 这个桶里装了整整一十升苹果酒。

e.en: A {dekalitre} is rarely used in everyday speech.
e.zh: 十升这个单位在日常口语中很少使用。

e.en: The rope was exactly one {dekameter} long.
e.zh: 这根绳子正好有一十米长。

e.en: A {dekameter} equals ten meters.
e.zh: 一十米等于十米。

e.en: The survey marked every {dekametre} along the road.
e.zh: 测量人员沿路每隔十米做一个标记。

e.en: One {dekametre} is ten metres in length.
e.zh: 一十米在长度上等于十米。

e.en: The chart used a {dekametric} scale for distance.
e.zh: 这张图用十米制比例表示距离。

e.en: Old textbooks sometimes mention {dekametric} units.
e.zh: 旧教材有时会提到十进度量单位。

e.en: The force was recorded as one {dekanem}.
e.zh: 这个力被记录为一十牛顿。

e.en: Engineers no longer use the {dekanem} very often.
e.zh: 工程师现在已不太常用十牛顿这个单位。

e.en: The farmer bought one {dekare} of hillside land.
e.zh: 那位农民买了一十公亩山坡地。

e.en: A {dekare} is equal to one thousand square meters.
e.zh: 一十公亩等于一千平方米。

e.en: They ordered a {dekastere} of firewood.
e.zh: 他们订购了一十立方米木柴。

e.en: The old contract measured timber by the {dekastere}.
e.zh: 那份旧合同按十立方米计量木材。

e.en: The museum displayed a working {dekatron} counter.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台还能工作的十进计数管。

e.en: A {dekatron} was once used in early computers.
e.zh: 十进计数管曾用于早期计算机。

e.en: Take a {dekko} at this strange old map.
e.zh: 看一眼这张奇怪的旧地图。

e.en: He had a quick {dekko} before leaving.
e.zh: 他离开前匆匆看了一眼。

e.en: The rules say that {deks} beat nines.
e.zh: 规则说十点牌压过九点牌。

e.en: The glossary listed {deks} as a plural form.
e.zh: 词汇表把deks列为一个复数形式。

e.en: The dialect shows {delabialization} before front vowels.
e.zh: 这种方言在前元音前表现出去唇化。

e.en: Linguists studied {delabialization} in the child's speech.
e.zh: 语言学家研究了这个孩子言语中的唇音弱化现象。

e.en: The geologist identified {delafossite} in the polished rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在抛光岩样中鉴定出铜铁矿类矿物。

e.en: Researchers studied {delafossite} as a possible transparent conductor.
e.zh: 研究人员把铜铁矿类材料作为潜在透明导体来研究。

e.en: Her winter dress was made of soft {delaine}.
e.zh: 她的冬装是用柔软的细羊毛织物做的。

e.en: The shop imported patterned {delaine} for women's gowns.
e.zh: 那家店进口带花纹的细羊毛布来做女式长裙。

e.en: Neglect can {delapidate} even a strong old house.
e.zh: 长期疏于维护会让一座坚固的老房子也变得破败。

e.en: Years of damp weather helped {delapidate} the abandoned mill.
e.zh: 多年的潮湿天气使那座废弃磨坊日渐荒废。

e.en: The clerk chose to {delate} the fraud to the magistrate.
e.zh: 那名职员选择向地方法官告发这起欺诈。

e.en: Old laws allowed citizens to {delate} suspected traitors.
e.zh: 旧法律允许公民正式控告涉嫌叛国的人。

e.en: The {delated} official denied every charge against him.
e.zh: 那名被告发的官员否认了所有指控。

e.en: Once {delated}, the merchant had to answer before the council.
e.zh: 一经被控告，那名商人就必须到议会前答辩。

e.en: He feared that {delating} his employer would cost him his job.
e.zh: 他担心告发雇主会让自己丢掉工作。

e.en: The pamphlet accused rivals of {delating} innocent neighbors.
e.zh: 那本小册子指责对手控告无辜的邻居。

e.en: The court record mentions his {delation} of the smugglers.
e.zh: 法庭记录提到他对走私者的告发。

e.en: In that period, {delation} could be rewarded with confiscated property.
e.zh: 在那个时期，正式告发可能会以没收来的财产作为奖赏。

e.en: The {delator} received money for naming the conspirators.
e.zh: 那名告发者因说出同谋者的名字而得到钱。

e.en: No one trusted the {delator} after the trial ended.
e.zh: 审判结束后，没有人再信任那个密告人。

e.en: The paper measured {delavaconitine} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 论文测定了植物提取物中的德拉瓦乌头碱。

e.en: Toxicologists warned that {delavaconitine} can be dangerous in small doses.
e.zh: 毒理学家警告说，少量德拉瓦乌头碱也可能有危险。

e.en: The bar association voted to {delawyer} him after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，律师协会投票决定取消他的律师资格。

e.en: A serious ethics breach can {delawyer} even a famous attorney.
e.zh: 严重违反职业道德甚至会让知名律师失去执业资格。

e.en: The engineer installed a {delay-action} switch on the alarm.
e.zh: 工程师在警报器上安装了一个延迟作用开关。

e.en: This {delay-action} fuse gives workers time to move away.
e.zh: 这种延迟引信能让工人有时间离开。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {delayed-action} tablet for nighttime relief.
e.zh: 医生开了一种延迟起效片，用于夜间缓解症状。

e.en: A {delayed-action} mechanism kept the door open for ten seconds.
e.zh: 一个延迟动作装置让门保持开启十秒。

e.en: The company began {delayering} to reduce management costs.
e.zh: 公司开始推行组织扁平化，以降低管理成本。

e.en: After {delayering}, employees reported directly to regional directors.
e.zh: 去层级之后，员工直接向区域主管汇报。

e.en: A {delcredere} agent guarantees payment from the buyer.
e.zh: 保付代理人会保证买方付款。

e.en: The contract included a {delcredere} commission for the extra risk.
e.zh: 合同中包含一笔保付佣金，用来补偿额外风险。

e.en: The editor wrote {dele} beside the repeated sentence.
e.zh: 编辑在重复的句子旁写下删除符号。

e.en: Please {dele} the comma before the final clause.
e.zh: 请删除最后一个从句前面的逗号。

e.en: The crew started {deleading} the old apartment walls.
e.zh: 施工队开始对旧公寓墙面进行除铅处理。

e.en: Proper {deleading} requires masks and sealed work areas.
e.zh: 正规的去铅作业需要口罩和封闭施工区。

e.en: Sweet music seemed to {delecate} the tired guests.
e.zh: 甜美的音乐似乎让疲惫的客人感到愉悦。

e.en: The rare wine could {delecate} even a severe critic.
e.zh: 这种珍稀葡萄酒甚至能让严苛的评论家高兴。

e.en: The dessert's {delectability} made everyone ask for seconds.
e.zh: 这道甜点的美味让每个人都想再来一份。

e.en: She praised the {delectability} of a quiet afternoon at home.
e.zh: 她称赞在家度过安静下午的那种可喜之处。

e.en: The chef hoped to {delectate} guests with a simple soup.
e.zh: 厨师希望用一道简单的汤让客人享受美味。

e.en: Poets once wrote that spring flowers {delectate} the soul.
e.zh: 诗人曾写道，春花使心灵愉悦。

e.en: Routine decisions are {delegable} to junior managers.
e.zh: 日常决策可以委派给初级经理处理。

e.en: The statute defines which powers are {delegable}.
e.zh: 该法规界定了哪些权力可以授权他人行使。

e.en: The small {delegacy} met the minister after lunch.
e.zh: 这个小代表团午饭后会见了部长。

e.en: His {delegacy} covered only routine financial approvals.
e.zh: 他被委派的职权只包括日常财务审批。

e.en: The proposal would {delegalize} several online gambling sites.
e.zh: 这项提案会使几个在线赌博网站失去合法地位。

e.en: Activists feared the decree could {delegalize} their organization.
e.zh: 活动人士担心该法令可能使他们的组织被认定为非法。

e.en: The {delegant} remained responsible for the final decision.
e.zh: 授权人仍然要对最终决定负责。

e.en: Each {delegant} signed a form naming the representative.
e.zh: 每位委派者都签署了表格，指定自己的代表。

e.en: The {delegatee} must report any conflict of interest.
e.zh: 受委派者必须报告任何利益冲突。

e.en: A good {delegatee} asks for clarification before acting.
e.zh: 好的受托人在行动前会先要求澄清。

e.en: The contract included a {delegatory} clause for emergencies.
e.zh: 合同中包含一项用于紧急情况的授权条款。

e.en: Her role was mainly {delegatory}, not supervisory.
e.zh: 她的角色主要是委派性质的，而不是监督性质的。

delegitimate.t: 使失去合法性；削弱正当性

e.en: The scandal threatened to {delegitimate} the new government.
e.zh: 这场丑闻威胁到新政府的合法性。

e.en: They used propaganda to {delegitimate} peaceful opposition.
e.zh: 他们利用宣传来削弱和平反对派的正当性。

e.en: The regime tried to {delegitimize} independent journalists.
e.zh: 该政权试图让独立记者失去公信力。

e.en: False accusations can {delegitimize} a fair protest.
e.zh: 虚假指控可能削弱一场正当抗议的合法性。

delenda.t: 应删除之物；应废除之事

e.en: The editor marked several paragraphs as {delenda}.
