e.en: The note says the mark moves {deorsum} during the test.
e.zh: 说明写着测试时标记会向下移动。

e.en: In anatomical Latin, {deorsum} means downward.
e.zh: 在解剖学拉丁用法中，deorsum 表示向下。

e.en: The exam measured {deorsumvergence} during vertical eye movement.
e.zh: 检查测量了垂直眼球运动中的双眼向下会聚。

e.en: Impaired {deorsumvergence} can affect reading on a lower screen.
e.zh: 向下会聚受损可能影响阅读较低位置的屏幕。

deoscillator.t: 去振荡器；消除振荡装置

e.en: The circuit includes a {deoscillator} to reduce unwanted oscillation.
e.zh: 该电路包含一个去振荡器，用来减少不必要的振荡。

e.en: A faulty {deoscillator} made the signal unstable again.
e.zh: 去振荡器故障使信号再次变得不稳定。

e.en: The scan showed gradual {deossification} near the joint.
e.zh: 扫描显示关节附近出现逐渐的骨质消失。

e.en: Researchers studied {deossification} in developing fish skeletons.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了鱼类骨骼发育中的脱骨化现象。

e.en: The chemist added a {deoxidant} to protect the metal.
e.zh: 化学师加入脱氧剂来保护金属。

e.en: Packaging may contain a {deoxidant} to slow spoilage.
e.zh: 包装中可能含有脱氧剂，以减缓变质。

e.en: The process can {deoxidate} molten steel before casting.
e.zh: 该工艺能在浇铸前对钢水脱氧。

e.en: Certain chemicals {deoxidate} compounds by removing oxygen.
e.zh: 某些化学物质通过去除氧来使化合物还原。

e.en: Aluminum is often used for {deoxidation} in steelmaking.
e.zh: 炼钢中常用铝进行脱氧。

e.en: The lab observed {deoxidation} when oxygen was removed.
e.zh: 实验室在氧被除去时观察到还原作用。

e.en: British texts may use {deoxidise} instead of deoxidize.
e.zh: 英国文本可能使用 deoxidise，而不是 deoxidize。

e.en: The additive helps {deoxidise} the molten metal.
e.zh: 这种添加剂有助于给熔融金属脱氧。

e.en: The furnace step promotes {deoxidization} of the molten metal.
e.zh: 这个炉内步骤会促进熔融金属的脱氧。

e.en: Careful {deoxidization} can improve the purity of the alloy.
e.zh: 细致的脱氧处理可以提高合金纯度。

e.en: The additive helps {deoxidize} the steel before casting.
e.zh: 这种添加剂有助于在浇铸前给钢水脱氧。

e.en: Chemists can {deoxidize} the sample under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 化学家可以在受控条件下还原除去样品中的氧。

e.en: The {deoxidized} copper was ready for further processing.
e.zh: 脱氧后的铜可以继续加工了。

e.en: They stored the {deoxidized} solution in sealed bottles.
e.zh: 他们把已除氧的溶液装进密封瓶中保存。

e.en: Aluminum is often used as a {deoxidizer} in steelmaking.
e.zh: 炼钢时常用铝作为脱氧剂。

e.en: The technician added a {deoxidizer} to protect the mixture.
e.zh: 技术员加入脱氧剂来保护这份混合物。

e.en: The reagent {deoxidizes} the surface during heating.
e.zh: 加热时这种试剂会使表面脱氧。

e.en: This treatment {deoxidizes} the water before analysis.
e.zh: 这种处理会在分析前除去水中的氧。

deoxy.t: 脱氧的；少一个氧原子的

e.en: The lab compared several {deoxy} forms of the compound.
e.zh: 实验室比较了这种化合物的几种脱氧形式。

e.en: A {deoxy} sugar lacks one oxygen atom found in the usual sugar.
e.zh: 脱氧糖少了普通糖中原本存在的一个氧原子。

e.en: Researchers isolated {deoxyandrographolide} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物提取物中分离出脱氧穿心莲内酯。

e.en: The paper measured {deoxyandrographolide} levels in several samples.
e.zh: 这篇论文测定了多个样品中的脱氧穿心莲内酯含量。

e.en: The adrenal gland can produce {deoxycorticosterone} in small amounts.
e.zh: 肾上腺可以少量产生脱氧皮质酮。

e.en: Doctors monitored {deoxycorticosterone} during the hormone study.
e.zh: 医生在激素研究中监测了脱氧皮质酮。

e.en: They used nitrogen gas to {deoxygenate} the solution.
e.zh: 他们用氮气除去溶液中的氧。

e.en: Pollution can {deoxygenate} a river and harm fish.
e.zh: 污染会使河水缺氧并伤害鱼类。

e.en: The diver breathed from a tank of carefully {deoxygenated} gas.
e.zh: 潜水员呼吸的是一罐经过仔细脱氧处理的气体。

e.en: Fish cannot survive long in {deoxygenated} water.
e.zh: 鱼在缺氧水体中无法长时间存活。

e.en: Rapid {deoxygenation} killed many organisms in the lake.
e.zh: 迅速缺氧化导致湖中许多生物死亡。

e.en: The experiment required complete {deoxygenation} of the solvent.
e.zh: 这个实验需要把溶剂彻底除氧。

e.en: The device can {deoxygenize} water before it enters the boiler.
e.zh: 这台设备能在水进入锅炉前除去其中的氧。

e.en: Engineers tried to {deoxygenize} the sealed chamber.
e.zh: 工程师试图给密封舱除氧。

e.en: DNA is built from four main {deoxynucleotides}.
e.zh: DNA由四种主要脱氧核苷酸构成。

e.en: The kit contains {deoxynucleotides} for the sequencing reaction.
e.zh: 这个试剂盒含有测序反应所需的脱氧核苷酸。

e.en: The term {deoxyriboneucleic} appears to be a misspelled scientific adjective.
e.zh: deoxyriboneucleic这个词似乎是一个拼错的科学形容词。

e.en: She meant {deoxyriboneucleic} acid when discussing DNA.
e.zh: 她讨论DNA时指的是脱氧核糖核酸。

e.en: The sample was treated with {deoxyribonuclease} to remove DNA.
e.zh: 样品用脱氧核糖核酸酶处理，以去除DNA。

e.en: Some bacteria release {deoxyribonuclease} into their surroundings.
e.zh: 一些细菌会向周围环境释放脱氧核糖核酸酶。

e.en: The virus contains a {deoxyribonucleoprotein} complex inside its shell.
e.zh: 这种病毒的外壳内含有脱氧核糖核蛋白复合物。

e.en: Scientists purified the {deoxyribonucleoprotein} for structural analysis.
e.zh: 科学家纯化了这种脱氧核糖核蛋白以进行结构分析。

e.en: Each {deoxyribonucleoside} contains a base and deoxyribose.
e.zh: 每个脱氧核糖核苷都含有一个碱基和脱氧核糖。

e.en: The drug resembles a natural {deoxyribonucleoside}.
e.zh: 这种药物类似一种天然脱氧核糖核苷。

e.en: A {deoxyribonucleotide} is one building block of DNA.
e.zh: 脱氧核糖核苷酸是DNA的组成单位之一。

e.en: The enzyme adds one {deoxyribonucleotide} to the growing strand.
e.zh: 这种酶会向延长中的链上添加一个脱氧核糖核苷酸。

e.en: DNA polymerase links {deoxyribonucleotides} into a new strand.
e.zh: DNA聚合酶把脱氧核糖核苷酸连接成新链。

e.en: The solution lacked enough {deoxyribonucleotides} for amplification.
e.zh: 这份溶液缺少扩增所需的足量脱氧核糖核苷酸。

e.en: DNA contains {deoxyribose} instead of ribose.
e.zh: DNA含有脱氧核糖，而不是核糖。

e.en: The structure of {deoxyribose} helps distinguish DNA from RNA.
e.zh: 脱氧核糖的结构有助于区分DNA和RNA。

e.en: The textbook compares riboses and {deoxyriboses} in nucleic acids.
e.zh: 教材比较了核酸中的核糖和脱氧核糖类。

e.en: Different {deoxyriboses} can appear in modified biological molecules.
e.zh: 不同的脱氧核糖类可能出现在修饰后的生物分子中。

e.en: A {deoxysugar} has one oxygen atom missing from the usual sugar structure.
e.zh: 脱氧糖比普通糖结构少一个氧原子。

e.en: This antibiotic includes a rare {deoxysugar} side chain.
e.zh: 这种抗生素含有一条罕见的脱氧糖侧链。

e.en: Workers had to {depaint} the old bridge before repairs.
e.zh: 工人必须在维修前去除旧桥上的油漆。

e.en: The solvent can {depaint} metal without damaging the surface.
e.zh: 这种溶剂能给金属除漆而不损伤表面。

e.en: The {depainted} panel showed signs of earlier damage.
e.zh: 除漆后的面板露出了早先受损的痕迹。

e.en: They inspected the {depainted} aircraft parts for cracks.
e.zh: 他们检查了除漆后的飞机零件是否有裂纹。

e.en: The {depainter} softened the old coating within minutes.
e.zh: 这种除漆剂几分钟内就软化了旧涂层。

e.en: A skilled {depainter} prepared the car body for restoration.
e.zh: 一名熟练的除漆工为车身修复做了准备。

depainting.t: 去除画作颜料层；反绘画化

e.en: The conservator avoided aggressive {depainting} during restoration.
e.zh: 修复时，文物修复师避免过度去除画作颜料层。

e.en: The essay describes modern {depainting} as a rejection of illusion.
e.zh: 这篇文章把现代的反绘画化描述为对幻象的拒绝。

e.en: The dialect shows {depalatalization} before back vowels.
e.zh: 这种方言在后元音前表现出去腭化。

e.en: Historical {depalatalization} changed the sound of many words.
e.zh: 历史上的腭音消失改变了许多词的读音。

e.en: The warehouse installed a new {depalletizer} for cartons.
e.zh: 仓库安装了一台新的纸箱卸托盘机。

e.en: A jam stopped the {depalletizer} during the night shift.
e.zh: 夜班时一次卡料让拆垛设备停了下来。

depancreatize.t: 切除胰腺；使失去胰腺功能

e.en: Researchers may {depancreatize} animals to study diabetes.
e.zh: 研究人员可能切除动物胰腺来研究糖尿病。

e.en: The operation can {depancreatize} the patient completely.
e.zh: 这项手术可能使患者完全失去胰腺功能。

e.en: The bakery bought an automatic {depanner} for loaves.
e.zh: 面包房买了一台用于面包的自动脱模机。

e.en: A skilled {depanner} keeps the cakes from breaking.
e.zh: 熟练的脱盘工能防止蛋糕破损。

e.en: Let the cake cool before {depanning} it.
e.zh: 蛋糕脱模前要先放凉。

e.en: Careful {depanning} prevents dents in the soft bread.
e.zh: 小心从烤盘取出可以避免软面包被压出凹痕。

e.en: Each {departee} received a brief farewell note.
e.zh: 每位离开者都收到了一张简短的告别便条。

e.en: The company interviewed every {departee} about workplace culture.
e.zh: 公司就职场文化访谈了每一位离任者。

e.en: The firm will {departmentalise} its growing design staff.
e.zh: 公司将把不断扩大的设计团队按部门划分。

e.en: Managers should not {departmentalise} problems too narrowly.
e.zh: 管理者不应把问题过分部门化。

departmentalised.t: 已部门化的；按部门划分的

e.en: The {departmentalised} structure slowed every decision.
e.zh: 这种已部门化的结构拖慢了每个决策。

e.en: Staff worked inside highly {departmentalised} teams.
e.zh: 员工在高度按部门划分的团队中工作。

departmentalism.t: 部门本位主义；部门主义

e.en: Excessive {departmentalism} weakened the reform effort.
e.zh: 过度的部门本位主义削弱了改革力度。

e.en: The dean tried to reduce {departmentalism} among faculty groups.
e.zh: 院长试图减少各教师群体之间的部门主义。

departmentalist.t: 部门主义者；主张分部门者

e.en: He sounded like a {departmentalist} during the budget debate.
e.zh: 预算辩论中他听起来像个部门主义者。

e.en: A strict {departmentalist} would split the school into smaller units.
e.zh: 严格主张分部门者会把学校拆成更小的单位。

e.en: Rapid {departmentalization} created clearer reporting lines.
e.zh: 快速部门化建立了更清晰的汇报关系。

e.en: The report criticized the {departmentalization} of patient care.
e.zh: 报告批评了病患照护按部门组织的问题。

e.en: They plan to {departmentalize} customer support next year.
e.zh: 他们计划明年把客户支持部门化。

e.en: Do not {departmentalize} knowledge that everyone needs.
e.zh: 不要把人人都需要的知识按部门隔离。

departmentalized.t: 部门化的；按部门组织的

e.en: The {departmentalized} system made collaboration harder.
e.zh: 这个部门化的系统让协作变得更难。

e.en: Students entered a more {departmentalized} curriculum in high school.
e.zh: 学生进入高中后接触到更按学科部门组织的课程。

e.en: The contract allowed {depasturage} on common land.
e.zh: 合同允许在公地上放牧。

e.en: Disputes over {depasturage} divided the village.
e.zh: 关于牧场使用权的争议使村庄产生分歧。

e.en: Farmers {depasture} sheep on the hillside each spring.
e.zh: 农民每年春天在山坡上放牧羊群。

e.en: Cattle may {depasture} there only after the rains.
e.zh: 牛群只能在雨季之后在那里吃草。

e.en: The island has a {depauperate} bird fauna.
e.zh: 这座岛的鸟类区系很贫乏。

e.en: Poor soil can {depauperate} the whole plant community.
e.zh: 贫瘠土壤会使整个植物群落衰弱。

e.en: The {depauperated} forest supported few insects.
e.zh: 这片变得贫乏的森林只养活了很少昆虫。

e.en: Years of drought left the grassland {depauperated}.
e.zh: 多年干旱使草原变得贫瘠衰弱。

e.en: Overgrazing is {depauperating} the native plant cover.
e.zh: 过度放牧正在使本地植被变得贫乏。

e.en: The {depauperating} effect of pollution was obvious.
e.zh: 污染造成的削弱和贫化作用很明显。

e.en: The survey recorded severe {depauperation} of reef species.
e.zh: 调查记录到珊瑚礁物种严重贫乏化。

e.en: Economic {depauperation} followed years of failed harvests.
e.zh: 多年歉收之后出现了经济上的贫困化。

e.en: Repeated fires can {depauperize} a forest ecosystem.
e.zh: 反复火灾会使森林生态系统变得贫乏。

e.en: Bad policy may {depauperize} rural families.
e.zh: 糟糕政策可能使农村家庭陷入贫困。

e.en: His {dependance} on loans worried the committee.
e.zh: 他对贷款的依赖让委员会担忧。

e.en: The old stable was treated as a {dependance} of the house.
e.zh: 那座旧马厩被视为主屋的附属建筑。

e.en: The typo {dependancy} still appears in old documents.
e.zh: dependancy 这个拼写错误仍出现在旧文件中。

e.en: The island was once listed as a {dependancy}.
e.zh: 这座岛曾被列为附属地。

depeople.t: 使人口减少；使无人居住

e.en: War can {depeople} an entire valley.
e.zh: 战争可能使整条山谷人口锐减。

e.en: The plague seemed to {depeople} the old town.
e.zh: 那场瘟疫似乎让这座老城变得无人居住。

depepsinized.t: 去胃蛋白酶处理的；失去胃蛋白酶的

e.en: The sample was {depepsinized} before further testing.
e.zh: 样本在进一步检测前经过了去胃蛋白酶处理。

e.en: Researchers compared normal tissue with {depepsinized} tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员将正常组织与去胃蛋白酶处理过的组织进行比较。

e.en: The manuscript describes the {deperdition} of an ancient city.
e.zh: 这份手稿描述了一座古城的彻底毁灭。

e.en: He feared the {deperdition} of every moral restraint.
e.zh: 他担心一切道德约束都会完全丧失。

depergelation.t: 脱冻结作用；解除胶冻状态

e.en: The chemist observed {depergelation} as the mixture warmed.
e.zh: 混合物升温时，化学家观察到解除胶冻状态的过程。

e.en: Controlled {depergelation} helped restore the material's flow.
e.zh: 受控的脱冻结作用帮助材料恢复了流动性。

deperm.t: 给船体消磁；去除永久磁性

e.en: Engineers had to {deperm} the vessel before deployment.
e.zh: 工程师必须在部署前给这艘船体消磁。

e.en: The old hull was {depermed} to reduce its magnetic signature.
e.zh: 旧船体经过消磁处理，以降低磁性特征。

e.en: Severe anxiety can trigger episodes of {depersonalisation}.
e.zh: 严重焦虑可能引发人格解体发作。

e.en: The policy led to the {depersonalisation} of customer service.
e.zh: 这项政策导致客户服务变得去个人化。

depersonalise.t: 使去个人化；使人格解体

e.en: Large systems can {depersonalise} the people they serve.
e.zh: 大型系统可能会使其服务对象变得去个人化。

e.en: The trauma seemed to {depersonalise} his memories of the event.
e.zh: 那次创伤似乎让他对事件的记忆产生人格解体感。

e.en: Workers used water to {depeter} the old masonry.
e.zh: 工人用水去除旧砖石中的硝石。

e.en: The process can {depeter} soil contaminated with nitrates.
e.zh: 这个过程可以除去受硝酸盐污染土壤中的硝酸盐。

e.en: The signal became {dephased} after passing through the medium.
e.zh: 信号穿过介质后变得失相。

e.en: Several {dephased} waves canceled each other out.
e.zh: 几列相位被扰乱的波相互抵消了。

e.en: Quantum {dephasing} reduced the accuracy of the calculation.
e.zh: 量子失相降低了计算的准确性。

e.en: The technician measured {dephasing} in the radio signal.
e.zh: 技术员测量了无线电信号中的相位散逸。

e.en: The operator must {dephlegmate} the vapor before collection.
e.zh: 操作员必须在收集前对蒸汽进行除水浓缩。

e.en: Old distillers tried to {dephlegmate} spirits for greater strength.
e.zh: 早期蒸馏者会精馏浓缩烈酒以提高酒精度。

dephlegmated.t: 已除水的；经精馏浓缩的

e.en: The {dephlegmated} alcohol had a much higher proof.
e.zh: 经精馏浓缩的酒精度数高得多。

e.en: Only the {dephlegmated} fraction was kept for analysis.
e.zh: 只有除水后的馏分被保留下来用于分析。

dephlegmating.t: 正在除水的；精馏浓缩的

e.en: The {dephlegmating} column improved separation in the still.
e.zh: 精馏浓缩柱提高了蒸馏器中的分离效果。

e.en: They monitored the {dephlegmating} liquid throughout the run.
e.zh: 他们在整个运行过程中监测正在除水浓缩的液体。

e.en: {Dephlegmation} removes excess water from the vapor stream.
e.zh: 除水作用会从蒸汽流中去除多余水分。

e.en: Better {dephlegmation} produced a cleaner distillate.
e.zh: 更好的精馏浓缩产生了更纯净的馏出物。

e.en: The distillery installed a new {dephlegmator} above the column.
e.zh: 酒厂在蒸馏柱上方安装了新的精馏冷凝器。

e.en: A damaged {dephlegmator} made the condensate too weak.
e.zh: 损坏的除水器使冷凝液浓度过低。

e.en: Priestley called oxygen {dephlogisticated} air.
e.zh: 普里斯特利把氧气称为去燃素空气。

e.en: The old text described the gas as {dephlogisticated}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种气体描述为去燃素的。

e.en: The experiment was said to be {dephlogisticating} the substance.
e.zh: 据说这个实验正在使该物质脱燃素。

e.en: Chemists later abandoned the idea of {dephlogisticating} air.
e.zh: 化学家后来放弃了使空气去燃素这一观念。

e.en: Steelmakers use {dephosphorization} to improve metal quality.
e.zh: 炼钢工人通过脱磷来提高金属质量。

e.en: The plant added a {dephosphorization} stage to wastewater treatment.
e.zh: 工厂在废水处理中增加了除磷处理阶段。

e.en: The process can {dephosphorize} molten iron efficiently.
e.zh: 该工艺能高效地使铁水脱磷。

e.en: Engineers tried to {dephosphorize} the wastewater before discharge.
e.zh: 工程师试图在排放前除去废水中的磷。

e.en: The protein was {dephosphorylated} after enzyme treatment.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在酶处理后被去磷酸化。

e.en: Cells with {dephosphorylated} receptors responded differently.
e.zh: 带有去磷酸化受体的细胞反应不同。

e.en: The enzyme {dephosphorylates} the target protein quickly.
e.zh: 这种酶会迅速使目标蛋白去磷酸化。

e.en: This pathway {dephosphorylates} several signaling molecules.
e.zh: 这条通路会使几种信号分子去磷酸化。

e.en: {Dephosphorylation} changed the protein's activity.
e.zh: 去磷酸化改变了这种蛋白的活性。

e.en: The drug blocks {dephosphorylation} in immune cells.
e.zh: 这种药物会阻断免疫细胞中的去磷酸化过程。

e.en: The editor spent hours {depicking} frames from the sequence.
e.zh: 编辑花了几个小时从序列中取消选取若干帧。

e.en: Manual {depicking} removed items chosen by mistake.
e.zh: 手动取消选取移除了误选的项目。

depictive.t: 描绘性的；具描述作用的

e.en: The poem uses {depictive} language throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇使用描绘性的语言。

e.en: In grammar, a {depictive} phrase describes a participant's state.
e.zh: 在语法中，描写性短语描述参与者的状态。

e.en: The novelist became a skilled {depictor} of rural life.
e.zh: 这位小说家成了描绘乡村生活的高手。

e.en: The diagram served as a simple {depictor} of the process.
e.zh: 这张图表充当了该过程的简单描述工具。

e.en: The artist tried to {depicture} the storm's violence.
e.zh: 艺术家试图描绘风暴的猛烈。

e.en: Old maps often {depicture} sea monsters near unknown coasts.
e.zh: 古地图常在未知海岸附近画上海怪。

e.en: The king is {depictured} as merciful in the mural.
e.zh: 壁画中这位国王被描绘成仁慈的人。

e.en: Her grief was {depictured} with unusual restraint.
e.zh: 她的悲痛被刻画得异常克制。

e.en: The novel is {depicturing} life after the war.
e.zh: 这部小说正在描绘战后的生活。

e.en: The chart is {depicturing} a sharp rise in prices.
e.zh: 这张图表显示价格大幅上涨。

e.en: The treatment may {depigment} small areas of skin.
e.zh: 这种治疗可能会使小块皮肤脱色。

e.en: Strong chemicals can {depigment} the fabric over time.
e.zh: 强性化学品久了会让布料褪去颜色。

e.en: The patient noticed {depigmentation} around the scar.
e.zh: 患者注意到疤痕周围出现色素脱失。

e.en: Sun damage can cause uneven {depigmentation}.
e.zh: 日晒损伤可能导致不均匀的脱色。

e.en: Some athletes {depilate} their legs before races.
e.zh: 有些运动员赛前会给腿部脱毛。

e.en: The cream can {depilate} without using a razor.
e.zh: 这种乳膏不用剃刀也能去除体毛。

e.en: Her {depilated} skin felt smooth after the treatment.
e.zh: 护理后，她脱过毛的皮肤摸起来很光滑。

e.en: The specimen had a {depilated} patch on its back.
e.zh: 这个样本背部有一块已脱毛的区域。

e.en: This cream {depilates} the upper lip in minutes.
e.zh: 这种乳膏几分钟内就能去除上唇毛发。

e.en: She {depilates} before every swimming competition.
e.zh: 她每次游泳比赛前都会脱毛。

e.en: Laser {depilation} can be expensive but lasting.
e.zh: 激光脱毛可能很贵，但效果较持久。

e.en: The salon offers waxing and other forms of {depilation}.
e.zh: 这家美容院提供蜜蜡脱毛等除毛服务。

e.en: She bought a small {depilator} for travel.
e.zh: 她买了一个小型脱毛器方便旅行时使用。

e.en: The old {depilator} irritated his skin.
e.zh: 那种旧脱毛剂刺激了他的皮肤。

e.en: She applied a {depilatory} cream to her legs.
e.zh: 她在腿上涂了脱毛膏。

e.en: The product has a strong {depilatory} smell.
e.zh: 这款产品有很重的脱毛剂气味。

e.en: The electric {depiler} removed hair quickly.
e.zh: 电动脱毛器很快就把毛发去除了。

e.en: A skilled {depiler} can reduce pain during waxing.
e.zh: 熟练的脱毛师能减轻蜜蜡脱毛时的疼痛。

e.en: The pharmacist recommended a mild {depilitant}.
e.zh: 药剂师推荐了一种温和的脱毛剂。

e.en: This {depilitant} lotion should not touch broken skin.
e.zh: 这种脱毛乳液不应接触破损皮肤。

e.en: The lab tested a new {depinker} for stained fibers.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一种用于染色纤维的新型去粉红色剂。

e.en: A {depinker} was added to correct the paper's tint.
e.zh: 他们加入去色剂来校正纸张的色调。

e.en: The tool can {deplanate} the soft metal surface.
e.zh: 这种工具能把柔软的金属表面压平。

e.en: Erosion may {deplanate} a rocky landscape over ages.
e.zh: 侵蚀作用可能经过漫长年代把岩石地貌削平。

e.en: Passengers may {deplane} through the rear door.
e.zh: 乘客可以从后门下飞机。

e.en: The crew had to {deplane} everyone during the delay.
e.zh: 延误期间，机组人员不得不让所有人下机。

e.en: We {deplaned} after waiting on the runway.
e.zh: 我们在跑道上等了一阵后下了飞机。

e.en: The unruly passenger was {deplaned} before takeoff.
e.zh: 那名不守规矩的乘客在起飞前被请下机。

e.en: The team {deplanes} at dawn and goes straight to practice.
e.zh: 球队黎明下飞机后直接去训练。

e.en: The airline {deplanes} passengers when repairs take too long.
e.zh: 维修时间过长时，航空公司会让乘客下机。

e.en: {Deplaning} began as soon as the jet bridge arrived.
e.zh: 登机桥一到，下飞机就开始了。

e.en: The captain ordered {deplaning} after the mechanical warning.
e.zh: 机械警报出现后，机长下令让乘客下机。

e.en: The workshop will {deplate} the silver before recycling it.
e.zh: 车间会先去除银镀层再进行回收。

e.en: Technicians must {deplate} the panel to inspect the frame.
e.zh: 技术人员必须拆下面板来检查框架。

e.en: {Deplating} exposes the base metal underneath.
e.zh: 除去镀层会露出下面的基底金属。

e.en: The repair crew started {deplating} the damaged wall.
e.zh: 维修人员开始拆除受损墙面的板材。

e.en: Poor planning can {deplenish} supplies before winter.
e.zh: 计划不周可能会在冬天前耗尽物资。

e.en: The fever seemed to {deplenish} his strength overnight.
e.zh: 这场发烧似乎一夜之间耗去了他的力气。

deplethoric.t: 减轻充血的；消减过盛的

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {deplethoric} treatment.
e.zh: 医生开了一种减轻充血的治疗方案。

e.en: Austerity was meant to have a {deplethoric} effect on spending.
e.zh: 紧缩政策本意是对开支产生削减过盛的作用。

e.en: The drought had a {depletive} effect on the reservoir.
e.zh: 干旱对水库造成了消耗性的影响。

e.en: Doctors avoided {depletive} treatments for the frail patient.
e.zh: 医生避免给这位虚弱患者使用耗减性的疗法。

e.en: The illness had a {depletory} effect on her energy.
e.zh: 这场病对她的精力造成了耗竭性的影响。

e.en: Old physicians used {depletory} methods like bloodletting.
e.zh: 旧时医生会使用放血等消耗性疗法。

e.en: The researcher described a {deploid} cell line in the report.
e.zh: 研究人员在报告中描述了一种去倍数体细胞系。

e.en: A {deploid} condition can affect how chromosomes are counted.
e.zh: 去倍数体状态会影响染色体的计数方式。

e.en: The policy promised {deploitation} of the exhausted mining region.
e.zh: 这项政策承诺停止开发这个资源枯竭的矿区。

e.en: Activists used {deploitation} to describe ending abusive labor practices.
e.zh: 活动人士用去剥削化来形容终止虐待性的劳动做法。

e.en: The judge emphasized the {deplorability} of the attack.
e.zh: 法官强调了这次袭击应受谴责的性质。

e.en: Her essay examines the {deplorability} of needless poverty.
e.zh: 她的文章探讨了不必要贫困的可悲性。

e.en: The speech ended with a {deploration} of needless violence.
e.zh: 演讲最后强烈谴责了不必要的暴力。

e.en: His private letters reveal a deep {deploration} of the loss.
e.zh: 他的私人信件流露出对这场损失的深切哀叹。

e.en: She looked {deploringly} at the broken memorial.
e.zh: 她哀叹地看着那座被毁的纪念碑。

e.en: The editor wrote {deploringly} about the corruption scandal.
e.zh: 编辑以谴责的口吻写到了这起腐败丑闻。

e.en: The old specimen was almost {deplumate} after years in storage.
e.zh: 那件旧标本存放多年后几乎已经脱尽羽毛。

e.en: A {deplumate} bird needs warmth while its feathers regrow.
e.zh: 脱羽的鸟在羽毛重新长出时需要保暖。

e.en: The handler had to {deplume} the injured bird carefully.
e.zh: 饲养员不得不小心地给受伤的鸟拔去羽毛。

e.en: The scandal seemed to {deplume} the once glamorous leader.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻似乎剥去了那位昔日风光领导人的光环。

deplumed.t: 被拔去羽毛的；失去光彩的

e.en: The {deplumed} hat looked sad in the rain.
e.zh: 那顶被拔掉羽饰的帽子在雨中显得很寒酸。

e.en: After the defeat, the champion appeared strangely {deplumed}.
e.zh: 失败之后，那位冠军显得出奇地失去了光彩。

e.en: The process {deplumes} the bird before cleaning.
e.zh: 这个流程会在清洗前先给鸟拔去羽毛。

e.en: Public ridicule {deplumes} even the most confident performer.
e.zh: 公众嘲笑会让再自信的表演者也失去光彩。

e.en: The keeper avoided {depluming} the bird unnecessarily.
e.zh: 饲养员避免不必要地拔掉那只鸟的羽毛。

e.en: The satire was aimed at {depluming} pompous officials.
e.zh: 这篇讽刺作品意在剥去自大官员的光彩。

e.en: The basin's {depocenter} shifted toward the fault line.
e.zh: 该盆地的沉积中心向断层线方向移动。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {depocenter} using seismic data.
e.zh: 地质学家利用地震数据绘制了沉积中心的位置。

e.en: The paper discusses {depoeciation} in isolated insect populations.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了孤立昆虫种群中的生境隔离形成新种现象。

e.en: Some biologists treat {depoeciation} as a special kind of speciation.
e.zh: 一些生物学家把生境隔离成种视为一种特殊的物种形成。

e.en: Nerve signals depend on rapid {depolarisation} of the cell membrane.
e.zh: 神经信号依赖细胞膜的快速去极化。

e.en: The talks encouraged political {depolarisation} after years of conflict.
e.zh: 多年冲突后，这些谈判推动了政治上的去两极化。

e.en: The stimulus can {depolarise} the neuron within milliseconds.
e.zh: 这种刺激能在毫秒内使神经元去极化。

e.en: Leaders tried to {depolarise} the debate before the vote.
e.zh: 投票前，领导人试图缓和这场辩论中的对立。

depolarised.t: 已去极化的；去两极化的

e.en: The membrane became {depolarised} during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验过程中，细胞膜变成了去极化状态。

e.en: A more {depolarised} parliament made compromise easier.
e.zh: 一个较少两极化的议会让妥协变得更容易。

e.en: The battery used a chemical {depolariser} to improve performance.
e.zh: 这种电池使用化学去极化剂来提升性能。

e.en: The optical setup included a {depolariser} before the detector.
e.zh: 这套光学装置在探测器前安装了去偏振器。

e.en: A strong pulse {depolarises} the cardiac tissue.
e.zh: 强脉冲会使心脏组织去极化。

e.en: Shared local work often {depolarises} political discussion.
e.zh: 共同参与地方事务常常能缓和政治讨论中的对立。

e.en: The graph shows {depolarization} across the nerve membrane.
e.zh: 这张图显示了神经膜上的去极化过程。

e.en: The mayor called for {depolarization} in public debate.
e.zh: 市长呼吁公共辩论去两极化。

e.en: Certain ions can {depolarize} the cell membrane quickly.
e.zh: 某些离子能迅速使细胞膜去极化。

e.en: The forum was designed to {depolarize} local politics.
e.zh: 这个论坛旨在缓和地方政治中的对立。

depolarized.t: 已去极化的；去两极化的

e.en: The {depolarized} neuron fired another signal.
e.zh: 去极化后的神经元又发出了一次信号。

e.en: The campaign left voters slightly more {depolarized}.
e.zh: 这场活动让选民之间的对立略有缓和。

e.en: Engineers added a {depolarizer} to stabilize the cell.
e.zh: 工程师加入去极化剂来稳定这个电池单元。

e.en: A fiber {depolarizer} reduced the effect of polarized light.
e.zh: 光纤去偏振器减弱了偏振光的影响。

e.en: The incoming current {depolarizes} the membrane.
e.zh: 进入的电流会使细胞膜去极化。

e.en: Honest dialogue sometimes {depolarizes} a divided community.
e.zh: 坦诚对话有时能缓和分裂社区的对立。

e.en: Excessive heat caused {depoling} in the ceramic sensor.
e.zh: 过高的热量导致陶瓷传感器发生退极化。

e.en: The technician measured {depoling} after the stress test.
e.zh: 技术员在压力测试后测量了退极化情况。

e.en: The charity tried to {depoliticise} the debate about food aid.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构试图让关于食品援助的争论去政治化。

e.en: Officials promised to {depoliticise} the hiring process.
e.zh: 官员承诺使招聘过程不受政治因素影响。

e.en: The city plans to {depollute} the old canal.
e.zh: 这座城市计划清除旧运河的污染。

e.en: New filters can {depollute} water before it reaches homes.
e.zh: 新过滤器能在水进入住户前将其净化。

e.en: River {depollution} will take several years.
e.zh: 河流污染清除需要好几年。

e.en: The factory invested in {depollution} equipment.
e.zh: 这家工厂投资了净化处理设备。

e.en: The catalyst improved {depolyalkylation} in the test reactor.
e.zh: 这种催化剂提高了试验反应器中的脱聚烷基化效果。

e.en: Researchers measured {depolyalkylation} under high pressure.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了高压条件下的脱聚烷基化反应。

e.en: The bacterium produces a {depolymerase} that breaks down plastic.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生一种能分解塑料的解聚酶。

e.en: Scientists purified the {depolymerase} for further study.
e.zh: 科学家纯化了这种解聚酶以便进一步研究。

e.en: Heat can trigger {depolymerization} in some plastics.
e.zh: 加热会引发某些塑料的解聚。

e.en: Chemical {depolymerization} turns waste polymer into useful monomers.
e.zh: 化学解聚能把废弃聚合物转化为有用的单体。

e.en: The enzyme can {depolymerize} the long sugar chains.
e.zh: 这种酶能使长糖链解聚。

e.en: Engineers hope to {depolymerize} waste plastic efficiently.
e.zh: 工程师希望高效降解废塑料中的聚合物。

e.en: The witness agreed to {depone} before the magistrate.
e.zh: 证人同意在地方法官面前宣誓作证。

e.en: She was asked to {depone} the facts in writing.
e.zh: 她被要求以书面形式证明这些事实。

e.en: He {deponed} that he had seen the contract signed.
e.zh: 他宣誓作证说自己看见合同被签署。

e.en: The facts {deponed} in the affidavit were later challenged.
e.zh: 宣誓书中陈述的事实后来受到质疑。

e.en: The {deponent} signed the affidavit in court.
e.zh: 宣誓作证者在法庭上签署了宣誓书。

e.en: A lawyer questioned the {deponent} about the missing records.
e.zh: 律师就丢失的记录询问了这名宣誓作证者。

e.en: The clerk {depones} that the file was delivered on Monday.
e.zh: 书记员宣誓作证说文件是在星期一送达的。

e.en: She {depones} to facts known from personal observation.
e.zh: 她就自己亲眼所见的事实作书面陈述。

e.en: He was {deponing} before the court all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在法庭前宣誓作证。

e.en: The witness hesitated while {deponing} the final statement.
e.zh: 证人在作最后陈述时犹豫了一下。

e.en: A scandal can quickly {depopularize} a public figure.
e.zh: 一桩丑闻可能很快让公众人物不再受欢迎。

e.en: The campaign tried to {depopularize} smoking among teenagers.
e.zh: 这场运动试图让吸烟在青少年中不再流行。

e.en: War became the chief {depopulator} of the region.
e.zh: 战争成了该地区人口减少的主要原因。

e.en: The disease was described as a silent {depopulator}.
e.zh: 这种疾病被描述为一种无声地导致人口减少的因素。

e.en: The council declared the governor {deposable} under the charter.
e.zh: 委员会宣布根据宪章可以罢免州长。

e.en: Even a powerful monarch was legally {deposable}.
e.zh: 即使是强大的君主在法律上也可以被废黜。

e.en: The king's {deposal} shocked the neighboring courts.
e.zh: 国王被废黜震惊了邻近各国宫廷。

e.en: The committee called for the minister's {deposal}.
e.zh: 委员会要求罢免这名部长。

e.en: The bank is regulated as a {deposit-taker}.
e.zh: 这家银行作为吸收存款机构受到监管。

e.en: Every licensed {deposit-taker} must protect customer funds.
e.zh: 每家持牌吸收存款机构都必须保护客户资金。

e.en: The rocks preserve a clear {depositional} history.
e.zh: 这些岩石保留了清晰的沉积历史。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {depositional} environment of the basin.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了该盆地的沉积环境图。

e.en: The novel traces the hero's moral {depravation}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了主人公道德堕落的过程。

e.en: They warned that unchecked greed led to {depravation}.
e.zh: 他们警告说，不受约束的贪婪会导致败坏。

e.en: The preacher condemned the city's {depravement}.
e.zh: 传教士谴责这座城市的道德败坏。

e.en: His letters reveal a slow {depravement} of judgment.
e.zh: 他的信件显示出判断力逐渐腐化。

e.en: The film was criticized as {depravingly} violent.
e.zh: 这部电影被批评为暴力到使人堕落。

e.en: He spoke {depravingly} of cruelty as entertainment.
e.zh: 他以一种败坏人心的口吻把残忍说成娱乐。

e.en: Her tone carried a hint of self-{deprecation}.
e.zh: 她的语气带着一点自我贬低。

e.en: The library announced the {deprecation} of the old API.
e.zh: 该库宣布弃用旧版API。

e.en: He gave a {deprecative} smile after the compliment.
e.zh: 听到夸奖后，他露出一个自我贬低式的微笑。

e.en: The report used {deprecative} language about the proposal.
e.zh: 报告用带有反对意味的措辞评价了这项提案。

e.en: She spoke {deprecatively} of his early poems.
e.zh: 她谈到他早期的诗时带着贬低的口气。

e.en: The critic smiled {deprecatively} at the proposal.
e.zh: 评论家对这个提议不以为然地笑了笑。

e.en: He became a persistent {deprecator} of modern art.
e.zh: 他成了现代艺术的长期贬低者。

e.en: Every reform has at least one loud {deprecator}.
e.zh: 每项改革至少都会有一个高声反对的人。

e.en: The editor wrote {deprecatorily} about the new policy.
e.zh: 编辑以贬斥的语气评论了这项新政策。

e.en: He waved {deprecatorily} at the expensive decorations.
e.zh: 他不以为然地挥手指了指那些昂贵装饰。

e.en: Her {deprecatory} remarks offended the committee.
e.zh: 她那些贬低性的言论冒犯了委员会。

e.en: He gave a {deprecatory} shrug before answering.
e.zh: 回答前，他不以为然地耸了耸肩。

e.en: The machine is a {depreciable} business asset.
e.zh: 这台机器是企业可折旧的资产。

e.en: Cars are usually {depreciable} from the first year.
e.zh: 汽车通常从第一年起就会贬值。

e.en: He spoke {depreciatingly} of his own success.
e.zh: 他说起自己的成功时显得很自谦。

e.en: The manager looked {depreciatingly} at the old equipment.
e.zh: 经理轻视地看了看那些旧设备。

e.en: His {depreciative} tone made the team angry.
e.zh: 他那种贬低的语气让团队很生气。

e.en: She gave a {depreciative} laugh at the suggestion.
e.zh: 她听到这个建议后轻蔑地笑了一声。

e.en: The article made him sound like a {depreciator} of tradition.
e.zh: 这篇文章让他听起来像是传统的贬低者。

e.en: A cautious {depreciator} valued the machinery below market price.
e.zh: 一名谨慎的估价人把机器估得低于市场价。

e.en: The review included several {depreciatory} comments.
e.zh: 这篇评论包含几处贬低性的意见。

e.en: The rumor had a {depreciatory} effect on the shares.
e.zh: 这个谣言对股票产生了贬值影响。

e.en: The manual mentioned the {deprecition} of an old command.
e.zh: 手册提到了一个旧命令的弃用。

e.en: His formal {deprecition} of violence surprised no one.
e.zh: 他正式表示反对暴力，并不让人意外。

e.en: Invaders began to {depredate} the coastal villages.
e.zh: 入侵者开始掠夺沿海村庄。

e.en: Unchecked pests can {depredate} a young orchard.
e.zh: 无人控制的害虫会毁坏一片幼果园。

e.en: The {depredated} town struggled to rebuild.
e.zh: 这座遭到掠夺的城镇艰难地重建。

e.en: Farmers counted the crops {depredated} by insects.
e.zh: 农民清点了被昆虫毁坏的庄稼。

e.en: The army was accused of {depredating} nearby farms.
e.zh: 这支军队被指控掠夺附近农场。

e.en: Rangers tracked animals {depredating} the nesting birds.
e.zh: 护林员追踪那些捕食筑巢鸟类的动物。

e.en: The pirate was feared as a ruthless {depredator}.
e.zh: 这个海盗作为残酷的掠夺者令人畏惧。

e.en: The wolf is a natural {depredator} of weak deer.
e.zh: 狼是弱小鹿只的天然捕食者。

e.en: The report described the raids as {depredatory}.
e.zh: 报告把这些袭击描述为掠夺性的。

e.en: Some {depredatory} insects damage stored grain.
e.zh: 一些破坏性昆虫会损害储存的谷物。

e.en: The engineer measured the {depressibility} of the seal.
e.zh: 工程师测量了密封件的可压缩性。

e.en: Good buttons require consistent {depressibility}.
e.zh: 好的按钮需要稳定一致的可按下性。

e.en: The keyboard has soft, {depressible} keys.
e.zh: 这款键盘的按键柔软且可按下。

e.en: The foam is light and easily {depressible}.
e.zh: 这种泡沫很轻，而且容易被压缩。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {depressimeter} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了压力降低测量仪。

e.en: A faulty {depressimeter} gave misleading readings.
e.zh: 一台故障的压力降低测量仪给出了误导性读数。

depressomotor.t: 抑制运动的；降压运动神经

e.en: The drug showed a {depressomotor} effect in the trial.
e.zh: 这种药在试验中表现出抑制运动的效果。

e.en: The paper discussed a {depressomotor} nerve pathway.
e.zh: 论文讨论了一条降压运动神经通路。

e.en: Engineers must {depressurise} the tank before repairs.
e.zh: 工程师维修前必须给储罐减压。

e.en: The cabin began to {depressurise} during the flight.
e.zh: 飞行中客舱开始失压。

e.en: Sudden {depressurization} forced an emergency descent.
e.zh: 突然失压迫使飞机紧急下降。

e.en: The manual explains safe {depressurization} of the chamber.
e.zh: 手册说明了舱室安全减压的方法。

e.en: He was known as a harsh {depreter} of popular taste.
e.zh: 他以严厉贬低大众品味而出名。

e.en: The old pamphlet calls him a {depreter} of learning.
e.zh: 那本旧小册子称他为学问的诋毁者。

e.en: Some legal rights are not easily {deprivable}.
e.zh: 有些法律权利并不容易被剥夺。

e.en: The grant was {deprivable} if conditions were broken.
e.zh: 如果违反条件，这笔补助可以被剥夺。

e.en: The court condemned the {deprival} of basic rights.
e.zh: 法院谴责对基本权利的剥夺。

e.en: Long {deprival} of sleep affected his judgment.
e.zh: 长期睡眠缺失影响了他的判断力。

deprofessionalise.t: 使非专业化；降低专业地位

e.en: The policy may {deprofessionalise} parts of nursing.
e.zh: 这项政策可能会使护理工作的部分领域非专业化。

e.en: Cheap templates can {deprofessionalise} complex design work.
e.zh: 廉价模板可能会降低复杂设计工作的专业地位。

deprofessionalised.t: 去专业化的；降低专业性的

e.en: The service became {deprofessionalised} after volunteers replaced trained staff.
e.zh: 志愿者取代受训员工后，这项服务变得去专业化。

e.en: Critics said the reforms left teaching {deprofessionalised}.
e.zh: 批评者说，这些改革使教学失去了专业性。

deprofessionalising.t: 使去专业化；削弱专业性

e.en: The policy is {deprofessionalising} social work in small towns.
e.zh: 这项政策正在削弱小城镇社会工作的专业性。

e.en: They accused the company of {deprofessionalising} expert roles.
e.zh: 他们指责公司把专家岗位去专业化。

deprofessionalization.t: 去专业化；专业地位下降

e.en: The union warned against the {deprofessionalization} of nursing.
e.zh: 工会警告不要让护理工作走向去专业化。

e.en: Rapid outsourcing caused the {deprofessionalization} of several technical jobs.
e.zh: 快速外包导致几个技术岗位的专业地位下降。

deprofessionalize.t: 使去专业化；降低专业性

e.en: Budget cuts may {deprofessionalize} the public health service.
e.zh: 预算削减可能会降低公共卫生服务的专业性。

e.en: The new rules could {deprofessionalize} legal advice for tenants.
e.zh: 新规定可能让面向租户的法律咨询去专业化。

deprogram.t: 消除思想控制；解除灌输

e.en: The counselor tried to {deprogram} former cult members.
e.zh: 咨询师试图帮助前邪教成员摆脱思想控制。

e.en: Parents hoped therapy would {deprogram} the extremist beliefs.
e.zh: 父母希望治疗能消除那些极端信念的灌输影响。

e.en: The family arranged {deprogramming} after he left the sect.
e.zh: 他离开教派后，家人安排了去洗脑辅导。

e.en: Effective {deprogramming} requires patience and trust.
e.zh: 有效的思想脱控需要耐心和信任。

e.en: Rising wages can {deproletarianize} parts of an industrial workforce.
e.zh: 工资上涨可能使部分产业工人非无产阶级化。

e.en: The regime hoped land ownership would {deproletarianize} urban workers.
e.zh: 该政权希望土地所有权能让城市工人非无产阶级化。

e.en: The refinery must {depropanize} the gas before storage.
e.zh: 炼油厂必须先从气体中除去丙烷再储存。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the column to {depropanize} the feed more efficiently.
e.zh: 工程师调整了塔设备，以更高效地脱除进料中的丙烷。

e.en: Researchers {deproteinate} the sample before testing its sugars.
e.zh: 研究人员在检测糖类前先对样品脱蛋白。

e.en: The lab used acid to {deproteinate} the blood plasma.
e.zh: 实验室用酸去除血浆中的蛋白质。

e.en: The protocol includes {deproteinization} before DNA extraction.
e.zh: 该流程在提取DNA前包括脱蛋白步骤。

e.en: Poor {deproteinization} can leave contaminants in the solution.
e.zh: 脱蛋白不彻底会使溶液中残留污染物。

e.en: Technicians {deproteinize} serum samples with a solvent.
e.zh: 技术人员用溶剂对血清样本脱蛋白。

e.en: The process can {deproteinize} shellfish waste for further use.
e.zh: 该工艺可以去除贝类废料中的蛋白质以便再利用。

e.en: The lichen extract contained a rare {depside}.
e.zh: 这种地衣提取物中含有一种罕见的缩酚酸类化合物。

e.en: Chemists identified the {depside} by its spectral pattern.
e.zh: 化学家通过光谱特征鉴定出这种缩酚酸类化合物。

e.en: The fungus produced a bioactive {depsidone}.
e.zh: 这种真菌产生了一种具有生物活性的缩酚酮类化合物。

e.en: A new {depsidone} was isolated from the lichen.
e.zh: 研究人员从地衣中分离出一种新的缩酚酮类化合物。

e.en: The diver checked the {depthometer} during the descent.
e.zh: 潜水员下潜时查看了深度计。

e.en: A faulty {depthometer} gave the submarine crew wrong readings.
e.zh: 故障的测深仪给潜艇船员提供了错误读数。

e.en: The old chart marked the water in {depthon} units.
e.zh: 这张旧海图用depthon这种深度单位标注水深。

e.en: Few modern sailors recognize the term {depthon}.
e.zh: 如今很少有水手认得depthon这个深度量名。

e.en: The mill scheduled {depulization} before dyeing the cloth.
e.zh: 工厂安排在染布前进行去毛处理。

e.en: Careful {depulization} made the textile surface smoother.
e.zh: 细致的脱绒处理让织物表面更平滑。

e.en: The herbal mixture was sold as a {depurant}.
e.zh: 这种草药混合物被当作净化身体的药剂出售。

e.en: The filter contains a {depurant} layer of activated carbon.
e.zh: 过滤器含有一层用于净化的活性炭材料。

e.en: The oysters are left in clean water to {depurate}.
e.zh: 牡蛎被放在清水中以排出杂质。

e.en: Engineers designed wetlands to {depurate} wastewater naturally.
e.zh: 工程师设计湿地来天然净化废水。

e.en: The plant is {depurating} wastewater before it reaches the river.
e.zh: 这座处理厂正在净化废水，然后才排入河流。

e.en: They used a {depurating} tank for freshly harvested shellfish.
e.zh: 他们用净化池处理刚采收的贝类。

e.en: Shellfish require {depuration} before they are sold raw.
e.zh: 贝类生食出售前需要经过净化处理。

e.en: The report measured the {depuration} of pollutants in the marsh.
e.zh: 报告测量了沼泽对污染物的净化作用。

e.en: The spring was believed to have {depurative} powers.
e.zh: 人们认为这处泉水有净化身体的功效。

e.en: Doctors questioned the advertised {depurative} effect of the tonic.
e.zh: 医生质疑这种补剂广告中宣称的排毒效果。

e.en: The seafood farm installed a new {depurator}.
e.zh: 这家海鲜养殖场安装了一台新的净化装置。

e.en: Water passes through the {depurator} before entering the tanks.
e.zh: 水进入水箱前会先通过净化器。

deputable.t: 可委派的；可任命为代表的

e.en: Only senior clerks were {deputable} for the hearing.
e.zh: 只有资深办事员可被委派参加听证会。

e.en: The role is {deputable} when the manager is absent.
e.zh: 经理缺席时，这一职责可以委派给他人。

deputization.t: 委任为代理；授予副职权

e.en: The sheriff announced the {deputization} of several volunteers.
e.zh: 治安官宣布将几名志愿者委任为临时副手。

e.en: Emergency rules allowed the rapid {deputization} of local officers.
e.zh: 紧急规定允许迅速授予当地官员代理职权。

e.en: The algorithm stores tasks in a {deque}.
e.zh: 该算法把任务存放在双端队列中。

e.en: You can add items to either end of a {deque}.
e.zh: 你可以在双端队列的任意一端添加项目。

deracialize.t: 消除种族化色彩；去种族化处理

e.en: The editor tried to {deracialize} the debate about policing.
e.zh: 编辑试图淡化这场关于警务辩论中的种族色彩。

e.en: Some officials wanted to {deracialize} the policy language.
e.zh: 一些官员想把政策措辞去种族化。

deradicalize.t: 使去激进化；消除极端思想

e.en: The program aims to {deradicalize} former militants.
e.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助前武装分子去除极端思想。

e.en: Teachers helped {deradicalize} the online discussion.
e.zh: 老师们帮助缓和了网上讨论中的激进倾向。

e.en: The lawyer began to {deraign} the old claim before the court.
e.zh: 律师开始在法庭上陈述这项旧主张。

e.en: The chronicler would {deraign} each noble lineage in detail.
e.zh: 编年史作者会详细叙述每个贵族世系。

e.en: His {deraignment} of the title filled several pages.
e.zh: 他对该头衔来龙去脉的陈述写了好几页。

e.en: The judge listened to the formal {deraignment}.
e.zh: 法官听取了正式的抗辩陈词。

derain.t: 除去雨水痕迹；图像去雨

e.en: The software can {derain} a blurry street photo.
e.zh: 这款软件可以去除模糊街景照片中的雨痕。

e.en: Researchers trained a model to {derain} video footage.
e.zh: 研究人员训练了一个模型来给视频画面去雨。

derased.t: 纹章中边缘参差撕裂的

e.en: The shield showed a {derased} animal head.
e.zh: 盾徽上有一个边缘像撕裂般的动物头。

e.en: Heraldic artists distinguish {derased} edges from clean cuts.
e.zh: 纹章画师会区分参差撕裂的边缘和整齐切口。

e.en: Engineers must {derate} the motor in high heat.
e.zh: 在高温下，工程师必须降低电机的额定功率。

e.en: The regulator may {derate} a plant after repeated faults.
e.zh: 监管机构可能因反复故障而下调电厂的评级。

derated.t: 已降低额定值的；降级的

e.en: The {derated} generator still powered the clinic.
e.zh: 降额后的发电机仍能为诊所供电。

e.en: Pilots used a {derated} takeoff setting to save the engines.
e.zh: 飞行员使用减推力起飞设置来保护发动机。

e.en: The controller {derates} the battery when it overheats.
e.zh: 电池过热时，控制器会降低其额定输出。

e.en: The agency {derates} unsafe equipment after inspection.
e.zh: 该机构在检查后会下调不安全设备的评级。

e.en: Thermal {derating} protects the circuit from damage.
e.zh: 热降额可以保护电路免受损坏。

e.en: The report recommended {derating} the bridge capacity.
e.zh: 报告建议下调这座桥的承载能力。

deration.t: 取消配给；解除定量供应

e.en: The government announced {deration} after harvests improved.
e.zh: 收成好转后，政府宣布取消配给。

e.en: Fuel {deration} came slowly in the postwar years.
e.zh: 战后几年里，燃料配给逐步解除。

e.en: The port ordered {deratization} of every warehouse.
e.zh: 港口下令对每座仓库进行灭鼠。

e.en: Public health teams monitored {deratization} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水后，公共卫生队伍监督灭鼠工作。

e.en: Workers came to {deratize} the old market.
e.zh: 工人们来给旧市场灭鼠。

e.en: Ships must {deratize} before entering some ports.
e.zh: 船只进入某些港口前必须进行灭鼠处理。

e.en: The soldiers fell into {deray} after the charge.
e.zh: 冲锋之后，士兵们陷入混乱。

e.en: The old poem describes courtly {deray} at dawn.
e.zh: 这首古诗描写了黎明时宫廷中的纷乱。

e.en: The museum label identified the dark crystal as {derbylite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这块深色晶体标为德比石。

e.en: Collectors rarely find good specimens of {derbylite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很少能找到品相好的德比石标本。

e.en: Stress triggered a spell of {derealization} during the exam.
e.zh: 考试时压力引发了一阵现实感丧失。

e.en: She described {derealization} as feeling detached from the room.
e.zh: 她形容现实感丧失就像与房间隔了一层。

derealize.t: 使失去现实感；使非真实化

e.en: Panic can {derealize} familiar surroundings.
e.zh: 恐慌会让熟悉的环境显得不真实。

e.en: The film uses sound to {derealize} ordinary city streets.
e.zh: 这部电影用声音把普通城市街道处理得失去现实感。

e.en: The union voted to {derecognise} the breakaway committee.
e.zh: 工会投票决定不再承认这个分裂出去的委员会。

e.en: A state may {derecognise} a foreign government.
e.zh: 一个国家可能撤销对外国政府的承认。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {dereeler} before production started.
e.zh: 生产开始前，技术员调好了放线器。

e.en: A jammed {dereeler} stopped the packaging line.
e.zh: 一个卡住的退卷装置使包装线停了下来。

e.en: Lens {dereflection} improves contrast in bright rooms.
e.zh: 镜片去反射处理能提高明亮房间里的对比度。

e.en: The coating provides {dereflection} for the display glass.
e.zh: 这种涂层为显示屏玻璃提供减反射效果。

e.en: You must {deregister} the device before selling it.
e.zh: 出售设备前，你必须把它注销登记。

e.en: The charity could be {deregistered} for breaking the rules.
e.zh: 该慈善机构可能因违规而被取消注册。

deregulator.t: 放松管制者；去监管机构

e.en: The minister became known as a fierce {deregulator}.
e.zh: 这位部长以强力推动放松管制而闻名。

e.en: Critics said the {deregulator} ignored safety warnings.
e.zh: 批评者说这位放松管制者忽视了安全警告。

dereism.t: 脱离现实的思维；自闭性思维

e.en: The psychiatrist noted signs of {dereism} in the patient.
e.zh: 精神科医生注意到患者有脱离现实思维的迹象。

e.en: His essay treats {dereism} as a retreat into fantasy.
e.zh: 他的文章把自闭性思维视为退入幻想的一种状态。

e.en: The mutation can {derepress} a silent gene.
e.zh: 这种突变能解除一个沉默基因的抑制。

e.en: Removing the regulator may {derepress} enzyme production.
e.zh: 去除调节因子可能会解除酶生成的阻遏。

derepressor.t: 解除阻遏物；去抑制因子

e.en: The protein acts as a {derepressor} in the operon.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在操纵子中起解除阻遏物的作用。

e.en: Researchers identified a possible {derepressor} for the pathway.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了该通路中一种可能的去抑制因子。

e.en: The army agreed to {derequisition} the farmer's truck.
e.zh: 军方同意解除对那辆农用卡车的征用。

e.en: Officials planned the {derequisition} of several wartime buildings.
e.zh: 官员计划归还几处战时被征用的建筑。

derequisitioned.t: 已解除征用的；已归还的

e.en: The {derequisitioned} hall reopened as a school.
e.zh: 那座已解除征用的大厅重新作为学校开放。

e.en: Several houses were {derequisitioned} after the emergency ended.
e.zh: 紧急状态结束后，几栋房屋被解除征用并归还。

derequisitioning.t: 解除征用；归还征用过程

e.en: The council began {derequisitioning} private homes in spring.
e.zh: 市政会在春天开始解除对私人住宅的征用。

e.en: Careful {derequisitioning} avoided disputes over damaged property.
e.zh: 谨慎的征用归还程序避免了财产受损纠纷。

e.en: The agency {derequisitions} equipment after each crisis.
e.zh: 该机构在每次危机后都会解除对设备的征用。

e.en: Wartime {derequisitions} often required formal records.
e.zh: 战时征用物的归还通常需要正式记录。

e.en: The software update will {derestrict} advanced settings.
e.zh: 这次软件更新将解除对高级设置的限制。

e.en: Officials voted to {derestrict} travel across the border.
e.zh: 官员投票决定放宽跨境旅行管制。

e.en: The sample needs {derichment} before the assay.
e.zh: 样本在检测前需要进行去富集处理。

e.en: Improper {derichment} can distort the final measurement.
e.zh: 去富集处理不当会扭曲最终测量结果。

e.en: She laughed {deridingly} at his proposal.
e.zh: 她嘲弄地笑了笑他的提议。

e.en: The critic spoke {deridingly} of the new policy.
e.zh: 那位评论家以讥笑的口吻谈到新政策。

e.en: You should {derind} the bacon before cooking.
e.zh: 烹调前你应该把培根外皮去掉。

e.en: The machine can {derind} fruit quickly.
e.zh: 这台机器能快速去掉水果外皮。

e.en: He kept a {deringer} hidden in his coat.
e.zh: 他把一把小型手枪藏在外套里。

e.en: The antique {deringer} was displayed behind glass.
e.zh: 那把古董德林杰手枪陈列在玻璃后面。

e.en: His {derious} tone made the room uneasy.
e.zh: 他那种嘲笑的语气让屋里的人很不自在。

e.en: The claim seemed {derious} to experienced lawyers.
e.zh: 这个说法在有经验的律师看来很可笑。

e.en: The excuse was plainly {derisible}.
e.zh: 这个借口显然荒唐可笑。

e.en: They treated the plan as {derisible} fantasy.
e.zh: 他们把这个计划看成可笑的幻想。

e.en: The formula is {derivable} from basic principles.
e.zh: 这个公式可以从基本原理推导出来。

e.en: Several benefits are {derivable} from the new system.
e.zh: 新系统可以带来几项好处。

e.en: The result is {derivably} true under these assumptions.
e.zh: 在这些假设下，该结果可推导地成立。

e.en: This meaning is {derivably} related to the older root.
e.zh: 这个含义可派生地与更古老的词根有关。

e.en: Each {derivant} was tested for stability.
e.zh: 每一种导出物都接受了稳定性测试。

e.en: The linguist traced the {derivant} to a Latin form.
e.zh: 语言学家把这个派生项追溯到一个拉丁形式。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {derivate} of the compound.
e.zh: 化学家合成了该化合物的一种新派生物。

e.en: The noun is a {derivate} of an older verb.
e.zh: 这个名词是一个较古老动词的衍生词。

e.en: The suffix has a {derivational} function.
e.zh: 这个后缀具有构词派生功能。

e.en: Students studied {derivational} patterns in English.
e.zh: 学生们研究了英语中的派生构词模式。

e.en: The clinic hired a new {derm} specialist.
e.zh: 这家诊所聘请了一位新的皮肤科专家。

e.en: The {derm} layer contains nerves and blood vessels.
e.zh: 真皮层含有神经和血管。

e.en: The treatment soothes the {derma} after irritation.
e.zh: 这种疗法能舒缓受刺激后的皮肤。

e.en: A thick {derma} protects the tissue beneath.
e.zh: 厚实的真皮保护下面的组织。

e.en: The specimen was a small {dermapteran} insect.
e.zh: 这个标本是一只小型蠼螋类昆虫。

e.en: She studied {dermapteran} wing structures in detail.
e.zh: 她详细研究了蠼螋类昆虫的翅膀结构。

e.en: The diagnosis mentioned {dermatatrophia} in the affected area.
e.zh: 诊断提到患处存在皮肤萎缩症。

e.en: Severe {dermatatrophia} can make the skin fragile.
e.zh: 严重的皮肤萎缩症会使皮肤变得脆弱。

e.en: The old catalog listed {dermateen} as a substitute material.
e.zh: 旧目录把皮肤素列为一种替代材料。

e.en: This sample of {dermateen} feels smooth and flexible.
e.zh: 这份皮质材料样品摸起来光滑而有弹性。

e.en: The old report described the sample as {dermatine} material.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把样本描述为皮肤样物质。

e.en: A thin {dermatine} layer covered the lesion.
e.zh: 病灶表面覆盖着一层薄薄的皮质物质。

e.en: The biopsy suggested {dermatoblastomycosis} rather than eczema.
e.zh: 活检提示是皮肤芽生菌病，而不是湿疹。

e.en: Untreated {dermatoblastomycosis} can spread slowly through the skin.
e.zh: 未经治疗的皮肤芽生菌病可能在皮肤内慢慢扩散。

e.en: The surgeon removed a small {dermatocyst} from her shoulder.
e.zh: 外科医生从她肩部切除了一个小皮肤囊肿。

e.en: A {dermatocyst} may feel like a firm lump under the skin.
e.zh: 皮肤囊肿摸起来可能像皮下的硬块。

e.en: The botanist identified the outer layer as the {dermatogen}.
e.zh: 植物学家把外层鉴定为生皮层。

e.en: In older terminology, the {dermatogen} gives rise to protective tissue.
e.zh: 按旧术语说，生皮层会形成保护性组织。

e.en: Each {dermatoglyph} was photographed for the study.
e.zh: 研究中给每一道皮纹都拍了照。

e.en: A rare {dermatoglyph} pattern appeared on the child's palm.
e.zh: 这个孩子的掌心出现了一种罕见的皮纹图案。

e.en: She studied {dermatoglyphics} to compare fingerprint patterns.
e.zh: 她研究皮纹学，用来比较指纹图案。

e.en: Clinical {dermatoglyphics} can sometimes support a genetic diagnosis.
e.zh: 临床皮纹学有时能辅助遗传病诊断。

e.en: Her {dermatographia} made red lines appear after light scratching.
e.zh: 她的皮肤划痕症让轻轻一抓就出现红线。

e.en: Cold weather seemed to worsen his {dermatographia}.
e.zh: 寒冷天气似乎加重了他的皮肤划痕症。

e.en: The clinic used {dermatography} to map the rash.
e.zh: 诊所用皮肤描记法标示皮疹范围。

e.en: Medical {dermatography} recorded changes in the patient's skin.
e.zh: 医学皮肤记录法记录了患者皮肤的变化。

e.en: The pathologist noted a {dermatoid} appearance in the tissue.
e.zh: 病理医生注意到该组织呈皮肤样外观。

e.en: A {dermatoid} cyst may contain hairlike structures.
e.zh: 皮肤样囊肿可能含有类似毛发的结构。

e.en: Factory dust caused mild {dermatokoniosis} on his arms.
e.zh: 工厂粉尘使他的手臂出现轻度皮肤尘埃沉着病。

e.en: The doctor distinguished {dermatokoniosis} from an allergic rash.
e.zh: 医生把皮肤尘埃沉着病同过敏性皮疹区分开来。

e.en: The pharmacist applied {dermatol} to the irritated area.
e.zh: 药剂师把皮肤用收敛防腐粉剂敷在受刺激部位。

e.en: Old manuals recommended {dermatol} for minor skin wounds.
e.zh: 旧手册建议小皮肤伤口使用这种收敛防腐粉剂。

e.en: The pain followed a clear {dermatomal} pattern.
e.zh: 疼痛呈现清楚的皮节分布模式。

e.en: A {dermatomal} rash helped confirm shingles.
e.zh: 按皮节分布的皮疹帮助确认了带状疱疹。

e.en: The rash spread across one {dermatome} on his chest.
e.zh: 皮疹沿他胸部的一个皮节扩散。

e.en: The surgeon used a {dermatome} to harvest thin skin grafts.
e.zh: 外科医生用取皮刀切取薄层皮片。

e.en: The study used {dermatometry} to assess skin thickness.
e.zh: 这项研究用皮肤测量法评估皮肤厚度。

e.en: Modern {dermatometry} can track swelling over time.
e.zh: 现代皮肤测量法可以追踪肿胀随时间的变化。

e.en: The athlete developed {dermatomycosis} between his toes.
e.zh: 这名运动员脚趾间患上了皮肤真菌病。

e.en: Topical medicine usually treats mild {dermatomycosis}.
e.zh: 轻度皮肤真菌病通常可用外用药治疗。

e.en: The burning pain suggested {dermatoneuritis}.
e.zh: 灼痛提示可能是皮神经炎。

e.en: Post-infection {dermatoneuritis} left the area sensitive to touch.
e.zh: 感染后的皮神经炎使该部位触碰时很敏感。

e.en: The patient had a chronic {dermatopathy} on both hands.
e.zh: 患者双手有慢性皮肤病变。

e.en: This drug can rarely cause severe {dermatopathy}.
e.zh: 这种药物少数情况下会引起严重皮肤病。

e.en: A severe {dermatophobe} avoided touching any public surface.
e.zh: 严重恐惧皮肤病的人会避免触碰任何公共表面。

e.en: The counselor helped the {dermatophobe} manage health anxiety.
e.zh: 咨询师帮助这名恐惧皮肤病的人管理健康焦虑。

e.en: The lab identified a {dermatophyte} in the nail sample.
e.zh: 实验室在指甲样本中发现了皮肤癣菌。

e.en: A {dermatophyte} often grows on warm, moist skin.
e.zh: 皮肤癣菌常在温暖潮湿的皮肤上生长。

e.en: The child was treated for scalp {dermatophytosis}.
e.zh: 这个孩子因头皮皮肤癣菌病接受治疗。

e.en: Untreated {dermatophytosis} can spread to family members.
e.zh: 未经治疗的皮肤癣菌病可能传给家人。

e.en: The team planned a {dermatoplastic} repair after the burn.
e.zh: 团队计划在烧伤后进行皮肤成形修复。

e.en: New {dermatoplastic} techniques improved the graft's appearance.
e.zh: 新的皮肤成形术技术改善了移植物外观。

e.en: She underwent {dermatoplasty} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她接受了皮肤成形术。

e.en: The hospital offers {dermatoplasty} for complex scars.
e.zh: 这家医院为复杂瘢痕提供植皮成形手术。

e.en: The dermatologist recorded persistent {dermatorrhea}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生记录了持续的皮肤分泌过多。

e.en: Stress appeared to worsen her {dermatorrhea}.
e.zh: 压力似乎加重了她的皮肤分泌过多。

e.en: Severe dryness led to painful {dermatorrhexis}.
e.zh: 严重干燥导致了疼痛的皮肤破裂。

e.en: The nurse cleaned the area around the {dermatorrhexis}.
e.zh: 护士清洁了皮肤破裂处周围的区域。

e.en: The rash was diagnosed as an inflammatory {dermatosis}.
e.zh: 这种皮疹被诊断为炎症性皮肤病。

e.en: Occupational {dermatosis} is common among workers handling chemicals.
e.zh: 接触化学品的工人常见职业性皮肤病。

e.en: The researcher described a {dermatotropic} virus that mainly affects the skin.
e.zh: 研究人员描述了一种主要影响皮肤的亲皮肤病毒。

e.en: Some medicines show {dermatotropic} activity after they enter the bloodstream.
e.zh: 有些药物进入血液后会表现出趋向皮肤的作用。

e.en: The surgeon considered {dermepenthesis} after the burn wound became stable.
e.zh: 烧伤创面稳定后，外科医生考虑进行植皮术。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes use {dermepenthesis} for skin grafting.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献有时用dermepenthesis指皮肤移植。

e.en: A {dermestid} beetle damaged the dried insect collection.
e.zh: 一只皮蠹甲虫损坏了那批干制昆虫标本。

e.en: Museums watch for {dermestid} larvae near old hides and feathers.
e.zh: 博物馆会留意旧兽皮和羽毛附近的皮蠹幼虫。

e.en: The cream is meant for {dermic} irritation, not deep wounds.
e.zh: 这种乳膏用于皮肤刺激，不适合深部伤口。

e.en: The biopsy showed changes in the {dermic} layer.
e.zh: 活检显示真皮层发生了变化。

e.en: Her {dermographia} made red lines appear after light scratching.
e.zh: 她的皮肤划痕症让轻轻一抓后就出现红线。

e.en: The doctor said {dermographia} is usually harmless but annoying.
e.zh: 医生说皮肤划痕症通常无害，但会令人烦恼。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {dermoid} cyst near the ovary.
e.zh: 扫描发现卵巢附近有一个小的皮样囊肿。

e.en: A {dermoid} growth may contain hair or skin tissue.
e.zh: 皮样增生物可能含有毛发或皮肤组织。

e.en: The pathologist noted {dermoidal} tissue inside the cyst.
e.zh: 病理医生注意到囊肿内有皮样组织。

e.en: A {dermoidal} mass can resemble normal skin under the microscope.
e.zh: 皮样肿块在显微镜下可能类似正常皮肤。

e.en: The nurse used a {dermometer} to check the patient's skin temperature.
e.zh: 护士用皮肤温度计检查病人的皮肤温度。

e.en: An old {dermometer} hung beside the examination table.
e.zh: 一支旧的皮肤温度计挂在检查床旁。

e.en: The bite caused a {dermonecrotic} lesion on his arm.
e.zh: 这次咬伤在他手臂上造成了皮肤坏死性病灶。

e.en: Some toxins have {dermonecrotic} effects in laboratory animals.
e.zh: 有些毒素会在实验动物身上产生致皮肤坏死的作用。

e.en: The {dermopteran} glided silently between the trees at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，那只皮翼目动物在树间无声滑翔。

e.en: A colugo is a living {dermopteran} from Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 鼯猴是生活在东南亚的现生皮翼目动物。

e.en: The turtle's shell forms part of its {dermoskeleton}.
e.zh: 龟壳构成了它皮骨骼的一部分。

e.en: Fossils may preserve the {dermoskeleton} even when softer tissues vanish.
e.zh: 即使软组织消失，化石仍可能保存外皮骨架。

e.en: The study focused on a {dermotropic} strain of the virus.
e.zh: 这项研究关注一种趋皮性的病毒株。

e.en: A {dermotropic} drug tends to concentrate in skin tissue.
e.zh: 亲皮肤药物往往会集中在皮肤组织中。

e.en: He kept a {dern} corner of the cellar for private papers.
e.zh: 他把地窖里一个隐秘角落留给私人文件。

e.en: The old poem speaks of a {dern} and lonely road.
e.zh: 那首古诗写到一条阴沉而孤寂的路。

e.en: I cannot find the {derned} key anywhere.
e.zh: 我到处都找不到那把该死的钥匙。

e.en: That {derned} machine stopped working again.
e.zh: 那台讨厌的机器又停工了。

e.en: The lawyer called it his {dernier} argument before the court.
e.zh: 律师称这是他在法庭上的最后论点。

e.en: In older writing, {dernier} may mean final or last.
e.zh: 在较旧的文章中，dernier可表示最终或最后。

e.en: The quarry installed a {derocker} to clear stones from the ore.
e.zh: 采石场安装了一台除石机来清除矿石中的石块。

e.en: A skilled {derocker} removed the loose rock before drilling began.
e.zh: 熟练的碎石清除工在钻孔开始前移走了松动岩石。

e.en: The report avoided {derogative} language about the former employees.
e.zh: 报告避免使用贬低前员工的语言。

e.en: His {derogative} remarks damaged the tone of the debate.
e.zh: 他的贬损言论破坏了辩论的气氛。

e.en: She spoke {derogatorily} about the rival team's work.
e.zh: 她轻蔑地谈论对手团队的工作。

e.en: The article referred {derogatorily} to local customs.
e.zh: 那篇文章以贬低口吻提到当地习俗。

deromanticize.t: 去浪漫化；使不再理想化

e.en: The memoir tries to {deromanticize} life on the road.
e.zh: 这本回忆录试图去浪漫化漂泊在路上的生活。

e.en: Teachers often {deromanticize} war by showing its daily suffering.
e.zh: 教师常通过展示战争中的日常苦难来使战争不再被理想化。

e.en: The factory improved {derosination} during paper processing.
e.zh: 工厂改进了造纸过程中的脱树脂处理。

e.en: Poor {derosination} can leave sticky deposits in the pulp.
e.zh: 脱树脂不充分会在纸浆中留下黏性沉积物。

e.en: The surgeon planned {derotation} of the twisted femur.
e.zh: 外科医生计划对扭转的股骨进行旋转矫正。

e.en: Image software can apply {derotation} to align the scan.
e.zh: 图像软件可以进行反旋转处理来对齐扫描图。

e.en: The novel is full of {derring-do} and narrow escapes.
e.zh: 这部小说充满英勇冒险和九死一生的逃脱。

e.en: His tales of {derring-do} sounded exaggerated after dinner.
e.zh: 饭后他那些大胆壮举的故事听起来有些夸张。

e.en: The captain's {derringdo} became part of village legend.
e.zh: 船长的英勇冒险成了村里的传奇。

e.en: Children loved stories of {derringdo} in distant kingdoms.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢遥远王国里大胆壮举的故事。

e.en: Farmers once used {derris} as a natural insecticide.
e.zh: 农民过去曾把鱼藤用作天然杀虫剂。

e.en: The old shed smelled faintly of {derris} powder.
e.zh: 旧棚屋里隐约有鱼藤粉的气味。

e.en: Apply the {deruster} before painting the metal gate.
e.zh: 给金属大门上漆前先涂除锈剂。

e.en: The mechanic kept a small {deruster} beside the workbench.
e.zh: 机修工把一个小除锈工具放在工作台旁。

derv.t: 苦行僧；旋转舞者；狂热者

e.en: The old poem describes a {derv} spinning in prayer.
e.zh: 那首古诗描写一名苦行僧在祈祷中旋转。

e.en: During the debate, he became a political {derv}.
e.zh: 辩论中，他变成了政治上的狂热分子。

e.en: The enzyme can {desaccharify} the syrup before fermentation.
e.zh: 这种酶能在发酵前去除糖浆中的糖分。

e.en: Researchers tried to {desaccharify} the sample without changing its proteins.
e.zh: 研究人员试图让样品脱糖，同时不改变其中的蛋白质。

e.en: The museum display led to the {desacralization} of the ancient ritual objects.
e.zh: 博物馆的陈列使这些古代祭祀用品被去神圣化。

e.en: Some critics saw the novel as a {desacralization} of national myths.
e.zh: 一些评论家认为这部小说是在世俗化民族神话。

e.en: The director chose to {desacralize} the legend with ordinary dialogue.
e.zh: 导演选择用日常对白让这个传说去神圣化。

e.en: Repeated scandals can {desacralize} once-revered institutions.
e.zh: 一再发生的丑闻会使曾受敬仰的机构失去神圣光环。

e.en: The technician scheduled the {desactivation} of the old alarm system.
e.zh: 技术员安排停用旧的报警系统。

e.en: The paper measured the {desactivation} of the catalyst at high temperature.
e.zh: 论文测量了催化剂在高温下的去活化过程。

e.en: The island built a plant to {desalinate} seawater.
e.zh: 这座岛建了一座工厂来淡化海水。

e.en: Engineers hope to {desalinate} brackish groundwater more cheaply.
e.zh: 工程师希望以更低成本去除咸淡地下水中的盐分。

e.en: A small {desalinator} supplied drinking water for the boat.
e.zh: 一台小型海水淡化器为船只提供饮用水。

e.en: The damaged {desalinator} left the village dependent on tankers.
e.zh: 受损的脱盐设备让村庄只能依赖运水车。

e.en: The new membrane can {desalinise} water using less energy.
e.zh: 这种新膜能以更低能耗淡化海水。

e.en: Farmers tried to {desalinise} the soil after years of irrigation.
e.zh: 多年灌溉后，农民试图去除土壤中的盐分。

e.en: The lab protocol required them to {desalivate} each specimen first.
e.zh: 实验规程要求他们先除去每个样本中的唾液。

e.en: Certain drugs may {desalivate} the mouth and cause discomfort.
e.zh: 某些药物可能会减少口腔唾液并引起不适。

e.en: Rinse the fish to {desalt} it before cooking.
e.zh: 烹饪前先冲洗鱼肉以去除盐分。

e.en: The refinery uses heat and water to {desalt} crude oil.
e.zh: 炼油厂用热和水给原油脱盐。

e.en: The chef added {desalted} cod to the stew.
e.zh: 厨师把已脱盐的鳕鱼加入炖菜中。

e.en: Only {desalted} water could be used in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中只能使用去盐后的水。

e.en: The refinery installed a larger {desalter} last year.
e.zh: 炼油厂去年安装了一台更大的脱盐器。

e.en: A skilled {desalter} knows when the fish is ready to cook.
e.zh: 熟练的脱盐工知道鱼什么时候适合下锅。

e.en: The report compared several methods of {desaltification}.
e.zh: 报告比较了几种脱盐方法。

e.en: Slow {desaltification} helped restore the damaged farmland.
e.zh: 缓慢的去盐过程帮助恢复了受损农田。

e.en: The device {desalts} seawater for emergency use.
e.zh: 这台设备为应急用途淡化海水。

e.en: She {desalts} the preserved olives by soaking them overnight.
e.zh: 她把腌橄榄浸泡一夜来去除盐分。

e.en: The bacterium produces a {desamidase} that modifies proteins.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生一种修饰蛋白质的脱酰胺酶。

e.en: They tested whether the {desamidase} remained active after heating.
e.zh: 他们测试这种脱酰胺酶加热后是否仍有活性。

e.en: The chemist analyzed the {desamidizate} under a microscope.
e.zh: 化学家在显微镜下分析这种脱酰胺产物。

e.en: Each {desamidizate} showed a slightly different reaction profile.
e.zh: 每种脱酰胺产物都显示出略有不同的反应特征。

e.en: Heat accelerated the {desamidization} of the protein sample.
e.zh: 加热加速了蛋白质样品的脱酰胺作用。

e.en: The team studied {desamidization} during long-term storage.
e.zh: 团队研究了长期储存过程中的去酰胺化现象。

e.en: This {desaminase} helps the cell break down amino compounds.
e.zh: 这种脱氨酶帮助细胞分解含氨基的化合物。

e.en: The mutation reduced {desaminase} activity in the liver.
e.zh: 该突变降低了肝脏中的脱氨酶活性。

e.en: The historian described the reform as a {desanctification} of royal power.
e.zh: 历史学家把这场改革描述为王权的去神圣化。

e.en: Believers protested the perceived {desanctification} of the shrine.
e.zh: 信徒抗议他们所认为的圣祠被亵圣化。

e.en: The play seemed to {desanctify} a revered national symbol.
e.zh: 这部戏似乎让一个受尊崇的国家象征失去神圣性。

e.en: They feared the commercial event would {desanctify} the temple grounds.
e.zh: 他们担心商业活动会亵渎寺庙场地。

e.en: The crew began {desanding} the pipeline after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，工作人员开始清除管道里的沙粒。

e.en: Proper {desanding} protects the pumps from abrasion.
e.zh: 恰当的除砂能保护水泵免受磨损。

e.en: Use the filter to {desaturate} the bright red background.
e.zh: 使用滤镜降低鲜红背景的饱和度。

e.en: The enzyme can {desaturate} a fatty acid chain.
e.zh: 这种酶能使脂肪酸链变为不饱和。

e.en: The image editor includes a simple {desaturator} tool.
e.zh: 这款图像编辑器包含一个简单的去饱和工具。

e.en: A faulty {desaturator} disrupted fatty acid synthesis.
e.zh: 有缺陷的脱饱和酶扰乱了脂肪酸合成。

e.en: You should {descale} the kettle every month.
e.zh: 你应该每个月给水壶除一次水垢。

e.en: The technician came to {descale} the coffee machine.
e.zh: 技师来给咖啡机清除水垢。

e.en: The {descaled} kettle boiled water more quickly.
e.zh: 除过水垢的水壶烧水更快。

e.en: She {descaled} the shower head with vinegar.
e.zh: 她用醋清除了淋浴喷头上的水垢。

e.en: Use a mild {descaler} for the espresso machine.
e.zh: 给意式咖啡机使用温和的除垢剂。

e.en: The plumber brought a small {descaler} for the pipes.
e.zh: 水管工带来一个小型除垢工具处理管道。

e.en: This solution {descales} kettles in ten minutes.
e.zh: 这种溶液十分钟内就能清除水壶水垢。

e.en: He {descales} the boiler before winter.
e.zh: 他在冬天前给锅炉除水垢。

e.en: The thieves {descamps} before dawn.
e.zh: 那些小偷在黎明前逃走。

e.en: She {descamps} to the countryside whenever work becomes unbearable.
e.zh: 每当工作难以忍受时，她就突然跑到乡下去。

e.en: The cliff is {descendable} with proper ropes.
e.zh: 有合适的绳索时，这座悬崖可以下去。

e.en: The estate was considered {descendable} to his heirs.
e.zh: 这份地产被认为可以传给他的继承人。

e.en: Engineers tested the {descendibility} of the rescue ladder.
e.zh: 工程师测试了救援梯是否便于下降。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {descendibility} of the title.
e.zh: 律师质疑该头衔是否具有可继承性。

e.en: The route is {descendible} only in dry weather.
e.zh: 这条路线只有在干燥天气下才可下行。

e.en: Some rights were once treated as {descendible} property.
e.zh: 有些权利曾被视为可继承的财产。

e.en: The balloon's slow {descension} worried the crowd.
e.zh: 气球缓慢下降让人群感到担心。

e.en: The poem describes a spiritual {descension} into despair.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一种坠入绝望的精神下沉。

e.en: The chart shows a clear {descensional} trend.
e.zh: 图表显示出明显的下降趋势。

e.en: The ritual had a {descensional} movement into the cave.
e.zh: 这个仪式包含向洞穴下行的动作。

e.en: The music followed a {descensive} pattern.
e.zh: 这段音乐采用了下行的旋律模式。

e.en: A {descensive} path led them into the valley.
e.zh: 一条向下的小路把他们带进山谷。

e.en: The theologian wrote about Christ's {descensus}.
e.zh: 那位神学家写到了基督的降下。

e.en: Scholars used {descensus} to describe the soul's fall.
e.zh: 学者们用这个词描述灵魂的坠落。

e.en: Some parents try to {deschool} their children after leaving formal classes.
e.zh: 一些家长在孩子离开正规课堂后，尝试让他们摆脱学校化思维。

e.en: The movement wanted to {deschool} society, not just reform classrooms.
e.zh: 这场运动想让社会去学校化，而不只是改革课堂。

e.en: The {deschooler} argued that learning happens everywhere.
e.zh: 这位去学校化倡导者认为学习可以发生在任何地方。

e.en: As a {deschooler}, he disliked rigid timetables.
e.zh: 作为去学校化支持者，他不喜欢僵硬的时间表。

e.en: {Deschooling} helped her rethink what learning meant.
e.zh: 去学校化教育帮助她重新思考学习的含义。

e.en: The book presents {deschooling} as a social critique.
e.zh: 这本书把去学校化作为一种社会批判来呈现。

e.en: The seedpod is {desciscent} when fully ripe.
e.zh: 这个荚果完全成熟时会裂开。

e.en: A {desciscent} capsule released the tiny seeds.
e.zh: 开裂的蒴果释放出细小的种子。

e.en: The paper describes {desclerotization} in insect tissue.
e.zh: 论文描述了昆虫组织中的去硬化过程。

e.en: Doctors monitored {desclerotization} after the treatment.
e.zh: 医生在治疗后监测硬化组织的软化情况。

e.en: The collector bought a specimen of {descloizite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块钒铅锌矿标本。

e.en: {Descloizite} often forms reddish brown crystals.
e.zh: 钒铅锌矿常形成红褐色晶体。

e.en: The software can {descramble} the encrypted signal.
e.zh: 这款软件可以解读加密信号。

e.en: Children had to {descramble} the letters to find the word.
e.zh: 孩子们必须把字母重新排列，找出那个单词。

e.en: The manuscript shows several {describal} errors.
e.zh: 这份手稿显示出几处抄写错误。

e.en: Her study focused on {describal} practices in monasteries.
e.zh: 她的研究关注修道院中的抄写惯例。

e.en: The {descrier} spotted smoke beyond the hills.
e.zh: 那个远望者发现山后有烟。

e.en: A careful {descrier} of motives will notice the contradiction.
e.zh: 善于察觉动机的人会注意到这个矛盾。

descriptivism.t: 描述主义；客观描写立场

e.en: Linguistic {descriptivism} records how people actually speak.
e.zh: 语言学的描述主义记录人们实际怎样说话。

e.en: His moral {descriptivism} avoids saying what people should do.
e.zh: 他的道德描述主义避免说明人们应该怎么做。

e.en: The log contains {descrptor}, a misspelling of descriptor.
e.zh: 日志里有descrptor，这是descriptor的误拼写。

e.en: Search for {descrptor} if the old database used that typo.
e.zh: 如果旧数据库用了这个拼写错误，就搜索descrptor。

e.en: The dentist applied a {desealant} before replacing the filling.
e.zh: 牙医在更换填充物前使用了去封闭剂。

e.en: A chemical {desealant} softened the old adhesive layer.
e.zh: 化学脱封材料软化了旧的黏合层。

desexualize.t: 去除性意味；淡化性别色彩

e.en: The editor tried to {desexualize} the advertisement for a wider audience.
e.zh: 编辑试图去除广告中的性意味，以面向更广泛的受众。

e.en: Some uniforms are meant to {desexualize} workers in public roles.
e.zh: 有些制服旨在淡化公共岗位工作人员的性别色彩。

desexualized.t: 去性化的；已淡化性意味的

e.en: The character was {desexualized} in the later film adaptation.
e.zh: 这个角色在后来的电影改编中被去除了性意味。

e.en: They preferred a {desexualized} dress code for the clinic.
e.zh: 他们更喜欢诊所采用淡化性别色彩的着装规定。

desexualizes.t: 去除性意味；淡化性别色彩

e.en: The policy {desexualizes} the workplace by limiting revealing uniforms.
e.zh: 这项政策通过限制暴露制服来淡化工作场所的性意味。

e.en: The novel {desexualizes} romance and focuses on companionship.
e.zh: 这部小说淡化了爱情中的性意味，转而关注陪伴。

desexualizing.t: 去除性意味的；淡化性别色彩的

e.en: The campaign used a {desexualizing} tone in its health messages.
e.zh: 这场宣传在健康信息中采用了淡化性意味的语气。

e.en: They discussed {desexualizing} the costume without losing its style.
e.zh: 他们讨论如何在不失风格的情况下淡化服装的性意味。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {desferrioxamine} for severe iron overload.
e.zh: 医生为严重铁过载开了去铁胺。

e.en: Patients receiving {desferrioxamine} need regular monitoring.
e.zh: 接受去铁胺治疗的患者需要定期监测。

e.en: She answered the door in elegant {deshabille}.
e.zh: 她衣着随意却优雅地去开门。

e.en: The painting shows the model in {deshabille}.
e.zh: 这幅画表现了模特半裸的状态。

e.en: The surgeon performed {desheathing} around the affected nerve.
e.zh: 外科医生对受影响神经周围进行了脱鞘处理。

e.en: Careful {desheathing} exposed the cable's inner conductor.
e.zh: 小心去除外层包覆后，电缆的内导体露了出来。

deshydremia.t: 血液水分减少；脱水性血症

e.en: Severe dehydration may cause {deshydremia} in vulnerable patients.
e.zh: 严重脱水可能导致脆弱患者出现血液水分减少。

e.en: The report listed {deshydremia} among the rare complications.
e.zh: 报告把脱水性血症列为罕见并发症之一。

desi.t: 南亚裔的；南亚本土风格

e.en: The restaurant serves {desi} food with regional spices.
e.zh: 这家餐馆供应带有地方香料的南亚风味食物。

e.en: She grew up in a large {desi} community in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦一个庞大的南亚裔社区中长大。

e.en: A small packet of {desiccant} kept the shoes dry.
e.zh: 一小包干燥剂让鞋子保持干燥。

e.en: The laboratory stored samples with {desiccant} to prevent moisture damage.
e.zh: 实验室用干燥剂保存样品，以防受潮损坏。

e.en: Silica gel is a common {desiccatant} in packaging.
e.zh: 硅胶是包装中常见的干燥剂。

e.en: The chemist added a {desiccatant} before sealing the container.
e.zh: 化学师在密封容器前加入了一种干燥物质。

e.en: The wind had a harsh {desiccative} effect on the soil.
e.zh: 这阵风对土壤产生了强烈的干燥作用。

e.en: Some ointments include {desiccative} ingredients for wet wounds.
e.zh: 有些药膏含有用于潮湿伤口的干燥性成分。

desiccator.t: 干燥器；实验室干燥容器

e.en: The crystals were placed in a {desiccator} overnight.
e.zh: 这些晶体被放在干燥器中过夜。

e.en: Open the {desiccator} slowly to avoid disturbing the sample.
e.zh: 慢慢打开实验室干燥容器，以免扰动样品。

e.en: Reformers {desiderate} a fairer system of taxation.
e.zh: 改革者渴望建立更公平的税收制度。

e.en: The committee seemed to {desiderate} clearer evidence.
e.zh: 委员会似乎认为还需要更明确的证据。

desiderated.t: 被渴望的；被认为需要的

e.en: Peace was the most {desiderated} outcome after years of conflict.
e.zh: 多年冲突之后，和平是最被渴望的结果。

e.en: The missing data were {desiderated} by every researcher on the team.
e.zh: 团队里的每位研究者都认为这些缺失数据很有必要。

e.en: The theory {desiderates} a stronger account of human choice.
e.zh: 这个理论需要对人的选择作出更有力的解释。

e.en: He {desiderates} recognition more than money.
e.zh: 比起金钱，他更渴望得到认可。

e.en: The author is {desiderating} a language beyond ordinary realism.
e.zh: 作者正在渴望一种超越普通现实主义的语言。

e.en: By {desiderating} certainty, the study ignored useful ambiguity.
e.zh: 这项研究因一味追求确定性而忽视了有用的模糊性。

e.en: Freedom remained his deepest {desideration}.
e.zh: 自由始终是他内心最深的渴望。

e.en: Reliable transport was a practical {desideration} for the village.
e.zh: 可靠的交通是这个村庄实际需要的东西。

e.en: The verb has a {desiderative} form in Sanskrit grammar.
e.zh: 这个动词在梵语语法中有表示愿望的形式。

e.en: Her letters reveal a strongly {desiderative} imagination.
e.zh: 她的信件显露出一种强烈渴望的想象力。

e.en: The company hired more {design-oriented} engineers this year.
e.zh: 公司今年聘用了更多以设计为导向的工程师。

e.en: A {design-oriented} approach can improve everyday public services.
e.zh: 以设计为导向的方法可以改善日常公共服务。

designability.t: 可设计性；设计适应能力

e.en: The material's {designability} made it popular with architects.
e.zh: 这种材料的可设计性使它受到建筑师欢迎。

e.en: Engineers tested the protein's {designability} under different constraints.
e.zh: 工程师在不同限制条件下测试了该蛋白的可设计性。

e.en: The interface is fully {designable} by the product team.
e.zh: 这个界面完全可以由产品团队来设计。

e.en: They treated the neighborhood as a {designable} social environment.
e.zh: 他们把这个社区视为一个可以规划的社会环境。

e.en: The philosopher compared the signs with their {designata}.
e.zh: 哲学家比较了符号及其所指对象。

e.en: In this theory, words and {designata} are kept strictly separate.
e.zh: 在这一理论中，词语和指称物被严格区分。

e.en: The suffix has a {designative} function in the old grammar.
e.zh: 这个后缀在旧语法中有表示作用。

e.en: A {designative} label points to one specific object.
e.zh: 一个指称性标签指向某个具体对象。

e.en: The code uses a short {designator} for each airport.
e.zh: 这套代码为每个机场使用一个简短标示符。

e.en: In logic, a {designator} may name a particular individual.
e.zh: 在逻辑学中，指称词可以命名某个特定个体。

e.en: The phrase has a {designatory} role in the sentence.
e.zh: 这个短语在句中起指称作用。

e.en: They chose a {designatory} symbol for the new category.
e.zh: 他们为这个新类别选了一个标示性符号。

e.en: Every term in the table has a clear {designatum}.
e.zh: 表中的每个术语都有明确的所指对象。

e.en: The philosopher asked whether the {designatum} really exists.
e.zh: 哲学家追问那个指称物是否真的存在。

e.en: The room looked {designless}, as if furniture had been dropped at random.
e.zh: 房间看起来毫无设计感，仿佛家具是随意放进去的。

e.en: He feared a {designless} universe without any guiding purpose.
e.zh: 他害怕一个没有任何指引目的的无意图宇宙。

e.en: The old charter confirmed his {designment} to the office.
e.zh: 旧宪章确认了他被指定担任该职。

e.en: Her careful {designment} of the meeting surprised no one.
e.zh: 她对这次会面的周密安排并不让人意外。

e.en: The engineer kept a {designograph} of the machine's layout.
e.zh: 工程师保存了一份机器布局的设计图。

e.en: A faded {designograph} showed how the parts once fitted together.
e.zh: 一张褪色的图示记录显示这些零件当初如何装配。

e.en: The plant began {desiliconizing} the molten metal before casting.
e.zh: 工厂在铸造前开始对熔融金属脱硅。

e.en: A new catalyst made {desiliconizing} the mixture faster.
e.zh: 一种新催化剂让除去混合物中的硅更快。

e.en: Workers will {desilt} the canal before the rainy season.
e.zh: 工人们会在雨季前清除运河淤泥。

e.en: The village hired a crew to {desilt} the blocked pond.
e.zh: 村里雇了一队人清理堵塞池塘的淤泥。

e.en: The drilling rig used a {desilter} to clean the mud.
e.zh: 钻井平台用除砂器清洁泥浆。

e.en: A broken {desilter} slowed the flood-control project.
e.zh: 一台坏掉的清淤设备拖慢了防洪工程。

e.en: The city scheduled {desilting} work along the river.
e.zh: 市政府安排了沿河清淤工作。

e.en: Regular {desilting} keeps the reservoir from losing capacity.
e.zh: 定期除泥沙能防止水库库容下降。

e.en: The refinery can {desilver} lead using a chemical process.
e.zh: 冶炼厂可以用化学工艺从铅中除银。

e.en: They tried to {desilver} the old photographic waste.
e.zh: 他们试图从旧摄影废料中脱银。

e.en: The report describes {desilverization} of lead bullion.
e.zh: 报告描述了粗铅的除银过程。

e.en: Improved {desilverization} reduced losses in the refinery.
e.zh: 改进的脱银工艺减少了冶炼厂的损耗。

e.en: The chemist found a way to {desilverize} the solution.
e.zh: 化学家找到了一种让溶液脱银的方法。

e.en: Old plates were treated to {desilverize} their worn surface.
e.zh: 旧底片经过处理以除去磨损表面的银。

e.en: Latin nouns often change meaning through {desinence}.
e.zh: 拉丁语名词常通过词尾变化表达意义。

e.en: The linguist marked each {desinence} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 语言学家标出了手稿中的每个词尾。

e.en: The poet lingered on the {desinent} sound of the line.
e.zh: 诗人停留在这一行结尾的声音上。

e.en: A {desinent} syllable may carry important grammatical information.
e.zh: 一个词尾音节可能承载重要的语法信息。

e.en: The teacher explained the {desinential} endings of the verbs.
e.zh: 老师解释了这些动词的词尾变化。

e.en: A {desinential} marker can show case or number.
e.zh: 语尾标记可以表示格或数。

e.en: Moisture can {desintegrate} the tablet before it is swallowed.
e.zh: 水分可能在药片被吞下前使其分解。

e.en: Civil conflict began to {desintegrate} the old empire.
e.zh: 内乱开始使这个古老帝国瓦解。

e.en: The lab installed a {desintegrator} for brittle samples.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一台用于脆性样品的粉碎机。

e.en: A faulty {desintegrator} left large pieces in the mixture.
e.zh: 故障的分解装置让混合物中残留了大块物料。

e.en: His {desipient} remarks weakened an otherwise serious speech.
e.zh: 他那些荒唐的话削弱了原本严肃的演讲。

e.en: The critic dismissed the plan as {desipient} optimism.
e.zh: 评论家把这个计划斥为愚蠢的乐观。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {desipramine} after reviewing her history.
e.zh: 医生查看她的病史后开了地昔帕明。

e.en: Patients taking {desipramine} should report severe side effects.
e.zh: 服用地昔帕明的患者应报告严重副作用。

e.en: The apartment is {desirably} close to the station.
e.zh: 这套公寓离车站很近，位置很理想。

e.en: Applicants should, {desirably}, have experience with children.
e.zh: 申请者最好有照看儿童的经验。

e.en: The monk sought a calm and {desireless} state.
e.zh: 那位僧人追求平静无欲的状态。

e.en: She felt strangely {desireless} after reaching her goal.
e.zh: 达到目标后，她奇怪地感到没有任何渴望。

e.en: The court demanded immediate {desistance} from the illegal activity.
e.zh: 法院要求立即停止这种非法活动。

e.en: His {desistance} from crime followed years of counseling.
e.zh: 经过多年辅导后，他停止了犯罪行为。

e.en: The treaty marked the {desition} of open hostilities.
e.zh: 这项条约标志着公开敌对状态的结束。

e.en: Old medical texts used {desition} for the stopping of symptoms.
e.zh: 旧医学文本用desition表示症状的终止。

desivac.t: 给织物脱浆处理；脱浆剂

e.en: The mill used {desivac} before dyeing the cloth.
e.zh: 工厂在给布料染色前使用脱浆处理。

e.en: A stronger {desivac} removed the starch finish.
e.zh: 更强的脱浆剂去除了淀粉整理层。

e.en: The engineer tested the fabric's {desizability} in warm water.
e.zh: 工程师在温水中测试这种织物的可脱浆性。

e.en: High {desizability} reduces chemical use in finishing.
e.zh: 较高的易脱浆程度能减少后整理中的化学品用量。

e.en: Workers {desize} the cotton before bleaching it.
e.zh: 工人在漂白棉布前先给它脱浆。

e.en: The enzyme bath can {desize} delicate fabric gently.
e.zh: 酶浴可以温和地除去精细织物上的浆料。

e.en: {Desizing} prepares the cloth for even dyeing.
e.zh: 脱浆能让布料为均匀染色做好准备。

e.en: Poor {desizing} left stiff patches on the fabric.
e.zh: 脱浆不彻底使织物上留下了发硬的斑块。

desk-bound.t: 受困于案头工作的；久坐办公的

e.en: She felt {desk-bound} after months of remote work.
e.zh: 远程工作几个月后，她觉得自己被困在案头工作里。

e.en: A {desk-bound} role can still be stressful.
e.zh: 久坐办公的岗位也可能压力很大。

desk-fax.t: 桌上传真机；办公桌传真设备

e.en: The old {desk-fax} still sat beside the printer.
e.zh: 那台旧桌上传真机仍放在打印机旁边。

e.en: He sent the contract from a {desk-fax}.
e.zh: 他用办公桌上的传真设备发出了合同。

deskbound.t: 受困于案头工作的；久坐办公的

e.en: The new job left him completely {deskbound}.
e.zh: 新工作让他完全离不开办公桌。

e.en: Many {deskbound} employees need regular movement breaks.
e.zh: 许多久坐办公的员工需要定时活动休息。

deskill.t: 降低技能要求；使技能退化

e.en: Automation can {deskill} parts of the production process.
e.zh: 自动化可能会降低生产流程中某些环节的技能要求。

e.en: Repetitive work may {deskill} experienced staff over time.
e.zh: 重复性工作久而久之可能使有经验的员工技能退化。

deskilling.t: 技能降级；工作去技能化

e.en: The union warned that {deskilling} would lower wages.
e.zh: 工会警告说，工作去技能化会压低工资。

e.en: Some software causes {deskilling} by hiding expert decisions.
e.zh: 有些软件把专业判断隐藏起来，从而导致技能退化。

deskman.t: 案头工作人员；值班接待员

e.en: The night {deskman} checked every guest's key.
e.zh: 夜班接待员核对了每位客人的钥匙。

e.en: As a {deskman}, he handled records all day.
e.zh: 作为案头工作人员，他整天处理记录。

e.en: My {deskmate} always shares useful notes after meetings.
e.zh: 我的邻桌同事总会在会后分享有用的笔记。

e.en: She became close friends with her school {deskmate}.
e.zh: 她和学校里的同桌成了好朋友。

e.en: He prefers field visits to {deskwork}.
e.zh: 比起案头工作，他更喜欢外出实地走访。

e.en: The project involves hours of careful {deskwork}.
e.zh: 这个项目需要花许多小时做细致的文书工作。

e.en: Technicians {deslag} the furnace after each run.
e.zh: 技术人员每次运行后都会清除炉内炉渣。

e.en: The crew used a lance to {deslag} the molten metal.
e.zh: 工人用喷枪清除熔融金属中的炉渣。

e.en: {Deslagging} keeps the furnace operating efficiently.
e.zh: 清渣能让炉子保持高效运行。

e.en: The plant scheduled {deslagging} during the shutdown.
e.zh: 工厂把除渣作业安排在停工期间进行。

deslanoside.t: 去乙酰毛花苷；强心苷药物

e.en: The doctor administered {deslanoside} for acute heart failure.
e.zh: 医生为急性心力衰竭患者使用了去乙酰毛花苷。

e.en: {Deslanoside} must be dosed carefully in older patients.
e.zh: 给老年患者使用去乙酰毛花苷时必须谨慎控制剂量。

e.en: The plant must {deslime} the ore before flotation.
e.zh: 工厂必须在浮选前除去矿石中的矿泥。

e.en: Engineers {deslime} the water channels every month.
e.zh: 工程师每月清除水道中的黏泥。

e.en: {Desliming} improves the efficiency of mineral separation.
e.zh: 脱泥能提高矿物分选效率。

e.en: The report blamed poor {desliming} for the low yield.
e.zh: 报告把产量低归因于脱泥效果不佳。

e.en: Workers {desludge} the tank before inspection.
e.zh: 工人在检查前清除罐内污泥。

e.en: The system can {desludge} wastewater without stopping production.
e.zh: 该系统能在不停产的情况下清除废水中的污泥。

e.en: The {desman} hunts small prey in cold streams.
e.zh: 麝鼩在寒冷溪流中捕食小型猎物。

e.en: Scientists tracked a rare {desman} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 科学家在河岸附近追踪到一只罕见的麝鼩。

desmethylfarreol.t: 去甲基法瑞醇；植物化合物

e.en: Researchers isolated {desmethylfarreol} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物提取物中分离出去甲基法瑞醇。

e.en: The paper examined whether {desmethylfarreol} reduced inflammation.
e.zh: 论文研究了去甲基法瑞醇是否能减轻炎症。

desmethylnobiletin.t: 去甲基川陈皮素；黄酮化合物

e.en: Citrus peel contains small amounts of {desmethylnobiletin}.
e.zh: 柑橘皮中含有少量去甲基川陈皮素。

e.en: The study measured {desmethylnobiletin} in several extracts.
e.zh: 这项研究测定了几种提取物中的去甲基川陈皮素。

e.en: Farmers once used {desmetryn} to control broadleaf weeds.
e.zh: 农民过去曾用扑灭通防治阔叶杂草。

e.en: The lab detected {desmetryn} residues in the soil sample.
e.zh: 实验室在土壤样本中检测到扑灭通残留。

e.en: A {desmid} often has a beautifully symmetrical shape.
e.zh: 鼓藻常常具有非常对称的美丽形态。

e.en: The pond sample contained several kinds of {desmid}.
e.zh: 池塘样本中含有好几种鼓藻。

e.en: The microscope revealed a delicate {desmidian} cell.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出一个精细的鼓藻细胞。

e.en: She catalogued {desmidian} species from mountain lakes.
e.zh: 她为山地湖泊中的鼓藻类物种编目。

desmin.t: 结蛋白；肌肉中间丝蛋白

e.en: The biopsy showed abnormal {desmin} staining in muscle tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示肌肉组织中的结蛋白染色异常。

e.en: {Desmin} helps maintain the structure of muscle cells.
e.zh: 结蛋白有助于维持肌肉细胞的结构。

e.en: The horse was treated for {desmitis} after the race.
e.zh: 那匹马赛后因韧带炎接受治疗。

e.en: Chronic {desmitis} can make walking painful.
e.zh: 慢性韧带炎会使行走变得疼痛。

e.en: The study described a {desmoenzyme} involved in tissue repair.
e.zh: 这项研究描述了一种参与组织修复的连接酶。

e.en: A rare {desmoenzyme} was isolated from the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从样本中分离出一种罕见的促结合酶。

e.en: The surgeon removed a {desmoid} tumor from her abdomen.
e.zh: 外科医生从她腹部切除了一个硬纤维瘤。

e.en: The tissue had a tough, {desmoid} appearance.
e.zh: 这块组织呈现坚韧的韧带样外观。

e.en: The reaction depends on a specific {desmolase}.
e.zh: 该反应依赖一种特定的裂解酶。

e.en: Researchers measured {desmolase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞中的裂解酶活性。

e.en: Heat caused {desmolysis} of the unstable compound.
e.zh: 加热导致这种不稳定化合物发生键裂解。

e.en: The paper discusses {desmolysis} during metabolism.
e.zh: 论文讨论了代谢过程中的分解作用。

desmosine.t: 锁链素；弹性蛋白交联氨基酸

e.en: Urine levels of {desmosine} may indicate elastin breakdown.
e.zh: 尿液中的锁链素水平可能提示弹性蛋白分解。

e.en: The lab detected {desmosine} in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室在组织样本中检测到锁链素。

e.en: A {desmosome} helps neighboring cells stick together.
e.zh: 桥粒帮助相邻细胞彼此黏附。

e.en: The disease weakens each {desmosome} in the skin.
e.zh: 这种疾病会削弱皮肤中的每个桥粒。

e.en: {Desmosterol} is a precursor in cholesterol synthesis.
e.zh: 链甾醇是胆固醇合成中的一种前体。

e.en: The blood test showed elevated {desmosterol} levels.
e.zh: 血液检查显示链甾醇水平升高。

e.en: The chemist explained {desmotropism} in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家解释了该化合物中的互变异构现象。

e.en: {Desmotropism} can change how a molecule reacts.
e.zh: 互变异构现象会改变分子的反应方式。

e.en: The molecule shows {desmotropy} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 该分子在特定条件下表现出互变异构。

e.en: Textbooks once used {desmotropy} for this tautomeric behavior.
e.zh: 教科书曾用互变异构来称呼这种异构行为。

e.en: The old manual included a chapter on {desmurgia}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册有一章介绍绷带包扎术。

e.en: Military medics learned {desmurgia} for field injuries.
e.zh: 军医学习绷带包扎术以处理野外伤情。

e.en: The wind blew {desolatingly} across the empty plain.
e.zh: 风令人凄凉地吹过空旷的平原。

e.en: Her voice was {desolatingly} calm after the news.
e.zh: 听到消息后，她的声音平静得令人心酸。

e.en: War became the great {desolator} of the region.
e.zh: 战争成了这个地区最大的破坏者。

e.en: The poem calls time a silent {desolator}.
e.zh: 诗中把时间称作沉默的毁灭者。

e.en: The storm had a {desolatory} effect on the village.
e.zh: 这场风暴对村庄造成了毁灭性的影响。

e.en: They crossed a {desolatory} stretch of abandoned land.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片荒凉的废弃土地。

e.en: Protein binding often requires partial {desolvation}.
e.zh: 蛋白质结合通常需要部分脱溶剂化。

e.en: The model estimates the energy cost of {desolvation}.
e.zh: 该模型估算脱溶剂化所需的能量成本。

desomorphine.t: 地索吗啡；强效阿片药物

e.en: {Desomorphine} is a powerful opioid drug.
e.zh: 地索吗啡是一种强效阿片类药物。

e.en: Doctors warned about the dangers of illicit {desomorphine}.
e.zh: 医生警告非法地索吗啡的危险。

e.en: The gas will {desorb} when the surface is heated.
e.zh: 表面受热时，气体会解吸出来。

e.en: Engineers tried to {desorb} pollutants from the filter.
e.zh: 工程师试图让污染物从滤材上脱附。

e.en: The {desorbed} molecules were measured by the detector.
e.zh: 检测器测量了已解吸的分子。

e.en: Water {desorbed} from the clay during heating.
e.zh: 加热过程中，水分从黏土中脱附出来。

e.en: Methanol served as the {desorbent} in the experiment.
e.zh: 甲醇在实验中充当解吸剂。

e.en: A stronger {desorbent} removed the trapped vapor.
e.zh: 更强的解吸剂除去了被困住的蒸气。

e.en: The heated surface was {desorbing} trapped gases.
e.zh: 受热表面正在释放被吸附的气体。

e.en: Scientists monitored {desorbing} ions from the material.
e.zh: 科学家监测从材料中脱附出来的离子。

e.en: The solvent {desorbs} slowly from the polymer film.
e.zh: 溶剂会从聚合物薄膜中慢慢脱附。

e.en: Carbon dioxide {desorbs} when pressure is reduced.
e.zh: 压力降低时，二氧化碳会解吸出来。

e.en: {Desosamine} is found in several macrolide antibiotics.
e.zh: 多种大环内酯类抗生素中含有地索糖胺。

e.en: The chemist modified the {desosamine} portion of the molecule.
e.zh: 化学家修改了分子中的地索糖胺部分。

e.en: The chemist measured {desoxidation} during the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家测量了反应过程中的脱氧作用。

e.en: Incomplete {desoxidation} left impurities in the metal.
e.zh: 脱氧不完全使金属中残留了杂质。

e.en: The alloy required a strong {desoxidizer} before casting.
e.zh: 这种合金在铸造前需要强效脱氧剂。

e.en: A suitable {desoxidizer} can remove excess oxygen.
e.zh: 合适的脱氧剂可以去除多余氧。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {desoxyadenosine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量脱氧腺苷。

e.en: Researchers compared {desoxyadenosine} with related nucleosides.
e.zh: 研究人员将脱氧腺苷与相关核苷进行了比较。

e.en: The gland produced excess {desoxycorticosterone}.
e.zh: 该腺体产生了过量的脱氧皮质酮。

e.en: Doctors monitored {desoxycorticosterone} levels in the patient.
e.zh: 医生监测了患者体内的脱氧皮质酮水平。

e.en: The report mentioned {desoxycortisone} as a steroid compound.
e.zh: 报告把脱氧可的松列为一种类固醇化合物。
