e.zh: 孩子们在房子后面的尘土堆旁玩耍。

e.en: The first edition has a rare {dust-jacket}.
e.zh: 这个初版本有一张罕见的书籍护封。

e.en: She removed the {dust-jacket} before reading.
e.zh: 她阅读前先取下了书的封套。

e.en: A {dust-laden} wind blew through the village.
e.zh: 一阵满是灰尘的风吹过村子。

e.en: Workers cleaned the {dust-laden} filters every week.
e.zh: 工人们每周清理那些积满灰尘的过滤器。

e.en: The {dust-man} collected ashes before dawn.
e.zh: 清晨前，那个清洁工收走了炉灰。

e.en: In the old story, a {dust-man} found the lost ring.
e.zh: 在那个老故事里，一名垃圾工找到了丢失的戒指。

e.en: The meeting ended after a minor {dust-up}.
e.zh: 会议在一场小争吵后结束了。

e.en: Their public {dust-up} embarrassed both campaigns.
e.zh: 他们公开的小冲突让两边的竞选团队都很尴尬。

e.en: A gray {dustball} rolled out from under the bed.
e.zh: 一团灰色的尘球从床底滚了出来。

e.en: The vacuum picked up every {dustball} in the corner.
e.zh: 吸尘器吸走了角落里的每一团灰尘。

e.en: Astronomers studied the dark {dustband} across the galaxy.
e.zh: 天文学家研究了横贯星系的暗色尘带。

e.en: The machine uses a {dustband} to seal the opening.
e.zh: 这台机器用一条防尘带封住开口。

e.en: The {dustbinman} emptied every bin before sunrise.
e.zh: 清洁工在日出前清空了每个垃圾桶。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {dustbinman} for years.
e.zh: 我祖父当了多年垃圾收集工人。

e.en: A single {dustbrand} glowed in the cold hearth.
e.zh: 冰冷的炉膛里有一块余烬还在发光。

e.en: He stirred the ash and found a {dustbrand}.
e.zh: 他拨开灰烬，发现了一块阴燃的木块。

e.en: The old {dustcart} rattled down the lane.
e.zh: 那辆旧垃圾车一路嘎吱作响地驶过小巷。

e.en: Workers loaded broken furniture onto the {dustcart}.
e.zh: 工人们把破家具装上清运垃圾的车。

e.en: Several {dustcarts} blocked the narrow street.
e.zh: 几辆垃圾车堵住了狭窄的街道。

e.en: The council bought new {dustcarts} for the district.
e.zh: 市政会为这个区购置了新的垃圾车。

e.en: She shook the {dustcloak} before entering the house.
e.zh: 她进屋前抖了抖那件防尘披风。

e.en: A faded {dustcloak} hung beside the stable door.
e.zh: 一件褪色的旧式外罩挂在马厩门旁。

e.en: The mechanic wore a grey {dustcoat} at work.
e.zh: 那名机械师上班时穿着一件灰色工作罩衣。

e.en: Her white {dustcoat} was covered with chalk marks.
e.zh: 她的白色防尘外衣上沾满了粉笔印。

e.en: Put the {dustcover} back on the printer.
e.zh: 把防尘罩重新盖到打印机上。

e.en: The novel still had its original {dustcover}.
e.zh: 那本小说还保留着原来的书籍护封。

e.en: Children searched the {dustheap} for useful scraps.
e.zh: 孩子们在垃圾堆里寻找有用的碎物。

e.en: The abandoned yard became a {dustheap} after years.
e.zh: 多年以后，那个废弃院子变成了一片尘土堆。

e.en: Rats moved between the {dustheaps} behind the market.
e.zh: 老鼠在市场后面的垃圾堆之间窜来窜去。

e.en: Old books lay in {dustheaps} across the attic.
e.zh: 旧书在阁楼各处积成了一堆堆尘土。

e.en: The attic was the {dustiest} room in the house.
e.zh: 阁楼是这所房子里灰尘最多的房间。

e.en: He chose the {dustiest} trail through the hills.
e.zh: 他选了山里尘土最重的那条小路。

dustily.t: 满是灰尘地；尘土飞扬地

e.en: The books sat {dustily} on the forgotten shelf.
e.zh: 那些书满是灰尘地放在被遗忘的书架上。

e.en: The cart rolled {dustily} across the dry field.
e.zh: 那辆车尘土飞扬地驶过干燥的田地。

e.en: The room's {dustiness} made her sneeze.
e.zh: 房间里灰尘太多，让她打起了喷嚏。

e.en: He disliked the {dustiness} of old archives.
e.zh: 他不喜欢旧档案室那种满是灰尘的状态。

e.en: The lab needs a {dustless} environment.
e.zh: 实验室需要一个无尘环境。

e.en: They bought {dustless} chalk for the classroom.
e.zh: 他们给教室买了不起灰的粉笔。

e.en: A {dustlike} powder covered the leaves.
e.zh: 叶子上覆盖着一层像灰尘的粉末。

e.en: The stone broke into {dustlike} fragments.
e.zh: 那块石头碎成了粉尘状的颗粒。

e.en: The unit called for a {dustoff} after the attack.
e.zh: 袭击后，部队请求直升机医疗后送。

e.en: A quick {dustoff} saved the wounded soldier.
e.zh: 一次迅速的撤离救下了那名受伤士兵。

e.en: Keep the camera in a {dustproof} case.
e.zh: 把相机放在防尘盒里。

e.en: The factory installed {dustproof} doors.
e.zh: 工厂安装了不透灰尘的门。

e.en: She covered the sofa with a {dustsheet}.
e.zh: 她用防尘布把沙发盖了起来。

e.en: Paint splashed onto the old {dustsheet}.
e.zh: 油漆溅到了那块旧遮尘罩布上。

e.en: They spread {dustsheets} before painting the ceiling.
e.zh: 他们刷天花板前铺好了防尘布。

e.en: White {dustsheets} covered the furniture all winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天，家具都盖着白色遮尘罩布。

e.en: The meeting ended in a political {dustup}.
e.zh: 会议最后演变成一场政治争吵。

e.en: Their {dustup} over money was soon forgotten.
e.zh: 他们因钱发生的小冲突很快就被忘了。

dutchy.t: 带荷兰风格的；像荷兰人的

e.en: The room had a slightly {dutchy} charm.
e.zh: 这个房间带着一点荷兰风格的魅力。

e.en: His accent sounded oddly {dutchy} to me.
e.zh: 在我听来，他的口音有点像荷兰人的。

e.en: The {duteous} son visited his mother daily.
e.zh: 那个尽职的儿子每天都去看望母亲。

e.en: She gave a {duteous} reply to the king.
e.zh: 她向国王作出了恭顺的回答。

e.en: The chemist analyzed {dvitellurium} compounds in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家分析了样品中的二碲化物。

e.en: Older papers sometimes use {dvitellurium} for a tellurium-rich substance.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用二碲化物指含碲较多的物质。

e.en: Medieval healers feared the dark power of {dwale}.
e.zh: 中世纪医者惧怕颠茄那种阴暗的药力。

e.en: The old poem mentions {dwale} as a sleep-inducing drink.
e.zh: 那首古诗把麻醉药写成一种催眠饮品。

e.en: The carpenter fitted a {dwang} between the wall studs.
e.zh: 木匠在墙柱之间装了一根横撑。

e.en: A loose {dwang} made the partition rattle in the wind.
e.zh: 一根松动的短支柱让隔墙在风中作响。

e.en: The shrub had a {dwarflike} shape after years of pruning.
e.zh: 多年修剪后，这灌木呈现出矮小的形态。

e.en: The tale describes a {dwarflike} figure guarding the cave.
e.zh: 故事描写了一个像侏儒的人影守着洞口。

e.en: The old apple tree looked {dwarfy} but still bore fruit.
e.zh: 那棵老苹果树看着矮小畸形，却仍然结果。

e.en: He drew a {dwarfy} character with huge boots.
e.zh: 他画了一个侏儒般的人物，穿着巨大的靴子。

dweebish.t: 书呆子气的；怪 nerd 的

e.en: His {dweebish} jokes amused the whole programming team.
e.zh: 他那些书呆子气的笑话逗乐了整个编程团队。

e.en: She wore the {dweebish} sweater proudly at the convention.
e.zh: 她在大会上自豪地穿着那件怪 nerd 的毛衣。

e.en: The cave became their {dwelling-place} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，那个洞穴成了他们的栖身之处。

e.en: Every bird needs a safe {dwelling-place} for its young.
e.zh: 每只鸟都需要一个安全的住所来养育幼鸟。

e.en: The {dwindlement} of supplies worried the expedition leader.
e.zh: 补给不断减少让探险队长很担心。

e.en: Critics noted the slow {dwindlement} of local customs.
e.zh: 评论者注意到当地习俗在慢慢消退。

e.en: Without rain, the young plants began to {dwine}.
e.zh: 没有雨水，幼苗开始枯萎。

e.en: The old dialect says people may {dwine} from grief.
e.zh: 这种古老方言说人可能因悲伤而衰弱。

e.en: The {dwining} flowers leaned over the dry path.
e.zh: 枯萎的花朵垂向干燥的小路。

e.en: He spoke of a {dwining} strength after the fever.
e.zh: 他说发烧之后体力正在衰弱。

e.en: The data were analyzed {dyadically} rather than individually.
e.zh: 这些数据是按成对关系分析的，而不是按个人分析。

e.en: Therapists sometimes observe partners {dyadically} during conflict.
e.zh: 治疗师有时会在冲突中观察伴侣的二元互动。

e.en: The colony experimented with {dyarchy} for several years.
e.zh: 这个殖民地曾试行双重统治数年。

e.en: Historians debate whether {dyarchy} weakened the old kingdom.
e.zh: 历史学家争论二头政治是否削弱了旧王国。

e.en: The spray contains {dyclonine} to numb the throat.
e.zh: 这种喷雾含有达克罗宁，用来麻痹喉咙。

e.en: Ask a doctor before using {dyclonine} on irritated skin.
e.zh: 在受刺激的皮肤上使用达克罗宁前，请先咨询医生。

e.en: The old {dye-house} stood beside the canal.
e.zh: 那座老染坊坐落在运河旁。

e.en: Workers carried wet cloth from the {dye-house}.
e.zh: 工人们从染色车间搬出湿布。

e.en: The {dye-works} supplied fabric mills across the region.
e.zh: 这家染色厂为全地区的织布厂供货。

e.en: Smoke from the old {dye-works} stained nearby walls.
e.zh: 旧染料厂冒出的烟熏黑了附近的墙。

e.en: Cotton's {dyeability} depends on the fiber treatment.
e.zh: 棉花的可染性取决于纤维处理方式。

e.en: The lab tested the {dyeability} of the new synthetic yarn.
e.zh: 实验室测试了这种新合成纱线的染色性能。

e.en: This fabric is {dyeable} after a simple prewash.
e.zh: 这种布料简单预洗后就可以染色。

e.en: Choose {dyeable} shoes if you need an exact color match.
e.zh: 如果需要颜色完全匹配，就选择可染色的鞋。

e.en: He is a {dyed-in-the-wool} supporter of the club.
e.zh: 他是这个俱乐部根深蒂固的支持者。

e.en: The policy angered even {dyed-in-the-wool} conservatives.
e.zh: 这项政策甚至激怒了那些彻底的保守派。

e.en: The {dyehouse} smelled strongly of indigo and steam.
e.zh: 染坊里弥漫着靛蓝和蒸汽的浓烈气味。

e.en: She managed a modern {dyehouse} for wool fabrics.
e.zh: 她管理一家处理羊毛织物的现代染色车间。

e.en: The architect marked changes on the {dyeline}.
e.zh: 建筑师在重氮复印图上标出了修改处。

e.en: Before digital files, builders often worked from a {dyeline}.
e.zh: 在数字文件普及前，建筑工人常按蓝图样张施工。

e.en: She {duteously} recorded every complaint in the log.
e.zh: 她尽职地把每一条投诉都记进日志。

e.en: The child {duteously} bowed when his grandmother entered.
e.zh: 祖母进来时，孩子恭顺地鞠了一躬。

e.en: His {duteousness} impressed the old judge.
e.zh: 他的尽职让那位老法官很受触动。

e.en: The poem praises filial {duteousness} above personal desire.
e.zh: 这首诗把孝顺恭敬看得高于个人愿望。

e.en: The officer marked the watches as {dutiable} goods.
e.zh: 海关人员把这些手表标为须缴关税的货物。

e.en: Alcohol above the allowance is usually {dutiable}.
e.zh: 超过免税额度的酒类通常需要纳税。

e.en: The merchant complained that heavily {dutied} imports were hard to sell.
e.zh: 商人抱怨说，高额征税的进口货很难销售。

e.en: She felt herself {dutied} to protect the family name.
e.zh: 她觉得自己有责任维护家族名声。

e.en: Doctors are {duty-bound} to protect patient confidentiality.
e.zh: 医生有义务保护病人的隐私。

e.en: He felt {duty-bound} to report the missing funds.
e.zh: 他觉得自己责无旁贷，必须报告资金失踪一事。

e.en: The shop sells only {duty-paid} cigarettes.
e.zh: 这家店只出售已经完税的香烟。

e.en: Keep the receipt to prove the wine is {duty-paid}.
e.zh: 请保留收据，以证明这瓶酒已经缴税。

duumvir.t: 古罗马二人执政官之一

e.en: A {duumvir} presided over the local court.
e.zh: 一名二人执政官主持了当地法庭。

e.en: The inscription names him as a {duumvir} of the colony.
e.zh: 碑文称他为该殖民地的二人执政官之一。

e.en: The tablet records a {duumviral} decree from the town council.
e.zh: 这块铭牌记录了市政会的一项二人执政官法令。

e.en: He sought {duumviral} office after years of service.
e.zh: 多年任职后，他谋求二人执政官职位。

duumvirate.t: 二人共同执政；二人执政职位

e.en: The city was governed by a {duumvirate} for one year.
e.zh: 这座城市由二人执政团治理了一年。

e.en: His election to the {duumvirate} raised his family status.
e.zh: 他当选二人执政官后，家族地位随之提升。

e.en: The {duumviri} supervised repairs to the baths.
e.zh: 这些二人执政官监督了浴场的修缮。

e.en: Inscriptions often list the {duumviri} by name.
e.zh: 碑文常常逐名列出二人执政官。

e.en: The two {duumvirs} signed the public contract.
e.zh: 两位二人执政官签署了公共合同。

e.en: Local {duumvirs} arranged the festival games.
e.zh: 当地的二人执政官安排了节庆竞赛。

e.en: She pulled the {duvay} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把羽绒被拉到肩上。

e.en: The guest room had a warm {duvay} on the bed.
e.zh: 客房的床上铺着一条暖和的羽绒被。

e.en: The costume was made from soft black {duvetine}.
e.zh: 这套戏服是用柔软的黑色绒面布做成的。

e.en: Technicians hung {duvetine} to block the stray light.
e.zh: 技术人员挂起遮光绒布来挡住杂光。

e.en: The photographer used {duvetyn} behind the subject.
e.zh: 摄影师在被摄者身后用了遮光绒布。

e.en: Her jacket had panels of faded {duvetyn}.
e.zh: 她的夹克上有几片褪色的绒面棉布。

e.en: The stage crew covered the rig with {duvetyne}.
e.zh: 舞台工作人员用遮光绒布盖住了设备架。

e.en: A strip of {duvetyne} softened the edge of the display.
e.zh: 一条绒面布让展台边缘显得柔和些。

e.en: She was named {dux} of the school.
e.zh: 她被评为全校优等生。

e.en: The late Roman {dux} commanded troops on the frontier.
e.zh: 这位晚期罗马将领指挥边境部队。

e.en: A shy {duyker} slipped through the undergrowth.
e.zh: 一只胆小的小羚羊穿过了灌木丛。

e.en: The guide pointed out fresh {duyker} tracks near the stream.
e.zh: 向导指出溪边有新鲜的小羚羊足迹。

e.en: The hunter mistook the {duykerbok} for a young antelope.
e.zh: 猎人把那只小羚羊误认为幼年羚羊。

e.en: A {duykerbok} can disappear quickly in thick brush.
e.zh: 小羚羊能很快消失在浓密灌木中。

e.en: Sanskrit grammar calls this compound a {dvandva}.
e.zh: 梵语语法把这种复合词称为并列复合词。

e.en: The phrase works like a {dvandva}, joining two equal nouns.
e.zh: 这个短语像并列复合词一样，把两个并列名词连在一起。

dvicesium.t: 旧称未发现的第87号元素

e.en: Chemists once used {dvicesium} for a predicted element.
e.zh: 化学家曾用旧称dvicesium指一种预测中的元素。

e.en: The name {dvicesium} disappeared after francium was identified.
e.zh: 钫被确认后，dvicesium这个名称便不再使用。

dvimanganese.t: 旧称未发现的第75号元素

e.en: Mendeleev predicted {dvimanganese} before rhenium was discovered.
e.zh: 门捷列夫在铼被发现前预测过这种旧称为dvimanganese的元素。

e.en: The textbook notes that {dvimanganese} later corresponded to rhenium.
e.zh: 教材指出，dvimanganese这个旧称后来对应的是铼。

e.en: The hillside was bright with {dyer's-broom} in June.
e.zh: 六月的山坡上开满染料木，颜色十分明亮。

e.en: Old dyers used {dyer's-broom} to make yellow dye.
e.zh: 过去的染工用染料木制作黄色染料。

e.en: The villagers gathered {dyeweed} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 村民们在河岸附近采集可制染料的野草。

e.en: Her notebook listed {dyeweed} among useful local plants.
e.zh: 她的笔记把染料草列为当地有用植物之一。

e.en: The merchant sold {dyewood} to textile workshops.
e.zh: 商人把染料木材卖给纺织作坊。

e.en: Some tropical trees provide valuable {dyewood}.
e.zh: 一些热带树木能提供珍贵的染料木。

e.en: The old {dyeworks} stood beside the canal.
e.zh: 那座旧染坊坐落在运河旁边。

e.en: Smoke from the {dyeworks} stained the nearby walls.
e.zh: 染料工厂冒出的烟把附近墙面熏脏了。

e.en: A {dykey} ridge kept the field from flooding.
e.zh: 一道像堤坝的土脊防止田地被淹。

e.en: The marsh had a {dykey} edge along the road.
e.zh: 沼泽靠路的一边有筑堤似的边缘。

e.en: The specimen was described as {dyktyonite} in the catalogue.
e.zh: 目录中把这件标本描述为网纹状化石材料。

e.en: A thin layer of {dyktyonite} crossed the rock surface.
e.zh: 岩石表面横贯着一层薄薄的网纹状化石质。

e.en: The architect admired the {dymaxion} approach to housing.
e.zh: 那位建筑师欣赏富勒式的高效住宅设计理念。

e.en: A {dymaxion} map shows the world with unusual cuts.
e.zh: 富勒式地图用不寻常的切分方式呈现世界。

dymixal.t: 双重混合的；复合混合的

e.en: The paper used {dymixal} to describe two mixed forms.
e.zh: 论文用双重混合的这个词来描述两种混合形态。

e.en: Her theory proposed a {dymixal} origin for the pattern.
e.zh: 她的理论认为这种图案有复合混合的来源。

e.en: The physicist used {dynam} in an older calculation.
e.zh: 那位物理学家在一项较旧的计算中使用了动力单位。

e.en: A single {dynam} was too small for the experiment.
e.zh: 一个动力单位对这次实验来说太小了。

e.en: The engineer checked the load with a {dynameter}.
e.zh: 工程师用测力计检查了负载。

e.en: The optician adjusted the {dynameter} before testing the lens.
e.zh: 验光师在检测镜片前调好了放大率测量器。

e.en: The lab recorded {dynametrical} data from the machine.
e.zh: 实验室记录了这台机器的动力测量数据。

e.en: A {dynametrical} method gave more precise results.
e.zh: 一种测力方法给出了更精确的结果。

e.en: The {dynamicist} modeled the motion of the stars.
e.zh: 那位动力学家建立了恒星运动模型。

e.en: As a social {dynamicist}, she studied group change.
e.zh: 作为社会动力论者，她研究群体变化。

e.en: The philosopher was known as a strict {dynamist}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家以严格的动力论者著称。

e.en: A {dynamist} explanation focused on forces, not substances.
e.zh: 动力论解释关注力，而不是实体。

e.en: His essay offered a {dynamistic} view of nature.
e.zh: 他的文章提出了一种动力论的自然观。

e.en: The doctrine sounded too {dynamistic} for her teacher.
e.zh: 在她老师听来，这种学说过于力本论化。

e.en: The newspaper called the bomber a {dynamitard}.
e.zh: 报纸把那名投弹者称为炸药恐怖分子。

e.en: Police feared another {dynamitard} might attack the station.
e.zh: 警方担心另一名爆破者可能袭击车站。

e.en: A {dynamite-laden} truck was found near the bridge.
e.zh: 桥附近发现了一辆装满炸药的卡车。

e.en: The miners avoided the {dynamite-laden} cart.
e.zh: 矿工们避开了那辆装有炸药的矿车。

e.en: The crew prepared a {dynamitic} charge for the tunnel.
e.zh: 施工队为隧道准备了一包炸药装药。

e.en: His speech had a {dynamitic} effect on the crowd.
e.zh: 他的演讲对人群产生了爆炸性的影响。

e.en: The pamphlet condemned {dynamitism} as political violence.
e.zh: 这本小册子谴责炸药主义是一种政治暴力。

e.en: Early miners discussed {dynamitism} in safety meetings.
e.zh: 早期矿工在安全会议上讨论炸药使用问题。

e.en: The lab installed a {dynamitron} for radiation studies.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一台高压粒子加速器用于辐射研究。

e.en: A technician monitored the {dynamitron} during the test.
e.zh: 测试期间，一名技术员监控着那台高压加速器。

e.en: The coach tried to {dynamize} the tired team.
e.zh: 教练试图让疲惫的队伍重新有活力。

e.en: Homeopaths claim shaking can {dynamize} a solution.
e.zh: 顺势疗法者声称摇动能增强溶液效力。

dynamoelectric.t: 发电机电的；电动发电的

e.en: The museum displayed an early {dynamoelectric} machine.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期发电机电设备。

e.en: A {dynamoelectric} system powered the lamps downstairs.
e.zh: 一套电动发电系统为楼下的灯供电。

dynamometamorphism.t: 动力变质作用；构造变质作用

e.en: The schist shows signs of {dynamometamorphism} along the fault zone.
e.zh: 这片片岩在断层带附近显示出动力变质作用的迹象。

e.en: Geologists linked the folded rocks to intense {dynamometamorphism}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这些褶皱岩石与强烈的构造变质作用联系起来。

dynamometric.t: 测力的；与测力计有关的

e.en: The clinic used a {dynamometric} test to assess grip strength.
e.zh: 诊所用测力测试来评估握力。

e.en: She compared the athletes' {dynamometric} results after training.
e.zh: 她比较了运动员训练后的测力结果。

e.en: The paper describes a {dynamometrical} method for measuring muscle fatigue.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了一种测量肌肉疲劳的测力方法。

e.en: His {dynamometrical} readings improved after rehabilitation.
e.zh: 康复后，他的测力读数有所提高。

e.en: Handheld {dynamometry} can track recovery after a wrist injury.
e.zh: 手持测力法可以追踪手腕受伤后的恢复情况。

e.en: The study used {dynamometry} to measure knee strength.
e.zh: 这项研究用肌力测量来评估膝部力量。

e.en: The mechanic added {dynamooil} to the old generator.
e.zh: 机械师给那台旧发电机加了发电机油。

e.en: A tin of {dynamooil} sat beside the workshop bench.
e.zh: 一罐旧式机油放在工坊工作台旁。

dynamostatic.t: 动静态的；力平衡相关的

e.en: The engineer proposed a {dynamostatic} model of the bridge load.
e.zh: 工程师提出了一个桥梁载荷的动静态模型。

e.en: Their analysis treated the joint as a {dynamostatic} system.
e.zh: 他们的分析把这个接头视为一个力平衡系统。

e.en: The radio set needed a {dynamotor} to supply high voltage.
e.zh: 这台无线电设备需要一台电动发电机来提供高压。

e.en: An old aircraft {dynamotor} was restored for the museum display.
e.zh: 一台旧飞机变流机被修复后用于博物馆展览。

e.en: The historian traced a {dynastical} struggle for the throne.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了一场围绕王位的王朝斗争。

e.en: Their marriage had clear {dynastical} importance.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻显然具有王朝层面的重要性。

dynastically.t: 按王朝方式；从王朝角度

e.en: The empire was organized {dynastically} around one ruling family.
e.zh: 这个帝国以一个统治家族为中心按王朝方式组织起来。

e.en: He viewed the succession {dynastically}, not democratically.
e.zh: 他从王朝角度而非民主角度看待继承问题。

dynasticism.t: 王朝主义；世袭统治观念

e.en: The revolution rejected {dynasticism} and hereditary privilege.
e.zh: 这场革命反对王朝主义和世袭特权。

e.en: Critics saw the appointment as modern {dynasticism}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项任命是现代世袭统治观念的体现。

e.en: The old oscillator circuit used a {dynatron}.
e.zh: 这个旧式振荡电路使用了负阻电子管。

e.en: A {dynatron} can exhibit negative resistance under certain conditions.
e.zh: 达纳管在特定条件下会表现出负电阻。

dyne.t: 达因；厘米克秒制力单位

e.en: One {dyne} is a very small unit of force.
e.zh: 一达因是一个很小的力单位。

e.en: The surface tension was reported in {dynes} per centimeter.
e.zh: 表面张力以每厘米达因数报告。

e.en: The collector found a rare {dynectron} in the radio cabinet.
e.zh: 收藏者在无线电机柜里发现了一只罕见的旧式电子管。

e.en: A {dynectron} was once used in specialized electronic circuits.
e.zh: 达内克管曾用于一些专门的电子电路。

dynein.t: 动力蛋白；细胞马达蛋白

e.en: The cell uses {dynein} to move cargo along microtubules.
e.zh: 细胞利用动力蛋白沿微管运输货物。

e.en: Defects in {dynein} can disrupt cilia movement.
e.zh: 动力蛋白缺陷可能扰乱纤毛运动。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {dynemeter} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了测力计。

e.en: A simple {dynemeter} measured the pull of the spring.
e.zh: 一个简单的力计测出了弹簧的拉力。

e.en: The force was only a few {dynes}.
e.zh: 这个力只有几个达因。

e.en: Surface tension is often expressed in {dynes} per centimeter.
e.zh: 表面张力常用每厘米达因表示。

e.en: The chapter introduced a {dynic} view of motion.
e.zh: 这一章介绍了一种从力出发理解运动的观点。

e.en: His theory emphasized the {dynic} relations between bodies.
e.zh: 他的理论强调物体之间的动力学关系。

e.en: Each {dynode} releases more electrons in the photomultiplier tube.
e.zh: 光电倍增管中的每个倍增电极都会释放更多电子。

e.en: The detector failed because one {dynode} was damaged.
e.zh: 探测器失灵是因为一个打拿极受损。

e.en: The engineer was {dynomizing} the small workshop with new machines.
e.zh: 工程师正用新机器让这个小工坊动力化。

e.en: The campaign focused on {dynomizing} rural production.
e.zh: 这项运动侧重于增强农村生产的动力。

e.en: The prototype used a compact {dynopeller} for propulsion.
e.zh: 这台原型机使用紧凑的动力螺旋桨推进。

e.en: A damaged {dynopeller} reduced the boat's speed.
e.zh: 受损的推进装置降低了船速。

dyon.t: 双荷粒子；理论物理粒子

e.en: A {dyon} carries both electric and magnetic charge.
e.zh: 双荷粒子同时带有电荷和磁荷。

e.en: The physicist discussed the {dyon} in a gauge theory seminar.
e.zh: 那位物理学家在规范理论研讨会上讨论了双荷粒子。

dyotron.t: 二极电子管；旧式真空管

e.en: The receiver used a {dyotron} in its detector stage.
e.zh: 这台接收机在检波级使用了二极电子管。

e.en: A spare {dyotron} was kept in the repair kit.
e.zh: 维修包里备有一只旧式真空管。

e.en: The plumber installed a {dypass} around the blocked valve.
e.zh: 水管工在堵塞的阀门旁安装了旁通管路。

e.en: Traffic used a temporary {dypass} during the roadworks.
e.zh: 道路施工期间，车辆走临时绕路通道。

dypnone.t: 二苯基丁烯酮；有机化合物

e.en: The lab synthesized {dypnone} for the reaction study.
e.zh: 实验室合成了二苯基丁烯酮用于反应研究。

e.en: Crystals of {dypnone} formed as the solution cooled.
e.zh: 溶液冷却时形成了二苯基丁烯酮晶体。

dysacousia.t: 听觉障碍；听觉异常感知

e.en: The patient reported {dysacousia} after the ear infection.
e.zh: 那名患者在耳部感染后说自己出现了听觉异常。

e.en: Her {dysacousia} made ordinary sounds seem distorted.
e.zh: 她的听觉障碍让普通声音听起来也变形了。

e.en: The neurologist noted {dysaesthesia} in both feet.
e.zh: 神经科医生发现她双脚都有感觉异常。

e.en: After surgery, mild {dysaesthesia} persisted around the scar.
e.zh: 手术后，疤痕周围仍有轻微的感觉异常。

e.en: The old report mentioned {dysalbumose} in the sample.
e.zh: 那份旧报告提到样本中有异常白蛋白胨。

e.en: Researchers once classified the residue as {dysalbumose}.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把这种残留物归为异常白蛋白胨。

e.en: The collection included a small piece of {dysanalite}.
e.zh: 这批藏品里有一小块钙钛矿类矿物。

e.en: Under magnification, {dysanalite} showed a dark metallic luster.
e.zh: 放大观察时，钙钛矿类矿物呈现深色金属光泽。

e.en: The injury caused {dysaphia} in his fingertips.
e.zh: 这次受伤导致他的指尖触觉减退。

e.en: Doctors tested for {dysaphia} with light pressure.
e.zh: 医生用轻微按压来检查是否有触觉障碍。

e.en: The therapist described his reaction as {dysaptation}.
e.zh: 治疗师把他的反应描述为适应不良。

e.en: Severe workplace stress may lead to {dysaptation}.
e.zh: 严重的职场压力可能导致调适障碍。

e.en: The stroke left him with mild {dysarthria}.
e.zh: 中风后他留下了轻度构音障碍。

e.en: Her {dysarthria} improved with speech therapy.
e.zh: 经过语言治疗，她说话不清的情况有所改善。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {dysautonomia} after months of dizziness.
e.zh: 她头晕了几个月后被诊断为自主神经功能失调。

e.en: Patients with {dysautonomia} may faint when standing.
e.zh: 自主神经功能失调患者站立时可能会晕倒。

e.en: Divers are trained to recognize signs of {dysbarism}.
e.zh: 潜水员会接受训练，识别气压病的迹象。

e.en: Rapid ascent can cause {dysbarism} in aviators.
e.zh: 快速上升可能使飞行人员出现气压相关损伤。

e.en: The examination revealed {dysbasia} and poor balance.
e.zh: 检查发现他有步行困难和平衡能力差的问题。

e.en: Her {dysbasia} worsened on uneven ground.
e.zh: 在不平的地面上，她的步态障碍更加明显。

dyscalculia.t: 计算障碍；数学学习困难

e.en: Children with {dyscalculia} may struggle with simple sums.
e.zh: 有计算障碍的孩子可能连简单加法也觉得吃力。

e.en: Her {dyscalculia} was not caused by poor teaching.
e.zh: 她的数学学习困难并不是教学不好造成的。

e.en: The historian called the scene {dyschronous} and misleading.
e.zh: 历史学家认为这个场景时间错位，容易误导人。

e.en: Their {dyschronous} responses made coordination difficult.
e.zh: 他们不同步的反应让协调变得困难。

e.en: The clinic treated {dyscoimesis} with behavioral methods.
e.zh: 这家诊所用行为疗法治疗睡眠障碍。

e.en: Chronic pain often brings {dyscoimesis} at night.
e.zh: 慢性疼痛常会在夜间带来入睡困难。

e.en: The physician suspected a blood {dyscrasia}.
e.zh: 医生怀疑这是某种血液恶病质。

e.en: Old medical texts used {dyscrasia} for bodily imbalance.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用体液失调来指身体内部失衡。

e.en: The mineral cabinet contained a specimen of {dyscrasite}.
e.zh: 矿物柜里有一件辉锑银矿标本。

e.en: Fresh {dyscrasite} can show a pale metallic sheen.
e.zh: 新鲜的辉锑银矿会呈现浅色金属光泽。

e.en: The camp reported several {dysenteric} patients.
e.zh: 营地报告有几名痢疾患者。

e.en: Contaminated water caused a {dysenteric} outbreak.
e.zh: 受污染的水引发了一场痢疾暴发。

e.en: Genetic testing confirmed {dysfibrinogenemia} in the family.
e.zh: 基因检测确认这个家族有纤维蛋白原异常血症。

e.en: Some people with {dysfibrinogenemia} develop abnormal clotting.
e.zh: 有些纤维蛋白原异常血症患者会出现凝血异常。

e.en: The child was evaluated for {dysgammaglobulinemia}.
e.zh: 医生对这个孩子进行了丙种球蛋白异常血症评估。

e.en: Recurrent infections can suggest {dysgammaglobulinemia}.
e.zh: 反复感染可能提示存在丙种球蛋白异常血症。

e.en: The scan showed renal {dysgenesis}.
e.zh: 扫描显示有肾脏发育异常。

e.en: Gonadal {dysgenesis} may affect puberty.
e.zh: 性腺发育不全可能影响青春期发育。

dysgenic.t: 导致遗传退化的；劣生的

e.en: He criticized the theory as {dysgenic} and biased.
e.zh: 他批评这一理论带有劣生观念和偏见。

e.en: The policy was attacked for its {dysgenic} assumptions.
e.zh: 这项政策因其导致遗传退化的假设而受到抨击。

e.en: The lecture examined the history of {dysgenics}.
e.zh: 这场讲座考察了劣生学的历史。

e.en: Modern scholars reject {dysgenics} as a social doctrine.
e.zh: 现代学者把劣生学作为社会学说加以否定。

e.en: His {dysgraphia} made handwritten exams difficult.
e.zh: 他的书写障碍让手写考试变得很困难。

e.en: Occupational therapy helped her manage {dysgraphia}.
e.zh: 作业治疗帮助她应对写字困难。

e.en: The specialist considered {dyshypophysia} after hormone tests.
e.zh: 激素检测后，专家考虑可能是垂体功能障碍。

e.en: Untreated {dyshypophysia} can affect growth and metabolism.
e.zh: 未治疗的垂体功能障碍会影响生长和代谢。

e.en: The medicine reduced tremor but caused {dyskinesia}.
e.zh: 这种药减轻了震颤，却引起了不自主运动。

e.en: Facial {dyskinesia} appeared after years of treatment.
e.zh: 多年治疗后出现了面部运动障碍。

dyslectic.t: 诵读困难的；阅读障碍的

e.en: The teacher adapted materials for {dyslectic} students.
e.zh: 老师为有阅读障碍的学生调整了材料。

e.en: A {dyslectic} reader may reverse letters while reading.
e.zh: 有诵读困难的读者阅读时可能会把字母看反。

dyslipoproteinemia.t: 脂蛋白异常血症；脂蛋白代谢紊乱

e.en: The specialist diagnosed {dyslipoproteinemia} after repeated blood tests.
e.zh: 反复验血后，专科医生诊断为脂蛋白异常血症。

e.en: Untreated {dyslipoproteinemia} can raise the risk of early heart disease.
e.zh: 未经治疗的脂蛋白代谢紊乱会增加早发心脏病风险。

dyslogia.t: 言语表达障碍；思维性语言紊乱

e.en: The neurologist noted mild {dyslogia} during the examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在检查中注意到轻度言语表达障碍。

e.en: His {dyslogia} made complex explanations hard to follow.
e.zh: 他的思维性语言紊乱让复杂说明很难听懂。

e.en: The critic used a {dyslogistic} label for the policy.
e.zh: 那位评论家用带有贬损意味的词来称呼这项政策。

e.en: A {dyslogistic} description can reveal the writer's bias.
e.zh: 带责难意味的描述可能暴露作者的偏见。

e.en: The report described the group {dyslogistically} as extremists.
e.zh: 报告以贬损方式把这个团体称为极端分子。

e.en: She spoke {dyslogistically} of reforms she disliked.
e.zh: 她带着责难口吻谈到自己不喜欢的改革。

dysmelia.t: 肢体发育畸形；肢体缺损

e.en: The child was born with {dysmelia} affecting one arm.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时一只手臂有肢体发育畸形。

e.en: Modern prosthetics can help people with {dysmelia} gain independence.
e.zh: 现代假肢能帮助肢体缺损者提高独立生活能力。

e.en: She missed school because of severe {dysmenorrhea}.
e.zh: 她因严重痛经而缺课。

e.en: Exercise may ease mild {dysmenorrhea} for some patients.
e.zh: 运动可能会缓解部分患者的轻度月经疼痛。

e.en: She reported {dysmenorrheic} cramps every month.
e.zh: 她说自己每个月都有痛经性痉挛。

e.en: The clinic offers treatment for {dysmenorrheic} symptoms.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供痛经相关症状的治疗。

e.en: The British leaflet explains common causes of {dysmenorrhoea}.
e.zh: 这份英国宣传单解释了痛经的常见原因。

e.en: Her {dysmenorrhoea} improved after medical treatment.
e.zh: 经过医学治疗后，她的月经疼痛有所改善。

dysmetria.t: 辨距不良；运动测距障碍

e.en: The finger-to-nose test showed clear {dysmetria}.
e.zh: 指鼻试验显示出明显的运动测距障碍。

e.en: Cerebellar damage can cause {dysmetria} in simple movements.
e.zh: 小脑损伤会导致简单动作中的辨距不良。

dysmetropsia.t: 视物大小距离错觉；视距障碍

e.en: During the migraine, she experienced {dysmetropsia} and dizziness.
e.zh: 偏头痛发作时，她出现视物大小距离错觉和头晕。

e.en: The patient described {dysmetropsia} as rooms seeming suddenly larger.
e.zh: 患者把视距障碍描述为房间突然显得更大。

dysmorphophobia.t: 体貌恐惧症；容貌焦虑症

e.en: His {dysmorphophobia} made mirrors extremely distressing.
e.zh: 他的体貌恐惧症让照镜子变得极其痛苦。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage {dysmorphophobia} more realistically.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助她更现实地应对容貌焦虑症。

e.en: The syndrome is associated with facial {dysmorphosis}.
e.zh: 这种综合征与面部形态异常有关。

e.en: Prenatal scans detected possible limb {dysmorphosis}.
e.zh: 产前扫描发现了可能的肢体发育畸形。

e.en: After the stroke, he had persistent {dysnomia}.
e.zh: 中风后，他一直有命名困难。

e.en: Mild {dysnomia} can make familiar names hard to recall.
e.zh: 轻度找词障碍会让人难以想起熟悉的名字。

dysnusia.t: 智力障碍；思维功能紊乱

e.en: The old case notes used {dysnusia} for impaired reasoning.
e.zh: 旧病例记录用dysnusia来指推理能力受损。

e.en: Doctors no longer commonly use {dysnusia} in modern reports.
e.zh: 现代报告中医生已不常使用智力障碍这个旧术语。

e.en: The dentist suspected {dysodontiasis} in the teenager's molars.
e.zh: 牙医怀疑这名青少年的臼齿存在出牙异常。

e.en: Painful {dysodontiasis} may require orthodontic assessment.
e.zh: 疼痛性的牙萌出困难可能需要正畸评估。

dysoria.t: 气味感知障碍；嗅觉异常

e.en: The infection left him with temporary {dysoria}.
e.zh: 感染使他暂时出现气味感知障碍。

e.en: Patients with {dysoria} may misidentify familiar smells.
e.zh: 有嗅觉异常的患者可能会误认熟悉的气味。

dysostosis.t: 骨发育不良；骨形成异常

e.en: X-rays revealed {dysostosis} in several facial bones.
e.zh: X光显示多块面骨存在骨发育不良。

e.en: Some inherited disorders cause {dysostosis} during childhood.
e.zh: 一些遗传性疾病会在儿童期导致骨形成异常。

e.en: Blood calcium changes suggested possible {dysparathyroidism}.
e.zh: 血钙变化提示可能存在甲状旁腺功能异常。

e.en: The endocrinologist monitored {dysparathyroidism} after surgery.
e.zh: 内分泌科医生在手术后监测甲状旁腺功能异常。

e.en: She sought medical advice for persistent {dyspareunia}.
e.zh: 她因持续性交疼痛而寻求医疗建议。

e.en: Postpartum {dyspareunia} can have physical and emotional causes.
e.zh: 产后性交痛可能有身体和情绪两方面原因。

e.en: His {dyspathy} toward crowds limited his social life.
e.zh: 他对人群的病态反感限制了社交生活。

e.en: The therapist distinguished {dyspathy} from ordinary dislike.
e.zh: 治疗师把异常厌恶与普通不喜欢区分开来。

e.en: The patient described burning {dyspepsodynia} after meals.
e.zh: 患者描述饭后有灼烧样的消化不良性疼痛。

e.en: Chronic {dyspepsodynia} should be evaluated by a doctor.
e.zh: 慢性胃痛应由医生评估。

e.en: Rich food often gave him {dyspepsy} at night.
e.zh: 油腻食物常让他夜里消化不良。

e.en: The medicine reduced her {dyspepsy} within a week.
e.zh: 这种药在一周内减轻了她的胃部不适。

e.en: He complained {dyspeptically} about the heavy dinner.
e.zh: 他因那顿油腻晚餐而消化不良似地抱怨。

e.en: The columnist wrote {dyspeptically} about modern politics.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家以不满的口吻写现代政治。

e.en: The stroke caused partial {dysphasia}.
e.zh: 中风造成了部分语言障碍。

e.en: Speech therapy helped improve her {dysphasia}.
e.zh: 语言治疗帮助改善了她的失语症。

e.en: The nurse used pictures with the {dysphasic} patient.
e.zh: 护士用图片与这名语言障碍患者交流。

e.en: A {dysphasic} episode may follow certain brain injuries.
e.zh: 某些脑损伤后可能出现失语症发作。

dysphemism.t: 粗直贬称；故意难听的说法

e.en: Calling the old car a rust bucket is a {dysphemism}.
e.zh: 把那辆旧车叫作破铁桶，是一种故意难听的说法。

e.en: The article used a harsh {dysphemism} for the policy.
e.zh: 那篇文章用一个粗直贬称来指代这项政策。

dysphemistic.t: 用粗直贬称的；难听化的

e.en: The headline chose a {dysphemistic} phrase for immigrants.
e.zh: 标题对移民使用了带贬损意味的难听说法。

e.en: His {dysphemistic} wording made the diagnosis sound frightening.
e.zh: 他的难听化措辞让这个诊断听起来很吓人。

e.en: The patient became {dyspnoeal} after climbing the stairs.
e.zh: 病人爬完楼梯后变得气促。

e.en: Doctors noted a {dyspnoeal} episode during the night.
e.zh: 医生记录到夜间出现了一次呼吸困难发作。

e.en: The child looked {dyspnoic} and needed oxygen.
e.zh: 那个孩子看起来呼吸困难，需要吸氧。

e.en: A {dyspnoic} patient should be assessed immediately.
e.zh: 出现气促的病人应立即接受评估。

dyspraxia.t: 运动协调障碍；动作失用症

e.en: Her {dyspraxia} made handwriting slow and tiring.
e.zh: 她的运动协调障碍让写字变得又慢又累。

e.en: The therapist helped children with {dyspraxia} plan movements.
e.zh: 治疗师帮助有动作失用症的孩子规划动作。

e.en: The magnet contains a small amount of {dysprosium}.
e.zh: 这块磁铁含有少量镝。

e.en: Engineers use {dysprosium} to improve heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师使用镝来提高耐热性。

dysprosody.t: 言语韵律障碍；语调异常

e.en: After the stroke, she developed {dysprosody} in her speech.
e.zh: 中风后，她说话出现了语调异常。

e.en: The clinician tested for {dysprosody} during conversation.
e.zh: 临床医生在交谈中检查是否有言语韵律障碍。

e.en: The surgeon described the wound problem as {dysrhaphia}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这个伤口问题描述为缝合不良。

e.en: Spinal {dysrhaphia} can affect nerve development.
e.zh: 脊柱闭合缺陷可能影响神经发育。

dysrhythmic.t: 节律异常的；心律失常的

e.en: The monitor showed a {dysrhythmic} heartbeat.
e.zh: 监护仪显示心跳节律异常。

e.en: His dancing looked oddly {dysrhythmic} to the music.
e.zh: 他的舞步跟音乐节奏显得很不协调。

dyssynergia.t: 协同失调；肌肉配合障碍

e.en: Pelvic floor {dyssynergia} can cause chronic constipation.
e.zh: 盆底协同失调可能导致长期便秘。

e.en: Neurological tests revealed {dyssynergia} in his movements.
e.zh: 神经系统检查发现他的动作存在协同失调。

e.en: The chemist described the compound as {dystectic}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物描述为难溶。

e.en: Older medical texts called such foods {dystectic}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献把这类食物称为难以消化的。

dysteleological.t: 反目的论的；无合目的性的

e.en: The philosopher offered a {dysteleological} reading of evolution.
e.zh: 那位哲学家提出了对进化的反目的论解读。

e.en: Disease was cited as a {dysteleological} feature of nature.
e.zh: 疾病被举作自然界无合目的性的特征。

dysteleology.t: 反目的论；无目的性学说

e.en: His essay discusses {dysteleology} in natural history.
e.zh: 他的文章讨论自然史中的反目的论。

e.en: The problem of pain often appears in debates on {dysteleology}.
e.zh: 痛苦问题常出现在关于无目的性学说的争论中。

dysteliology.t: 反目的论；无目的性研究

e.en: The lecture introduced {dysteliology} as a challenge to design arguments.
e.zh: 讲座把反目的论介绍为对设计论证的挑战。

e.en: Few students had heard of {dysteliology} before the seminar.
e.zh: 在研讨课之前，很少有学生听过无目的性研究。

dysthymiac.t: 心境恶劣者；持续抑郁者

e.en: The report described him as a chronic {dysthymiac}.
e.zh: 报告称他是长期心境恶劣者。

e.en: A {dysthymiac} may function well but feel persistently low.
e.zh: 持续抑郁者可能生活功能正常，却长期情绪低落。

dysthymic.t: 心境恶劣的；持续抑郁的

e.en: She had a {dysthymic} mood for many years.
e.zh: 她多年来一直处于持续抑郁的心境。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a {dysthymic} disorder.
e.zh: 医生诊断为心境恶劣障碍。

dysthyroidea.t: 甲状腺功能异常；甲状腺失调

e.en: The old chart listed {dysthyroidea} among her conditions.
e.zh: 旧病历把甲状腺功能异常列为她的病症之一。

e.en: Symptoms of {dysthyroidea} can resemble anxiety or fatigue.
e.zh: 甲状腺失调的症状可能像焦虑或疲劳。

e.en: The veterinarian treated a cow with {dystocia}.
e.zh: 兽医治疗了一头难产的母牛。

e.en: Shoulder {dystocia} is an obstetric emergency.
e.zh: 肩难产是一种产科急症。

dystonia.t: 肌张力障碍；肌肉痉挛症

e.en: Her {dystonia} caused painful neck spasms.
e.zh: 她的肌张力障碍导致颈部疼痛性痉挛。

e.en: Medication reduced the musician's hand {dystonia}.
e.zh: 药物减轻了那位音乐家的手部肌肉痉挛症。

dystrophia.t: 营养不良；组织萎缩变性

e.en: The diagnosis used the older term {dystrophia}.
e.zh: 诊断中使用了较旧的术语营养不良。

e.en: Muscular {dystrophia} was noted in the medical record.
e.zh: 病历中记录了肌肉萎缩变性。

dystrophic.t: 营养不良性的；萎缩变性的

e.en: The biopsy showed {dystrophic} changes in the tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示组织有萎缩变性的改变。

e.en: Some scars develop {dystrophic} calcification over time.
e.zh: 有些瘢痕会随时间出现营养不良性钙化。

dystrophication.t: 营养不良化；组织变性过程

e.en: The paper described gradual {dystrophication} of the muscle fibers.
e.zh: 论文描述了肌纤维逐渐发生营养不良化。

e.en: Local injury can lead to {dystrophication} in nearby tissue.
e.zh: 局部损伤可能导致邻近组织出现变性过程。

dystrophoneurosis.t: 营养神经症；神经营养障碍

e.en: The antique textbook mentioned {dystrophoneurosis} after trauma.
e.zh: 那本旧教材提到创伤后的营养神经症。

e.en: Doctors no longer use {dystrophoneurosis} in routine diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生在常规诊断中已不再使用神经营养障碍这个旧称。

e.en: The case notes used {dystrypsia} for persistent indigestion.
e.zh: 病例记录用消化困难来描述持续性消化不良。

e.en: Severe {dystrypsia} made eating uncomfortable for him.
e.zh: 严重的消化不良让他进食时很不舒服。

e.en: She reported {dysuria} and lower abdominal pain.
e.zh: 她说自己有尿痛和下腹痛。

e.en: A urinary infection often causes {dysuria}.
e.zh: 尿路感染常会引起排尿困难。

e.en: The patient reported {dysuric} symptoms after surgery.
e.zh: 病人报告术后出现排尿疼痛的症状。

e.en: A {dysuric} child may avoid going to the bathroom.
e.zh: 排尿困难的孩子可能会避免上厕所。

e.en: A {dytiscid} beetle surfaced near the pond edge.
e.zh: 一只龙虱科甲虫在池塘边浮出水面。

e.en: The guide identified the insect as a {dytiscid}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只昆虫是一种龙虱。

e.en: The old law treated a {dyvour} harshly.
e.zh: 旧法律对破产债务人处罚很严。

e.en: He called the cheat a {dyvour} in anger.
e.zh: 他气愤地把那个骗子骂作无赖。

e.en: His {dyvoury} ruined several small creditors.
e.zh: 他的破产让几位小债主受了损失。

e.en: The pamphlet denounced such {dyvoury} as shameful.
e.zh: 那本小册子谴责这种欺诈行为可耻。

e.en: A {dzeren} crossed the open steppe at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，一只蒙古原羚穿过开阔草原。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {dzeren} during its migration.
e.zh: 研究人员在迁徙期间追踪这只蒙古原羚。

e.en: The farmer used a {dzho} to carry supplies.
e.zh: 农民用一头牦牛杂交牛搬运物资。

e.en: A {dzho} can be stronger than ordinary cattle.
e.zh: 牦牛杂交牛可能比普通家牛更强壮。

e.en: The {dzigettai} galloped across the dry plain.
e.zh: 那头蒙古野驴飞奔过干燥的平原。

e.en: Few visitors ever see a {dzigettai} in the wild.
e.zh: 很少有游客在野外见过蒙古野驴。

e.en: A lone {dziggetai} stood beyond the ridge.
e.zh: 一头孤单的蒙古野驴站在山脊那边。

e.en: The old book described the {dziggetai} as swift.
e.zh: 那本旧书把蒙古野驴描述为行动迅捷。

e.en: They loaded grain onto the {dzo}.
e.zh: 他们把粮食装到那头牦牛杂交牛身上。

e.en: A {dzo} is useful in high mountain villages.
e.zh: 牦牛杂交牛在高山村庄很有用。

e.en: The {diciest} part of the climb came near the top.
e.zh: 攀登中最危险的部分出现在接近山顶时。

e.en: Choosing that supplier was the {diciest} decision we made.
e.zh: 选择那家供应商是我们做过的最不稳妥的决定。

e.en: Don't be a {dick-head} about a small mistake.
e.zh: 别因为一个小错误就表现得像个混蛋。

e.en: Everyone thought the loud {dick-head} ruined the meeting.
e.zh: 大家都觉得那个吵闹的蠢货毁了会议。

e.en: A {dickcissel} sang from the fence post.
e.zh: 一只迪克西塞尔草鹀在栅栏柱上鸣叫。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {dickcissel} in the prairie grass.
e.zh: 向导指出草原草丛里有一只迪克西塞尔草鹀。

e.en: He wore a white {dickey} under his jacket.
e.zh: 他在夹克里面戴了一片白色假衬胸。

e.en: The old chair has a {dickey} leg.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子有一条不稳的腿。

e.en: A little {dickey-bird} landed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只小鸟落在了窗台上。

e.en: She never said a {dickey-bird} about the missing keys.
e.zh: 她对丢失的钥匙一点消息也没透露。

e.en: The child watched a {dickeybird} hop across the path.
e.zh: 孩子看着一只小鸟跳过小路。

e.en: We heard not a {dickeybird} from him all week.
e.zh: 我们整整一周都没听到他一点消息。

e.en: The nursery rhyme begins with {dickory} after hickory.
e.zh: 那首童谣在hickory之后接着唱dickory。

e.en: She laughed at the silly word {dickory} in the rhyme.
e.zh: 她被童谣里dickory这个滑稽词逗笑了。

e.en: Some {dickwad} parked across two spaces.
e.zh: 有个讨厌鬼一辆车占了两个车位。

e.en: Stop acting like a {dickwad} and apologize.
e.zh: 别再像个蠢货一样，去道歉吧。

e.en: A {dicky-bird} was chirping in the hedge.
e.zh: 一只小鸟在树篱里啁啾。

e.en: Nobody heard a {dicky-bird} about the secret plan.
e.zh: 没人听到关于这个秘密计划的一点风声。

e.en: The {dickybird} flew out of the open cage.
e.zh: 那只小鸟从敞开的笼子里飞了出来。

e.en: He said not a {dickybird} during the interview.
e.zh: 他在面试中一句话也没说。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {diclofenamide} for her condition.
e.zh: 医生为她的病情开了双氯非那胺。

e.en: Patients should discuss {diclofenamide} side effects with a pharmacist.
e.zh: 患者应向药剂师咨询双氯非那胺的副作用。

e.en: Farmers used {diclofop} to control wild oats.
e.zh: 农民使用禾草灵来防治野燕麦。

e.en: The label explains when {diclofop} can be sprayed safely.
e.zh: 标签说明了何时可以安全喷洒禾草灵。

e.en: The grower applied {dicloran} to prevent fruit rot.
e.zh: 种植者施用二氯兰来预防果腐病。

e.en: Residue tests detected {dicloran} on some samples.
e.zh: 残留检测在一些样品上发现了二氯兰。

e.en: The infection responded well to {dicloxacillin}.
e.zh: 这种感染对双氯西林反应良好。

e.en: Take {dicloxacillin} exactly as the prescription says.
e.zh: 请严格按照处方服用双氯西林。

e.en: The paper described {diconchinine} as a quinine derivative.
e.zh: 论文把二辛可宁描述为奎宁衍生物。

e.en: Only a specialist would recognize {diconchinine} in that formula.
e.zh: 只有专家才会认出那个配方中的二辛可宁。

e.en: {Dicophane} was once widely used as an insecticide.
e.zh: 滴滴涕曾作为杀虫剂被广泛使用。

e.en: Environmental rules later restricted {dicophane} in many countries.
e.zh: 后来许多国家的环保法规限制了滴滴涕的使用。

e.en: A bean plant is a familiar {dicot}.
e.zh: 豆类植物是一种常见的双子叶植物。

e.en: The seedling showed two leaves, marking it as a {dicot}.
e.zh: 幼苗长出两片叶子，说明它是双子叶植物。

e.en: Many garden flowers are {dicots}.
e.zh: 许多园艺花卉都属于双子叶植物。

e.en: The lesson compared monocots with {dicots}.
e.zh: 这节课比较了单子叶植物和双子叶植物。

e.en: The botanist identified the sprout as a {dicotyl}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这株嫩芽认定为双子叶植物。

e.en: Old textbooks sometimes use {dicotyl} for a dicotyledon.
e.zh: 旧教材有时用dicotyl来指双子叶植物。

e.en: A sunflower is classified as a {dicotyledon}.
e.zh: 向日葵被归类为双子叶植物。

e.en: Each {dicotyledon} typically begins with two seed leaves.
e.zh: 每种双子叶植物通常从两片子叶开始生长。

e.en: Tomatoes are {dicotyledonous} plants.
e.zh: 番茄是双子叶植物。

e.en: The {dicotyledonous} seedling had two clear seed leaves.
e.zh: 这株双子叶幼苗有两片清晰的子叶。

e.en: His speech was full of careful {diplomaism}.
e.zh: 他的讲话充满了谨慎的外交腔调。

e.en: She used {diplomaism} to avoid offending either side.
e.zh: 她运用外交手腕，避免冒犯任何一方。

e.en: After lunch, a {drowsihead} settled over the class.
e.zh: 午饭后，全班都陷入昏昏欲睡的状态。

e.en: He looked like a {drowsihead} during the long sermon.
e.zh: 漫长的布道中，他看起来像个困得发懵的人。

e.en: The spring water was clear and {druable}.
e.zh: 泉水清澈，可以饮用。

e.en: They searched the island for any {druable} liquid.
e.zh: 他们在岛上寻找任何能喝的液体。

e.en: She worked {drudgingly} through the endless accounts.
e.zh: 她辛苦乏味地处理那些没完没了的账目。

e.en: He {drudgingly} carried stones up the hill.
e.zh: 他吃力地把石头一块块搬上山。

e.en: The {druffen} sailor sang outside the tavern.
e.zh: 那个醉醺醺的水手在酒馆外唱歌。

e.en: His {druffen} speech made everyone uneasy.
e.zh: 他酒醉后的讲话让大家都感到不自在。

e.en: The police arrested a {drug-dealer} near the station.
e.zh: 警方在车站附近逮捕了一名毒品贩子。

e.en: She refused to rent the room to a known {drug-dealer}.
e.zh: 她拒绝把房间租给一个出名的毒贩。

drug-fast.t: 药物固定的；耐药固定的

e.en: The stain produced a {drug-fast} reaction in the sample.
e.zh: 这种染色在样本中产生了药物固定反应。

e.en: Researchers noted several {drug-fast} bacterial forms.
e.zh: 研究人员注意到几种耐药固定的细菌形态。

e.en: The school promotes a {drug-free} campus.
e.zh: 学校提倡建设无毒品校园。

e.en: She chose a {drug-free} approach to pain management.
e.zh: 她选择不用药的方式来控制疼痛。

e.en: His {drug-habit} destroyed his career.
e.zh: 他的吸毒成瘾毁掉了事业。

e.en: The doctor asked about her daily {drug-habit}.
e.zh: 医生询问了她每天的用药习惯。

e.en: Hospitals are worried about {drug-resistant} infections.
e.zh: 医院担心耐药性感染。

e.en: The treatment failed against a {drug-resistant} strain.
e.zh: 这种治疗对一种耐药菌株无效。

e.en: I bought cough syrup at the {drug-store}.
e.zh: 我在药店买了止咳糖浆。

e.en: The old {drug-store} also sold magazines and candy.
e.zh: 那家老式药房还卖杂志和糖果。

e.en: The border patrol caught several {drug-traffickers}.
e.zh: 边境巡逻队抓获了几名毒品走私贩。

e.en: Local communities suffered under violent {drug-traffickers}.
e.zh: 当地社区深受暴力贩毒分子之害。

e.en: He learned {druggery} from an old apothecary.
e.zh: 他向一位老药剂师学习药材买卖。

e.en: The book describes medieval {druggery} in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细描写了中世纪的药物事务。

e.en: A faded {drugget} covered the hallway floor.
e.zh: 一块褪色的粗毛地毯铺在走廊地板上。

e.en: They placed {drugget} over the carpet during repairs.
e.zh: 维修时他们在地毯上铺了护毯布。

e.en: He preferred {drugless} treatment for mild back pain.
e.zh: 他更愿意用不用药的方法治疗轻微背痛。

e.en: The clinic advertised {drugless} healing methods.
e.zh: 那家诊所宣传无药物的疗法。

e.en: A {drugpusher} approached teenagers outside the club.
e.zh: 一个毒贩在俱乐部外接近青少年。

e.en: The novel portrays the {drugpusher} as ruthless.
e.zh: 这部小说把那个兜售毒品者刻画得冷酷无情。

e.en: The village {drugster} prepared herbs for fever.
e.zh: 村里的药商配制草药来退烧。

e.en: An old {drugster} kept jars behind the counter.
e.zh: 一位老药剂师把罐子放在柜台后面。

e.en: The legend tells of a wise {druidess}.
e.zh: 传说讲述了一位睿智的女德鲁伊。

e.en: A {druidess} blessed the grove before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前，一位女祭司为树林祝福。

e.en: The radio used a {duodiode-pentide} valve.
e.zh: 这台收音机使用了双二极五极电子管。

e.en: He replaced the faulty {duodiode-pentide} in the receiver.
e.zh: 他更换了接收机里故障的双二极五极电子管。

e.en: The circuit diagram shows a {duodiode-pentode}.
e.zh: 电路图上标有一个双二极五极管。

e.en: Collectors still search for this {duodiode-pentode} tube.
e.zh: 收藏者仍在寻找这种双二极五极电子管。

e.en: The amplifier contains a {duodiode-triode} stage.
e.zh: 这台放大器包含一级双二极三极管电路。

e.en: A {duodiode-triode} combined detection and amplification.
e.zh: 双二极三极管把检波和放大功能结合在一起。

e.en: The engineer tested a {duodynatron} oscillator.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一只双负阻振荡电子管。

e.en: A rare {duodynatron} appeared in the museum display.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里出现了一只罕见的双负阻振荡电子管。

e.en: The textbook used a {duograph} to compare prices.
e.zh: 教材用双线图比较价格。

e.en: She drew a {duograph} showing two related trends.
e.zh: 她画了一张双重图来显示两个相关趋势。

e.en: The window was fitted with {duolex} glass.
e.zh: 这扇窗装了双层玻璃。

e.en: The instrument used a {duolex} lens system.
e.zh: 这台仪器使用了双层透镜系统。

e.en: The actors performed a witty {duologue}.
e.zh: 两位演员表演了一段机智的二人对话。

e.en: Her play begins with a tense {duologue}.
e.zh: 她的剧本以一场紧张的二人戏开头。

e.en: The old treaty was signed by several {diplomata} from Europe.
e.zh: 这份旧条约由几名欧洲外交官签署。

e.en: In formal Latin-influenced prose, {diplomata} may mean diplomatic documents.
e.zh: 在带拉丁色彩的正式文体中，diplomata也可指外交文件。

e.en: The minister answered in careful {diplomatese} that revealed little.
e.zh: 部长用谨慎的外交辞令回答，几乎没有透露什么。

e.en: Her apology sounded like corporate {diplomatese} rather than regret.
e.zh: 她的道歉听起来像企业式官样话，而不像真后悔。

diplomatise.t: 使外交化；用外交方式处理

e.en: The committee tried to {diplomatise} the dispute before it reached court.
e.zh: 委员会试图先用外交方式处理这场争端，避免闹上法庭。

e.en: He tends to {diplomatise} every blunt criticism into polite advice.
e.zh: 他总会把每句直白批评都处理成委婉建议。

e.en: Her quiet {diplomatism} kept the coalition from collapsing.
e.zh: 她沉稳的外交手腕让联盟没有崩溃。

e.en: The speech valued {diplomatism} over direct confrontation.
e.zh: 这篇演讲重视外交作风，而不是直接对抗。

e.en: The retired {diplomatist} wrote memoirs about secret negotiations.
e.zh: 那位退休外交家写了关于秘密谈判的回忆录。

e.en: As a family {diplomatist}, she settled arguments before dinner.
e.zh: 作为家里的调停高手，她总能在晚饭前平息争吵。

diplomatize.t: 使外交化；以外交手段处理

e.en: They hoped to {diplomatize} the border issue through quiet talks.
e.zh: 他们希望通过低调会谈以外交方式处理边境问题。

e.en: Please do not {diplomatize} a simple request into a formal statement.
e.zh: 请不要把一个简单请求包装成正式声明。

e.en: The physician noted {diplomellituria} in the rare metabolic report.
e.zh: 医生在那份罕见代谢报告中记录了尿中含葡萄糖和果糖。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes list {diplomellituria} beside other sugar disorders.
e.zh: 旧医学书有时把diplomellituria列在其他糖代谢异常旁边。

e.en: The botanist described the moss as {diplomonoecious} in her notes.
e.zh: 植物学家在笔记中把这种苔藓描述为双性同株。

e.en: A {diplomonoecious} plant can bear both sexual structures on one individual.
e.zh: 双性同株植物可在同一个体上具有两类性结构。

e.en: In this life cycle, the {diplon} dominates the visible generation.
e.zh: 在这种生活史中，双倍体阶段占据可见世代。

e.en: The lecturer contrasted a {diplon} with a haploid organism.
e.zh: 讲师把双倍体个体与单倍体生物作了对比。

e.en: The paper used {diplonomy} to explain the paired naming system.
e.zh: 论文用双重命名法解释这种成对命名体系。

e.en: Few students had encountered {diplonomy} outside specialist terminology.
e.zh: 很少有学生在专业术语之外见过diplonomy这个词。

diplont.t: 双倍体生物；双倍体阶段

e.en: A human is a {diplont} for most of the life cycle.
e.zh: 人在生命周期的大部分时间里属于双倍体生物。

e.en: The diagram labels the {diplont} stage after fertilization.
e.zh: 图示把受精后的阶段标为双倍体阶段。

e.en: The insect population spread through {diploparthenogenesis} without males.
e.zh: 这个昆虫种群通过二倍体孤雌生殖在没有雄性的情况下扩散。

e.en: Researchers confirmed {diploparthenogenesis} by checking the offspring's chromosomes.
e.zh: 研究人员通过检查后代染色体确认了二倍体孤雌生殖。

e.en: The alga spends winter in its {diplophase}.
e.zh: 这种藻类以二倍体阶段越冬。

e.en: During the {diplophase}, each cell carries paired chromosomes.
e.zh: 在二倍体阶段，每个细胞都带有成对染色体。

e.en: The singer developed {diplophonia} after a throat infection.
e.zh: 这名歌手喉咙感染后出现了复声症。

e.en: Doctors heard {diplophonia} when the patient sustained a vowel.
e.zh: 患者持续发元音时，医生听到了双重发声。

e.en: A {diplopod} curled tightly under the damp log.
e.zh: 一只马陆在潮湿木头下紧紧蜷成一团。

e.en: The museum specimen was labeled as a tropical {diplopod}.
e.zh: 博物馆标本被标注为一种热带倍足类动物。

e.en: After the accident, she reported {diplopy} in her left eye.
e.zh: 事故后，她说左眼出现了复视。

e.en: Temporary {diplopy} can make reading and driving difficult.
e.zh: 暂时性复视会让阅读和开车变得困难。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {diplosal} compound for analysis.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种复盐化合物用于分析。

e.en: Older manuals use {diplosal} where modern texts say double-salt.
e.zh: 旧手册使用diplosal这个词，现代文本则说double-salt。

diploscope.t: 复视检查器；双眼视觉仪

e.en: The clinic used a {diploscope} to test binocular vision.
e.zh: 诊所用复视检查器测试双眼视觉。

e.en: An old {diploscope} sat beside the ophthalmologist's desk.
e.zh: 一台旧的双眼视觉仪放在眼科医生桌旁。

e.en: The textbook described chromosome {diplosis} after fertilization.
e.zh: 教材描述了受精后染色体的二倍化。

e.en: Ancient physicians used {diplosis} for certain forms of double vision.
e.zh: 古代医生用diplosis指某些形式的复视。

e.en: The veterinary report recorded {diplosomatia} in the malformed calf.
e.zh: 兽医报告记录了那头畸形小牛的双体畸形。

e.en: Cases of {diplosomatia} are usually discussed in embryology texts.
e.zh: 双体畸形病例通常见于胚胎学教材的讨论中。

e.en: The grass can reproduce by {diplospory} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 这种草在特定条件下可以通过二倍孢子生殖繁殖。

e.en: Her thesis compared {diplospory} with other forms of apomixis.
e.zh: 她的论文把二倍孢子生殖与其他无融合生殖形式作了比较。

e.en: The flower is {diplostemonous}, with stamens in two whorls.
e.zh: 这种花雄蕊两轮排列，具有两圈雄蕊。

e.en: A {diplostemonous} arrangement helped identify the plant family.
e.zh: 雄蕊两轮的排列有助于识别这个植物科。

e.en: The leaves were {diplostichous} along the slender stem.
e.zh: 叶子沿细茎呈两列排列。

e.en: She sketched the {diplostichous} pattern before collecting samples.
e.zh: 采样前，她先画下了这种两列排列的模式。

e.en: The fish farm reported {diplostomiasis} after many trout went blind.
e.zh: 许多鳟鱼失明后，鱼场报告出现了双穴吸虫病。

e.en: Microscopy confirmed {diplostomiasis} in the infected fish eyes.
e.zh: 显微镜检查确认受感染鱼眼中存在双穴吸虫病。

e.en: The {directrice} welcomed the guests to the French school.
e.zh: 女校长欢迎客人来到这所法国学校。

e.en: In the old hotel, the {directrice} managed every detail personally.
e.zh: 在那家老酒店里，女主管亲自管理每个细节。

e.en: The {drillmaster} shouted commands across the yard.
e.zh: 操练教官在院子里大声发号施令。

e.en: Her piano teacher was a strict {drillmaster}.
e.zh: 她的钢琴老师是个严厉训练者。

e.en: The {drillship} moved closer to the offshore field.
e.zh: 那艘钻井船驶近了海上油田。

e.en: Engineers lived on the {drillship} for weeks.
e.zh: 工程师们在钻井船上住了好几个星期。

e.en: The machinist selected a piece of {drillstock}.
e.zh: 机加工师傅挑选了一块钻具材料。

e.en: Old {drillstock} was stored behind the workshop.
e.zh: 旧的钻柄坯料存放在车间后面。

e.en: The technician checked the grain with a {drimeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用湿度测定仪检查谷物。

e.en: A faulty {drimeter} gave misleading moisture readings.
e.zh: 一台有故障的干燥计给出了误导性的含水读数。

e.en: The beetle is considered {drimophilous} by local naturalists.
e.zh: 当地博物学家认为这种甲虫喜栖树林。

e.en: Some {drimophilous} species vanish when forests are cleared.
e.zh: 一些林栖物种会在森林被砍伐后消失。

e.en: Police stopped a {drink-driver} near the station.
e.zh: 警方在车站附近拦下了一名酒驾司机。

e.en: The campaign warned every {drink-driver} about severe penalties.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动警告每个醉酒驾驶者会面临严厉处罚。

e.en: He lost his licence for {drink-driving}.
e.zh: 他因酒后驾驶被吊销了驾照。

e.en: New laws made {drink-driving} penalties much tougher.
e.zh: 新法律大幅加重了醉酒驾驶的处罚。

e.en: The wine has excellent {drinkability} despite its age.
e.zh: 这款酒虽然年份久，但适饮性很好。

e.en: Brewers test a beer's {drinkability} before release.
e.zh: 酿酒师会在上市前测试啤酒的好喝程度。

e.en: They found a noisy {drinkery} near the docks.
e.zh: 他们在码头附近找到一家吵闹的酒馆。

e.en: The old {drinkery} became a quiet cafe.
e.zh: 那家旧酒馆后来变成了一间安静的咖啡馆。

e.en: Let's have a quick {drinkie} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭前我们先小喝一杯吧。

e.en: She called every cocktail a little {drinkie}.
e.zh: 她把每杯鸡尾酒都叫作一小杯饮料。

e.en: The child dropped his {drinking-cup} on the floor.
e.zh: 那个孩子把饮水杯掉在了地上。

e.en: Each camper brought a metal {drinking-cup}.
e.zh: 每个露营者都带了一个金属饮水杯。

e.en: She filled her bottle at the {drinking-fountain}.
e.zh: 她在饮水机那里把水瓶装满。

e.en: The school installed a new {drinking-fountain}.
e.zh: 学校安装了一台新的公共饮水机。

e.en: The park has several {drinking-fountains} near the paths.
e.zh: 公园小路旁有几处公共饮水喷泉。

e.en: Many old {drinking-fountains} were replaced last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天许多旧饮水机被更换了。

e.en: It was a strangely {drinkless} wedding reception.
e.zh: 那场婚宴奇怪地没有酒水。

e.en: After hours in the sun, we remained {drinkless}.
e.zh: 在太阳下待了几个小时后，我们仍然没有饮料。

e.en: He became talkative and {drinky} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后他变得话多，还带着酒意。

e.en: The party had a loud, {drinky} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那场聚会气氛喧闹，充满酒意。

driography.t: 平版复制术；无水印刷法

e.en: The museum displayed prints made by {driography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了用无水印刷法制作的版画。

e.en: Few students had heard of {driography} before the workshop.
e.zh: 工作坊前很少有学生听说过平版复制术。

e.en: The {drip-drip} from the tap kept me awake.
e.zh: 水龙头的滴答声让我一直睡不着。

e.en: A {drip-drip} of bad news damaged confidence.
e.zh: 坏消息一点点传来，损害了信心。

e.en: We heard the {drip-drop} of rain on the roof.
e.zh: 我们听见雨水在屋顶上滴滴答答。

e.en: The cave echoed with a steady {drip-drop}.
e.zh: 洞穴里回响着稳定的滴答落水声。

e.en: This shirt is made from {drip-dry} fabric.
e.zh: 这件衬衫是用滴干免熨面料做的。

e.en: Hang the swimsuit up to {drip-dry}.
e.zh: 把泳衣挂起来让它滴干。

drip-feed.t: 点滴输送；逐步少量提供

e.en: Nurses used a {drip-feed} to give him fluids.
e.zh: 护士用点滴给他补充液体。

e.en: The company chose to {drip-feed} information to reporters.
e.zh: 公司选择逐步少量地向记者透露信息。

e.en: She packed a {dripdry} dress for the trip.
e.zh: 她为旅行带了一条滴干免熨的连衣裙。

e.en: Let the jacket {dripdry} in the bathroom.
e.zh: 把夹克放在浴室里让它滴干。

e.en: The chef used a {dripless} oil bottle.
e.zh: 厨师使用了一个防滴漏油瓶。

e.en: A {dripless} faucet saves water and frustration.
e.zh: 不滴漏的水龙头既省水也省心。

drownproofing.t: 防溺水漂浮法；自救游法

e.en: The class taught basic {drownproofing} to beginners.
e.zh: 这门课教初学者基本的防溺水漂浮法。

e.en: Good {drownproofing} helps swimmers conserve energy.
e.zh: 良好的自救游法能帮助游泳者保存体力。

drowsiest.t: 最困倦的；最昏昏欲睡的

e.en: I felt {drowsiest} during the afternoon lecture.
e.zh: 下午听讲座时我感到最困。

e.en: The baby was {drowsiest} after her bath.
e.zh: 洗完澡后，宝宝最昏昏欲睡。

e.en: The designer checked the {duopage} spread before printing.
e.zh: 设计师在印刷前检查了这组对开页版面。

e.en: A {duopage} layout can make photos feel more dramatic.
e.zh: 双页版式能让照片显得更有冲击力。

e.en: The study examined {duoparental} care in several bird species.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了几种鸟类中双亲共同育雏的情况。

e.en: They preferred a {duoparental} approach to early childcare.
e.zh: 他们更倾向于由双亲共同参与早期育儿。

e.en: The engineer tested a {duophase} cooling system under load.
e.zh: 工程师在负载条件下测试了两相冷却系统。

e.en: Their plan used a {duophase} rollout for the new policy.
e.zh: 他们的新政策采用了双阶段推进方案。

e.en: The laboratory repaired the {duopigatron} after the beam became unstable.
e.zh: 束流变得不稳定后，实验室修理了这台双等离子体离子源。

e.en: A {duopigatron} can generate intense ion beams for experiments.
e.zh: 双等离子体离子源能为实验产生高强度离子束。

e.en: The accelerator used a {duoplasmatron} to supply ions.
e.zh: 这台加速器使用双等离子体离子源来提供离子。

e.en: Technicians adjusted the {duoplasmatron} before the morning run.
e.zh: 技术人员在上午运行前调校了双等离子体离子源。

e.en: The market became increasingly {duopolistic} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后，这个市场越来越呈现双头垄断格局。

e.en: Regulators worried about {duopolistic} pricing in the industry.
e.zh: 监管机构担心该行业出现双头垄断式定价。

e.en: Economists described the local crop market as a {duopsony}.
e.zh: 经济学家把当地农产品市场描述为双买主垄断。

e.en: A {duopsony} can push suppliers into accepting lower prices.
e.zh: 双买主垄断可能迫使供应商接受更低价格。

e.en: The city considered a {duorail} system for the airport link.
e.zh: 该市考虑为机场线建设双轨系统。

e.en: Workers inspected the {duorail} before passenger service resumed.
e.zh: 客运恢复前，工人检查了这段双轨铁路。

e.en: The portrait was printed in {duotone} for a vintage effect.
e.zh: 这张肖像采用双色调印刷，以营造复古效果。

e.en: She chose a blue and black {duotone} for the poster.
e.zh: 她为海报选择了蓝黑双色调。

e.en: The radio circuit used a {duotriode} in the amplifier stage.
e.zh: 这个无线电电路在放大级使用了双三极管。

e.en: He replaced the faulty {duotriode} with a modern equivalent.
e.zh: 他用现代等效元件替换了故障的双三极管。

e.en: The archive preserved a rare {duotype} of the old engraving.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了一幅罕见的旧版画双色版。

e.en: Printers used {duotype} to add depth without full color.
e.zh: 印刷工用双色印刷法在不做全彩的情况下增加层次感。

e.en: The software team tested the {dupability} of the reported bug.
e.zh: 软件团队测试了这个已报告故障的可复现性。

e.en: High {dupability} made the design easy to manufacture.
e.zh: 较高的可复制性使这个设计容易投入制造。

e.en: The file is {dupable} without losing its original formatting.
e.zh: 这个文件可以复制而不会丢失原有格式。

e.en: He was not easily {dupable} by a smooth sales pitch.
e.zh: 他不容易被花言巧语的推销说辞骗倒。

e.en: She draped a red {dupatta} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把一条红色南亚长披巾披在肩上。

e.en: The bride's {dupatta} was embroidered with gold thread.
e.zh: 新娘的长披巾上绣着金线。

e.en: The memoir exposed the old {duperies} of the court.
e.zh: 这本回忆录揭露了宫廷昔日的种种欺骗行为。

e.en: Investors eventually saw through his elaborate {duperies}.
e.zh: 投资者最终看穿了他精心设计的骗局。

e.en: The trial revealed years of financial {dupery}.
e.zh: 审判揭露了多年来的财务欺骗。

e.en: She dismissed the rumor as political {dupery}.
e.zh: 她把这个传闻斥为政治诈术。
